  24 class CLANN_Portlet extends UserDesktopPortlet
  25 {
  26 
  27     public function __construct ( $label )
  28     {
  29         parent::__construct ( $label );
  30 
  31         $this->name = 'Latest announcements';
  32         $this->label = 'CLANN_Portlet';
  33 
  34         if ( file_exists ( claro_get_conf_repository () . 'CLANN.conf.php' ) )
  35         {
  36             include claro_get_conf_repository () . 'CLANN.conf.php';
  37         }
  38     }

  40     public function renderContent ()
  41     {
  42         $personnalCourseList = get_user_course_list ( claro_get_current_user_id () );
  43 
  44         $announcementEventList = announcement_get_items_portlet ( $personnalCourseList );
  45 
  46         $output = '';
  47 
  48         if ( $announcementEventList )
  49         {
  50             $output .= '<dl id="portletMyAnnouncements">';
  51 
  52             foreach ( $announcementEventList as $announcementItem )
  53             {
  54                 // Hide hidden and expired elements
  55                 $isVisible = (bool) ($announcementItem[ 'visibility' ] == 'SHOW') ? (1) : (0);
  56                 
  57                 $isOffDeadline = (bool)
  58                 (
  59                     (isset ( $announcementItem[ 'visibleFrom' ] )
  60                         && strtotime ( $announcementItem[ 'visibleFrom' ] ) > time ()
  61                     )
  62                     ||
  63                     (isset ( $announcementItem[ 'visibleUntil' ] )
  64                         && time () >= strtotime ( $announcementItem[ 'visibleUntil' ] )
  65                     )
  66                 ) ? (1) : (0);
  67 
  68                 if ( $isVisible && !$isOffDeadline )
  69                 {
  70                     $output .= '<dt>' . "\n"
  71                         . '<img class="iconDefinitionList" src="' . get_icon_url ( 'announcement', 'CLANN' ) . '" alt="" />'
  72                         . ' <a href="' . $announcementItem[ 'url' ] . '">'
  73                         . $announcementItem[ 'title' ]
  74                         . '</a>' . "\n"
  75                         . '</dt>' . "\n";
  76 
  77                     foreach ( $announcementItem[ 'eventList' ] as $announcementEvent )
  78                     {
  79                         // Prepare the render
  80                         $displayChar = 250;
  81 
  82                         if ( strlen ( $announcementEvent[ 'content' ] ) > $displayChar )
  83                         {
  84                             $content = substr ( $announcementEvent[ 'content' ], 0, $displayChar )
  85                                 . '... <a href="'
  86                                 . claro_htmlspecialchars ( Url::Contextualize ( $announcementEvent[ 'url' ] ) ) . '">'
  87                                 . '<b>' . get_lang ( 'Read more &raquo;' ) . '</b></a>';
  88                         }
  89                         else
  90                         {
  91                             $content = $announcementEvent[ 'content' ];
  92                         }
  93 
  94                         $output .= '<dd>'
  95                             . '<a href="' . $announcementEvent[ 'url' ] . '">'
  96                             . $announcementItem[ 'courseOfficialCode' ]
  97                             . '</a> : ' . "\n"
  98                             . (!empty ( $announcementEvent[ 'title' ] ) ?
  99                                 $announcementEvent[ 'title' ] :
 100                                 get_lang ( 'No title' )) . "\n"
 101                             . ' - '
 102                             . $content . "\n"
 103                             . '</dd>' . "\n";
 104                     }
 105                 }
 106             }
 107             
 108             $output .= '</dl>';
 109         }
 110         else
 111         {
 112             $output .= "\n"
 113                 . '<dl>' . "\n"
 114                 . '<dt>' . "\n"
 115                 . '<img class="iconDefinitionList" src="' . get_icon_url ( 'announcement', 'CLANN' ) . '" alt="" />'
 116                 . ' ' . get_lang ( 'No announcement to display' ) . "\n"
 117                 . '</dt>' . "\n"
 118                 . '</dl>' . "\n";
 119         }
 120 
 121         return $output;
 122     }

 127     }
 128 
 129 }

   5 /**
   6  * CLAROLINE
   7  *
   8  * The script works with the 'annoucement' tables in the main claroline table
   9  *
  10  * DB Table structure:
  11  * ---
  12  *
  13  * id         : announcement id
  14  * contenu    : announcement content
  15  * visibleFrom  : date of the publication of the announcement
  16  * visibleUntil  : date of expiration of the announcement
  17  * temps      : date of the announcement introduction / modification
  18  * title      : optionnal title for an announcement
  19  * ordre      : order of the announcement display
  20  *              (the announcements are display in desc order)
  21  *
  22  * @version     1.8 $Revision: 14461 $
  23  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  24  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html (GPL) GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
  25  * @package     CLANN
  26  * @author      Claro Team <cvs@claroline.net>
  27  * @author      Christophe Gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
  28  */
  29 
  30 
  31 /**
  32  * Get list of all announcements in the given or current course.
  33  *
  34  * @param array     $thisCourse
  35  * @param int       $limit number of records to return
  36  * @param int       $startTime
  37  * @param bool      $visibleOnly
  38  * @return array of array(id, title, content, time, visibility, rank)
  39  * @since 1.7
  40  */
  41 function announcement_get_course_item_list($thisCourse, $limit = null, $startTime = null, $visibleOnly = true )
  42 {
  43     // **** Caution: has to get fixed !
  44     $tableAnn = get_conf('courseTablePrefix') . $thisCourse['db'] . get_conf('dbGlu') . 'announcement';
  45     // ****
  46     
  47     $sql = "SELECT '" . claro_sql_escape($thisCourse['sysCode']     ) ."' AS `courseSysCode`, \n"
  48             . "'" . claro_sql_escape($thisCourse['officialCode']) ."'     AS `courseOfficialCode`, \n"
  49             . "'CLANN'                                              AS `toolLabel`,\n"
  50             . "CONCAT(`temps`, ' ', '00:00:00')                     AS `date`, \n"
  51             . "CONCAT(`title`,' - ',`contenu`)                      AS `content`, \n"
  52             . "`visibility`, \n"
  53             . "`visibleFrom`, \n"
  54             . "`visibleUntil` \n"
  55             . "FROM `" . $tableAnn . "` \n"
  56             . "WHERE CONCAT(`title`, `contenu`) != '' \n"
  57             . ( $startTime ? '' : "AND DATE_FORMAT( `temps`, '%Y %m %d') >= '".date('Y m d', (double)$startTime)."' \n" )
  58             . ( $visibleOnly ? "  AND visibility = 'SHOW' \n" : '' )
  59             . "ORDER BY `date` DESC \n"
  60             . ( $limit ? "LIMIT " . (int) $limit : '' )
  61             ;
  62     
  63     return claro_sql_query_fetch_all_cols($sql);
  64 }
  65 
  66 
  67 /**
  68  * Get list of all announcements in the given or current course.
  69  *
  70  * @param array     $thisCourse
  71  * @param int       $limit number of records to return
  72  * @param int       $startTime
  73  * @param bool      $visibleOnly
  74  * @return array of array(id, title, content, time, visibility, rank)
  75  * @since 1.7
  76  */
  77 function announcement_get_course_item_list_portlet($thisCourse, $limit = null, $startTime = null, $visibleOnly = true )
  78 {
  79     // **** Caution: has to get fixed !
  80     $tableAnn = get_conf('courseTablePrefix') . $thisCourse['db'] . get_conf('dbGlu') . 'announcement';
  81     // ****
  82     
  83     $curdate = claro_mktime();
  84     
  85     $sql = "SELECT '" . claro_sql_escape($thisCourse['sysCode']     ) ."' AS `courseSysCode`, \n"
  86          . "'" . claro_sql_escape($thisCourse['officialCode']) ."'  AS `courseOfficialCode`, \n"
  87          . "'CLANN'                                                 AS `toolLabel`, \n"
  88          . "CONCAT(`temps`, ' ', '00:00:00')                        AS `date`, \n"
  89          . "`id`                                                    AS `id`, \n"
  90          . "`title`                                                 AS `title`, \n"
  91          . "`contenu`                                               AS `content`, \n"
  92          . "`visibility`, \n"
  93          . "`visibleFrom`, \n"
  94          . "`visibleUntil` \n"
  95          . "FROM `" . $tableAnn . "` \n"
  96          . "WHERE CONCAT(`title`, `contenu`) != '' \n"
  97          . ( $startTime ? '' : "AND DATE_FORMAT( `temps`, '%Y %m %d') >= '".date('Y m d', (double)$startTime)."' \n" )
  98          . ( $visibleOnly ? "  AND visibility = 'SHOW' \n" : '' )
  99          . "            AND (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`visibleFrom`) < '". $curdate ."'
 100                               OR `visibleFrom` IS NULL OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`visibleFrom`)=0
 101                             )
 102                         AND ('". $curdate ."' < UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`visibleUntil`) OR `visibleUntil` IS NULL)"
 103          . "ORDER BY `date` DESC \n"
 104          . ( $limit ? "LIMIT " . (int) $limit : '' );
 105     
 106     return claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sql);
 107 }
 108 
 109 function announcement_get_items_portlet($personnalCourseList)
 110 {
 111     $courseDigestList = array();
 112     
 113     $clannToolId = get_tool_id_from_module_label('CLANN');
 114     
 115     foreach($personnalCourseList as $thisCourse)
 116     {
 117         if ( is_module_installed_in_course_lightversion ( 'CLANN', $thisCourse ) 
 118             && is_tool_activated_in_course_lightversion( $clannToolId, $thisCourse )
 119             && is_tool_visible_for_portlet( $clannToolId, $thisCourse['sysCode'] ) )
 120         {
 121             $courseEventList = announcement_get_course_item_list_portlet($thisCourse, get_conf('announcementPortletMaxItems', 3));
 122 
 123             if ( is_array($courseEventList) )
 124             {
 125                 foreach($courseEventList as $thisEvent)
 126                 {
 127                     $courseTitle = trim(strip_tags($thisCourse['title']));
 128                     if ( $courseTitle == '' )
 129                     {
 130                         $courseTitle = substr($courseTitle, 0, 60) . (strlen($courseTitle) > 60 ? ' (...)' : '');
 131                     }
 132 
 133                     $eventContent = trim(strip_tags($thisEvent['content']));
 134                     if ( $eventContent == '' )
 135                     {
 136                         $eventContent = substr($eventContent, 0, 60) . (strlen($eventContent) > 60 ? ' (...)' : '');
 137                     }
 138 
 139                     $courseOfficialCode = $thisEvent['courseOfficialCode'];
 140 
 141                     if(!array_key_exists($courseOfficialCode, $courseDigestList))
 142                     {
 143                         $courseDigestList[$courseOfficialCode] = array();
 144                         $courseDigestList[$courseOfficialCode]['eventList'] = array();
 145                         $courseDigestList[$courseOfficialCode]['id'] = $thisEvent['id'];
 146                         $courseDigestList[$courseOfficialCode]['courseOfficialCode'] = $courseOfficialCode;
 147                         $courseDigestList[$courseOfficialCode]['title'] = $courseTitle;
 148                         $courseDigestList[$courseOfficialCode]['visibility'] = $thisEvent['visibility'];
 149                         $courseDigestList[$courseOfficialCode]['visibleFrom'] = $thisEvent['visibleFrom'];
 150                         $courseDigestList[$courseOfficialCode]['visibleUntil'] = $thisEvent['visibleUntil'];
 151                         $courseDigestList[$courseOfficialCode]['url'] = get_path('url')
 152                             . '/claroline/announcements/announcements.php?cidReq='
 153                             . $thisEvent['courseSysCode'];
 154                     }
 155 
 156                     $courseDigestList[$courseOfficialCode]['eventList'][] =
 157                         array(
 158                             'id' => $thisEvent['id'],
 159                             'courseSysCode' => $thisEvent['courseSysCode'],
 160                             'toolLabel' => $thisEvent['toolLabel'],
 161                             'title' => $thisEvent['title'],
 162                             'content' => $eventContent,
 163                             'date' => $thisEvent['date'],
 164                             'url' => get_path('url')
 165                                 . '/claroline/announcements/announcements.php?cidReq='
 166                                 . $thisEvent['courseSysCode']
 167                                 . '#item'.$thisEvent['id']
 168                         );
 169                 }
 170             }
 171         }
 172     }
 173     
 174     return $courseDigestList;
 175 }

 227 /**
 228  * Add a new announcement in the given or current course.
 229  *
 230  * @param string    $title title of the new item
 231  * @param string    $content   content of the new item
 232  * @param date      $visibleFrom
 233  * @param date      $visibleUntil
 234  * @param bool      visibility
 235  * @param date      $time  publication date of the item def:now
 236  * @param string    $course_id sysCode of the course (leaveblank for current course)
 237  * @return id of the new item
 238  * @since 1.7
 239  * @todo convert to param date timestamp
 240  */
 241 function announcement_add_item($title='',$content='', $visible_from=null, $visible_until=null, $visibility=null, $time=null, $course_id=null)
 242 {
 243     $tbl= claro_sql_get_course_tbl(claro_get_course_db_name_glued($course_id));
 244     
 245     $sqlTime = (is_null($time)) ? ($sqlTime = "NOW()") : ("FROM_UNIXTIME('". (int) $time ."')");
 246     
 247     // Determine the position of the new announcement
 248     $sql = "SELECT (MAX(ordre) + 1) AS nextRank
 249             FROM  `" . $tbl['announcement'] . "`";
 250     
 251     $nextRank = claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sql);
 252     
 253     $visibility = (($visibility == 1) ? ("SHOW") : ("HIDE"));
 254     $visible_from = (!is_null($visible_from) ? ("'".claro_sql_escape($visible_from)."'") : ("NULL"));
 255     $visible_until = (!is_null($visible_until) ? ("'".claro_sql_escape($visible_until)."'") : ("NULL"));
 256     
 257     // Insert announcement
 258     $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $tbl['announcement'] . "`
 259             SET title           = '" . claro_sql_escape(trim($title)) . "',
 260                 contenu         = '" . claro_sql_escape(trim($content)) . "',
 261                 temps           = " . $sqlTime .",
 262                 visibleFrom     = " . $visible_from . ",
 263                 visibleUntil    = " . $visible_until . ",
 264                 ordre           = '" . (int) $nextRank . "',
 265                 visibility      = '" . $visibility . "'";
 266     
 267     return claro_sql_query_insert_id($sql);
 268 }

 270 /**
 271  * Update an announcement in the given or current course.
 272  *
 273  * @param string    $title     title of the new item
 274  * @param string    $content   content of the new item
 275  * @param date      $visible_from
 276  * @param date      $visible_until
 277  * @param bool      visibility
 278  * @param date      $time      publication date of the item def:now
 279  * @param string    $course_id sysCode of the course (leaveblank for current course)
 280  * @return handler of query
 281  * @since 1.7
 282  * @todo convert to param date timestamp
 283  */
 284 function announcement_update_item($announcement_id, $title=null, $content=null, $visible_from=null, $visible_until=null, $visibility=null, $time=null, $course_id=null)
 285 {
 286     $tbl= claro_sql_get_course_tbl(claro_get_course_db_name_glued($course_id));
 287     
 288     $visibility = (($visibility == 1) ? ("SHOW") : ("HIDE"));
 289     $visible_from = (!is_null($visible_from) ? ("'".claro_sql_escape($visible_from)."'") : ("NULL"));
 290     $visible_until = (!is_null($visible_until) ? ("'".claro_sql_escape($visible_until)."'") : ("NULL"));
 291     
 292     $sqlSet = array();
 293     if(!is_null($title))      $sqlSet[] = " title = '" . claro_sql_escape(trim($title)) . "' ";
 294     if(!is_null($content))    $sqlSet[] = " contenu = '" . claro_sql_escape(trim($content)) . "' ";
 295     if(!is_null($content))    $sqlSet[] = " visibleFrom = " . $visible_from . " ";
 296     if(!is_null($content))    $sqlSet[] = " visibleUntil = " . $visible_until . " ";
 297     if(!is_null($visibility)) $sqlSet[] = " visibility = '" . $visibility . "' ";
 298     if(!is_null($time))       $sqlSet[] = " temps = from_unixtime('".(int)$time."') ";
 299     
 300     if (count($sqlSet) > 0)
 301     {
 302         $sql = "UPDATE  `" . $tbl['announcement'] . "`
 303                 SET " . implode(', ', $sqlSet) . "
 304                 WHERE id='" . (int) $announcement_id . "'";
 305         
 306         return claro_sql_query($sql);
 307     }
 308     else
 309         return null;
 310 }

 352 /**
 353  * Displaces an entry (up or down).
 354  *
 355  * @param  integer $entryId  an valid id of announcement.
 356  * @param  string $cmd       'UP' or 'DOWN'
 357  * @return true;
 358  *
 359  * @author Christophe Gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
 360  */
 361 function move_entry($item_id, $cmd, $course_id=null)
 362 {
 363     $tbl = claro_sql_get_course_tbl(claro_get_course_db_name_glued($course_id));
 364     
 365     if ( $cmd == 'DOWN' )
 366     {
 367         $thisAnnouncementId = $item_id;
 368         $sortDirection      = 'DESC';
 369     }
 370     elseif ( $cmd == 'UP' )
 371     {
 372         $thisAnnouncementId = $item_id;
 373         $sortDirection      = 'ASC';
 374     }
 375     else
 376         return false;
 377     
 378     if ( $sortDirection )
 379     {
 380         $sql = "SELECT id,
 381                        ordre AS rank
 382                 FROM `" . $tbl['announcement'] . "`
 383                 ORDER BY `ordre` " . $sortDirection;
 384         
 385         $result = claro_sql_query($sql);
 386         $thisAnnouncementRankFound = false;
 387         $thisAnnouncementRank = '';
 388         while ( (list ($announcementId, $announcementRank) = mysql_fetch_row($result)) )
 389         {
 390             // STEP 2 : FOUND THE NEXT ANNOUNCEMENT ID AND ORDER.
 391             //          COMMIT ORDER SWAP ON THE DB
 392 
 393             if ($thisAnnouncementRankFound == true)
 394             {
 395                 $nextAnnouncementId    = $announcementId;
 396                 $nextAnnouncementRank  = $announcementRank;
 397 
 398                 $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl['announcement'] . "`
 399                     SET ordre = '" . (int) $nextAnnouncementRank . "'
 400                     WHERE id =  '" . (int) $thisAnnouncementId . "'";
 401 
 402                 claro_sql_query($sql);
 403 
 404                 $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl['announcement'] . "`
 405                     SET ordre = '" . $thisAnnouncementRank . "'
 406                     WHERE id =  '" . $nextAnnouncementId . "'";
 407                 claro_sql_query($sql);
 408 
 409                 return true;
 410             }
 411 
 412             // STEP 1 : FIND THE ORDER OF THE ANNOUNCEMENT
 413 
 414             if ( $announcementId == $thisAnnouncementId )
 415             {
 416                 $thisAnnouncementRank      = $announcementRank;
 417                 $thisAnnouncementRankFound = true;
 418             }
 419         }
 420         
 421         if (!$thisAnnouncementRankFound)
 422         {
 423             return false;
 424         }
 425     }
 426 }
 427 
 428 function clann_get_max_and_min_rank( $course_id = null )
 429 {
 430     $course_id = is_null($course_id) ? claro_get_current_course_id() : $course_id;
 431     
 432     $tbl = claro_sql_get_course_tbl(claro_get_course_db_name_glued($course_id));
 433     
 434     return Claroline::getDatabase()->query( "
 435       SELECT 
 436         MAX(ordre) AS maxRank,
 437         MIN(ordre) AS minRank
 438      FROM `" . $tbl['announcement'] . "`" )->fetch();
 439 }

   3 /**

   6  * This script allows users to log on platform and back to requested ressource.

  14 
  15 require '../inc/claro_init_global.inc.php';
  16 require_once get_path('incRepositorySys').'/lib/course_user.lib.php';
  17 
  18 // Keep the username in session
  19 if (isset($_REQUEST['login']))
  20 {
  21     $_SESSION['lastUserName'] = strip_tags($_REQUEST['login']);
  22 }
  23 
  24 // Capture the source of the authentication's trigger to get back to it
  25 if ( isset($_REQUEST['fromPortal']) && $_REQUEST['fromPortal'] == 'true' && !isset($_REQUEST['sourceUrl']) )
  26 {
  27     $sourceUrl = null;
  28 }
  29 elseif ( isset( $_REQUEST['sourceUrl'] ) )
  30 {
  31     if ( strstr( base64_decode( $_REQUEST['sourceUrl'] ), 'logout=true' ) )
  32     {
  33         $sourceUrl = base64_encode( get_path( 'rootWeb' ) );
  34     }
  35     else
  36     {
  37         $sourceUrl = $_REQUEST['sourceUrl'];
  38     }
  39 }
  40 elseif ( isset($_SERVER ['HTTP_REFERER'])
  41          &&   basename($_SERVER ['HTTP_REFERER']) != basename($_SERVER['PHP_SELF'])
  42          && ! strstr($_SERVER ['HTTP_REFERER'], 'logout=true') )
  43 {
  44      $sourceUrl = base64_encode($_SERVER ['HTTP_REFERER']);
  45 }
  46 elseif ( isset( $_SERVER ['HTTP_REFERER'] )
  47     && basename($_SERVER ['HTTP_REFERER']) != basename($_SERVER['PHP_SELF'])
  48     && strstr($_SERVER ['HTTP_REFERER'], 'logout=true') )
  49 {
  50     $sourceUrl = base64_encode( get_path( 'rootWeb' ) );
  51 }
  52 else
  53 {
  54     $sourceUrl = null;
  55 }
  56 
  57 // Immediatly redirect to the CAS authentication process
  58 // If CAS is the only authentication system enabled
  59 if (get_conf('claro_CasEnabled',false) && ! get_conf('claro_displayLocalAuthForm',true))
  60 {
  61     claro_redirect($_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] . '?authModeReq=CAS&sourceUrl='.urlencode($sourceUrl));
  62 }
  63 
  64 if ( $sourceUrl )
  65 {
  66     $sourceUrl = claro_htmlspecialchars($sourceUrl);
  67 }
  68 else
  69 {
  70     $sourceUrl = '';
  71 }
  72 
  73 if (claro_is_in_a_course())
  74 {
  75     $sourceCid = claro_htmlspecialchars(claro_get_current_course_id());
  76 }
  77 else
  78 {
  79     $sourceCid = '';
  80 }
  81 
  82 if (claro_is_in_a_group())
  83 {
  84     $sourceGid = claro_htmlspecialchars(claro_get_current_group_id());
  85 }
  86 else
  87 {
  88     $sourceGid = '';
  89 }
  90 
  91 $cidRequired = (isset($_REQUEST['cidRequired']) ? $_REQUEST['cidRequired'] : false);
  92 
  93 //TODO: possibility to continue in anonymous
  94 $uidRequired = true;
  95 
  96 // The script needs the user to be authentificated
  97 if (!claro_is_user_authenticated() && $uidRequired)
  98 {
  99     $defaultLoginValue  = '';
 100     $dialogBox          = new DialogBox;
 101     
 102     if (isset($_SESSION['lastUserName']))
 103     {
 104         $defaultLoginValue = strip_tags($_SESSION['lastUserName']);
 105         unset($_SESSION['lastUserName']);
 106     }
 107     
 108     if (get_conf('claro_displayLocalAuthForm',true) == true)
 109     {
 110         if ( $claro_loginRequested && ! $claro_loginSucceeded ) // var comming from claro_init_local.inc.php
 111         {
 112             if (AuthManager::getFailureMessage())

 114                 // need to use get_lang two times...
 115                 $dialogBox->error( get_lang( AuthManager::getFailureMessage() ) );
 116             }
 117             else
 118             {
 119                 $dialogBox->error( get_lang('Login failed.') . ' ' . get_lang('Please try again.') );
 120             }
 121             
 122             if (get_conf('allowSelfReg', false))

 124                 $dialogBox->warning( get_lang('If you haven\'t a user account yet, use the <a href="%url">the account creation form</a>.',array('%url'=> get_path('url') . '/claroline/auth/inscription.php')) );
 125             }
 126             else
 127             {
 128                 $dialogBox->error( get_lang('Contact your administrator.') );
 129             }
 130             
 131             $dialogBox->warning( get_lang('Warning the system distinguishes uppercase (capital) and lowercase (small) letters') );
 132         }
 133         
 134         if (get_conf('claro_secureLogin', false))
 135         {
 136             $formAction = 'https://' . $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] . $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'];
 137             
 138         }
 139         else
 140         {
 141             $formAction = $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'];

 143     } // end if claro_dispLocalAuthForm
 144     
 145     $template = new CoreTemplate('auth_form.tpl.php');

 159 // The script needs a course id, but no course is set
 160 elseif (!claro_is_in_a_course() && $cidRequired)
 161 {
 162     $tbl                = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 163     $sql = "
 164             SELECT c.code                                             AS `value`,

 166             FROM `" . $tbl['course'] . "`          AS c ,
 167                  `" . $tbl['rel_course_user'] . "` AS cu
 168             WHERE c.code = cu.code_cours

 180     
 181     $claroline->display->body->appendContent($template->render());
 182     
 183     echo $claroline->display->render();
 184 }
 185 // Login succeeded
 186 else
 187 {
 188     if(!isset($userLoggedOnCas))
 189         $userLoggedOnCas = false;
 190     
 191     $claroline->notifier->event( 'user_login', array('data' => array('ip' => $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']) ) );
 192

 197         if ( $_course['registrationAllowed'] )

 203                     // enrolment pending message displayed by body.tpl

 205                 else

 212                           . get_lang('Enrolment').'</a>' . "\n"
 213                           . '</p>' . "\n";
 214                 }

 217             {

 219                 $out .= '<p align="center">' . "\n"
 220                       . get_lang('Create first a user account on this platform') . ' : '
 221                       . '<a href="' . get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'auth/inscription.php">'
 222                       . get_lang('Go to the account creation page')
 223                       . '</a>'."\n"
 224                       . '</p>'."\n";
 225             }
 226             else

 229                 $out .= '<p align="center">'."\n"

 231                       . '</p>'."\n";

 234         else

 237             $out .= '<p align="center">'."\n"

 243                       . '<br /><small>' . get_lang('Email') . ' : <a href="mailto:' . $_course['email'] .'">' . $_course['email']. '</a>';

 292     else

 294         if ( get_conf('claro_secureLogin', false) )
 295         {
 296             claro_redirect('http://'.$_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'].get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb'));
 297         }
 298         else
 299         {
 300             claro_redirect(get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb'));
 301         }

 303 }

 113             SET

 138 function agenda_update_item ( $event_id, $title = null, $content = null, $day = null, $hour = null, $lasting = null, $speakers = '', $location = null, $visibility = null, $courseCode = null )
 139 {
 140     $tbl_c_names = claro_sql_get_course_tbl ( claro_get_course_db_name_glued ( $courseCode ) );
 141     $tbl_calendar_event = $tbl_c_names[ 'calendar_event' ];
 142 
 143     $speakers = (!empty ( $speakers )) ? ("'" . claro_sql_escape ( $speakers ) . "'") : ("null");
 144 
 145     $sqlSet = array ( );
 146     if ( !is_null ( $title ) )
 147         $sqlSet[ ] = " `titre` = '" . claro_sql_escape ( trim ( $title ) ) . "' ";

 154     if ( !is_null ( $lasting ) )

 162

 164     {
 165         $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl_calendar_event . "`
 166                 SET " . implode ( ', ', $sqlSet ) . "
 167                 WHERE `id` = " . (int) $event_id;

 288 function get_agenda_items_compact_mode ( $userCourseList, $month, $year )
 289 {
 290     $courseDigestList = array ( );
 291 
 292     $toolId = get_tool_id_from_module_label ( 'CLCAL' );
 293 
 294     // get agenda-items for every course
 295     foreach ( $userCourseList as $thisCourse )
 296     {
 297         if ( is_module_installed_in_course_lightversion ( 'CLCAL', $thisCourse )
 298             && is_tool_activated_in_course_lightversion ( $toolId, $thisCourse )
 299             && is_tool_visible_for_portlet( $toolId, $thisCourse['sysCode'] ) )
 300         {
 301             $courseEventList = get_agenda_items_list ( $thisCourse, $month, $year );
 302 
 303             if ( is_array ( $courseEventList ) )
 304             {
 305                 foreach ( $courseEventList as $thisEvent )
 306                 {
 307                     $eventLine = trim ( strip_tags ( $thisEvent[ 'title' ] ) );
 308 
 309                     if ( $eventLine == '' )
 310                     {
 311                         $eventContent = trim ( strip_tags ( $thisEvent[ 'content' ] ) );
 312                         $eventLine = substr ( $eventContent, 0, 60 ) . (strlen ( $eventContent ) > 60 ? ' (...)' : '');
 313                     }
 314 
 315                     $eventDate = explode ( '-', $thisEvent[ 'day' ] );
 316                     $day = intval ( $eventDate[ 2 ] );
 317 
 318                     if ( !array_key_exists ( $day, $courseDigestList ) )
 319                     {
 320                         $courseDigestList[ $day ] = array ( );
 321                         $courseDigestList[ $day ][ 'eventList' ] = array ( );
 322                         $courseDigestList[ $day ][ 'date' ] = $thisEvent[ 'day' ];
 323                     }
 324 
 325                     $courseDigestList[ $day ][ 'eventList' ][ ] =
 326                         array (
 327                             'hour' => $thisEvent[ 'hour' ],
 328                             'courseOfficialCode' => $thisCourse[ 'officialCode' ],
 329                             'courseSysCode' => $thisCourse[ 'sysCode' ],
 330                             'content' => $eventLine,
 331                             'url' => get_path ( 'url' )
 332                             . '/claroline/calendar/agenda.php?cidReq='
 333                             . $thisCourse[ 'sysCode' ]
 334                             . '#item' . $thisEvent[ 'id' ]
 335                     );
 336                 }
 337             }
 338         }
 339         
 340         ksort ( $courseDigestList );
 341     }
 342     
 343     return $courseDigestList;
 344 }

 346 function get_agenda_items ( $userCourseList, $month, $year )
 347 {
 348     $items = array ( );
 349 
 350     // get agenda-items for every course
 351 
 352     foreach ( $userCourseList as $thisCourse )
 353     {
 354 
 355         $courseEventList = get_agenda_items_list ( $thisCourse, $month, $year );
 356 
 357         if ( is_array ( $courseEventList ) )
 358             foreach ( $courseEventList as $thisEvent )
 359             {
 360                 $eventLine = trim ( strip_tags ( $thisEvent[ 'title' ] ) );
 361 
 362                 if ( $eventLine == '' )
 363                 {
 364                     $eventContent = trim ( strip_tags ( $thisEvent[ 'content' ] ) );
 365                     $eventLine = substr ( $eventContent, 0, 60 ) . (strlen ( $eventContent ) > 60 ? ' (...)' : '');
 366                 }
 367 
 368                 $eventDate = explode ( '-', $thisEvent[ 'day' ] );
 369                 $day = intval ( $eventDate[ 2 ] );
 370                 $eventTime = explode ( ':', $thisEvent[ 'hour' ] );
 371                 $time = $eventTime[ 0 ] . ':' . $eventTime[ 1 ];
 372                 $url = get_path ( 'url' ) . '/claroline/calendar/agenda.php?cidReq=' . $thisCourse[ 'sysCode' ];
 373 
 374                 if ( !isset ( $items[ $day ][ $thisEvent[ 'hour' ] ] ) )
 375                 {
 376                     $items[ $day ][ $thisEvent[ 'hour' ] ] = '';
 377                 }
 378 
 379                 $items [ $day ] [ $thisEvent[ 'hour' ] ] .= '<br />'
 380                     . '<i>'
 381                     . '<small>' . $time . ' : </small>'
 382                     . '</i>'
 383                     . '<br />'
 384                     . $eventLine
 385                     . ' - '
 386                     . '<small>'
 387                     . '<a href="' . $url . '">'
 388                     . $thisCourse[ 'officialCode' ]
 389                     . '</a>'
 390                     . '</small>' . "\n"
 391                 ;
 392             } // end foreach courseEventList
 393     }
 394 
 395     // sorting by hour for every day
 396     $agendaItemList = array ( );
 397 
 398     while ( list($agendaday, $tmpitems) = each ( $items ) )
 399     {
 400         sort ( $tmpitems );
 401 
 402         while ( list(, $val) = each ( $tmpitems ) )
 403         {
 404             if ( !isset ( $agendaItemList[ $agendaday ] ) )
 405                 $agendaItemList[ $agendaday ] = '';
 406             $agendaItemList[ $agendaday ] .= $val;
 407         }
 408     }
 409 
 410     return $agendaItemList;
 411 }

 413 function claro_disp_monthly_calendar ( $agendaItemList, $month, $year, $weekdaynames, $monthName )
 414 {

 417         )
 418         . 'claro_disp_monthly_calendar is deprecated , use claro_html_monthly_calendar', 'error' );
 419 
 420     return claro_html_monthly_calendar ( $agendaItemList, $month, $year, $weekdaynames, $monthName );
 421 }

 423 /**
 424  * build a view of items place a monthly view
 425  *
 426  * @param array $agendaItemList list of item to include in the view
 427  * @param integer $month number of the month in the year (0=january)
 428  * @param integer $year number of the year (4 digit)
 429  * @param array $weekdaynames array from langfiles with names of the week days
 430  * @param string $monthName name of the current month
 431  * @return mixed : whether success html stream or false and error throw claro_failure
 432  */
 433 function claro_html_monthly_calendar ( $agendaItemList, $month, $year, $weekdaynames, $monthName, $compactMode = false )
 434 {
 435     $htmlStream = '';
 436     //Handle leap year
 437     $numberofdays = array ( 0, 31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31 );
 438 
 439     if ( ($year % 400 == 0) || ( $year % 4 == 0 && $year % 100 != 0 ) )
 440     {
 441         $numberofdays[ 2 ] = 29;
 442     }
 443 
 444     //Get the first day of the month
 445     $dayone = getdate ( mktime ( 0, 0, 0, $month, 1, $year ) );
 446 
 447     //Start the week on monday
 448     $startdayofweek = $dayone[ 'wday' ] <> 0 ? ($dayone[ 'wday' ] - 1) : 6;
 449 
 450     $backwardsURL = $_SERVER[ 'PHP_SELF' ]
 451         . '?month=' . ($month == 1 ? 12 : $month - 1)
 452         . '&amp;year=' . ($month == 1 ? $year - 1 : $year);
 453 
 454     $forewardsURL = $_SERVER[ 'PHP_SELF' ]
 455         . '?month=' . ($month == 12 ? 1 : $month + 1)
 456         . '&amp;year=' . ($month == 12 ? $year + 1 : $year);
 457 
 458     $htmlStream .= '<table class="claroTable" width="100%">' . "\n"
 459         . '<tr class="superHeader">' . "\n"
 460         . '<th width="13%">'
 461     ;
 462 
 463     if ( $compactMode == false )
 464     {
 465         $htmlStream .= '<center>' . "\n"
 466             . '<a href="' . $backwardsURL . '">&lt;&lt;</a>'
 467             . '</center>' . "\n"
 468         ;
 469     }
 470 
 471     $htmlStream .= '</th>' . "\n"
 472         . '<th width="65%" colspan="5">'
 473         . '<center>'
 474         . $monthName . ' ' . $year
 475         . '</center>'
 476         . '</th>' . "\n"
 477         . '<th width="13%">'
 478     ;
 479 
 480     if ( $compactMode == false )
 481     {
 482         $htmlStream .= '<center>' . "\n"
 483             . '<a href="' . $forewardsURL . '">&gt;&gt;</a>
 484         .    </center>'
 485         ;
 486     }
 487 
 488     $htmlStream .= '</th>' . "\n"
 489         . '</tr>' . "\n"
 490         . '<tr>' . "\n"
 491     ;
 492 
 493     for ( $iterator = 1; $iterator < 8; $iterator++ )
 494     {
 495         $htmlStream .= '<th width="13%">' . $weekdaynames[ $iterator % 7 ] . '</th>' . "\n";
 496     }
 497 
 498     $htmlStream .= '</tr>' . "\n\n";
 499 
 500     $curday = -1;
 501 
 502     $today = getdate ();
 503 
 504     while ( $curday <= $numberofdays[ $month ] )
 505     {
 506         $htmlStream .= '<tr>' . "\n";
 507 
 508         for ( $iterator = 0; $iterator < 7; $iterator++ )
 509         {
 510             if ( ($curday == -1) && ($iterator == $startdayofweek) )
 511             {
 512                 $curday = 1;
 513             }
 514 
 515             if ( ($curday > 0) && ($curday <= $numberofdays[ $month ]) )
 516             {
 517                 if ( ($curday == $today[ 'mday' ])
 518                     && ($year == $today[ 'year' ])
 519                     && ($month == $today[ 'mon' ]) )
 520                 {
 521                     $weekdayType = 'highlight'; // today
 522                 }
 523                 elseif ( $iterator < 5 )
 524                 {
 525                     $weekdayType = 'workingWeek';
 526                 }
 527                 else
 528                 {
 529                     $weekdayType = 'weekEnd';
 530                 }
 531 
 532                 $dayheader = $curday;
 533 
 534                 $htmlStream .= '<td height="40" width="12%" valign="top" '
 535                     . 'class="' . $weekdayType
 536                     . ($compactMode && isset ( $agendaItemList[ $curday ] ) ? ' dayWithEvent' : '')
 537                     . '">'
 538                 ;
 539 
 540                 if ( $compactMode && isset ( $agendaItemList[ $curday ] ) )
 541                 {
 542                     $htmlStream .= '<a href="' . $agendaItemList[ $curday ][ 'eventList' ][ 0 ][ 'url' ] . '">' . $dayheader . '</a>';
 543                 }
 544                 else
 545                 {
 546                     $htmlStream .= $dayheader;
 547                 }
 548 
 549                 if ( !$compactMode && isset ( $agendaItemList[ $curday ] ) )
 550                 {
 551                     $htmlStream .= $agendaItemList[ $curday ];
 552                 }
 553 
 554                 $htmlStream .= '</td>' . "\n";
 555 
 556                 $curday++;
 557             }
 558             else
 559             {
 560                 $htmlStream .= '<td width="12%">&nbsp;</td>' . "\n";
 561             }
 562         }
 563         $htmlStream .= '</tr>' . "\n\n";
 564     }
 565     $htmlStream .= '</table>';
 566 
 567     return $htmlStream;
 568 }

   5 /**
   6  * CLAROLINE
   7  *
   8  * User desktop : MyCalendar portlet calendar class
   9  *

  18 FromKernel::uses('user.lib','courselist.lib');
  19 From::Module('CLCAL')->uses('agenda.lib');
  20 
  21 include claro_get_conf_repository() . 'CLHOME.conf.php'; // conf file
  22 
  23 class UserDesktopCalendar
  24 {
  25     protected $year;
  26     protected $month;
  27     
  28     public function __construct()
  29     {
  30         if (file_exists(claro_get_conf_repository() . 'CLCAL.conf.php'))
  31         {
  32             include claro_get_conf_repository() . 'CLCAL.conf.php';
  33         }
  34         
  35         $today = getdate();
  36         $this->month = $today['mon'];
  37         $this->year = $today['year'];
  38     }
  39     
  40     public function setYear( $year )
  41     {
  42         $this->year = $year;
  43     }
  44     
  45     public function setMonth( $month )
  46     {
  47         $this->month = $month;
  48     }
  49     
  50     public function getMonthName()
  51     {
  52         $langMonthNames = get_locale('langMonthNames');
  53         return $langMonthNames['long'][$this->month -1];
  54     }
  55     
  56     public function getMonth()
  57     {
  58         return $this->month;
  59     }
  60     
  61     public function getYear()
  62     {
  63         return $this->year;
  64     }
  65     
  66     protected function ajaxMiniCalendar( $agendaItemList )
  67     {
  68         $weekdaynames = get_locale('langDay_of_weekNames');
  69         $weekdaynames = $weekdaynames['init'];
  70         
  71         $htmlStream = '';
  72         //Handle leap year
  73         $numberofdays = array(0,31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31);
  74     
  75         if ( ($this->getYear()%400 == 0) || ( $this->getYear()%4 == 0 && $this->getYear()%100 != 0 ) )
  76         {
  77             $numberofdays[2] = 29;
  78         }
  79     
  80         //Get the first day of the month
  81         $dayone = getdate(mktime(0,0,0,$this->getMonth(),1,$this->getYear()));
  82     
  83         //Start the week on monday
  84         $startdayofweek = $dayone['wday']<> 0 ? ($dayone['wday']-1) : 6;
  85         
  86         $previousMonth = $this->getMonth() == 1
  87             ? 12
  88             : $this->getMonth() -1
  89             ;
  90         
  91         $previousYear = $this->getMonth() == 1
  92             ? $this->getYear() - 1
  93             : $this->getYear()
  94             ;
  95         
  96         $nextMonth = $this->getMonth() == 12
  97             ? 1
  98             : $this->getMonth() + 1
  99             ;
 100         
 101         $nextYear = $this->getMonth() == 12
 102             ? $this->getYear() + 1
 103             : $this->getYear()
 104             ;
 105             
 106         $htmlStream = "<script type=\"text/javascript\">
 107 var UserDesktopCalendar = {
 108     previous: function(){
 109         $.ajax({
 110             url: '".get_module_url('CLCAL')."/ajaxHandler.php',
 111             data: 'year=".(int)$previousYear."&month=".(int)$previousMonth."&location=userdesktop',
 112             success: function(response){
 113                 $('#portletMycalendar').empty().append(response);
 114             }
 115         });
 116     },
 117     next: function(){
 118         $.ajax({
 119             url: '".get_module_url('CLCAL')."/ajaxHandler.php',
 120             data: 'year=".(int)$nextYear."&month=".(int)$nextMonth."&location=userdesktop',
 121             success: function(response){
 122                 $('#portletMycalendar').empty().append(response);
 123             }
 124         });
 125     }
 126 };
 127 </script>";
 128         
 129         $htmlStream .=  '<table class="claroTable" width="100%">' . "\n"
 130         .    '<tr class="superHeader">' . "\n"
 131         .    '<th width="13%">'
 132         ;
 133         
 134         $htmlStream .= '<center>' . "\n"
 135         .    '<a href="" onclick="UserDesktopCalendar.previous();return false;">&lt;&lt;</a>'
 136         .    '</center>' . "\n"
 137         ;
 138         
 139         $htmlStream .= '</th>' . "\n"
 140         .    '<th width="65%" colspan="5">'
 141         .    '<center>'
 142         .    $this->getMonthName() . ' ' . $this->getYear()
 143         .    '</center>'
 144         .    '</th>' . "\n"
 145         .    '<th width="13%">'
 146         ;
 147         
 148         $htmlStream .= '<center>' . "\n"
 149         .    '<a href="" onclick="UserDesktopCalendar.next();return false;">&gt;&gt;</a>'
 150         .    '</center>'
 151         ;
 152     
 153         $htmlStream .= '</th>' . "\n"
 154         .    '</tr>' . "\n"
 155         .    '<tr>' ."\n"
 156         ;
 157     
 158         for ( $iterator = 1; $iterator < 8; $iterator++)
 159         {
 160             $htmlStream .=   '<th width="13%">' . $weekdaynames[$iterator%7] . '</th>' . "\n";
 161         }
 162     
 163         $htmlStream .=  '</tr>' . "\n\n";
 164     
 165         $curday = -1;
 166     
 167         $today = getdate();
 168     
 169         while ($curday <= $numberofdays[$this->getMonth()])
 170         {
 171             $htmlStream .=  '<tr>' . "\n";
 172     
 173             for ($iterator = 0; $iterator < 7 ; $iterator++)
 174             {
 175                 if ( ($curday == -1) && ($iterator == $startdayofweek) )
 176                 {
 177                     $curday = 1;
 178                 }
 179     
 180                 if ( ($curday > 0) && ($curday <= $numberofdays[$this->getMonth()]) )
 181                 {
 182                     if (   ($curday == $today['mday'])
 183                     && ($this->getYear()   == $today['year'])
 184                     && ($this->getMonth()  == $today['mon' ]) )
 185                     {
 186                         $weekdayType = 'highlight'; // today
 187                     }
 188                     elseif ( $iterator < 5 )
 189                     {
 190                         $weekdayType = 'workingWeek';
 191                     }
 192                     else
 193                     {
 194                         $weekdayType = 'weekEnd';
 195                     }
 196     
 197                     $dayheader = $curday ;
 198     
 199                     $htmlStream .= '<td height="40" width="12%" valign="top" '
 200                     .    'class="' . $weekdayType
 201                     .    (isset($agendaItemList[$curday]) ? ' dayWithEvent': '')
 202                     .    '">'
 203                     ;
 204     
 205                     if ( isset($agendaItemList[$curday]) )
 206                     {
 207                         $htmlStream .= '<a href="'.$agendaItemList[$curday]['eventList'][0]['url'].'">' . $dayheader .'</a>';
 208                     }
 209                     else
 210                     {
 211                         $htmlStream .= $dayheader;
 212                     }
 213     
 214                     $htmlStream .= '</td>' . "\n";
 215     
 216                     $curday++;
 217                 }
 218                 else
 219                 {
 220                     $htmlStream .= '<td width="12%">&nbsp;</td>' . "\n";
 221                 }
 222             }
 223             $htmlStream .= '</tr>' . "\n\n";
 224         }
 225         
 226         $htmlStream .= '</table>';
 227         
 228         return $htmlStream;
 229     }
 230     
 231     public function render()
 232     {
 233         $userCourseList = get_user_course_list( claro_get_current_user_id() );
 234         $agendaItemList = get_agenda_items_compact_mode($userCourseList, $this->month, $this->year);
 235 
 236         $output = '';
 237 
 238         
 239         
 240         $output .= '<div class="details">' . "\n"
 241                  . '<dl class="calendarDetails">' . "\n";
 242         
 243         if($agendaItemList)
 244         {
 245             foreach($agendaItemList as $agendaItem)
 246             {
 247                 $output .= '<dt>' . "\n"
 248                          . '<img class="iconDefinitionList" src="' . get_icon_url('agenda', 'CLCAL') . '" alt="Calendar" />&nbsp;'
 249                          . claro_html_localised_date( get_locale('dateFormatLong'),
 250                                 strtotime($agendaItem['date']) )
 251                          . '</dt>' . "\n";
 252                 
 253                 foreach($agendaItem['eventList'] as $agendaEvent)
 254                 {
 255                     $output .= '<dd>'
 256                              . '<a href="' . $agendaEvent['url'] . '">'
 257                              . $agendaEvent['courseOfficialCode']
 258                              . '</a> : ' . "\n"
 259                              . $agendaEvent['content'] . "\n"
 260                              . '</dd>' . "\n";
 261                 }
 262             }
 263         }
 264         else
 265         {
 266             $output .= '<dt>' . "\n"
 267                      . '<img class="iconDefinitionList" src="' . get_icon_url('agenda', 'CLCAL') . '" alt="" />&nbsp;'
 268                      . get_lang('No event to display') . "\n"
 269                      . '</dt>' . "\n";
 270         }
 271         
 272         $output .= ''
 273                  . '</dl>' . "\n"
 274                  . '</div>' . "\n";
 275         
 276         // $output .= '<div class="calendar">'.$this->ajaxMiniCalendar($agendaItemList).'</div>';
 277         
 278         return $output;
 279     }
 280 }

   2 
   3 /**
   4  * CLAROLINE
   5  *
   6  * This script manages the creation of a course.
   7  * It contains 3 panels:
   8  * - Form
   9  * - Wait
  10  * - Done
  11  *
  12  * @version     $Revision: 14422 $
  13  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  14  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html (GPL) GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
  15  * @see         http://www.claroline.net/wiki/CLCRS/
  16  * @package     COURSE
  17  *              old version : http://cvs.claroline.net/cgi-bin/viewcvs.cgi/claroline/claroline/create_course/add_course.php
  18  * @author      Claro Team <cvs@claroline.net>
  19  * @since       1.9
  20  */
  21 
  22 require '../inc/claro_init_global.inc.php';
  23 
  24 //=================================
  25 // Security check
  26 //=================================
  27 
  28 if ( ! claro_is_user_authenticated() )       claro_disp_auth_form();
  29 if ( ! claro_is_allowed_to_create_course() ) claro_die(get_lang('Not allowed'));
  30 
  31 //=================================
  32 // Main section
  33 //=================================
  34 
  35 include claro_get_conf_repository() . 'course_main.conf.php';
  36 require_once get_path('incRepositorySys') . '/lib/add_course.lib.inc.php';
  37 require_once get_path('incRepositorySys') . '/lib/course.lib.inc.php';
  38 require_once get_path('incRepositorySys') . '/lib/course_user.lib.php';
  39 require_once get_path('incRepositorySys') . '/lib/user.lib.php'; // for claro_get_uid_of_platform_admin()
  40 require_once get_path('incRepositorySys') . '/lib/fileManage.lib.php';
  41 require_once get_path('incRepositorySys') . '/lib/form.lib.php';
  42 require_once get_path('incRepositorySys') . '/lib/sendmail.lib.php';
  43 require_once get_path('incRepositorySys') . '/lib/claroCourse.class.php';
  44 
  45 define('DISP_COURSE_CREATION_FORM'     ,__LINE__);
  46 define('DISP_COURSE_CREATION_SUCCEED'  ,__LINE__);
  47 define('DISP_COURSE_CREATION_FAILED'   ,__LINE__);
  48 define('DISP_COURSE_CREATION_PROGRESS' ,__LINE__);
  49 
  50 $display = DISP_COURSE_CREATION_FORM; // default display
  51 
  52 $dialogBox = new DialogBox();
  53 
  54 $cmd                = isset($_REQUEST['cmd']) ? $_REQUEST['cmd'] : null;
  55 $adminContext       = isset($_REQUEST['adminContext']) ? (bool) $_REQUEST['adminContext'] : null;
  56 
  57 // $sourceCourseId has a value only if we're about to create a session course; it's null otherwise
  58 $sourceCourseId = isset($_REQUEST['course_sourceCourseId']) ? (int) $_REQUEST['course_sourceCourseId'] : null;
  59 
  60 // New course object
  61 $thisUser = claro_get_current_user_data();
  62 $course = new ClaroCourse($thisUser['firstName'], $thisUser['lastName'], $thisUser['mail']);
  63 
  64 if (!is_null($sourceCourseId))
  65 {
  66     $course->sourceCourseId = $sourceCourseId;
  67 }
  68 
  69 if ( !is_null($course->sourceCourseId) && !empty($course->sourceCourseId) )
  70 {
  71     $sourceCourse = new claroCourse();
  72     $sourceCourse->load(claroCourse::getCodeFromId($course->sourceCourseId));
  73     
  74     if( $sourceCourse->sourceCourseId )
  75     {
  76         claro_die( get_lang( 'You cannot create a course session from another course session' ) );
  77     }
  78     
  79     $course->categories = $sourceCourse->categories;
  80 }
  81 
  82 if ( $adminContext && claro_is_platform_admin() )
  83 {
  84     // From admin, add param to form
  85     $course->addHtmlParam('adminContext','1');
  86 }
  87 
  88 if ( claro_is_platform_admin() || get_conf('courseCreationAllowed', true) )
  89 {
  90     if ( $cmd == 'exEdit' )
  91     {
  92         $course->handleForm();
  93         
  94         if( $course->validate() )
  95         {
  96             if( $course->save() )
  97             {
  98                 // include the platform language file with all language variables
  99                 language::load_translation();
 100                 language::load_locale_settings();
 101                 
 102                 $course->mailAdministratorOnCourseCreation($thisUser['firstName'], $thisUser['lastName'], $thisUser['mail']);
 103                 
 104                 $dialogBox->success( get_lang('You have just created the course website')
 105                 .            ' : ' . '<strong>' . $course->officialCode . '</strong>' );
 106                 
 107                 $display = DISP_COURSE_CREATION_SUCCEED;
 108             }
 109             else
 110             {
 111                 $dialogBox->error( $course->backlog->output() );
 112                 $display = DISP_COURSE_CREATION_FAILED;
 113             }
 114         }
 115         else
 116         {
 117             $dialogBox->error( $course->backlog->output() );
 118             $display = DISP_COURSE_CREATION_FAILED;
 119         }
 120     }
 121     
 122     if( $cmd == 'rqProgress' )
 123     {
 124         $course->handleForm();
 125     
 126         if( $course->validate() )
 127         {
 128             // Trig a waiting screen as course creation may take a while...
 129             $progressUrl = $course->buildProgressUrl();
 130     
 131             $htmlHeadXtra[] = '<meta http-equiv="REFRESH" content="0; URL=' . $progressUrl . '">';
 132     
 133             // Display "progression" page
 134             $dialogBox->info( get_lang('Creating course (it may take a while) ...') . '<br />' . "\n"
 135             .      '<p align="center">'
 136             .      '<img src="' . get_icon_url('processing') . '" alt="" />'
 137             .      '</p>' . "\n"
 138             .      '<p>'
 139             .      get_lang('If after while no message appears confirming the course creation, please click <a href="%url">here</a>',array('%url' => $progressUrl))
 140             .      '</p>' );
 141             
 142             $display = DISP_COURSE_CREATION_PROGRESS;
 143         }
 144         else
 145         {
 146             $dialogBox->error( $course->backlog->output() );
 147             $display = DISP_COURSE_CREATION_FAILED;
 148         }
 149     }
 150 }
 151 
 152 // Set navigation url
 153 if ( $adminContext && claro_is_platform_admin() )
 154 {
 155     ClaroBreadCrumbs::getInstance()->prepend( get_lang('Create course'), get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'course/create.php?adminContext=1' );
 156     ClaroBreadCrumbs::getInstance()->prepend( get_lang('Administration'), get_path('rootAdminWeb') );
 157     $backUrl = get_path('rootAdminWeb') ;
 158 }
 159 else
 160 {
 161     if ( $course->courseId )
 162     {
 163         $backUrl = get_path('url') . '/claroline/course/index.php?cid='.$course->courseId;
 164     }
 165     else
 166     {
 167         $backUrl = get_path('url') . '/index.php';
 168     }
 169 }
 170 
 171 if ( ! get_conf('courseCreationAllowed', true) )
 172 {
 173     $dialogBox->warning(get_lang('Course creation is disabled on the platform'));
 174 }
 175 
 176 
 177 //=================================
 178 // Display section
 179 //=================================
 180 
 181 $out = '';
 182 
 183 $out .=  claro_html_tool_title(get_lang('Create a course website'));
 184 
 185 $out .= $dialogBox->render();
 186 
 187 if ( claro_is_platform_admin()
 188     || get_conf('courseCreationAllowed', true) )
 189 {
 190     if( $display == DISP_COURSE_CREATION_FORM || $display == DISP_COURSE_CREATION_FAILED )
 191     {
 192         // display form
 193         $out .= $course->displayForm($backUrl);
 194     }
 195     elseif ( $display == DISP_COURSE_CREATION_PROGRESS )
 196     {
 197         // do nothing except displaying dialogBox content
 198     }
 199     elseif ( $display == DISP_COURSE_CREATION_SUCCEED )
 200     {
 201         // display back link
 202         $out .= '<p>'
 203         .    claro_html_cmd_link( claro_htmlspecialchars( $backUrl ), get_lang('Continue') )
 204         .     '</p>' . "\n"
 205         ;
 206     }
 207 }
 208 
 209 $claroline->display->body->appendContent($out);
 210 
 211 echo $claroline->display->render();

   1 <?php // $Id: index.php 14468 2013-06-10 08:22:10Z zefredz $
   2 
   3 // vim: expandtab sw=4 ts=4 sts=4:
   4 
   5 /**
   6  * CLAROLINE
   7  *
   8  * User desktop index.
   9  *
  10  * @version     $Revision: 14468 $
  11  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  12  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html (GPL) GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
  13  * @package     DESKTOP
  14  * @author      Claroline team <info@claroline.net>
  15  */
  16 
  17 // reset course and groupe
  18 $cidReset       = true;
  19 $gidReset       = true;
  20 $uidRequired    = true;
  21 
  22 // load Claroline kernel
  23 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../../claroline/inc/claro_init_global.inc.php';
  24 
  25 if( ! claro_is_user_authenticated() ) claro_disp_auth_form();
  26 
  27 // load libraries
  28 FromKernel::uses('user.lib', 'utils/finder.lib');
  29 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/lib/portlet.lib.php';
  30 
  31 // Breadcrumb
  32 FromKernel::uses('display/userprofilebox.lib');
  33 ClaroBreadCrumbs::getInstance()->append(get_lang('My desktop'), get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb').'desktop/index.php');
  34 
  35 $dialogBox = new DialogBox();
  36 
  37 define( 'KERNEL_PORTLETS_PATH', dirname( __FILE__ ) . '/lib/portlet' );
  38 
  39 // Load and register (if needed) portlets
  40 try
  41 {
  42     $portletList = new PortletList;
  43     
  44     $fileFinder = new Claro_FileFinder_Extension( KERNEL_PORTLETS_PATH, '.class.php', false );
  45     
  46     foreach ( $fileFinder as $file )
  47     {
  48         // Require portlet file
  49         require_once $file->getPathname();
  50         
  51         // Compute portlet class name from file name
  52         $pos = strpos( $file->getFilename(), '.' );
  53         $className = substr( $file->getFilename(), '0', $pos );
  54         
  55         // Load portlet from database
  56         $portletInDB = $portletList->loadPortlet( $className );
  57         
  58         // If it's not in DB, add it
  59         if( !$portletInDB )
  60         {
  61             if( class_exists($className) )
  62             {
  63                 $portlet = new $className($portletInDB['label']);
  64                 
  65                 if ( $portlet->getLabel() )
  66                 {
  67                     $portletList->addPortlet( $portlet->getLabel(), $portlet->getName() );
  68                 }
  69                 else
  70                 {
  71                     Console::warning("Portlet {$className} has no label !");
  72                 }
  73             }
  74         }
  75         else
  76         {
  77             continue;
  78         }
  79     }
  80     
  81     $moduleList = get_module_label_list();
  82     
  83     if ( is_array( $moduleList ) )
  84     {
  85         foreach ( $moduleList as $moduleId => $moduleLabel )
  86         {
  87             $portletPath = get_module_path( $moduleLabel )
  88                 . '/connector/desktop.cnr.php';
  89             
  90             if ( file_exists( $portletPath ) )
  91             {
  92                 require_once $portletPath;
  93                 
  94                 $className = "{$moduleLabel}_Portlet";
  95                 
  96                 // Load portlet from database
  97                 $portletInDB = $portletList->loadPortlet($className);
  98                 
  99                 // If it's not in DB, add it
 100                 if( !$portletInDB )
 101                 {
 102                     if ( class_exists($className) )
 103                     {
 104                         $portlet = new $className($portletInDB['label']);
 105                         
 106                         if ( $portlet->getLabel() )
 107                         {
 108                             $portletList->addPortlet( $portlet->getLabel(), $portlet->getName() );
 109                         }
 110                         else
 111                         {
 112                             Console::warning("Portlet {$className} has no label !");
 113                         }
 114                     }
 115                 }
 116                 
 117                 load_module_config($moduleLabel);
 118                 Language::load_module_translation($moduleLabel);
 119             }
 120         }
 121     }
 122 }
 123 catch (Exception $e)
 124 {
 125     $dialogBox->error( get_lang('Cannot load portlets') );
 126     pushClaroMessage($e->__toString());
 127 }
 128 
 129 // Generate Output from Portlet
 130 
 131 $outPortlet = '';
 132 
 133 $portletList = $portletList->loadAll( true );
 134 
 135 if ( !empty( $portletList ) )
 136 {
 137     foreach ( $portletList as $portlet )
 138     {
 139         try
 140         {
 141             if ( empty( $portlet['label'] ) )
 142             {
 143                 pushClaroMessage( "Portlet with no label found ! Please check your database", 'warning' );
 144                 continue;
 145             }
 146             
 147             // load portlet
 148             if( ! class_exists( $portlet['label'] ) )
 149             {
 150                 pushClaroMessage("User desktop : class {$portlet['label']} not found !", 'warning');
 151                 continue;
 152             }
 153             
 154             if( $portlet['label'] == 'mycourselist' )
 155             {
 156                 continue;
 157             }
 158             
 159             $plabel = $portlet['label'];
 160             
 161             $portlet = new $plabel($plabel);
 162             
 163             if( ! $portlet instanceof UserDesktopPortlet )
 164             {
 165                 pushClaroMessage("{$portlet['label']} is not a valid user desktop portlet !");
 166                 continue;
 167             }
 168             
 169             $outPortlet .= $portlet->render();
 170         }
 171         catch (Exception $e )
 172         {
 173             $portletDialog = new DialogBox();
 174             
 175             $portletDialog->error(
 176                 get_lang(
 177                     'An error occured while loading the portlet : %error%',
 178                     array(
 179                         '%error%' => $e->getMessage()
 180                     )
 181                 )
 182             );
 183             
 184             $outPortlet .= '<div class="claroBlock portlet">'
 185                 . '<h3 class="blockHeader">' . "\n"
 186                 . $portlet->renderTitle()
 187                 . '</h3>' . "\n"
 188                 . '<div class="claroBlockContent">' . "\n"
 189                 . $portletDialog->render()
 190                 . '</div>' . "\n"
 191                 . '</div>' . "\n\n"
 192                 ;
 193         }
 194     }
 195 }
 196 else
 197 {
 198     $dialogBox->error(get_lang('Cannot load portlet list'));
 199 }
 200 
 201 // Generate Script Output
 202 CssLoader::getInstance()->load('desktop','all');
 203 
 204 $template = new CoreTemplate('user_desktop.tpl.php');
 205 
 206 $userProfileBox = new UserProfileBox(false);
 207 
 208 $myCourseList = new MyCourseList;
 209 
 210 $template->assign('dialogBox', $dialogBox);
 211 $template->assign('userProfileBox', $userProfileBox);
 212 $template->assign('outPortlet', $outPortlet);
 213 $template->assign('mycourselist', $myCourseList->render());
 214 
 215 $claroline->display->body->appendContent($template->render());
 216 
 217 echo $claroline->display->render();

   1 <?php // $Id: portlet.lib.php 14466 2013-06-10 08:17:34Z zefredz $
   2 
   3 // vim: expandtab sw=4 ts=4 sts=4:
   4

   7 /**
   8  * CLAROLINE
   9  *
  10  * User desktop portlet classes.
  11  *
  12  * @version     $Revision: 14466 $
  13  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  14  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html (GPL) GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
  15  * @package     DESKTOP
  16  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  17  */
  18 
  19 require_once get_path('includePath') . '/lib/portlet.class.php';
  20 
  21 abstract class UserDesktopPortlet extends Portlet
  22 {
  23     /**
  24      * @var String
  25      */
  26     protected $name, $label;
  27     
  28     public function getName()
  29     {
  30         return $this->name;
  31     }
  32     
  33     public function getLabel()
  34     {
  35         return $this->label;
  36     }
  37     
  38     public function setName($name)
  39     {
  40         $this->name = $name;
  41     }
  42     
  43     public function setLabel($label)
  44     {
  45         $this->label = $label;
  46     }
  47 }
  48 
  49 class PortletList
  50 {
  51     private $tblDesktopPortlet;
  52 
  53     const UP = 'up';
  54     const DOWN = 'down';
  55     const VISIBLE = 'visible';
  56     const INVISIBLE = 'invisible';
  57 
  58     public function __construct()
  59     {
  60         // convert to Claroline course table names
  61         $tbl_lp_names = get_module_main_tbl( array('desktop_portlet') );
  62         $this->tblDesktopPortlet = $tbl_lp_names['desktop_portlet'];
  63     }
  64 
  65     // load
  66     public function loadPortlet( $label )
  67     {
  68         $sql = "SELECT
  69                     `label`,
  70                     `name`,
  71                     `rank`,
  72                     `visibility`
  73                 FROM `".$this->tblDesktopPortlet."`
  74                 WHERE label = '" . claro_sql_escape( $label ) . "'";
  75 
  76         $data = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
  77 
  78         if( empty($data) )
  79         {
  80             return false;
  81         }
  82         else
  83         {
  84             return $data;
  85         }
  86     }
  87 
  88     public function loadAll( $visibility = false )
  89     {
  90         $sql = "SELECT
  91                     `label`,
  92                     `name`,
  93                     `rank`,
  94                     `visibility`
  95                 FROM `".$this->tblDesktopPortlet."`
  96                 WHERE 1 "
  97                 . ( $visibility == true ? "AND visibility = 'visible'" : '' ) .
  98                 "ORDER BY `rank` ASC";
  99 
 100         if ( false === ( $data = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sql) ) )
 101         {
 102             return false;
 103         }
 104         else
 105         {
 106             return $data;
 107         }
 108     }
 109 
 110     // save
 111     public function addPortlet( $label, $name, $rank = null, $visible = true )
 112     {
 113         if ( Claroline::getDatabase()->query("SELECT `label` FROM `{$this->tblDesktopPortlet}` WHERE `label` = '" . claro_sql_escape($label) . "'")->numRows() )
 114         {
 115             return false;
 116         }
 117         
 118         $sql = "SELECT MAX(rank) FROM  `" . $this->tblDesktopPortlet . "`";
 119         $maxRank = claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sql);
 120         
 121         $sqlRank = empty( $rank )
 122             ? $maxRank + 1
 123             : (int) $rank
 124             ;
 125             
 126         $sqlVisibility = $visible
 127             ? "visible"
 128             : "invisible"
 129             ;
 130             
 131         // insert
 132         $sql = "INSERT INTO `".$this->tblDesktopPortlet."`
 133                 SET `label` = '" . claro_sql_escape($label) . "',
 134                     `name` = '" . claro_sql_escape($name) . "',
 135                     `visibility` = '" . $sqlVisibility . "',
 136                     `rank` = " . $sqlRank;
 137                     
 138         return ( claro_sql_query($sql) != false );
 139     }
 140 
 141     private function movePortlet($label, $direction)
 142     {
 143         switch ($direction)
 144         {
 145             case self::UP :
 146             {
 147                 //1-find value of current module rank in the dock
 148                 $sql = "SELECT `rank`
 149                         FROM `" . $this->tblDesktopPortlet . "`
 150                         WHERE `label`='" . claro_sql_escape($label) . "'"
 151                         ;
 152 
 153                 $result = claro_sql_query_get_single_value( $sql );
 154 
 155                 //2-move down above module
 156                 $sql = "UPDATE `" . $this->tblDesktopPortlet . "`
 157                         SET `rank` = `rank`+1
 158                         WHERE `label` != '" . claro_sql_escape($label) . "'
 159                         AND `rank`       = " . (int) $result['rank'] . " -1 "
 160                         ;
 161 
 162                 claro_sql_query( $sql );
 163 
 164                 //3-move up current module
 165                 $sql = "UPDATE `" . $this->tblDesktopPortlet . "`
 166                         SET `rank` = `rank`-1
 167                         WHERE `label` = '" . claro_sql_escape($label) . "'
 168                         AND `rank` > 1"
 169                         ;
 170 
 171                 claro_sql_query($sql);
 172 
 173                 break;
 174             }
 175             case self::DOWN :
 176             {
 177                 //1-find value of current module rank in the dock
 178                 $sql = "SELECT `rank`
 179                         FROM `" . $this->tblDesktopPortlet . "`
 180                         WHERE `label`='" . claro_sql_escape($label) . "'"
 181                         ;
 182 
 183                 $result = claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sql);
 184 
 185                 //this second query is to avoid a page refreshment wrong update
 186 
 187                 $sqlmax = "SELECT MAX(`rank`) AS `max_rank`
 188                           FROM `" . $this->tblDesktopPortlet . "`"
 189                           ;
 190 
 191                 $resultmax = claro_sql_query_get_single_value( $sqlmax );
 192 
 193                 if ( $resultmax['max_rank'] == $result['rank'] ) break;
 194 
 195                 //2-move up above module
 196                 $sql = "UPDATE `" . $this->tblDesktopPortlet . "`
 197                         SET `rank` = `rank` - 1
 198                         WHERE `label` != '" . claro_sql_escape($label) . "'
 199                         AND `rank` = " . (int) $result['rank'] . " + 1
 200                         AND `rank` > 1"
 201                         ;
 202 
 203                 claro_sql_query($sql);
 204 
 205                 //3-move down current module
 206                 $sql = "UPDATE `" . $this->tblDesktopPortlet . "`
 207                         SET `rank` = `rank` + 1
 208                         WHERE `label`='" . claro_sql_escape($label) . "'"
 209                         ;
 210 
 211                 claro_sql_query($sql);
 212 
 213                 break;
 214             }
 215         }
 216     }
 217 
 218     public function moveUp( $label )
 219     {
 220         $this->movePortlet( $label, self::UP );
 221     }
 222     
 223     public function moveDown( $label )
 224     {
 225         $this->movePortlet( $label, self::DOWN );
 226     }
 227     
 228     private function setVisibility( $label, $visibility )
 229     {
 230         $sql = "UPDATE `".$this->tblDesktopPortlet."`
 231                 SET `visibility` = '" . $visibility . "'
 232                 WHERE `label` = '" . $label . "'"
 233                 ;
 234 
 235         if( claro_sql_query($sql) == false ) return false;
 236 
 237         return true;
 238     }
 239 
 240     public function setVisible( $label )
 241     {
 242         $this->setVisibility( $label, self::VISIBLE);
 243     }
 244 
 245     public function setInvisible( $label )
 246     {
 247         $this->setVisibility( $label, self::INVISIBLE);
 248     }
 249 }

  19 require_once get_path( 'clarolineRepositorySys' ) . '/messaging/lib/tools.lib.php';
  20 require_once get_path( 'clarolineRepositorySys' ) . '/messaging/lib/messagebox/inbox.lib.php';
  21 
  22 class MyMessages extends UserDesktopPortlet
  23 {
  24     protected $inbox;
  25     
  26     public function __construct($label)
  27     {
  28         parent::__construct($label);
  29         
  30         $this->name = 'My last messages';
  31         $this->label = 'mymessages';
  32         
  33         $this->inbox = new InBox;
  34         $this->inbox->getMessageStrategy()->setNumberOfMessagePerPage( get_conf('myboxNumberOfMessage',5) );
  35     }
  36     
  37     
  38     public function renderContent()
  39     {
  40         $output = '';
  41         
  42         $output .= '<table class="claroTable emphaseLine" width="99%" border="0" cellspacing="2">' . "\n"
  43                  . '<thead>' . "\n"
  44                  . '<tr align="center" valign="top">' . "\n"
  45                  . '<th>&nbsp;</th>' . "\n"
  46                  . '<th>' . get_lang('Subject') . '</th>' . "\n"
  47                  . '<th>' . get_lang('Sender') . '</th>' . "\n"
  48                  . '<th>' . get_lang('Date') . '</th>' . "\n"
  49                  . '</tr>' . "\n"
  50                  . '</thead>' . "\n"
  51                  . '<tbody>' . "\n";
  52         
  53         if( $this->inbox->getNumberOfMessage() > 0 )
  54         {
  55             foreach( $this->inbox as $message )
  56             {
  57                 if ( $message->isPlatformMessage() )
  58                 {
  59                     $classMessage = 'class="platformMessage"';
  60                     $iconMessage = '<img src="' . get_icon_url('important') . '" alt="' . get_lang('Important') . '" />';
  61                 }
  62                 else
  63                 {
  64                     $classMessage = ( $message->isRead() ? 'class="readMessage"' : 'class="unreadMessage"' );
  65                     $iconMessage = ( $message->isRead() ? '<img src="' . get_icon_url('mail_open') . '" alt="" />' : '<img src="' . get_icon_url('mail_close') . '" alt="" />' );
  66                 }
  67                 
  68                 $output .= "\n"
  69                          . '<tr ' . $classMessage . '>' . "\n"
  70                          . '<td>' . $iconMessage . '</td>' . "\n"
  71                          . '<td>'
  72                          . '<a href="' . get_path( 'clarolineRepositoryWeb' ) . 'messaging/readmessage.php?messageId=' . $message->getId() . '&amp;type=received">'
  73                          . claro_htmlspecialchars( $message->getSubject() )
  74                          . '</a>' . "\n"
  75                          . '</td>' . "\n"
  76                          . '<td>' . claro_htmlspecialchars( $message->getSenderLastName() ) . '&nbsp;' . claro_htmlspecialchars( $message->getSenderFirstName() ) . '</td>' . "\n"
  77                          . '<td align="center">' . claro_html_localised_date( get_locale( 'dateFormatLong' ), strtotime( $message->getSendTime() ) ) . '</td>' . "\n"
  78                          . '</tr>' . "\n";
  79             }
  80         }
  81         else
  82         {
  83                 $output .= "\n"
  84                          . '<tr>' . "\n"
  85                          . '<td colspan="4" align="center">' . get_lang('Empty') . '</td>' . "\n"
  86                          . '</tr>' . "\n";
  87         }
  88         
  89         $output .= "\n"
  90                  . '</tbody>' . "\n"
  91                  . '</table>' . "\n"
  92                  . '<a href="'.get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb')
  93                  . 'messaging/index.php' . '">'
  94                  . get_lang('View all my messages')
  95                  . '</a>';
  96         
  97         return $output;
  98     }
  99     
 100

 102     {
 103         $output = get_lang('My %numberOfMessages last messages', array( '%numberOfMessages' => get_conf('myboxNumberOfMessage',5) ) );
 104         
 105         return $output;
 106     }
 107 }

  18 /**

  28 // The CLARO_INCLUDE_ALLOWED constant allows to include PHP file further in the
  29 // code. Files which are meant to be included check if this constant is defined.
  30 // If it isn't the case, these files immediately die.
  31 // This process prevents hacking by direct calls of included file and setting

 439 /*----------------------------------------------------------------------
 440   Prevent duplicate form submission
 441   ----------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 442 
 443 // The code below is a routine to prevent duplicate form submission, for
 444 // example if the user clicks on the 'Refresh' or 'Back' button of his
 445 // browser. It will nullify all the variables posted to the server by the
 446 // form, provided this form complies to 2 points :
 447 //
 448 // 1. The form is submitted by POST method (<form method="post">). GET
 449 // method is not taken into account.
 450 //
 451 // 2. A unique ID value is provided at form submission that way
 452 //
 453 //    <input type="hidden" name="claroFormId" value="< ?php echo uniqid(''); ? >">
 454 //
 455 // The routine records in PHP session all the the ID of the submitted
 456 // forms. Once a form is submitted, its ID is compared to recorded ID, to
 457 // check if the form hasn't be posted before.
 458 //
 459 // One can set a limit to the stored ID in session by adapting the
 460 // CLARO_MAX_REGISTERED_FORM_ID constant.
 461 
 462 define('CLARO_MAX_REGISTERED_FORM_ID', 50);
 463 
 464 if ( claro_is_user_authenticated() )
 465 {
 466     if ( empty( $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ) || !isset( $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ) )
 467     {
 468         $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = strrev(md5(time()));
 469     }
 470     
 471     if ( defined('CSRF_PROTECTED') && CSRF_PROTECTED )
 472     {
 473         if ( $_POST )
 474         {
 475             if ( !isset( $_POST['csrf_token'] ) || ( $_POST['csrf_token'] != $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ) )
 476             {
 477                 claro_die( get_lang("Not Allowed !") );
 478                 exit();
 479             }
 480         }
 481     }
 482 }
 483 
 484 if ( isset($_POST['claroFormId']) )
 485 {
 486     if ( ! isset($_SESSION['claroFormIdList']) )
 487     {
 488         $_SESSION['claroFormIdList'] = array( $_POST['claroFormId'] );
 489     }
 490     elseif ( in_array($_POST['claroFormId'], $_SESSION['claroFormIdList']) )
 491     {
 492         foreach( $_POST as $thisPostKey => $thisPostValue )
 493         {
 494             $_REQUEST[$thisPostKey] = null;
 495         }
 496 
 497         $_POST = array();
 498     }
 499     else
 500     {
 501          $claroFormIdListCount = array_unshift($_SESSION['claroFormIdList'],
 502                                                $_POST['claroFormId']         );
 503 
 504          if ( $claroFormIdListCount > CLARO_MAX_REGISTERED_FORM_ID )
 505          {
 506             array_pop( $_SESSION['claroFormIdList'] );
 507          }
 508     }
 509 }
