  20 /*******************************************************************************
  21  *
  22  *                             SCRIPT PURPOSE
  23  *
  24  * This script initializes and manages main Claroline session informations. It
  25  * keeps available session informations always up to date.
  26  *
  27  * You can request a course id. It will check if the course Id requested is the
  28  * same as the current one. If it isn't it will update session information from
  29  * the database. You can also force the course reset if you want ($cidReset).
  30  *
  31  * All the course informations are store in the $_course array.
  32  *
  33  * You can request a group id. It will check if the group Id requested is the
  34  * same as the current one. If it isn't it will update session information from
  35  * the database. You can also force the course reset if you want ($gidReset).
  36  *
  37  * All the current group information are stored in the $_group array
  38  *
  39  * The course id is stored in $_cid session variable.
  40  * The group  id is stored in $_gid session variable.
  41  *
  42  *
  43  *                    VARIABLES AFFECTING THE SCRIPT BEHAVIOR
  44  *
  45  * string  $login
  46  * string  $password
  47  * boolean $logout
  48  *
  49  * string  $cidReq   : course Id requested
  50  * boolean $cidReset : ask for a course Reset, if no $cidReq is provided in the
  51  *                     same time, all course informations is removed from the
  52  *                     current session
  53  *
  54  * int     $gidReq   : group Id requested
  55  * boolean $gidReset : ask for a group Reset, if no $gidReq is provided in the
  56  *                     same time, all group informations is removed from the
  57  *                     current session
  58  *
  59  * int     $tidReq   : tool Id requested
  60  * boolean $tidReset : ask for a tool reset, if no $tidReq or $tlabelReq is
  61  *                     provided  in the same time, all information concerning
  62  *                     the current tool is removed from the current sesssion
  63  *
  64  * $tlabelReq        : more generic call to a tool. Each tool are identified by
  65  *                     a unique id into the course. But tools which are part of
  66  *                     the claroline release have also an generic label.
  67  *                     Tool label and tool id are decoupled. It means that one
  68  *                     can have several token of the same tool with different
  69  *                     settings in the same course.
  70  *
  71  *                   VARIABLES SET AND RETURNED BY THE SCRIPT
  72  *
  73  * Here is resumed below all the variables set and returned by this script.
  74  *
  75  * USER VARIABLES
  76  *
  77  * int $_uid (the user id)
  78  *
  79  * string  $_user ['firstName']
  80  * string  $_user ['lastName' ]
  81  * string  $_user ['mail'     ]
  82  * string  $_user ['officialEmail'     ]
  83  * string  $_user ['lastLogin']
  84  *
  85  * boolean $is_platformAdmin
  86  * boolean $is_allowedCreateCourse
  87  *
  88  * COURSE VARIABLES
  89  *
  90  * string  $_cid (the course id)
  91  *
  92  * string  $_course['name'        ]
  93  * string  $_course['officialCode']
  94  * string  $_course['sysCode'     ]
  95  * string  $_course['path'        ]
  96  * string  $_course['dbName'      ]
  97  * string  $_course['dbNameGlu'   ]
  98  * string  $_course['titular'     ]
  99  * string  $_course['language'    ]
 100  * string  $_course['extLinkUrl'  ]
 101  * string  $_course['extLinkName' ]
 102  * string  $_course['categoryCode']
 103  * string  $_course['categoryName']
 104  *
 105  * PROPERTIES IN ALL GROUPS OF THE COURSE
 106  *
 107  * boolean $_groupProperties ['registrationAllowed']
 108  * boolean $_groupProperties ['private'            ]
 109  * int     $_groupProperties ['nbGroupPerUser'     ]
 110  * boolean $_groupProperties ['tools'] ['CLFRM']
 111  * boolean $_groupProperties ['tools'] ['CLDOC']
 112  * boolean $_groupProperties ['tools'] ['CLWIKI']
 113  * boolean $_groupProperties ['tools'] ['CLCHT']
 114  *
 115  * REL COURSE USER VARIABLES
 116  * int     $_profileId
 117  * string  $_courseUser['role']
 118  * boolean $is_courseMember
 119  * boolean $is_courseTutor
 120  * boolean $is_courseAdmin
 121  *
 122  * REL COURSE GROUP VARIABLES
 123  *
 124  * int     $_gid (the group id)
 125  *
 126  * string  $_group ['name'       ]
 127  * string  $_group ['description']
 128  * int     $_group ['tutorId'    ]
 129  * int     $_group ['forumId'    ]
 130  * string  $_group ['directory'  ]
 131  * int     $_group ['maxMember'  ]
 132  *
 133  * boolean $is_groupMember
 134  * boolean $is_groupTutor
 135  * boolean $is_groupAllowed
 136  *
 137  * TOOL VARIABLES
 138  *
 139  * int $_tid
 140  *
 141  * string $_courseTool['label'         ]
 142  * string $_courseTool['name'          ]
 143  * string $_courseTool['visibility'    ]
 144  * string $_courseTool['url'           ]
 145  * string $_courseTool['icon'          ]
 146  * string $_courseTool['access_manager']
 147  *
 148  * REL USER TOOL COURSE VARIABLES
 149  * boolean $is_toolAllowed
 150  *
 151  * LIST OF THE TOOLS AVAILABLE FOR THE CURRENT USER
 152  *
 153  * int     $_courseToolList[]['id'            ]
 154  * string  $_courseToolList[]['label'         ]
 155  * string  $_courseToolList[]['name'          ]
 156  * string  $_courseToolList[]['visibility'    ]
 157  * string  $_courseToolList[]['icon'          ]
 158  * string  $_courseToolList[]['access_manager']
 159  * string  $_courseToolList[]['url'           ]
 160  *
 161  *
 162  *                       IMPORTANT ADVICE FOR DEVELOPERS
 163  *
 164  * We strongly encourage developers to use a connection layer at the top of
 165  * their scripts rather than use these variables, as they are, inside the core
 166  * of their scripts. It will make Claroline code maintenance much easier.
 167  *
 168  * For example, a common practice is to connect the user status with action
 169  * permission flag at the top of the script like this :
 170  *
 171  *     $is_allowedToEdit = $is_courseAdmin
 172  *
 173  *
 174  *                               SCRIPT STRUCTURE
 175  *
 176  * 1. The script determines if there is an authentication attempt. This part
 177  * only chek if the login name and password are valid. Afterwards, it set the
 178  * $_uid (user id) and the $uidReset flag. Other user informations are retrieved
 179  * later. It's also in this section that optional external authentication
 180  * devices step in.
 181  *
 182  * 2. The script determines what other session informations have to be set or
 183  * reset, setting correctly $cidReset (for course) and $gidReset (for group).
 184  *
 185  * 3. If needed, the script retrieves the other user informations (first name,
 186  * last name, ...) and stores them in session.
 187  *
 188  * 4. If needed, the script retrieves the course information and stores them
 189  * in session
 190  *
 191  * 5. The script initializes the user status and permission for current course
 192  *
 193  * 6. If needed, the script retrieves group informations an store them in
 194  * session.
 195  *
 196  * 7. The script initializes the user status and permission for the current group.
 197  *
 198  * 8. The script initializes the user status and permission for the current tool
 199  *
 200  * 9. The script get the list of all the tool available into the current course
 201  *    for the current user.
 202  ******************************************************************************/
 203

 227 /*===========================================================================

 232 $AllowedPhpRequestList = array('logout', 'uidReset',
 233                                'cidReset', 'cidReq',
 234                                'gidReset', 'gidReq',
 235                                'tidReset', 'tidReq', 'tlabelReq');
 236 
 237 // Cleaning up $GLOBALS to avoid issues with register_globals
 238 foreach($AllowedPhpRequestList as $thisPhpRequestName)

 241     // the claro init process. Avoid variable setting if it is the case.
 242 
 243     if ( isset($GLOBALS[$thisPhpRequestName]) )

 245         continue;
 246     }
 247 
 248     if ( isset($_REQUEST[$thisPhpRequestName] ) )
 249     {
 250         $GLOBALS[$thisPhpRequestName] = $_REQUEST[$thisPhpRequestName];
 251     }
 252     else
 253     {
 254         $GLOBALS[$thisPhpRequestName] = null;
 255     }
 256 }

 259 if ( is_null( $cidReset ) )

 262         && isset( $_SESSION['_cid'] )
 263         && $cidReq != $_SESSION['_cid'] )

 265         $cidReset = true;
 266     }
 267     elseif ( isset( $cidReq )

 270         $cidReset = true;
 271     }

 273         && isset( $_SESSION['_cid'] ) )
 274     {
 275         $cidReset = true;
 276     }
 277 }

 279 if ( is_null( $gidReset ) )

 284     {

 292     elseif ( ! isset( $gidReq )
 293         && isset( $_SESSION['_gid'] ) )

 299 $login    = isset($_REQUEST['login'   ]) ? trim( $_REQUEST['login'   ] ) : null;
 300 $password = isset($_REQUEST['password']) ? trim( $_REQUEST['password'] ) : null;
 301 
 302 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 303   Check authentification
 304  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 305 
 306 // default variables initialization
 307 $claro_loginRequested = false;
 308 $claro_loginSucceeded = false;
 309 $currentUser = false;
 310 
 311 if ( $logout && !empty($_SESSION['_uid']) )
 312 {
 313     // logout from CAS server
 314     if ( get_conf('claro_CasEnabled', false) && get_conf('claro_CasGlobalLogout') )
 315     {
 316         require get_path('rootSys').'/claroline/auth/extauth/cas/casProcess.inc.php';
 317     }
 318     
 319     // needed to notify that a user has just loggued out
 320     $logout_uid = $_SESSION['_uid'];
 321 }
 322 
 323 if ( ! empty($_SESSION['_uid']) && ! ($login || $logout) )
 324 {
 325     if (isset($_REQUEST['switchToUser']))
 326     {
 327         if (! empty($_SESSION['_user']['isPlatformAdmin']))
 328         {
 329             if ((bool) $_SESSION['_user']['isPlatformAdmin'] === true)
 330             {
 331                 $targetId = $_REQUEST['switchToUser'];
 332 
 333                 if (user_is_admin($targetId))
 334                 {
 335                     exit('ERROR !! You cannot access another administrator account !');
 336                 }
 337                 
 338                 try
 339                 {
 340                     $currentUser = Claro_CurrentUser::getInstance($targetId, true);
 341                     $currentUser->saveToSession();
 342                     
 343                 }
 344                 catch (Exception $ex)
 345                 {
 346                     exit('ERROR !! Undefined user id: the requested user doesn\'t exist'
 347                          . 'at line '.__LINE__);
 348                 }
 349                 
 350                 $_SESSION['_uid']             = $targetId;
 351                 $_SESSION['isVirtualUser']    = true;
 352                 $_SESSION['is_platformAdmin'] = $_SESSION['_user']['isPlatformAdmin'];
 353                 $_SESSION['is_allowedCreateCourse'] = $_SESSION['_user']['isCourseCreator'];
 354             }
 355         }
 356     }
 357     
 358     // uid is in session => login already done, continue with this value
 359     $_uid = $_SESSION['_uid'];
 360     
 361     $is_platformAdmin = !empty($_SESSION['is_platformAdmin'])
 362         ? $_SESSION['is_platformAdmin']
 363         : false
 364         ;
 365 
 366     $is_allowedCreateCourse = !empty($_SESSION['is_allowedCreateCourse'])
 367         ? $_SESSION['is_allowedCreateCourse']
 368         : false
 369         ;
 370 }
 371 else
 372 {
 373     // $_uid     = null;   // uid not in session ? prevent any hacking
 374     $uidReset = false;
 375     
 376     // Unset current user authentication :
 377     if ( isset( $GLOBALS['_uid'] ) )
 378     {
 379         unset( $GLOBALS['_uid'] );
 380     }
 381     
 382     if ( isset( $_SESSION['_uid'] ) )
 383     {
 384         unset( $_SESSION['_uid'] );
 385     }
 386     
 387     if ( isset( $GLOBALS['_user'] ) )
 388     {
 389         unset( $GLOBALS['_user'] );
 390     }
 391     
 392     if ( isset( $_SESSION['_user'] ) )
 393     {
 394         unset( $_SESSION['_user'] );
 395     }
 396     
 397     // CAS
 398 
 399     if ( get_conf('claro_CasEnabled', false)
 400          && isset($_REQUEST['authModeReq'])
 401          && $_REQUEST['authModeReq'] == 'CAS'
 402          )
 403     {
 404         require get_path('rootSys').'/claroline/auth/extauth/cas/casProcess.inc.php';
 405     }
 406     
 407     // SHIBBOLETH ( PROBABLY BROKEN !!!! )
 408     
 409     if ( get_conf('claro_ShibbolethEnabled',false) )
 410     {
 411         require get_path('rootSys').'/claroline/auth/extauth/shibboleth/shibbolethProcess.inc.php';
 412     }
 413 
 414     if ( $login && $password ) // $login && $password are given to log in
 415     {
 416         // reinitalize all session variables
 417         session_unset();
 418 
 419         $claro_loginRequested = true;
 420         
 421         try
 422         {
 423             $currentUser = AuthManager::authenticate($login, $password);
 424 
 425             if ( $currentUser )
 426             {
 427                 $_uid = (int)$currentUser->userId;
 428                 $uidReset = true;
 429                 $claro_loginSucceeded = true;
 430             }
 431             else
 432             {
 433                 $_uid = null;
 434                 $claro_loginSucceeded = false;
 435             }
 436         }
 437         catch (Exception $e)
 438         {
 439             Console::error("Cannot authenticate user : " . $e->__toString());
 440             $_uid = null;
 441             $claro_loginSucceeded = false;
 442         }
 443     } // end if $login & password
 444     else
 445     {
 446         $claro_loginRequested = false;
 447     }
 448 }
 449 
 450 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 451   User initialisation
 452  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 453 
 454 if ( !empty($_uid) ) // session data refresh requested && uid is given (log in succeeded)
 455 {
 456     try
 457     {
 458         /*if (!$currentUser)
 459         {
 460             $currentUser = Claro_CurrentUser::getInstance($_uid);
 461         }*/
 462         
 463         // User login
 464         if ( $uidReset )
 465         {
 466             // Update the current session id with a newly generated one ( PHP >= 4.3.2 )
 467             // This function is vital in preventing session fixation attacks
 468             // function_exists('session_regenerate_id') && session_regenerate_id();
 469         
 470             $cidReset = true;
 471             $gidReset = true;
 472             
 473             $currentUser = Claro_CurrentUser::getInstance( $_uid, true );
 474             
 475             $_user = $currentUser->getRawData();
 476     
 477             // Extracting the user data
 478             $is_platformAdmin = $currentUser->isPlatformAdmin;
 479             $is_allowedCreateCourse  = ( get_conf('courseCreationAllowed', true) && $currentUser->isCourseCreator ) || $is_platformAdmin;
 480             
 481             $currentUser->saveToSession();
 482     
 483             if ( $currentUser->firstLogin() )
 484             {
 485                 // first login for a not self registred (e.g. registered by a teacher)
 486                 // do nothing (code may be added later)
 487                 $currentUser->updateCreatorId();
 488                 $_SESSION['firstLogin'] = true;
 489             }
 490             else
 491             {
 492                 $_SESSION['firstLogin'] = false;
 493             }
 494     
 495             // RECORD SSO COOKIE
 496             // $ssoEnabled set in conf/auth.sso.conf.php
 497             if ( get_conf('ssoEnabled',false ))
 498             {
 499                 FromKernel::uses ( 'sso/cookie.lib' );
 500                 $boolCookie = SingleSignOnCookie::setForUser( $currentUser->userId );
 501             } // end if ssoEnabled
 502         }
 503         // User in session
 504         else
 505         {
 506             $currentUser = Claro_CurrentUser::getInstance($_uid);
 507             
 508             try
 509             {
 510                 $currentUser->loadFromSession();
 511                 $_user = $currentUser->getRawData();
 512             }
 513             catch ( Exception $e )
 514             {
 515                 $_user = null;
 516             }
 517         }
 518     }
 519     catch ( Exception $e )
 520     {
 521         exit('WARNING !! Undefined user id: the requested user doesn\'t exist '
 522             . 'at line '.__LINE__);
 523     }
 524 }
 525 else
 526 {
 527     // Anonymous, logout or login failed
 528     $_user = null;
 529     $_uid  = null;
 530     $is_platformAdmin        = false;
 531     $is_allowedCreateCourse  = false;
 532 }
 533 
 534 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 535   Course initialisation
 536  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 537 
 538 // if the requested course is different from the course in session
 539 
 540 if ( $cidReq && ( !isset($_SESSION['_cid']) || $cidReq != $_SESSION['_cid'] ) )
 541 {
 542     $cidReset = true;
 543     $gidReset = true;    // As groups depend from courses, group id is reset
 544 }
 545 
 546 if ( $cidReset ) // course session data refresh requested
 547 {
 548     if ( $cidReq )
 549     {
 550         $_course = claro_get_course_data($cidReq, true);
 551 
 552         if ($_course == false)
 553         {
 554             die('WARNING !! The course\'s datas couldn\'t be loaded at line '
 555                 .__LINE__.'.  Please contact your platform administrator.');
 556         }
 557 
 558         $_cid    = $_course['sysCode'];
 559 
 560         $_groupProperties = claro_get_main_group_properties($_cid);
 561 
 562         if ($_groupProperties == false)
 563         {
 564             die('WARNING !! The group\'s properties couldn\'t be loaded at line '
 565                 .__LINE__.'.  Please contact your platform administrator.');
 566         }
 567     }
 568     else
 569     {
 570         $_cid    = null;
 571         $_course = null;
 572 
 573         $_groupProperties ['registrationAllowed'] = false;
 574         
 575         $groupToolList = get_group_tool_label_list();
 576         
 577         foreach ( $groupToolList as $thisGroupTool )
 578         {
 579             $thisGroupToolLabel = $thisGroupTool['label'];
 580             $propertyList['tools'][$thisGroupToolLabel] = false;
 581         }
 582         
 583         $_groupProperties ['private'] = true;
 584     }
 585 
 586 }
 587 else // else of if($cidReset) - continue with the previous values
 588 {
 589     $_cid = !empty($_SESSION['_cid'])
 590         ? $_SESSION['_cid']
 591         : null
 592         ;
 593     
 594     $_course = !empty($_SESSION['_course'])
 595         ? $_SESSION['_course']
 596         : null
 597         ;
 598     
 599     $_groupProperties = !empty($_SESSION['_groupProperties'])
 600         ? $_SESSION['_groupProperties']
 601         : null
 602         ;
 603 }
 604 
 605 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 606   Course / user relation initialisation
 607  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 608 
 609 if ( $uidReset || $cidReset ) // session data refresh requested
 610 {
 611     if ( $_uid && $_cid ) // have keys to search data
 612     {
 613           $_course_user_properties = claro_get_course_user_properties($_cid,$_uid,true);
 614 
 615           // would probably be less and less used because
 616           // claro_get_course_user_data($_cid,$_uid)
 617           // and claro_get_current_course_user_data() do the same job
 618 
 619           $_profileId      = $_course_user_properties['privilege']['_profileId'];
 620           $is_courseMember = $_course_user_properties['privilege']['is_courseMember'];
 621           $is_courseTutor  = $_course_user_properties['privilege']['is_courseTutor'];
 622           $is_courseAdmin  = $_course_user_properties['privilege']['is_courseAdmin'];
 623 
 624           $_courseUser = claro_get_course_user_data($_cid,$_uid);
 625     }
 626     else // keys missing => not anymore in the course - user relation
 627     {
 628         // course
 629         $_profileId      = claro_get_profile_id('anonymous');
 630         $is_courseMember = false;
 631         $is_courseAdmin  = false;
 632         $is_courseTutor  = false;
 633 
 634         $_courseUser = null; // not used
 635     }
 636     
 637     $is_courseAllowed = (bool)
 638     (
 639         ( $_course['visibility']
 640           && ( $_course['access'] == 'public'
 641                || ( $_course['access'] == 'platform'
 642                     && claro_is_user_authenticated()
 643                   )
 644              )
 645         )
 646         || $is_courseMember
 647         || $is_platformAdmin
 648     ); // here because it's a right and not a state
 649 }
 650 else // else of if ($uidReset || $cidReset) - continue with the previous values
 651 {
 652     $_profileId = !empty($_SESSION['_profileId'])
 653         ? $_SESSION['_profileId']
 654         : false
 655         ;
 656     
 657     $is_courseMember = !empty($_SESSION['is_courseMember'])
 658         ? $_SESSION['is_courseMember']
 659         : false
 660         ;
 661     
 662     $is_courseAdmin = !empty($_SESSION['is_courseAdmin'])
 663         ? $_SESSION['is_courseAdmin']
 664         : false
 665         ;
 666     
 667     $is_courseAllowed = !empty($_SESSION['is_courseAllowed'])
 668         ? $_SESSION['is_courseAllowed' ]
 669         : false
 670         ;
 671     
 672     $is_courseTutor = !empty($_SESSION['is_courseTutor'])
 673         ? $_SESSION['is_courseTutor']
 674         : false
 675         ;
 676     
 677     // not used !?!
 678     $_courseUser = !empty($_SESSION['_courseUser'])
 679         ? $_SESSION['_courseUser']
 680         : null
 681         ;
 682 }
 683 
 684 // Installed module in course if available in platform and not in course
 685 if ( $_cid
 686     && is_array( $_course )
 687     && isset($_course['dbNameGlu'])
 688     && !empty($_course['dbNameGlu'])
 689     && trim($_course['dbNameGlu']) )
 690 {
 691     // 0. load course configuration to avoid creating uneeded examples
 692     
 693     require claro_get_conf_repository() . 'course_main.conf.php';
 694     
 695     
 696     // 1. get tool list from main db
 697     
 698     $mainCourseToolList = claro_get_main_course_tool_list();
 699     
 700     // 2. get list af already installed tools from course
 701     
 702     $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 703     $tbl_tool            = $tbl_mdb_names['tool'           ];
 704 
 705     $sql = " SELECT pct.id                    AS toolId       ,
 706                   pct.claro_label           AS label
 707 
 708             FROM `".$_course['dbNameGlu']."tool_list` AS ctl
 709             INNER JOIN `".$tbl_tool."` AS pct
 710             ON `ctl`.`tool_id` = `pct`.`id`
 711             WHERE ctl.installed = 'true'";
 712     
 713     $courseToolList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sql);
 714     
 715     $tmp = array();
 716     
 717     foreach ( $courseToolList as $thisCourseTool )
 718     {
 719         $tmp[$thisCourseTool['label']] = $thisCourseTool['toolId'];
 720     }
 721     
 722     // 3. compare the two lists and register and install/activate missing tool if necessary
 723     
 724     $listOfToolsToAdd = array();
 725     
 726     foreach ( $mainCourseToolList as $thisToolId => $thisMainCourseTool )
 727     {
 728         if ( ! array_key_exists( $thisMainCourseTool['label'], $tmp ) )
 729         {
 730             $listOfToolsToAdd[$thisMainCourseTool['label']] = $thisToolId;
 731         }
 732     }
 733     
 734     foreach ( $listOfToolsToAdd as $toolLabel => $toolId )
 735     {
 736         if ( ! is_module_registered_in_course( $toolId, $_cid ) )
 737         {
 738             register_module_in_single_course( $toolId, $_cid );
 739         }
 740         
 741         if ( !is_module_installed_in_course( $toolLabel, $_cid )
 742             && 'AUTOMATIC' == get_module_data( $toolLabel, 'add_in_course' ) )
 743         {
 744             install_module_in_course( $toolLabel, $_cid );
 745         }
 746         
 747         if ( 'AUTOMATIC' == get_module_data( $toolLabel, 'add_in_course' ) )
 748         {
 749             if ( 'activated' == get_module_data( $toolLabel, 'activation' ) )
 750             {
 751                 update_course_tool_activation_in_course( $toolId,
 752                     $_cid,
 753                     true );
 754                 
 755                 set_module_visibility_in_course( $toolId, $_cid, true );
 756             }
 757         }
 758     }
 759 }
 760 
 761 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 762   Course / tool relation initialisation
 763  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 764 
 765 // if the requested tool is different from the current tool in session
 766 // (special request can come from the tool id, or the tool label)
 767 
 768 if (   ( $tidReq    && $tidReq    != $_SESSION['_tid']                 )
 769     || ( $tlabelReq && ( ! isset($_SESSION['_courseTool']['label'])
 770                          || $tlabelReq != $_SESSION['_courseTool']['label']) )
 771    )
 772 {
 773     $tidReset = true;
 774 }
 775 
 776 if ( $tidReset || $cidReset ) // session data refresh requested
 777 {
 778     if ( ( $tidReq || $tlabelReq) && $_cid ) // have keys to search data
 779     {
 780         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 781         $tbl_tool            = $tbl_mdb_names['tool'           ];
 782 
 783         $sql = " SELECT ctl.id                  AS id            ,
 784                       pct.id                    AS toolId       ,
 785                       pct.claro_label           AS label         ,
 786                       ctl.script_name           AS name          ,
 787                       ctl.visibility            AS visibility    ,
 788                       pct.icon                  AS icon          ,
 789                       pct.access_manager        AS access_manager,
 790                       pct.script_url            AS url
 791 
 792                    FROM `".$_course['dbNameGlu']."tool_list` ctl,
 793                     `".$tbl_tool."`  pct
 794 
 795                WHERE `ctl`.`tool_id` = `pct`.`id`
 796                  AND (`ctl`.`id`      = '". (int) $tidReq."'
 797                        OR   (".(int) is_null($tidReq)." AND pct.claro_label = '". claro_sql_escape($tlabelReq) ."')
 798                      )";
 799 
 800         // Note : 'ctl' stands for  'course tool list' and  'pct' for 'platform course tool'
 801         $_courseTool = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
 802 
 803         if ( is_array($_courseTool) ) // this tool have a recorded state for this course
 804         {
 805             $_tid        = $_courseTool['id'];
 806             $_mainToolId = $_courseTool['toolId'];
 807         }
 808         else // this tool has no status related to this course
 809         {
 810             $activatedModules = get_module_label_list( true );
 811             
 812             if ( ! in_array( $tlabelReq, $activatedModules ) )
 813             {
 814                 exit('WARNING !! Undefined Tlabel or Tid: your script declare '
 815                     . 'be a tool wich is not registred at line '.__LINE__.'.  '
 816                     . 'Please contact your platform administrator.');
 817             }
 818             else
 819             {
 820                 $_tid        = null;
 821                 $_mainToolId = null;
 822                 $_courseTool = null;
 823             }
 824         }
 825     }
 826     else // keys missing => not anymore in the course - tool relation
 827     {
 828         // course
 829         $_tid        = null;
 830         $_mainToolId = null;
 831         $_courseTool = null;
 832     }
 833 
 834 }
 835 else // continue with the previous values
 836 {
 837     $_tid = !empty($_SESSION['_tid'])
 838         ? $_SESSION['_tid']
 839         : null
 840         ;
 841     
 842     $_mainToolId = !empty($_SESSION['_mainToolId'])
 843         ? $_SESSION['_mainToolId']
 844         : null
 845         ;
 846     
 847     $_courseTool = !empty( $_SESSION['_courseTool'])
 848         ? $_SESSION['_courseTool']
 849         : null
 850         ;
 851 }
 852 
 853 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 854   Group initialisation
 855  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 856 
 857 // if the requested group is different from the group in session
 858 
 859 if ( $gidReq && ( !isset($_SESSION['_gid']) || $gidReq != $_SESSION['_gid']) )
 860 {
 861     $gidReset = true;
 862 }
 863 
 864 if ( $gidReset || $cidReset ) // session data refresh requested
 865 {
 866     if ( $gidReq && $_cid ) // have keys to search data
 867     {
 868         $context = array(
 869             CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE => $_cid,
 870             CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP => $gidReq );
 871         
 872         $course_group_data = claro_get_group_data($context, true );
 873 
 874         $_group = $course_group_data;
 875         
 876         if ( $_group ) // This group has recorded status related to this course
 877         {
 878             $_gid = $course_group_data ['id'];
 879         }
 880         else
 881         {
 882             claro_die('WARNING !! Undefined groupd id: the requested group '
 883                 . ' doesn\'t exist at line '.__LINE__.'.  '
 884                 . 'Please contact your platform administrator.');
 885         }
 886     }
 887     else  // Keys missing => not anymore in the group - course relation
 888     {
 889         $_gid   = null;
 890         $_group = null;
 891     }
 892 }
 893 else // continue with the previous values
 894 {
 895     $_gid = !empty($_SESSION ['_gid'])
 896         ? $_SESSION ['_gid']
 897         : null
 898         ;
 899     
 900     $_group = !empty($_SESSION ['_group'])
 901         ? $_SESSION ['_group']
 902         : null
 903         ;
 904 }
 905 
 906 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 907   Group / User relation initialisation
 908  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 909 
 910 if ($uidReset || $cidReset || $gidReset) // session data refresh requested
 911 {
 912     if ($_uid && $_cid && $_gid) // have keys to search data
 913     {
 914         $sql = "SELECT status,
 915                        role
 916                 FROM `" . $_course['dbNameGlu'] . "group_rel_team_user`
 917                 WHERE `user` = '". (int) $_uid . "'
 918                 AND `team`   = '". (int) $gidReq . "'";
 919 
 920         $result = claro_sql_query($sql)  or die ('WARNING !! Load user course_group status (DB QUERY) FAILED ! '.__LINE__);
 921 
 922         if (mysql_num_rows($result) > 0) // This user has a recorded status related to this course group
 923         {
 924             $gpuData = mysql_fetch_array($result);
 925 
 926             $_groupUser ['status'] = $gpuData ['status'];
 927             $_groupUser ['role'  ] = $gpuData ['role'  ];
 928 
 929             $is_groupMember = true;
 930         }
 931         else
 932         {
 933             $is_groupMember = false;
 934             $_groupUser     = null;
 935         }
 936 
 937         $is_groupTutor = ($_group['tutorId'] == $_uid);
 938 
 939     }
 940     else  // Keys missing => not anymore in the user - group (of this course) relation
 941     {
 942         $is_groupMember = false;
 943         $is_groupTutor  = false;
 944 
 945         $_groupUser = null;
 946     }
 947 
 948     // user group access is allowed or user is group member or user is admin
 949     $is_groupAllowed = (bool) (!$_groupProperties['private']
 950                                || $is_groupMember
 951                                || $is_courseAdmin
 952                                || claro_is_group_tutor()
 953                                || $is_platformAdmin);
 954 
 955 }
 956 else // continue with the previous values
 957 {
 958     $_groupUser = !empty($_SESSION['_groupUser'])
 959         ? $_SESSION['_groupUser']
 960         : null
 961         ;
 962         
 963     $is_groupMember  = !empty($_SESSION['is_groupMember'])
 964         ? $_SESSION['is_groupMember']
 965         : null
 966         ;
 967     
 968     $is_groupTutor = !empty($_SESSION['is_groupTutor'])
 969         ? $_SESSION['is_groupTutor']
 970         : null
 971         ;
 972     
 973     $is_groupAllowed = !empty($_SESSION['is_groupAllowed'])
 974         ? $_SESSION['is_groupAllowed']
 975         : null
 976         ;
 977 }
 978 
 979 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 980   COURSE TOOL / USER / GROUP REL. INIT
 981  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 982 
 983 if ( $uidReset || $cidReset || $gidReset || $tidReset ) // session data refresh requested
 984 {
 985     if ( $_tid && $_gid )
 986     {
 987         //echo 'passed here';
 988 
 989         $toolLabel = trim( $_courseTool['label'] , '_');
 990 
 991         $is_toolAllowed = array_key_exists($toolLabel, $_groupProperties ['tools'])
 992             && $_groupProperties ['tools'] [$toolLabel]
 993             // do not allow to access group tools when groups are not allowed for current profile
 994             && claro_is_allowed_tool_read(get_tool_id_from_module_label('CLGRP'),$_profileId,$_cid);
 995 
 996         if ( $_groupProperties ['private'] )
 997         {
 998             $is_toolAllowed = $is_toolAllowed && ( $is_groupMember || claro_is_group_tutor() );
 999         }
1000 
1001         $is_toolAllowed = $is_toolAllowed || ( $is_courseAdmin || $is_platformAdmin );
1002     }
1003     elseif ( $_tid )
1004     {
1005         if ( ( ! $_courseTool['visibility'] && ! claro_is_allowed_tool_edit($_mainToolId,$_profileId,$_cid) )
1006              || ! claro_is_allowed_tool_read($_mainToolId,$_profileId,$_cid) )
1007         {
1008             $is_toolAllowed = false;
1009         }
1010         else
1011         {
1012             $is_toolAllowed = true;
1013         }
1014     }
1015     else
1016     {
1017         $is_toolAllowed = false;
1018     }
1019 
1020 }
1021 else // continue with the previous values
1022 {
1023     $is_toolAllowed = !empty( $_SESSION['is_toolAllowed'] )
1024         ? $_SESSION['is_toolAllowed']
1025         : null
1026         ;
1027 }
1028 
1029 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1030   Course tool list initialisation for current user
1031  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
1032 
1033 if ($uidReset || $cidReset)
1034 {
1035     if ($_cid) // have course keys to search data
1036     {
1037         $_courseToolList = claro_get_course_tool_list($_cid, $_profileId, true, true);
1038     }
1039     else
1040     {
1041         $_courseToolList = null;
1042     }
1043 }
1044 else // continue with the previous values
1045 {
1046     $_courseToolList = !empty($_SESSION['_courseToolList'])
1047         ? $_SESSION['_courseToolList']
1048         : null
1049         ;
1050 }
1051 
1052 /*===========================================================================
1053   Save all variables in session
1054  ===========================================================================*/
1055 
1056 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1057   User info in the platform
1058  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
1059 $_SESSION['_uid'                  ] = $_uid;
1060 $_SESSION['_user'                 ] = $_user;
1061 $_SESSION['is_allowedCreateCourse'] = $is_allowedCreateCourse;
1062 $_SESSION['is_platformAdmin'      ] = $is_platformAdmin;
1063 
1064 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1065   Course info of $_cid course
1066  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
1067 
1068 $_SESSION['_cid'            ] = $_cid;
1069 $_SESSION['_course'         ] = $_course;
1070 $_SESSION['_groupProperties'] = $_groupProperties;
1071 
1072 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1073   User rights of $_uid in $_cid course
1074  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
1075 
1076 $_SESSION['_profileId'      ] = $_profileId;
1077 $_SESSION['is_courseAdmin'  ] = $is_courseAdmin;
1078 $_SESSION['is_courseAllowed'] = $is_courseAllowed;
1079 $_SESSION['is_courseMember' ] = $is_courseMember;
1080 $_SESSION['is_courseTutor'  ] = $is_courseTutor;
1081 
1082 if ( isset($_courseUser) ) $_SESSION['_courseUser'] = $_courseUser; // not used
1083 
1084 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1085   Tool info of $_tid in $_cid course
1086  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
1087 
1088 $_SESSION['_tid'       ] = $_tid;
1089 $_SESSION['_mainToolId'] = $_mainToolId;
1090 $_SESSION['_courseTool'] = $_courseTool;
1091 
1092 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1093   Group info of $_gid in $_cid course
1094  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
1095 
1096 $_SESSION['_gid'           ] = $_gid;
1097 $_SESSION['_group'         ] = $_group;
1098 $_SESSION['is_groupAllowed'] = $is_groupAllowed;
1099 $_SESSION['is_groupMember' ] = $is_groupMember;
1100 $_SESSION['is_groupTutor'  ] = $is_groupTutor;
1101 
1102 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1103  Tool in $_cid course allowed to $_uid user
1104  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
1105 
1106 if ( $_cid && $_tid )
1107 {
1108     $is_toolAllowed = $is_toolAllowed && claro_is_course_tool_activated( $_cid, $_tid );
1109 }
1110 
1111 $_SESSION['is_toolAllowed'] = $is_toolAllowed;
1112 
1113 /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1114   List of available tools in $_cid course
1115  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
1116 
1117 $_SESSION['_courseToolList'] = $_courseToolList;

   1 <?php // $Id: add_course.lib.inc.php 14314 2012-11-07 09:09:19Z zefredz $
   2 
   3 if ( count( get_included_files() ) == 1 )
   4 {
   5     die( 'The file ' . basename(__FILE__) . ' cannot be accessed directly, use include instead' );
   6 }
   7 
   8 /**
   9  * CLAROLINE
  10  *
  11  * add_course lib contain function to add a course
  12  * add is, find keys names aivailable, build the the course database
  13  * fill the course database, build the content directorys, build the index page
  14  * build the directory tree, register the course.
  15  *
  16  * @version 1.9 $Revision: 14314 $
  17  *
  18  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  19  *
  20  * @license http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html (GPL) GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
  21  *
  22  * @see http://www.claroline.net/wiki/CLCRS/
  23  *
  24  * @package COURSE
  25  *
  26  * @author Claro Team <cvs@claroline.net>
  27  * @author Christophe Gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
  28  * @author Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  29  *
  30  */
  31 
  32 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/course_user.lib.php';
  33 
  34 
  35 /**
  36  * with  the WantedCode we can define the 4 keys  to find courses datas
  37  *
  38  * @param string $wantedCode initial model
  39  * @param string $prefix4all       prefix added  for ALL keys
  40  * @param string $prefix4baseName  prefix added  for basename key (after the $prefix4all)
  41  * @param string $prefix4path      prefix added  for repository key (after the $prefix4all)
  42  * @param string $addUniquePrefix  prefix randomly generated prepend to model
  43  * @param boolean $useCodeInDepedentKeys   whether not ignore $wantedCode param. If FALSE use an empty model.
  44  * @param boolean $addUniqueSuffix suffix randomly generated append to model
  45  * @return array
  46  * - ["currentCourseCode"]          : Must be alphaNumeric and outputable in HTML System
  47  * - ["currentCourseId"]            : Must be unique in mainDb.course it's the primary key
  48  * - ["currentCourseDbName"]        : Must be unique it's the database name.
  49  * - ["currentCourseRepository"]    : Must be unique in /get_path('coursesRepositorySys')/
  50  *
  51  * @todo actually if suffix is not unique the next append and not replace
  52  * @todo add param listing keyg wich wouldbe identical
  53  * @todo manage an error on brake for too many try
  54  * @todo $keysCourseCode is always
  55  */
  56 function define_course_keys ($wantedCode,
  57                              $prefix4all = '',
  58                              $prefix4baseName = '',
  59                              $prefix4path = '',
  60                              $addUniquePrefix = false,
  61                              $useCodeInDepedentKeys = true,
  62                              $addUniqueSuffix = false
  63 
  64                              )
  65 {
  66     $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  67     $tbl_course    = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
  68 
  69 
  70     $nbCharFinalSuffix = get_conf('nbCharFinalSuffix','3');
  71 
  72     // $keys["currentCourseCode"] is the "public code"
  73     
  74     //FIXME FIXME FIXME
  75     /*
  76     $wantedCode =  strtr($wantedCode,
  77     '�����������������������������������������������������������',
  78     'AAAAAACEEEEIIIIDNOOOOOOUUUUYsaaaaaaaceeeeiiiionoooooouuuuyy');
  79     */
  80 
  81     //$wantedCode = strtoupper($wantedCode);
  82     $charToReplaceByUnderscore = '- ';
  83     $wantedCode = preg_replace('/['.$charToReplaceByUnderscore.']/', '_', $wantedCode);
  84     $wantedCode = preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/', '', $wantedCode);
  85 
  86     if ($wantedCode=='') $wantedCode = get_conf('prefixAntiEmpty');
  87 
  88     $keysCourseCode    = $wantedCode;
  89 
  90     if (!$useCodeInDepedentKeys) $wantedCode = '';
  91     // $keys['currentCourseId'] would Became $cid in normal using.
  92 
  93     if ($addUniquePrefix) $uniquePrefix =  substr(md5 (uniqid('')),0,10);
  94     else                  $uniquePrefix = '';
  95 
  96     if ($addUniqueSuffix) $uniqueSuffix =  substr(md5 (uniqid('')),0,10);
  97 
  98     else                  $uniqueSuffix = '';
  99 
 100     $keysAreUnique = false;
 101 
 102     $finalSuffix = array('CourseId'=>''
 103                         ,'CourseDb'=>''
 104                         ,'CourseDir'=>''
 105                         );
 106                         
 107     $tryNewFSCId = $tryNewFSCDb = $tryNewFSCDir = 0;
 108 
 109     while (!$keysAreUnique)
 110     {
 111          $keysCourseId     = $prefix4all
 112          .                   $uniquePrefix
 113          .                   strtoupper($wantedCode)
 114          .                   $uniqueSuffix
 115          .                   ($finalSuffix['CourseId'] > 0?
 116                              sprintf("_%0" . $nbCharFinalSuffix . "s", $finalSuffix['CourseId']):'')
 117          ;
 118 
 119          $keysCourseDbName = $prefix4baseName
 120          .                   $uniquePrefix
 121          .                   strtoupper($wantedCode)
 122          .                   $uniqueSuffix
 123          .                   ($finalSuffix['CourseDb'] > 0?
 124                              sprintf("_%0" . $nbCharFinalSuffix . "s", $finalSuffix['CourseDb']):'')
 125          ;
 126 
 127          $keysCourseRepository = $prefix4path
 128          .                       $uniquePrefix
 129          .                       strtoupper($wantedCode)
 130          .                       $uniqueSuffix
 131          .                       ($finalSuffix['CourseDir'] > 0?
 132                                  sprintf("_%0" . $nbCharFinalSuffix . "s", $finalSuffix['CourseDir']):'')
 133          ;
 134 
 135         $keysAreUnique = true;
 136         // Now we go to check if there are unique
 137 
 138         $sqlCheckCourseId    = "SELECT COUNT(code) AS existAllready
 139                                 FROM `" . $tbl_course . "`
 140                                 WHERE code = '" . $keysCourseId  ."'";
 141 
 142         $resCheckCourseId    = claro_sql_query ($sqlCheckCourseId);
 143         $isCheckCourseIdUsed = mysql_fetch_array($resCheckCourseId);
 144 
 145         if (isset($isCheckCourseIdUsed[0]['existAllready']) && $isCheckCourseIdUsed[0]['existAllready'] > 0)
 146         {
 147             $keysAreUnique = false;
 148             $tryNewFSCId++;
 149             $finalSuffix['CourseId']++;
 150         };
 151 
 152         if (get_conf('singleDbEnabled'))
 153         {
 154             $sqlCheckCourseDb = "SHOW TABLES LIKE '".$keysCourseDbName."%'";
 155         }
 156         else
 157         {
 158             $sqlCheckCourseDb = "SHOW DATABASES LIKE '".$keysCourseDbName."'";
 159         }
 160 
 161         $resCheckCourseDb = claro_sql_query ($sqlCheckCourseDb);
 162 
 163         $isCheckCourseDbUsed = mysql_num_rows($resCheckCourseDb);
 164 
 165         if ($isCheckCourseDbUsed > 0)
 166         {
 167             $keysAreUnique = false;
 168             $tryNewFSCDb++;
 169             $finalSuffix['CourseDb']++;
 170         };
 171 
 172         if (file_exists(get_path('coursesRepositorySys') . '/' . $keysCourseRepository))
 173         {
 174             $keysAreUnique = false;
 175             $tryNewFSCDir++;
 176             $finalSuffix['CourseDir']++;
 177 
 178         };
 179 
 180         if(!$keysAreUnique)
 181         {
 182             $finalSuffix['CourseDir'] = max($finalSuffix);
 183             $finalSuffix['CourseId']  = $finalSuffix['CourseDir'];
 184             $finalSuffix['CourseDb']  = $finalSuffix['CourseDir'];
 185         }
 186 
 187         // here  we can add a counter to exit if need too many try
 188         $limitQtyTry = 128;
 189 
 190         if (($tryNewFSCId+$tryNewFSCDb+$tryNewFSCDir > $limitQtyTry)
 191                 or ($tryNewFSCId > $limitQtyTry / 2 )
 192                 or ($tryNewFSCDb > $limitQtyTry / 2 )
 193                 or ($tryNewFSCDir > $limitQtyTry / 2 )
 194             )
 195         {
 196             trigger_error('too many try for ' .  $wantedCode ,E_USER_WARNING);
 197             return false;
 198 
 199         }
 200     }
 201 
 202     // dbName Can't begin with a number
 203     if (!strstr("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ",$keysCourseDbName[0]))
 204     {
 205         $keysCourseDbName = get_conf('prefixAntiNumber') . $keysCourseDbName;
 206     }
 207 
 208     $keys['currentCourseCode'      ] = $keysCourseCode;      // screen code
 209     $keys['currentCourseId'        ] = $keysCourseId;        // sysCode
 210     $keys['currentCourseDbName'    ] = $keysCourseDbName;    // dbname
 211     $keys['currentCourseRepository'] = $keysCourseRepository;// append to course repository
 212 
 213     return $keys;
 214 };
 215 
 216 
 217 /**
 218  * Create directories used by course.
 219  *
 220  * @param  string $courseRepository path from $coursesRepositorySys to root of course
 221  * @param  string $courseId         sysId of course
 222  * @return boolean
 223  * @author Christophe Gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
 224  * @author Hugues Peeters <hugues.peeters@claroline.net>
 225  * @author Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
 226  */
 227 function prepare_course_repository($courseRepository, $courseId)
 228 {
 229 
 230     if( ! is_dir(get_path('coursesRepositorySys')) )
 231     {
 232         claro_mkdir(get_path('coursesRepositorySys'), CLARO_FILE_PERMISSIONS, true);
 233     }
 234 
 235     $courseDirPath = get_path('coursesRepositorySys') . $courseRepository;
 236 
 237     if ( ! is_writable(get_path('coursesRepositorySys')) )
 238     {
 239         return claro_failure::set_failure(
 240             get_lang( 'Folder %folder is not writable'
 241                 , array( '%folder' => get_path('coursesRepositorySys') ) ) );
 242     }
 243 
 244     $folderList = array(
 245         $courseDirPath ,
 246         $courseDirPath . '/document',
 247         $courseDirPath . '/group'
 248     );
 249 
 250     foreach ( $folderList as $folder )
 251     {
 252         if ( ! claro_mkdir($folder, CLARO_FILE_PERMISSIONS,true) )
 253         {
 254             return claro_failure::set_failure(
 255                 get_lang( 'Unable to create folder %folder'
 256                     ,array( '%folder' => $folder ) ) );
 257         }
 258     }
 259 
 260     // build index.php of course
 261     $courseIndex = $courseDirPath . '/index.php';
 262     
 263     $courseIndexContent = '<?php ' . "\n"
 264         . 'header (\'Location: '. get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb')
 265         . 'course/index.php?cid=' . claro_htmlspecialchars($courseId) . '\') ;' . "\n"
 266         . '?' . '>' . "\n"
 267         ;
 268     
 269     if ( ! file_put_contents( $courseIndex, $courseIndexContent ) )
 270     {
 271         return claro_failure::set_failure(
 272             get_lang('Unable to create file %file'
 273                 , array('%file' => 'index.php' ) ) );

 276     $groupIndex = get_path('coursesRepositorySys')
 277         . $courseRepository . '/group/index.php'

 280     $groupIndexContent = '<?php session_start(); ?'.'>';

 284         return claro_failure::set_failure(
 285             get_lang('Unable to create file %file'
 286                 , array('%file' => 'group/index.php' ) ) );
 287     }
 288 
 289     return true;

 375 /**
 376  * To create a record in the course table of main database.  Also handles
 377  * the categories links creation.
 378  *
 379  * @param string    $courseSysCode
 380  * @param string    $courseScreenCode
 381  * @param int       $sourceCourseId
 382  * @param string    $courseRepository
 383  * @param string    $courseDbName
 384  * @param string    $titular
 385  * @param string    $email
 386  * @param array     $categories
 387  * @param string    $intitule
 388  * @param string    $languageCourse
 389  * @param string    $uidCreator
 390  * @param bool      $visibility
 391  * @param string    $registration ('open', 'close' or 'validation')
 392  * @param string    $registrationKey
 393  * @return bool     success;
 394  * @author Christophe Gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
 395  */
 396 function register_course( $courseSysCode, $courseScreenCode, $sourceCourseId,
 397                           $courseRepository, $courseDbName,
 398                           $titular, $email, $categories, $intitule, $languageCourse='',
 399                           $uidCreator,
 400                           $access, $registration, $registrationKey='', $visibility=true,
 401                           $extLinkName='', $extLinkUrl='',$publicationDate,
 402                           $expirationDate, $status, $userLimit)
 403 {
 404     global $versionDb, $clarolineVersion;
 405     
 406     $tblList                    = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 407     $tbl_course                 = $tblList['course'];
 408     $tbl_category               = $tblList['category'];
 409     $tbl_rel_course_category    = $tblList['rel_course_category'];
 410     
 411     // Needed parameters
 412     if ($courseSysCode    == '') return claro_failure::set_failure('courseSysCode is missing');
 413     if ($courseScreenCode == '') return claro_failure::set_failure('courseScreenCode is missing');
 414     if ($courseDbName     == '') return claro_failure::set_failure('courseDbName is missing');
 415     if ($courseRepository == '') return claro_failure::set_failure('course Repository is missing');
 416     if ($uidCreator       == '') return claro_failure::set_failure('uidCreator is missing');
 417     if (!in_array($registration, array('open', 'close', 'validation')))
 418     {
 419         return claro_failure::set_failure('wrong registration value');
 420     }
 421     
 422     // Optionnal settings
 423     $languageCourse = (!empty($languageCourse)) ? $languageCourse : 'english';
 424     
 425     $sourceCourseId = (!is_null($sourceCourseId) && !empty($sourceCourseId)) ?
 426         claro_sql_escape($sourceCourseId) : "NULL";
 427     
 428     $currentVersionFilePath = get_conf('rootSys') . 'platform/currentVersion.inc.php';
 429     file_exists($currentVersionFilePath) && require $currentVersionFilePath;
 430     
 431     $defaultProfileId = claro_get_profile_id('user');
 432     
 433     // Insert course
 434     $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $tbl_course . "` SET
 435             code                 = '" . claro_sql_escape($courseSysCode)        . "',
 436             sourceCourseId       = " . $sourceCourseId . ",
 437             dbName               = '" . claro_sql_escape($courseDbName)         . "',
 438             directory            = '" . claro_sql_escape($courseRepository)     . "',
 439             language             = '" . claro_sql_escape($languageCourse)       . "',
 440             intitule             = '" . claro_sql_escape($intitule)             . "',
 441             visibility           = '" .  ($visibility?'VISIBLE':'INVISIBLE')    . "',
 442             access               = '" .  claro_sql_escape($access)              . "',
 443             registration         = '" .  claro_sql_escape($registration)        . "',
 444             registrationKey      = '" .  claro_sql_escape($registrationKey)     . "',
 445             diskQuota            = NULL,
 446             creationDate         = FROM_UNIXTIME(" . claro_sql_escape($publicationDate) . "),
 447             expirationDate       = FROM_UNIXTIME(" . claro_sql_escape($expirationDate)  . "),
 448             status               = '" . claro_sql_escape($status)           . "',
 449             userLimit            = '" . (int) $userLimit                    . "',
 450             versionDb            = '" . claro_sql_escape($versionDb)        . "',
 451             versionClaro         = '" . claro_sql_escape($clarolineVersion) . "',
 452             lastEdit             = NOW(),
 453             lastVisit            = NULL,
 454             titulaires           = '" . claro_sql_escape($titular)          . "',
 455             email                = '" . claro_sql_escape($email)            . "',
 456             administrativeNumber = '" . claro_sql_escape($courseScreenCode) . "',
 457             extLinkName          = '" . claro_sql_escape($extLinkName)      . "',
 458             extLinkUrl           = '" . claro_sql_escape($extLinkUrl)       . "',
 459             defaultProfileId     = " . $defaultProfileId ;
 460     
 461     if ( claro_sql_query($sql) == false)
 462     {
 463         return false;
 464     }
 465     
 466     $courseId = mysql_insert_id();
 467     
 468     // Insert categories
 469     if ( link_course_categories ( $courseId, $categories ) === false )
 470     {
 471         return false;
 472     }
 473     
 474     // Did we insert a session couse ?
 475     if (!is_null($sourceCourseId))
 476     {
 477         // If yes, flag its source course
 478         $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl_course . "`
 479                 SET isSourceCourse = 1
 480                 WHERE cours_id = $sourceCourseId";
 481         
 482         if ( claro_sql_query($sql) == false )
 483         {
 484             return false;
 485         }
 486     }
 487     
 488     return true;
 489 }

 577         . $courseDbName . get_conf('dbGlu')

 603 /**
 604  * Install module databases at course creation
 605  */
 606 function install_module_at_course_creation( $moduleLabel, $courseDbName, $language, $courseDirectory )
 607 {
 608     $sqlPath = get_module_path( $moduleLabel ) . '/setup/course_install.sql';
 609     $phpPath = get_module_path( $moduleLabel ) . '/setup/course_install.php';
 610 
 611     if ( file_exists( $sqlPath ) )
 612     {
 613         if ( ! execute_sql_at_course_creation( $sqlPath, $courseDbName ) )
 614         {
 615             return false;
 616         }
 617     }
 618 
 619     if ( file_exists( $phpPath ) )
 620     {
 621         // include the language file with all language variables
 622         language::load_translation( $language );
 623         language::load_locale_settings( $language );
 624         language::load_module_translation( $moduleLabel, $language );
 625         
 626         // define tables to use in php install scripts
 627         $courseDbName = get_conf('courseTablePrefix') . $courseDbName.get_conf('dbGlu');
 628         $moduleCourseTblList = claro_sql_get_course_tbl($courseDbName);
 629 
 630         /*
 631          * @todo select database should not be needed if the setup scripts are
 632          * well written !
 633          */
 634         if ( ! get_conf('singleDbEnabled') )
 635         {
 636             claro_sql_select_db($courseDbName);
 637         }
 638         
 639         require_once $phpPath;
 640     }
 641     
 642     return true;
 643 }

 645 /**
 646  * Execute SQL files at course creation
 647  */
 648 function execute_sql_at_course_creation( $sqlPath, $courseDbName )
 649 {
 650     if ( file_exists( $sqlPath ) )
 651     {
 652         $sql = file_get_contents( $sqlPath );
 653         
 654         $currentCourseDbNameGlu = get_conf('courseTablePrefix') . $courseDbName . get_conf('dbGlu');
 655 
 656         $sql = str_replace('__CL_COURSE__', $currentCourseDbNameGlu, $sql );
 657 
 658         if ( ! claro_sql_multi_query($sql) )
 659         {
 660             return claro_failure::set_failure( 'SQL_QUERY_FAILED' );
 661         }
 662         else
 663         {
 664             return true;
 665         }
 666     }
 667     else
 668     {
 669         return claro_failure::set_failure( 'SQL_FILE_NOT_FOUND' );
 670     }
 671 }

  36 /**
  37  * delete a course of the plateform
  38  *
  39  * TODO detect failure with claro_failure
  40  *
  41  * @param string $cid
  42  *
  43  * @return boolean TRUE        if suceed
  44  *         boolean FALSE       otherwise.
  45  */
  46 function delete_course($code, $sourceCourseId)
  47 {
  48     global $eventNotifier;
  49 
  50     // Declare needed tables
  51     $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  52     $tbl_course                 = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
  53     $tbl_rel_course_user        = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user'];
  54     $tbl_course_class           = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_class'];
  55     $tbl_rel_course_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
  56     $tbl_rel_course_portlet     = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_portlet'];
  57 
  58     $this_course = claro_get_course_data($code);
  59     
  60     if ( ! $this_course )
  61     {
  62         // This is bad !
  63         throw new Exception("Course not found");
  64     }
  65     
  66     $currentCourseId = trim( $this_course['sysCode'] );
  67     
  68     if ( empty( $currentCourseId ) )
  69     {
  70         // This is bad !
  71         throw new Exception("Missing course id");
  72     }
  73 
  74     // Delete user registrations into this course
  75     $sql = 'DELETE FROM `' . $tbl_rel_course_user . '`
  76             WHERE code_cours="' . $currentCourseId . '"';
  77 
  78     claro_sql_query($sql);
  79 
  80     // Remove any recording in rel_cours_class
  81     $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl_course_class . "`
  82             WHERE courseId ='" . claro_sql_escape($currentCourseId) . "'";
  83 
  84     claro_sql_query($sql);
  85     
  86     // Remove links between this course and categories
  87     $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "`
  88             WHERE courseId ='" . $this_course['id'] . "'";
  89 
  90     claro_sql_query($sql);
  91     
  92     // Remove links between this course and portlets
  93     $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl_rel_course_portlet . "`
  94             WHERE courseId ='" . $this_course['id'] . "'";
  95 
  96     claro_sql_query($sql);
  97 
  98     // Delete the course inside the platform course registery
  99     $sql = 'DELETE FROM `' . $tbl_course . '`
 100             WHERE code= "' . claro_sql_escape($currentCourseId) . '"';
 101 
 102     claro_sql_query($sql);
 103     
 104     // Is it a session course ?
 105     if (!is_null($sourceCourseId))
 106     {
 107         // Does the source course still have session courses ?
 108         $sql = "SELECT COUNT(cours_id) AS nbSessionCourses
 109                 FROM `" . $tbl_course . "`
 110                 WHERE sourceCourseId = " . (int) $sourceCourseId;
 111         
 112         $result = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
 113         
 114         if ( $result['nbSessionCourses'] == 0 )
 115         {
 116             $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl_course . "`
 117                     SET isSourceCourse = 0
 118                     WHERE cours_id = " . (int) $sourceCourseId;
 119             
 120             claro_sql_query($sql);
 121         }
 122     }
 123 
 124     // Delete course right
 125     RightCourseProfileToolRight::resetAllRightProfile($currentCourseId);
 126 
 127     // Delete course module tables
 128     // FIXME handle errors
 129     list( $success, $log ) = delete_all_modules_from_course( $currentCourseId );
 130 
 131     // Notify the course deletion event
 132     $args['cid'] = $this_course['sysCode'];
 133     $args['tid'] = null;
 134     $args['rid'] = null;
 135     $args['gid'] = null;
 136     $args['uid'] = $GLOBALS['_uid'];
 137 
 138     $eventNotifier->notifyEvent("course_deleted",$args);
 139 
 140     if ( $currentCourseId == $code )
 141     {
 142         $currentCourseDbName    = trim($this_course['dbName']);
 143         $currentCourseDbNameGlu = trim($this_course['dbNameGlu']);
 144         $currentCoursePath      = trim( $this_course['path'] );
 145         
 146         if ( empty( $currentCourseDbName ) )
 147         {
 148             // This is bad !
 149             throw new Exception("Missing db name");
 150         }
 151         
 152         if ( empty( $currentCourseDbNameGlu ) )
 153         {
 154             // This is bad !
 155             throw new Exception("Missing db name glu");
 156         }
 157 
 158         if( get_conf( 'singleDbEnabled' ) )
 159         // IF THE PLATFORM IS IN MONO DATABASE MODE
 160         {
 161             // SEARCH ALL TABLES RELATED TO THE CURRENT COURSE
 162             claro_sql_query("use " . get_conf('mainDbName'));
 163             $tbl_to_delete = claro_sql_get_course_tbl(claro_get_course_db_name_glued($currentCourseId));
 164             foreach($tbl_to_delete as $tbl_name)
 165             {
 166                 $sql = 'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `' . $tbl_name . '`';
 167                 claro_sql_query($sql);
 168             }
 169             
 170             // Underscores must be replaced because they are used as wildcards in LIKE sql statement
 171             $cleanCourseDbNameGlu = str_replace("_","\_", $currentCourseDbNameGlu);
 172             $sql = 'SHOW TABLES LIKE "' . $cleanCourseDbNameGlu . '%"';
 173 
 174             $result = claro_sql_query($sql);
 175             
 176             // DELETE ALL TABLES OF THE CURRENT COURSE
 177             $tblSurvivor = array();
 178             
 179             while( false !== ($courseTable = mysql_fetch_array($result,MYSQL_NUM ) ))
 180             {
 181                 $tblSurvivor[]=$courseTable[0];
 182                 //$tblSurvivor[$courseTable]='not deleted';
 183             }
 184             
 185             if ( sizeof( $tblSurvivor ) > 0 )
 186             {
 187                 Claroline::getInstance()->log( 
 188                     'DELETE_COURSE', 
 189                     array_merge(
 190                         array (
 191                             'DELETED_COURSE_CODE' => $code,
 192                             'UNDELETED_TABLE_COUNTER' => sizeof( $tblSurvivor )
 193                         ), 
 194                         
 195                         $tblSurvivor 
 196                     )
 197                 );
 198             }
 199         }
 200         else
 201         // IF THE PLATFORM IS IN MULTI DATABASE MODE
 202         {
 203             $sql = "DROP DATABASE `" . $currentCourseDbName . "`";
 204             claro_sql_query($sql);
 205         }
 206 
 207         // MOVE THE COURSE DIRECTORY INTO THE COURSE GARBAGE COLLECTOR
 208 
 209         if( !empty( $currentCoursePath ) )
 210         {
 211             if ( file_exists(get_conf('coursesRepositorySys') . $currentCoursePath . '/') )
 212             {
 213                 claro_mkdir( get_conf('garbageRepositorySys'), CLARO_FILE_PERMISSIONS, true );
 214 
 215                 rename (
 216                     get_conf('coursesRepositorySys') . $currentCoursePath . '/',
 217                     get_conf('garbageRepositorySys','garbage') . '/' . $currentCoursePath . '_' . date('YmdHis')
 218                 );
 219             }
 220             else
 221             {
 222                 Console::warning( "DELETE_COURSE : Course directory not found {$currentCoursePath} for course {$currentCourseId}");
 223             }
 224             
 225             Claroline::log( 'COURSE_DELETED', array(
 226                 'courseCode' => $currentCourseId,
 227                 'courseDbName' => $currentCourseDbName,
 228                 'courseDbNameGlu' => $currentCourseDbNameGlu,
 229                 'coursePath' => $currentCoursePath
 230             ) );
 231             
 232             return true;
 233         }
 234         else
 235         {
 236             Console::error("DELETE_COURSE : Try to delete a course repository with no folder name {$currentCourseId} !");
 237             
 238             return true;
 239         }
 240     }
 241     else
 242     {
 243         return false ;
 244     }
 245 }

 248 /**
 249  * create link between a course and categories.
 250  *
 251  * @author Antonin Bourguignon <antonin.bourguignon@claroline.net>
 252  * @param  int      id of course
 253  * @param  array    collection of categories
 254  * @return boolean  success
 255  * @since  1.10
 256  */
 257 function link_course_categories ( $courseId, $categories )
 258 {
 259     $tbl_mdb_names             = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 260     $tbl_rel_course_category   = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 261     
 262     // Insert categories
 263     $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` (courseId, categoryId, rootCourse)
 264             VALUES ";
 265     
 266     $catArr = array();
 267     
 268     foreach( $categories as $category )
 269     {
 270         $catArr[] =  "(" . $courseId . ", " . $category->id . ", 0)";
 271     }
 272     
 273     $sql .= implode( ',' , $catArr );
 274     
 275     if ( ! empty( $catArr ) )
 276     {
 277         return claro_sql_query($sql);
 278     }
 279 }

 282 /**
 283  * delete link between a course and its associated categories.
 284  *
 285  * @author Antonin Bourguignon <antonin.bourguignon@claroline.net>
 286  * @param  int      id of course
 287  * @param  array    collection of categories
 288  *                  (leave it empty to unlink ALL categories)
 289  * @return boolean  success
 290  * @since  1.10
 291  */
 292 function unlink_course_categories ( $courseId, $categories = array() )
 293 {
 294     $tbl_mdb_names             = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 295     $tbl_rel_course_category   = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 296     
 297     // Include specified categories identifiers in the request
 298     $categoriesIdsRestriction = "";
 299     if ( !empty($categories) )
 300     {
 301         $categoriesIds = '';
 302         for ( $i = 0; $i < count($categories); $i++ )
 303         {
 304             $categoriesIds .= $categories[$i]->id;
 305             // More elements to come ?  Add a comma
 306             if ( $i < count($categories)-1 )
 307             {
 308                 $categoriesIds .= ", ";
 309             }
 310         }
 311         $categoriesIdsRestriction = " AND categoryId IN (" . $categoriesIds . ")";
 312     }
 313     
 314     $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "`
 315             WHERE courseId=" . (int) $courseId . $categoriesIdsRestriction;
 316     
 317     return claro_sql_query($sql);
 318 }

 349 /**

 351  *

 353  * @param  int     id of user in DB
 354  * @param  int     id of course in DB

 356  */
 357 function is_registered_to($user_id, $course_id)

 370 /**
 371  * Transfrom a key word into a usable key word ina SQL : "*" must be replaced by "%" and "%" by "\%"
 372  * @param  the string to transform
 373  * @return the string modified
 374  */
 375 function pr_star_replace($string)
 376 {
 377     $string = str_replace("%",'\%', $string);
 378     $string = str_replace("*",'%', $string);
 379     return $string;
 380 }

  17 /**
  18  * Authentication Driver interface
  19  */
  20 interface AuthDriver
  21 {
  22     /**
  23      * Set the options from the driver configuration file
  24      * @see AUTHENTICATION.txt for details about the option array
  25      * @param array $driverConfig
  26      */
  27     public function setDriverOptions( $driverConfig );
  28     
  29     /**
  30      * Set the authentication parameters used by the driver
  31      * @param string $username
  32      * @param string $password
  33      */
  34     public function setAuthenticationParams( $username, $password );
  35     
  36     /**
  37      * Authenticate the user
  38      * @return boolean true if authentication succeeds, false if authentication 
  39      *  fails
  40      */
  41     public function authenticate();
  42     
  43     /**
  44      * Get user data from the authentication source
  45      * @return array
  46      */
  47     public function getUserData();
  48     
  49     /**
  50      * Get filtered user data
  51      * @return array
  52      */
  53     public function getFilteredUserData();
  54     
  55     /**
  56      * Get the authentication source name
  57      * @return string
  58      */
  59     public function getAuthSource();
  60     
  61     /**
  62      * Does this authentication source allow new users to register to the platform
  63      * @return boolean
  64      */
  65     public function userRegistrationAllowed();
  66     
  67     /**
  68      * Does this authentication source allow to update user profile information
  69      * @return boolean
  70      */
  71     public function userUpdateAllowed();
  72     
  73     /**
  74      * Get failure message if authentication have failed
  75      * @return string
  76      */
  77     public function getFailureMessage();
  78     
  79     /**
  80      * Get options for user auth profile
  81      * @see authprofile.lib.php
  82      * @return array
  83      * @since Claroline 1.11
  84      */
  85     public function getAuthProfileOptions();
  86 }

  88 /**
  89  * Abstract Authentication Driver defining generic common methods
  90  * @see AuthDriver
  91  */
  92 abstract class AbstractAuthDriver implements AuthDriver
  93 {
  94     protected 
  95         $userId = null,
  96         $username = null, 
  97         $password = null,
  98         $authSourceName;
  99     
 100     protected
 101         $driverConfig,
 102         $userRegistrationAllowed = false,
 103         $userUpdateAllowed = false,
 104         
 105         $extAuthOptionList = array(),
 106         $extAuthAttribNameList = array(),
 107         $extAuthAttribTreatmentList = array(),
 108         $extAuthIgnoreUpdateList = array(),
 109         
 110         $authProfileOptions = array(
 111             'courseRegistrationAllowed' => null,
 112             'courseEnrolmentMode' => null, 
 113             'defaultCourseProfile' => null, 
 114             'editableProfileFields' => null,
 115             'readonlyProfileFields' => null
 116         );
 117     
 118     
 119     protected $extraMessage = null;
 120     
 121     // abstract public function getUserData();
 122     
 123     public function setDriverOptions( $driverConfig )
 124     {
 125         $this->driverConfig = $driverConfig;
 126         
 127         if ( ! isset( $driverConfig['driver'] ) )
 128         {
 129             throw new Exception("Missing mandatory driver properties");
 130         }
 131         
 132         if ( ! isset( $driverConfig['driver']['authSourceName'] ) )
 133         {
 134             throw new Exception("Missing mandatory driver authentication source name");
 135         }
 136         
 137         $this->authSourceName = $driverConfig['driver']['authSourceName'];
 138         
 139         $this->userRegistrationAllowed = isset( $driverConfig['driver']['userRegistrationAllowed'] )
 140             ? $driverConfig['driver']['userRegistrationAllowed']
 141             : false
 142             ;
 143         $this->userUpdateAllowed = isset( $driverConfig['driver']['userUpdateAllowed'] )
 144             ? $driverConfig['driver']['userUpdateAllowed']
 145             : false
 146             ;
 147             
 148         $this->extAuthOptionList = isset( $driverConfig['extAuthOptionList'] )
 149             ? $driverConfig['extAuthOptionList']
 150             : array()
 151             ;
 152         
 153         $this->extAuthAttribNameList = isset( $driverConfig['extAuthAttribNameList'] )
 154             ? $driverConfig['extAuthAttribNameList']
 155             : array()
 156             ;
 157         
 158         $this->extAuthAttribTreatmentList = isset( $driverConfig['extAuthAttribTreatmentList'] )
 159             ? $driverConfig['extAuthAttribTreatmentList']
 160             : array()
 161             ;
 162         
 163         $this->extAuthIgnoreUpdateList = isset( $driverConfig['extAuthAttribToIgnore'] )
 164             ? $driverConfig['extAuthAttribToIgnore']
 165             : array()
 166             ;
 167         
 168         $defaultProfileOptions = array( 
 169                 'courseRegistrationAllowed' => null,
 170                 'courseEnrolmentMode' => null, 
 171                 'defaultCourseProfile' => null, 
 172                 'editableProfileFields' => null,
 173                 'readonlyProfileFields' => null );
 174         
 175         // @since 1.11 
 176         $this->authProfileOptions = isset($driverConfig['authProfileOptions'])
 177             ? array_merge( $defaultProfileOptions, $driverConfig['authProfileOptions'] )
 178             : $defaultProfileOptions
 179             ;
 180     }
 181     
 182     protected function setFailureMessage( $message )
 183     {
 184         $this->extraMessage = $message;
 185     }
 186     
 187     public function getFailureMessage()
 188     {
 189         return $this->extraMessage;
 190     }
 191     
 192     public function getAuthSource()
 193     {
 194         return $this->authSourceName;
 195     }
 196     
 197     public function setAuthenticationParams( $username, $password )
 198     {
 199         $this->username = $username;
 200         $this->password = $password;
 201     }
 202     
 203     public function getFilteredUserData()
 204     {
 205         $data  = $this->getUserData();
 206         
 207         if ( ! is_array($data) )
 208         {
 209             return array();
 210         }
 211         
 212         foreach ( $data as $key => $value )
 213         {
 214             if ( in_array( $key, $this->extAuthIgnoreUpdateList ) )
 215             {
 216                 unset( $data[$key] );
 217             }
 218             elseif ( in_array( $key, $this->extAuthAttribTreatmentList ) )
 219             {
 220                 $treatmentCallback = $this->extAuthAttribTreatmentList[$key];
 221                 
 222                 if ( is_callable( $treatmentCallback ) )
 223                 {
 224                     // feed the data returned by the authentication driver to the callback
 225                     $data[$key] = call_user_func_array(
 226                         $treatmentCallback, 
 227                         array( $value, $data ) 
 228                     );
 229                 }
 230                 else // a string
 231                 {
 232                     $data[$key] = $treatmentCallback;
 233                 }
 234             }
 235         }
 236         
 237         return $data;
 238     }
 239     
 240     public function userRegistrationAllowed()
 241     {
 242         return $this->userRegistrationAllowed;
 243     }
 244     
 245     public function userUpdateAllowed()
 246     {
 247         return $this->userUpdateAllowed;
 248     }
 249 
 250     public function getAuthProfileOptions()
 251     {
 252         return $this->authProfileOptions;
 253     }
 254 }
