 256 /**
 257  * Generic Authentication Driver using the Claroline database to authenticate 
 258  * users
 259  */
 260 class LocalDatabaseAuthDriver extends AbstractAuthDriver
 261 {
 262     protected $userId;
 263     
 264     public function setAuthenticationParams( $username, $password )
 265     {
 266         $this->username = $username;
 267         
 268         if ( get_conf('userPasswordCrypted',false) )
 269         {
 270             $this->password = md5($password);
 271         }
 272         else
 273         {
 274             $this->password = $password;
 275         }
 276     }
 277     
 278     public function authenticate()
 279     {
 280         if ( empty( $this->username ) || empty( $this->password ) )
 281         {
 282             return false;
 283         }
 284         
 285         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 286         
 287         $sql = "SELECT user_id, username, password, authSource\n"
 288             . "FROM `{$tbl['user']}`\n"
 289             . "WHERE "
 290             . ( get_conf('claro_authUsernameCaseSensitive',true) ? 'BINARY ' : '')
 291             . "username = ". Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($this->username) . "\n"
 292             . "AND authSource = '".$this->getAuthSource()."'" . "\n"
 293             . "ORDER BY user_id DESC LIMIT 1"
 294             ;
 295             
 296         $userDataList = Claroline::getDatabase()->query( $sql );
 297         
 298         if ( $userDataList->numRows() > 0 )
 299         {
 300             foreach ( $userDataList as $userData )
 301             {
 302                 if ( $this->password === $userData['password'] )
 303                 {
 304                     $this->userId = $userData['user_id'];
 305                     return true;
 306                 }
 307                 else
 308                 {
 309                     return false;
 310                 }
 311             }
 312         }
 313         else
 314         {
 315             return false;
 316         }
 317     }
 318     
 319     public function userRegistrationAllowed()
 320     {
 321         return false;
 322     }
 323     
 324     public function userUpdateAllowed()
 325     {
 326         return false;
 327     }
 328     
 329     public function getUserData()
 330     {
 331         return null;
 332     }
 333     
 334     public function getFilteredUserData()
 335     {
 336         return array();
 337     }
 338 }

 378         {
 379             $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 380             
 381             $sql = "SELECT propertyValue\n"
 382                 . "FROM `{$tbl['user_property']}`\n"
 383                 . "WHERE "
 384                 . "userId = ". Claroline::getDatabase()->quote(parent::userId) . "\n"
 385                 . "AND propertyId = 'accountExpirationDate'"
 386                 ;
 387 
 388             $res = Claroline::getDatabase()->query( $sql );
 389 
 390             if ( $res->numRows() )
 391             {
 392                 $date = $res->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE);
 393 
 394                 if ( strtotime($date) <= time() )
 395                 {
 396                     $this->setFailureMessage(
 397                         get_lang(
 398                             "Your account has expired, please contact the platform adminitrator."
 399                             )
 400                         );
 401 
 402                     return false;
 403                 }
 404                 else
 405                 {
 406                     return true;
 407                 }
 408             }
 409             else
 410             {
 411                 return false;
 412             }
 413         }
 414         else
 415         {
 416             return false;
 417         }
 418     }
 419     
 420     public function setDriverOptions($driverConfig)
 421     {
 422         // skip
 423     }

   3 // vim: expandtab sw=4 ts=4 sts=4:
   4 
   5 /**
   6  * Authentication Manager
   7  *
   8  * @version     Claroline 1.11 $Revision: 14536 $
   9  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  10  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  11  * @author      Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  12  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  13  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  14  * @package     kernel.auth
  15  */
  16 
  17 // Get required libraries
  18 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../core/claroline.lib.php';
  19 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../database/database.lib.php';
  20 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../kernel/user.lib.php';
  21 
  22 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/authdrivers.lib.php';
  23 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/ldapauthdriver.lib.php';
  24 
  25 if ( get_conf( 'claro_loadDeprecatedPearAuthDriver', true ) )
  26 {
  27     require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/pearauthdriver.lib.php';
  28 }
  29 
  30 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/authprofile.lib.php';
  31 
  32 class AuthManager
  33 {
  34     protected static $extraMessage = null;
  35     
  36     public static function getFailureMessage()
  37     {
  38         return self::$extraMessage;
  39     }
  40     
  41     protected static function setFailureMessage( $message )
  42     {
  43         self::$extraMessage = $message;
  44     }
  45     
  46     public static function authenticate( $username, $password )
  47     {
  48         if ( !empty($username) && $authSource = AuthUserTable::getAuthSource( $username ) )
  49         {
  50             Console::debug("Found authentication source {$authSource} for {$username}");
  51             $driverList = array( AuthDriverManager::getDriver( $authSource ) );
  52         }
  53         else
  54         {
  55             // avoid issues with session collision when many users connect from
  56             // the same computer at the same time with the same browser session !
  57             if ( AuthUserTable::userExists( $username ) )
  58             {
  59                 self::setFailureMessage( get_lang( "There is already an account with this username." ) );
  60                 return false;
  61             }
  62             
  63             $authSource = null;
  64             $driverList = AuthDriverManager::getRegisteredDrivers();
  65         }
  66         
  67         foreach ( $driverList as $driver )
  68         {
  69             $driver->setAuthenticationParams( $username, $password );
  70             
  71             if ( $driver->authenticate() )
  72             {
  73 
  74                 $uid = AuthUserTable::registered( $username, $driver->getAuthSource() );
  75                 
  76                 if ( $uid )
  77                 {
  78                     if ( $driver->userUpdateAllowed() )
  79                     {
  80                         $userAttrList =  $driver->getFilteredUserData();
  81                         
  82                         if ( isset( $userAttrList['loginName'] ) )
  83                         {
  84                             $newUserName = $userAttrList['loginName'];
  85                             
  86                             if ( ! get_conf('claro_authUsernameCaseSensitive', true) )
  87                             {
  88                                 $newUsername = strtolower($newUserName);
  89                                 $username = strtolower($username);
  90                             }
  91                             
  92                             // avoid session collisions !
  93                             if ( $username != $newUserName )
  94                             {
  95                                 Console::error( "EXTAUTH ERROR : try to overwrite an existing user {$username} with another one" . var_export($userAttrList, true) );
  96                             }
  97                             else
  98                             {
  99                                 AuthUserTable::updateUser( $uid, $userAttrList );
 100                                 Console::info( "EXTAUTH INFO : update user {$uid} {$username} with " . var_export($userAttrList, true) );
 101                             }
 102                         }
 103                         else
 104                         {
 105                             Console::error( "EXTAUTH ERROR : no loginName given for user {$username} by authSource " . $driver->getAuthSource() );
 106                         }
 107                     }
 108                     
 109                     return Claro_CurrentUser::getInstance( $uid, true );
 110                 }
 111                 elseif ( $driver->userRegistrationAllowed() )
 112                 {
 113                     // duplicate code here to avoid issue with multiple requests on a busy server !
 114                     if ( AuthUserTable::userExists( $username ) )
 115                     {
 116                         self::setFailureMessage( get_lang( "There is already an account with this username." ) );
 117                         return false;
 118                     }
 119                     
 120                     $uid = AuthUserTable::createUser( $driver->getUserData() );
 121                     
 122                     return Claro_CurrentUser::getInstance( $uid, true );
 123                 }
 124             }
 125             elseif ( $authSource )
 126             {
 127                 self::setFailureMessage( $driver->getFailureMessage() );
 128             }
 129         }
 130         
 131         // authentication failed
 132         return false;
 133     }
 134 }
 135 
 136 class AuthUserTable
 137 {
 138     public static function userExists( $username )
 139     {
 140         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 141 
 142         $sql = "SELECT user_id, authSource\n"
 143             . "FROM `{$tbl['user']}`\n"
 144             . "WHERE "
 145             . ( get_conf('claro_authUsernameCaseSensitive',true) ? 'BINARY ' : '')
 146             . "username = ". Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($username) . "\n"
 147             ;
 148 
 149         $res = Claroline::getDatabase()->query( $sql );
 150 
 151         if ( $res->numRows() )
 152         {
 153             return true;
 154         }
 155         else
 156         {
 157             return false;
 158         }
 159     }
 160     
 161     public static function registered( $username, $authSourceName )
 162     {
 163         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 164         
 165         $sql = "SELECT user_id\n"
 166             . "FROM `{$tbl['user']}`\n"
 167             . "WHERE "
 168             . ( get_conf('claro_authUsernameCaseSensitive',true) ? 'BINARY ' : '')
 169             . "username = ". Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($username) . "\n"
 170             . "AND\n"
 171             . "authSource = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($authSourceName) . "\n"
 172             . "ORDER BY user_id DESC LIMIT 1"
 173             ;
 174             
 175         $res = Claroline::getDatabase()->query( $sql );
 176         
 177         if ( $res->numRows() )
 178         {
 179             $uidArr = $res->fetch();
 180             
 181             return (int) $uidArr['user_id'];
 182         }
 183         else
 184         {
 185             return false;
 186         }
 187     }
 188     
 189     public static function getAuthSource( $username )
 190     {
 191         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 192         
 193         $sql = "SELECT authSource\n"
 194             . "FROM `{$tbl['user']}`\n"
 195             . "WHERE "
 196             . ( get_conf('claro_authUsernameCaseSensitive',true) ? "BINARY " : "" )
 197             . "username = ". Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($username) . "\n"
 198             . "ORDER BY user_id DESC LIMIT 1"
 199             ;
 200             
 201         return  Claroline::getDatabase()->query( $sql )->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE);
 202     }
 203     
 204     public static function createUser( $userAttrList )
 205     {
 206         return self::registerUser( $userAttrList, null );
 207     }
 208     
 209     public static function updateUser( $uid, $userAttrList )
 210     {
 211         return self::registerUser( $userAttrList, $uid );
 212     }
 213     
 214     protected static function registerUser( $userAttrList, $uid = null )
 215     {
 216         $preparedList = array();
 217         
 218         // Map database fields
 219         $dbFieldToClaroMap = array(
 220             'nom' => 'lastname',
 221             'prenom' => 'firstname',
 222             'username' => 'loginName',
 223             'email' => 'email',
 224             'officialCode' => 'officialCode',
 225             'phoneNumber' => 'phoneNumber',
 226             'isCourseCreator' => 'isCourseCreator',
 227             'authSource' => 'authSource');
 228         
 229         // Do not overwrite username and authsource for an existing user !!!
 230         if ( ! is_null( $uid ) )
 231         {
 232             unset( $dbFieldToClaroMap['username'] );
 233             unset( $dbFieldToClaroMap['authSource'] );
 234         }
 235 
 236         
 237         foreach ( $dbFieldToClaroMap as $dbFieldName => $claroAttribName )
 238         {
 239             if ( isset($userAttrList[$claroAttribName])
 240                 && ! is_null($userAttrList[$claroAttribName]) )
 241             {
 242                 $preparedList[] = $dbFieldName
 243                     . ' = '
 244                     . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($userAttrList[$claroAttribName])
 245                     ;
 246             }
 247         }
 248         
 249         if ( empty( $preparedList ) )
 250         {
 251             return false;
 252         }
 253         
 254         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 255         
 256         $sql = ( $uid ? 'UPDATE' : 'INSERT INTO' )
 257             . " `{$tbl['user']}`\n"
 258             . "SET " . implode(",\n", $preparedList ) . "\n"
 259             . ( $uid ? "WHERE  user_id = " . (int) $uid : '' )
 260             ;
 261         
 262         Claroline::getDatabase()->exec($sql);
 263         
 264         if ( ! $uid )
 265         {
 266             $uid = Claroline::getDatabase()->insertId();
 267         }
 268         
 269         return $uid;
 270     }
 271 }

 273 class AuthDriverManager
 274 {
 275     protected static $drivers = false;
 276     protected static $driversAllowingLostPassword = false;
 277     
 278     public static function getRegisteredDrivers()
 279     {
 280         if ( ! self::$drivers )
 281         {
 282             self::initDriverList();
 283         }
 284         
 285         return  self::$drivers;
 286     }
 287     
 288     public static function getDriver( $authSource )
 289     {
 290         if ( ! self::$drivers )
 291         {
 292             self::initDriverList();
 293         }
 294         
 295         if ( array_key_exists( $authSource, self::$drivers ) )
 296         {
 297             return self::$drivers[$authSource];
 298         }
 299         else
 300         {
 301             throw new Exception("No auth driver found for {$authSource} !");
 302         }
 303     }
 304     
 305     protected static function loadDriver ( $driverConfigPath )
 306     {
 307         if ( !file_exists( $driverConfigPath ) )
 308         {
 309             if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 310             {
 311                 throw new Exception("Driver configuration {$driverConfigPath} not found");
 312             }
 313 
 314             Console::error( "Driver configuration {$driverConfigPath} not found" );
 315             
 316             return;
 317         }
 318         
 319         $driverConfig  = array();
 320         
 321         include $driverConfigPath;
 322         
 323         if ( $driverConfig['driver']['enabled'] == true )
 324         {
 325             $driverClass = $driverConfig['driver']['class'];
 326             
 327             // search for kernel drivers
 328             if ( class_exists( $driverClass ) )
 329             {
 330                 $driver = new $driverClass;
 331                 $driver->setDriverOptions( $driverConfig );
 332                 self::$drivers[$driverConfig['driver']['authSourceName']] = $driver;
 333             }
 334             // search for user defined drivers
 335             else
 336             {
 337                 // load dynamic drivers
 338                 if ( ! file_exists ( get_path('rootSys') . 'platform/conf/extauth/drivers' ) )
 339                 {
 340                     FromKernel::uses('fileManage.lib');
 341                     claro_mkdir(get_path('rootSys') . 'platform/conf/extauth/drivers', CLARO_FILE_PERMISSIONS, true );
 342                 }
 343                 
 344                 $driverPath = get_path('rootSys') 
 345                     . 'platform/conf/extauth/drivers/' 
 346                     . strtolower($driverClass).'.drv.php';
 347 
 348                 if ( file_exists($driverPath) )
 349                 {
 350                     require_once $driverPath;
 351 
 352                     if ( class_exists( $driverClass ) )
 353                     {
 354                         $driver = new $driverClass;
 355                         $driver->setDriverOptions( $driverConfig );
 356                         self::$drivers[$driverConfig['driver']['authSourceName']] = $driver;
 357 
 358                     }
 359                     else
 360                     {
 361                         if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 362                         {
 363                             throw new Exception("Driver class {$driverClass} not found");
 364                         }
 365 
 366                         Console::error( "Driver class {$driverClass} not found" );
 367                     }
 368                 }
 369                 else
 370                 {
 371                     if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 372                     {
 373                         throw new Exception("Driver class {$driverClass} not found");
 374                     }
 375 
 376                     Console::error( "Driver class {$driverClass} not found" );
 377                 }
 378             }
 379         }
 380         
 381         if ( isset($driverConfig['driver']['lostPasswordAllowed']) && $driverConfig['driver']['lostPasswordAllowed'] == true )
 382         {
 383             self::$driversAllowingLostPassword[$driverConfig['driver']['authSourceName']] = $driverConfig['driver']['authSourceName'];
 384         }
 385     }
 386     
 387     public static function getDriversAllowingLostPassword()
 388     {
 389         if ( ! self::$drivers )
 390         {
 391             self::initDriverList();
 392         }
 393         
 394         return self::$driversAllowingLostPassword;
 395     }
 396     
 397     public static function checkIfDriverSupportsLostPassword( $authSourceName )
 398     {
 399         if ( ! self::$drivers )
 400         {
 401             self::initDriverList();
 402         }
 403         
 404         if ( isset( self::$driversAllowingLostPassword[$authSourceName] ) )
 405         {
 406             return true;
 407         }
 408         else
 409         {
 410             return false;
 411         }
 412     }
 413     
 414     protected static function initDriverList()
 415     {
 416         // load static drivers
 417         self::$drivers = array(
 418             'claroline' => new ClarolineLocalAuthDriver(),
 419             'disabled' => new UserDisabledAuthDriver(),
 420             'temp' => new TemporaryAccountAuthDriver()
 421         );
 422         
 423         self::$driversAllowingLostPassword = array(
 424             'claroline' => 'claroline',
 425             'clarocrypt' => 'clarocrypt'
 426         );
 427         
 428         // load dynamic drivers
 429         if ( ! file_exists ( get_path('rootSys') . 'platform/conf/extauth' ) )
 430         {
 431             FromKernel::uses('fileManage.lib');
 432             claro_mkdir(get_path('rootSys') . 'platform/conf/extauth', CLARO_FILE_PERMISSIONS, true );
 433         }
 434         
 435         if ( get_conf( 'claro_authDriversAutoDiscovery', true ) )
 436         {
 437             $driversToLoad = array();
 438             
 439             $it = new DirectoryIterator( get_path('rootSys') . 'platform/conf/extauth' );
 440             
 441             foreach ( $it as $file )
 442             {
 443                 if ( $file->isFile() && substr( $file->getFilename(), -9 ) == '.conf.php' )
 444                 {
 445                     $driversToLoad[] = $file->getPathname();
 446                 }          
 447             }
 448 
 449             sort( $driversToLoad );
 450 
 451             foreach ( $driversToLoad as $driverFile )
 452             {
 453                 self::loadDriver($driverFile);
 454             }        
 455         }
 456         else
 457         {
 458             if ( file_exists( get_path('rootSys') . 'platform/conf/extauth/drivers.list' ) )
 459             {
 460                 $authDriverList = file( get_path('rootSys') . 'platform/conf/extauth/drivers.list' );
 461                 
 462                 foreach ( $authDriverList as $authDriver )
 463                 {
 464                     $authDriver = trim($authDriver);
 465                     
 466                     if ( ! empty( $authDriver ) )
 467                     {
 468                         self::loadDriver(ltrim(rtrim(get_path('rootSys') . 'platform/conf/extauth/'.$authDriver)));
 469                     }
 470                 }
 471             }
 472         }
 473     }
 474 }

   9  * Authentication Profiles API is used to give specific rights to a user based
  10  * on his authentication source. This library provides a new course registration

  23 /**
  24  * Authentication Profile class
  25  */
  26 class AuthProfile
  27 {
  28     protected
  29         $courseRegistrationAllowed = null,
  30         $defaultCourseProfile = null,
  31         $courseEnrolmentMode = null,
  32         $editableProfileFields = null,
  33         $userId,
  34         $authSource;
  35     
  36     /**
  37      *
  38      * @param int $userId
  39      * @param string $authSource
  40      */
  41     public function __construct( $userId, $authSource )
  42     {
  43         $this->userId = $userId;
  44         $this->authSource = $authSource;
  45     }
  46     
  47     /**
  48      * Get the user id
  49      * @return int
  50      */
  51     public function getUserId()
  52     {
  53         return $this->userId;
  54     }
  55     
  56     /**
  57      * Set the authentication profile options. Contains
  58      *  $data['courseRegistrationAllowed'] with value true, false or null (let the platform decide)
  59      *  $data['courseEnrolmentMode'] with value 'open', 'close', 'validation' or null (let the platform decide)
  60      *  $data['defaultCourseProfile'] profile attributed by default to the user when registering to a new course or null
  61      *  $data['editableProfileFields'] array of editable fileds in the user profile or null
  62      * @return $this
  63      */
  64     public function setAuthDriverOptions( $data )
  65     {
  66         if ( isset($data['courseEnrolmentMode']) )
  67         {
  68             $this->courseEnrolmentMode = $data['courseEnrolmentMode'];
  69         }
  70         else
  71         {
  72             $this->courseEnrolmentMode = null;
  73         }
  74 
  75         if ( isset($data['defaultCourseProfile']) && ! is_null($data['defaultCourseProfile']) )
  76         {
  77             $this->defaultCourseProfile = $data['defaultCourseProfile'];
  78         }
  79         else
  80         {
  81             $this->defaultCourseProfile = 'user';
  82         }
  83 
  84         if ( isset($data['editableProfileFields']) && ! empty($data['editableProfileFields']) )
  85         {
  86             $this->editableProfileFields = $data['editableProfileFields'];
  87         }
  88         else
  89         {
  90             load_kernel_config('user_profile');
  91             
  92             if ( empty ( $data['readonlyProfileFields'] ) )
  93             {
  94                 $this->editableProfileFields = get_conf('profile_editable');
  95             }
  96             else
  97             {
  98                 $baseProfileFeilds = get_conf('profile_editable');
  99                 $this->editableProfileFields = array();
 100                 
 101                 foreach ( $baseProfileFeilds as $profileField )
 102                 {
 103                     if ( !in_array( $profileField, $data['readonlyProfileFields'] ) )
 104                     {
 105                         $this->editableProfileFields[] = $profileField;
 106                     }
 107                 }
 108             }
 109         }
 110         
 111         if ( isset ( $data['courseRegistrationAllowed'] ) && ! is_null($data['courseRegistrationAllowed']) )
 112         {
 113             $this->courseRegistrationAllowed = $data['courseRegistrationAllowed'];
 114         }
 115         else
 116         {
 117             $this->courseRegistrationAllowed = get_conf( 'allowToSelfEnroll', true );
 118         }
 119         
 120         return $this;
 121     }
 122     
 123     /**
 124      * Get the profile to give to the user when enroled in a course
 125      * @return string
 126      */
 127     public function getCourseProfile()
 128     {
 129         return $this->defaultCourseProfile;
 130     }
 131     
 132     /**
 133      * Get user enrolment mode
 134      * @return 'string'pending', 'auto' or null
 135      */
 136     public function getCourseRegistrationMode()
 137     {
 138         return $this->courseEnrolmentMode;
 139     }
 140     
 141     /**
 142      * Get the list of user profile fields editable for this user
 143      * @return array of string, editable field list
 144      */
 145     public function getEditableProfileFields()
 146     {
 147         return $this->editableProfileFields;
 148     }
 149     
 150     /**
 151      * Is the user allowed to enrol in a course
 152      * @return boolean
 153      */
 154     public function isProfileAllowedToRegisterInCourse()
 155     {
 156         return $this->courseRegistrationAllowed;
 157     }
 158 }

 160 /**
 161  * Auth profile factory
 162  */
 163 class AuthProfileManager
 164 {
 165     /**
 166      * Get the authentication profile for the given user id
 167      * @param int $userId
 168      * @return AuthProfile
 169      */
 170     public static function getUserAuthProfile( $userId )
 171     {
 172         if ( $userId != claro_get_current_user_id() )
 173         {
 174             $user = new Claro_User($userId);
 175             $user->loadFromDatabase();
 176         }
 177         else
 178         {
 179             $user = Claro_CurrentUser::getInstance();
 180         }
 181         
 182         $authSource = $user->authSource;
 183         
 184         if ( ! $authSource )
 185         {
 186             throw new Exception("Cannot find user authentication source for user {$userId}");
 187         }
 188         
 189         try
 190         {
 191             $profileOptions = AuthDriverManager::getDriver( $authSource )->getAuthProfileOptions();
 192         }
 193         catch ( Exception $e )
 194         {
 195             if ( claro_is_platform_admin () || ( claro_is_in_a_course() && claro_is_course_manager () && $userId != claro_get_current_user_id () ) )
 196             {
 197                 Console::warning("Cannot find user authentication source for user {$userId}, use claroline default options instead");
 198                 $profileOptions = AuthDriverManager::getDriver( 'claroline' )->getAuthProfileOptions();
 199             }
 200             else
 201             {
 202                 throw $e;
 203             }
 204         }
 205         
 206         $authProfile = new AuthProfile( $userId, $authSource );
 207         $authProfile->setAuthDriverOptions($profileOptions);
 208 
 209         if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 210         {
 211             pushClaroMessage(var_export($profileOptions, true), 'debug');
 212         }
 213 
 214         return $authProfile;
 215     }
 216 }

  13 /**
  14  * Represents data from the LDAP and declare __get and __Set magic methods
  15  */
  16 class Claro_Ldap_DataObject
  17 {
  18     protected $data;
  19     protected $mapping;
  20     
  21     public function __construct( $data )
  22     {
  23         $this->data = $data;
  24         $this->mapping = array(
  25             'officialCode' => 'employeenumber',
  26             'firstName' => 'givenname',
  27             'lastName' => 'sn',
  28             'phone' => 'telephonenumber',
  29             'username' => 'uid',
  30             'email' => 'mail'
  31         );
  32     }
  33     
  34     protected function getMappedName( $name )
  35     {
  36         if ( isset( $this->mapping[$name] ) )
  37         {
  38             return $this->mapping[$name];
  39         }
  40         else
  41         {
  42             return $name;
  43         }
  44     }
  45     
  46     public function __get( $name )
  47     {
  48         $name = $this->getMappedName( $name );
  49         
  50         if ( isset ( $this->data[$name] ) )
  51         {
  52             $data = Claro_Ldap_Utils::decode( $this->data[$name] );
  53             
  54             if ( $data['count'] == 1 )
  55             {
  56                 $data = $data[0];
  57             }
  58             else
  59             {
  60                 $data = Claro_Ldap_Utils::removeCount( $data );
  61             }
  62             
  63             return $data;
  64         }
  65         else
  66         {
  67             return null;
  68         }
  69     }
  70 
  71     /**
  72      * Get the list of retreived attributes
  73      * @return array
  74      */
  75     public function listGivenAttributes()
  76     {
  77         $arrayKeys = array_keys( $this->data );
  78         $givenAttributes = array();
  79         
  80         foreach ( $arrayKeys as $key )
  81         {
  82             if ( ! is_numeric( $key ) && $key != 'count' )
  83             {
  84                 $givenAttributes[] = $key;
  85             }
  86         }
  87         
  88         return $givenAttributes;
  89     }
  90 
  91     /**
  92      * Set the data object fields to LDAP attributes names mapping
  93      * @param array $mapping
  94      * @return $this
  95      */
  96     public function setMapping( $mapping )
  97     {
  98         $this->mapping = $mapping;
  99 
 100         // allow chaining
 101         return $this;
 102     }
 103 }

 105 /**
 106  * LDAP User
 107  */
 108 class Claro_Ldap_User extends Claro_Ldap_DataObject
 109 {
 110     protected $dn, $userAttr;
 111     
 112     public function __construct( $dn, $data, $userAttr = null )
 113     {
 114         $this->dn = $dn;
 115         $this->userAttr = $userAttr;
 116         parent::__construct( $data );
 117     }
 118 
 119     /**
 120      * Get the dn of the user
 121      * @return string
 122      */
 123     public function getDn()
 124     {
 125         return $this->dn;
 126     }
 127 
 128     /**
 129      * Get the retreived data (ie attributes) of the user
 130      * @return array
 131      */
 132     public function getData()
 133     {
 134         return Claro_Ldap_Utils::decode( $this->data );
 135     }
 136     
 137     /**
 138      * Get the retreived mapped data (ie attributes) of the user.
 139      * @return array
 140      */
 141     public function getMappedData()
 142     {
 143         $data = $this->getData();
 144         
 145         foreach ( $data as $name => $value )
 146         {
 147             if ( isset( $this->mapping[$name] ) )
 148             {
 149                 $data[$this->mapping[$name]] = $value;
 150             }
 151         }
 152         
 153         return $data;
 154     }

 156     /**
 157      * Get the user identifier in the LDAP (use the setMapping to map the uid
 158      * filed of the USer object to the correct LDAP attribute)
 159      * @return string
 160      */
 161     public function getUid()
 162     {
 163         if ( empty( $this->userAttr ) )
 164         {
 165             return $this->uid;
 166         }
 167         else
 168         {
 169             return $this->__get($this->userAttr);
 170         }
 171     }
 172 }

 174 /**
 175  * LDAP Connection class
 176  */
 177 class Claro_Ldap
 178 {
 179     protected $ds;
 180     protected $server, $port;
 181     protected $rootDomain;
 182     
 183     public function __construct( $server, $port, $rootDomain = '' )
 184     {
 185         $this->server = $server;
 186         $this->port = $port;
 187         $this->rootDomain = $rootDomain;
 188     }
 189     
 190     public function __destruct()
 191     {
 192         $this->close();
 193         unset( $this->ds, $this->server, $this->port, $this->rootDomain );
 194     }
 195     
 196     public function connect()
 197     {
 198         $this->ds = ldap_connect( $this->server, $this->port );
 199         
 200         if ( $this->ds )
 201         {
 202             ldap_set_option( $this->ds, LDAP_OPT_PROTOCOL_VERSION, 3 );
 203         }
 204         else
 205         {
 206             throw new Exception("Cannot connect to LDAP server");
 207         }
 208         
 209         return $this;
 210     }
 211     
 212     public function bind( $dn, $pw )
 213     {
 214         if ( false === @ldap_bind( $this->ds, $dn, $pw ) )
 215         {
 216             throw new Exception("Cannot bind to server");
 217         }
 218         
 219         return $this;
 220     }
 221     
 222     public function bindAnonymous()
 223     {
 224         if ( false === @ldap_bind( $this->ds ) )
 225         {
 226             throw new Exception("Cannot bind to server");
 227         }
 228         
 229         return $this;
 230     }
 231     
 232     public function close()
 233     {
 234         if ( $this->ds )
 235         {
 236             @ldap_unbind( $this->ds );
 237             @ldap_close( $this->ds );
 238         }
 239         
 240         return $this;
 241     }
 242     
 243     /**
 244      * Get one user from the LDAP given its uid
 245      * @return Ldap_User or false
 246      */
 247     public function getUser( $uid, $filter = null, $userAttr = null )
 248     {
 249         if ( ! is_null($userAttr) )
 250         {
 251             $searchString = "({$userAttr}={$uid})";
 252         }
 253         else
 254         {
 255             $searchString = "(uid={$uid})";
 256         }
 257         
 258         if ( ! is_null( $filter ) )
 259         {
 260             $searchString = '(& '.$searchString.' '.$filter.')';
 261         }
 262         
 263         $sr = @ldap_search( $this->ds, $this->rootDomain, $searchString );
 264         
 265         if ( @ldap_count_entries( $this->ds, $sr ) == 1 )
 266         {
 267             // get the resource of the user
 268             $re = @ldap_first_entry( $this->ds, $sr );
 269             // get the data of the user as an array
 270             $entries = @ldap_get_entries( $this->ds, $sr );
 271             // user object from the dn and the entries corresponding to the user
 272             $user = new Claro_Ldap_User( ldap_get_dn( $this->ds, $re ), $entries[0], $userAttr );
 273 
 274             return $user;
 275         }
 276         else
 277         {
 278             return false;
 279         }
 280     }
 281     
 282     /**
 283      * Search the LDAP
 284      * @return array of matching entries or false
 285      */
 286     public function search( $searchString, $filterString = null )
 287     {
 288         if ( empty( $filterString ) )
 289         {
 290             $sr = @ldap_search( $this->ds, $this->rootDomain, $searchString );
 291         }
 292         else
 293         {
 294             $sr = @ldap_search( $this->ds, $this->rootDomain, $searchString, $filterString );
 295         }
 296         
 297         if ( @ldap_count_entries( $this->ds, $sr ) > 0 )
 298         {
 299             $entries = @ldap_get_entries( $this->ds, $sr );
 300             return $entries;
 301         }
 302         else
 303         {
 304             return false;
 305         }
 306     }
 307     
 308     public function authenticate( $dn, $pw )
 309     {
 310         try
 311         {
 312             $this->bind( $dn, $pw );
 313             return true;
 314         }
 315         catch ( Exception $e )
 316         {
 317             return false;
 318         }
 319     }
 320 }
 321 
 322 /**
 323  * LDAP Utility Functions
 324  */
 325 class Claro_Ldap_Utils
 326 {
 327     public static function decode( $data )
 328     {
 329         if ( is_array( $data ) )
 330         {
 331             array_walk_recursive( $data, array('Claro_Ldap_Utils', '_decode') );
 332             
 333             return $data;
 334         }
 335         else
 336         {
 337             return Claro_Ldap_Utils::_decode( $data );
 338         }
 339     }
 340     
 341     private static function _decode( &$str )
 342     {
 343         // $str = iconv( 'UTF-8', 'ISO-8859-1', $str );
 344         $str = utf8_decode( $str );
 345         return $str;
 346     }
 347     
 348     public static function encode( $data  )
 349     {
 350         if ( is_array( $data ) )
 351         {
 352             array_walk_recursive( $data, array('Claro_Ldap_Utils', '_encode') );
 353             
 354             return $data;
 355         }
 356         else
 357         {
 358             return Claro_Ldap_Utils::_encode( $data );
 359         }
 360     }
 361     
 362     private static function _encode( &$str )
 363     {
 364         // $str = iconv( 'ISO-8859-1', 'UTF-8', $str );
 365         utf8_encode( $str );
 366         return $str;
 367     }
 368     
 369     public static function removeCount( $data )
 370     {
 371         if ( isset( $data['count'] ) )
 372         {
 373             unset( $data['count'] );
 374         }
 375         
 376         return $data;
 377     }
 378 }

   1 <?php // $Id: ldapauthdriver.lib.php 14511 2013-08-12 06:56:21Z zefredz $
   2 
   3 /**
   4  * LDAP Authentication Driver
   5  *
   6  * @version     2.5 $Revision: 14511 $
   7  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
   8  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
   9  * @license     http://www.fsf.org/licensing/licenses/agpl-3.0.html
  10  *              GNU AFFERO GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 3
  11  */
  12 
  13 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/ldap.lib.php';
  14 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/authdrivers.lib.php';
  15 
  16 class ClaroLdapAuthDriver extends AbstractAuthDriver
  17 {
  18     protected $driverConfig;
  19     
  20     protected $authSourceName;
  21     
  22     protected
  23         $userRegistrationAllowed,
  24         $userUpdateAllowed;
  25         
  26     protected
  27         $extAuthOptionList,
  28         $extAuthAttribNameList,
  29         $extAuthAttribTreatmentList,
  30         $userAttr,
  31         $userFilter,
  32         $userSelfBindAuth,
  33         $useBindDn;
  34         
  35     protected $user;
  36     
  37     public function setDriverOptions( $driverConfig )
  38     {
  39         $this->driverConfig = $driverConfig;
  40         $this->authSourceName = $driverConfig['driver']['authSourceName'];
  41         
  42         $this->userRegistrationAllowed = isset( $driverConfig['driver']['userRegistrationAllowed'] )
  43             ? $driverConfig['driver']['userRegistrationAllowed']
  44             : false
  45             ;
  46         $this->userUpdateAllowed = isset( $driverConfig['driver']['userUpdateAllowed'] )
  47             ? $driverConfig['driver']['userUpdateAllowed']
  48             : false
  49             ;
  50             
  51         $this->extAuthOptionList = $driverConfig['extAuthOptionList'];
  52         $this->extAuthAttribNameList = $driverConfig['extAuthAttribNameList'];
  53         $this->extAuthAttribTreatmentList = $driverConfig['extAuthAttribTreatmentList'];
  54         $this->extAuthIgnoreUpdateList = $driverConfig['extAuthAttribToIgnore'];
  55 
  56         // @since 1.9.9 
  57         $defaultProfileOptions = array( 
  58                 'courseRegistrationAllowed' => null,
  59                 'courseEnrolmentMode' => null, 
  60                 'defaultCourseProfile' => null, 
  61                 'editableProfileFields' => null,
  62                 'readonlyProfileFields' => array( 'login', 'password', 'phone', 'email', 'officalCode' ) );
  63         
  64         // @since 1.11 
  65         $this->authProfileOptions = isset($driverConfig['authProfileOptions'])
  66             ? array_merge( $defaultProfileOptions, $driverConfig['authProfileOptions'] )
  67             : $defaultProfileOptions
  68             ;
  69         
  70         $this->userSelfBindAuth = isset( $driverConfig['extAuthOptionList']['userSelfBindAuth'] )
  71             ? $driverConfig['extAuthOptionList']['userSelfBindAuth'] 
  72             : false
  73             ;
  74         
  75         $this->useBindDn = isset( $driverConfig['extAuthOptionList']['useBindDn'] )
  76             ? $driverConfig['extAuthOptionList']['useBindDn'] 
  77             : false
  78             ;
  79         
  80         $this->userAttr = isset($this->extAuthOptionList['userattr']) 
  81             ? $this->extAuthOptionList['userattr'] 
  82             : 'uid'
  83             ;
  84             
  85         $this->userFilter = isset($this->extAuthOptionList['userfilter']) 
  86             ? $this->extAuthOptionList['userfilter'] 
  87             : null
  88             ;
  89     }
  90     
  91     public function authenticate()
  92     {
  93         $auth = new Claro_Ldap(
  94             $this->extAuthOptionList['url'],
  95             $this->extAuthOptionList['port'],
  96             $this->extAuthOptionList['basedn']
  97         );
  98         
  99         try
 100         {
 101             $auth->connect();
 102             
 103             // no anonymous bind
 104             // user can search
 105             if( $this->userSelfBindAuth == 'true')
 106             {
 107                 $searchdn = "{$this->userAttr}={$this->username},".$this->extAuthOptionList['basedn'];
 108                 $searchpw = $this->password;
 109                 
 110                 $auth->bind( $searchdn, $searchpw );
 111             }
 112             // user cannot search
 113             elseif ( $this->useBindDn )
 114             {
 115                 $searchdn = $this->extAuthOptionList['binddn'];
 116                 $searchpw = $this->extAuthOptionList['bindpw']; 
 117             
 118                 $auth->bind( $searchdn, $searchpw );
 119             }
 120             
 121             // search user
 122             
 123             $user = $auth->getUser($this->username, $this->userFilter, $this->userAttr);
 124             
 125             if ( $user )
 126             {
 127                 if( $this->userSelfBindAuth == 'true')
 128                 {
 129                     $binddn = "{$this->userAttr}={$this->username},".$this->extAuthOptionList['basedn'];
 130                 }
 131                 else
 132                 {
 133                     $binddn = $user->getDn();
 134                 }
 135                 
 136                 
 137                 if( $auth->authenticate( $binddn, $this->password ) )
 138                 {
 139                     $this->user = $user;
 140                     return true;
 141                 }
 142                 else
 143                 {
 144                     return false;
 145                 }
 146             }
 147         }
 148         catch ( Exception $e )
 149         {
 150             $this->setFailureMessage($e->getMessage());
 151             
 152             if ( claro_debug_mode () )
 153             {
 154                 Console::error($e->__toString());
 155             }
 156             else
 157             {
 158                 Console::error($e->getMessage());
 159             }
 160             
 161             return false;
 162         }
 163     }
 164     
 165     public function userRegistrationAllowed()
 166     {
 167         return $this->userRegistrationAllowed;
 168     }
 169     
 170     public function userUpdateAllowed()
 171     {
 172         return $this->userUpdateAllowed;
 173     }
 174     
 175     public function getAuthSource()
 176     {
 177         return $this->authSourceName;
 178     }
 179     
 180     public function getUserData()
 181     {
 182         //$userData = $this->user->getData();
 183         
 184         $userAttrList = array('lastname'     => NULL,
 185                           'firstname'    => NULL,
 186                           'loginName'    => NULL,
 187                           'email'        => NULL,
 188                           'officialCode' => NULL,
 189                           'phoneNumber'  => NULL,
 190                           'isCourseCreator' => NULL,
 191                           'authSource'   => NULL);
 192         
 193         foreach($this->extAuthAttribNameList as $claroAttribName => $extAuthAttribName)
 194         {
 195             if ( ! is_null($extAuthAttribName) )
 196             {
 197                 if ( ! is_null($this->user->$extAuthAttribName) )
 198                 {
 199                     $userAttrList[$claroAttribName] = $this->user->$extAuthAttribName;
 200                 }
 201             }
 202         }
 203         
 204         // $userAttrList = array_merge( $userData, $userAttrList );
 205         
 206         foreach($userAttrList as $claroAttribName => $claroAttribValue)
 207         {
 208             if ( array_key_exists($claroAttribName, $this->extAuthAttribTreatmentList ) )
 209             {
 210                 $treatmentCallback = $this->extAuthAttribTreatmentList[$claroAttribName];
 211 
 212                 if ( is_callable( $treatmentCallback ) )
 213                 {
 214                     $claroAttribValue = $treatmentCallback($claroAttribValue);
 215                 }
 216                 else
 217                 {
 218                     $claroAttribValue = $treatmentCallback;
 219                 }
 220             }
 221 
 222             $userAttrList[$claroAttribName] = $claroAttribValue;
 223         } // end foreach
 224 
 225         /* Two fields retrieving info from another source ... */
 226 
 227         $userAttrList['loginName' ] = $this->user->getUid();
 228         $userAttrList['authSource'] = $this->authSourceName;
 229         
 230         return $userAttrList;
 231     }
 232 }

   5 /**
   6  * PEAR-based Authentication Driver
   7  *
   8  * @version     1.11 $Revision: 13495 $
   9  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  10  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  11  * @author      Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  12  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  13  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  14  * @package     kernel.auth
  15  * @deprecated  since Claroline 1.11
  16  */
  17 
  18 class PearAuthDriver extends AbstractAuthDriver
  19 {
  20     protected $driverConfig;
  21     protected $authType;
  22     protected $authSourceName;
  23     protected $userRegistrationAllowed;
  24     protected $userUpdateAllowed;
  25     protected $extAuthOptionList;
  26     protected $extAuthAttribNameList;
  27     protected $extAuthAttribTreatmentList;
  28     
  29     protected $auth;
  30     
  31     public function authenticate()
  32     {
  33         if ( empty( $this->username ) || empty( $this->password ) )
  34         {
  35             return false;
  36         }
  37         
  38         $_POST['username'] = $this->username;
  39         $_POST['password'] = $this->password;
  40         
  41         if ( $this->authType === 'LDAP')
  42         {
  43             // CASUAL PATCH (Nov 21 2005) : due to a sort of bug in the
  44             // PEAR AUTH LDAP container, we add a specific option wich forces
  45             // to return attributes to a format compatible with the attribute
  46             // format of the other AUTH containers
  47 
  48             $this->extAuthOptionList ['attrformat'] = 'AUTH';
  49         }
  50         
  51         require_once 'Auth/Auth.php';
  52 
  53         $this->auth = new Auth( $this->authType, $this->extAuthOptionList, '', false);
  54 
  55         $this->auth->start();
  56         
  57         return $this->auth->getAuth();
  58     }
  59     
  60     public function getUserData()
  61     {
  62         $userAttrList = array('lastname'     => NULL,
  63                           'firstname'    => NULL,
  64                           'loginName'    => NULL,
  65                           'email'        => NULL,
  66                           'officialCode' => NULL,
  67                           'phoneNumber'  => NULL,
  68                           'isCourseCreator' => NULL,
  69                           'authSource'   => NULL);
  70 
  71         foreach($this->extAuthAttribNameList as $claroAttribName => $extAuthAttribName)
  72         {
  73             if ( ! is_null($extAuthAttribName) )
  74             {
  75                 $userAttrList[$claroAttribName] = $this->auth->getAuthData($extAuthAttribName);
  76             }
  77         }
  78         
  79         foreach($userAttrList as $claroAttribName => $claroAttribValue)
  80         {
  81             if ( array_key_exists($claroAttribName, $this->extAuthAttribTreatmentList ) )
  82             {
  83                 $treatmentCallback = $this->extAuthAttribTreatmentList[$claroAttribName];
  84 
  85                 if ( is_callable( $treatmentCallback ) )
  86                 {
  87                     $claroAttribValue = $treatmentCallback($claroAttribValue);
  88                 }
  89                 else
  90                 {
  91                     $claroAttribValue = $treatmentCallback;
  92                 }
  93             }
  94 
  95             $userAttrList[$claroAttribName] = $claroAttribValue;
  96         } // end foreach
  97 
  98         /* Two fields retrieving info from another source ... */
  99 
 100         $userAttrList['loginName' ] = $this->auth->getUsername();
 101         $userAttrList['authSource'] = $this->authSourceName;
 102         
 103         if ( isset($userAttrList['status']) )
 104         {
 105             $userAttrList['isCourseCreator'] = ($userAttrList['status'] == 1) ? 1 : 0;
 106         }
 107         
 108         return $userAttrList;
 109     }
 110 }

   1 <?php // $Id: backlog.class.php 14201 2012-07-09 14:20:10Z jrm_ $
   2 
   3 // vim: expandtab sw=4 ts=4 sts=4:
   4 
   5 /**
   6  * CLAROLINE
   7  *
   8  * Backlog.
   9  *
  10  * @version     $Revision: 14201 $
  11  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  12  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  13  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  14  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  15  * @package     KERNEL
  16  */
  17 
  18 define ( 'BACKLOG_SUCCESS', 'BACKLOG_SUCCESS' );
  19 define ( 'BACKLOG_FAILURE', 'BACKLOG_FAILURE' );
  20 define ( 'BACKLOG_DEBUG',   'BACKLOG_DEBUG' );
  21 define ( 'BACKLOG_INFO',   'BACKLOG_INFO' );
  22 
  23 /**
  24  * Backlog class
  25  * @deprecated since Claroline 1.10, use exceptions, Console.lib or DialogBox 
  26  *  instead
  27  */
  28 class Backlog
  29 {
  30     var $_backlog = array();
  31     var $_size = array();
  32 
  33     function Backlog()
  34     {
  35         $this->_size[BACKLOG_SUCCESS] = 0;
  36         $this->_size[BACKLOG_FAILURE] = 0;
  37         $this->_size[BACKLOG_DEBUG] = 0;
  38         $this->_size[BACKLOG_INFO] = 0;
  39     }
  40 
  41     function success( $msg )
  42     {
  43         $this->message( $msg, BACKLOG_SUCCESS );
  44         $this->_size[BACKLOG_SUCCESS]++;
  45     }
  46 
  47     function failure( $msg )
  48     {
  49         $this->message( $msg, BACKLOG_FAILURE );
  50         $this->_size[BACKLOG_FAILURE]++;
  51     }
  52 
  53     function debug( $msg )
  54     {
  55         $this->message( $msg, BACKLOG_DEBUG );
  56         $this->_size[BACKLOG_DEBUG]++;
  57     }
  58 
  59     function info( $msg )
  60     {
  61         $this->message( $msg, BACKLOG_INFO );
  62         $this->_size[BACKLOG_INFO]++;
  63     }
  64 
  65     function message( $msg, $type )
  66     {
  67         $this->_backlog[] = array( 'type' => $type, 'msg' => $msg );
  68     }
  69 
  70     function size( $type = null )
  71     {
  72         switch ( $type )
  73         {
  74             case BACKLOG_SUCCESS:
  75             case BACKLOG_FAILURE:
  76             case BACKLOG_DEBUG:
  77             case BACKLOG_INFO:
  78             {
  79                 return $this->_size[$type];
  80             } break;
  81 
  82             default:
  83             {
  84                 return count($this->_backlog);
  85             }
  86         }
  87     }
  88 
  89     function output()
  90     {
  91         $out = array();
  92 
  93         foreach ( $this->_backlog as $entry )
  94         {
  95             $type = $entry['type'];
  96             $msg = $entry['msg'];
  97 
  98             switch ( $type )
  99             {
 100                 case BACKLOG_SUCCESS:
 101                 {
 102                     $out[] = '<span class="backlogSuccess">' . $msg . '</span>';
 103                 } break;
 104                 case BACKLOG_FAILURE:
 105                 {
 106                     $out[] = '<span class="backlogFailure">' . $msg . '</span>';
 107                 } break;
 108                 case BACKLOG_DEBUG:
 109                 {
 110                     $out[] = '<span class="backlogDebug">' . $msg . '</span>';
 111                 } break;
 112                 case BACKLOG_INFO:
 113                 {
 114                     $out[] = '<span class="backlogInfo">' . $msg . '</span>';
 115                 } break;
 116                 default:
 117                 {
 118                     $out[] = '<span class="backlogMessage">' . $msg . '</span>';
 119                 }
 120             }
 121 
 122             unset ($type, $msg );
 123         }
 124 
 125         return implode( '<br />' . "\n", $out );
 126     }
 127 
 128     function append( $other )
 129     {
 130         if ( is_a( $other, 'Backlog' ) )
 131         {
 132             $this->_backlog = array_merge( $this->_backlog, $other->_backlog );
 133             return true;
 134         }
 135         else
 136         {
 137             return false;
 138         }
 139     }
 140 
 141     function main()
 142     {
 143         $bl = new Backlog;
 144         echo '<pre>';
 145         $bl->success( 'message success 1' );
 146         $bl->debug( 'message debug 1' );
 147         $bl->failure( 'message failure 1' );
 148         $bl->success( 'message success 2' );
 149         $bl->info( 'message info 1' );
 150         var_dump( $bl->size() );
 151         var_dump( $bl->_size );
 152         echo '</pre>';
 153 
 154         echo '<pre>';
 155         echo $bl->output();
 156         echo '</pre>';
 157         
 158         echo 'Append';
 159         echo '<pre>';
 160         $bl->append( $bl );
 161         echo $bl->output();
 162         echo '</pre>';
 163     }
 164 }
 165 
 166 class Backlog_Reporter
 167 {
 168     public static function report( $summary, $details, $label = '', $focus = false )
 169     {
 170         $id = uniqid('details');
 171 
 172         if ( empty( $details ) )
 173         {
 174             $display = '<span class="backlogSummary">'.$summary.'</span>';
 175         }
 176         else
 177         {
 178             $linkName = ( $focus ) ? "#lnk_$id" : "#";
 179             $labeldetails = empty( $label ) ? get_lang('details') : $label;
 180             $display = <<<__ERRDISP__
 181 <script type="text/javascript">
 182 function toggleDetails( id )
 183 {
 184 var details = document.getElementById( id );
 185 
 186 if ( details.style.display == 'block' )
 187 {
 188     details.style.display = 'none';
 189 }
 190 else
 191 {
 192     details.style.display = 'block';
 193 }
 194 }
 195 </script>
 196 <a name="lnk_$id"></a>
 197 <span class="backlogSummary">$summary
 198 [<a href="$linkName" onclick="toggleDetails('$id');return false;">$labeldetails</a>]
 199 </span>
 200 <div id="$id" style="display: none;" class="backlogDetails">
 201 $details
 202 </div>
 203 __ERRDISP__;
 204         }
 205 
 206         return $display;
 207     }
 208 }
 209 
 210 if ( basename( $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] ) === basename(__FILE__) )
 211 {
 212     Backlog::main();
 213 }

/claroline/inc/lib/category.lib.inc.php

   1 <?php // $Id: backlog.class.php 12923 2011-03-03 14:23:57Z abourguignon $
   2 
   3 /**
   4  * CLAROLINE
   5  *
   6  * SQL requests for claroCategory class.
   7  *
   8  * @version     $Revision: 11894 $
   9  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  10  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html (GPL) GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
  11  * @author      Claro Team <cvs@claroline.net>
  12  * @author      Antonin Bourguignon <antonin.bourguignon@claroline.net>
  13  * @since       1.10
  14  */
  15 
  16 
  17 /**
  18  * Get datas for a category.
  19  *
  20  * @param int       identifier of the category
  21  * @return array    category's datas
  22  */
  23 function claro_get_cat_datas($id)
  24 {
  25     // Get table name
  26     $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  27     $tbl_category               = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
  28     $tbl_rel_course_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
  29             
  30     $sql = "SELECT
  31             c.id                    AS id,
  32             c.name                  AS name,
  33             c.code                  AS code,
  34             c.idParent              AS idParent,
  35             c.rank                  AS rank,
  36             c.visible               AS visible,
  37             c.canHaveCoursesChild   AS canHaveCoursesChild,
  38             rcc.courseId            AS rootCourse
  39 
  40             FROM `" . $tbl_category . "` AS c
  41             
  42             LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` AS rcc
  43             ON rcc.categoryId = c.id
  44             AND rcc.rootCourse = 1
  45             
  46             WHERE c.id = " . (int) $id;
  47     
  48     $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
  49     
  50     return $result->fetch();
  51 }
  52 
  53 
  54 /**
  55  * Return the predecessor of a specified category (based on the rank attribute).  Ranks can
  56  * be discontinued (1, 2, 4, 7, ...), so we can't just perform a $rank-1 to get the direct
  57  * predecessor of a category.
  58  *
  59  * @param int       rank of the category that you want the predecessor
  60  * @param int       identifier of the category that you want the predecessor
  61  * @return int      identifier of the direct predecessor (if any)
  62  */
  63 function claro_get_previous_cat_datas($rank, $idParent)
  64 {
  65     // Get table name
  66     $tbl_mdb_names   = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  67     $tbl_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
  68     
  69     // Retrieve all the predecessors
  70     $sql = "SELECT id
  71             FROM `" . $tbl_category . "`
  72             WHERE idParent = " . (int) $idParent . "
  73             AND rank < " . (int) $rank . "
  74             ORDER BY `rank` DESC";
  75     
  76     $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
  77     
  78     // Are there any predecessors ?
  79     $nbPredecessors = count( $result );
  80     
  81     if ( $nbPredecessors > 0 )
  82     {
  83         // Get the closest predecessor
  84         $result->rewind();
  85         return $result->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE);
  86     }
  87     else
  88     {
  89         return false;
  90     }
  91 }
  92 
  93 
  94 /**
  95  * Return the successor of a specified category (based on the rank attribute).
  96  * Ranks can be discontinued (1, 2, 4, 7, ...), so we can't just perform a
  97  * $rank+1 to get the direct successor of a category.
  98  *
  99  * @param int       rank of the category that you want the successor
 100  * @param int       identifier of the category that you want the successor
 101  * @return int      identifier of the direct successor (if any)
 102  */
 103 function claro_get_following_cat_datas($rank, $idParent)
 104 {
 105     // Get table name
 106     $tbl_mdb_names   = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 107     $tbl_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
 108     
 109     // Retrieve all the successors
 110     $sql = "SELECT id
 111             FROM `" . $tbl_category . "`
 112             WHERE idParent = " . (int) $idParent . "
 113             AND rank > " . (int) $rank . "
 114             ORDER BY `rank` ASC";
 115     
 116     $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 117     
 118     // Are there any successors ?
 119     $nbSuccessors = count( $result );
 120     
 121     if ( $nbSuccessors > 0 )
 122     {
 123         // Get the closest successor
 124         $result->rewind();
 125         return $result->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE);
 126     }
 127     else
 128     {
 129         return false;
 130     }
 131 }
 132 
 133 
 134 /**
 135  * Return categories from the node $parent.  Also returns the number
 136  * of courses (nbCourses) directly linked to each category.
 137  *
 138  * @param int       identifier of the parent from wich we want to
 139  *                  get the categories
 140  * @param bool      $visibility (1 = only visible, 0 = only invisible, null = all; default: null)
 141  * @return iterator collection of categories ordered by rank
 142  */
 143 function claro_get_categories($parent, $visibility)
 144 {
 145     // Get table name
 146     $tbl_mdb_names             = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 147     $tbl_category              = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
 148     $tbl_rel_course_category   = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 149     
 150     // Retrieve all children of the id $parent
 151     $sql = "SELECT c.id, c.name,
 152             c.code, c.idParent, c.rank, c.visible, c.canHaveCoursesChild
 153             FROM `" . $tbl_category . "` AS c
 154             
 155             WHERE c.idParent = " . (int) $parent;
 156     
 157     if (!is_null($visibility))
 158     {
 159         $sql .= "
 160             AND c.visible = " . $visibility;
 161     }
 162     
 163     if (get_conf('categories_order_by', 'rank') == 'rank')
 164     {
 165         $sql .= "
 166             ORDER BY c.`rank`";
 167     }
 168     elseif  (get_conf('categories_order_by') == 'alpha_asc')
 169     {
 170         $sql .= "
 171             ORDER BY c.`name` ASC";
 172     }
 173     else
 174     {
 175         $sql .= "
 176             ORDER BY c.`name` DESC";
 177     }
 178     
 179     return Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 180 }

 182 
 183 /**
 184  * Return all the categories from the node $parent (recursivly).  Also returns
 185  * the number of courses (nbCourses) directly linked to each category and the
 186  * level of each category.
 187  *
 188  * @param int       identifier of the parent from wich we want to get
 189  *                  the categories tree (default: 0)
 190  * @param int       level where we start (default: 0)
 191  * @param bool      visibility (1 = only visible, 0 = only invisible, null = all; default: null)
 192  * @return array    collection of all the categories organized hierarchically and ordered by rank
 193  */
 194 function claro_get_all_categories($parent = 0, $level = 0, $visibility = null)
 195 {
 196     // Get table name
 197     $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 198     $tbl_category               = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
 199     $tbl_course                 = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
 200     $tbl_rel_course_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 201     
 202     // Retrieve all children of the id $parent
 203     $sql = "SELECT COUNT(rcc.courseId) AS nbCourses,
 204             ca.id, ca.name,
 205             ca.code,
 206             ca.idParent,
 207             ca.rank,
 208             ca.visible,
 209             ca.canHaveCoursesChild,
 210             co.intitule AS dedicatedCourse,
 211             co.code AS dedicatedCourseCode
 212             
 213             FROM `" . $tbl_category . "` AS ca
 214             
 215             LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` AS rcc
 216             ON rcc.categoryId = ca.id
 217             
 218             LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_course . "` AS co
 219             ON rcc.courseId = co.cours_id AND rcc.rootCourse = 1
 220             
 221             WHERE ca.idParent = " . (int) $parent;
 222     
 223     if ( !is_null($visibility) )
 224     {
 225         $sql .= "
 226             AND ca.visible = " . $visibility;
 227     }
 228     
 229     $sql .=  "
 230             GROUP BY ca.`id`";
 231     
 232     if ( get_conf('categories_order_by') == 'rank' )
 233         $sql .= "
 234             ORDER BY ca.`rank`";
 235     elseif ( get_conf('categories_order_by') == 'alpha_asc' )
 236         $sql .= "
 237             ORDER BY ca.`name` ASC";
 238     elseif ( get_conf('categories_order_by') == 'alpha_desc' )
 239         $sql .= "
 240             ORDER BY ca.`name` DESC";
 241     
 242     $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 243     $result_array = array();
 244     
 245     // Get each child
 246     foreach ( $result as $row )
 247     {
 248         $row['level'] = $level;
 249         $result_array[] = $row;
 250         // Call this function again to get the next level of the tree
 251         $result_array = array_merge( $result_array, claro_get_all_categories($row['id'], $level+1) );
 252     }
 253     
 254     return $result_array;
 255 }
 256 
 257 
 258 /**
 259  * Return the identifiers of all the parents of a category.
 260  * Reserved category 0 never has any parent.
 261  *
 262  * @param int       identifier of the specified category
 263  * @return array    collection of all the identifiers of the parents
 264  */
 265 function claro_get_parents_ids($id)
 266 {
 267     // Get table name
 268     $tbl_mdb_names             = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 269     $tbl_category              = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
 270     
 271     // Retrieve parent of the category
 272     $sql = "SELECT idParent
 273             FROM `" . $tbl_category . "`
 274             WHERE id = " . (int) $id . "";
 275     
 276     $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 277     
 278     if (!$result->isEmpty())
 279     {
 280         $parentId = $result->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE);
 281         
 282         $result_array = array();
 283         
 284         // Keep going up until reaching the root
 285         if ( $parentId != 0 )
 286         {
 287             $result_array[] = $parentId;
 288             $result_array = array_merge( $result_array, claro_get_parents_ids($parentId) );
 289         }
 290     
 291         return $result_array;
 292     }
 293     else
 294     {
 295         return array();
 296     }
 297 }

 300 /**
 301  * Insert a category in database (with rank following the last category of
 302  * the same parent)
 303  *
 304  * @param string        name of the category
 305  * @param string        code of the category
 306  * @param int           identifier of the parent category (default: 0)
 307  * @param int           rank, position in the tree's level // Not used
 308  * @param bool          visibility (default: 1)
 309  * @param bool          canHaveCoursesChild (authorized to possess courses) (default: 1)
 310  * @return handler
 311  */
 312 function claro_insert_cat_datas($name, $code, $idParent, $rank, $visible, $canHaveCoursesChild)
 313 {
 314     // Get table name
 315     $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 316     $tbl_category               = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
 317     $tbl_rel_course_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 318     
 319     // Get the highest rank for the designated parent
 320     $sql = "SELECT MAX(rank) AS maxRank
 321             FROM `" . $tbl_category . "`
 322             WHERE idParent=" . (int) $idParent;
 323     
 324     $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 325     $result->rewind();
 326     
 327     $newRank = $result->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE) + 1;
 328     
 329     $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $tbl_category . "` SET
 330             `name`                  = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($name) . ",
 331             `code`                  = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($code) . ",
 332             `idParent`              = " . (int) $idParent . ",
 333             `rank`                  = " . $newRank. ",
 334             `visible`               = " . (int) $visible . ",
 335             `canHaveCoursesChild`   = " . (int) $canHaveCoursesChild;
 336     
 337     return Claroline::getDatabase()->exec($sql);
 338 }

 341 /**
 342  * Update datas of a category.  If the parent ($idParent) is modified,
 343  * category's rank will follow the last category of the new parent.
 344  *
 345  * @param int       identifier of the category
 346  * @param string    name of the category
 347  * @param string    code of the category
 348  * @param int       identifier of the parent category (default: 0)
 349  * @param int       rank, position in the tree's level
 350  * @param bool      visibility (default: 1)
 351  * @param bool      canHaveCoursesChild (authorized to possess courses) (default: 1)
 352  * @param int           identifier of the root course/dedicated course
 353  */
 354 function claro_update_cat_datas($id, $name, $code, $idParent, $rank, $visible, $canHaveCoursesChild, $rootCourse)
 355 {
 356     // Get table name
 357     $tbl_mdb_names   = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 358     $tbl_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
 359     $tbl_rel_course_category   = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 360     
 361     // New root course ?
 362     if (!is_null($rootCourse))
 363     {
 364         $sql = "SELECT rcc.courseId
 365                 FROM `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` AS rcc
 366                 WHERE rcc.categoryId = " . (int) $id . "
 367                 AND rootCourse = 1";
 368         
 369         $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 370         $course = $result->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE);
 371         
 372         // Unset the previous rootCourse
 373         if (isset($course['courseId']) && $course['courseId'] != $rootCourse)
 374         {
 375             $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` SET
 376                     rootCourse = 0
 377                     WHERE categoryId = " . (int) $id . "
 378                     AND courseId = " . $course['courseId'];
 379             
 380             Claroline::getDatabase()->exec($sql);
 381         }
 382         
 383         // Set the new rootCourse
 384         $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` SET
 385                 rootCourse = 1
 386                 WHERE categoryId = " . (int) $id . "
 387                 AND courseId = " . $rootCourse;
 388         
 389         Claroline::getDatabase()->exec($sql);
 390     }
 391     
 392     // New parent ?
 393     $sql = "SELECT c.idParent
 394             FROM `" . $tbl_category . "` AS c
 395             WHERE c.id = " . (int) $id;
 396     
 397     $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 398     
 399     if ($result->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE) == $idParent) // Parent hasn't changed
 400     {
 401         $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl_category . "` SET
 402                 `name`                  = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($name) . ",
 403                 `code`                  = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($code) . ",
 404                 `rank`                  = " . (int) $rank . ",
 405                 `visible`               = " . (int) $visible . ",
 406                 `canHaveCoursesChild`   = " . (int) $canHaveCoursesChild . "
 407                 WHERE id = " . (int) $id;
 408     }
 409     else // Parent has changed
 410     {
 411         // Get the highest rank for the designated new parent
 412         $sql = "SELECT MAX(rank) AS maxRank
 413                 FROM `" . $tbl_category . "`
 414                 WHERE idParent=" . (int) $idParent;
 415         
 416         $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 417         
 418         $newRank = $result->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE) + 1;
 419         
 420         // Update datas
 421         $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl_category . "` SET
 422                 `name`                  = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($name) . ",
 423                 `code`                  = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($code) . ",
 424                 `idParent`              = " . (int) $idParent . ",
 425                 `rank`                  = " . $newRank. ",
 426                 `visible`               = " . (int) $visible . ",
 427                 `canHaveCoursesChild`   = " . (int) $canHaveCoursesChild . "
 428                 WHERE id = " . (int) $id;
 429     }
 430     
 431     return Claroline::getDatabase()->exec($sql);
 432 }

 435 /**
 436  * Delete datas of a category and unlinks all courses linked to it.
 437  *
 438  * @param int       identifier of the category
 439  * @return handler
 440  */
 441 function claro_delete_cat_datas($id)
 442 {
 443     // Get table name
 444     $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 445     $tbl_category               = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
 446     $tbl_rel_course_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 447     
 448     //Unlink the courses
 449     $sql = "SELECT courseId, categoryId
 450             FROM `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "`
 451             WHERE categoryId = " . (int) $id;
 452     
 453     $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 454     
 455     while ($link = $result->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_ASSOC))
 456     {
 457         $sql = "SELECT COUNT(courseId) AS nbLinks
 458                 FROM `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "`
 459                 WHERE courseId = " . $link['courseId'];
 460         
 461         $result2 = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 462         $nbLinks = $result2->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE);
 463         
 464         //If there are multiple links for this course, just delete the one we want
 465         if ($nbLinks > 1)
 466         {
 467             $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "`
 468                     WHERE categoryId = " . (int) $id . "
 469                     AND courseId = " . $link['courseId'];
 470             Claroline::getDatabase()->exec($sql);
 471         }
 472         //If there is only one link for this course, link it to the root category
 473         else
 474         {
 475             $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "`
 476                     SET
 477                     categoryId = 0,
 478                     rootCourse = 0
 479                     WHERE categoryId = " . (int) $id . "
 480                     AND courseId = " . $link['courseId'];
 481             Claroline::getDatabase()->exec($sql);
 482         }
 483     }
 484     
 485     //Finaly, delete the category
 486     $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl_category . "`
 487             WHERE id = " . (int) $id;
 488     
 489     return Claroline::getDatabase()->exec($sql);
 490 }

 537 /**
 538  * Count the number of courses belonging to the category and all its
 539  * subcategories (recursivly).
 540  * The count does NOT include root courses.
 541  *
 542  * @param int       identifier of the category
 543  * @param int       count, starting value of counting (default: 0)
 544  * @return int      number of courses
 545  */
 546 function claro_count_all_courses($id, $count = 0)
 547 {
 548     // Get table name
 549     $tbl_mdb_names             = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 550     $tbl_category              = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
 551     $tbl_rel_course_category   = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 552     
 553     // Count number of courses for this category
 554     $sql = "SELECT COUNT(rcc.courseId) AS nbCourses
 555             FROM `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` AS rcc
 556             WHERE rcc.categoryId = " . (int) $id . "
 557             AND rootCourse != 1";
 558     
 559     $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 560     $nbCourses = $result->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE);
 561     $count = ($nbCourses > 0) ? ($count + $nbCourses) : ($count);
 562     
 563     // Retrieve all children of this category
 564     $sql = "SELECT id
 565             FROM `" . $tbl_category . "`
 566             WHERE idParent = " . (int) $id;
 567     
 568     $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 569     
 570     // Get each child
 571     foreach ( $result as $row )
 572     {
 573         $count =+ claro_count_all_courses($row['id'], $count);
 574     }
 575     
 576     return $count;
 577 }

  21 class CategoryBrowser

  57         $this->coursesList      = claroCourse::getRestrictedCourses($categoryId, $userId);

  65      * 
  66      * @return object ClaroCategory
  67      * @since 1.8
  68      */

  70     {

  72             return $this->currentCategory;
  73         else
  74             return null;

 111     /**
 112      * Fetch list of courses of the current category without
 113      * the session courses.
 114      *
 115      * This list include main data about
 116      * the user but also registration status
 117      *
 118      * @return array list of courses of the current category
 119      * without session courses
 120      * @since 1.10
 121      * @deprecated session and source courses are equally displayed since 1.11
 122      */
 123     public function getCoursesWithoutSessionCourses()
 124     {
 125         if (!empty($this->coursesList))
 126         {
 127             $coursesList = array();
 128             foreach ($this->coursesList as $course)
 129             {
 130                 if (is_null($course['sourceCourseId']) || 
 131                     (isset($course['isCourseManager']) && 
 132                     $course['isCourseManager'] == 1)
 133                 )
 134                 {
 135                     $coursesList[] = $course;
 136                 }
 137             }
 138             
 139             return $coursesList;
 140         }
 141         else
 142         {
 143             return array();
 144         }
 145     }
