 148     /**
 149      * Fetch list of courses of the current category without
 150      * the source courses (i.e. courses having session courses).
 151      *
 152      * This list include main data about the user but also
 153      * registration status.
 154      *
 155      * @return array list of courses of the current category
 156      * without source courses
 157      * @since 1.10
 158      * @deprecated session and source courses are equally displayed since 1.11
 159      */
 160     public function getCoursesWithoutSourceCourses()
 161     {
 162         if (!empty($this->coursesList))
 163         {
 164             // Find the source courses identifiers
 165             $sourceCoursesIds = array();
 166             foreach ($this->coursesList as $course)
 167             {
 168                 if (!is_null($course['sourceCourseId'])
 169                     && !in_array($course['sourceCourseId'], $sourceCoursesIds))
 170                 {
 171                     $sourceCoursesIds[] = $course['sourceCourseId'];
 172                 }
 173             }
 174             
 175             $coursesList = array();
 176             foreach ($this->coursesList as $course)
 177             {
 178                 if (!in_array($course['id'], $sourceCoursesIds))
 179                     $coursesList[] = $course;
 180             }
 181             
 182             return $coursesList;
 183         }
 184         else
 185         {
 186             return array();
 187         }
 188     }

 207     /**

 211      */
 212     public function getTemplate()
 213     {
 214         $currentCategory    = $this->getCurrentCategorySettings();
 215         $categoryList       = $this->getSubCategoryList();
 216         $navigationUrl      = new Url($_SERVER['PHP_SELF'].'#categoryContent');
 217         
 218         /*
 219          * Build url param list
 220          * @todo find a better way to do that
 221          */
 222         if (isset($_REQUEST['cmd']))
 223         {
 224             $navigationUrl->addParam('cmd', $_REQUEST['cmd']);
 225         }
 226         if (isset($_REQUEST['fromAdmin']))
 227         {
 228             $navigationUrl->addParam('fromAdmin', $_REQUEST['fromAdmin']);
 229         }
 230         if (isset($_REQUEST['uidToEdit']))
 231         {
 232             $navigationUrl->addParam('uidToEdit', $_REQUEST['uidToEdit']);
 233         }
 234         if (isset($_REQUEST['asTeacher']))
 235         {
 236             $navigationUrl->addParam('asTeacher', $_REQUEST['asTeacher']);
 237         }
 238         
 239         $courseTreeView = 
 240             CourseTreeNodeViewFactory::getCategoryCourseTreeView(
 241                 $this->categoryId, 
 242                 $this->userId);
 243         
 244         $courseTreeView->setViewOptions($this->viewOptions);
 245         
 246         $template = new CoreTemplate('categorybrowser.tpl.php');
 247         $template->assign('currentCategory', $currentCategory);
 248         $template->assign('categoryBrowser', $this);
 249         $template->assign('categoryList', $categoryList);
 250         $template->assign('courseTreeView', $courseTreeView);
 251         $template->assign('navigationUrl', $navigationUrl->toUrl());
 252         
 253         return $template;
 254     }

 188     /**
 189      * insert or update course data
 190      *
 191      * @return boolean success
 192      */
 193     public function save ()
 194     {
 195         if ( empty($this->courseId) )
 196         {
 197             // Insert
 198             $keys = define_course_keys ($this->officialCode,'',get_conf('dbNamePrefix'));
 199             
 200             $courseSysCode      = trim($keys['currentCourseId']);
 201             $courseDbName       = trim($keys['currentCourseDbName']);
 202             $courseDirectory    = trim($keys['currentCourseRepository']);
 203             
 204             if ( empty($courseSysCode) || empty($courseDbName) || empty($courseDirectory) )
 205             {
 206                 throw new Exception("Error missing data for course {$this->officialCode}");
 207             }
 208             
 209             if ( ! $this->useExpirationDate) $this->expirationDate = 'NULL';
 210             
 211             // Session courses are created without categories links:
 212             // so we duplicate the source course's categories links
 213             
 214             /*if ( !is_null($this->sourceCourseId) && !empty($this->sourceCourseId) )
 215             {
 216                 $sourceCourse = new claroCourse();
 217                 $sourceCourse->load(claroCourse::getCodeFromId($this->sourceCourseId));
 218                 
 219                 $this->categories = $sourceCourse->categories;
 220             }*/
 221             
 222             if ( !is_null($this->sourceCourseId) && !empty($this->sourceCourseId) )
 223             {
 224                 $sourceCourse = new claroCourse();
 225                 $sourceCourse->load(claroCourse::getCodeFromId($this->sourceCourseId));
 226                 
 227                 if( $sourceCourse->sourceCourseId )
 228                 {
 229                     throw new Exception( 'You cannot create a course session from another course session' );
 230                 }
 231             }
 232             
 233             if (   prepare_course_repository($courseDirectory, $courseSysCode)
 234                 && register_course($courseSysCode
 235                    ,               $this->officialCode
 236                    ,               $this->sourceCourseId
 237                    ,               $courseDirectory
 238                    ,               $courseDbName
 239                    ,               $this->titular
 240                    ,               $this->email
 241                    ,               $this->categories
 242                    ,               $this->title
 243                    ,               $this->language
 244                    ,               $GLOBALS['_uid']
 245                    ,               $this->access
 246                    ,               $this->registration
 247                    ,               $this->registrationKey
 248                    ,               $this->visibility
 249                    ,               $this->departmentName
 250                    ,               $this->extLinkUrl
 251                    ,               $this->publicationDate
 252                    ,               $this->expirationDate
 253                    ,               $this->status
 254                    ,               $this->userLimit )
 255                 && install_course_database( $courseDbName )
 256                 && install_course_tools( $courseDbName, $this->language, $courseDirectory )
 257                 )
 258             {
 259                 $courseObj = new Claro_Course($courseSysCode);
 260                 $courseObj->load();
 261 
 262                 $courseRegistration = new Claro_CourseUserRegistration(
 263                     AuthProfileManager::getUserAuthProfile($GLOBALS['_uid']),
 264                     $courseObj,
 265                     null,
 266                     null
 267                 );
 268                 
 269                 $courseRegistration->ignoreRegistrationKeyCheck();
 270                 $courseRegistration->ignoreCategoryRegistrationCheck();
 271                 
 272                 $courseRegistration->setCourseAdmin();
 273                 $courseRegistration->setCourseTutor();
 274                 $courseRegistration->forceSuperUser();
 275                 
 276                 if ( $courseRegistration->addUser() )
 277                 {
 278                 
 279                     // Set course id
 280                     $this->courseId = $courseSysCode;
 281 
 282                     // Notify event manager
 283                     $args['courseSysCode'  ] = $courseSysCode;
 284                     $args['courseDbName'   ] = $courseDbName;
 285                     $args['courseDirectory'] = $courseDirectory;
 286                     $args['courseCategory' ] = $this->categories;
 287 
 288                     $GLOBALS['eventNotifier']->notifyEvent("course_created",$args);
 289 
 290                     return true;
 291                 }
 292                 else
 293                 {
 294                     $this->backlog->failure( $courseRegistration->getErrorMessage() );
 295                     return false;
 296                 }
 297             }
 298             else
 299             {
 300                 $lastFailure = claro_failure::get_last_failure();
 301                 $this->backlog->failure( 'Error : '. $lastFailure );
 302                 return false;
 303             }
 304 
 305         }
 306         else
 307         {
 308             // Update
 309             $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 310             $tbl_course = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
 311             $tbl_cdb_names = claro_sql_get_course_tbl();
 312             $tbl_course_properties = $tbl_cdb_names['course_properties'];
 313             
 314             if ( ! $this->useExpirationDate) $this->expirationDate = null;
 315             
 316             $sqlExpirationDate = is_null($this->expirationDate)
 317                 ? 'NULL'
 318                 : 'FROM_UNIXTIME(' . claro_sql_escape($this->expirationDate) . ')'
 319                 ;
 320             
 321             $sqlCreationDate = is_null($this->publicationDate)
 322                 ? 'NULL'
 323                 : 'FROM_UNIXTIME(' . claro_sql_escape($this->publicationDate) . ')'
 324                 ;
 325             
 326             $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl_course . "`
 327                     SET `intitule`             = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->title) . "',
 328                         `titulaires`           = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->titular) . "',
 329                         `administrativeNumber` = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->officialCode) . "',
 330                         `language`             = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->language) . "',
 331                         `extLinkName`          = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->departmentName) . "',
 332                         `extLinkUrl`           = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->extLinkUrl) . "',
 333                         `email`                = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->email) . "',
 334                         `visibility`           = '" . ($this->visibility ? 'visible':'invisible') . "',
 335                         `access`               = '" . claro_sql_escape( $this->access ) . "',
 336                         `registration`         = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->registration) . "',
 337                         `registrationKey`      = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->registrationKey) . "',
 338                         `lastEdit`             = NOW(),
 339                         `creationDate`         = " . $sqlCreationDate . ",
 340                         `expirationDate`       = " . $sqlExpirationDate . ",
 341                         `status`               = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->status)   . "',
 342                         `userLimit`            = '" . (int) $this->userLimit . "'
 343                     WHERE code='" . claro_sql_escape($this->courseId) . "'";
 344             
 345             // Handle categories
 346             // 1/ Remove all links in database
 347             $this->unlinkCategories();
 348             
 349             // 2/ Link new categories selection
 350             $this->linkCategories($this->categories);
 351             
 352             // If it's a source course, do the same for all its session courses
 353             if ( $this->isSourceCourse )
 354             {
 355                 $sql2 = "SELECT cours_id FROM `" . $tbl_course . "`
 356                         WHERE sourceCourseId = " . $this->id;
 357                 
 358                 $sessionCourses = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sql2);
 359                 
 360                 foreach ($sessionCourses as $sessionCourse)
 361                 {
 362                     unlink_course_categories ( $sessionCourse['cours_id'] );
 363                     link_course_categories ( $sessionCourse['cours_id'], $this->categories );
 364                 }
 365             }
 366             
 367             return claro_sql_query($sql);
 368         }
 369     }

 381         // Declare needed tables
 382         $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 383         $tbl_courses                 = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
 384         
 385         $sql = "SELECT isSourceCourse
 386                 FROM `" . $tbl_courses . "`
 387                 WHERE cours_id = " . (int) $id;
 388         
 389         $res = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);

 497     /**
 498      * Get any related course to the current course (parent or child).
 499      *
 500      * @return array    courses
 501      * @since 1.10
 502      */
 503     public function getRelatedCourses()
 504     {
 505         // Declare needed tables
 506         $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 507         $tbl_course                 = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
 508         
 509         $sql = "SELECT c.cours_id               AS id,
 510                        c.titulaires             AS titular,
 511                        c.code                   AS sysCode,
 512                        c.isSourceCourse         AS isSourceCourse,
 513                        c.sourceCourseId         AS sourceCourseId,
 514                        c.intitule               AS title,
 515                        c.administrativeNumber   AS officialCode,
 516                        c.language,
 517                        c.directory,
 518                        c.visibility,
 519                        c.access,
 520                        c.registration,
 521                        c.email,
 522                        c.status,
 523                        c.userLimit
 524                 FROM `" . $tbl_course . "` AS c
 525                 WHERE c.sourceCourseId = " . $this->id . "
 526                 OR c.cours_id = " . $this->id;
 527         
 528         if (!empty($this->sourceCourseId))
 529         {
 530             $sql .= "
 531                 OR cours_id = " . $this->sourceCourseId . "
 532                 OR c.sourceCourseId = " . $this->sourceCourseId;
 533         }
 534         
 535         $sql .= "
 536             ORDER BY c.isSourceCourse DESC
 537         ";
 538         
 539         return claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 540     }

 543     /**
 544      * Get related course to the current course (parent or child) for a
 545      * given user.
 546      *
 547      * @return array    courses
 548      * @since 1.11
 549      */
 550     public function getRelatedUserCourses($userId)
 551     {
 552         // Declare needed tables
 553         $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 554         $tbl_course                 = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
 555         $tbl_rel_user_courses       = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user'];
 556         
 557         $sql = "SELECT c.cours_id               AS id,
 558                        c.titulaires             AS titular,
 559                        c.code                   AS sysCode,
 560                        c.isSourceCourse         AS isSourceCourse,
 561                        c.sourceCourseId         AS sourceCourseId,
 562                        c.intitule               AS title,
 563                        c.administrativeNumber   AS officialCode,
 564                        c.language,
 565                        c.directory,
 566                        c.visibility,
 567                        c.access,
 568                        c.registration,
 569                        c.email,
 570                        c.status,
 571                        c.userLimit
 572                 FROM `" . $tbl_course . "` AS c
 573                 
 574                 RIGHT JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_user_courses . "` AS rcu
 575                 ON rcu.user_id = " . (int) $userId . "
 576                 AND rcu.code_cours = c.code
 577                 
 578                 WHERE c.sourceCourseId = " . $this->id . "
 579                 OR c.cours_id = " . $this->id;
 580         
 581         if (!empty($this->sourceCourseId))
 582         {
 583             $sql .= "
 584                 OR cours_id = " . $this->sourceCourseId . "
 585                 OR c.sourceCourseId = " . $this->sourceCourseId;
 586         }
 587         
 588         $sql .= "
 589                 ORDER BY c.isSourceCourse DESC, c.intitule ASC";
 590         
 591         return claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 592     }

 623     
 624     /**
 625      * Retrieve course data from a course's form.
 626      */
 627     public function handleForm ()
 628     {
 629         /*
 630          * Manage the multiple select.
 631          * If it has been left empty (no selection), create an array with
 632          * the identifier of the root category (0).
 633          * If it has been serialized in the progress URL, unserialized it.
 634          */
 635         if ( isset($_REQUEST['linked_categories']) )
 636         {
 637             $_REQUEST['linked_categories'] = is_array($_REQUEST['linked_categories']) ?
 638                 ($_REQUEST['linked_categories']) :
 639                 (unserialize($_REQUEST['linked_categories']));
 640         }
 641         else
 642         {
 643             $_REQUEST['linked_categories'] = array(0);
 644         }
 645         
 646         if ( isset($_REQUEST['isSourceCourse']) )   $this->title = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['isSourceCourse']));
 647         if ( isset($_REQUEST['sourceCourseId']) )   $this->title = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['sourceCourseId']));
 648         if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_title']) )     $this->title = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['course_title']));
 649         
 650         if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_officialCode']) )
 651         {
 652             $this->officialCode = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['course_officialCode']));
 653             $this->officialCode = preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/', '', $this->officialCode);
 654             switch (get_conf('forceCodeCase'))
 655             {
 656                 case 'upper':
 657                     $this->officialCode = strtoupper($this->officialCode);
 658                     break;
 659                 case 'lower':
 660                     $this->officialCode = strtolower($this->officialCode);
 661                     break;
 662                 case 'nochange':
 663                     break;
 664                 default:
 665                     break;
 666             }
 667         }
 668         
 669         if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_titular']) )   $this->titular = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['course_titular']));
 670         if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_email']) )     $this->email = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['course_email']));
 671         if ( count($_REQUEST['linked_categories']) > 0 )
 672         {
 673             $categoriesList = array();
 674             foreach( $_REQUEST['linked_categories'] as $category )
 675             {
 676                 // Bypass the loading page "course creating, please wait"
 677                 $categoryId = (is_a($category, 'claroCategory')) ? (strip_tags($category->id)) : (strip_tags($category));
 678                 $tempCat = new claroCategory();
 679                 $tempCat->load($categoryId);
 680                 $categoriesList[] = $tempCat;
 681             }
 682             
 683             $this->categories = $categoriesList;
 684         }
 685         else
 686         {
 687             $rootCat = new claroCategory();
 688             $rootCat->load(0);
 689             $this->categories = array($rootCat);
 690         }
 691         
 692         if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_departmentName']) )    $this->departmentName = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['course_departmentName']));
 693         if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_extLinkUrl']) )        $this->extLinkUrl = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['course_extLinkUrl']));
 694         if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_language']) )          $this->language = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['course_language']));
 695         if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_visibility']) )        $this->visibility  = (bool) $_REQUEST['course_visibility'];
 696         if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_access']) )            $this->access = $_REQUEST['course_access'];
 697         
 698         if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_registration']) )
 699         {
 700             if ( isset($_REQUEST['registration_validation']) && $_REQUEST['registration_validation'] == 'on' )
 701             {
 702                 $this->registration = 'validation';
 703             }
 704             else
 705             {
 706                 $this->registration = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['course_registration']));
 707             }
 708         }
 709         
 710         if ( isset($_REQUEST['registration_key']) || isset($_REQUEST['course_registrationKey']) )
 711         {
 712             $this->registrationKey = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['course_registrationKey']));
 713         }
 714         else
 715         {
 716             $this->registrationKey = null;
 717         }
 718         
 719         if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_status_selection']))
 720         {
 721             if ($_REQUEST['course_status_selection'] == 'disable')
 722             {
 723                 $this->status = isset($_REQUEST['course_status'])
 724                     ? trim($_REQUEST['course_status'])
 725                     : null
 726                     ;
 727             }
 728             elseif ($_REQUEST['course_status_selection'] == 'date' )
 729             {
 730                 $this->status = 'date';
 731                     
 732                 if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_publicationDate' ]) )
 733                 {
 734                     $this->publicationDate = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['course_publicationDate']));
 735                 }
 736                 elseif (isset($_REQUEST['course_publicationYear'])
 737                     && isset($_REQUEST['course_publicationMonth'])
 738                     && isset($_REQUEST['course_publicationDay']))
 739                 {
 740                     $this->publicationDate = mktime(
 741                         0,0,0,
 742                         $_REQUEST['course_publicationMonth'],
 743                         $_REQUEST['course_publicationDay'],
 744                         $_REQUEST['course_publicationYear'] );
 745                 }
 746                 else
 747                 {
 748                     $this->publicationDate = mktime(23,59,59);
 749                 }
 750                 
 751                 $this->useExpirationDate = (bool) (isset($_REQUEST['useExpirationDate']) && $_REQUEST['useExpirationDate']);
 752                 
 753                 if ( $this->useExpirationDate )
 754                 {
 755                     if ( isset($_REQUEST['course_expirationDate']) )
 756                     {
 757                         $this->expirationDate = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['course_expirationDate']));
 758                     }
 759                     elseif ( isset($_REQUEST['course_expirationYear'])
 760                         && isset($_REQUEST['course_expirationMonth'])
 761                         && isset($_REQUEST['course_expirationDay']) )
 762                     {
 763                         $this->expirationDate = mktime(
 764                             23,59,59,
 765                             $_REQUEST['course_expirationMonth'],
 766                             $_REQUEST['course_expirationDay'],
 767                             $_REQUEST['course_expirationYear'] );
 768                     }
 769                     else
 770                     {
 771                         $this->expirationDate = mktime(0,0,0);
 772                     }
 773                 }
 774             }
 775             else
 776             {
 777                 $this->status = 'enable';
 778             }
 779         }
 780         
 781         if (isset($_REQUEST['course_userLimit']) && $_REQUEST['course_userLimit'] > 0)
 782         {
 783             $this->userLimit = (int) $_REQUEST['course_userLimit'];
 784         }
 785         else
 786         {
 787             $this->userLimit = 0;
 788         }
 789     }

 792     /**
 793      * Validate data from object.  Error handling with a backlog object.
 794      *
 795      * @return boolean success
 796      */
 797     public function validate ()
 798     {
 799         $success = true ;
 800         
 801         /**
 802          * Configuration array , define here which field can be left empty or not
 803          */
 804         
 805         $fieldRequiredStateList['title'         ] = get_conf('human_label_needed');
 806         $fieldRequiredStateList['officialCode'  ] = get_conf('human_code_needed');
 807         $fieldRequiredStateList['titular'       ] = false;
 808         $fieldRequiredStateList['email'         ] = get_conf('course_email_needed');
 809         $fieldRequiredStateList['categories'    ] = false; // Can be left blank (no category associated)
 810         $fieldRequiredStateList['language'      ] = true;
 811         $fieldRequiredStateList['departmentName'] = get_conf('extLinkNameNeeded');
 812         $fieldRequiredStateList['extLinkUrl'    ] = get_conf('extLinkUrlNeeded');
 813         $fieldRequiredStateList['publicationDate'] = $this->status == 'date';
 814         $fieldRequiredStateList['expirationDate'] = $this->status == 'date' && $this->useExpirationDate;
 815         
 816         // Validate course access
 817         if ( empty($this->access) || ! in_array($this->access, array('public','private','platform')) )
 818         {
 819             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Missing or invalid course access'));
 820             $success = false ;
 821             
 822             if ( !$this->courseId
 823                 && $this->access == 'public'
 824                 && !( get_conf('allowPublicCourses', true) || claro_is_platform_admin() ) )
 825             {
 826                 $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('You are not allowed to create a public course'));
 827                 $success = false ;
 828             }
 829         }
 830         
 831         // Validate course title
 832         if ( empty($this->title) && $fieldRequiredStateList['title'] )
 833         {
 834             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Course title needed'));
 835             $success = false ;
 836         }
 837         
 838         // Validate course code
 839         if ( empty($this->officialCode) && $fieldRequiredStateList['officialCode'])
 840         {
 841             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Course code needed'));
 842             $success = false ;
 843         }
 844         
 845         // Check course length
 846         if( strlen($this->officialCode) > 40 )
 847         {
 848             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Course code too long'));
 849             $success = false;
 850         }
 851         
 852         // Validate email
 853         if ( empty($this->email) && $fieldRequiredStateList['email'])
 854         {
 855             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Email needed'));
 856             $success = false ;
 857         }
 858         else
 859         {
 860             if ( ! $this->validateEmailList() )
 861             {
 862                 $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('The email address is not valid'));
 863                 $success = false;
 864             }
 865         }
 866         
 867         // Validate course language
 868         if ( empty($this->language) && $fieldRequiredStateList['language'])
 869         {
 870             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Language needed'));
 871             $success = false ;
 872         }
 873         
 874         // Validate course departmentName
 875         if ( empty($this->departmentName) && $fieldRequiredStateList['departmentName'])
 876         {
 877             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Department needed'));
 878             $success = false ;
 879         }
 880         
 881         // Validate course extLinkUrl
 882         if ( empty($this->extLinkUrl) && $fieldRequiredStateList['extLinkUrl'])
 883         {
 884             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Department url needed'));
 885             $success = false ;
 886         }
 887         
 888         // Validate department url
 889         if ( ! $this->validateExtLinkUrl() )
 890         {
 891             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Department URL is not valid'));
 892             $success = false ;
 893         }
 894         
 895         // Validate course publication date
 896         if ( empty($this->publicationDate) && $fieldRequiredStateList['publicationDate'])
 897         {
 898             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Publication date needed'));
 899             $success = false ;
 900         }
 901         
 902         //TODO check expirationDate
 903         if ( empty($this->expirationDate) && $fieldRequiredStateList['expirationDate'])
 904         {
 905             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Expiration date needed'));
 906             $success = false ;
 907         }
 908         
 909         if ( !empty($this->expirationDate) && $fieldRequiredStateList['expirationDate'] )
 910         {
 911             if ( $this->publicationDate > $this->expirationDate )
 912             {
 913                 $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Publication date must precede expiration date'));
 914                 $success = false ;
 915             }
 916         }
 917         
 918         // Validate categories
 919         foreach ($this->categories as $category)
 920         {
 921             if ( !get_conf ( 'clcrs_rootCategoryAllowed', true ) && $category->id == 0 && !claro_is_platform_admin() )
 922             {
 923                 $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('You need to choose at least one category for this course'));
 924                 $success = false ;
 925             }
 926             elseif ( !$category->canHaveCoursesChild && !claro_is_platform_admin() )
 927             {
 928                 $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('The category <i>%category</i> can\'t contain courses', array('%category' => $category->name)));
 929                 $success = false ;
 930             }
 931         }
 932         
 933         return $success;
 934     }

 936     
 937     /**
 938      * Validate url and try to repair it if no protocol specified.
 939      *
 940      * @return boolean success
 941      */
 942     protected function validateExtLinkUrl ()
 943     {
 944         if ( empty($this->extLinkUrl) ) return true;
 945         
 946         $regexp = "!^(http|https|ftp)\://[a-zA-Z0-9\.-]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,3}(:[a-zA-Z0-9]*)?/?([a-zA-Z0-9\._\?\,\'/\\\+&%\$#\=~-])*$!i";
 947         
 948         if ( ! preg_match($regexp,$this->extLinkUrl) )
 949         {
 950             // Problem with url. try to repair
 951             // if  it  only the protocol missing add http
 952             $fixed_url = 'http://' . $this->extLinkUrl;
 953             if ( preg_match($regexp, $fixed_url))
 954             {
 955                 $this->extLinkUrl = $fixed_url;
 956             }
 957             else
 958             {
 959                  return false;
 960             }
 961         }
 962         
 963         return true;
 964     }
 965     
 966     
 967     /**
 968      * validate email ( and semi-column separated email list )
 969      *
 970      * @return boolean success
 971      */
 972     protected function validateEmailList ()
 973     {
 974         // empty email is valide as we already checked if field was required
 975         if( empty($this->email) ) return true;
 976         
 977         $emailControlList = strtr($this->email,', ',';');
 978         $emailControlList = preg_replace( '/;+/', ';', $emailControlList );
 979         
 980         $emailControlList = explode(';',$emailControlList);
 981         
 982         $emailValidList = array();
 983         
 984         foreach ( $emailControlList as $emailControl )
 985         {
 986             $emailControl = trim($emailControl);
 987             
 988             if ( ! is_well_formed_email_address( $emailControl ) )
 989             {
 990                 return false;
 991             }
 992             else
 993             {
 994                 $emailValidList[] = $emailControl;
 995             }
 996         }
 997         
 998         $this->email = implode(';',$emailValidList);
 999         return true;
1000     }

1003     /**
1004      * Display form
1005      *
1006      * @param $cancelUrl string url of the cancel button
1007      * @return string html output of form
1008      */
1009     public function displayForm ($cancelUrl=null)
1010     {
1011         JavascriptLoader::getInstance()->load('course_form');
1012         
1013         $languageList = get_language_to_display_list('availableLanguagesForCourses');
1014         $categoriesList = claroCategory::getAllCategoriesFlat();
1015         
1016         $linkedCategoriesListHtml   = ''; // Categories linked to the course
1017         $unlinkedCategoriesListHtml = ''; // Other categories (not linked to the course)
1018         foreach ( $categoriesList as $category )
1019         {
1020             // Is that category linked to the current course or not ?
1021             $match = false;
1022             foreach ( $this->categories as $searchCategory )
1023             {
1024                 if ( $category['id'] == (int) $searchCategory->id )
1025                 {
1026                     $match = true;
1027                     break;
1028                 }
1029                 else
1030                 {
1031                     $match = false;
1032                 }
1033             }
1034             
1035             // Dispatch in the lists
1036             if ( $match )
1037             {
1038                 $linkedCategoriesListHtml .= '<option '
1039                     . (!$category['visible'] ? 'class="hidden" ' : '')
1040                     . 'value="'
1041                     . $category['id'] . '">' . $category['path']
1042                     . '</option>' . "\n";
1043             }
1044             else
1045             {
1046                 if ($category['canHaveCoursesChild'] || claro_is_platform_admin())
1047                 {
1048                     $unlinkedCategoriesListHtml .= '<option '
1049                         . (!$category['visible'] ? 'class="hidden" ' : '')
1050                         . 'value="'
1051                         . $category['id'] . '">' . $category['path']
1052                         . '</option>' . "\n";
1053                 }
1054             }
1055         }
1056         
1057         $publicDisabled = !(get_conf('allowPublicCourses', true) || claro_is_platform_admin())
1058             ? ' disabled="disabled"'
1059             : '';
1060         
1061         $publicCssClass = !(get_conf('allowPublicCourses', true) || claro_is_platform_admin())
1062             ? ' class="notice"'
1063             : '';
1064         
1065         $publicMessage = $this->access != 'public' && !(get_conf('allowPublicCourses', true) || claro_is_platform_admin())
1066             ? '<br /><span class="notice">'
1067                 . get_lang('If you need to create a public course, please contact the platform administrator')
1068                 . '</span>'
1069             : '';
1070         
1071         $cancelUrl = is_null($cancelUrl) ?
1072             get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'course/index.php?cid=' . claro_htmlspecialchars($this->courseId) :
1073             $cancelUrl;
1074         
1075         $template = new CoreTemplate('course_form.tpl.php');
1076         $template->assign('formAction', $_SERVER['PHP_SELF']);
1077         $template->assign('relayContext', claro_form_relay_context());
1078         $template->assign('course', $this);
1079         $template->assign('linkedCategoriesListHtml', $linkedCategoriesListHtml);
1080         $template->assign('unlinkedCategoriesListHtml', $unlinkedCategoriesListHtml);
1081         $template->assign('languageList', $languageList);
1082         $template->assign('publicDisabled', $publicDisabled);
1083         $template->assign('publicCssClass', $publicCssClass);
1084         $template->assign('publicMessage', $publicMessage);
1085         $template->assign('cancelUrl', $cancelUrl);
1086         $template->assign('nonRootCategoryRequired', !get_conf ( 'clcrs_rootCategoryAllowed', true ) );
1087         
1088         return $template->render();
1089     }

1141     /**
1142      * Get html representing parameter list depending on method (POST for form, GET for URL's')
1143      *
1144      * @param $method string GET OR POST
1145      * @return string html output of params for $method method
1146      */
1147     public function getHtmlParamList($method = 'GET')
1148     {
1149         if ( empty($this->htmlParamList) ) return '';
1150         
1151         $html = '';
1152         
1153         if ( $method == 'POST' )
1154         {
1155             foreach ( $this->htmlParamList as $name => $value )
1156             {
1157                 $html .= '<input type="hidden" name="' . claro_htmlspecialchars($name) . '" value="' . claro_htmlspecialchars($value) . '" />' . "\n" ;
1158             }
1159         }
1160         else // GET
1161         {
1162             $params = array();
1163             foreach ( $this->htmlParamList as $name => $value )
1164             {
1165                 $params[] = rawurlencode($name) . '=' . rawurlencode($value);
1166             }
1167             
1168             $html = implode('&amp;', $params );
1169         }
1170         
1171         return $html;
1172     }

1179      * @param $registration string
1180      * @return integer value of visibility field
1181      *
1182      * @deprecated 1.9

1184     public function getVisibility ( $access, $registration )
1185     {
1186         $visibility = 0 ;

1188         if     ( ! $access && ! $registration ) $visibility = 0;
1189         elseif ( ! $access &&   $registration ) $visibility = 1;
1190         elseif (   $access && ! $registration ) $visibility = 3;
1191         elseif (   $access &&   $registration ) $visibility = 2;

1193         return $visibility ;

1223     /**
1224      * Courses are often identified through their code (sysCode).  This
1225      * method permits to easily get the code of a course based on
1226      * its identifier (integer).
1227      *
1228      * @param int       course identifier
1229      * @return string   course code (sysCode)
1230      * @since 1.10
1231      */
1232     public static function getCodeFromId ( $id )
1233     {
1234         // Declare needed tables
1235         $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
1236         $tbl_course                 = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
1237         
1238         $sql = "SELECT c.code AS sysCode
1239                 
1240                 FROM `" . $tbl_course . "` AS c
1241                 WHERE c.cours_id = " . (int) $id;
1242         
1243         if ($result = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql))
1244         {
1245             return $result['sysCode'];
1246         }
1247         else
1248         {
1249             return null;
1250         }
1251     }

1271                 
1272                 FROM `" . $tbl_course . "` AS c
1273                 WHERE c.code = '" . $code . "'";

1277             return $result['id'];
1278         }
1279         else

1281             return null;
1282         }

1286     /**
1287      * Send course creation information by mail to all platform administrators
1288      *
1289      * @param string creator firstName
1290      * @param string creator lastname
1291      * @param string creator email
1292      */
1293     public function mailAdministratorOnCourseCreation ($creatorFirstName, $creatorLastName, $creatorEmail)
1294     {
1295         $subject = get_lang('Course created : %course_name',array('%course_name'=> $this->title));
1296         
1297         $categoryCodeList = array();
1298         
1299         foreach ($this->categories as $category)
1300         {
1301             $categoryCodeList[] = $category->name;
1302         }
1303         
1304         $body = nl2br(get_block('blockCourseCreationEmailMessage', array( '%date' => claro_html_localised_date(get_locale('dateTimeFormatLong')),
1305                                 '%sitename' => get_conf('siteName'),
1306                                 '%user_firstname' => $creatorFirstName,
1307                                 '%user_lastname' => $creatorLastName,
1308                                 '%user_email' => $creatorEmail,
1309                                 '%course_code' => $this->officialCode,
1310                                 '%course_title' => $this->title,
1311                                 '%course_lecturers' => $this->titular,
1312                                 '%course_email' => $this->email,
1313                                 '%course_categories' => (!empty($this->categories) ? implode(', ', $categoryCodeList) : get_lang('No category')),
1314                                 '%course_language' => $this->language,
1315                                 '%course_url' => get_path('rootWeb') . 'claroline/course/index.php?cid=' . claro_htmlspecialchars($this->courseId)) ) );
1316         
1317         // Get the concerned senders of the email
1318         $mailToUidList = claro_get_uid_of_system_notification_recipient();
1319         if(empty($mailToUidList)) $mailToUidList = claro_get_uid_of_platform_admin();
1320         
1321         $message = new MessageToSend(claro_get_current_user_id(),$subject,$body);
1322         
1323         $recipient = new UserListRecipient();
1324         $recipient->addUserIdList($mailToUidList);
1325         
1326         //$message->sendTo($recipient);
1327         $recipient->sendMessage($message);
1328         
1329     }

1333      * Build progress param url
1334      *
1335      * @return string url
1336      */
1337     public function buildProgressUrl ()
1338     {
1339         $url = $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] . '?cmd=exEdit';
1340         
1341         $paramList = array();
1342         
1343         $paramList['course_isSourceCourse']     = $this->isSourceCourse;
1344         $paramList['course_sourceCourseId']     = $this->sourceCourseId;
1345         $paramList['course_title']              = $this->title;
1346         $paramList['course_officialCode']       = $this->officialCode;
1347         $paramList['course_titular']            = $this->titular;
1348         $paramList['course_email']              = $this->email;
1349         $paramList['linked_categories']         = serialize($this->categories); // Serialize array to put it into an URL
1350         $paramList['course_departmentName']     = $this->departmentName;
1351         $paramList['course_extLinkUrl']         = $this->extLinkUrl;
1352         $paramList['course_language']           = $this->language;
1353         $paramList['course_visibility']         = $this->visibility;
1354         $paramList['course_access']             = $this->access;
1355         $paramList['course_registration']       = $this->registration;
1356         $paramList['course_registrationKey']    = $this->registrationKey;
1357         $paramList['course_publicationDate']    = $this->publicationDate;
1358         $paramList['course_expirationDate']     = $this->expirationDate;
1359         $paramList['useExpirationDate']         = $this->useExpirationDate;
1360         $paramList['course_status']             = $this->status;
1361         $paramList['course_userLimit']          = $this->userLimit;
1362         
1363         $paramList = array_merge($paramList, $this->htmlParamList);
1364         
1365         foreach ($paramList as $key => $value)
1366         {
1367             $url .= '&amp;' . rawurlencode($key) . '=' . rawurlencode($value);
1368         }
1369         
1370         return $url;
1371     }
1372 }

  81 /**
  82  * Get unique keys of a course.
  83  *
  84  * @param  string $courseId (optionnal)  If not set, it use the current course
  85  *         will be taken.
  86  * @return array list of unique keys (sys, db & path) of a course
  87  * @author Christophe Gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
  88  * @author Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  89  * @since 1.7
  90  */
  91 function claro_get_course_data($courseId = NULL, $force = false )
  92 {
  93     static $cachedDataList = array();
  94     
  95     $useCurrentCourseData = false;
  96     
  97     if ( is_null( $courseId ) && claro_is_in_a_course() )
  98     {
  99         $courseId =  claro_get_current_course_id();
 100         $useCurrentCourseData = true;
 101     }
 102     
 103     if ( ! array_key_exists( $courseId, $cachedDataList ) || true === $force )
 104     {
 105         if ( $useCurrentCourseData )
 106         {
 107             $courseDataList = $GLOBALS['_course'];
 108         }
 109         else
 110         {
 111             $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 112             $tbl_courses                = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
 113             $tbl_category               = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
 114             $tbl_rel_course_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 115             
 116             // Get course datas
 117             $sql =  "SELECT
 118                     c.cours_id              AS id,
 119                     c.code                  AS sysCode,
 120                     c.isSourceCourse        AS isSourceCourse,
 121                     c.sourceCourseId        AS sourceCourseId,
 122                     c.intitule              AS name,
 123                     c.administrativeNumber  AS officialCode,
 124                     c.directory             AS path,
 125                     c.dbName                AS dbName,
 126                     c.titulaires            AS titular,
 127                     c.email                 AS email,
 128                     c.language              AS language,
 129                     c.extLinkUrl            AS extLinkUrl,
 130                     c.extLinkName           AS extLinkName,
 131                     c.visibility            AS visibility,
 132                     c.access                AS access,
 133                     c.registration          AS registration,
 134                     c.registrationKey       AS registrationKey,
 135                     c.diskQuota             AS diskQuota,
 136                     UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.creationDate)          AS publicationDate,
 137                     UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.expirationDate)        AS expirationDate,
 138                     c.status                AS status,
 139                     c.userLimit             AS userLimit
 140                     
 141                     FROM `" . $tbl_courses . "` AS c
 142                     
 143                     WHERE c.code = '" . claro_sql_escape($courseId) . "'";
 144             
 145             $courseDataList = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
 146             
 147             if ( ! $courseDataList ) return claro_failure::set_failure('course_not_found');
 148             
 149             $courseDataList['access'             ] = $courseDataList['access'];
 150             $courseDataList['visibility'         ] = (bool) ('visible' == $courseDataList['visibility'] );
 151             $courseDataList['registrationAllowed'] = $courseDataList['registration'];
 152             $courseDataList['dbNameGlu'          ] = get_conf('courseTablePrefix') . $courseDataList['dbName'] . get_conf('dbGlu'); // use in all queries
 153             
 154             // Get categories datas
 155             $sql = "SELECT cat.id  AS categoryId
 156                     FROM `" . $tbl_category . "` AS cat
 157                     LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` AS rcc
 158                     ON ( cat.id = rcc.categoryId )
 159                     WHERE rcc.courseId = " . $courseDataList['id'];
 160             
 161             $categoriesDataList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 162             
 163             $courseDataList['categories'         ] = $categoriesDataList;
 164 
 165             // Doesn't work claro_sql_get_tbl need a tool id and is not for a tool
 166             // kernel table would be in mainDB.
 167             // $tbl =  claro_sql_get_tbl('course_properties', array(CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE=>$courseDataList['sysCode']));
 168             $tbl = claro_sql_get_course_tbl( $courseDataList['dbNameGlu'] );
 169             $tbl_course_properties = $tbl['course_properties'];
 170             
 171             $sql = "SELECT name, value
 172                     FROM `" . $tbl_course_properties . "`
 173                     WHERE category = 'MAIN'";
 174 
 175             $extraDataList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 176 
 177             if (is_array($extraDataList) )
 178             {
 179                 foreach($extraDataList as $thisData)
 180                 {
 181                     $courseDataList[$thisData['name']] = $thisData['value'];
 182                 }
 183             }
 184         }
 185 
 186         $cachedDataList[$courseId] = $courseDataList; // cache for the next time ...
 187     }
 188 
 189     return $cachedDataList[$courseId];
 190 }

 193 /**
 194  * Get all courses datas in data base.
 195  *
 196  * @param int           category identifier (default: null)
 197  * @param bool          $visibility (1 = only visible, 0 = only invisible, null = all; default: null)
 198  * @return array        collection of courses ordered by label (asc)
 199  * @author Antonin Bourguignon <antonin.bourguignon@claroline.net>
 200  * @since 1.10
 201  */
 202 function claro_get_all_courses ($categoryId = null, $visibility = null)
 203 {
 204     $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 205     $tbl_course                 = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
 206     $tbl_rel_course_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 207     
 208     $curdate = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time());
 209     
 210     $sql = "SELECT c.cours_id               AS id,
 211                    c.titulaires             AS titular,
 212                    c.code                   AS sysCode,
 213                    c.isSourceCourse         AS isSourceCourse,
 214                    c.sourceCourseId         AS sourceCourseId,
 215                    c.intitule               AS title,
 216                    c.administrativeNumber   AS officialCode,
 217                    c.language,
 218                    c.directory,
 219                    c.visibility,
 220                    c.access,
 221                    c.registration,
 222                    c.email,
 223                    c.status,
 224                    c.userLimit
 225                    
 226             FROM `" . $tbl_course . "` AS c";
 227     
 228     if (!is_null($categoryId))
 229     {
 230         $sql .= "
 231             LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` AS rcc
 232             ON c.cours_id = rcc.courseId
 233             
 234             WHERE (rcc.categoryId = " . (int) $categoryId . "
 235             OR c.sourceCourseId IS NOT NULL)";
 236     }
 237 
 238     if (!is_null($visibility))
 239     {
 240         if (!is_null($categoryId))
 241             $sql .= "AND ";
 242         else
 243             $sql .= "WHERE ";
 244             
 245         if ($visibility)
 246             $sql .= "c.visibility = 'visible'";
 247         else
 248             $sql .= "c.visibility = 'invisible'";
 249     }
 250 
 251     $sql .= "
 252             ORDER BY c.intitule ASC";
 253     
 254     return claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 255 }

 258 /**
 259  * Get courses datas in data base.
 260  *
 261  * @param int           category identifier (default: null)
 262  * @param int           identifier of the user
 263  * @return array        array of courses ordered by label (asc)
 264  * @author Antonin Bourguignon <antonin.bourguignon@claroline.net>
 265  * @since 1.10
 266  */
 267 function claro_get_restricted_courses ($categoryId, $userId)
 268 {
 269     $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 270     $tbl_course                 = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
 271     $tbl_rel_course_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 272     $tbl_rel_course_user        = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user'];
 273     
 274     $curdate = claro_mktime();
 275     
 276     $sql = "SELECT c.cours_id               AS id,
 277                     c.titulaires            AS titular,
 278                     c.code                  AS sysCode,
 279                     c.isSourceCourse        AS isSourceCourse,
 280                     c.sourceCourseId        AS sourceCourseId,
 281                     c.intitule              AS title,
 282                     c.administrativeNumber  AS officialCode,
 283                     c.dbName                AS db,
 284                     c.intitule              AS title,
 285                     UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.expirationDate)    AS expirationDate,
 286                     UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.creationDate)      AS creationDate,
 287                     c.language,
 288                     c.directory,
 289                     c.visibility,
 290                     c.access,
 291                     c.registration,
 292                     c.email,
 293                     c.status,
 294                     c.userLimit";
 295     
 296     if (!is_null($categoryId))
 297         $sql .= ",
 298                     rcc.categoryId  AS categoryId,
 299                     rcc.rootCourse  AS rootCourse";
 300     
 301     if (!is_null($userId))
 302         $sql .= ",
 303                     rcu.isCourseManager,
 304                     rcu.isPending,
 305                     rcu.user_id              AS enroled";
 306     
 307     $sql .= "
 308             FROM `" . $tbl_course . "` AS c";
 309     
 310     if (!is_null($userId))
 311         $sql .= "
 312             
 313             LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_course_user . "` AS rcu
 314             ON c.code = rcu.code_cours AND rcu.user_id = " . (int) $userId;
 315     
 316     if (!is_null($categoryId))
 317         $sql .= "
 318             
 319             LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` AS rcc
 320             ON c.cours_id = rcc.courseId";
 321     
 322 
 323     $sql .= "
 324             
 325             WHERE visibility = 'visible' ";
 326     
 327     if (!is_null($categoryId))
 328         $sql .= "
 329             AND rcc.rootCourse != 1";
 330     
 331     
 332     // User logged can't see source courses
 333     if (!is_null($userId))
 334             $sql .= "
 335             AND (isSourceCourse = 0 OR rcu.isCourseManager = 1)";
 336     
 337     // User anonymous can't see session courses
 338     else
 339             $sql .= "
 340             AND sourceCourseId IS NULL";
 341             
 342     $sql .= "
 343             AND (
 344                   (c.status = 'enable'
 345                     OR (c.status = 'date'
 346                          AND (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.creationDate) < '". $curdate ."'
 347                                 OR c.creationDate IS NULL OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.creationDate) = 0)
 348                          AND ('". $curdate ."' < UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.expirationDate)  OR c.expirationDate IS NULL)
 349                        )
 350                   )";
 351     
 352     if (!is_null($userId))
 353         $sql .= "
 354                   OR NOT (rcu.user_id IS NULL)";
 355         
 356     $sql .= "
 357                 )";
 358     
 359     if (!is_null($categoryId))
 360         $sql .= "
 361             AND ( rcc.categoryId = " . (int) $categoryId . ")";
 362     
 363     if ( !get_conf('userCourseListGroupByCategories') )
 364     {
 365         $sql .= " GROUP BY c.code";
 366     }
 367 
 368     if ( get_conf('course_order_by') == 'official_code' )
 369     {
 370         $sql .= " ORDER BY UPPER(c.`administrativeNumber`), c.`intitule`";
 371     }
 372     else
 373     {
 374         $sql .= " ORDER BY c.`intitule`, UPPER(c.`administrativeNumber`)";
 375     }
 376     
 377     return claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 378 }

 449 /**
 450  * This function return properties for groups in a given course context.
 451  *
 452  * @param string $courseId sysCode of the course.
 453  *
 454  * @return array ('registrationAllowed' ,
 455                   'self_registration',
 456                   'private',
 457                   'nbGroupPerUser',
 458                   'tools' => array ('CLFRM',
 459                                     'CLDOC',
 460                                     'CLWIKI',
 461                                     'CLCHT')
 462                                     )
 463 
 464 
 465  * The 4th first properties  are course properties dedicated to groups as default value.
 466  * The 'tool' array is like course.tool_list.
 467  */
 468 function claro_get_main_group_properties($courseId)
 469 {
 470     $tbl_cdb_names = claro_sql_get_course_tbl( claro_get_course_db_name_glued($courseId) );
 471     $tbl_course_properties   = $tbl_cdb_names['course_properties'];
 472 
 473     $sql = "SELECT name,
 474                    value
 475             FROM `" . $tbl_course_properties . "`
 476             WHERE category = 'GROUP'";
 477 
 478     $dbDataList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 479 
 480     if (is_array($dbDataList) )
 481     {
 482         foreach($dbDataList as $thisData)
 483         {
 484             $tempList[$thisData['name']] = (int) $thisData['value'];
 485         }
 486 
 487         $propertyList = array();
 488 
 489         $propertyList ['registrationAllowed'] =  isset( $tempList['self_registration'] ) && $tempList['self_registration'] == 1;
 490         $propertyList ['unregistrationAllowed'] =  isset($tempList['self_unregistration']) && $tempList['self_unregistration'] == 1;
 491         $propertyList ['tutorRegistrationAllowed'] =  isset( $tempList['tutor_registration'] ) && $tempList['tutor_registration'] == 1;
 492         $propertyList ['private'            ] =  !isset( $tempList['private'] ) || $tempList['private']  == 1;
 493         $propertyList ['nbGroupPerUser'     ] =  isset( $tempList['nbGroupPerUser'] ) ? $tempList['nbGroupPerUser'] : 1;
 494 
 495         $propertyList['tools'] = array();
 496         
 497         $groupToolList = get_activated_group_tool_label_list( $courseId );
 498         
 499         foreach ( $groupToolList as $thisGroupTool )
 500         {
 501             $thisGroupToolLabel = $thisGroupTool['label'];
 502             $propertyList['tools'][$thisGroupToolLabel] = isset( $tempList[$thisGroupToolLabel] ) ? ($tempList[$thisGroupToolLabel] == 1) : false;
 503         }
 504         
 505         return $propertyList;
 506     }
 507     else
 508     {
 509         return false;
 510     }
 511 }

 576 function claro_get_group_data($context, $force = false )

 579     {

 581     }
 582 
 583     if (is_array($context) && array_key_exists(CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP,$context))
 584     {
 585         $gid = $context[CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP];
 586     }
 587     $groupDataList = null;
 588 
 589     static $cachedGroupDataList = null;
 590 /*
 591     if ( ! $force)
 592     {
 593         if ( $cachedGroupDataList && $groupId == $cachedGroupDataList['sysCode'] )
 594         {
 595             $groupDataList = $cachedGroupDataList;
 596         }
 597         elseif ( ( is_null($groupId) && $GLOBALS['_gid']) )
 598         {
 599             $groupDataList = $GLOBALS['_group'];
 600         }
 601     }
 602 */
 603     if ( ! $groupDataList )
 604     {
 605         $tbl_c_names = claro_sql_get_course_tbl(claro_get_course_db_name_glued($cid) );
 606

 614

 616                 LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_c_names['bb_forums'] . "`   f
 617 
 618                    ON    g.id = f.group_id
 619                 WHERE    `id` = '". (int) $gid."'";

 621         $groupDataList = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
 622 
 623         if ( ! $groupDataList ) return claro_failure::set_failure('group_not_found');
 624 
 625         $cachedGroupDataList = $groupDataList; // cache for the next time ...

 667 /**
 668  * Get a list of tag names of some tools
 669  * This is a bad named function because they return only tool type modules
 670  *
 671  * Returned tagname is the "Developpers english name" this tag would be passed to get_lang
 672  *
 673  * @param boolean $active true filter to keep only tools activated in platform
 674  * @return array( `label`=>`tagname`)
 675  */
 676 function claro_get_module_name_list($active = true)
 677 {
 678     static $toolNameList;
 679 
 680     $tbl_mdb_names   = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 681     $tbl_module      = $tbl_mdb_names['module'];
 682 
 683     if( ! isset( $toolNameList ) )
 684     {
 685         $toolNameList = array('CLANN' => 'Announcements'
 686         ,                     'CLFRM' => 'Forums'
 687         ,                     'CLCAL' => 'Agenda'
 688         ,                     'CLCHT' => 'Chat'
 689         ,                     'CLDOC' => 'Documents and Links'
 690         ,                     'CLDSC' => 'Course description'
 691         ,                     'CLGRP' => 'Groups'
 692         ,                     'CLLNP' => 'Learning path'
 693         ,                     'CLQWZ' => 'Exercises'
 694         ,                     'CLWRK' => 'Assignments'
 695         ,                     'CLUSR' => 'Users'
 696         ,                     'CLWIKI' => 'Wiki'
 697         );
 698     }
 699 
 700     //add in result the module of type 'tool'
 701     //see if we take only activated modules or all of them
 702 
 703     if ($active)
 704     {
 705         $activationSQL = " AND `activation`='activated'";
 706     }
 707     else
 708     {
 709         $activationSQL = "";
 710     }
 711 
 712     //find tool modules
 713 
 714     $sql = "SELECT `label`, `name` FROM `" . $tbl_module . "`
 715                             WHERE `type`='tool'
 716                               ".$activationSQL;
 717 
 718     $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 719 
 720     //add them in result array
 721 
 722     foreach ($result as $tool)
 723     {
 724 
 725         if (!isset($toolNameList[$tool['label']]))
 726         {
 727             $toolNameList[$tool['label']] = $tool['name'];
 728         }
 729     }
 730 
 731     return $toolNameList;
 732 }

 739 /**
 740  * Return the list of tool installed on the platform
 741  *
 742  * @param  boolean $force (optionnal) - reset the result cache, default is false
 743  *
 744  * @return array the main course list array ( $tid => 'label','name','url','icon','activation' )
 745  */
 746 function claro_get_main_course_tool_list ( $force = false )
 747 {
 748     static $courseToolList = null ;
 749 
 750     if ( is_null($courseToolList) || $force )
 751     {
 752         // Initialise course tool list
 753         $courseToolList = array();
 754 
 755         // Get name of the tables
 756         $tbl_mdb_names        = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 757         $tbl_tool_list        = $tbl_mdb_names['tool'];
 758         $tbl_module           = $tbl_mdb_names['module'];
 759 
 760         // Find module tools
 761         $sql = "SELECT t.id,
 762                        t.claro_label as label,
 763                        m.name,
 764                        m.activation,
 765                        t.icon,
 766                        t.access_manager,
 767                        t.script_url as url
 768                 FROM `" . $tbl_module . "` as m,
 769                      `" . $tbl_tool_list . "` as t
 770                WHERE t.claro_label = m.label
 771                  AND m.type = 'tool'
 772                ORDER BY t.def_rank";
 773 
 774         $courseToolResult = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 775 
 776         // Fill course tool list
 777         foreach ( $courseToolResult as $courseTool )
 778         {
 779             $toolId = $courseTool['id'];
 780 
 781             $courseToolList[$toolId]['label'] = $courseTool['label'];
 782             $courseToolList[$toolId]['name'] = $courseTool['name'];
 783             $courseToolList[$toolId]['url'] = get_module_url($courseTool['label']) . '/' . $courseTool['url'] ;
 784 
 785             if ( !empty($courseTool['icon']) )
 786             {
 787                 $courseToolList[$toolId]['icon'] = get_module_url($courseTool['label']) . '/'. $courseTool['icon'];
 788             }
 789             else
 790             {
 791                 $courseToolList[$toolId]['icon'] = $GLOBALS['imgRepositoryWeb'] .'/tool.png';
 792             }
 793 
 794             if ( $courseTool['activation'] == 'activated' )
 795             {
 796                 $courseToolList[$toolId]['activation'] = true;
 797             }
 798             else
 799             {
 800                 $courseToolList[$toolId]['activation'] = false;
 801             }
 802 
 803             if ( $courseTool['access_manager'] == 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' )
 804             {
 805                 $courseToolList[$toolId]['activable'] = false;
 806             }
 807             else
 808             {
 809                 $courseToolList[$toolId]['activable'] = true;
 810             }
 811         }
 812     }
 813 
 814     return $courseToolList ;
 815 }
 816 
 817 /**
 818  * Return the tool list for a course according a certain access level.
 819  *
 820  * @param string    $courseIdReq - the requested course id
 821  * @param int       $profileIdReq - the requested profile id
 822  * @param boolean   $force (optionnal)  - reset the result cache, default is false
 823  * @param boolean   $active (optionnal) - get the list of active tool only if set
 824  *                  to true (default behaviour)
 825  * @param mixed     $courseActive (optional) - set to true (default behaviour) to get
 826  *                  only activated course tools, set to false to get all course tools
 827  *
 828  * @return array    the courses list
 829  */
 830 
 831 function claro_get_course_tool_list( $courseIdReq,
 832                                     $profileIdReq,
 833                                     $force = false,
 834                                     $active = true,
 835                                     $courseActive = true )
 836 {
 837     static $courseToolList = null, $courseId = null, $profileId = null;
 838 
 839     if (   is_null($courseToolList)
 840     || $courseId    != $courseIdReq
 841     || $profileId   != $profileIdReq
 842     || $force )
 843     {
 844         $courseId   = $courseIdReq;
 845         $profileId  = $profileIdReq;
 846 
 847         $tbl_mdb_names        = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 848         $tbl_tool_list        = $tbl_mdb_names['tool'];
 849         $tbl_module           = $tbl_mdb_names['module'];
 850         $tbl_cdb_names        = claro_sql_get_course_tbl( claro_get_course_db_name_glued($courseIdReq) );
 851         $tbl_course_tool_list = $tbl_cdb_names['tool'];
 852 
 853         /*
 854         * Search all the tool corresponding to this access levels
 855         */
 856 
 857         // find module or claroline existing tools
 858 
 859         $sql = "SELECT DISTINCT ctl.id            AS id,
 860                       pct.id                      AS tool_id,
 861                       pct.claro_label             AS label,
 862                       ctl.script_name             AS external_name,
 863                       ctl.visibility              AS visibility,
 864                       IFNULL(pct.icon,'tool.png') AS icon,
 865                       ISNULL(ctl.tool_id)         AS external,
 866                       m.activation ,
 867                       m.name                      AS name,
 868                       ctl.activated               AS activated,
 869                       ctl.installed               AS installed,
 870                       IFNULL( ctl.script_url ,
 871                               pct.script_url )    AS url
 872                FROM `" . $tbl_course_tool_list . "` AS ctl,
 873                     `" . $tbl_module . "`           AS m,
 874                     `" . $tbl_tool_list . "`        AS pct
 875 
 876                WHERE pct.id = ctl.tool_id
 877                  AND pct.claro_label = m.label
 878                  ". ($active ? " AND m.activation = 'activated' " :"") . "
 879                  ". ($courseActive ? " AND ctl.activated = 'true' " :"") . "
 880                ORDER BY external, pct.def_rank, ctl.rank";
 881 
 882         $courseToolList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 883 
 884         // right profile management
 885 
 886         $size = count($courseToolList);
 887 
 888         for ( $i=0 ; $i<$size ; $i++ )
 889         {
 890             $toolId = $courseToolList[$i]['tool_id'];
 891             $visibility = (bool) $courseToolList[$i]['visibility'];
 892 
 893             // delete tool from course tool list if :
 894             // 1. tool is invisible and profile has no right to edit tool
 895             // 2. profile has no right to view tool
 896             if ( ( $visibility == false && ! claro_is_allowed_tool_edit($toolId,$profileId,$courseId) )
 897             || ! claro_is_allowed_tool_read($toolId,$profileId,$courseId) )
 898             {
 899                 unset($courseToolList[$i]);
 900             }
 901         }
 902 
 903         // find external url added by teacher
 904 
 905         $sql = "SELECT DISTINCT ctl.id            AS id,
 906                       NULL                        AS tool_id,
 907                       NULL                        AS label,
 908                       ctl.script_name             AS external_name,
 909                       ctl.visibility              AS visibility,
 910                       'tool.png'                  AS icon,
 911                       ISNULL(ctl.tool_id)         AS external,
 912                       NULL                        AS name,
 913                       ctl.script_url              AS url
 914 
 915                FROM `" . $tbl_course_tool_list . "` AS ctl
 916                WHERE ISNULL(ctl.tool_id) ";
 917 
 918         if ( ! get_init('is_courseAdmin') )
 919         {
 920             $sql .= 'AND ctl.visibility = 1';
 921         }
 922 
 923         $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 924 
 925         $courseToolList = array_merge($courseToolList,$result);
 926     }
 927 
 928     return $courseToolList;
 929 }

1058     }
1059 */

1069 $claro_failureList = array();
1070 
1071 /**
1072  * collects and manage failures occuring during script execution
1073  * The main purpose is allowing to manage the display messages externaly
1074  * from functions or objects. This strengthens encapsulation principle
1075  *
1076  * @example :
1077  *
1078  *  function my_function()
1079  *  {
1080  *      if ($succeeds) return true;
1081  *      else           return claro_failure::set_failure('my_failure_type');
1082  *  }
1083  *
1084  *  if ( my_function() )
1085  *  {
1086  *      SOME CODE ...
1087  *  }
1088  *  else
1089  *  {
1090  *      $failure_type = claro_failure::get_last_failure()
1091  *  }
1092  *
1093  * @author Hugues Peeters <hugues.peeters@claroline.net>
1094  * @package failure
1095  * @deprecated since 1.9, use Exceptions instead
1096  */
1097 class claro_failure
1098 {
1099     /*
1100     * IMPLEMENTATION NOTE : For now the $claro_failureList list is set to the
1101     * global scope, as PHP 4 is unable to manage static variable in class. But
1102     * this feature is awaited in PHP 5. The class is already written to
1103     * minimize the changes when static class variable will be possible. And the
1104     * API won't change.
1105     */
1106 
1107     // var $claro_failureList = array();
1108 
1109     /**
1110      * Pile the last failure in the failure list
1111      *
1112  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
1113      * @param  string $failureType the type of failure
1114      * @global array  claro_failureList
1115      * @return boolean false to stay consistent with the main script
1116      */
1117 
1118     public static function set_failure($failureType)
1119     {
1120         global $claro_failureList;
1121 
1122         $claro_failureList[] = $failureType;
1123 
1124         pushClaroMessage('set failure : ' . var_export($failureType,1),'set_failure');
1125 
1126         return false;
1127     }
1128 
1129 
1130     /**
1131      * get the last failure stored
1132      *
1133      * @author Hugues Peeters <hugues.peeters@claroline.net>
1134      * @return string the last failure stored
1135      */
1136 
1137     public static function get_last_failure()
1138     {
1139         global $claro_failureList;
1140 
1141         if( isset( $claro_failureList[ count($claro_failureList) - 1 ] ) )
1142         return $claro_failureList[ count($claro_failureList) - 1 ];
1143         else
1144         return '';
1145     }
1146 }

1194 /**
1195  * Display options to switch between student view and course manager view
1196  * This function is mainly used by the claro_init_banner.inc.php file
1197  * The display mode command will only be displayed if
1198  * claro_set_tool_view_mode(true) has been previously called.
1199  * This will affect the return value of claro_is_allowed_to_edit() function.
1200  * It will ten return false as the user is a simple student.
1201  *
1202  * @author Roan Embrechts
1203  * @author Hugues Peeters
1204  * @param string - $viewModeRequested.
1205  *                 For now it can be 'STUDENT' or 'COURSE_ADMIN'
1206  * @see claro_is_allowed_to_edit()
1207  * @see claro_is_display_mode_available()
1208  * @see claro_set_display_mode_available()
1209  * @see claro_get_tool_view_mode()
1210  * @see claro_set_tool_view_mode()
1211  * @return true;
1212  */
1213 
1214 
1215 function claro_disp_tool_view_option($viewModeRequested = false)
1216 {
1217     pushClaroMessage( (function_exists('claro_html_debug_backtrace')
1218              ? claro_html_debug_backtrace()
1219              : 'claro_html_debug_backtrace() not defined'
1220              )
1221              .'claro_disp_tool_view_option is deprecated , use claro_html_tool_view_option','error');
1222 
1223     return claro_html_tool_view_option($viewModeRequested);
1224 }
1225 
1226 function claro_html_tool_view_option($viewModeRequested = false)
1227 {
1228     if ( ! claro_is_course_manager() || ! claro_is_display_mode_available() ) return false;
1229 
1230     if ($viewModeRequested) claro_set_tool_view_mode($viewModeRequested);
1231 
1232     $currentViewMode = claro_get_tool_view_mode();
1233 
1234     /*------------------------------------------------------------------------
1235     PREPARE URL
1236     ------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
1237 
1238     /*
1239     * check if the REQUEST_URI contains already URL parameters
1240     * (thus a questionmark)
1241     */
1242 
1243     if ( strstr($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI' ], '?') )
1244     {
1245         $url = $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI' ];
1246     }
1247     else
1248     {
1249         $url = $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] . '?';
1250     }
1251 
1252     /*
1253      * convert & to &amp;
1254      */
1255 
1256     $url = str_replace( '&amp;', '&', $url );
1257     $url = claro_htmlspecialchars( strip_tags( $url ) );
1258 
1259     /*
1260     * remove previous view mode request from the url
1261     */
1262 
1263     $url = str_replace('&amp;viewMode=STUDENT'     , '', $url);
1264     $url = str_replace('&amp;viewMode=COURSE_ADMIN', '', $url);
1265     $url = str_replace('?viewMode=STUDENT'     , '?', $url);
1266     $url = str_replace('?viewMode=COURSE_ADMIN', '?', $url);
1267     $url = str_replace('?&amp;', '?', $url );
1268 
1269     /*------------------------------------------------------------------------
1270     INIT BUTTONS
1271     -------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
1272     
1273     if ( substr( $url, -1, 1) === '?' )
1274     {
1275         $sep = '';
1276     }
1277     else
1278     {
1279         $sep = '&amp;';
1280     }
1281 
1282 
1283     switch ($currentViewMode)
1284     {
1285         case 'COURSE_ADMIN' :
1286 
1287             $studentButton = '<a href="' . claro_htmlspecialchars( Url::Contextualize($url . $sep . 'viewMode=STUDENT' ) ) . '">'
1288             .                get_lang('Student')
1289             .                '</a>'
1290             ;
1291             $courseAdminButton = '<b class="userName">' . get_lang('Course manager') . '</b>';
1292 
1293             break;
1294 
1295         case 'STUDENT' :
1296 
1297             $studentButton     = '<b class="userName">'.get_lang('Student').'</b>';
1298             $courseAdminButton = '<a href="'.claro_htmlspecialchars( Url::Contextualize($url . $sep . 'viewMode=COURSE_ADMIN' ) ) . '">'
1299             . get_lang('Course manager')
1300             . '</a>';
1301             break;
1302     }
1303 
1304     /*------------------------------------------------------------------------
1305     DISPLAY COMMANDS MENU
1306     ------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
1307 
1308     return get_lang('View mode') . ' : '
1309     .    $studentButton
1310     .    ' | '
1311     .    $courseAdminButton
1312     ;
1313 }

1317 /**
1318  * return the current mode in tool able to handle different view mode
1319  *
1320  * @return string 'COURSE_ADMIN' or 'STUDENT'
1321  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
1322  */
1323 
1324 function claro_get_tool_view_mode()
1325 {
1326     // check first if a viewMode has been requested
1327     // if one was requested change the current viewMode to the mode asked
1328     // if there was no change requested and there is nothing in session
1329     // concerning view mode set the default viewMode
1330     // if there was something in session and nothing
1331     // in request keep the session value ( == nothing to do)
1332     if( isset($_REQUEST['viewMode']) )
1333     {
1334         claro_set_tool_view_mode($_REQUEST['viewMode']);
1335     }
1336     elseif( ! isset($_SESSION['claro_toolViewMode']) )
1337     {
1338         claro_set_tool_view_mode('COURSE_ADMIN'); // default
1339     }
1340 
1341     return $_SESSION['claro_toolViewMode'];
1342 }
