1444 /**
1445  * Equivalent to mktime but taking the mainTimeShift into account
1446  *
1447  *  Usage :
1448  *      claro_mktime ( [int hour [, int minute [, int second [, int month [
1449  *          , int day [, int year [, int is_dst]]]]]]] )
1450  *
1451  * @see mktime()
1452  * @return timestamp corresponding to the given arguments shifted by
1453  *  mainTimeShift config value
1454  * @author Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
1455  */
1456 function claro_mktime()
1457 {
1458     if ( 0 < func_num_args() )
1459     {
1460         $args = func_get_args();
1461 
1462         return call_user_func_array( 'mktime', $args );
1463     }
1464     else
1465     {
1466         // shift
1467         $mainTimeShift = (int) get_conf('mainTimeShift',0);
1468         return time()+(3600 * $mainTimeShift);
1469     }
1470 }

1501 /**
1502  * get the list  of aivailable languages on the platform
1503  *
1504  * @author Christophe Gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
1505  *
1506  * @return array( langCode => langLabel) with aivailable languages
1507  */
1508 function claro_get_language_list()
1509 {
1510     $langNameOfLang = get_locale('langNameOfLang');
1511     $dirname = get_path('incRepositorySys') . '/../lang/';
1512 
1513     if($dirname[strlen($dirname)-1]!='/')
1514     $dirname .= '/';
1515 
1516     if (!file_exists($dirname)) trigger_error('lang repository not found',E_USER_WARNING);
1517 
1518     $handle = opendir($dirname);
1519 
1520     while ( ($entries = readdir($handle) ) )
1521     {
1522         if ($entries == '.' || $entries == '..' || $entries == 'CVS' || $entries == '.svn')
1523         {
1524             continue;
1525         }
1526         
1527         if (is_dir($dirname . $entries))
1528         {
1529             if (isset($langNameOfLang[$entries]))
1530             {
1531                 $language_list[$entries]['langNameCurrentLang'] = $langNameOfLang[$entries];
1532             }
1533             
1534             $language_list[$entries]['langNameLocaleLang']  = $entries;
1535         }
1536     }
1537     closedir($handle);
1538     return $language_list;
1539 }

1541 /**

1545  * But a course or a group can overide some config values
1546  *
1547  * This function return the repository ignoring if it's  existing or empty
1548  *

1551  */
1552 function claro_get_conf_repository($context=array())
1553 {

1555         return get_path('rootSys') . 'platform/conf/';
1556 
1557     if (array_key_exists(CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE, $context))
1558     {
1559         if (array_key_exists(CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP, $context))
1560         {
1561             return claro_get_course_group_path($context) . '/conf/';
1562         }
1563         return get_path('coursesRepositorySys') . claro_get_course_path($context[CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE]) . '/conf/';
1564 
1565     }
1566 
1567 
1568     pushClaroMessage('Unknown context passed to claro_get_conf_repository : ' . var_export($context,1), 'warning');
1569     return null;
1570 
1571 }

1582 function get_conf($param, $default = null)

1631 /**
1632  * HTTP response splitting security flaw filter
1633  * @author Frederic Minne <zefredz@gmail.com>
1634  * @return string clean string to filter http_response_splitting attack
1635  * @see http://www.saintcorporation.com/cgi-bin/demo_tut.pl?tutorial_name=HTTP_Response_Splitting.html
1636  */
1637 
1638 function http_response_splitting_workaround( $str )
1639 {
1640     $dangerousCharactersPattern = '~(\r\n|\r|\n|%0a|%0d|%0D|%0A)~';
1641     return preg_replace( $dangerousCharactersPattern, '', $str );
1642 }
1643 
1644 /**
1645  * Strip the slashes coming from browser request
1646  *
1647  * If the php.ini setting MAGIC_QUOTE_GPC is set to ON, all the variables
1648  * content comming frome the browser are automatically quoted by adding
1649  * slashes (default setting before PHP 4.3). claro_unquote_gpc() removes
1650  * these slashes. It needs to be called just once at the biginning
1651  * of the script.
1652  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
1653  *
1654  * @return void
1655  */
1656 
1657 function claro_unquote_gpc()
1658 {
1659     if ( ! defined('CL_GPC_UNQUOTED') )
1660     {
1661         if ( get_magic_quotes_gpc() )
1662         {
1663             /*
1664             * The new version is written in a safer approach inspired by Ilia
1665             * Alshanetsky. The previous approach which was using recursive
1666             * function permits to smash the stack and crash PHP. For example if
1667             * the user supplies a very deep multidimensional array, such as
1668             * foo[][][][] ..., the recursion can reach the point of exhausting
1669             * the stack. Generating such an attack is quite trivial, via the
1670             * use of :
1671             *
1672             *    str_repeat() function example $str = str_repeat("[]", 100000);
1673             *    file_get_contents("http://sitre.com.scriptphp?foo={$str}");
1674             */
1675 
1676             $inputList = array(&$_REQUEST, &$_GET, &$_POST, &$_COOKIE);
1677 
1678             while ( list($topKey, $array) = each($inputList) )
1679             {
1680                 foreach( $array as $childKey => $value)
1681                 {
1682                     if ( ! is_array($value) )
1683                     {
1684                         $inputList[$topKey][$childKey] = stripslashes($value);
1685                     }
1686                     else
1687                     {
1688                         $inputList[] =& $inputList[$topKey][$childKey];
1689                     }
1690                 }
1691             }
1692 
1693             define('CL_GPC_UNQUOTED', true);
1694 
1695         } // end if get_magic_quotes_gpc
1696     }
1697 }

1796 /**
1797  * Generate some informations in HTML format over the execution context.\n
1798  * Informations are placed into hidden inputs.
1799  */
1800 function claro_form_relay_context($context=null)
1801 {
1802     $html = '';
1803     if ( is_null($context) )
1804     {
1805         $context = Claro_Context::getCurrentUrlContext();
1806     }
1807     
1808     if ( array_key_exists( 'cid', $context )
1809         && ! array_key_exists( 'cidReq', $context ) )
1810     {
1811         $context['cidReq'] = $context['cid'];
1812         unset( $context['cid'] );
1813     }
1814 
1815     if ( array_key_exists( 'gid', $context )
1816         && ! array_key_exists( 'gidReq', $context ) )
1817     {
1818         $context['gidReq'] = $context['gid'];
1819         unset( $context['gid'] );
1820     }
1821     
1822     foreach ( $context as $key => $value )
1823     {
1824         $html .= '<input type="hidden" name="'.claro_htmlspecialchars(strip_tags($key)).'" value="'.claro_htmlspecialchars(strip_tags($value)).'" />';
1825     }
1826 
1827     return $html;
1828 }

1862 /**

1896         .        '<!-- end of debugBanner -->' . "\n\n"
1897         ;

1899 
1900     return $html;

1903 /**
1904  * Protect $_SERVER[PHP_SELF] against HTTP response splitting and XSS
1905  * @return string
1906  */
1907 function php_self()
1908 {
1909     // remove html tags
1910     $url = strip_tags($_SERVER['PHP_SELF']);
1911     // protect against XSS
1912     $url = preg_replace( '~(\r\n|\r|\n|%0a|%0d|%0D|%0A)~', '', $url );
1913     // entify remaining special chars
1914     $url = claro_htmlspecialchars( strip_tags( $url ) );
1915 
1916     return $url;
1917 }

1919 /**
1920  * Get the URI of the current page : PHP_SELF + QUERY_STRING, protected against
1921  * HTTP Response Splitting and XSS
1922  * @param   boolean $html if set to true (default) the returned URI is passed
1923  *              through claro_htmlspecialchars before being returned
1924  * @return  string
1925  */
1926 function page_uri( $html = true )
1927 {
1928     $uri = Url::Contextualize( php_self() . "?" . strip_tags($_SERVER['QUERY_STRING']) );
1929     
1930     return $html ? claro_htmlspecialchars( $uri ) : $uri;
1931 }

1942 /**
1943  * Is the given tool activated in the given course
1944  * @param string $courseId course code
1945  * @param string $toolId tool id in the course, not the main tool id !
1946  * @return boolean
1947  */
1948 function claro_is_course_tool_activated( $courseId, $toolId )
1949 {
1950     static $activatedCourseToolList = false;
1951 
1952     if ( ! $activatedCourseToolList )
1953     {
1954         $activatedCourseToolList = array();
1955 
1956     $tbl_cdb_names        = claro_sql_get_course_tbl( claro_get_course_db_name_glued($courseId) );
1957     $tbl_course_tool_list = $tbl_cdb_names['tool'];
1958 
1959     /*
1960     * Search all the tool corresponding to this access levels
1961     */
1962 
1963     // find module or claroline existing tools
1964 
1965         $sql = "SELECT ctl.id, ctl.activated\n"
1966             ."FROM `" . $tbl_course_tool_list . "` AS ctl"
1967         ;
1968     
1969         $toolList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sql);
1970     
1971         foreach ( $toolList as $tool )
1972         {
1973             $activatedCourseToolList[$tool['id']] = $tool['activated'];
1974         }
1975     }
1976 
1977     return $activatedCourseToolList[$toolId] == 'true';
1978 }

1980 /**
1981  * Get the main tool_id for a given course tool from its tid in the course
1982  * @param   int $tid id of the tool instance in the course
1983  * @param   string $courseId id (sysCode) of the course (optional, current course used if missing)
1984  * @param   int $profileId profile of the user to get the tool list from (optional, current user used if missing)
1985  * @return  int tool_id, main tool id
1986  */
1987 function claro_get_tool_id_from_course_tid( $tid, $courseId = null, $profileId = null )
1988 {
1989     $courseId = empty( $courseId )
1990         ? claro_get_current_course_id()
1991         : $courseId
1992         ;
1993     
1994     $profileId = empty( $profileId )
1995         ? claro_get_current_user_profile_id_in_course( $courseId )
1996         : $profileId
1997         ;
1998     
1999     $courseToolList = claro_get_course_tool_list( $courseId, $profileId );
2000     
2001     foreach ( $courseToolList as $courseTool )
2002     {
2003         if ( $courseTool['id'] == $tid )
2004         {
2005             return $courseTool['tool_id'];
2006         }
2007     }
2008     
2009     return false;
2010 }

2012 /**
2013  * Get the course tid for a given course tool from its main tool id
2014  * @param   int $tool_id id of the tool instance in the platform
2015  * @param   string $courseId id (sysCode) of the course (optional, current course used if missing)
2016  * @param   int $profileId profile of the user to get the tool list from (optional, current user used if missing)
2017  * @return  int tid, course tool id
2018  */
2019 function claro_get_course_tid_from_tool_id( $tool_id, $courseId = null, $profileId = null )
2020 {
2021     $courseId = empty( $courseId )
2022         ? claro_get_current_course_id()
2023         : $courseId
2024         ;
2025     
2026     $profileId = empty( $profileId )
2027         ? claro_get_current_user_profile_id_in_course( $courseId )
2028         : $profileId
2029         ;
2030     
2031     $courseToolList = claro_get_course_tool_list( $courseId, $profileId );
2032     
2033     foreach ( $courseToolList as $courseTool )
2034     {
2035         if ( $courseTool['tool_id'] == $tool_id )
2036         {
2037             return $courseTool['id'];
2038         }
2039     }
2040     
2041     return false;
2042 }

2092 /**
2093  * Secure a backlink url by replacing it with a platform url, when the given 
2094  * url is not from the platform
2095  * @param string $url
2096  * @return string
2097  */
2098 function secure_backlink_url( $url )
2099 {
2100     // cleanup url of potential html injection
2101     $url = strip_tags($url);
2102     
2103     // if url does not start with urlAppend or rootWeb, we need to "secure" it
2104     if ( !preg_match( "!^".get_path('url')."!", $url ) 
2105         && !preg_match (  "!^".get_path('rootWeb')."!", $url )
2106         && !preg_match ( "!^".  str_replace ( 'http://', 'https://', get_path('rootWeb') )."!", $url )
2107         && !preg_match ( "!^".  str_replace ( 'http://', '', get_path('rootWeb') )."!", $url )
2108     )
2109     {
2110         if ( stristr ( $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'], ':' ) )
2111         {
2112             $http_hostArr = explode(":", $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST']);
2113             $http_host = $http_hostArr[0];
2114         }
2115         else
2116         {
2117             $http_host = $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'];
2118         }
2119         
2120         // if url starts with HTTP_HOST -> OK
2121         if( stristr( $url, $http_host ) )
2122         {
2123             return $url;
2124         }
2125         // else replace with context root url
2126         else
2127         {
2128             if ( isset( $GLOBALS['tlabelReq'] ) )
2129             {
2130                 return Url::Contextualize(get_module_entry_url($GLOBALS['tlabelReq']));
2131             }
2132             elseif ( claro_is_in_a_course () )
2133             {
2134                 return get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb').'course/index.php?cid='.  claro_get_current_course_id ();
2135             }
2136             else
2137             {
2138                 return get_path('url');
2139             }
2140         }
2141     }
2142     // else url is OK -> return it
2143     else
2144     {
2145         return $url;
2146     }
2147 }

  53     /**

  56     public function __construct ($id = null, $name = null, $code = null, $parentId = null, $rank = null, $visible = 1, $canHaveCoursesChild = 1, $rootCourse = null)
  57     {
  58         $this->id                   = $id;
  59         $this->name                 = $name;
  60         $this->code                 = $code;
  61         $this->idParent             = $parentId;
  62         $this->rank                 = $rank;
  63         $this->visible              = $visible;
  64         $this->canHaveCoursesChild  = $canHaveCoursesChild;

  70     /**
  71      * Load category data from database in the current object.
  72      *
  73      * @param int       category identifier
  74      * @return bool     success
  75      */
  76     public function load ($id)
  77     {
  78         $data = claro_get_cat_datas($id);
  79         
  80         if ( !$data )
  81         {
  82             claro_failure::set_failure('category_not_found');
  83             return false;
  84         }
  85         else
  86         {
  87             $this->id                   = $id;
  88             $this->name                 = $data['name'];
  89             $this->code                 = $data['code'];
  90             $this->idParent             = $data['idParent'];
  91             $this->rank                 = $data['rank'];
  92             $this->visible              = $data['visible'];
  93             $this->canHaveCoursesChild  = $data['canHaveCoursesChild'] == '0' ? false : true;
  94             $this->rootCourse           = $data['rootCourse'];
  95             
  96             return true;
  97         }
  98     }

 101     /**
 102      * Insert or update current category data.
 103      *
 104      * @return bool     success
 105      */
 106     public function save ()
 107     {
 108         $canHaveCourseChild = $this->canHaveCoursesChild ? 1 : 0;
 109         
 110         if ( empty($this->id) )
 111         {
 112             // No id: it's a new category -> insert
 113             if( claro_insert_cat_datas($this->name, $this->code, $this->idParent, $this->rank, $this->visible, $canHaveCourseChild, $this->rootCourse) )
 114                 return true;
 115             else
 116             {
 117                 claro_failure::set_failure('category_not_saved');
 118                 return false;
 119             }
 120         }
 121         else
 122         {
 123             // No id: it's a new category -> update
 124             if( claro_update_cat_datas($this->id, $this->name, $this->code, $this->idParent, $this->rank, $this->visible, $canHaveCourseChild, $this->rootCourse) )
 125                 return true;
 126             else
 127             {
 128                 claro_failure::set_failure('category_not_saved');
 129                 return false;
 130             }
 131         }
 132     }

 149     /**
 150      * Get the complete path of a category.
 151      *
 152      * @return string   path.
 153      * @example echo getPath($categoryId, $categoriesList) will show "Category A > Category B > Category C"
 154      */
 155     public static function getPath ( $categoryId, $categoriesList = null, $separator = ' > ' )
 156     {
 157         if ( is_null($categoriesList) )
 158         {
 159             $categoriesList = self::getAllCategories();
 160         }
 161         
 162         if ( !get_conf( 'clcrs_displayShortCategoryPath', false ) )
 163         {
 164             $path   = null;
 165             $findId = $categoryId;
 166 
 167             while ( !is_null($findId) && $findId != 0 )
 168             {
 169                 foreach ( $categoriesList as $category )
 170                 {
 171                     if ( $category['id'] == $findId )
 172                     {
 173                         $path = $category['name'] . ((!is_null($path))?(' ' . $separator . ' ' . $path):(null));
 174                         $findId = $category['idParent'];
 175                         break;
 176                     }
 177                 }
 178             }
 179 
 180             return $path;
 181         }
 182         else
 183         {
 184             $path   = null;
 185             $findId = $categoryId;
 186             
 187             $thisCategoryName = '';
 188 
 189             while ( !is_null($findId) && $findId != 0 )
 190             {
 191                 foreach ( $categoriesList as $category )
 192                 {
 193                     if ( $category['id'] == $categoryId )
 194                     {
 195                         $thisCategoryName = $category['name'];
 196                     }
 197                     
 198                     if ( $category['id'] == $findId )
 199                     {
 200                         $path = $category['code'] . ((!is_null($path))?(' ' . $separator . ' ' . $path):(null));
 201                         $findId = $category['idParent'];
 202                         break;
 203                     }
 204                 }
 205             }
 206             
 207             $path = "({$path}) {$thisCategoryName}";
 208 
 209             return $path;
 210         }
 211     }

 256     /**
 257      * Return a list of categories associated to a list of courses
 258      *
 259      * @param array     list of courses
 260      * @return array    list of categories associated to courses
 261      */
 262     public static function getCoursesCategories ( $courses )
 263     {
 264         // Get table name
 265         $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 266         $tbl_category               = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
 267         $tbl_rel_course_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 268         
 269         if (!empty($courses))
 270         {
 271             // Isolate courses ids
 272             $coursesIds = array();
 273             foreach ($courses as $course)
 274             {
 275                 $coursesIds[] = $course['courseId'];
 276             }
 277             
 278             $coursesIds = implode(', ', $coursesIds);
 279             
 280             $sql = "SELECT rcc.courseId, c.id AS categoryId, c.name, c.code,
 281                     c.rank, c.visible, rcc.rootCourse
 282                     FROM `" . $tbl_category . "` AS c
 283                     
 284                     LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` AS rcc
 285                     ON c.id = rcc.categoryId
 286                     
 287                     WHERE rcc.courseId IN ({$coursesIds})";
 288             
 289             if (get_conf('categories_order_by', 'rank') == 'rank')
 290             {
 291                 $sql .= "
 292                     ORDER BY c.`rank`";
 293             }
 294             elseif  (get_conf('categories_order_by') == 'alpha_asc')
 295             {
 296                 $sql .= "
 297                     ORDER BY c.`name` ASC";
 298             }
 299             else
 300             {
 301                 $sql .= "
 302                     ORDER BY c.`name` DESC";
 303             }
 304             
 305             $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 306             
 307             // Copy the result into an array
 308             $categories = array();
 309             foreach ($result as $category)
 310             {
 311                 $categories[] = $category;
 312             }
 313             
 314             return $categories;
 315         }
 316         else
 317         {
 318             return array();
 319         }
 320         
 321     }

 324     /**
 325      * Return a list of categories associated to a list of courses
 326      *
 327      * @param int user id
 328      * @return array list of categories associated to the user
 329      */
 330     public static function getUserCategoriesFlat ( $userId, $separator = '>' )
 331     {
 332         // Get table name
 333         $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 334         $tbl_course                 = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
 335         $tbl_rel_course_user        = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user'];
 336         $tbl_category               = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
 337         $tbl_rel_course_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 338 
 339         $sql = "SELECT ca.id, 
 340                        ca.name, 
 341                        ca.visible, 
 342                        ca.canHaveCoursesChild,
 343                        ca.idParent
 344 
 345                 FROM `{$tbl_category}` AS ca
 346 
 347                 JOIN `{$tbl_rel_course_category}` AS rcc
 348                 ON ca.id = rcc.categoryId
 349 
 350                 JOIN `{$tbl_course}` AS co
 351                 ON rcc.courseId = co.cours_id
 352 
 353                 JOIN `{$tbl_rel_course_user}` AS rcu
 354                 ON rcu.code_cours = co.code
 355 
 356                 WHERE rcu.user_id = {$userId}
 357 
 358                 GROUP BY ca.id";
 359 
 360         $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 361         $result->setFetchMode(Mysql_ResultSet::FETCH_ASSOC);
 362 
 363         return ClaroCategory::flatCategoryList($result, $separator);
 364     }

 410     /**
 411      * Turn an array of categories into an array of "flat" categories 
 412      * (each array entry contains the whole path to a category).

 416     public static function flatCategoryList($categoryList, $separator)
 417     {

 420         {
 421             $flatList[] = array(
 422                 'id' =>     $category['id'],
 423                 'canHaveCoursesChild' => $category['canHaveCoursesChild'],
 424                 'visible' => $category['visible'],
 425                 'path' =>   self::getPath($category['id'], $categoryList, $separator)

 483      * Check if a user is registered to a category.
 484      *
 485      * @param int       identifier of the user
 486      * @param int       identifier of the category
 487      * @return bool     user is registered to category
 488      */
 489     public static function isRegistredToCategory ($userId, $categoryId)
 490     {
 491         //TODO make it recursive
 492         if (is_null($userId) || is_null($categoryId))
 493         {
 494             claro_failure::set_failure('missing_user_or_category_id');
 495             return false;
 496         }
 497         else
 498         {
 499             // Get table name
 500             $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 501             $tbl_course                 = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
 502             $tbl_rel_course_category    = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_category'];
 503             $tbl_rel_course_user        = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user'];
 504             
 505             $sql = "SELECT rcu.code_cours AS sysCode
 506                     FROM `" . $tbl_rel_course_user . "` AS rcu
 507                     
 508                     LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_course . "` AS co
 509                     ON co.code = rcu.code_cours
 510                     
 511                     LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` AS rcc
 512                     ON rcc.courseId = co.cours_id
 513                     
 514                     WHERE rcu.user_id = " . (int) $userId . "
 515                     AND rcc.categoryId = " . (int) $categoryId . "
 516                     AND rcc.rootCourse = 1";
 517             
 518             $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 519             $sysCode = $result->fetch(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE);

 521             if(!empty($sysCode))
 522             {
 523                 return true;
 524             }
 525             else
 526             {
 527                 return false;
 528             }

 558         $idSwapCategory = claro_get_previous_cat_datas($this->rank, $this->idParent);

 580         $idSwapCategory = claro_get_following_cat_datas($this->rank, $this->idParent);
 581         if (!empty($idSwapCategory))
 582         {

 594     /**
 595      * Exchange ranks between the current category and another one
 596      * and save the modification in database.
 597      *
 598      * @param int       identifier of the other category
 599      */
 600     public function exchangeRanks ($id)
 601     {
 602         // Get the other category
 603         $swapCategory = new claroCategory();
 604         $swapCategory->load($id);
 605         
 606         // Exchange the ranks
 607         $tempRank = $this->rank;
 608         $this->rank = $swapCategory->rank;
 609         $swapCategory->rank = $tempRank;
 610         
 611         // Save the modifications
 612         $this->save();
 613         $swapCategory->save();
 614     }

 619      * exists in database).

 621      * @return bool     result: TRUE if the code is unique, FALSE if it's not
 622      */
 623     public function checkUniqueCode ()
 624     {
 625         if ( claro_count_code($this->id, $this->code) == 0 )
 626             return true;
 627         else
 628             return false;
 629     }

 637      *                  of the current category

 639     public function checkIsChild ($id)

 641          $ids = claro_get_parents_ids($id);

 653     public function handleForm ()
 654     {
 655         if ( isset($_REQUEST['category_id']) )                  $this->id = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['category_id']));
 656         if ( isset($_REQUEST['category_name']) )                $this->name = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['category_name']));
 657         
 658         if ( isset($_REQUEST['category_code']) ) // Only capital letters and numbers
 659         {
 660             $this->code = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['category_code']));
 661             $this->code = preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/', '', $this->code);
 662             $this->code = strtoupper($this->code);

 665         if ( isset($_REQUEST['category_parent']) )              $this->idParent = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['category_parent']));
 666         
 667         if ( isset($_REQUEST['category_rank']) )                $this->rank = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['category_rank']));
 668                
 669         if ( isset($_REQUEST['category_visible']) )             $this->visible = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['category_visible']));
 670         if ( isset($_REQUEST['category_can_have_courses']) )    $this->canHaveCoursesChild = trim(strip_tags($_REQUEST['category_can_have_courses']));

 675     /**
 676      * Validate data from current object.  Error handling with
 677      * a backlog object.
 678      *
 679      * @return bool     success
 680      */
 681     public function validate ()
 682     {
 683         //TODO don't get how this function actually works
 684         
 685         $success = true ;
 686         
 687         // Configuration array, define here which field can be left empty or not
 688         //TODO make it more accurate using function get_conf('human_label_needed');
 689         $fieldRequiredStateList['name']                 = true;
 690         $fieldRequiredStateList['code']                 = true;
 691         $fieldRequiredStateList['idParent']             = true;
 692         $fieldRequiredStateList['rank']                 = false;
 693         $fieldRequiredStateList['visible']              = true;
 694         $fieldRequiredStateList['canHaveCoursesChild']  = true;
 695         
 696         // Validate category name
 697         if ( is_null($this->name) && $fieldRequiredStateList['name'] )
 698         {
 699             claro_failure::set_failure('category_missing_field_name');
 700             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Category name is required'));
 701             $success = false ;
 702         }
 703         
 704         // Validate category code
 705         if ( is_null($this->code) && $fieldRequiredStateList['code'] )
 706         {
 707             claro_failure::set_failure('category_missing_field_code');
 708             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Category code needed'));
 709             $success = false ;
 710         }
 711         
 712         // Check if the code is unique
 713         if ( !$this->checkUniqueCode() )
 714         {
 715             claro_failure::set_failure('category_duplicate_code');
 716                $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('This category already exists'));
 717             $success = false ;
 718         }
 719         
 720         // Validate parent identifier
 721         if ( is_null($this->idParent) && $fieldRequiredStateList['idParent'] )
 722         {
 723             claro_failure::set_failure('category_missing_field_idParent');
 724             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Category parent needed'));
 725             $success = false ;
 726         }
 727         
 728         // Category can't be its own parent
 729         if ( $this->idParent == $this->id )
 730         {
 731             claro_failure::set_failure('category_self_linked');
 732                $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Category can\'t be its own parent'));
 733             $success = false ;
 734         }
 735         
 736         // Category can't be linked to one of its own children
 737         if ( $this->checkIsChild($this->idParent) )
 738         {
 739             claro_failure::set_failure('category_child_linked');
 740                $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Category can\'t be linked to one of its own children'));
 741             $success = false ;
 742         }
 743         
 744         // Check authorisation to possess courses
 745         if ( is_null($this->visible) && $fieldRequiredStateList['visible'] )
 746         {
 747             claro_failure::set_failure('category_missing_field_visible');
 748             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Visibility of the category must be set'));
 749             $success = false;
 750         }
 751         
 752         // Check authorisation to possess courses
 753         if ( is_null($this->canHaveCoursesChild) && $fieldRequiredStateList['canHaveCoursesChild'] )
 754         {
 755             claro_failure::set_failure('category_missing_field_canHaveCoursesChild');
 756             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Category must be authorized or not to have courses children'));
 757             $success = false;
 758         }
 759         
 760         return $success;
 761     }

 770     public function displayForm ($cancelUrl=null)
 771     {
 772         $languageList   = claro_get_lang_flat_list();
 773         $categoriesList = self::getAllCategories();
 774         $coursesList    = isset($this->id) ? (claroCourse::getAllCourses($this->id)) : (array());
 775         
 776         // Generate HTML options list for categories
 777         $categoriesHtmlList = '<option value="0">' . get_lang("None") . '</option>';
 778         $disabled   = false;
 779         $tempLevel  = null;
 780         foreach ( $categoriesList as $elmt )
 781         {
 782             // Enable/disable elements in the drop down list
 783             if ( !empty($elmt['id']) && $elmt['id'] == $this->id )
 784             {
 785                 $disabled = true;
 786                 $tempLevel = $elmt['level'];
 787             }
 788             elseif ( isset($tempLevel) && $elmt['level'] > $tempLevel )
 789             {
 790                 $disabled = true;
 791             }
 792             else
 793             {
 794                 $disabled = false;
 795                 $tempLevel = null;
 796             }
 797             
 798             $categoriesHtmlList .= '<option value="' . $elmt['id'] . '" ' . ( ( !empty($elmt['id']) && $elmt['id'] == $this->idParent ) ? ('selected="selected"') : ('') ) . ( ( $disabled ) ? ('disabled="disabled"') : ('') ) . '>' . str_repeat('&nbsp;', 4*$elmt['level']) . $elmt['name'] . ' (' . $elmt['code'] . ') </option>';
 799         }
 800         
 801         // Generate HTML options list for courses
 802         $coursesHtmlList = '<option value="0">' . get_lang("None") . '</option>';
 803         foreach ( $coursesList as $elmt )
 804         {
 805             // Session courses can't become category courses
 806             if (is_null($elmt['sourceCourseId']))
 807             {
 808                 $coursesHtmlList .= '<option value="' . $elmt['id'] . '" '
 809                                   . ( ( !empty($elmt['id']) && $elmt['id'] == $this->rootCourse ) ? ('selected="selected"') : ('') ) . '>'
 810                                   . $elmt['title'] . ' (' . $elmt['sysCode'] . ')</option>';
 811             }
 812         }
 813         
 814         // TODO use a template
 815         
 816         if ( is_null($cancelUrl) )
 817             $cancelUrl = get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'course/index.php?cid=' . claro_htmlspecialchars($this->id);
 818         
 819         $html = '';
 820         
 821         $html .= '<form method="post" id="categorySettings" action="' . $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] . '" >' . "\n"
 822             . claro_form_relay_context()
 823             . '<input type="hidden" name="cmd" value="' . (empty($this->id)?'exAdd':'exEdit') . '" />' . "\n"
 824             . '<input type="hidden" name="claroFormId" value="' . uniqid('') . '" />' . "\n";
 825         
 826         $html .= '<fieldset>' . "\n"
 827             . '<dl>' . "\n";
 828             
 829         // Category identifier
 830         $html .= '<input type="hidden" name="category_id" value="' . $this->id . '" />' . "\n";
 831         
 832         // Category name
 833         $html .= '<dt>'
 834             . '<label for="category_name">'
 835             . get_lang('Category name')
 836             . (get_conf('human_label_needed') ? '<span class="required">*</span> ':'')
 837             .'</label></dt>'
 838             . '<dd>'
 839             . '<input type="text" name="category_name" id="category_name" value="' . claro_htmlspecialchars($this->name) . '" size="30" maxlength="100" />'
 840             . (empty($this->id) ? '<br /><span class="notice">'.get_lang('e.g. <em>Sciences of Economics</em>').'</span>':'')
 841             . '</dd>' . "\n" ;
 842         
 843         // Category code
 844         $html .= '<dt>'
 845             . '<label for="category_code">'
 846             . get_lang('Category code')
 847             . '<span class="required">*</span> '
 848             . '</label></dt>'
 849             . '<dd><input type="text" id="category_code" name="category_code" value="' . claro_htmlspecialchars($this->code) . '" size="30" maxlength="12" />'
 850             . (empty($this->id) ? '<br /><span class="notice">'.get_lang('max. 12 characters, e.g. <em>ROM2121</em>').'</span>':'')
 851             . '</dd>' . "\n" ;
 852         
 853         // Category's parent
 854         $html .= '<dt>'
 855             . '<label for="category_parent">'
 856             . get_lang('Parent category')
 857             . '</label></dt>'
 858             . '<dd>'
 859             . '<select  id="category_parent" name="category_parent" />'
 860             . $categoriesHtmlList
 861             . '</select>'
 862             . '</dd>' . "\n" ;
 863         
 864         // Category's rank
 865         $html .= '<input type="hidden" name="category_rank" value="' . (empty($this->rank)?0:$this->rank) . '" />'."\n";
 866         
 867         // Category's visibility
 868         $html .= '<dt>'
 869             . get_lang('Category visibility')
 870             . '<span class="required">*</span>'
 871             . '</dt>'
 872             . '<dd>'
 873             . '<input type="radio" id="visible" name="category_visible" value="1" ' . (( $this->visible == 1 || !isset($this->visible) ) ? 'checked="checked"' : null ) . ' />'
 874             . '&nbsp;'
 875             . '<label for="visible">' . get_lang('Visible') . '</label><br />'
 876             . '<input type="radio" id="hidden" name="category_visible" value="0" ' . (( $this->visible == 0 && isset($this->visible) ) ? 'checked="checked"' : null ) . ' />'
 877             . '&nbsp;'

 879             . '</dd>' . "\n" ;
 880         
 881         // Category's right to possess courses

 885             . '</dt>'

 888             . '&nbsp;'

 890             . '<input type="radio" id="cant_have_courses" name="category_can_have_courses" value="0" ' . (( $this->canHaveCoursesChild == 0 && isset($this->canHaveCoursesChild) ) ? 'checked="checked"':'' ) . ' />'
 891             . '&nbsp;'

 893             . '<span class="notice">'.get_lang('Authorize the category to possess courses or not (opened or closed category)').'</span>'
 894             . '</dd>' . "\n" ;

 896         // Category's dedicated course/board

 906             . '</dd>' . "\n" ;
 907

 910             . '<span class="required">*</span>&nbsp;'.get_lang('Denotes required fields') . '<br />' . "\n"
 911             . '<input type="submit" value="' . get_lang('Ok') . '" />' . "\n"
 912             . claro_html_button($_SERVER['PHP_SELF'], get_lang('Cancel'))
 913             . '</form>' . "\n";
 914         
 915         return $html;
 916     }

  25  *     {

  27  *        return $bar;
  28  *     }
  29  * }

  54  */

  65 /**
  66  * Replace str_ireplace()
  67  *
  68  * @category    PHP
  69  * @package     PHP_Compat
  70  * @link        http://php.net/function.str_ireplace
  71  * @author      Aidan Lister <aidan@php.net>
  72  * @version     $Revision: 14318 $
  73  * @since       PHP 5
  74  * @require     PHP 4.0.0 (user_error)
  75  * @note        count not by returned by reference, to enable
  76  *              change '$count = null' to '&$count'
  77  */
  78 if (!function_exists('str_ireplace')) {
  79     function str_ireplace($search, $replace, $subject, $count = null)
  80     {
  81         // Sanity check
  82         if (is_string($search) && is_array($replace)) {
  83             user_error('Array to string conversion', E_USER_NOTICE);
  84             $replace = (string) $replace;
  85         }
  86 
  87         // If search isn't an array, make it one
  88         if (!is_array($search)) {
  89             $search = array ($search);
  90         }
  91         $search = array_values($search);
  92 
  93         // If replace isn't an array, make it one, and pad it to the length of search
  94         if (!is_array($replace)) {
  95             $replace_string = $replace;
  96 
  97             $replace = array ();
  98             for ($i = 0, $c = count($search); $i < $c; $i++) {
  99                 $replace[$i] = $replace_string;
 100             }
 101         }
 102         $replace = array_values($replace);
 103 
 104         // Check the replace array is padded to the correct length
 105         $length_replace = count($replace);
 106         $length_search = count($search);
 107         if ($length_replace < $length_search) {
 108             for ($i = $length_replace; $i < $length_search; $i++) {
 109                 $replace[$i] = '';
 110             }
 111         }
 112 
 113         // If subject is not an array, make it one
 114         $was_array = false;
 115         if (!is_array($subject)) {
 116             $was_array = true;
 117             $subject = array ($subject);
 118         }
 119 
 120         // Loop through each subject
 121         $count = 0;
 122         foreach ($subject as $subject_key => $subject_value) {
 123             // Loop through each search
 124             foreach ($search as $search_key => $search_value) {
 125                 // Split the array into segments, in between each part is our search
 126                 $segments = explode(strtolower($search_value), strtolower($subject_value));
 127 
 128                 // The number of replacements done is the number of segments minus the first
 129                 $count += count($segments) - 1;
 130                 $pos = 0;
 131 
 132                 // Loop through each segment
 133                 foreach ($segments as $segment_key => $segment_value) {
 134                     // Replace the lowercase segments with the upper case versions
 135                     $segments[$segment_key] = substr($subject_value, $pos, strlen($segment_value));
 136                     // Increase the position relative to the initial string
 137                     $pos += strlen($segment_value) + strlen($search_value);
 138                 }
 139 
 140                 // Put our original string back together
 141                 $subject_value = implode($replace[$search_key], $segments);
 142             }
 143 
 144             $result[$subject_key] = $subject_value;
 145         }
 146 
 147         // Check if subject was initially a string and return it as a string
 148         if ($was_array === true) {
 149             return $result[0];
 150         }
 151 
 152         // Otherwise, just return the array
 153         return $result;
 154     }
 155 }

 157 /**
 158  * define file_put_contents()
 159  *
 160  * @category    PHP
 161  * @package     PHP_Compat
 162  * @link        http://php.net/function.file-put-contents.php
 163  * @since       CLAROLINE 1.8
 164  * @require     PHP 4.0.0 (user_error)
 165  * @note
 166  */
 167 
 168 if ( ! function_exists( 'file_put_contents' ) )
 169 {
 170     if ( !defined( 'FILE_APPEND' ) )
 171     {
 172         define( 'FILE_APPEND', 8 );
 173     }
 174 
 175     function file_put_contents( $file, $content, $flags = null )
 176     {
 177         if ( is_array( $content ) )
 178         {
 179             $content = implode( '', $content );
 180         }
 181 
 182         if ( !is_scalar( $content ) )
 183         {
 184             trigger_error( 'file_put_contents() The 2nd parameter should be'
 185             . ' either a string or an array',
 186             E_USER_WARNING );
 187             return false;
 188         }
 189 
 190         if ( FILE_APPEND === $flags )
 191         {
 192             $fd = fopen( $file, 'a' );
 193         }
 194         else
 195         {
 196             $fd = fopen( $file, 'wb' );
 197         }
 198 
 199         if ( false === $fd )
 200         {
 201             return false;
 202         }
 203         else
 204         {
 205             $nb_bytes = fwrite( $fd, $content );
 206             fclose( $fd );
 207             return $nb_bytes;
 208         }
 209     }
 210 }

 212 /**
 213  * define array_intersect_key() of PHP 5
 214  *
 215  * @category    PHP
 216  * @package     PHP_Compat
 217  * @link        http://php.net/function.file-put-contents.php
 218  * @since       CLAROLINE 1.8.1
 219  * @require     PHP 4.0.0 (user_error)
 220  * @note
 221  */
 222 
 223 
 224 if(!function_exists('array_intersect_key'))
 225 {
 226     function array_intersect_key($array1,$array2)
 227     {
 228         $array3=array();
 229         foreach (array_keys($array2) as $keyToKeep)
 230         {
 231             if (array_key_exists($keyToKeep,$array1))
 232             $array3[$keyToKeep] = $array1[$keyToKeep];
 233         }
 234         return $array3;
 235     }
 236 }

 239 /**
 240  * Replace scandir()
 241  *
 242  * @category    PHP
 243  * @package     PHP_Compat
 244  * @link        http://php.net/function.scandir
 245  * @author      Aidan Lister <aidan@php.net>
 246  * @version     $Revision: 14318 $
 247  * @since       PHP 5
 248  * @require     PHP 4.0.0 (user_error)
 249  */
 250 function php_compat_scandir($directory, $sorting_order = 0)
 251 {
 252     if (!is_string($directory)) {
 253         user_error('scandir() expects parameter 1 to be string, ' .
 254             gettype($directory) . ' given', E_USER_WARNING);
 255         return;
 256     }
 257 
 258     if (!is_int($sorting_order) && !is_bool($sorting_order)) {
 259         user_error('scandir() expects parameter 2 to be long, ' .
 260             gettype($sorting_order) . ' given', E_USER_WARNING);
 261         return;
 262     }
 263 
 264     if (!is_dir($directory) || (false === $fh = @opendir($directory))) {
 265         user_error('scandir() failed to open dir: Invalid argument', E_USER_WARNING);
 266         return false;
 267     }
 268 
 269     $files = array ();
 270     while (false !== ($filename = readdir($fh))) {
 271         $files[] = $filename;
 272     }
 273 
 274     closedir($fh);
 275 
 276     if ($sorting_order == 1) {
 277         rsort($files);
 278     } else {
 279         sort($files);
 280     }
 281 
 282     return $files;
 283 
 284 }
 285 
 286 
 287 // Define
 288 if (!function_exists('scandir')) {
 289     function scandir($directory, $sorting_order = 0)
 290     {
 291         return php_compat_scandir($directory, $sorting_order = 0);
 292     }
 293 }

 299     {
 300         return strtr( $text,
 301             array_flip(
 302                 get_html_translation_table( HTML_SPECIALCHARS ) ) );
 303     }

   3 /**
   4  * Fix the issues with the change of default encoding in claro_htmlspecialchars 
   5  * and htmlentities functions
   6  * 
   7  * The drawback is that this will probably degrade the performance of the 
   8  * platform a bit by adding some indirection for PHP native functions
   9  */
  10 
  11 // define constants added to PHP in PHP 5.2.7 if missing
  12 if (!defined('PHP_VERSION_ID')) 
  13 {
  14     $version = explode('.',PHP_VERSION);
  15 
  16     define('PHP_VERSION_ID', ($version[0] * 10000 + $version[1] * 100 + $version[2]));
  17     define('PHP_MAJOR_VERSION',   $version[0]);
  18     define('PHP_MINOR_VERSION',   $version[1]);
  19     define('PHP_RELEASE_VERSION', $version[2]);
  20 }
  21 
  22 // PHP 5.4 fix
  23 if ( PHP_MAJOR_VERSION > 5 ||  ( PHP_MAJOR_VERSION == 5 && PHP_MINOR_VERSION >= 4 ) )
  24 {
  25     define ( 'DEFAULT_COMPAT', ENT_COMPAT | ENT_HTML401 );
  26     define ( 'DEFAULT_ENCODING', 'iso-8859-1' );
  27     
  28     function claro_htmlspecialchars( 
  29         $string, 
  30         $flags = DEFAULT_COMPAT, 
  31         $encoding = DEFAULT_ENCODING )
  32     {
  33         return htmlspecialchars( $string, $flags, $encoding );
  34     }
  35     
  36     function claro_htmlentities( 
  37         $string, 
  38         $flags = DEFAULT_COMPAT, 
  39         $encoding = DEFAULT_ENCODING )
  40     {
  41         return htmlentities( $string, $flags, $encoding );
  42     }
  43     
  44     function claro_html_entity_decode (
  45         $string, 
  46         $flags = DEFAULT_COMPAT, 
  47         $encoding = DEFAULT_ENCODING )
  48     {
  49         return html_entity_decode( $string, $flags, $encoding );
  50     }
  51 }
  52 // PHP 5.3 allows passing func_get_args() as argument
  53 elseif ( PHP_MAJOR_VERSION == 5 && PHP_MINOR_VERSION == 3 )
  54 {
  55     function claro_htmlspecialchars()
  56     {
  57         return call_user_func_array('htmlspecialchars', func_get_args());
  58     }
  59      
  60     function claro_htmlentities()
  61     {
  62         return call_user_func_array('htmlentities', func_get_args());
  63     }
  64     
  65     function claro_html_entity_decode()
  66     {
  67         return call_user_func_array('html_entity_decode', func_get_args());
  68     }
  69 }
  70 // Other versions
  71 else
  72 {
  73     function claro_htmlspecialchars()
  74     {
  75         $args = func_get_args();
  76         return call_user_func_array('htmlspecialchars', $args);
  77     }
  78      
  79     function claro_htmlentities()
  80     {
  81         $args = func_get_args();
  82         return call_user_func_array('htmlentities', $args);
  83     }
  84     
  85     function claro_html_entity_decode()
  86     {
  87         $args = func_get_args();
  88         return call_user_func_array('html_entity_decode', $args);
  89     }
  90 }

   2 
   3 /**
   4  * User administration connector
   5  * @since Claroline 1.11.6
   6  */
   7 interface Module_AdminUser
   8 {
   9     /**
  10      * Delete user tracking data in course
  11      * @param int $userId
  12      * @param string $courseCode
  13      */
  14     public function deleteUserCourseTrackingData( $userId, $courseCode );
  15     
  16     /**
  17      * Delete resources posted by user in course
  18      * @param int $userId
  19      * @param string $courseCode
  20      */
  21     public function deleteUserCourseResources( $userId, $courseCode );
  22     
  23     /**
  24      * Delete tracking data in course for the list of users
  25      * @param int $userIdList list of user ids
  26      * @param string $courseCode
  27      */
  28     public function deleteUserListCourseTrackingData( $userIdList, $courseCode );
  29     
  30     /**
  31      * Delete resources posted in course by the users in the list
  32      * @param int $userIdList list of user ids
  33      * @param string $courseCode
  34      */
  35     public function deleteUserListCourseResources( $userIdList, $courseCode );
  36 }
  37 
  38 /**
  39  * Abstract generic User administration connector
  40  * @since Claroline 1.11.6
  41  */
  42 abstract class GenericModule_AdminUser implements Module_AdminUser
  43 {
  44     private $database;
  45     
  46     public function __construct ( $database )
  47     {
  48         $this->database = $database ? $database : Claroline::getDatabase ();
  49     }
  50     
  51     /**
  52      * Return the list of tracking tables
  53      * @param string $courseCode
  54      * @return array ( table_name => user_id_field_name
  55      */
  56     abstract public function getCourseTrackingTables( $courseCode );
  57     
  58     /**
  59      * Return the list of resource tables
  60      * @param string $courseCode
  61      * @return array ( table_name => user_id_field_name
  62      */
  63     abstract public function getCourseResourceTables( $courseCode );
  64     
  65     public function deleteUserListCourseTrackingData ( $userIdList, $courseCode )
  66     {
  67         foreach ( $this->getCourseTrackingTables( $courseCode ) as $tableName => $userIdColumn )
  68         {
  69             $this->database->exec("DELETE FROM `{$tableName}` WHERE {$userIdColumn} IN (".implode( ',', $userIdList ).")");
  70         }
  71     }
  72     
  73     public function deleteUserListCourseResources ( $userIdList, $courseCode )
  74     {
  75         foreach ( $this->getCourseResourceTables( $courseCode ) as $tableName => $userIdColumn )
  76         {
  77             $this->database->exec("DELETE FROM `{$tableName}` WHERE {$userIdColumn} IN (".implode( ',', $userIdList ).")");
  78         }
  79     }
  80     
  81     public function deleteUserCourseTrackingData ( $userId, $courseCode )
  82     {
  83         return $this->deleteUserListCourseTrackingData ( array( (int) $userId ), $courseCode );
  84     }
  85     
  86     public function deleteUserCourseResources ( $userId, $courseCode )
  87     {
  88         return $this->deleteUserListCourseResources ( array( (int) $userId ), $courseCode );
  89     }
  90 }

   5 /**
   6  * CLAROLINE
   7  *
   8  * Singleton class to represent the Claroline platform. This is a utility
   9  * class providing classes and methods to deal with the kernel and the page
  10  * display.
  11  *
  12  * @version     $Revision: 14182 $
  13  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  14  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  15  * @author      Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  16  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  17  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  18  * @package     kernel.core
  19  */
  20 
  21 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../core/debug.lib.php';
  22 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../core/console.lib.php';
  23 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../core/event.lib.php';
  24 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../core/log.lib.php';
  25 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../core/url.lib.php';
  26 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../core/notify.lib.php';
  27 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../display/display.lib.php';
  28 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../database/database.lib.php';
  29 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../utils/ajax.lib.php';
  30 
  31 /**
  32  * Main Claroline class containing references to Claroline kernel objects
  33  * This class is a Singleton
  34  */
  35 class Claroline
  36 {
  37     // Display type constants
  38     const PAGE      = 'CL_PAGE';
  39     const FRAMESET  = 'CL_FRAMESET';
  40     const POPUP     = 'CL_POPUP';
  41     const FRAME     = 'CL_FRAME';
  42     
  43     // Kernel objects
  44     /**
  45      * @var EventManager
  46      */
  47     public $eventManager;
  48     /**
  49      * @var ClaroNotification
  50      */
  51     public $notification;
  52     /**
  53      * @var ClaroNotifier
  54      */
  55     public $notifier;
  56     // Display object
  57     public $display;
  58     /**
  59      * @var Logger
  60      */
  61     public $logger;
  62     
  63     protected $moduleLabelStack;
  64     
  65     // this class is a singleton, use static method getInstance()
  66     private function __construct()
  67     {
  68         try
  69         {
  70             // initialize the event manager and notification classes
  71             $this->eventManager = EventManager::getInstance();
  72             $this->notification = ClaroNotification::getInstance();
  73             $this->notifier = ClaroNotifier::getInstance();
  74             
  75             // initialize logger
  76             $this->logger = new Logger();
  77             
  78             $this->moduleLabelStack = array();
  79             
  80             if ( isset($GLOBALS['tlabelReq']) )
  81             {
  82                 $this->pushModuleLabel($GLOBALS['tlabelReq']);
  83                 
  84                 pushClaroMessage("Set current module to {$GLOBALS['tlabelReq']}", 'debug');
  85             }
  86         }
  87         catch ( Exception $e )
  88         {
  89             die( $e );
  90         }
  91     }
  92 
  93     /**
  94      * Add a label at the top of the module stack
  95      * @param string $label
  96      */
  97     public function pushModuleLabel( $label )
  98     {
  99         array_push( $this->moduleLabelStack, $label );
 100     }
 101 
 102     /**
 103      * Remove the modulke label at the top of the module stack
 104      */
 105     public function popModuleLabel()
 106     {
 107         array_pop( $this->moduleLabelStack );
 108     }
 109 
 110     /**
 111      * Get the label of the current module
 112      * @return string or false
 113      */
 114     public function currentModuleLabel()
 115     {
 116         if ( empty( $this->moduleLabelStack ) )
 117         {
 118             return false;
 119         }
 120         else
 121         {
 122            return $this->moduleLabelStack[count($this->moduleLabelStack)-1];
 123         }
 124     }
 125     
 126     /**
 127      * Set the type of display to use
 128      * @param   string type, display type could be
 129      *  Claroline::PAGE         a standard page with header, banner, body and footer
 130      *  Claroline::FRAMESET     a frameset with header and frames
 131      *  Claroline::POPUP        a popup-embedded page
 132      *  Claroline::FRAME        a frame-embedded page
 133      *  default value : Claroline::PAGE
 134      */
 135     public function setDisplayType( $type = self::PAGE )
 136     {
 137         switch ( $type )
 138         {
 139             case self::PAGE:
 140                 $this->display = new ClaroPage;
 141                 break;
 142             case self::POPUP:
 143                 $this->display = new ClaroPage;
 144                 $this->display->popupMode();
 145                 break;
 146             case self::FRAME:
 147                 $this->display = new ClaroPage;
 148                 $this->display->frameMode();
 149                 break;
 150             case self::FRAMESET:
 151                 $this->display = new ClaroFramesetPage;
 152                 break;
 153             default:
 154                 throw new Exception( 'Invalid display type' );
 155         }
 156     }
 157     
 158     // Singleton instance
 159     private static $instance = false; // this class is a singleton
 160     
 161     /**
 162      * Returns the singleton instance of the Claroline object
 163      * @return  Claroline singleton instance
 164      */
 165     public static function getInstance()
 166     {
 167         if ( ! self::$instance )
 168         {
 169             self::$instance = new self;
 170         }
 171 
 172         return self::$instance;
 173     }
 174 
 175     /**
 176      * Get the current display object
 177      * @return Display which can be a ClaroPage or ClaroFramesetPage according
 178      *  to the display type
 179      */
 180     public static function getDisplay()
 181     {
 182         return self::getInstance()->display;
 183     }
 184 
 185     /**
 186      * Helper to initialize the display
 187      * @param string $displayType
 188      */
 189     public static function initDisplay( $displayType = self::PAGE )
 190     {
 191         self::getInstance()->setDisplayType( $displayType );
 192     }
 193 
 194     /**
 195      * Helper to log a message
 196      * @param string $type
 197      * @param string $data
 198      */
 199     public static function log( $type, $data )
 200     {
 201         self::getInstance()->logger->log($type, $data);
 202     }
 203     
 204     protected static $db = false;
 205     // Database link
 206     protected static $database = false;
 207 
 208     /**
 209      * Get the current database connection object
 210      * @return Claroline_Database_Connection
 211      */
 212     public static function getDatabase()
 213     {
 214         if ( ! self::$database )
 215         {
 216             // self::initMainDatabase();
 217             self::$database = new Claroline_Database_Connection();//self::$db);
 218             self::$database->connect();
 219             
 220             // the following options are for campus where only one language is used
 221             // or multiple languages but with compatible charsets (for example 
 222             // english (latin1) and portuguese (latin2). @see mysql documentation 
 223             // for allowed charsets
 224             
 225             $charset = get_conf( 'mysqlSetNames' );
 226             
 227             if ( !empty( $charset ) )
 228             {
 229                 self::$database->setCharset($charset);
 230             }
 231         }
 232         
 233         return self::$database;
 234     }
 235 
 236     /**
 237      * Initialize the database for claro_sql_* legacy code
 238      * @return void
 239      * @throws Exception when the database connection cannot be created
 240      * @deprecated since 1.10
 241      */
 242     public static function initMainDatabase()
 243     {
 244         if ( !self::$db )
 245         {
 246             self::$db = self::getDatabase()->getDbLink();
 247         }
 248         
 249         if ($GLOBALS['statsDbName'] == '')
 250         {
 251             $GLOBALS['statsDbName'] = get_conf('mainDbName');
 252         }
 253     }
 254 
 255     protected static $_ajaxServiceBroker = false;
 256 
 257     /**
 258      * Get kernel Ajax Service Broker instance
 259      * @return Ajax_Remote_Service_Broker
 260      * @since Claroline 1.9.5
 261      */
 262     public static function ajaxServiceBroker()
 263     {
 264         if ( ! self::$_ajaxServiceBroker )
 265         {
 266             self::$_ajaxServiceBroker = new Ajax_Remote_Service_Broker();
 267         }
 268 
 269         return self::$_ajaxServiceBroker;
 270     }
 271 }

   5 /**
   6  * Console and debug bar. Display a log message to the console and send it to
   7  * the Claroline log table.
   8  *
   9  * @version     Claroline 1.11 Revision: 12923 $
  10  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2012, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  11  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  12  * @author      Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>

  15  * @package     kernel.core
  16  */
  17 
  18 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/debug.lib.php';
  19 
  20 class Console
  21 {
  22     const
  23         MESSAGE = 'message',
  24         DEBUG = 'debug',
  25         WARNING = 'warning',
  26         INFO = 'info',
  27         SUCCESS = 'success',
  28         ERROR = 'error';
  29     
  30     const
  31         REPORT_LEVEL_ERROR = 1,
  32         REPORT_LEVEL_WARNING = 2,
  33         REPORT_LEVEL_INFO = 3,
  34         REPORT_LEVEL_SUCCESS = 4,
  35         REPORT_LEVEL_ALL = 5;
  36     
  37     public static function message( $message )
  38     {
  39         pushClaroMessage( $message, self::MESSAGE );
  40         Claroline::log( self::MESSAGE, $message );
  41     }
  42 
  43     public static function debug( $message )
  44     {
  45         if ( claro_debug_mode() )
  46         {
  47             pushClaroMessage( $message, self::DEBUG );
  48             Claroline::log( self::DEBUG, $message );
  49         }
  50     }
  51     
  52     public static function warning( $message )
  53     {
  54         if ( claro_debug_mode() ) pushClaroMessage( $message, self::WARNING );    
  55         if ( get_conf( 'log_report_level', self::REPORT_LEVEL_ALL ) >= self::REPORT_LEVEL_WARNING ) Claroline::log( self::WARNING, $message );
  56     }
  57 
  58     public static function info( $message )
  59     {
  60         if ( claro_debug_mode() ) pushClaroMessage( $message, self::INFO );
  61         if ( get_conf( 'log_report_level', self::REPORT_LEVEL_ALL ) >= self::REPORT_LEVEL_INFO ) Claroline::log( self::INFO, $message );
  62     }
  63 
  64     public static function success( $message )
  65     {
  66         if ( claro_debug_mode() ) pushClaroMessage( $message, self::SUCCESS );
  67         if ( get_conf( 'log_report_level', self::REPORT_LEVEL_ALL ) >= self::REPORT_LEVEL_SUCCESS ) Claroline::log( self::SUCCESS, $message );
  68     }
  69 
  70     public static function error( $message )
  71     {
  72         // claro_failure::set_failure( $message );
  73         if ( claro_debug_mode() ) pushClaroMessage( $message, self::ERROR );
  74         if ( get_conf( 'log_report_level', self::REPORT_LEVEL_ALL ) >= self::REPORT_LEVEL_ERROR ) Claroline::log( self::ERROR, $message );
  75     }
  76     
  77     public static function log( $message, $type )
  78     {
  79         if ( claro_debug_mode() ) pushClaroMessage( $message, $type );
  80         Claroline::log( $type, $message );
  81     }
  82 }

   5 /**
   6  * CLAROLINE
   7  *
   8  * Context handling library.
   9  *
  10  * @version     $Revision: 13302 $
  11  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  12  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  13  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  14  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  15  * @package     kernel.core
  16  * @since       1.9
  17  */
  18 
  19 defined('CLARO_CONTEXT_PLATFORM')
  20     || define('CLARO_CONTEXT_PLATFORM',     'platform');
  21 
  22 defined('CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE')
  23     || define('CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE',       'course');
  24 
  25 defined('CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP')
  26     || define('CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP',        'group');
  27 
  28 defined('CLARO_CONTEXT_USER')
  29     || define('CLARO_CONTEXT_USER',         'user');
  30 
  31 defined('CLARO_CONTEXT_TOOLINSTANCE')
  32     || define('CLARO_CONTEXT_TOOLINSTANCE', 'toolInstance');
  33 
  34 defined('CLARO_CONTEXT_TOOLLABEL')
  35     || define('CLARO_CONTEXT_TOOLLABEL',    'toolLabel');
  36 
  37 defined('CLARO_CONTEXT_MODULE')
  38     || define('CLARO_CONTEXT_MODULE',       'moduleLabel');
  39 
  40 /**
  41  * Claroline Execution Context
  42  */
  43 class Claro_Context
  44 {
  45     /**
  46      * Get the current execution context
  47      * @return array
  48      */
  49     public static function getCurrentContext()
  50     {
  51         $context = array();
  52         
  53         if (claro_is_in_a_course())
  54         {
  55             $context[CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE] = claro_get_current_course_id();
  56         }
  57 
  58         if (claro_is_in_a_group())
  59         {
  60             $context[CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP] = claro_get_current_group_id();
  61         }
  62         
  63         if ( claro_is_in_a_tool() )
  64         {
  65             if ( isset($GLOBALS['tlabelReq']) && $GLOBALS['tlabelReq'] )
  66             {
  67                 $context[CLARO_CONTEXT_TOOLLABEL] = $GLOBALS['tlabelReq'];
  68             }
  69             
  70             if ( claro_get_current_tool_id() )
  71             {
  72                 $context[CLARO_CONTEXT_TOOLINSTANCE] = claro_get_current_tool_id();
  73             }
  74         }
  75         
  76         if ( get_current_module_label() )
  77         {
  78             $context[CLARO_CONTEXT_MODULE] = get_current_module_label();
  79         }
  80         
  81         return $context;
  82     }
  83     
  84     /**
  85      * Get the current context array formated for use in urls
  86      * @return array
  87      */
  88     public static function getCurrentUrlContext()
  89     {
  90         $givenContext = self::getCurrentContext();
  91         
  92         return self::getUrlContext( $givenContext );
  93     }
  94 
  95     /**
  96      * Get the given context array formated for use in urls
  97      * @param array $givenContext
  98      * @return array
  99      */
 100     public static function getUrlContext( $givenContext )
 101     {
 102         $context = array();
 103         
 104         if ( ( claro_is_in_a_group() && !isset($givenContext[CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP]) )
 105             || isset($givenContext[CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP]) )
 106         {
 107             $context['gidReset'] = 'true';
 108         }
 109         
 110         if ( ( claro_is_in_a_course() && !isset($givenContext[CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE]) )
 111             || isset($givenContext[CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE]))
 112         {
 113             $context['cidReset'] = 'true';
 114         }
 115         
 116         if ( isset($givenContext[CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE]) )
 117         {
 118             $context['cidReq'] = $givenContext[CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE];
 119         }
 120         
 121         if ( isset($givenContext[CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP]) )
 122         {
 123             $context['gidReq'] = $givenContext[CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP];
 124         }
 125         
 126         if( isset( $_REQUEST['inPopup'] ) )
 127         {
 128             $context['inPopup'] = $_REQUEST['inPopup'];
 129         }
 130         
 131         if( isset( $_REQUEST['inFrame'] ) )
 132         {
 133             $context['inFrame'] = $_REQUEST['inFrame'];
 134         }
 135         
 136         if( isset( $_REQUEST['embedded'] ) )
 137         {
 138             $context['embedded'] = $_REQUEST['embedded'];
 139         }
 140         
 141         if( isset( $_REQUEST['hide_banner'] ) )
 142         {
 143             $context['hide_banner'] = $_REQUEST['hide_banner'];
 144         }
 145         
 146         if( isset( $_REQUEST['hide_footer'] ) )
 147         {
 148             $context['hide_footer'] = $_REQUEST['hide_footer'];
 149         }
 150         
 151         if( isset( $_REQUEST['hide_body'] ) )
 152         {
 153             $context['hide_body'] = $_REQUEST['hide_body'];
 154         }
 155         
 156         if ( $moduleLabel = claro_called_from() )
 157         {
 158             $context['calledFrom'] = $moduleLabel;
 159         }
 160         
 161         return $context;
 162     }
 163 }

  19 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../utils/iterators.lib.php';

  21 /**
  22  * Protect file path against arbitrary file inclusion
  23  * @param   string path, untrusted path
  24  * @return  string secured path
  25  */
  26 function protect_against_file_inclusion( $path )
  27 {
  28     while ( false !== strpos( $path, '://' )
  29         || false !== strpos( $path, '..' ) )
  30     {
  31         // protect against remote file inclusion
  32         $path = str_replace( '://', '', $path );
  33         // protect against arbitrary file inclusion
  34         $path = str_replace( '..', '.', $path );
  35     }
  36         
  37     return $path;
  38 }
  39 
  40 /**
  41  * Kernel library loader
  42  */
  43 class FromKernel
  44 {
  45     /**
  46      * Load a list of kernel libraries
  47      * Usage : FromKernel::uses( list of libraries );
  48      * @params  list of libraries
  49      * @throws  Exception if a library is not found
  50      */
  51     public static function uses()
  52     {
  53         $args = func_get_args();
  54         
  55         defined('INCLUDES') || define ( 'INCLUDES', dirname(__FILE__) . '/..');
  56         
  57         foreach ( $args as $lib )
  58         {
  59             if ( substr($lib, -4) !== '.php' )
  60             {
  61                 $lib .= '.php';
  62             }
  63             
  64             $lib = protect_against_file_inclusion( $lib );
  65             
  66             $kernelPath = INCLUDES . '/' . $lib;
  67             
  68             if ( file_exists( $kernelPath ) )
  69             {
  70                 require_once $kernelPath;
  71             }
  72             else
  73             {
  74                 throw new Exception( "Lib not found $lib" );
  75             }
  76         }
  77     }
  78 }
  79 
  80 /**
  81  * Module library loader
  82  */
  83 class From
  84 {
  85     protected $moduleLabel;
  86     
  87     protected function __construct( $moduleLabel )
  88     {
  89         $this->moduleLabel = $moduleLabel;
  90     }
  91     
  92     /**
  93      * Load a list of libraries from a given module
  94      * Usage : From::module(ModuleLable)->uses( list of libraries );
  95      * @params  list of libraries
  96      * @return  array of not found libraries
  97      */
  98     public function uses()
  99     {
 100         $args = func_get_args();
 101         $notFound = array();
 102         
 103         foreach ( $args as $lib )
 104         {
 105             if ( basename( $lib ) == '*' )
 106             {
 107                 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../utils/finder.lib.php';
 108                 
 109                 $localPath = get_module_path( $this->moduleLabel ) . '/lib/' . dirname( $lib );
 110                 
 111                 if ( file_exists( $localPath )
 112                     && is_dir( $localPath )
 113                     && is_readable( $localPath )
 114                 )
 115                 {
 116                     $path = $localPath;
 117                 }
 118                 else
 119                 {
 120                     if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 121                     {
 122                         throw new Exception( "Cannot load libraries from {$dir} at {$localPath}" );
 123                     }
 124                     
 125                     $notFound[] = $lib;
 126                     
 127                     continue;
 128                 }
 129                 
 130                 $finder = new Claro_FileFinder_Extension( $path, '.php', false );
 131                 
 132                 foreach ( $finder as $file )
 133                 {
 134                     require_once $file->getPathname();
 135                 }
 136             }
 137             else
 138             {
 139                 if ( substr($lib, -4) !== '.php' ) $lib .= '.php';
 140                 
 141                 $lib = protect_against_file_inclusion( $lib );
 142                 
 143                 $libPath = get_module_path( $this->moduleLabel ) . '/lib/' . $lib;
 144                 
 145                 if ( file_exists( $libPath ) )
 146                 {
 147                     require_once $libPath;
 148                 }
 149                 else
 150                 {
 151                     if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 152                     {
 153                         throw new Exception( "Cannot load library {$libPath}" );
 154                     }
 155                     
 156                     $notFound[] = $lib;
 157                     
 158                     continue;
 159                 }
 160             }
 161         }
 162     }
 163     
 164     /**
 165      * Load a list of plugins from a given module
 166      * Usage : From::module(ModuleLable)->loadPlugins( list of connectors );
 167      * @since Claroline 1.9.6
 168      * @params  list of plugins
 169      * @return  array of not found plugins
 170      */
 171     public function loadPlugins()
 172     {
 173         $args = func_get_args();
 174         $notFound = array();
 175         
 176         foreach ( $args as $cnr )
 177         {
 178             if ( substr($cnr, -4) !== '.php' && substr( $cnr, -4 ) === '.lib' )
 179             {
 180                 $cnr .= '.php';
 181             }
 182             elseif ( substr($cnr, -8) !== '.lib.php' )
 183             {
 184                 $cnr .= '.lib.php';
 185             }
 186             
 187             $cnr = protect_against_file_inclusion( $cnr );
 188             
 189             $cnrPath = get_module_path( $this->moduleLabel ) . '/plugins/' . $cnr;
 190             
 191             if ( file_exists( $cnrPath ) )
 192             {
 193                 require_once $cnrPath;
 194             }
 195             else
 196             {
 197                 if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 198                 {
 199                     throw new Exception( "Cannot load plugin {$cnrPath}" );
 200                 }
 201                 
 202                 $notFound[] = $cnr;
 203                 
 204                 continue;
 205             }
 206             
 207         }
 208         
 209         return $notFound;
 210     }
 211     
 212     private static $cache = array();
 213     
 214     /**
 215      * Get the loader for a given module
 216      * @param   string $moduleLabel
 217      * @return  Loader instance
 218      */
 219     public static function module( $moduleLabel = null )
 220     {
 221         if ( empty($moduleLabel) )
 222         {
 223             $moduleLabel = get_current_module_label();
 224         }
 225         
 226         if ( !array_key_exists( $moduleLabel, self::$cache ) )
 227         {
 228             self::$cache[$moduleLabel] = new self($moduleLabel);
 229         }
 230         
 231         return self::$cache[$moduleLabel];
 232     }
 233 }

  24 class Profiler
  25 {
  26     const PROFILER_STATUS_STARTED = 'started';
  27     const PROFILER_STATUS_NOT_STARTED = 'not_started';
  28     const PROFILER_STATUS_STOPPED = 'stopped';
  29     
  30     private $startTime;
  31     private $status;
  32     private $endTime;
  33     private $log;
  34 
  35     public function __construct()
  36     {
  37         $this->log = array();
  38         $this->status = self::PROFILER_STATUS_NOT_STARTED;
  39     }
  40 
  41     public function start( $restart = false )
  42     {
  43         if ( $this->status == self::PROFILER_STATUS_STARTED
  44             && ! $restart )
  45         {
  46             return;
  47         }
  48         
  49         $this->startTime = $this->_getCurrentTime();
  50         $this->status = self::PROFILER_STATUS_STARTED;
  51         
  52         Console::log(sprintf("&gt;&gt; Profiler (re)started at %f", $this->startTime), 'profile');
  53     }
  54 
  55     public function restart()
  56     {
  57         $this->start( true );
  58     }
  59 
  60     public function stop()
  61     {
  62         if ( $this->status != self::PROFILER_STATUS_STARTED )
  63         {
  64             $this->restart();
  65         }
  66 
  67         $this->endTime = $this->_getCurrentTime();
  68         $this->status = self::PROFILER_STATUS_STOPPED;
  69         
  70         Console::log(sprintf("&gt;&gt; Profiler stoped at %f", $this->endTime), 'profile');
  71         Console::log(
  72             sprintf("** Elapsed time : %f seconds **", $this->getElapsedTime())
  73             , 'profile');
  74     }
  75 
  76     public function mark( $file, $line, $msg = '##MARK##' )
  77     {
  78         if ( $this->status != self::PROFILER_STATUS_STARTED )
  79         {
  80             $this->restart();
  81         }
  82 
  83         $now = $this->_getCurrentTime();
  84 
  85         $elapsed = $now - $this->startTime;
  86         $elapsed = sprintf( '%f seconds', $elapsed );
  87         $timestamp = sprintf( '[@%f]', $now );
  88 
  89         $mark = "$timestamp $msg <br />in $file at line $line after $elapsed";
  90 
  91         $this->log[] = $mark;
  92         Console::log($mark, 'profile');
  93     }
  94 
  95     public function getElapsedTime()
  96     {
  97         return $this->endTime - $this->startTime;
  98     }
  99 
 100     private function _getCurrentTime()
 101     {
 102         list($usec, $sec) = explode(" ", microtime());
 103         return ((float)$usec + (float)$sec);
 104     }
 105 }
