  19 /**
  20  * Event used within event manager architecture
  21  * @access public
  22  */
  23 class Event
  24 {
  25     // event type
  26     private $_type;
  27     // additionnal arguments needed by event listeners
  28     private $_args;
  29 
  30     /**
  31      * constructor
  32      * @access public
  33      * @param $type string event type
  34      * @param $args array extra parameters
  35      */
  36     public function __construct( $type, $args = null )
  37     {
  38         $this->_type = $type;
  39         $this->_args = $args;
  40     }
  41 
  42     /**
  43      * get event type
  44      * @access public
  45      * @return string event type
  46      */
  47     public function getEventType( )
  48     {
  49         return $this->_type;
  50     }
  51 
  52     /**
  53      * get extra parameters
  54      * @access public
  55      * @return array event extra parameters
  56      */
  57     public function getArgs( )
  58     {
  59         return $this->_args;
  60     }
  61     
  62     public function send()
  63     {
  64         EventManager::notify( $this );

  68 /**
  69  * Class to manage events and dispatch them to event listeners
  70  * @access public
  71  */
  72 class EventManager
  73 {
  74     // private fields
  75     private $_registry = array();
  76     
  77     private static $instance = false;
  78 
  79     /**
  80      * Constructor
  81      * @access public
  82      */
  83     private function __construct()
  84     {
  85     }
  86 
  87     /**
  88      * register new event listener for a given event
  89      * @access public
  90      * @param string eventType event type
  91      * @param EventListener listener reference to the event listener
  92      * @return string event listener ID
  93      */
  94     public function register( $eventType, &$listener )
  95     {
  96         if ( ! isset( $this->_registry[$eventType] ) )
  97         {
  98             $this->_registry[$eventType] = array( );
  99         }
 100 
 101         $id = md5( serialize( $listener ) );
 102         $this->_registry[$eventType][$id] =& $listener;
 103 
 104         return $id;
 105     }
 106 
 107     /**
 108      * unregister event listener
 109      * @access public
 110      * @param string eventype type of event watching by the listener
 111      * @param string id listener ID
 112      * @return bool
 113      */
 114     public function unregister( $eventType, $id )
 115     {
 116         if ( array_key_exists( $eventType, $this->_registry )
 117             && array_key_exists( $id, $this->_registry[$eventType] ) )
 118         {
 119             unset( $this->_registry[$eventType][$id] );
 120 
 121             if ( is_array( $this->_registry[$eventType] )
 122                 && count( $this->_registry[$eventType] ) == 0 )
 123             {
 124                 unset( $this->_registry[$eventType] );
 125             }
 126 
 127             return true;
 128         }
 129         else
 130         {
 131             return false;
 132         }
 133     }
 134 
 135     /**
 136      * notify occurence of an event to the event manager
 137      * @access package private
 138      * @param string event type of occured event
 139      * @return int number of listeners notified or boolean false
 140      */
 141     public function eventOccurs( $event )
 142     {
 143         if ( isset( $this->_registry[$event->getEventType()] )
 144             && is_array( $this->_registry[$event->getEventType( )] )
 145             && count( $this->_registry[$event->getEventType( )] ) != 0 )
 146         {
 147             $cnt = 0;
 148 
 149             foreach( $this->_registry[$event->getEventType( )] as $listener )
 150             {
 151                 if ( !is_null( $listener ) )
 152                 {
 153                     $listener->handle( $event );
 154                     $cnt++;
 155                 }
 156             }
 157 
 158             return $cnt;
 159         }
 160         else
 161         {
 162             $errmsg = __CLASS__ . " : No listener found for EVENT["
 163                 . $event->getEventType( ) . "]"
 164                 ;
 165                 
 166             Console::debug( $errmsg );
 167 
 168             return false;
 169         }
 170     }
 171 
 172     // static
 173 
 174     /**
 175      * get event manager singleton instance
 176      * @access public
 177      * @return EventManager instance
 178      * @static
 179      */
 180     public static function getInstance()
 181     {
 182         if  ( ! EventManager::$instance )
 183         {
 184             EventManager::$instance = new EventManager;
 185         }
 186         
 187         return EventManager::$instance;
 188     }
 189 
 190     /**
 191      * notify occurence of an event to the event manager. Usage :
 192      *  - EventManager::notify( $event );
 193      *  - EventManager::notify( $eventType, $args );
 194      * @access  public
 195      * @param   string event type of occured event, or event object
 196      * @param   array args optional event arguments (only if event type given
 197      *      as first argument)
 198      * @static
 199      */
 200     public static function notify( $event, $args = null )
 201     {
 202         if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 203         {
 204             Console::debug( __Class__."::notify ".$event->getEventType() );
 205         }
 206         
 207         if ( is_string ( $event ) )
 208         {
 209             // $event is an event type
 210             $event = new Event( $event, $args );
 211         }
 212         
 213         $mngr = EventManager::getInstance();
 214         return $mngr->eventOccurs($event);
 215     }
 216 
 217     /**
 218      * register new event listener for a given event
 219      * @access public
 220      * @static
 221      * @param string eventType event type
 222      * @param EventListener listener reference to the event listener
 223      * @return string event listener ID
 224      */
 225     public static function addListener( $eventType, &$listener )
 226     {
 227         $mngr = EventManager::getInstance();
 228         return $mngr->register($eventType, $listener);
 229     }
 230 
 231     /**
 232      * unregister event listener
 233      * @access public
 234      * @static
 235      * @param string eventype type of event watching by the listener
 236      * @param string id listener ID
 237      * @return boolean
 238      */
 239     public static function removeListener( $eventType, $id )
 240     {
 241         $mngr = EventManager::getInstance();
 242         return $mngr->unregister($eventType, $id);
 243     }
 244 
 245     // debugging methods
 246 
 247     /**
 248      * list all registered events and the number of listeners for each
 249      * @access public
 250      */
 251     public function listRegisteredEvents( )
 252     {
 253         $out = '';
 254         
 255         if ( is_array( $this->_registry )
 256             && count( $this->_registry ) != 0 )
 257         {
 258             foreach ( $this->_registry as $eventType => $listeners )
 259             {
 260                 $out .=  "$eventType( " . count( $listeners ) . " )\n";
 261             }
 262         }
 263         else
 264         {
 265             $out .= "none\n";
 266         }
 267         
 268         return $out;
 269     }
 270 
 271     /**
 272      * list all registered listeners and their ID
 273      * @access public
 274      */
 275     public function listRegisteredListeners( )
 276     {
 277         $out = '';
 278         
 279         if ( is_array( $this->_registry )
 280             && count( $this->_registry ) != 0 )
 281         {
 282             foreach ( $this->_registry as $eventType => $listeners )
 283             {
 284                 $out .= "$eventType( " . count( $listeners ) . " )\n";
 285 
 286                 foreach ( $listeners as $id => $listener )
 287                 {
 288                     $out .= "\tID: $id\n";
 289                 }
 290             }
 291         }
 292         else
 293         {
 294             $out .= "none\n";
 295         }
 296         
 297         return $out;
 298     }
 299 }
 300 
 301 /**
 302  * listen to a particular event
 303  * @access public
 304  */
 305 class EventListener
 306 {
 307     private $_callback;
 308 
 309     /**
 310      * constructor
 311      * @access public
 312      * @param callback to call when the observed event occurs
 313      */
 314     public function __construct( $callback )
 315     {
 316         $this->_callback = $callback;
 317     }
 318 
 319     /**
 320      * notification of event occurence
 321      * @access package private
 322      * @param Event event the event to handle
 323      */
 324     public function handle( $event )
 325     {
 326         try
 327         {
 328             if ( is_callable( $this->_callback ) )
 329             {
 330                 call_user_func( $this->_callback, $event );
 331             }
 332             else
 333             {
 334                 Console::Error( 'Callback failed for event '
 335                     . $event->getEventType( ) . ' : not callable' );
 336             }
 337         }
 338         catch( Exception $e )
 339         {
 340             Console::Error( '[Exception] in callback for event '
 341                 . $event->getEventType( ) . ' : '
 342                 // . var_export( $this->_callback, true )
 343                 . ' : ' . $e );
 344         }
 345     }
 346 }

 348 /**
 349  * generic event driven application
 350  * @access public
 351  * @abstract
 352  */
 353 class EventDriven
 354 {
 355     /**
 356      * add an event listener to the event driven application
 357      * @access public
 358      * @param string methodName callback method, must be a method of the
 359      *   current event-driven instance
 360      * @param string eventType event type
 361      * @return string eventlistener ID
 362      */
 363     public function addListener( $eventType, $methodName )
 364     {
 365         $listener = new EventListener( array( &$this, $methodName ) );
 366         return EventManager::addListener( $eventType, $listener );
 367     }
 368 
 369     /**
 370      * remove an event listener from the application
 371      * @access public
 372      * @param string eventType event type
 373      * @param string eventlistener ID
 374      * @return boolean
 375      */
 376     public function removeListener( $eventType, $id )
 377     {
 378         return EventManager::removeListener( $eventType, $id );
 379     }
 380 }

 382 /**
 383  * Generic event generator for test purpose
 384  * @access public
 385  */
 386 class EventGenerator
 387 {
 388     /**
 389      * notify the event manager for an event occurence
 390      * @access public
 391      * @param Event event the event that occurs; an instance of the event class
 392      */
 393     public function sendEvent( $event )
 394     {
 395         EventManager::notify( $event );
 396     }
 397 
 398     /**
 399      * public function to notify manager that an event occured,
 400      * using this fucntion instead of sendEvent allow to let the class create
 401      * the Event instance for you
 402      *
 403      * @param string eventType the type of the event
 404      * @param array args an array containing any parameters needed
 405      *   to describe the event occurence
 406      */
 407 
 408     public function notifyEvent( $eventType, $args )
 409     {
 410         $event = new Event( $eventType, $args );
 411         $this->sendEvent( $event );
 412     }
 413 }

  40     return $attribList;
  41 }
  42  
  43 /**
  44  * Create an html link to the given url with the given text and attributes
  45  * @param   string text
  46  * @param   string url
  47  * @param   array attributes (optional)
  48  * @return  string
  49  */
  50 function link_to ( $text, $url, $attributes = null )
  51 {
  52     $url = htmlspecialchars_decode( $url );
  53     
  54     $link = '<a href="'
  55         . claro_htmlspecialchars( $url ) . '"'
  56         . make_attribute_list( $attributes )
  57         . '>' . claro_htmlspecialchars( $text ) . '</a>'
  58         ;
  59         
  60     return $link;
  61 }
  62 
  63 /**
  64  * Create an html link to the given url inside claroline with the given
  65  * text and attributes
  66  * @param   string text
  67  * @param   string url inside claroline
  68  * @param   array context (cid, gid)
  69  * @param   array attributes (optional)
  70  * @return  string
  71  */
  72 function link_to_claro ( $text, $url = null, $context = null, $attributes = null )
  73 {
  74     if ( empty ( $url ) )
  75     {
  76         $url = get_path( 'url' ) . '/index.php';
  77     }
  78     
  79     $urlObj = new Url( $url );
  80     
  81     if ( $context )
  82     {
  83         $urlObj->relayContext($context);
  84     }
  85     else
  86     {
  87         $urlObj->relayCurrentContext();
  88     }
  89     
  90     $url = $urlObj->toUrl();
  91     
  92     return link_to ( $text, $url, $attributes );
  93 }
  94 
  95 /**
  96  * Create an html link to the given course or course tool
  97  * text and attributes
  98  * @param   string text
  99  * @param   string courseId
 100  * @param   array attributes (optional)
 101  * @return  string
 102  */
 103 function link_to_course ( $text, $courseId, $attributes = null )
 104 {
 105     $url = get_path('url') . '/claroline/course/index.php?cid='.$courseId;
 106     $urlObj = new Url( $url );
 107     
 108     $url = $urlObj->toUrl();
 109     
 110     return link_to ( $text, $url, $attributes );
 111 }

 155

 175 /**

 177  * @param   string $textzone name of the textzone
 178  * @param   string $defaultContent content displayed if textzone cannot be found or doesn't exist
 179  */
 180 function include_textzone( $textzone, $defaultContent = null )
 181 {
 182     $textzone = secure_file_path( $textzone );
 183     // find correct path where the file is
 184     // FIXME : move ALL textzones to the same location !
 185     if( file_exists( get_path('rootSys') . './platform/textzone/'.$textzone) )
 186     {
 187         $textzonePath = get_path('rootSys') . './platform/textzone/'.$textzone;
 188     }
 189     elseif( file_exists( get_path('rootSys') . './'.$textzone) )
 190     {
 191         $textzonePath = get_path('rootSys') . './'.$textzone;
 192     }
 193     else
 194     {
 195         $textzonePath = null;
 196     }
 197     
 198     // textzone content
 199     if ( !is_null( $textzonePath ) )
 200     {
 201         include $textzonePath;
 202     }
 203     else
 204     {
 205         if( !is_null( $defaultContent) )
 206         {
 207             echo $defaultContent;
 208         }
 209         
 210         if( claro_is_platform_admin() )
 211         {
 212             // help tip for administrator
 213             echo '<p>'
 214             .    get_lang('blockTextZoneHelp', array('%textZoneFile' => $textzone))
 215             .    '</p>';

 219     // edit link
 220     if( claro_is_platform_admin() )
 221     {
 222         echo '<p>' . "\n"
 223         .    '<a href="'.get_path('rootAdminWeb').'managing/editFile.php?cmd=rqEdit&amp;file='.$textzone.'">' . "\n"
 224         .    '<img src="'.get_icon_url('edit').'" alt="" />' . get_lang('Edit text zone') . "\n"
 225         .    '</a>' . "\n"
 226         .    '</p>' . "\n";

 261 /**
 262  * @param int $gid 
 263  * @param string $courseId 
 264  * @param boolean $active if set to true, only actvated tool will be considered for display
 265  */
 266 function get_group_tool_menu( $gid = null, $courseId = null, $active = true )
 267 {
 268     $toolList = array();
 269     
 270     if ( is_null( $gid ) )
 271     {
 272         $gid = claro_get_current_group_id();
 273     }
 274     
 275     if ( is_null( $courseId ) )
 276     {
 277         $courseId = claro_get_current_course_id();
 278     }
 279     
 280     require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../group.lib.inc.php';
 281     
 282     $groupToolList = get_group_tool_list( $courseId, $active );
 283 
 284     // group space links
 285 
 286     /* $toolList[] =
 287     claro_html_cmd_link(
 288         claro_htmlspecialchars(Url::Contextualize( get_module_url('CLGRP').'/group_space.php' ))
 289         , '<img src="' . get_icon_url('group') . '" alt="" />&nbsp;'
 290         . get_lang('Group area')
 291     ); */
 292 
 293     $courseGroupData= claro_get_main_group_properties( $courseId );
 294 
 295     foreach ( $groupToolList as $groupTool )
 296     {
 297         if ( is_tool_activated_in_groups( $courseId, $groupTool['label'] )
 298             && ( isset( $courseGroupData['tools'][$groupTool['label']] )
 299                 && $courseGroupData['tools'][$groupTool['label']]
 300             )
 301         )
 302         {
 303             $toolList[] = claro_html_cmd_link(
 304                 claro_htmlspecialchars(Url::Contextualize(
 305                     get_module_url($groupTool['label'])
 306                     . '/' . $groupTool['url'] ))
 307                 , '<img src="' . get_module_url($groupTool['label']) . '/' . ($groupTool['icon']) . '" alt="" />'
 308                     . '&nbsp;'
 309                     . claro_get_tool_name ($groupTool['label'])
 310                 , array('class' => $groupTool['visibility'] ? 'visible':'invisible')
 311             );
 312         }
 313     }
 314     
 315     if ( count( $toolList ) )
 316     {
 317         return claro_html_menu_horizontal( $toolList );
 318     }
 319     else
 320     {
 321         return '';
 322     }
 323 }

  19 /**
  20  * Javascript loader singleton class
  21  */
  22 class JavascriptLoader
  23 {
  24     private static $instance = false;
  25 
  26     private $libraries, $pathList;
  27 
  28     private function __construct()
  29     {
  30         $this->libraries = array();
  31         $this->pathList = array();
  32     }
  33 
  34     public function getLibraries()
  35     {
  36         return $this->libraries;
  37     }
  38 
  39     public function loadedLibraries()
  40     {
  41         return array_keys( $this->libraries );
  42     }
  43 
  44     /**
  45      * Load a javascript source file
  46      * @param   string lib javascript lib url relative to one of the
  47      *  declared javascript paths
  48      * @return  boolean true if the library was found, false else
  49      */
  50     public function load( $lib )
  51     {
  52         $this->pathList = array(
  53             get_module_path( get_current_module_label() ) . '/js' => get_module_url( get_current_module_label() ) . '/js',
  54             get_path( 'rootSys' ) . 'web/js' => get_path('url') . '/web/js',
  55             './js' => './js'
  56         );
  57         
  58         $lib = secure_file_path( $lib );
  59         
  60         foreach ( $this->pathList as $tryPath => $tryUrl )
  61         {
  62             if ( claro_debug_mode() )
  63             {
  64                 pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::Try to find {$lib} in {$tryPath}", 'debug');
  65             }
  66             
  67             
  68             if ( file_exists ( $tryPath . '/' . $lib . '.js' ) )
  69             {
  70                 if ( array_key_exists( $tryPath . '/' . $lib . '.js', $this->libraries ) )
  71                 {
  72                     return false;
  73                 }
  74                 
  75                 $mtime = '';
  76                 /*
  77                 if ( get_conf('javascriptCompression', true)
  78                     && file_exists( $tryPath . '/min/' . $lib . '.js' )  )
  79                 {
  80                     $this->libraries[$tryPath . '/' . $lib . '.js'] = $tryUrl . '/min/' . $lib . '.js';
  81                     
  82                     $mtime = filemtime($tryPath . '/min/' . $lib . '.js');
  83                     
  84                     if ( claro_debug_mode() )
  85                     {
  86                         pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::Use ".$tryPath.'/min/' .$lib.'.js', 'debug');
  87                     }
  88                 }
  89                 else
  90                 {
  91                     $this->libraries[$tryPath . '/' . $lib . '.js'] = $tryUrl . '/' . $lib . '.js';
  92                     
  93                     $mtime = filemtime($tryPath . '/' . $lib . '.js');
  94                     
  95                     if ( claro_debug_mode() )
  96                     {
  97                         pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::Use ".$tryPath.'/' .$lib.'.js', 'debug');
  98                     }
  99                 }*/
 100 
 101                     $this->libraries[$tryPath . '/' . $lib . '.js'] = $tryUrl . '/' . $lib . '.js';
 102 
 103                     $mtime = filemtime($tryPath . '/' . $lib . '.js');
 104                 
 105                 ClaroHeader::getInstance()->addHtmlHeader(
 106                     '<script src="'.$this->libraries[$tryPath . '/' . $lib . '.js'].'?'.$mtime.'" type="text/javascript"></script>'
 107                 );
 108                 
 109                 return true;
 110             }
 111         }
 112 
 113         if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 114         {
 115             pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::NotFound ".$lib.'.js', 'error');
 116         }
 117 
 118         return false;
 119     }
 120     
 121     public function loadFromModule( $moduleLabel, $lib )
 122     {
 123         $lib = secure_file_path( $lib );
 124         
 125         if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 126         {
 127             pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::Try to find {$lib} in {$moduleLabel}", 'debug');
 128         }
 129         
 130         $path = get_module_path( $moduleLabel ) . '/js/' . $lib . '.js';
 131         $url = get_module_url( $moduleLabel ) . '/js/' . $lib . '.js';
 132         
 133         if ( file_exists( $path ) )
 134         {
 135             if ( array_key_exists( $path, $this->libraries ) )
 136             {
 137                 return false;
 138             }
 139             
 140             $this->libraries[$path] = $url;
 141             
 142             if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 143             {
 144                 pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::Use {$path}::{$url}", 'debug');
 145             }
 146             
 147             ClaroHeader::getInstance()->addHtmlHeader(
 148                 '<script src="'.$url.'?'.filemtime($path).'" type="text/javascript"></script>'
 149             );
 150             
 151             return true;
 152         }
 153         else
 154         {
 155             if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 156             {
 157                 pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::Cannot found {$lib} in {$moduleLabel}", 'error');
 158             }
 159             
 160             return false;
 161         }
 162     }
 163 
 164     public static function getInstance()
 165     {
 166         if ( ! JavascriptLoader::$instance )
 167         {
 168             JavascriptLoader::$instance = new JavascriptLoader;
 169         }
 170 
 171         return JavascriptLoader::$instance;
 172     }
 173 }

 175 class CssLoader
 176 {
 177     private static $instance = false;
 178 
 179     private $css, $pathList;
 180 
 181     private function __construct()
 182     {
 183         $this->css = array();
 184         $this->pathList = array();
 185     }
 186 
 187     public function getCss()
 188     {
 189         return $this->css;
 190     }
 191 
 192     public function loadedCss()
 193     {
 194         return array_keys( $this->css );
 195     }
 196 
 197     /**
 198      * Load a css file
 199      * @param   string lib css file url relative to one of the
 200      *  declared css paths
 201      * @return  boolean true if the library was found, false if not
 202      */
 203     public function load( $css, $media = 'all' )
 204     {
 205         $this->pathList = array(
 206             get_path('rootSys') . 'platform/css/' . get_current_module_label()
 207                 => get_path('url') . '/platform/css/' . get_current_module_label(),
 208             get_module_path( get_current_module_label() ) . '/css'
 209                 => get_module_url( get_current_module_label() ) . '/css',
 210             get_path('rootSys') . 'platform/css'
 211                 => get_path('url') . '/platform/css', // <-- is this useful or not ?
 212             get_path( 'rootSys' ) . 'web/css'
 213                 => get_path('url') . '/web/css',
 214             /* get_path( 'rootSys' ) . 'claroline/css'
 215                 => get_path('url') . '/claroline/css', */ // <-- this stay there for legacy but should be removed.
 216             './css' => './css'
 217         );
 218         
 219         $css = secure_file_path( $css );
 220 
 221         foreach ( $this->pathList as $tryPath => $tryUrl )
 222         {
 223             if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 224             {
 225                 pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::Try ".$tryPath.'/'.$css.'.css', 'debug');
 226             }
 227 
 228             if ( file_exists ( $tryPath . '/' . $css . '.css' ) )
 229             {
 230                 if ( array_key_exists( $tryPath . '/' . $css . '.css', $this->css ) )
 231                 {
 232                     return false;
 233                 }
 234                 
 235                 if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 236                 {
 237                     pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::Use ".$tryPath.'/'.$css.'.css', 'debug');
 238                 }
 239 
 240                 $this->css[$tryPath . '/' . $css . '.css'] = array(
 241                     'url' => $tryUrl . '/' . $css . '.css' . '?' . filemtime($tryPath . '/' . $css . '.css'),
 242                     'media' => $media
 243                 );
 244                 
 245                 ClaroHeader::getInstance()->addHtmlHeader(
 246                     '<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css"'
 247                     . ' href="'. $this->css[$tryPath . '/' . $css . '.css']['url'].'"'
 248                     . ' media="'.$this->css[$tryPath . '/' . $css . '.css']['media'].'" />'
 249                 );
 250 
 251                 return true;
 252                 // break;
 253             }
 254         }
 255 
 256         if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 257         {
 258             pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::NotFound ".$css.'.css', 'error');
 259         }
 260 
 261         return false;
 262     }
 263     
 264     public function loadFromModule( $moduleLabel, $lib, $media = 'all' )
 265     {
 266         $lib = secure_file_path( $lib );
 267         $moduleLabel = secure_file_path( $moduleLabel );

 283                 'url' => get_path('url') . '/platform/css/' . $moduleLabel . '/' . $lib . '.css',

 289         );
 290         
 291         /*$path = get_module_path( $moduleLabel ) . '/css/' . $lib . '.css';
 292         $url = get_module_url( $moduleLabel ) . '/css/' . $lib . '.css';*/
 293 
 294         foreach ( $cssPath as $cssTry )

 296             $path = $cssTry['path'];
 297             $url = $cssTry['url'];
 298 
 299             if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 300             {
 301                 pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::Try {$path}::{$url} for {$moduleLabel}", 'debug');
 302             }
 303 
 304             if ( file_exists( $path ) )

 306                 if ( array_key_exists( $path, $this->css ) )

 308                     return false;
 309                 }
 310 
 311                 $this->css[$path] = array(

 314                 );
 315 
 316                 if ( claro_debug_mode() )

 318                     pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::Use {$path}::{$url} for {$moduleLabel}", 'debug');

 320 
 321                 ClaroHeader::getInstance()->addHtmlHeader(

 323                     . ' href="'. $url.'"'
 324                     . ' media="'.$media.'" />'
 325                 );
 326 
 327                 return true;
 328             }
 329             else
 330             {
 331                 if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 332                 {
 333                     pushClaroMessage(__Class__."::Cannot found css {$lib} for {$moduleLabel}", 'error');
 334                 }
 335 
 336                 return false;
 337             }
 338         }

   5 /**
   6  * CLAROLINE
   7  *
   8  * Logging class.
   9  *
  10  * @version     Claroline 1.11 $Revision: 14183 $
  11  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2012, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  12  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  13  * @author      Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  14  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  15  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  16  * @package     kernel.core
  17  */
  18 
  19 class Logger
  20 {
  21     private $tbl_log;
  22     
  23     public function __construct()
  24     {
  25         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  26         $this->tbl_log  = $tbl_mdb_names['log'];
  27     }
  28     
  29     /**
  30      * Add a message to the log. The message will be associated with the current
  31      * course_code, user_id, tool_id, date and IP address of the client
  32      * @param string $type
  33      * @param string $data
  34      * @return boolean 
  35      */
  36     public function log( $type, $data )
  37     {
  38         $cid        = claro_get_current_course_id();
  39         $tid        = claro_get_current_tool_id();
  40         $uid        = claro_get_current_user_id();
  41         $date       = claro_date("Y-m-d H:i:s");
  42 
  43         $ip         = !empty( $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR']) ? $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] : null;
  44 
  45         $data = serialize( $data );
  46 
  47         $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $this->tbl_log . "`
  48                 SET `course_code` = " . ( is_null($cid) ? "NULL" : "'" . claro_sql_escape($cid) . "'" ) . ",
  49                     `tool_id` = ". ( is_null($tid) ? "NULL" : "'" . claro_sql_escape($tid) . "'" ) . ",
  50                     `user_id` = ". ( is_null($uid) ? "NULL" : "'" . claro_sql_escape($uid) . "'" ) . ",
  51                     `ip` = ". ( is_null($ip) ? "NULL" : "'" . claro_sql_escape($ip) . "'" ) . ",
  52                     `date` = '" . $date . "',
  53                     `type` = '" . claro_sql_escape($type) . "',
  54                     `data` = '" . claro_sql_escape($data) . "'";
  55 
  56         return claro_sql_query($sql);
  57     }
  58 }

  68     public function notifyCourseEvent($eventType, $cid, $tid, $rid, $gid, $uid)
  69     {
  70         $eventArgs = array();
  71         $eventArgs['cid'] = $cid;
  72         $eventArgs['tid'] = $tid;
  73         $eventArgs['rid'] = $rid;
  74         $eventArgs['gid'] = $gid;
  75         $eventArgs['uid'] = $uid;
  76         $eventArgs['date'] = date("Y-m-d H:i:00");
  77 
  78         $this->notifyEvent($eventType, $eventArgs);
  79     }
  80 
  81     public function event( $type, $args = null)
  82     {
  83         if( !is_array($args) )
  84         {
  85             $args = array();
  86         }
  87 
  88         if ( !array_key_exists( 'cid', $args ) && claro_is_in_a_course() )
  89         {
  90             $args['cid'] = claro_get_current_course_id();
  91         }
  92 
  93         if ( !array_key_exists( 'gid', $args ) &&  claro_is_in_a_group() )
  94         {
  95             $args['gid'] = claro_get_current_group_id();
  96         }
  97 
  98         if ( !array_key_exists( 'tid', $args ) && claro_is_in_a_tool() )
  99         {
 100             $args['tid'] = claro_get_current_tool_id();
 101             // $args['tlabel'] = get_current_module_label();
 102         }
 103 
 104         if ( !array_key_exists( 'uid', $args ) && claro_is_user_authenticated() )
 105         {
 106             $args['uid'] = claro_get_current_user_id();
 107         }
 108 
 109         if ( ! array_key_exists( 'date', $args ) )
 110         {
 111             $args['date'] = claro_date("Y-m-d H:i:00");
 112         }
 113 
 114         $this->notifyEvent( $type, $args );
 115     }
 116 }

 141     /**
 142      * Add an event generated in a course to the tracking system
 143      * @param Event $event
 144      * @return boolean 
 145      */
 146     public function trackInCourse( $event )
 147     {
 148         $event_args = $event->getArgs();
 149 
 150         $tid        = array_key_exists('tid', $event_args) ? $event_args['tid'] : null;
 151         $gid        = array_key_exists('gid', $event_args) ? $event_args['gid'] : null;
 152         $uid        = array_key_exists('uid', $event_args) ? $event_args['uid'] : null;
 153         $date         = array_key_exists('date', $event_args )  ? $event_args['date']: claro_date("Y-m-d H:i:s");
 154 
 155         if( array_key_exists('data', $event_args) )
 156         {
 157             $data = serialize( $event_args['data'] );
 158         }
 159         else
 160         {
 161             $data = '';
 162         }
 163 
 164         $eventType  = $event->getEventType();
 165 
 166         if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 167         {
 168             Console::message( 'Data added in course tracking '
 169                     . $eventType . ' : '
 170                     . var_export( $event, true ) );
 171         }
 172 
 173         if( claro_is_in_a_course() )
 174         {
 175             $tbl_cdb_names = claro_sql_get_course_tbl( claro_get_course_db_name_glued(claro_get_current_course_id()) );
 176             $tbl_tracking_event  = $tbl_cdb_names['tracking_event'];
 177 
 178             $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $tbl_tracking_event . "`
 179                     SET `tool_id` = ". ( is_null($tid) ? "NULL" : "'" . claro_sql_escape($tid) . "'" ). ",
 180                         `group_id` = ". ( is_null($gid) ? "NULL" : "'" . claro_sql_escape($gid) . "'" ). ",
 181                         `user_id` = ". ( is_null($uid) ? "NULL" : "'" . claro_sql_escape($uid) . "'" ). ",
 182                         `date` = '" . $date . "',
 183                         `type` = '" . claro_sql_escape($eventType) . "',
 184                         `data` = '" . claro_sql_escape($data) . "'";
 185 
 186             return claro_sql_query($sql);
 187         }
 188         else
 189         {
 190             return false;
 191         }
 192 
 193     }

 241     /**
 242      * Add a course access event to the tracking system
 243      * @param Event $event
 244      * @return boolean 
 245      */
 246     public function trackToolAccess( $event )
 247     {
 248         if( ! get_conf('is_trackingEnabled') ) return false;
 249 
 250         $event_args = $event->getArgs();
 251 
 252         $cid        = array_key_exists('cid', $event_args) ? $event_args['cid'] : '';
 253         $tid        = array_key_exists('tid', $event_args) ? $event_args['tid'] : '';
 254 
 255         if( !empty($cid) && !empty($tid) )
 256         {
 257             // count access only if user has not already accessed this tool in this course during this session
 258             if( !isset( $_SESSION['tracking']['visitedTools'][$cid][$tid] ) )
 259             {
 260                 $this->trackInCourse( $event );
 261                 // TODO : also save information in main DB for later use from administration : cid, tid and counter ?
 262                 $_SESSION['tracking']['visitedTools'][$cid][$tid] = claro_mktime();
 263                 return true;
 264             }
 265         }
 266 
 267         return false;
 268 
 269     }

 271     /**
 272      * Add a course access event to the tracking system
 273      * @param Event $event
 274      * @return boolean 
 275      */
 276     public function trackCourseAccess( $event )
 277     {
 278         // tool_id will be recorded too if user enters via a tool directly
 279         if( ! get_conf('is_trackingEnabled') ) return false;
 280 
 281         $event_args = $event->getArgs();
 282 
 283         $cid        = array_key_exists('cid', $event_args) ? $event_args['cid'] : '';
 284 
 285         if( !empty($cid) )
 286         {
 287             // count access only if user has not already accessed this tool in this course during this session
 288             if( !isset( $_SESSION['tracking']['visitedCourses'][$cid] ) )
 289             {
 290                 $this->trackInCourse( $event );
 291                 // TODO : also save information in main DB for later use from administration : cid and counter ?
 292                 $_SESSION['tracking']['visitedCourses'][$cid] = claro_mktime();
 293                 // session destruction on login or logout
 294                 return true;
 295             }
 296         }
 297 
 298         return false;
 299     }

 301     /**
 302      * Add a platform access event to the tracking system
 303      * @param Event $event
 304      * @return boolean 
 305      */
 306     public function trackPlatformAccess( $event )
 307     {
 308         // tool_id will be recorded too if user enters via a tool directly
 309         if( ! get_conf('is_trackingEnabled') ) return false;
 310 
 311         // count access only if user was not already on the platform
 312         if( !isset( $_SESSION['tracking']['platformAccessed'] ) )
 313         {
 314             // we don't have a trace saying that user was already on the platform
 315             // so check its referer
 316             if( ! empty($_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER']) )
 317             {
 318                 if( false === strpos( $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'],get_path('rootWeb') ) )
 319                 {
 320                     // http referer is different user probably comes from outside
 321                     $externalReferer = true;
 322                 }
 323                 else
 324                 {
 325                     $externalReferer = false;
 326                     $_SESSION['tracking']['platformAccessed'] = claro_mktime();
 327                 }
 328             }
 329             else
 330             {
 331                 // referer not set so we take the guess that user was not on the platform
 332                 // and access it directly
 333                 $externalReferer = true;
 334             }
 335 
 336             if( $externalReferer )
 337             {
 338                 $this->trackInPlatform( $event );
 339                 $_SESSION['tracking']['platformAccessed'] = claro_mktime();
 340 
 341                 return true;
 342             }
 343         }
 344         return false;
 345     }

 349     /*
 350      * Notify a modification of a resource
 351      * @param Event $event
 352      */
 353     public function modificationDefault( $event )
 354     {
 355         $event_args = $event->getArgs();
 356 
 357         $cid        = array_key_exists( 'cid', $event_args) ? $event_args['cid'] : '';
 358         $tid        = array_key_exists( 'tid', $event_args) ? $event_args['tid'] : 0;
 359         $rid        = array_key_exists( 'rid', $event_args) ? $event_args['rid'] : '';
 360         $gid        = array_key_exists( 'gid', $event_args) ? $event_args['gid'] : 0;
 361         $uid        = array_key_exists( 'uid', $event_args) ? $event_args['uid'] : 0;
 362 
 363         $eventType  = $event->getEventType();
 364 
 365         // call function to update db info
 366 
 367         if ($eventType != 'delete')
 368         {
 369             $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 370             $tbl_notify    = $tbl_mdb_names['notify'];
 371 
 372             // 1- check if row already exists
 373 
 374             $sql = "SELECT count(`id`) FROM `" . $tbl_notify . "`
 375                          WHERE `course_code`= '".claro_sql_escape($cid)."'
 376                            AND `tool_id`= ". (int) $tid . "
 377                            AND `ressource_id`= '". claro_sql_escape($rid) . "'
 378                            AND `group_id` = ". (int) $gid . "
 379                            AND `user_id` = ". (int) $uid;
 380 
 381             $do_update = (bool) claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sql);
 382 
 383             // 2- update or create for concerned row
 384 
 385             $now = claro_date("Y-m-d H:i:s");
 386 
 387             if ($do_update)
 388             {
 389                 $sqlDoUpdate = "UPDATE `" . $tbl_notify . "`
 390                      SET `date` = '" . claro_sql_escape($now) . "'
 391                      WHERE `course_code` = '" . claro_sql_escape($cid) . "'
 392                        AND `tool_id`     =  " . (int) $tid . "
 393                        AND `ressource_id`= '" . claro_sql_escape($rid) . "'
 394                        AND `group_id`    =  " . (int) $gid . "
 395                        AND `user_id`     =  " . (int) $uid;
 396             }
 397             else
 398             {
 399                 $sqlDoUpdate = "INSERT INTO `" . $tbl_notify . "`
 400                             SET   `course_code`  = '" . claro_sql_escape($cid) . "',
 401                                   `tool_id`      =  " . (int) $tid . ",
 402                                   `date`         = '" . claro_sql_escape($now) . "',
 403                                   `ressource_id` = '" . claro_sql_escape($rid) . "',
 404                                   `group_id`     =  " . (int) $gid . ",
 405                                   `user_id`      =  " . (int) $uid ;
 406 
 407             }
 408 
 409             claro_sql_query($sqlDoUpdate);
 410 
 411             // 3- save in session of this user that this ressource is already seen.
 412             // --> as he did the modification himself, he shouldn't be notified
 413             $_SESSION['ConsultedRessourceList'][$cid . ':' . $tid . ':' . $gid . ':' . $rid . ':' . $now] = TRUE;
 414 
 415         }
 416     }

 452     /**
 453      * Notify the deletion of a resource
 454      * @param Event $event
 455      * TODO split this method in different callbacks
 456      */
 457     public function modificationDelete ( $event )
 458     {
 459         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 460         $tbl_notify     = $tbl_mdb_names['notify'];
 461 
 462         $event_args = $event->getArgs();
 463 
 464         $cid        = array_key_exists( 'cid', $event_args) ? $event_args['cid'] : '';
 465         $tid        = array_key_exists( 'tid', $event_args) ? $event_args['tid'] : 0;
 466         $rid        = array_key_exists( 'rid', $event_args) ? $event_args['rid'] : '';
 467         $gid        = array_key_exists( 'gid', $event_args) ? $event_args['gid'] : 0;
 468         $uid        = array_key_exists( 'uid', $event_args) ? $event_args['uid'] : 0;
 469 
 470         $eventType  = $event->getEventType();
 471 
 472         // in case of a complete deletion of a COURSE, all event regarding this course must be deleted
 473         if ($eventType == 'course_deleted')
 474         {
 475             $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl_notify . "`
 476                     WHERE `course_code`='". claro_sql_escape($cid)."'";
 477         }
 478 
 479         // in case of a complete deletion of a GROUP, all event regarding this group must be deleted
 480         elseif ($eventType == 'group_deleted')
 481         {
 482             $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl_notify . "`
 483                     WHERE `course_code`='" . claro_sql_escape($cid) . "'
 484                       AND `group_id` = ". (int) $gid;
 485         }
 486         // otherwise, just delete event concerning the tool or the ressource in the course
 487         else
 488         {
 489             $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl_notify . "`
 490                       WHERE `course_code`='". claro_sql_escape($cid) ."'
 491                         AND `tool_id`= ". (int) $tid."
 492                         AND `ressource_id`= '". claro_sql_escape($rid) ."'
 493                         AND `group_id` = ". (int) $gid;
 494         }
 495 
 496         claro_sql_query($sql);
 497     }

 499     // Calendar notifications
 500     
 501     /**
 502      * Generate an event in the calendar at the end date
 503      * of an assignment or an exercise. The corresponding
 504      * config params ('allow_work_event_generation',
 505      * 'allow_exercise_event_generation') must be set to true.
 506      * @param Event $event
 507      */
 508     public function calendarAddEvent($event)
 509     {
 510         $eventArgs = $event->getArgs();
 511 
 512         $cid = array_key_exists( 'cid', $eventArgs) ? $eventArgs['cid'] : '';
 513         $tid = array_key_exists( 'tid', $eventArgs) ? $eventArgs['tid'] : 0;
 514         $rid = array_key_exists( 'rid', $eventArgs) ? $eventArgs['rid'] : '';
 515 
 516         $mainTables    = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 517         $courseTables  = claro_sql_get_course_tbl();
 518 
 519         $eventResourceTable = $mainTables['event_resource'];
 520         $calendarTable      = $courseTables['calendar_event'];
 521         $workTable          = $courseTables['wrk_assignment'];
 522         $exerciseTable      = $courseTables['qwz_exercise'];
 523 
 524         $eventType = $event->getEventType();
 525 
 526         if ($eventType == 'work_added')
 527         {
 528             // check that the configuration variable for work event
 529             // generation is set to true
 530             if (get_conf('allow_work_event_generation', false) == false) return;
 531 
 532             // select data from assignment
 533             $sql = 'SELECT `title`, `description`,
 534                            `end_date` AS endDate, `visibility` ' .
 535                    'FROM `' . $workTable . '` ' .
 536                    'WHERE `id` = ' . $rid;
 537             $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 538         }
 539         elseif ($eventType == 'exercise_added')
 540         {
 541             // check that the configuration variable for exercise event
 542             // generation is set to true
 543             if (get_conf('allow_exercise_event_generation', false) == false) return;
 544 
 545             // select data from exercise
 546             $sql = 'SELECT `title`, `description`, `endDate`,
 547                            CAST(`endDate` AS SIGNED) AS integerDate,
 548                            `visibility` ' .
 549                    'FROM `' . $exerciseTable . '` ' .
 550                    'WHERE `id` = ' . $rid;
 551             $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 552 
 553             // check that an end date has been chosen for this exercise,
 554             // otherwise it doesn't make sense to insert it in the agenda
 555             // (when no date has been chosen, the date field is set to '0000-00-00')
 556             if ($result[0]['integerDate'] == 0) return;
 557         }
 558 
 559         // explode assignment/exercise end date into day and hour
 560         $date = explode(' ', $result[0]['endDate']);
 561 
 562         // set the visibility value of the assignment/exercise record
 563         // to its corresponding value in the calendar table
 564         $result[0]['visibility'] == 'VISIBLE' ?
 565                          $visibility = 'SHOW' :
 566                          $visibility = 'HIDE' ;
 567 
 568         // insert a new event in the calendar
 569         $sql = 'INSERT INTO `' . $calendarTable . '` ' .
 570                'SET `titre`      = \'' . $result[0]['title'] . '\', ' .
 571                    '`contenu`    = \'' . $result[0]['description'] . '\', ' .
 572                    '`day`        = \'' . $date[0] . '\', ' .
 573                    '`hour`       = \'' . $date[1] . '\', ' .
 574                    '`visibility` = \'' . $visibility . '\'';
 575         claro_sql_query($sql);
 576 
 577         // insert the relationship between the event and the assignment/exercise
 578         // into the 'event_resource' table
 579         $sql = 'INSERT INTO `' . $eventResourceTable . '` ' .
 580                'SET `event_id`    = \'' . mysql_insert_id() . '\', ' .
 581                    '`resource_id` = \'' . $rid . '\', ' .
 582                    '`tool_id`     = \'' . $tid . '\', ' .
 583                    '`course_code` = \'' . $cid . '\'';
 584         claro_sql_query($sql);
 585     }
 586 
 587     /**
 588      * Delete a generated calendar event when the
 589      * original resource (exercise or assignment) has
 590      * been deleted.
 591      * @param Event $event
 592      */
 593     public function calendarDeleteEvent($event)
 594     {
 595         $eventArgs = $event->getArgs();
 596 
 597         $cid = array_key_exists( 'cid', $eventArgs) ? $eventArgs['cid'] : '';
 598         $tid = array_key_exists( 'tid', $eventArgs) ? $eventArgs['tid'] : 0;
 599         $rid = array_key_exists( 'rid', $eventArgs) ? $eventArgs['rid'] : '';
 600 
 601         $mainTables    = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 602         $courseTables  = claro_sql_get_course_tbl();
 603 
 604         $eventResourceTable = $mainTables['event_resource'];
 605         $calendarTable      = $courseTables['calendar_event'];
 606 
 607         $eventType = $event->getEventType();
 608 
 609         // try to get the id of the corresponding event
 610         $sql = 'SELECT `event_id` FROM `' . $eventResourceTable . '` ' .
 611                'WHERE `resource_id` = \'' . $rid . '\' ' .
 612                  'AND `tool_id`     = \'' . $tid . '\' ' .
 613                  'AND `course_code` = \'' . $cid . '\'';
 614         $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 615 
 616         if ($result != false)
 617         {
 618             $eventId = $result[0]['event_id'];
 619 
 620             // delete the event in the calendar
 621             $sql = 'DELETE FROM `' . $calendarTable . '` ' .
 622                    'WHERE `id` = ' . $eventId;
 623             claro_sql_query($sql);
 624 
 625             // delete the relationship between event
 626             // and assignment/exercise in 'event_resource'
 627             $sql = 'DELETE FROM `' . $eventResourceTable . '` ' .
 628                    'WHERE `event_id`    = ' .   $eventId . ' ' .
 629                      'AND `resource_id` = ' .   $rid . ' ' .
 630                      'AND `tool_id`     = ' .   $tid . ' ' .
 631                      'AND `course_code` = \'' . $cid . '\'';
 632             claro_sql_query($sql);
 633         }
 634     }

 636     /**
 637      * Update the data (date, title, description, visibility)
 638      * of a generated calendar event when the original
 639      * resource has been updated.
 640      * @param Event $event
 641      */
 642     public function calendarUpdateEvent($event)
 643     {
 644         $eventArgs = $event->getArgs();
 645 
 646         $cid = array_key_exists( 'cid', $eventArgs) ? $eventArgs['cid'] : '';
 647         $tid = array_key_exists( 'tid', $eventArgs) ? $eventArgs['tid'] : 0;
 648         $rid = array_key_exists( 'rid', $eventArgs) ? $eventArgs['rid'] : '';
 649 
 650         $mainTables    = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 651         $courseTables  = claro_sql_get_course_tbl();
 652 
 653         $eventResourceTable = $mainTables['event_resource'];
 654         $calendarTable      = $courseTables['calendar_event'];
 655         $workTable          = $courseTables['wrk_assignment'];
 656         $exerciseTable      = $courseTables['qwz_exercise'];
 657 
 658         $eventType = $event->getEventType();
 659 
 660         // try to get the id of the corresponding event
 661         $sql = 'SELECT `event_id` FROM `' . $eventResourceTable . '` ' .
 662                'WHERE `resource_id` = \'' . $rid . '\' ' .
 663                  'AND `tool_id`     = \'' . $tid . '\' ' .
 664                  'AND `course_code` = \'' . $cid . '\'';
 665         $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 666 
 667         if ($result != false)
 668         {
 669             $eventId = $result[0]['event_id'];
 670 
 671             if ($eventType == 'work_updated')
 672             {
 673                 // select new data from the work table
 674                 $sql = 'SELECT `title`, `description`, `end_date` as endDate, `visibility` ' .
 675                        'FROM `' . $workTable . '` ' .
 676                        'WHERE `id` = ' . $rid;
 677                 $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 678             }
 679             elseif ($eventType == 'exercise_updated')
 680             {
 681                 // select new data from the exercise table
 682                 $sql = 'SELECT `title`, `description`, `endDate`, `visibility` ' .
 683                        'FROM `' . $exerciseTable . '` ' .
 684                        'WHERE `id` = ' . $rid;
 685                 $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 686             }
 687 
 688             // explode assignment end date into day and hour
 689             $date = explode(' ', $result[0]['endDate']);
 690 
 691             // set the visibility value of the assignment/exercise table to its
 692             // corresponding value in the calendar table
 693             $result[0]['visibility'] == 'VISIBLE' ?
 694                              $visibility = 'SHOW' :
 695                              $visibility = 'HIDE' ;
 696 
 697             // update the corresponding event in the calendar
 698             $sql = 'UPDATE `' . $calendarTable . '` ' .
 699                    'SET `titre`      = \'' . $result[0]['title'] . '\', ' .
 700                        '`contenu`    = \'' . $result[0]['description'] . '\', ' .
 701                        '`day`        = \'' . $date[0] . '\', ' .
 702                        '`hour`       = \'' . $date[1] . '\', ' .
 703                        '`visibility` = \'' . $visibility . '\' ' .
 704                    'WHERE `id` = ' . $eventId;
 705             claro_sql_query($sql);
 706         }
 707     }

 756     /**
 757      * Get the list of course with notified resource changes since the given
 758      * date for the given user
 759      * @param string $date
 760      * @param int $user_id
 761      * @return array(`course_code`)
 762      */
 763     public function getNotifiedCourses( $date, $user_id )
 764     {
 765         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 766         $tbl_cours_user = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user'];
 767         $tbl_notify     = $tbl_mdb_names['notify'];
 768 
 769         $courses = array();
 770         $courseList = array();
 771 
 772         //  1- find the list of the user's course and in this list, take only the course where recent events happened
 773         //    A- FOR A STUDENT : where the events concerned everybody (uid = 0) or the user himself (uid)
 774         //    B- FOR A TEACHER : every events of a course must be reported (this take much sense in the work tool, with submissions)
 775         if ( !isset($_SESSION['firstLogin']) || !$_SESSION['firstLogin'] )
 776         {
 777             $sql="SELECT `course_code`, `tool_id`, `group_id`, `ressource_id`,`date` FROM `".$tbl_cours_user."` AS CU, `".$tbl_notify."` AS N
 778                 WHERE CU.`code_cours` = N.`course_code`
 779                     AND CU.`user_id` = '". (int)$user_id."'
 780                     AND N.`date` > '".$date."'
 781                     AND ((N.`user_id` = '0' OR N.`user_id` = '". (int)$user_id."') OR CU.`isCourseManager`='1')
 782                     ";
 783 
 784             $courseList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 785 
 786         }
 787 
 788         // from result in the notify table, we mustn't take account of the ressources already consulted,
 789         // (saved in session)
 790 
 791         $size = count($courseList);
 792 
 793         for($i=0;$i<$size;$i++)
 794         {
 795 
 796            if (($courseList[$i]['group_id'])==0) $courseList[$i]['group_id'] = "";
 797 
 798            if (isset($_SESSION['ConsultedRessourceList'])
 799             && isset($_SESSION['ConsultedRessourceList'][$courseList[$i]['course_code'].":".$courseList[$i]['tool_id'].":".$courseList[$i]['group_id'].":".$courseList[$i]['ressource_id'].":".$courseList[$i]['date']]))
 800            {
 801               unset($courseList[$i]); // the ressource is already seen, we retrieve it from the results
 802 
 803            }
 804            else
 805            {
 806                $courses[] = $courseList[$i]['course_code']; // there is a ressource not consulted yet, we add the course_id in results
 807            }
 808         }
 809 
 810         //2- return an array with the courses with recent unknow event until the date '$date' in the course list of the user
 811 
 812         return $courses;
 813     }

 815     /**
 816      * Get the list of tools with notified event in the given course since the given
 817      * date for the given user and the optional given group
 818      * @param string $course_id
 819      * @param string $date
 820      * @param int $user_id
 821      * @param int $group_id (default 0 meaning no group)
 822      * @return array(`tool_id`)
 823      */
 824     public function getNotifiedTools( $course_id, $date, $user_id,$group_id = '0' )
 825     {
 826 
 827         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 828         $tbl_notify    = $tbl_mdb_names['notify'];
 829 
 830         //if user is course admin, he is notified of event concerning all user in the course
 831 
 832         if (claro_is_course_manager())
 833         {
 834            $toadd = "";
 835         } // otherwise we must only know about what concerns everybody or himself
 836         else
 837         {
 838            $toadd = "AND (N.`user_id` = '0' OR N.`user_id` = '".(int)$user_id."')";
 839         }
 840 
 841 
 842         $tools = array();
 843 
 844         // 1 - Find the tool list of the given course that contains some event newer than the date '$date'
 845         //    - FOR A STUDENT : where the events concerned everybody (uid = 0) or the user himself (uid)
 846         //    - FOR A TEACHER : every events of a course must be reported (this take much sense in the work tool, with submissions)
 847 
 848 
 849         if ( !isset($_SESSION['firstLogin']) || !$_SESSION['firstLogin'] ) {
 850 
 851 
 852             // A- retrieve new item since last login in the notify table
 853 
 854             $sql = "SELECT `tool_id`, `date`, `group_id`, `course_code`, `ressource_id`
 855                     FROM `".$tbl_notify."` AS N
 856                     WHERE N.`course_code` = '".claro_sql_escape($course_id)."'
 857                     AND N.`date` > '".$date."'
 858                     ".$toadd."
 859                     AND (N.`group_id` = '".$group_id."')
 860                     ";
 861 
 862             $toolList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 863 
 864             if (is_array($toolList))
 865 
 866             // B- from result in the notify table, we mustn't take the ressources already consulted, saved in session
 867 
 868             $size = count($toolList);
 869 
 870             for($i=0;$i<$size;$i++)
 871             {
 872 
 873                if (($toolList[$i]['group_id'])==0) $toolList[$i]['group_id'] = "";
 874 
 875                if (isset($_SESSION['ConsultedRessourceList'])
 876                 && isset($_SESSION['ConsultedRessourceList'][$toolList[$i]['course_code'].":".$toolList[$i]['tool_id'].":".$toolList[$i]['group_id'].":".$toolList[$i]['ressource_id'].":".$toolList[$i]['date']]))
 877                {
 878                   unset($toolList[$i]); // the ressource is already seen, we retrieve it from the results
 879 
 880                }
 881                else
 882                {
 883                    $tools[] = $toolList[$i]['tool_id']; // there is a ressource not consulted yet, we add tht tool_id in results
 884                }
 885             }
 886 
 887         }
 888 
 889 
 890         // 2- return an array with the tools id with recent unknow event until the date '$date'
 891 
 892         return $tools;
 893     }

 943     /**
 944      * Check if a resource has been subject to a notification in the given course since the given
 945      * date for the given user, group and tool
 946      * @param string $course_id
 947      * @param string $date
 948      * @param int $user_id
 949      * @param int $group_id
 950      * @param int $tool_id
 951      * @param mixed $ressourceId
 952      * @param bool $setAsViewed (default true)
 953      * @return array(`tool_id`)
 954      */
 955     public function isANotifiedRessource($course_id, $date, $user_id, $group_id, $tool_id, $ressourceId,$setAsViewed=TRUE)
 956     {
 957         // global $fileList, $fileKey; //needed for the document tool
 958         $keysStrings = $course_id . ':' . $tool_id . ':' . $group_id . ':';
 959 
 960         // see if the ressource is new AND not consulted yet
 961 
 962         if (!isset($this->toolNotifiedRessourceList))
 963         {
 964             $this->toolNotifiedRessourceList = $this->getNotifiedRessources($course_id, $date, $user_id, $group_id, $tool_id);
 965         }
 966 
 967 
 968         // compare table result with SESSION information
 969 
 970         if (isset($this->toolNotifiedRessourceList[$ressourceId])
 971              && !isset($_SESSION['ConsultedRessourceList'][$keysStrings . $ressourceId . ':' . $this->toolNotifiedRessourceList[$ressourceId]['date']]))
 972 
 973         {
 974             //now, the ressource is seen
 975 
 976             if ($setAsViewed) $_SESSION['ConsultedRessourceList'][$keysStrings . $ressourceId . ':' . $this->toolNotifiedRessourceList[$ressourceId]['date']] = TRUE;
 977 
 978             return true;
 979         }
 980         else 
 981         {
 982             return false;
 983         }
 984     }

 986     /**
 987      * Check if a document has been subject to a notification in the given course since the given
 988      * date for the given user, group and tool

 991      * @param int $user_id
 992      * @param int $group_id
 993      * @param int $tool_id
 994      * @param string $thisFile
 995      * @param bool $setAsViewed (default true)
 996      * @return array(`tool_id`)
 997      * @TODO move to CLDOC and/or replace by a GENERIC mechanism, not a hardcoded specific one
 998      */
 999     public function isANotifiedDocument($course_id, $date, $user_id, $group_id, $tool_id, $thisFile,$setAsViewed=TRUE)
1000     {
1001         // global $fileList, $fileKey; //needed for the document tool
1002         $keysStrings = $course_id . ':' . $tool_id . ':' . $group_id . ':';
1003 
1004         // see if the ressource is new AND not consulted yet
1005 
1006         if (!isset($this->toolNotifiedRessourceList))
1007         {
1008             $this->toolNotifiedRessourceList = $this->getNotifiedRessources($course_id, $date, $user_id, $group_id, $tool_id);
1009         }
1010 
1011         //deal with specific case of folders in document tool
1012 
1013         if ((claro_get_current_course_tool_data('label') == 'CLDOC') && ($thisFile['type'] == A_DIRECTORY))
1014         {
1015             $ressourceList = $this->toolNotifiedRessourceList;
1016 
1017             foreach ($ressourceList as $ressource)
1018             {
1019                 $ressource_identification = $keysStrings
1020                 .                           $ressource['ressource_id'] . ':'
1021                 .                           $ressource['date']
1022                 ;
1023                 $pattern = '/' . $keysStrings . preg_quote($thisFile['path'], '/') . '.*:' . $ressource['date'] . '/';
1024 
1025                 if (!isset($_SESSION['ConsultedRessourceList'][$ressource_identification])
1026                 && preg_match($pattern,$ressource_identification))
1027                 {
1028                     if ($ressource_identification == $keysStrings . $thisFile['path'] . ':' . $ressource['date'])
1029                     //in case the new item is the folder itself only
1030                     {
1031                         $_SESSION['ConsultedRessourceList'][$ressource_identification] = TRUE;
1032                     }
1033                     return true;
1034                 }
1035             }
1036             return false;
1037         }
1038 
1039 
1040         // compare table result with SESSION information
1041 
1042         if (isset($this->toolNotifiedRessourceList[$thisFile['path']])
1043              && !isset($_SESSION['ConsultedRessourceList'][$keysStrings . $thisFile['path'] . ':' . $this->toolNotifiedRessourceList[$thisFile['path']]['date']]))
1044 
1045         {
1046             //now, the ressource is seen
1047 
1048             if ($setAsViewed) $_SESSION['ConsultedRessourceList'][$keysStrings . $thisFile['path'] . ':' . $this->toolNotifiedRessourceList[$thisFile['path']]['date']] = TRUE;
1049 
1050             return true;
1051         }
1052         else
1053         {
1054             return false;
1055         }
1056     }

1059      * Check if a forum has been subject to a notification in the given course since the given
1060      * date for the given user, group and tool
1061      * @param string $course_id
1062      * @param string $date
1063      * @param int $user_id
1064      * @param int $group_id
1065      * @param int $tool_id
1066      * @param int $forumId
1067      * @return array(`tool_id`)
1068      * @TODO move to CLFRM and/or replace by a GENERIC mechanism, not a hardcoded specific one
1069      */
1070     public function isANotifiedForum( $course_id, $date, $user_id, $group_id, $tool_id, $forumId )
1071     {
1072 
1073         $keysStrings = $course_id . ':' . $tool_id . ':' . $group_id . ':';
1074 
1075         // see if the ressource is new AND not consulted yet
1076 
1077         $notified_ressources = $this->getNotifiedRessources($course_id, $date, $user_id, $group_id, $tool_id);
1078 
1079         // see if the forum is to be notified or not.
1080 
1081         foreach ($notified_ressources as $ressource)
1082         {
1083             $ressource_identification = $keysStrings . $ressource['ressource_id'] . ':' . $ressource['date'];
1084 
1085             $pattern = '/' . $keysStrings . $forumId . '-.*:' . $ressource['date'] . '/';
1086 
1087             //for each ressource, it must not be in session yet and it must concern this forum exactly
1088 
1089             if (!isset($_SESSION['ConsultedRessourceList'][$ressource_identification])
1090             && preg_match($pattern, $ressource_identification))
1091             {
1092                 return true;
1093             }
1094         }
1095         return false;
1096     }

1137     /**
1138      * Get the date of a user's last login
1139      * @param int $user_id
1140      * @return string 
1141      */
1142     public function getLastLoginBeforeToday($user_id)
1143     {
1144         $tbl_mdb_names        = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
1145         $tbl_tracking_event   = $tbl_mdb_names['tracking_event'];
1146 
1147         $today = date('Y-m-d 00:00:00');
1148 
1149         $sql = "SELECT MAX(`date`) AS THEDAY
1150                   FROM `" . $tbl_tracking_event . "`
1151                  WHERE `type` = 'user_login'
1152                    AND `user_id` = " . (int) $user_id . "
1153                    AND `date` < '" . $today . "'";
1154 
1155         $theday = claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sql);
1156 
1157         $login_date = ($theday ? $theday : $today);
1158 
1159         return $login_date;
1160     }

1171     /**
1172      * @param int $user_id
1173      * @return string 
1174      */
1175     public function getLastActionBeforeLoginDate($user_id)
1176     {
1177         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
1178         $tbl_rel_course_user = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user'];
1179 
1180         $_user = claro_get_current_user_data();
1181 
1182         //if we already knwo in session what is the last action date, just retrieve it from the session
1183 
1184         if (isset($_SESSION['last_action'])) return $_SESSION['last_action'];
1185 
1186         //otherwise we must find it in the access statistics information of the database
1187 
1188         $last_login_date = date("Y-m-d H:i:s", $_user['lastLogin']);
1189 
1190         // 1 - retriev course list in which the user is subscribed
1191 
1192         $sql  = "SELECT `code_cours`
1193                    FROM `".$tbl_rel_course_user."` AS CU
1194                   WHERE CU.`user_id`='".(int)$user_id."'";
1195         $courses = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
1196 
1197         // 2 - retrieve each max(date) of acces for each date
1198 
1199         $last_action_date = "0000-00-00 00:00:00"; //set default last action date
1200 
1201             //look for last action date in every tracking table of courses where the user is registered
1202 
1203         foreach ($courses as $course)
1204         {
1205             $tbl_c_names = claro_sql_get_course_tbl(claro_get_course_db_name_glued($course['code_cours']));
1206             $tbl_course_tracking_event = $tbl_c_names['tracking_event'];
1207 
1208             $sqlMaxDate = "SELECT MAX(`date`) AS MAXDATE
1209                       FROM `" . $tbl_course_tracking_event . "` AS STAT,
1210                            `" . $tbl_rel_course_user . "` AS CU
1211                      WHERE `type` = 'course_access'
1212                        AND STAT.`user_id` = " . (int) $user_id . "
1213                        AND STAT.`user_id` = CU.`user_id`
1214                        AND CU.`user_id` = " . (int) $user_id;
1215             $maxDate = claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sqlMaxDate);
1216 
1217 
1218             if ($maxDate && (strtotime($maxDate) > strtotime($last_action_date)))
1219             {
1220                 $last_action_date = $maxDate;
1221             }
1222         }
1223 
1224         // return (and save in session) the latest action :
1225         // last login or latest action in the tracking tables
1226 
1227         if (strtotime($last_action_date) > strtotime($last_login_date))
1228         {
1229             $_SESSION['last_action'] = $last_action_date;
1230             return $last_action_date;
1231         }
1232         else
1233         {
1234             $_SESSION['last_action'] = $last_login_date;
1235             return $last_login_date;
1236         }
1237     }
