   5 /**
   6  * CLAROLINE
   7  *
   8  * Url manipulation library.
   9  *
  10  * @version     $Revision: 14320 $
  11  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  12  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  13  * @author      Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  14  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  15  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  16  * @package     kernel.core
  17  */
  18 
  19 /**
  20  * Class to manipulate Urls
  21  */
  22 class Url
  23 {
  24     protected $url = array(
  25         'scheme' => '',
  26         'host' => '',
  27         'port' => '',
  28         'user' => '',
  29         'pass' => '',
  30         'path' => '',
  31         'query' => array(),
  32         'fragment' => ''
  33     );
  34     
  35 
  36     /**
  37      * Constructor
  38      * @param   string url base url (use PHP_SELF if missing)
  39      */
  40     public function __construct( $url = '' )
  41     {
  42         $url = empty($url)
  43             ? $_SERVER['PHP_SELF']
  44             : $url
  45             ;
  46             
  47         $url = htmlspecialchars_decode( $url );
  48         
  49         $urlArr = @parse_url( $url );
  50         
  51         $queryArr = array();
  52         
  53         if ( !empty($urlArr['query']) )
  54         {
  55             @parse_str($urlArr['query'], $queryArr );
  56         }
  57         
  58         unset ($urlArr['suery']);
  59         
  60         $this->url = array_merge( $this->url, $urlArr );
  61         $this->url['query'] = $queryArr;
  62     }
  63     
  64     public function __get( $name )
  65     {
  66         if ( isset( $this->url[$name] ) )
  67         {
  68             return $this->url[$name];
  69         }
  70         else
  71         {
  72             return null;
  73         }
  74     }
  75     
  76     public function __set( $name, $value )
  77     {
  78         if ( isset( $this->url[$name] ) )
  79         {
  80             $this->url[$name] = $value;
  81         }
  82     }
  83 
  84     /**
  85      * Relay Claroline current Url context in urls
  86      * @return $this
  87      */
  88     public function relayCurrentContext()
  89     {
  90         /* $context = Claro_Context::getCurrentUrlContext();
  91         
  92         if ( array_key_exists( 'cid', $context )
  93             && ! array_key_exists( 'cidReq', $context ) )
  94         {
  95             $context['cidReq'] = $context['cid'];
  96             unset( $context['cid'] );
  97         }
  98 
  99         if ( array_key_exists( 'gid', $context )
 100             && ! array_key_exists( 'gidReq', $context ) )
 101         {
 102             $context['gidReq'] = $context['gid'];
 103             unset( $context['gid'] );
 104         } */
 105         
 106         $this->addParamList( Claro_Context::getCurrentUrlContext() );
 107 
 108         return $this;
 109     }
 110     
 111     /**
 112      * Relay given Url context in urls
 113      * @param   array context
 114      * @return $this
 115      */
 116     public function relayContext( $context )
 117     {
 118         $this->addParamList( $context );
 119 
 120         return $this;
 121     }
 122 
 123     /**
 124      * Add a list of parameters to the current url
 125      * @param   array $paramList associative array of parameters name=>value
 126      * @param   boolean $overwrite will overwrite the value of an existing
 127      *  parameter if set to true
 128      * @return $this
 129      */
 130     public function addParamList( $paramList, $overwrite = false )
 131     {
 132         if ( !empty( $paramList ) && is_array( $paramList ) )
 133         {
 134             foreach ( $paramList as $name => $value )
 135             {
 136                 if ( !$overwrite && !empty( $value ) )
 137                 {
 138                     $this->addParam( $name, $value );
 139                 }
 140                 elseif ( $overwrite )
 141                 {
 142                     $this->replaceParam( $name, $value, true );
 143                 }
 144             }
 145         }
 146 
 147         return $this;
 148     }
 149 
 150     /**
 151      * Add one parameter to the current url
 152      * @param   string $name parameter name
 153      * @param   string $value parameter value
 154      * @return $this
 155      */
 156     public function addParam( $name, $value )
 157     {
 158         if ( !array_key_exists($name, $this->url['query'] ) )
 159         {
 160             $this->url['query'][$name] = $value;
 161         }
 162 
 163         return $this;
 164     }
 165 
 166     /**
 167      * Replace the value of the given parameter with the given value
 168      * @param   string $name parameter name
 169      * @param   string $value parameter value
 170      * @param   boolean $addIfMissing add the parameter if missing (default false)
 171      * @return  $this
 172      * @throws  Exception if trying to modify a non existent parameter with
 173      *  $addIfMissing set to false (default)
 174      */
 175     public function replaceParam( $name, $value, $addIfMissing = false )
 176     {
 177         if ( $addIfMissing || array_key_exists( $name, $this->url['query'] ) )
 178         {
 179             $this->addParam( $name, $value );
 180             return $this;
 181         }
 182         else
 183         {
 184             throw new Exception("Cannot replace parameter {$name} : not found");
 185         }
 186     }
 187 
 188     /**
 189      * Remove the given parameter
 190      * @param   string $name parameter name
 191      * @param   boolean $ignoreMissing if set to true, the method invokation
 192      *  will ignore a missing parameter. If set to false (default) removing a
 193      *  non existent parameter will generate an exception
 194      * @return  $this
 195      * @throws  Exception if trying to remove a non existent parameter with
 196      *  $ignoreMissing set to false (default)
 197      */
 198     public function removeParam( $name, $ignoreMissing = false )
 199     {
 200         if ( array_key_exists( $name, $this->url['query'] ) )
 201         {
 202             unset( $this->url['query'] );
 203 
 204             return $this;
 205         }
 206         elseif ( $ignoreMissing)
 207         {
 208             return $this;
 209         }
 210         else
 211         {
 212             throw new Exception("Cannot remove parameter {$name} : not found");
 213         }
 214     }
 215 
 216     /**
 217      * Convert the current Url object to an URL string
 218      * @return string
 219      */
 220     public function toUrl()
 221     {
 222         $url = '';
 223         
 224         if ( !empty($this->url['scheme']) )
 225         {
 226             if ( $this->url['scheme'] != 'mailto' )
 227             {
 228                 $url .= $this->url['scheme'] . '://';
 229             }
 230             else
 231             {
 232                 $url .= $this->url['scheme'] . ':';
 233             }
 234         }
 235         
 236         if ( !empty( $this->url['user'] ) )
 237         {
 238             $url .= $this->url['user'];
 239             
 240             if ( !empty( $this->url['pass'] ) )
 241             {
 242                 $url .= ":{$this->url['pass']}";
 243             }
 244             
 245             $url .= '@';
 246         }
 247         
 248         if ( !empty ( $this->url['host']))
 249         {
 250             $url .= $this->url['host'];
 251         }
 252         
 253         if ( !empty ( $this->url['port']))
 254         {
 255             $url .= ':'.$this->url['port'];
 256         }
 257         
 258         if ( !empty ( $this->url['path']))
 259         {
 260             $url .= $this->url['path'];
 261         }
 262         
 263         if ( !empty($this->url['query']) )
 264         {
 265             $url .= '?' . http_build_query( $this->url['query'] );
 266         }
 267         
 268         if ( !empty ( $this->url['fragment']))
 269         {
 270             $url .= '#' . $this->url['fragment'];
 271         }
 272         
 273         return $url;
 274     }
 275 
 276     /**
 277      * @since   Claroline 1.9
 278      * @return  string
 279      */
 280     public function  __toString()
 281     {
 282         return $this->toUrl();
 283     }
 284 
 285     /**
 286      * Add current execution context to the given URL
 287      * @param string $url
 288      * @param array $context
 289      * @return string
 290      */
 291     public static function Contextualize( $url, $context = null )
 292     {
 293         $urlObj = new self($url);
 294         
 295         if ( empty( $context ) )
 296         {
 297             $urlObj->relayCurrentContext();
 298         }
 299         else
 300         {
 301             $urlObj->relayContext( $context );
 302         }
 303         
 304         return $urlObj->toUrl();
 305     }
 306 
 307     /**
 308      * Build an url from sctract
 309      * @param string $url
 310      * @param array $params
 311      * @param array $context
 312      * @return Url
 313      */
 314     public static function buildUrl( $url, $params = null, $context = null )
 315     {
 316         $urlObj = new Url($url);
 317         $urlObj->addParamList($params);
 318         $urlObj->relayContext($context);
 319         
 320         return $urlObj;
 321     }
 322 }

  22 /**
  23   * Delete a directory.
  24   *
  25   * @param string $dir    the directory deleting
  26   * @return boolean whether success true
  27   *
  28   */
  29 function delete_directory($dir)
  30 {
  31     $deleteOk = true;
  32     
  33     $current_dir = opendir($dir);
  34     
  35     while($entryname = readdir($current_dir))
  36     {
  37         if(is_dir("$dir/$entryname") && ($entryname != "." && $entryname != '..'))
  38         {
  39             delete_directory("${dir}/${entryname}");
  40         }
  41         elseif($entryname != '.' && $entryname != '..')
  42         {
  43             unlink("${dir}/${entryname}");
  44         }
  45     }
  46     
  47     closedir($current_dir);
  48     rmdir(${dir}."/");
  49     return $deleteOk;
  50 }

  83 /**

  88 function language_exists()
  89 {
  90     $dirname = get_path('clarolineRepositorySys') . 'lang/';
  91 
  92     if($dirname[strlen($dirname)-1]!='/')
  93         $dirname.='/';
  94 
  95     //Open the repertoy
  96     $handle=opendir($dirname);
  97 
  98     //For each reportery in the repertory /lang/
  99     while ($entries = readdir($handle))

 104 
 105         //else it is a repertory of a language
 106         if (is_dir($dirname.$entries))

 108             $arrayLanguage[] = $entries;
 109         }
 110     }
 111     closedir($handle);
 112 
 113     return $arrayLanguage;

 117 /**
 118  * Build the <option> element with categories where we can create/have courses.
 119  *
 120  * @param the code of the preselected categorie
 121  * @param the separator used between a cat and its paretn cat to display in the <select>
 122  * @return echo all the <option> elements needed for a <select>.
 123  *
 124  */
 125 function build_editable_cat_table($selectedCat = null, $separator = "&gt;")
 126 {
 127     $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 128     $tbl_category        = $tbl_mdb_names['category'];
 129 
 130     $sql = " SELECT code, code_P, name, canHaveCoursesChild
 131                FROM `" . $tbl_category . "`
 132                ORDER BY `name`";
 133     $result = claro_sql_query($sql);
 134     // first we get the categories available in DB from the SQL query result in parameter
 135 
 136     while ($myfac = mysql_fetch_array($result))
 137     {
 138         $categories[$myfac['code']]['code']   = $myfac['code'];
 139         $categories[$myfac['code']]['parent'] = $myfac['code_P'];
 140         $categories[$myfac['code']]['name']   = $myfac['name'];
 141         $categories[$myfac['code']]['childs'] = $myfac['canHaveCoursesChild'];
 142     }
 143 
 144     // then we build the table we need : full path of editable cats in an array
 145 
 146     $tableToDisplay = array();
 147     echo '<select name="faculte" id="faculte">' . "\n";
 148     foreach ($categories as $cat)
 149     {
 150         if ( $cat["childs"] == 'TRUE' )
 151         {
 152 
 153             echo '<option value="' . $cat['code'] . '"';
 154             if ($cat["code"]==$selectedCat) echo ' selected ';
 155             echo '>';
 156             $tableToDisplay[$cat['code']]= $cat;
 157             $parentPath  = get_full_path($categories, $cat['code'], $separator);
 158 
 159             $tableToDisplay[$cat['code']]['fullpath'] = $parentPath;
 160             echo '(' . $tableToDisplay[$cat['code']]['fullpath'] . ') ' . $cat['name'];
 161             echo '</option>' . "\n";
 162         }
 163     }
 164     echo '</select>' . "\n";
 165 
 166     return $tableToDisplay;
 167 }

 189 /**
 190  * Recursive function to get the full categories path of a specified categorie.
 191  *
 192  * @param table of all the categories, 2 dimension tables, first dimension for cat codes, second for names,
 193  *  parent's cat code.
 194  * @param $catcode   string the categorie we want to have its full path from root categorie
 195  * @param $separator string
 196  * @return void
 197  */
 198 function get_full_path($categories, $catcode = NULL, $separator = ' > ')
 199 {
 200     //Find parent code
 201 
 202     $parent = null;
 203 
 204     foreach ($categories as $currentCat)
 205     {
 206         if (( $currentCat['code'] == $catcode))
 207         {
 208             $parent       = $currentCat['parent'];
 209             $childTreePos = $currentCat['treePos']; // for protection anti loop
 210         }
 211     }
 212     // RECURSION : find parent categorie in table
 213     if ($parent == null)
 214     {
 215         return $catcode;
 216     }
 217 
 218     foreach ($categories as $currentCat)
 219     {
 220         if (($currentCat['code'] == $parent))
 221         {
 222 
 223             if ($currentCat['treePos'] >= $childTreePos ) return claro_failure::set_failure('loop_in_structure');
 224             if ($parent == $catcode ) return claro_failure::set_failure('loop_in_structure');
 225 
 226             return get_full_path($categories, $parent, $separator)
 227             .      $separator
 228             .      $catcode
 229             ;
 230 
 231         }
 232     }
 233 }

 273         $cid = claro_get_current_course_id();
 274     }
 275     
 276      $tableName = get_module_main_tbl(array('rel_course_user'));
 277      
 278     $sql = "SELECT user_id "
 279          . "FROM `". $tableName['rel_course_user']."` "
 280          . "WHERE code_cours='".claro_sql_escape($cid)."' "
 281          . "AND isCourseManager = 1"
 282             ;
 283     
 284     $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_cols($sql);
 285     
 286     return $result['user_id'];
 287     
 288 }

 291 /**
 292  * Get an icon url according to a course access mode ('public', 'private' or 'platform')
 293  *
 294  * @param String label of the access mode for which an icon is asked for
 295  * @return String the url to the icon
 296  */
 297 function get_course_access_icon($access)
 298 {
 299     switch($access)
 300     {
 301         case 'private' :
 302             $iconUrl = get_icon_url('access_locked');
 303             break;
 304         case 'platform' :
 305             $iconUrl = get_icon_url('access_platform');
 306             break;
 307         case 'public' :
 308             $iconUrl = get_icon_url('access_open');
 309             break;
 310         default :
 311             $iconUrl = get_icon_url('course');
 312     }
 313     
 314     return $iconUrl;
 315 }

 318 /**
 319  * Get an icon url according to a course access mode ('public', 'private' or 'platform')
 320  *
 321  * @param String label of the access mode for which an icon is asked for
 322  * @return String caption
 323  */
 324 function get_course_access_mode_caption($access)
 325 {
 326     switch($access)
 327     {
 328         case 'private' :
 329             $caption = get_lang('Access allowed only to course members (people on the course user list)');
 330             break;
 331         case 'platform' :
 332             $caption = get_lang('Access allowed only to platform members (user registered to the platform)');
 333             break;
 334         case 'public' :
 335             $caption = get_lang('Access allowed to anybody (even without login)');
 336             break;
 337         default :
 338             $caption = $access;
 339     }
 340     
 341     return $caption;
 342 }

 345 /**
 346  * Localize the name of a lang
 347  *
 348  * @param String lang name
 349  * @return String localized lang name
 350  */
 351 function get_course_locale_lang($language)
 352 {
 353     $langNameOfLang = get_locale('langNameOfLang');
 354     
 355     $localeLang = (!empty($langNameOfLang[$language])) ?
 356         (ucfirst($langNameOfLang[$language])) :
 357         (ucfirst($language));
 358     
 359     return $localeLang;
 360 }

  82     {
  83         parent::__construct();
  84         
  85         $this->userId = $userId;
  86     }
  87     
  88     public function getIterator()
  89     {
  90         $tbl_mdb_names              = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  91         $tbl_courses                = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
  92         $tbl_rel_course_user        = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user'];
  93         
  94         $sql = "SELECT
  95                 c.code                  AS courseId,
  96                 c.code                  AS sysCode,
  97                 c.cours_id              AS id,
  98                 c.isSourceCourse        AS isSourceCourse,
  99                 c.sourceCourseId        AS sourceCourseId,
 100                 c.intitule              AS name,
 101                 c.administrativeNumber  AS officialCode,
 102                 c.administrativeNumber  AS administrativeNumber,
 103                 c.directory             AS path,
 104                 c.dbName                AS dbName,
 105                 c.titulaires            AS titular,
 106                 c.email                 AS email,
 107                 c.language              AS language,
 108                 c.extLinkUrl            AS extLinkUrl,
 109                 c.extLinkName           AS extLinkName,
 110                 c.visibility            AS visibility,
 111                 c.access                AS access,
 112                 c.registration          AS registration,
 113                 c.registrationKey       AS registrationKey,
 114                 c.diskQuota             AS diskQuota,
 115                 UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.creationDate)      AS publicationDate,
 116                 UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.expirationDate)    AS expirationDate,
 117                 c.status                AS status,
 118                 c.userLimit             AS userLimit
 119                 
 120                 FROM `" . $tbl_courses . "` AS c
 121                 
 122                 JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_course_user . "` AS rcu
 123                 ON rcu.code_cours = c.code
 124                 AND rcu.user_id = " . (int) $this->userId . "
 125                 
 126                 ORDER BY " . $this->orderBy . " ASC";
 127         
 128         $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 129         
 130         return new CourseListIterator($result);
 131     }
 132 }

 304                 c.directory             AS path,

 306                 c.titulaires            AS titular,

 310                 c.extLinkName           AS extLinkName,
 311                 c.visibility            AS visibility,
 312                 c.access                AS access,
 313                 c.registration          AS registration,
 314                 c.registrationKey       AS registrationKey,
 315                 c.diskQuota             AS diskQuota,
 316                 UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.creationDate)      AS publicationDate,
 317                 UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.expirationDate)    AS expirationDate,
 318                 c.status                AS status,
 319                 c.userLimit             AS userLimit
 320                 
 321                 FROM `" . $tbl_courses . "` AS c
 322                 
 323                 WHERE UPPER(administrativeNumber) LIKE '%" . $upperKeyword . "%'
 324                 OR UPPER(intitule) LIKE '%" . $upperKeyword . "%'
 325                 OR UPPER(titulaires) LIKE '%" . $upperKeyword . "%'
 326                 
 327                 ORDER BY " . $this->orderBy . " ASC";
 328         
 329         $result = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);

 331         return new CourseListIterator($result);
 332     }

 350 /**
 351  * Manage source and session courses tree structure.
 352  * Is implemented in a way that can only handle a two level depth tree.
 353  * That's why the class is CourseTree and not Tree.
 354  */
 355 class CourseTree
 356 {
 357     /**
 358      * @var CourseTreeNode
 359      * @todo Not sure about the name of this var
 360      */
 361     protected $root;
 362     
 363     /**
 364      * Constructor.
 365      * @param CourseListIterator
 366      */
 367     public function __construct($courseListIterator)
 368     {
 369         // Root of the course tree
 370         $root = new CourseTreeNode(null);
 371         
 372         $tempNodesList = array();
 373         
 374         foreach ($courseListIterator as $course)
 375         {
 376             // Create a new course tree node
 377             $node = new CourseTreeNode($course->id);
 378             $node->setCourse($course);
 379             
 380             // Is it a source course ?
 381             if ($course->isSourceCourse)
 382             {
 383                 // Can we find it in the temp list ?
 384                 if (isset($tempNodesList[$course->id]))
 385                 {
 386                     $tempNodesList[$course->id]->setCourse($course);
 387                     
 388                     // Merge it from the temp list to the actual tree
 389                     $root->appendChild($tempNodesList[$course->id]);
 390                     unset($tempNodesList[$course->id]);
 391                 }
 392                 else
 393                 {
 394                     // Add it to the tree
 395                     $root->appendChild($node);
 396                 }
 397             }
 398             
 399             // Is it a session course ?
 400             elseif ($course->sourceCourseId)
 401             {
 402                 // Is the parent in the tree ?
 403                 if ($root->getChild($course->sourceCourseId))
 404                 {
 405                     // Append the child to its parent in the tree
 406                     $root->getChild($course->sourceCourseId)->appendChild($node);
 407                 }
 408                 // Is the parent in the temp list ?
 409                 elseif (isset($tempNodesList[$course->sourceCourseId]))
 410                 {
 411                     // Append the child to its parent in the temp list
 412                     $tempNodesList[$course->sourceCourseId]->appendChild($node);
 413                 }
 414                 else
 415                 {
 416                     // Add the parent and its child in the temp list
 417                     $parentNode = new CourseTreeNode($course->sourceCourseId);
 418                     $parentNode->appendChild($node);
 419                     
 420                     /*
 421                      * Note that the parent doesn't have any course data yet.
 422                      * Those data will have to be loaded later, when the parent
 423                      * will be found in the course list iterator
 424                      * ($courseListIterator), before getting merged in the tree.
 425                      */
 426                     $tempNodesList[$course->sourceCourseId] = $parentNode;
 427                 }
 428             }
 429             
 430             // It seems to be a regular course
 431             else
 432             {
 433                 // Add it to the tree
 434                 $root->appendChild($node);
 435             }
 436         }
 437         
 438         /*
 439          * The tree should be fully builded now BUT...
 440          * What if one (or more) session course don't have their parent
 441          * in the course list iterator ($courseListIterator) ?  That could
 442          * happen (on rare occasions), so it has to be supported.
 443          *
 444          * The nodes wich belong to what we'll call "unfound parents"
 445          * will be reasigned to an "adoptive parent" node and appended
 446          * at the end of the tree.
 447          */
 448         if (!empty($tempNodesList))
 449         {
 450             // Set an adoptive node
 451             $adoptiveParent = new CourseTreeNode(null);
 452             
 453             foreach ($tempNodesList as $unfoundParentNode)
 454             {
 455                 // If the unfound parent has children
 456                 if ($unfoundParentNode->hasChildren())
 457                 {
 458                     // Reasign each orphan node to the adoptive parent node
 459                     foreach ($unfoundParentNode->getChildren() as $orphanNode)
 460                     {
 461                         $adoptiveParent->appendChild($orphanNode);
 462                     }
 463                 }
 464                 
 465                 unset($unfoundParentNode);
 466             }
 467             
 468             // Append the adoptive parent node at the end of the tree
 469             $root->appendChild($adoptiveParent);
 470         }
 471         
 472         $this->root = $root;
 473     }
 474     
 475     /**
 476      * @return CourseTreeNode
 477      * @todo Not sure about the name of this method
 478      */
 479     public function getRootNode()
 480     {
 481         return $this->root;
 482     }
 483     
 484     public function __toString()
 485     {
 486         return $this->recursiveToString();
 487     }
 488     
 489     protected function recursiveToString($node = null, $level = 0)
 490     {
 491         $out = '';
 492         
 493         if (!isset($node))
 494         {
 495             $currentNode = $this->root;
 496         }
 497         else
 498         {
 499             $currentNode = $node;
 500             
 501             $out .= str_repeat('_', $level-1)
 502                   . get_lang('I\'m node <b>%id</b>', array('%id' => $currentNode->getId()))
 503                   . ($currentNode->hasChildren() ?
 504                         get_lang(
 505                             ' and i have %nbChildren children',
 506                             array('%nbChildren' => $currentNode->countChildren())
 507                         ) :
 508                         ''
 509                     )
 510                   . '<br />';
 511         }
 512         
 513         if ($currentNode->hasChildren())
 514         {
 515             $level++;
 516             foreach ($currentNode->getChildren() as $childNode)
 517             {
 518                 $out .= $this->recursiveToString($childNode, $level);
 519             }
 520         }
 521         
 522         return $out;
 523     }
 524 }
 525 
 526 
 527 class CourseTreeNode
 528 {
 529     /**
 530      * @var int
 531      */
 532     protected $id;
 533     
 534     /**
 535      * @var Claro_Course
 536      */
 537     protected $course;
 538     
 539     /**
 540      * @var array of CourseNode (array index: int course id)
 541      */
 542     protected $children;
 543     
 544     /**
 545      * Constructor.
 546      * @param int id
 547      */
 548     public function __construct($id)
 549     {
 550         $this->id = $id;
 551         $this->children = array();
 552     }
 553     
 554     /**
 555      * @param CourseTreeNode
 556      * @return $this for chaining
 557      */
 558     public function appendChild($node)
 559     {
 560         $this->children[$node->id] = $node;
 561         
 562         return $this;
 563     }
 564     
 565     /**
 566      * @return boolean
 567      */
 568     public function hasChildren()
 569     {
 570         return !empty($this->children);
 571     }
 572     
 573     /**
 574      * @return boolean
 575      */
 576     public function hasCourse()
 577     {
 578         return !empty($this->course);
 579     }
 580     
 581     /**
 582      * @return int number of children
 583      */
 584     public function countChildren()
 585     {
 586         return count($this->children);
 587     }
 588     
 589     /**
 590      * @return array of CourseTreeNode
 591      */
 592     public function getChildren()
 593     {
 594         return $this->children;
 595     }
 596     
 597     /**
 598      * @param int id
 599      * @return CourseTreeNode (null if doesn't exist)
 600      */
 601     public function getChild($id)
 602     {
 603         if (!empty($this->children[$id]))
 604         {
 605             return $this->children[$id];
 606         }
 607         else
 608         {
 609             return null;
 610         }
 611     }
 612     
 613     /**
 614      * @return Claro_Course (null if empty)
 615      */
 616     public function getCourse()
 617     {
 618         if (!empty($this->course))
 619         {
 620             return $this->course;
 621         }
 622         else
 623         {
 624             return null;
 625         }
 626     }
 627     
 628     /**
 629      * @return int node id
 630      */
 631     public function getId()
 632     {
 633         return $this->id;
 634     }
 635     
 636     /**
 637      * @param int node id
 638      * @return $this for chaining
 639      */
 640     public function setId($id)
 641     {
 642         $this->id = $id;
 643         
 644         return $this;
 645     }
 646     
 647     /**
 648      * @param Claro_Course
 649      * @return $this for chaining
 650      */
 651     public function setCourse($course)
 652     {
 653         $this->course = $course;
 654         
 655         return $this;
 656     }
 657 }

 660 /**
 661  * The CourseTreeView renders the base of a course tree.  The course tree 
 662  * contains nodes (CourseTreeNode) rendered through the CourseTreeNodeView 
 663  * class.
 664  */
 665 class CourseTreeView implements Display
 666 {
 667     /**
 668      * @var CourseTreeNode
 669      */
 670     protected $courseTreeRootNode;
 671     
 672     /**
 673      * @var CourseUserPrivilegesList
 674      */
 675     protected $courseUserPrivilegesList;
 676     
 677     /**
 678      * @var NotifiedCourseList
 679      */
 680     protected $notifiedCourseList;
 681     
 682     /**
 683      * @var Database_ResultSet list of categories
 684      */
 685     protected $categoryList;
 686     
 687     /**
 688      * @var int id of selected category to view
 689      */
 690     protected $selectedViewCategory;
 691     
 692     /**
 693      * @var CourseTreeViewOptions
 694      */
 695     protected $viewOptions;
 696     
 697     /**
 698      * Constructor.
 699      * If no CourseTreeViewOptions is set, the constructor will 
 700      * create set a default CourseTreeViewOptions.
 701      * 
 702      * @param CourseTree
 703      * @param CourseUserPrivilegesList (default: null)
 704      * @param NotifiedCourseList (default: null)
 705      * @param Database_ResultSet list of categories (default: null)
 706      * @param int id of selected category (default: null)
 707      * @param CourseTreeViewOptions (default: null)
 708      */
 709     public function __construct(
 710         $courseTreeNode,
 711         $courseUserPrivilegesList = null,
 712         $notifiedCourseList = null,
 713         $categoryList = null, 
 714         $selectedViewCategory = null, 
 715         $viewOptions = null)
 716     {
 717         $this->courseTreeRootNode = $courseTreeNode;
 718         $this->courseUserPrivilegesList = $courseUserPrivilegesList;
 719         $this->notifiedCourseList = $notifiedCourseList;
 720         $this->categoryList = $categoryList;
 721         $this->selectedViewCategory = $selectedViewCategory;
 722         $this->viewOptions = isset($viewOptions) ? 
 723             $viewOptions : new CourseTreeViewOptions();
 724     }
 725     
 726     /**
 727      * @return CourseTreeViewOptions
 728      */
 729     public function getViewOptions()
 730     {
 731         return $this->viewOptions;
 732     }
 733     
 734     /**
 735      * @param CourseTreeViewOptions
 736      */

 960 class CourseTreeNodeViewFactory
 961 {
 962     /**
 963      * Get the complete course tree of a specific user.
 964      * 
 965      * @param int user id
 966      * @return CourseTreeView
 967      */
 968     static public function getUserCourseTreeView($userId)
 969     {
 970         // CourseListIterator
 971         $courseList = new UserCourseList($userId);
 972         $courseListIterator = $courseList->getIterator();
 973         
 974         // User rights
 975         $privilegeList = new CourseUserPrivilegesList($userId);
 976         $privilegeList->load();
 977         
 978         // Hot courses
 979         $notifiedCourseList = new NotifiedCourseList($userId);
 980         
 981         // User categories
 982         $userCategoryList = ClaroCategory::getUserCategories($userId);
 983         
 984         // Selected category
 985         $selectedCategoryId = isset($_REQUEST['viewCategory']) ? 
 986             (int) $_REQUEST['viewCategory'] : 
 987             null;
 988         
 989         // Course tree
 990         $courseTree = new CourseTree($courseListIterator);
 991         
 992         // View
 993         $courseTreeView = new CourseTreeView(
 994             $courseTree->getRootNode(), 
 995             $privilegeList,
 996             $notifiedCourseList, 
 997             $userCategoryList,
 998             $selectedCategoryId, 
 999             null);
1000         
1001         return $courseTreeView;
1002     }
1003     
1004     /**
1005      * Get the complete course tree of a specific category.
1006      * If you wish to display enroll links regarding another user than the 
1007      * current one, you can specify another user id in the method's params.
1008      * This is useful when, for instance, you are a platform admin enrolling 
1009      * another user to some courses.
1010      * 
1011      * @param int category id
1012      * @param int user id
1013      * @return CourseTreeView 
1014      */
1015     static public function getCategoryCourseTreeView($categoryId, $userId = null)
1016     {
1017         $userId = empty($userId) ? claro_get_current_user_id() : $userId;
1018         
1019         // CourseListIterator
1020         $courseList = new CategoryCourseList($categoryId);
1021         $courseListIterator = $courseList->getIterator();
1022         
1023         // User rights
1024         $privilegeList = new CourseUserPrivilegesList($userId);
1025         $privilegeList->load();
1026         
1027         // Course tree
1028         $courseTree = new CourseTree($courseListIterator);
1029         
1030         // View
1031         $courseTreeView = new CourseTreeView(
1032             $courseTree->getRootNode(), 
1033             $privilegeList, 
1034             null,
1035             null,
1036             null,
1037             null);
1038         
1039         return $courseTreeView;
1040     }
1041     
1042     /**
1043      * Get the complete course tree of a specific category and for a specific 
1044      * user.  
1045      * Note that only the courses contained in the category and for which the 
1046      * user is enrolled will be in the result.
1047      * 
1048      * @param int user id
1049      * @param int category id
1050      * @return CourseTreeView 
1051      */
1052     static public function getUserCategoryCourseTreeView($userId, $categoryId)
1053     {
1054         // CourseListIterator
1055         $courseList = new UserCategoryCourseList($userId, $categoryId);
1056         $courseListIterator = $courseList->getIterator();
1057         
1058         // User rights
1059         $privilegeList = new CourseUserPrivilegesList($userId);
1060         $privilegeList->load();
1061         
1062         // Hot courses
1063         $notifiedCourseList = new NotifiedCourseList($userId);
1064         
1065         // User categories
1066         $userCategoryList = ClaroCategory::getUserCategories($userId);
1067         
1068         // Selected category
1069         $selectedCategoryId = isset($_REQUEST['viewCategory']) ? 
1070             (int) $_REQUEST['viewCategory'] : 
1071             null;
1072         
1073         // Course tree
1074         $courseTree = new CourseTree($courseListIterator);
1075         
1076         // View
1077         $courseTreeView = new CourseTreeView(
1078             $courseTree->getRootNode(), 
1079             $privilegeList,
1080             $notifiedCourseList, 
1081             $userCategoryList,
1082             $selectedCategoryId,
1083             null);
1084         
1085         return $courseTreeView;
1086     }
1087     
1088     /**
1089      * Get the complete course tree of a specific keyword.
1090      * 
1091      * @param string keyword
1092      * @return CourseTreeView 
1093      */
1094     static public function getSearchedCourseTreeView($keyword)
1095     {
1096         // CourseListIterator

1101         $privilegeList = new CourseUserPrivilegesList(claro_get_current_user_id());
1102         $privilegeList->load();

   5 /**
   6  * CLAROLINE
   7  *
   8  * Claroline User Privileges in Courses.
   9  *

  15  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  16  * @package     kernel.course
  17  * @since       Claroline 1.11
  18  */
  19 
  20 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../utils/iterators.lib.php';
  21 
  22 /**
  23  * This class represents one user's privileges in a course.
  24  *
  25  * WARNING! this class behaves differently than the init.lib function
  26  * claro_get_course_user_privilege() :
  27  *  1) the platform admin status is not taken into account when evaluating
  28  *      isCourseManager;
  29  *  2) isPending is not taken into account when evaluating isCourseMember
  30  */
  31 class CourseUserPrivileges
  32 {
  33     protected
  34         $userId,
  35         $courseId;
  36     
  37     protected
  38         $_profileId,
  39         $is_courseAdmin,
  40         $is_courseTutor,
  41         $is_coursePending,
  42         $is_courseMember;
  43     
  44     /**
  45      * Constructor
  46      * @param string $courseId course system code
  47      * @param int $userId user id
  48      */
  49     public function __construct( $courseId, $userId )
  50     {
  51         $this->userId = $userId;
  52         $this->courseId = $courseId;
  53     }
  54     
  55     public function load()
  56     {
  57         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  58         
  59         $cuData = Claroline::getDatabase()->query("
  60             SELECT
  61                 cu.profile_id AS profileId,
  62                 cu.isCourseManager,
  63                 cu.isPending,
  64                 cu.tutor
  65             FROM
  66                 `{$tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user']}` `cu`
  67             WHERE
  68                 cu.`user_id`  = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->escape($this->userId) . "
  69             AND
  70                 cu.`code_cours` = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($this->courseId))->fetch();
  71 
  72         if ( !empty($cuData) )
  73         {
  74             $this->_profileId        = $cuData['profileId'];
  75             $this->is_coursePending  = (bool) ($cuData['isPending' ]);
  76             $this->is_courseMember   = true;
  77             $this->is_courseTutor    = (bool) ($cuData['tutor'] == 1 );
  78             $this->is_courseAdmin    = (bool) ($cuData['isCourseManager'] == 1 );
  79         }
  80         else // this user has no status related to this course
  81         {
  82             $this->_profileId        = claro_get_profile_id('guest');
  83             $this->is_coursePending  = false;
  84             $this->is_courseMember   = false;
  85             $this->is_courseTutor    = false;
  86             $this->is_courseAdmin    = false;
  87         }
  88     }
  89     
  90     /**
  91      * Is the user a course manager ?
  92      * @return bool
  93      */
  94     public function isCourseManager()
  95     {
  96         return $this->is_courseAdmin;
  97     }
  98     
  99     /**
 100      * Is the user a member of the course ?
 101      * @return bool
 102      */
 103     public function isCourseMember()
 104     {
 105         return $this->is_courseMember;
 106     }
 107     
 108     /**
 109      * Is the user's enrolment in the course pending ?
 110      * @return bool
 111      */
 112     public function isEnrolmentPending()
 113     {
 114         return $this->is_coursePending;
 115     }
 116     
 117     /**
 118      * Is the user a tutor within the course
 119      * @return bool
 120      */
 121     public function isCourseTutor()
 122     {
 123         return $this->is_courseTutor;
 124     }
 125     
 126     /**
 127      * Get the user's profile id in the course
 128      * @return int
 129      */
 130     public function getProfileId()
 131     {
 132         return $this->_profileId;
 133     }
 134     
 135     public function getUserId()
 136     {
 137         return $this->userId;
 138     }
 139     
 140     public function  getCourseId()
 141     {
 142         return $this->courseId;
 143     }
 144     
 145     public static function fromArray( $courseId, $userId = null, $data = null )
 146     {
 147         $priv = new self( $courseId, $userId );
 148         
 149         if ( !empty($data) )
 150         {
 151             $priv->_profileId        = $data['profileId'];
 152             $priv->is_coursePending  = (bool) ($data['isPending' ]);
 153             $priv->is_courseMember   = true;
 154             $priv->is_courseTutor    = (bool) ($data['tutor'] == 1 );
 155             $priv->is_courseAdmin    = (bool) ($data['isCourseManager'] == 1 );
 156         }
 157         else
 158         {
 159             $priv->_profileId        = claro_get_profile_id('guest');
 160             $priv->is_coursePending  = false;
 161             $priv->is_courseMember   = false;
 162             $priv->is_courseTutor    = false;
 163             $priv->is_courseAdmin    = false;
 164         }
 165         
 166         return $priv;
 167     }
 168 }

 170 class CourseAnonymousUserPrivileges extends CourseUserPrivileges
 171 {

 174         parent::__construct($courseId, null);

 195 class CourseUserPrivilegesList
 196 {
 197     protected $userId, $coursePrivilegesList;
 198     
 199     public function __construct( $userId = null )
 200     {
 201         $this->userId = $userId;
 202         $this->coursePrivilegesList = array();
 203     }
 204     
 205     public function load()
 206     {
 207         if ( $this->userId )
 208         {
 209             $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 210 
 211             $coursePrivilegesList = Claroline::getDatabase()->query("
 212                 SELECT
 213                     cu.code_cours AS courseId,
 214                     cu.profile_id AS profileId,
 215                     cu.isCourseManager,
 216                     cu.isPending,
 217                     cu.tutor
 218                 FROM
 219                     `{$tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user']}` `cu`
 220                 WHERE
 221                     cu.`user_id`  = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->escape($this->userId) );
 222 
 223             foreach ( $coursePrivilegesList as $coursePrivileges )
 224             {
 225                 $this->coursePrivilegesList[$coursePrivileges['courseId']] = $coursePrivileges;
 226             }
 227         }
 228     }
 229     
 230     public function getCoursePrivileges( $courseCode )
 231     {
 232         if ( ! $this->userId )
 233         {
 234             $priv = CourseAnonymousUserPrivileges::fromArray( $courseCode );
 235         }
 236         else
 237         {
 238             if ( isset( $this->coursePrivilegesList[$courseCode] ) )
 239             {
 240                 $priv = CourseUserPrivileges::fromArray($courseCode, $this->userId, $this->coursePrivilegesList[$courseCode] );
 241             }
 242             else
 243             {
 244                 $priv = CourseUserPrivileges::fromArray($courseCode, $this->userId);
 245             }
 246         }
 247         
 248         return $priv;
 249     }
 250     
 251     public function getIterator()
 252     {
 253         $it = new CourseUserPrivilegesIterator( $this->userId, $this->coursePrivilegesList );
 254         
 255         return $it;
 256     }
 257 }
 258 
 259 class CourseUserPrivilegesIterator extends RowToObjectArrayIterator
 260 {
 261     public function __construct( $userId, $array )
 262     {
 263         $this->userId = $userId;
 264         
 265         parent::__construct($array);
 266     }
 267     
 268     public function current()
 269     {
 270         $data = $this->collection[$this->key()];
 271         
 272         if ( !isset( $data['courseId'] ) )
 273         {
 274             throw new Exception("Missing courseId in data");
 275         }
 276         
 277         if ( $this->userId )
 278         {
 279             return CourseUserPrivileges::fromArray( $data['courseId'], $this->userId, $data );
 280         }
 281         else
 282         {
 283             return CourseAnonymousUserPrivileges::fromArray( $data['courseId'] );
 284         }
 285     }
 286 }

   7 /**

   9  *
  10  * Course user library contains function to manage users registration and properties in course

  12  * @version     $Revision: 14516 $

  22 /**
  23  * Subscribe a specific user to a specific course.  If this course is a session
  24  * course, the user will also be subscribed to the source course.
  25  * 
  26  * Helper for Claro_CourseUserRegistration
  27  *
  28  * @param int $userId user ID from the course_user table
  29  * @param string $courseCode course code from the cours table
  30  * @param boolean $admin
  31  * @param boolean $tutor
  32  * @param int $class_id
  33  * @return boolean TRUE  if it succeeds, FALSE otherwise
  34  */
  35 
  36 function user_add_to_course(
  37     $userId, $courseCode, $admin = false, $tutor = false,
  38     $class_id = null )
  39 {
  40     $courseObj = new Claro_Course($courseCode);
  41     $courseObj->load();
  42     
  43     $courseRegistration = new Claro_CourseUserRegistration(
  44         AuthProfileManager::getUserAuthProfile($userId),
  45         $courseObj,
  46         null,
  47         null
  48     );
  49     
  50     if ( $admin )
  51     {
  52         $courseRegistration->setCourseAdmin();
  53     }
  54     
  55     if ( $tutor )
  56     {
  57         $courseRegistration->setCourseTutor();
  58     }
  59     
  60     if ( $class_id )
  61     {
  62         $claroClass = new Claro_Class();
  63         $claroClass->load($class_id);
  64         $courseRegistration->setClass( $claroClass );
  65     }
  66     
  67     $courseRegistration->ignoreRegistrationKeyCheck();
  68     
  69     if ( $courseRegistration->addUser() )
  70     {
  71         return true;
  72     }
  73     else
  74     {
  75         // @todo should throw an exception here
  76         Console::error(
  77             "Cannot register user {$userId} in course {$courseCode} ["
  78             . $courseRegistration->getStatus() . ":"
  79             . $courseRegistration->getErrorMessage()."]" );
  80             
  81         return false;
  82     }
  83 }
  84 
  85 /**
  86  * Check if the registration flag of the given course set to "open"
  87  * or "validation", if the course statut is "enable" or "date"
  88  * and, in this case, if we are in the date limits.
  89  * @author Hugues Peeters <hugues.peeters@advalvas.be>
  90  * @param string $courseId - sys code of the course
  91  * @return boolean
  92  */
  93 
  94 function is_course_registration_allowed($courseId)
  95 {
  96     $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  97     $tbl_course = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
  98     
  99     $curdate = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time());
 100     
 101     $sql = "
 102         SELECT count(*) AS registration_allowed
 103         FROM `" . $tbl_course . "` AS `course`
 104         WHERE `course`.`code` = '" . claro_sql_escape($courseId) . "'
 105         AND (
 106               `course`.`registration` = 'open'
 107               OR
 108               `course`.`registration` = 'validation'
 109             )
 110         AND ( `course`.`status` = 'enable'
 111                 OR (
 112                      `course`.`status` = 'date'
 113                         AND (
 114                               `course`.`creationDate` < '". $curdate ."'
 115                               OR
 116                               `course`.`creationDate` IS NULL OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP( `course`.`creationDate` ) = 0
 117                             )
 118                         AND (
 119                               '". $curdate ."' < `course`.`expirationDate`
 120                               OR
 121                               `course`.`expirationDate` IS NULL
 122                             )
 123                     )
 124             )";
 125     
 126     $courseRegistrationList = claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sql);
 127     
 128     return (bool) ($courseRegistrationList) ;
 129 }

 158 /**
 159  * unsubscribe a specific user from a specific course
 160  *
 161  *
 162  * @param  int     $user_id        user ID from the course_user table
 163  * @param  mixed (string or array) $courseCodeList course sys code
 164  * @param  boolean $force  true  possible to remove a course admin from course
 165  *                        (default false)
 166  * @param  boolean $deleteTrackingData (default false)
 167  *
 168  * @return boolean TRUE        if unsubscribtion succeed
 169  *         boolean FALSE       otherwise.
 170  */
 171 function user_remove_from_course( $userId, $courseCodeList = array(), $force = false, $delTrackData = false, $class_id = null)
 172 {
 173     if ( ! is_array($courseCodeList) ) $courseCodeList = array($courseCodeList);
 174     
 175     if ( $class_id )
 176     {
 177         $claroClass = new Claro_Class();
 178         $claroClass->load($class_id);
 179     }
 180     else
 181     {
 182         $claroClass = null;
 183     }
 184     
 185     $allWorksWell = true;
 186     
 187     foreach ( $courseCodeList as $courseCode )
 188     {
 189         $course = new Claro_Course( $courseCode );
 190         $course->load();
 191         
 192         $userCourseRegistration = new Claro_CourseUserRegistration(
 193             AuthProfileManager::getUserAuthProfile($userId),
 194             $course
 195         );
 196         
 197         if ( $force )
 198         {
 199             $userCourseRegistration->forceUnregistrationOfManager();
 200         }
 201         
 202         if ( !is_null( $claroClass ) )
 203         {
 204             $userCourseRegistration->setClass( $claroClass );
 205         }
 206         
 207         $keepTrackingData = !$delTrackData;
 208         
 209         if ( !$userCourseRegistration->removeUser( $keepTrackingData, array() ) )
 210         {
 211             Console::warning("Cannot remove user {$userId} from {$courseCode}");
 212             $allWorksWell = false;
 213         }
 214     }
 215     
 216     return $allWorksWell;
 217 }

 219 /**
 220  * delete a list of user id from a list of courses
 221  * @param array $userIdList list of user id to remove
 222  * @param array|string $courseCodeList array of course codes or one single course code
 223  * @param bool $force forece the deletion
 224  * @param bool $delTrackData delete tracking data
 225  * @param bool $unregister_by_class unregister by class
 226  * @return int number of deleted users
 227  */
 228 function user_remove_userlist_from_course( $userIdList, $courseCodeList = array(), $force = false, $delTrackData = false, $unregister_by_class = false)
 229 {
 230     $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 231     $userDeletedCount = 0;
 232 
 233     if ( ! is_array($courseCodeList) ) $courseCodeList = array($courseCodeList);
 234     
 235     foreach ( $userIdList as $userIdToProcess )
 236     {
 237         $userId = is_numeric( $userIdToProcess ) ? $userIdToProcess : $userIdToProcess['user_id'];
 238         
 239         if ( ! $force && $userId == $GLOBALS['_uid'] )
 240         {
 241             // PREVIOUSLY CHECK THE USER IS NOT COURSE ADMIN OF THESE COURSES
 242 
 243             $sql = "SELECT COUNT(user_id)
 244                     FROM `" . $tbl['rel_course_user'] . "`
 245                     WHERE user_id = ". (int) $userId ."
 246                       AND isCourseManager = 1
 247                       AND code_cours IN ('" . implode("', '", array_map('claro_sql_escape', $courseCodeList) ) . "') ";
 248 
 249             if ( claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sql)  > 0 )
 250             {
 251                 Claroline::getInstance()->log( 'DELETE_USER_FAILED' , array ('USER' => $userId, 'failure' => 'course_manager_cannot_unsubscribe_himself') );
 252                 continue;
 253             }
 254         }
 255 
 256         $sql = "SELECT code_cours , count_user_enrol, count_class_enrol
 257                 FROM `" . $tbl['rel_course_user'] . "`
 258                 WHERE `code_cours` IN ('" . implode("', '", array_map('claro_sql_escape', $courseCodeList) ) . "')
 259                 AND   `user_id` = " . $userId ;
 260 
 261         $userEnrolCourseList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 262 
 263         foreach ( $userEnrolCourseList as $thisUserEnrolCourse )
 264         {
 265 
 266             $thisCourseCode    = $thisUserEnrolCourse['code_cours'];
 267             $count_user_enrol  = $thisUserEnrolCourse['count_user_enrol'];
 268             $count_class_enrol = $thisUserEnrolCourse['count_class_enrol'];
 269 
 270             if ( ( $count_user_enrol + $count_class_enrol ) <= 1 )
 271             {
 272                 // remove user from course
 273                 if ( user_remove_from_group($userId, $thisCourseCode) == false ) return false;
 274 
 275                 $dbNameGlued   = claro_get_course_db_name_glued($thisCourseCode);
 276                 $tbl_cdb_names = claro_sql_get_course_tbl($dbNameGlued);
 277 
 278                 $tbl_bb_notify         = $tbl_cdb_names['bb_rel_topic_userstonotify'];
 279                 $tbl_group_team        = $tbl_cdb_names['group_team'         ];
 280                 $tbl_userinfo_content  = $tbl_cdb_names['userinfo_content'   ];
 281 
 282                $sqlList = array();
 283                $toolCLFRM =  get_module_data('CLFRM');
 284 
 285                if (is_tool_activated_in_course($toolCLFRM['id'],$thisUserEnrolCourse['code_cours']))
 286                {
 287                    $sqlList = array(
 288                         "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl_bb_notify        . "` WHERE user_id = " . (int) $userId );
 289                }
 290 
 291                 array_push($sqlList,
 292                 "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl_userinfo_content . "` WHERE user_id = " . (int) $userId ,
 293                 // change tutor to NULL for the course WHERE the tutor is the user to delete
 294                 "UPDATE `" . $tbl_group_team . "` SET `tutor` = NULL WHERE `tutor`='" . (int) $userId . "'"
 295                 );
 296 
 297                 foreach( $sqlList as $thisSql )
 298                 {
 299                     if ( claro_sql_query($thisSql) == false ) continue;
 300                 }
 301 
 302                 if ($delTrackData)
 303                 {
 304                     if ( user_delete_course_tracking_data($userId, $thisCourseCode) == false) continue;
 305                 }
 306 
 307                 $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl['rel_course_user'] . "`
 308                     WHERE user_id = " . (int) $userId . "
 309                       AND code_cours = '" . claro_sql_escape($thisCourseCode) . "'";
 310 
 311                 if ( claro_sql_query($sql) == false ) continue;
 312             }
 313             else
 314             {
 315                 // decrement the count of registration by the user or class
 316                 if ( ! $unregister_by_class )  $count_user_enrol--;
 317                 else                           $count_class_enrol--;
 318 
 319                 // update enrol count in table rel_course_user
 320 
 321                 $sql = "UPDATE `".$tbl['rel_course_user']."`
 322                           SET `count_user_enrol` = '" . $count_user_enrol . "',
 323                             `count_class_enrol` = '" . $count_class_enrol . "'
 324                           WHERE `user_id`   =  " . (int) $userId . "
 325                           AND  `code_cours` = '" . claro_sql_escape($thisCourseCode) . "'";
 326 
 327                 if ( !claro_sql_query($sql) ) continue;
 328 
 329             }
 330         }
 331         
 332         $userDeletedCount++;
 333     }
 334 
 335     return $userDeletedCount;
 336 }

 388 /**
 389  * change the status of the user in a course
 390  * @author Hugues Peeters <hugues.peeters@advalvas.be>
 391  *
 392  * @param $userId       integer user ID from the course_user table
 393  * @param $courseId     string course code from the cours table
 394  * @param $propertyList array should contain 'role', 'profileId', 'isCOurseManager', 'tutor'
 395  *
 396  * @return boolean TRUE if update succeed, FALSE otherwise.
 397  */
 398 
 399 function user_set_course_properties($userId, $courseId, $propertyList)
 400 {
 401     $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 402 
 403     $setList = array();
 404 
 405     if ( array_key_exists('isCourseManager', $propertyList) )
 406     {
 407         if ( $propertyList['isCourseManager'] ) $propertyList['profileId'] = claro_get_profile_id('manager') ;
 408     }
 409 
 410     if ( array_key_exists('profileId', $propertyList) )
 411     {
 412         $setList[] = "profile_id = '" . (int) $propertyList['profileId'] . "'";
 413 
 414         if ( $propertyList['profileId'] == claro_get_profile_id('manager') ) $propertyList['isCourseManager'] = 1 ;
 415         else                                                                 $propertyList['isCourseManager'] = 0 ;
 416     }
 417 
 418     if ( array_key_exists('isCourseManager', $propertyList) )
 419     {
 420         if ( $propertyList['isCourseManager'] ) $setList[] = 'isCourseManager = 1';
 421         else                                    $setList[] = 'isCourseManager = 0';
 422     }
 423 
 424     if ( array_key_exists('tutor', $propertyList) )
 425     {
 426         if ( $propertyList['tutor'] ) $setList[] = 'tutor = 1';
 427         else                          $setList[] = 'tutor = 0';
 428     }
 429 
 430     if ( array_key_exists('role', $propertyList) )
 431     {
 432         $setList[] = "role = '" . claro_sql_escape($propertyList['role']) . "'";
 433     }
 434 
 435     if ( count($setList) > 0 )
 436     {
 437         $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl['rel_course_user'] . "`
 438                 SET " . implode(', ', $setList) ."
 439                 WHERE   `user_id`    = " . (int) $userId . "
 440                 AND     `code_cours` = '" . claro_sql_escape($courseId) . "'";
 441 
 442         if ( claro_sql_query_affected_rows($sql) > 0 ) return true;
 443         else                                           return false;
 444     }
 445 
 446     return false;
 447 }

 533 /**
 534  * get the main user information
 535  * @param  integer $user_id user id as stored in the claroline main db
 536  * @return array   containing user info as 'lastName', 'firstName'
 537  *           'email', 'role'
 538  */
 539 
 540 function course_user_get_properties($userId, $courseId)
 541 {
 542     if (0 == (int) $userId)
 543     {
 544         return false;
 545     }
 546 
 547     $tbl_mdb_names       = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 548     $tbl_user            = $tbl_mdb_names['user'];
 549     $tbl_rel_course_user = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user'];
 550     $tbl_course          = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
 551 
 552     $sql = "SELECT  u.nom        AS lastName,
 553                     u.prenom     AS firstName,
 554                     u.email      AS email,
 555                     u.officialEmail  AS officialEmail,
 556                     u.pictureUri AS picture,
 557                     cu.profile_id AS profileId,
 558                     cu.role      AS role,
 559                     cu.isCourseManager ,
 560                     cu.tutor     AS isTutor,
 561                     c.intitule   AS courseName
 562             FROM    `" . $tbl_user            . "` AS u,
 563                     `" . $tbl_rel_course_user . "` AS cu,
 564                     `" . $tbl_course . "` AS c
 565             WHERE   u.user_id = cu.user_id
 566             AND     u.user_id = " . (int) $userId . "
 567             AND     cu.code_cours = '" . claro_sql_escape($courseId) . "'
 568             AND     c.code = cu.code_cours ";
 569 
 570     $result = claro_sql_query($sql);
 571 
 572     if (mysql_num_rows($result) > 0)
 573     {
 574         $userInfo = mysql_fetch_array($result, MYSQL_ASSOC);
 575         return $userInfo;
 576     }
 577 
 578     return false;
 579 }

 673 /**
 674  * return the list of user of the course in parameter. It use by default the
 675  * current course identification
 676  *
 677  * @param string $courseCode course identication
 678  * @return array of int
 679  */
 680 function claro_get_course_user_list($courseCode = NULL)
 681 {
 682     if($courseCode == NULL)
 683     {
 684         $courseCode = claro_get_current_course_id();
 685     }
 686     
 687     $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 688 
 689     $tbl_rel_course_user = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user'  ];
 690     $tbl_users           = $tbl_mdb_names['user'             ];
 691     
 692     $sqlGetUsers = "SELECT `user`.`user_id`      AS `user_id`,
 693                        `user`.`nom`          AS `nom`,
 694                        `user`.`prenom`       AS `prenom`,
 695                        `user`.`email`        AS `email`,
 696                        `course_user`.`profile_id`,
 697                        `course_user`.`isCourseManager`,
 698                        `course_user`.`tutor`  AS `tutor`,
 699                        `course_user`.`role`   AS `role`
 700                FROM `" . $tbl_users . "`           AS user,
 701                     `" . $tbl_rel_course_user . "` AS course_user
 702                WHERE `user`.`user_id`=`course_user`.`user_id`
 703                AND   `course_user`.`code_cours`='" . claro_sql_escape($courseCode) . "'
 704                ORDER BY `user`.`nom`,  `user`.`prenom` ;";
 705     
 706     return claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sqlGetUsers);
 707 }

 753 /**
 754  * Course enrolment validation class
 755  */
 756 class UserCourseEnrolmentValidation
 757 {
 758     const 
 759         ENROLMENT_PENDING = 1,
 760         ENROLMENT_NOTPENDING = 0;
 761 
 762     
 763     protected 
 764         $privileges, 
 765         $course, 
 766         $isPending, 
 767         $validationCanBeChanged;
 768     
 769     
 770     public function __construct( $course, $privileges )
 771     {
 772         $this->privileges = $privileges;    
 773         $this->course = $course;
 774         
 775         if ( ( $this->privileges->isCourseManager() && !$this->privileges->isEnrolmentPending() ) 
 776             || !$this->privileges->isCourseMember()  )
 777         {
 778             $this->validationCanBeChanged = false;
 779         }
 780         else
 781         {
 782             $this->validationCanBeChanged = true;
 783             
 784             if ( $this->privileges->isEnrolmentPending() )
 785             {
 786                 $this->isPending = self::ENROLMENT_PENDING;
 787             }
 788             else
 789             {
 790                 $this->isPending = self::ENROLMENT_NOTPENDING;
 791             }
 792         }
 793     }
 794     
 795     public function isModifiable()
 796     {
 797         return $this->validationCanBeChanged;
 798     }
 799     
 800     public function isPending()
 801     {
 802         return $this->isPending;
 803     }
 804     
 805     public function grant()
 806     {
 807         return $this->changeValidation(self::ENROLMENT_NOTPENDING);
 808     }
 809     
 810     public function revoke()
 811     {
 812         return $this->changeValidation(self::ENROLMENT_PENDING);
 813     }
 814     
 815     protected function changeValidation( $pendingStatus )
 816     {
 817         if (!$this->isModifiable())
 818         {
 819             throw new Exception("Cannot change user "
 820                 . $this->privileges->getUserId()
 821                 ." enrolment validation in course " 
 822                 . $this->privileges->getCourseId() );
 823         }
 824         
 825         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 826 
 827         $updated = Claroline::getDatabase()->exec("
 828                 UPDATE 
 829                     `{$tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user']}` AS rcu
 830                 SET 
 831                     isPending = " . $pendingStatus . "
 832                 WHERE 
 833                     `rcu`.`user_id` = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->escape($this->privileges->getUserId()) . "
 834                 AND 
 835                     `code_cours` = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($this->privileges->getCourseId()) );
 836 
 837         if ($updated)
 838         {
 839             if ( $this->course->sourceCourseId )
 840             {
 841                 $sourceCourseRegistrationValidation = new self( 
 842                     ClaroCourse::getCodeFromId( $this->course->sourceCourseId ),
 843                     $this->privileges->getUserId()
 844                 );
 845                 
 846                 $sourceCourseRegistrationValidation->changeValidation( $pendingStatus );
 847             }
 848             
 849             return true;
 850         }
 851         else
 852         {
 853             return false;
 854         }
 855     }
 856 }

  17 /**
  18  * Search a specific course based on his course code.  If the user isn't
  19  * a platform admin, this function will not return source courses having
  20  * session courses.
  21  *
  22  * @param  string       $keyword course code from the cours table
  23  * @param  mixed        $userId  null or valid id of a user (default:null)
  24  * @return array        course parameters
  25  * @deprecated use SearchedCourseList instead
  26  */
  27 function search_course ( $keyword, $userId = null )
  28 {
  29     $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl ();
  30     $tbl_course = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'course' ];
  31     $tbl_rel_course_user = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'rel_course_user' ];
  32 
  33     $keyword = trim ( $keyword );
  34 
  35     if ( empty ( $keyword ) )
  36         return array ( );
  37 
  38     $upperKeyword = addslashes ( strtoupper ( $keyword ) );
  39 
  40     $curdate = date ( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time () );
  41 
  42     $sql = "SELECT c.cours_id             AS id,
  43                    c.intitule             AS title,
  44                    c.titulaires           AS titular,
  45                    c.code                 AS sysCode,
  46                    c.sourceCourseId       AS souceCourseId,
  47                    c.administrativeNumber AS officialCode,
  48                    c.directory            AS directory,
  49                    c.code                 AS code,
  50                    c.language             AS language,
  51                    c.email                AS email,
  52                    c.sourceCourseId,
  53                    c.visibility,
  54                    c.access,
  55                    c.registration,
  56                    c.status,
  57                    c.creationDate,
  58                    c.expirationDate"
  59         . ($userId ? ",
  60                    cu.user_id AS enroled,
  61                    cu.isCourseManager" : "")
  62         . " \n "
  63         . "FROM `" . $tbl_course . "` c "
  64         . " \n "
  65         . ($userId ? "LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_course_user . "` AS cu
  66                         ON  c.code = cu.code_cours
  67                         AND cu.user_id = " . (int) $userId : "")
  68         . " \n "
  69         . "WHERE ( "
  70         . (claro_is_platform_admin () ? '' :
  71             "(visibility = 'VISIBLE'
  72                 AND ( `status`='enable'
  73                         OR ( `status` = 'date'
  74                             AND ( `creationDate` < '" . $curdate . "'
  75                                 OR `creationDate` IS NULL
  76                                 OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`creationDate`) = 0
  77                                 )
  78                             AND ( '" . $curdate . "' < `expirationDate`
  79                                 OR `expirationDate` IS NULL
  80                                 )
  81                             )
  82                     )
  83             "
  84             . ( $userId ? " OR cu.user_id " : "")
  85             . " ) AND "
  86         )
  87         . "
  88             ( UPPER(administrativeNumber)   LIKE '%" . $upperKeyword . "%'
  89                 OR UPPER(intitule)              LIKE '%" . $upperKeyword . "%'
  90                 OR UPPER(titulaires)            LIKE '%" . $upperKeyword . "%'
  91                 )"
  92         . "
  93             )
  94             ORDER BY officialCode";
  95 
  96     $coursesList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all ( $sql );
  97 
  98     if ( count ( $coursesList ) > 0 )
  99     {
 100         //If not platform admin, remove source courses
 101         if ( !claro_is_platform_admin () )
 102         {
 103             // Find the source courses identifiers
 104             $sourceCoursesIds = array ( );
 105             foreach ( $coursesList as $course )
 106             {
 107                 if ( !is_null ( $course[ 'sourceCourseId' ] )
 108                     && !in_array ( $course[ 'sourceCourseId' ], $sourceCoursesIds ) )
 109                 {
 110                     $sourceCoursesIds[ ] = $course[ 'sourceCourseId' ];
 111                 }
 112             }
 113 
 114             $filteredCoursesList = array ( );
 115             foreach ( $coursesList as $course )
 116             {
 117                 if ( !in_array ( $course[ 'id' ], $sourceCoursesIds ) )
 118                     $filteredCoursesList[ ] = $course;
 119             }
 120 
 121             return $filteredCoursesList;
 122         }
 123         else
 124         {
 125             return $coursesList;
 126         }
 127     }
 128     else
 129     {
 130         return array ( );
 131     }
 132 }

 134 /**
 135  * Return course list of a user.
 136  *
 137  * @param int $userId valid id of a user
 138  * @param boolean $renew whether true, force to read databaseingoring an existing cache (default: false)
 139  * @param boolean $categories wheter true, get categories informations (default: false)
 140  * @return array (list of course) of array (course settings) of the given user
 141  * @todo search and merge other instance of this functionality (claro_get_user_course_list())
 142  * @deprecated use UserCourseList instead
 143  */
 144 function get_user_course_list ( $userId, $renew = false, $categories = false )
 145 {
 146     static $cached_uid = null, $userCourseList = null;
 147 
 148     if ( $cached_uid != $userId || is_null ( $userCourseList ) || $renew )
 149     {
 150         $cached_uid = $userId;
 151 
 152         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl ();
 153         $tbl_courses = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'course' ];
 154         $tbl_rel_user_courses = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'rel_course_user' ];
 155         $tbl_rel_course_category = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'rel_course_category' ];
 156 
 157         $curdate = claro_mktime ();
 158 
 159         $sql = "SELECT course.cours_id,
 160                        course.code                  AS `sysCode`,
 161                        course.directory             AS `directory`,
 162                        course.administrativeNumber  AS `officialCode`,
 163                        course.dbName                AS `db`,
 164                        course.intitule              AS `title`,
 165                        course.titulaires            AS `titular`,
 166                        course.language              AS `language`,
 167                        course.access                AS `access`,
 168                        course.status,
 169                        course.sourceCourseId,
 170                        UNIX_TIMESTAMP(course.expirationDate) AS expirationDate,
 171                        UNIX_TIMESTAMP(course.creationDate)   AS creationDate,
 172                        rcu.isCourseManager";
 173 
 174         if ( $categories )
 175             $sql .= ",
 176                        rcc.categoryId               AS `categoryId`,
 177                        rcc.rootCourse";
 178 
 179         $sql .= "
 180                 
 181                 FROM `" . $tbl_courses . "` AS course
 182                 
 183                 LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_user_courses . "` AS rcu
 184                 ON rcu.user_id = " . (int) $userId . " ";
 185 
 186         if ( $categories )
 187             $sql .= "
 188                 
 189                 LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl_rel_course_category . "` AS rcc
 190                 ON course.cours_id = rcc.courseId";
 191 
 192         $sql .= "
 193                 
 194                 WHERE course.code = rcu.code_cours
 195                 AND (course.`status`='enable'
 196                       OR (course.`status` = 'date'
 197                            AND (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`creationDate`) < '" . $curdate . "'
 198                                  OR `creationDate` IS NULL OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`creationDate`)=0
 199                                )
 200                            AND ('" . $curdate . "' < UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`expirationDate`) OR `expirationDate` IS NULL)
 201                          )
 202                     )";
 203 
 204         if ( $categories )
 205             $sql .= "
 206                 AND rcc.rootCourse != 1";
 207 
 208         if ( !get_conf ( 'userCourseListGroupByCategories' ) )
 209         {
 210             $sql .= " GROUP BY course.code";
 211         }
 212 
 213         if ( get_conf ( 'course_order_by' ) == 'official_code' )
 214         {
 215             $sql .= " ORDER BY UPPER(`administrativeNumber`), `title`";
 216         }
 217         else
 218         {
 219             $sql .= " ORDER BY `title`, UPPER(`administrativeNumber`)";
 220         }
 221 
 222         $userCourseList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all ( $sql );
 223     }
 224 
 225     return $userCourseList;
 226 }

 271                               OR course.`status` = 'pending'
 272                               OR (course.`status` = 'date'
 273                                   AND (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`creationDate`) > '" . $curdate . "'

 283         else

 287 
 288         $userCourseListDesactivated = claro_sql_query_fetch_all ( $sql );

 290 
 291     return $userCourseListDesactivated;

 352 /**
 353  * Return trail (path) for a given category.
 354  *
 355  * @param array         list of categories
 356  * @param int           id of the category for which we want the trail
 357  * @return string       trail
 358  */
 359 function build_category_trail ( $categoriesList, $requiredId )
 360 {
 361     $trail = array ( );
 362 
 363     if ( is_array ( $categoriesList ) && !empty ( $categoriesList ) )
 364     {
 365         foreach ( $categoriesList as $category )
 366         {
 367             if ( $category[ 'id' ] == $requiredId )
 368             {
 369                 if ( !is_null ( $category[ 'idParent' ] ) && ($category[ 'idParent' ]) )
 370                 {
 371                     $trail[ ] = build_category_trail ( $categoriesList, $category[ 'idParent' ] );
 372                     $trail[ ] = $category[ 'name' ];
 373                 }
 374                 else
 375                 {
 376                     return $category[ 'name' ];
 377                 }
 378             }
 379         }
 380     }
 381 
 382     return implode ( ' &gt; ', $trail );
 383 }

 385 function is_user_allowed_to_see_desactivated_course ( $course )
 386 {
 387     return claro_is_platform_admin () || $course[ 'isCourseManager' ] == '1'
 388         || ( $course[ 'status' ] == 'pending' && get_conf ( 'crslist_DisplayPendingToAllUsers', false ) )
 389         || ( $course[ 'status' ] == 'disable' && get_conf ( 'crslist_DisplayDisableToAllUsers', false ) )
 390         || ( $course[ 'status' ] == 'date' && $course[ 'creationDate' ] > claro_mktime () && get_conf ( 'crslist_DisplayExpiredToAllUsers', false ) )
 391         || ( $course[ 'status' ] == 'date' && isset ( $course[ 'expirationDate' ] ) && $course[ 'expirationDate' ] < claro_mktime () && get_conf ( 'crslist_DisplayUnpublishedToAllUsers', false ) );
 392 }
