 394 /**
 395  * Returns a courses list for the current user.
 396  *
 397  * @return string       list of courses (HTML format)
 398  * @deprecated use UserCourseList and CourseTreeView instead
 399  */
 400 function render_user_course_list_desactivated ()
 401 {
 402     $personnalCourseList = get_user_course_list_desactivated ( claro_get_current_user_id () );
 403 
 404     $deactivatedCoursesDiplayed = 0;
 405 
 406     $out = '';
 407 
 408     //display list
 409     if ( !empty ( $personnalCourseList ) && is_array ( $personnalCourseList ) )
 410     {
 411         $out .= '<dl class="courseList">' . "\n";
 412 
 413         foreach ( $personnalCourseList as $course )
 414         {
 415             if ( !is_user_allowed_to_see_desactivated_course ( $course ) )
 416             {
 417                 continue;
 418             }
 419 
 420             $deactivatedCoursesDiplayed++;
 421 
 422 
 423             if ( get_conf ( 'course_order_by' ) == 'official_code' )
 424             {
 425                 $courseTitle = $course[ 'officialCode' ] . ' - ' . $course[ 'title' ];
 426             }
 427             else
 428             {
 429                 $courseTitle = $course[ 'title' ] . ' (' . $course[ 'officialCode' ] . ')';
 430             }
 431 
 432             $url = get_path ( 'url' ) . '/claroline/course/index.php?cid='
 433                 . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $course[ 'sysCode' ] );
 434 
 435             $urlSettings = Url::Contextualize ( get_path ( 'url' ) . '/claroline/course/settings.php?cidReq='
 436                     . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $course[ 'sysCode' ] . '&cmd=exEnable' ) );
 437 
 438             $out .= '<dt>' . "\n"
 439                 . '<img class="iconDefinitionList" src="' . get_icon_url ( 'course_deactivated' )
 440                 . '" alt="' . get_lang ( 'Course deactivated' ) . '" /> ';
 441 
 442             if ( $course[ 'status' ] == 'pending' )
 443             {
 444                 if ( claro_is_platform_admin () || $course[ 'isCourseManager' ] == '1' )
 445                 {
 446                     $out.= '<a href="' . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $url ) . '">'
 447                         . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $courseTitle )
 448                         . '</a>' . "\n"
 449                         . '<img class="qtip" src="' . get_icon_url ( 'manager' ) . '" alt="' . get_lang ( 'You are manager of this course' ) . '" /> '
 450                         . '[<a href="' . $urlSettings . '">' . get_lang ( 'Reactivate it' ) . '</a>]';
 451                 }
 452                 elseif ( get_conf ( 'crslist_DisplayPendingToAllUsers', false ) )
 453                 {
 454                     $out.= claro_htmlspecialchars ( $courseTitle )
 455                         . ' <em><small>' . get_lang ( 'You cannot access this course until the course manager has reactivated it' ) . '</small></em>'
 456                         . "\n";
 457                 }
 458             }
 459 
 460             if ( $course[ 'status' ] == 'disable' )
 461             {
 462                 if ( claro_is_platform_admin () )
 463                 {
 464                     $out .= '<a href="' . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $url ) . '">'
 465                         . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $courseTitle )
 466                         . '</a> '
 467                         . '<img src="' . get_icon_url ( 'platformadmin' ) . '" alt="" /> '
 468                         . '[<a href="' . $urlSettings . '"> ' . get_lang ( 'Reactivate it' ) . '</a>]'
 469                         . "\n";
 470                 }
 471                 else
 472                 {
 473                     if ( $course[ 'isCourseManager' ] == '1' )
 474                     {
 475                         $out.= claro_htmlspecialchars ( $courseTitle )
 476                             . ' ' . get_lang ( 'Contact your administrator to reactivate it. ' );
 477                     }
 478                     elseif ( get_conf ( 'crslist_DisplayDisableToAllUsers', false ) )
 479                     {
 480                         $out.= claro_htmlspecialchars ( $courseTitle )
 481                             . ' <em><small>' . get_lang ( 'You cannot access this course it has been deactivated' ) . '</small></em>'
 482                             . "\n";
 483                     }
 484                 }
 485             }
 486 
 487             if ( $course[ 'status' ] == 'date' )
 488             {
 489                 if ( $course[ 'creationDate' ] > claro_mktime () )
 490                 {
 491                     if ( claro_is_platform_admin () || $course[ 'isCourseManager' ] == '1' )
 492                     {
 493                         $out.= '<a href="' . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $url ) . '">'
 494                             . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $courseTitle )
 495                             . '</a>' . "\n"
 496                             . ' ' . get_lang ( 'Will be published on ' ) . date ( 'd-m-Y', $course[ 'creationDate' ] );
 497                     }
 498                     elseif ( get_conf ( 'crslist_DisplayUnpublishedToAllUsers', false ) )
 499                     {
 500                         $out.= claro_htmlspecialchars ( $courseTitle )
 501                             . ' ' . get_lang ( 'Will be published on ' ) . date ( 'd-m-Y', $course[ 'creationDate' ] );
 502                     }
 503                 }
 504 
 505                 if ( isset ( $course[ 'expirationDate' ] ) AND ($course[ 'expirationDate' ] < claro_mktime ()) )
 506                 {
 507                     if ( claro_is_platform_admin () || $course[ 'isCourseManager' ] == '1' )
 508                     {
 509                         $out.= '<a href="' . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $url ) . '">'
 510                             . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $courseTitle )
 511                             . '</a>' . "\n"
 512                             . ' ' . get_lang ( 'Expired since ' ) . date ( 'd-m-Y', $course[ 'expirationDate' ] );
 513                     }
 514                     elseif ( get_conf ( 'crslist_DisplayExpiredToAllUsers', false ) )
 515                     {
 516                         $out.= claro_htmlspecialchars ( $courseTitle )
 517                             . ' ' . get_lang ( 'Expired since ' ) . date ( 'd-m-Y', $course[ 'expirationDate' ] );
 518                     }
 519                 }
 520             }
 521 
 522             $out .= '</dt>' . "\n";
 523 
 524             $out .= '<dd>'
 525                 . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $course[ 'titular' ] )
 526                 . '</dd>' . "\n";
 527         }
 528 
 529         $out .= '</dl>' . "\n";
 530     }
 531 
 532     if ( $deactivatedCoursesDiplayed == 0 )
 533     {
 534         return '';
 535     }
 536     else
 537     {
 538         return $out;
 539     }
 540 }
 541 
 542 /**
 543  * Returns a courses list for the current user.
 544  *
 545  * @return string       list of courses (HTML format)
 546  * @deprecated use UserCourseList and CourseTreeView instead
 547  */
 548 function render_user_course_list ()
 549 {
 550     // Get the list of personnal courses marked as contening new events
 551     $date = Claroline::getInstance ()->notification->get_notification_date ( claro_get_current_user_id () );
 552     $modified_course = Claroline::getInstance ()->notification->get_notified_courses ( $date, claro_get_current_user_id () );
 553 
 554     // Get all the user's courses
 555     $userCourseList = claro_get_user_course_list ();
 556 
 557 
 558     // Use the course id as array index, exclude disable courses
 559     // and flag hot courses
 560     $reorganizedUserCourseList = array ( );
 561     $tempSessionCourses = array ( );
 562 
 563     foreach ( $userCourseList as $course )
 564     {
 565         // Do not include "disable", "pending", "trash" or "date" courses
 566         // (if we're not in the date limits)
 567         $curdate = claro_mktime ();
 568         $courseIsEnable = (bool) (
 569             $course[ 'status' ] == 'enable' ||
 570             (
 571             $course[ 'status' ] == 'date' &&
 572             (!isset ( $course[ 'creationDate' ] ) || strtotime ( $course[ 'creationDate' ] ) <= $curdate) &&
 573             (!isset ( $course[ 'expirationDate' ] ) || strtotime ( $course[ 'expirationDate' ] ) >= $curdate)
 574             )
 575             );
 576 
 577         // Flag hot courses
 578         $course[ 'hot' ] = (bool) in_array ( $course[ 'sysCode' ], $modified_course );
 579 
 580         if ( !isset ( $reorganizedUserCourseList[ $course[ 'courseId' ] ] ) && $courseIsEnable )
 581         {
 582             // If it's not a session course, include it in the final list
 583             if ( empty ( $course[ 'sourceCourseId' ] ) )
 584             {
 585                 $reorganizedUserCourseList[ $course[ 'courseId' ] ] = $course;
 586             }
 587             // If it's a session course, put it aside for now,
 588             // we'll get back to it later
 589             else
 590             {
 591                 $tempSessionCourses[ $course[ 'sourceCourseId' ] ][ ] = $course;
 592             }
 593         }
 594     }
 595     
 596     unset ( $userCourseList );
 597 
 598     // Merge courses and their session courses (if any)
 599     foreach ( $tempSessionCourses as $sourceCourseId => $sessionCourses )
 600     {
 601         /*
 602          * Sometimes, a session course could not find its associated source
 603          * course in the user course list.  Simply because, for some reason,
 604          * this user isn't registered to the source course anymore, but is
 605          * still registered in the session course.
 606          */
 607         if ( !empty ( $reorganizedUserCourseList[ $sourceCourseId ] ) )
 608         {
 609             $reorganizedUserCourseList[ $sourceCourseId ][ 'sessionCourses' ] = $sessionCourses;
 610         }
 611         else
 612         {
 613             foreach ( $sessionCourses as $course )
 614             {
 615                 $reorganizedUserCourseList[ $course[ 'courseId' ] ] = $course;
 616             }
 617         }
 618     }
 619     unset ( $tempSessionCourses );
 620 
 621 
 622     // Now, $reorganizedUserCourseList contains all user's courses and, for
 623     // each course, its eventual session courses.
 624     // Display
 625     $out = '';
 626 
 627     // Courses organized by categories
 628     if ( get_conf ( 'userCourseListGroupByCategories' ) )
 629     {
 630         // Get all the categories names (used to build trails)
 631         $categoryList = ClaroCategory::getAllCategories ( 0, 0, 1 );
 632 
 633         // Get the categories informations for these courses
 634         $userCategoryList = ClaroCategory::getCoursesCategories ( $reorganizedUserCourseList );
 635 
 636         // Use the category id as array index
 637         $reorganizedUserCategoryList = array ( );
 638 
 639         foreach ( $userCategoryList as $category )
 640         {
 641             // Flag root courses and put it aside
 642             $reorganizedUserCourseList[ $category[ 'courseId' ] ][ 'rootCourse' ] = 0;
 643 
 644             if ( $category[ 'rootCourse' ] )
 645             {
 646                 $reorganizedUserCourseList[ $category[ 'courseId' ] ][ 'rootCourse' ] = 1;
 647             }
 648 
 649             if ( !isset ( $reorganizedUserCategoryList[ $category[ 'categoryId' ] ] ) )
 650             {
 651                 $reorganizedUserCategoryList[ $category[ 'categoryId' ] ] =
 652                     $category;
 653 
 654                 //We won't need that key anymore
 655                 unset ( $reorganizedUserCategoryList[ $category[ 'categoryId' ] ][ 'courseId' ] );
 656             }
 657 
 658             // Initialise the category's course list
 659             $reorganizedUserCategoryList[ $category[ 'categoryId' ] ][ 'courseList' ] = array ( );
 660         }
 661 
 662         // Place courses in the right categories and build categories' trails
 663         $currentCategoryId = null;
 664 
 665         foreach ( $userCategoryList as $category )
 666         {
 667             // Build the full trail for each category (excepted root category)
 668             if ( $category[ 'categoryId' ] == 0 )
 669             {
 670                 $trail = $category[ 'name' ];
 671             }
 672             else
 673             {
 674                 $trail = build_category_trail ( $categoryList, $category[ 'categoryId' ] );
 675             }
 676             
 677             $reorganizedUserCategoryList[ $category[ 'categoryId' ] ][ 'trail' ] = $trail;
 678 
 679             // Put root courses aside
 680             if ( $reorganizedUserCourseList[ $category[ 'courseId' ] ][ 'rootCourse' ] )
 681             {
 682                 $reorganizedUserCategoryList[ $category[ 'categoryId' ] ][ 'rootCourse' ] =
 683                     $reorganizedUserCourseList[ $category[ 'courseId' ] ];
 684             }
 685             else
 686             {
 687                 // Do not include source courses (only display session courses)
 688                 // (excepted if the user is manager of the course)
 689                 if ( !($reorganizedUserCourseList[ $category[ 'courseId' ] ][ 'isSourceCourse' ])
 690                     || $reorganizedUserCourseList[ $category[ 'courseId' ] ][ 'isCourseManager' ] )
 691                 {
 692                     $reorganizedUserCategoryList[ $category[ 'categoryId' ] ][ 'courseList' ][ ] =
 693                         $reorganizedUserCourseList[ $category[ 'courseId' ] ];
 694                 }
 695             }
 696         }
 697 
 698         unset ( $userCategoryList );
 699 
 700         if ( count ( $reorganizedUserCategoryList ) > 0 )
 701         {
 702             $out .= '<dl class="courseList">';
 703 
 704             foreach ( $reorganizedUserCategoryList as $category )
 705             {
 706 
 707                 if ( !empty ( $category[ 'courseList' ] ) || !empty ( $category[ 'rootCourse' ] ) )
 708                 {
 709                     $out .= '<dt>' . "\n"
 710                         . '<h4 id="' . $category[ 'categoryId' ] . '">'
 711                         . $category[ 'trail' ]
 712                         . (!empty ( $category[ 'rootCourse' ] ) ?
 713                             ' [<a href="'
 714                             . get_path ( 'url' ) . '/claroline/course/index.php?cid='
 715                             . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $category[ 'rootCourse' ][ 'sysCode' ] )
 716                             . '">' . get_lang ( 'Infos' ) . '</a>]' :
 717                             '')
 718                         . '</h4>' . "\n"
 719                         . '</dt>' . "\n";
 720 
 721                     if ( !empty ( $category[ 'courseList' ] ) )
 722                     {
 723                         foreach ( $category[ 'courseList' ] as $course )
 724                         {
 725                             $out .= render_course_in_dl_list ( $course, $course[ 'hot' ] );
 726                         }
 727                     }
 728                     else
 729                     {
 730                         $out .= '<dt>' . get_lang ( 'There are no courses in this category' ) . '</dt>';
 731                     }
 732                 }
 733             }
 734         }
 735 
 736         $out .= '</dl>';
 737     }
 738     // Simple course list
 739     else
 740     {
 741         if ( count ( $reorganizedUserCourseList ) > 0 )
 742         {
 743             $out .= '<dl class="courseList">';
 744 
 745             foreach ( $reorganizedUserCourseList as $course )
 746             {
 747                 $displayIconAccess = ($course[ 'isCourseManager' ] || claro_is_platform_admin ()) ?
 748                     (true) : (false);
 749                 $out .= render_course_in_dl_list ( $course, $course[ 'hot' ], $displayIconAccess );
 750             }
 751 
 752             $out .= '</dl>' . "\n";
 753         }
 754     }
 755 
 756     return $out;
 757 }
 758 
 759 /**
 760  * Return course informations in <dt> and <dd> html tags.
 761  * Use it in a <dl> tag (description list).
 762  *
 763  * @param $course
 764  * @param $hot
 765  * @param $displayIconAccess
 766  * @return string
 767  * @deprecated use UserCourseList and CourseTreeView instead
 768  */
 769 function render_course_in_dl_list ( $course, $hot = false, $displayIconAccess = true )
 770 {
 771     $out = '';
 772 
 773     $classItem = ($hot) ? 'hot' : '';
 774 
 775     $langNameOfLang = get_locale ( 'langNameOfLang' );
 776 
 777     // Display a manager icon if the user is manager of the course
 778     $userStatusImg = (isset ( $course[ 'isCourseManager' ] ) && $course[ 'isCourseManager' ] == 1 ) ?
 779         ('&nbsp;&nbsp;<img class="qtip role" src="' . get_icon_url ( 'manager' ) . '" alt="' . get_lang ( 'You are manager of this course' ) . '" />') :
 780         ('');
 781 
 782     // Show course language if not the same of the platform
 783     if ( (get_conf ( 'platformLanguage' ) != $course[ 'language' ]) || get_conf ( 'showAlwaysLanguageInCourseList', false ) )
 784     {
 785         $courseLanguageTxt = (!empty ( $langNameOfLang[ $course[ 'language' ] ] )) ?
 786             (' &ndash; ' . claro_htmlspecialchars ( ucfirst ( $langNameOfLang[ $course[ 'language' ] ] ) )) :
 787             (' &ndash; ' . claro_htmlspecialchars ( ucfirst ( $course[ 'language' ] ) ));
 788     }
 789     else
 790     {
 791         $courseLanguageTxt = '';
 792     }
 793 
 794     // Display the course title following the platform configuration requirements
 795     $courseTitle = (get_conf ( 'course_order_by' ) == 'official_code') ?
 796         ($course[ 'officialCode' ] . ' - ' . $course[ 'title' ]) :
 797         ($course[ 'title' ] . ' (' . $course[ 'officialCode' ] . ')');
 798 
 799     $url = get_path ( 'url' ) . '/claroline/course/index.php?cid='
 800         . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $course[ 'sysCode' ] );
 801 
 802     // Display an icon following the course's access settings
 803     $iconUrl = ($displayIconAccess) ?
 804         (get_course_access_icon ( $course[ 'access' ] )) :
 805         (get_icon_url ( 'course' ));
 806 
 807     // Display course's manager email
 808     $managerString = (isset ( $course[ 'email' ] ) && claro_is_user_authenticated ()) ?
 809         ('<a href="mailto:' . $course[ 'email' ] . '">' . $course[ 'titular' ] . '</a>') :
 810         ( $course[ 'titular' ] . $courseLanguageTxt );
 811 
 812     // Don't give a link to the course if the user is in pending state
 813     $isUserPending = isset ( $course[ 'isPending' ] ) && $course[ 'isPending' ] == 1 ?
 814         (true) :
 815         (false);
 816 
 817     $courseLink = '<a href="'
 818         . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $url ) . '">'
 819         . claro_htmlspecialchars ( $courseTitle )
 820         . '</a>'
 821         . $userStatusImg . "\n";
 822 
 823     if ( $isUserPending )
 824     {
 825         $courseLink .= ' [' . get_lang ( 'Pending registration' ) . ']' . "\n";
 826     }
 827 
 828     // Make a nice explicit sentence about the course's access
 829     if ( $course[ 'access' ] == 'public' )
 830     {
 831         $courseAccess = get_lang ( 'Access allowed to anybody (even without login)' );
 832     }
 833     elseif ( $course[ 'access' ] == 'platform' )
 834     {
 835         $courseAccess = get_lang ( 'Access allowed only to platform members (user registered to the platform)' );
 836     }
 837     elseif ( $course[ 'access' ] == 'private' )
 838     {
 839         $courseAccess = get_lang ( 'Access allowed only to course members (people on the course user list)' );
 840     }
 841     else
 842     {
 843         $courseAccess = $course[ 'access' ];
 844     }
 845 
 846 
 847     $out .= '<dt>' . "\n"
 848         . '<img class="qtip iconDefinitionList" src="' . $iconUrl . '" alt="' . $courseAccess . '" /> '
 849         . '<span' . (!empty ( $classItem ) ? ' class="' . $classItem . '"' : '') . '>' . $courseLink . '</span>' . "\n"
 850         . '</dt>' . "\n"
 851         . '<dd>' . "\n"
 852         . '<span class="managerString">' . $managerString . "</span>\n";
 853 
 854     if ( !empty ( $course[ 'sessionCourses' ] ) )
 855     {
 856         $out .= '<dl>' . "\n";
 857 
 858         foreach ( $course[ 'sessionCourses' ] as $sessionCourse )
 859         {
 860             $out .= render_course_in_dl_list ( $sessionCourse, $sessionCourse[ 'hot' ] ) . "\n";
 861         }
 862 
 863         $out .= '</dl>' . "\n";
 864     }
 865 
 866     $out .= '</dd>' . "\n\n";
 867 
 868     return $out;
 869 }

   3 /**
   4  * CLAROLINE

   6  * Course search box Class.

  11  * @author      Claro Team <cvs@claroline.net>
  12  * @author      Antonin Bourguignon <antonin.bourguignon@claroline.net>
  13  * @since       1.11
  14  *
  15  * @todo        while we browse through platform's categories, the search box
  16  *              doesn't take the current category in account for its researches.
  17  * @todo        this class deserves to get splitted into 2 parts (at least), 
  18  *              including a view part with the render and view options get and 
  19  *              set methods.

  21 
  22 class CourseSearchBox implements Display
  23 {
  24     /**
  25      * Where the script is executed
  26      *
  27      * @var string
  28      */
  29     protected $formAction;
  30     
  31     /**
  32      * The specified keyword(s)
  33      *
  34      * @var string
  35      */
  36     protected $keyword;
  37     
  38     /**
  39      * Course list
  40      *
  41      * @var array
  42      */
  43     protected $searchResults;
  44     
  45     /**
  46      * View options for the course tree to render
  47      *
  48      * @var CourseTreeViewOptions
  49      */
  50     protected $viewOptions;
  51     
  52     public function __construct($formAction)
  53     {
  54         $this->formAction   = $formAction;
  55         
  56         if (isset($_REQUEST['coursesearchbox_keyword']))
  57         {
  58             // Note: $keyword get secured later, in the SQL request
  59             $this->keyword = preg_replace( "/[^0-9\w _.]/", ' ', $_REQUEST['coursesearchbox_keyword'] );
  60         }
  61         else
  62         {
  63             $this->keyword = '';
  64         }
  65         
  66         $this->viewOptions = new CourseTreeViewOptions();
  67     }
  68     
  69     protected function fetchResults()
  70     {
  71         $this->searchResults = 
  72             CourseTreeNodeViewFactory::getSearchedCourseTreeView($this->keyword);
  73     }
  74     
  75     /**
  76      * @return CourseTreeViewOptions
  77      */
  78     public function getViewOptions()
  79     {
  80         return $this->viewOptions;
  81     }
  82     
  83     /**
  84      * @param CourseTreeViewOptions
  85      */
  86     public function setViewOptions($viewOptions)
  87     {
  88         $this->viewOptions = $viewOptions;
  89     }
  90     
  91     /**
  92      * @return CoreTemplate
  93      */
  94     public function getTemplate()
  95     {
  96         if (!empty($this->keyword))
  97         {
  98             $this->fetchResults();
  99             $this->searchResults->setViewOptions($this->viewOptions);
 100         }
 101         
 102         $template = new CoreTemplate('course_search_box.tpl.php');
 103         $template->assign('formAction', $this->formAction);
 104         $template->assign('courseTree', $this->searchResults);
 105         $template->assign('keyword', $this->keyword);
 106         
 107         return $template;
 108     }
 109     
 110     public function render()
 111     {
 112         return $this->getTemplate()->render();
 113     }
 114 }

   1 <?php // $Id: database.lib.php 14734 2014-02-28 07:11:48Z zefredz $
   2 
   3 // vim: expandtab sw=4 ts=4 sts=4:
   4 
   5 /**
   6  * Light-weight and extensible Object-Oriented Database Layer for Claroline
   7  * the main goal is to have some of the advantages of mysqli or pdo
   8  * and being compatible to the old Claroline kernel database connection.
   9  *
  10  * This library provides the following interfaces :
  11  *
  12  * 1. Database_Connection interface provided to allow implementation of other
  13  * database connections
  14  * 2. Database_ResultSet interface provided to allow implementation of other
  15  * database result sets
  16  *
  17  * This library provides the following classes :
  18  *
  19  * 1. Claroline_Database_Connection is an adapter provided by the Claroline core
  20  *  class through Claroline::getDatabase() static method call
  21  * 2. Mysql_Database_connection is an adapater build upon the mysql extension
  22  *  provided to connect to other databases
  23  * 3. Mysql_ResultSet implementation of Database_ResultSet to store and access
  24  *  database query result based on mysql extension and used by both
  25  *  Mysql_Database_Connection and Claroline_Database_Connection
  26  * 4. Database_Connection_Exception exception class specific to database
  27  *  connections
  28  *
  29  * @version     $Revision: 14734 $
  30  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  31  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  32  * @author      Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  33  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  34  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  35  * @package     kernel.database
  36  */
  37 
  38 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../utils/iterators.lib.php';
  39 
  40 /**
  41  * Database Specific Exception
  42  */
  43 class Database_Connection_Exception extends Exception{};
  44 
  45 /**
  46  * Database_Connection generic interface
  47  */
  48 interface Database_Connection
  49 {
  50     /**
  51      * Connect to the database
  52      * @throws  Database_Connection_Exception
  53      */
  54     public function connect();
  55     
  56     /**
  57      * Select a database
  58      * @param   string $database database name
  59      * @throws  Database_Connection_Exception on failure
  60      */
  61     public function selectDatabase( $database );
  62     
  63     /**
  64      * Execute a query and returns the number of affected rows
  65      * @return  int
  66      * @throws  Database_Connection_Exception
  67      */
  68     public function exec( $sql );
  69     
  70     /**
  71      * Execute a query and returns the result set
  72      * @return  Database_ResultSet
  73      * @throws  Database_Connection_Exception
  74      */
  75     public function query( $sql );
  76     
  77     /**
  78      * Returns the number of rows affected by the last query
  79      * @return  int
  80      * @throws  Database_Connection_Exception
  81      */
  82     public function affectedRows();
  83     
  84     /**
  85      * Get the ID generated from the previous INSERT operation
  86      * @return  int
  87      * @throws  Database_Connection_Exception
  88      */
  89     public function insertId();
  90     
  91     /**
  92      * Escape dangerous characters in the given string
  93      * @param   string $str
  94      * @return  string
  95      */
  96     public function escape( $str );
  97     
  98     /**
  99      * Escape dangerous characters and enquote the given string
 100      * @param   string $str
 101      * @return  string
 102      */
 103     public function quote( $str );
 104     
 105     /**
 106      * Set connexion charset 
 107      * @param string $charset 
 108      */
 109     public function setCharset( $charset );
 110     
 111     /**
 112      * Get connexion charset 
 113      * @return string connexion charset
 114      */
 115     public function getCharset();
 116 }
 117 
 118 /**
 119  * Mysql specific Database_Connection
 120  */
 121 class Mysql_Database_Connection implements Database_Connection
 122 {
 123     protected $host, $username, $password, $database;
 124     protected $dbLink;
 125     
 126     /**
 127      * Create a new Mysql_Database_Connection instance
 128      * @param   string $host database host
 129      * @param   string $username database user name
 130      * @param   string $password database user password
 131      * @param   string $database name of the database to select (optional)
 132      */
 133     public function __construct( $host, $username, $password, $database = null )
 134     {
 135         $this->host = $host;
 136         $this->username = $username;
 137         $this->password = $password;
 138         $this->database = $database;
 139         $this->dbLink = false;
 140     }
 141     
 142     protected function isConnected()
 143     {
 144         return !empty($this->dbLink);
 145     }
 146     
 147     /**
 148      * @see Database_Connection
 149      */
 150     public function connect()
 151     {
 152         if ( $this->isConnected() )
 153         {
 154             throw new Database_Connection_Exception("Already to database server {$this->username}@{$this->host}");
 155         }
 156         
 157         $this->dbLink = @mysql_connect( $this->host, $this->username, $this->password );
 158         
 159         if ( ! $this->dbLink )
 160         {
 161             throw new Database_Connection_Exception("Cannot connect to database server {$this->username}@{$this->host}");
 162         }
 163         
 164         if ( !empty( $this->database ) )
 165         {
 166             $this->selectDatabase( $this->database );
 167         }
 168     }
 169     
 170     /**
 171      * @see Database_Connection
 172      */
 173     public function selectDatabase( $database )
 174     {
 175         if ( ! $this->isConnected() )
 176         {
 177             throw new Database_Connection_Exception("No connection found to database server, please connect first");
 178         }
 179         
 180         if ( ! @mysql_select_db( $database, $this->dbLink ) )
 181         {
 182             throw new Database_Connection_Exception("Cannot select database {$database} on {$this->username}@{$this->host}");
 183         }
 184         
 185         $this->database = $database;
 186     }
 187     
 188     /**
 189      * @see Database_Connection
 190      */
 191     public function affectedRows()
 192     {
 193         if ( ! $this->isConnected() )
 194         {
 195             throw new Database_Connection_Exception("No connection found to database server, please connect first");
 196         }
 197         
 198         return @mysql_affected_rows( $this->dbLink );
 199     }
 200     
 201     /**
 202      * @see Database_Connection
 203      */
 204     public function insertId()
 205     {
 206         if ( ! $this->isConnected() )
 207         {
 208             throw new Database_Connection_Exception("No connection found to database server, please connect first");
 209         }
 210         
 211         return @mysql_insert_id( $this->dbLink );
 212     }
 213     
 214     /**
 215      * @see Database_Connection
 216      */
 217     public function exec( $sql )
 218     {
 219         if ( ! $this->isConnected() )
 220         {
 221             throw new Database_Connection_Exception("No connection found to database server, please connect first");
 222         }
 223         
 224         if ( false === @mysql_query( $sql, $this->dbLink ) )
 225         {
 226             throw new Database_Connection_Exception( "Error in {$sql} : ".@mysql_error($this->dbLink), @mysql_errno($this->dbLink) );
 227         }
 228         
 229         return $this->affectedRows();
 230     }
 231     
 232     /**
 233      * @see Database_Connection
 234      */
 235     public function query( $sql )
 236     {
 237         if ( ! $this->isConnected() )
 238         {
 239             throw new Database_Connection_Exception("No connection found to database server, please connect first");
 240         }
 241         
 242         if ( false === ( $result = @mysql_query( $sql, $this->dbLink ) ) )
 243         {
 244             throw new Database_Connection_Exception( "Error in {$sql} : ".@mysql_error($this->dbLink), @mysql_errno($this->dbLink) );
 245         }
 246         
 247         $tmp = new Mysql_ResultSet( $result );
 248         
 249         return $tmp;
 250     }
 251     
 252     /**
 253      * @see Database_Connection
 254      */
 255     public function escape( $str )
 256     {
 257         return mysql_real_escape_string( $str, $this->dbLink );
 258     }
 259     
 260     /**
 261      * @see Database_Connection
 262      */
 263     public function quote( $str )
 264     {
 265         return "'".$this->escape($str)."'";
 266     }
 267     
 268     public function setCharset( $charset )
 269     {
 270         if ( function_exists( 'mysql_set_charset' ) )
 271         {
 272             pushClaroMessage('mysql_set_charset');
 273             @mysql_set_charset( $charset, $this->dbLink );
 274         }
 275         else
 276         {
 277             pushClaroMessage('set names');
 278             @mysql_query( "SET CHARACTER SET {$charset}", $this->dbLink );
 279             @mysql_query( "SET NAMES {$charset}", $this->dbLink );
 280         }
 281     }
 282     
 283     public function getCharset()
 284     {
 285         return mysql_client_encoding( $this->dbLink );
 286     }
 287 }

 289 /**
 290  * Provides a MYsql_Database_Connection adapted to the Claroline database
 291  * with extra logging capability that mimics the old sql.lib.php functions
 292  * @todo move to database/claroline.lib.php to split generic database layer from
 293  * Claroline specific database layer
 294  */
 295 class
 296     Claroline_Database_Connection
 297 extends
 298     Mysql_Database_Connection
 299 {
 300     protected $mysqlConnection;
 301     protected $queryCounter = 0;
 302 
 303     public function __construct()
 304     {
 305         $this->mysqlConnection = parent::__construct(
 306             get_conf('dbHost'),
 307             get_conf('dbLogin'),
 308             get_conf('dbPass'),
 309             get_conf('mainDbName')
 310         );
 311     }
 312 
 313     /**
 314      * Connect to the database
 315      * @see Database_Connection
 316      */
 317     public function connect()
 318     {
 319         if ( $this->isConnected() )
 320         {
 321             throw new Database_Connection_Exception("Already to database server {$this->username}@{$this->host}");
 322         }
 323 
 324         if ( ! defined('CLIENT_FOUND_ROWS') )
 325         {
 326             define('CLIENT_FOUND_ROWS', 2);
 327         }
 328 
 329         $this->dbLink = @mysql_connect(
 330             $this->host,
 331             $this->username,
 332             $this->password,
 333             false,
 334             CLIENT_FOUND_ROWS
 335         );
 336 
 337         if ( ! $this->dbLink )
 338         {
 339             throw new Database_Connection_Exception("Cannot connect to database server {$this->username}@{$this->host}");
 340         }
 341 
 342         if ( !empty( $this->database ) )
 343         {
 344             $this->selectDatabase( $this->database );
 345         }
 346     }
 347 
 348     /**
 349      * @see Database_Connection
 350      */
 351     public function exec( $sql )
 352     {
 353         if ( claro_debug_mode() && get_conf('CLARO_PROFILE_SQL',false) )
 354         {
 355             $start = microtime();
 356         }
 357 
 358         try
 359         {
 360             parent::exec( self::prepareQueryForExecution( $sql ) );
 361 
 362             if ( claro_debug_mode() && get_conf('CLARO_PROFILE_SQL',false) )
 363             {
 364                 $duration = microtime() - $start;
 365                 $info = 'execution time : ' . ($duration > 0.001 ? '<b>' . round($duration,4) . '</b>':'&lt;0.001')  . '&#181;s'  ;
 366                 $info .= ': affected rows :' . $this->affectedRows();
 367 
 368                 pushClaroMessage( '<br />Query counter : <b>' . $this->queryCounter++ . '</b> : ' . $info . '<br />'
 369                     . '<code><span class="sqlcode">' . nl2br($sql) . '</span></code>'
 370                     , 'sqlinfo' );
 371 
 372             }
 373             
 374             return $this->affectedRows();
 375         }
 376         catch ( Database_Exception $e )
 377         {
 378             if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 379             {
 380                 $duration = microtime() - $start;
 381                 $info = 'execution time : ' . ($duration > 0.001 ? '<b>' . round($duration,4) . '</b>':'&lt;0.001')  . '&#181;s'  ;
 382                 $info .= ': affected rows :' . $this->affectedRows();
 383 
 384                 pushClaroMessage( '<br />Query counter : <b>' . $this->queryCounter++ . '</b> : ' . $info . '<br />'
 385                     . '<code><span class="sqlcode">' . nl2br($sql) . '</span></code>'
 386                     , 'error' );
 387             }
 388 
 389             throw $e;
 390         }
 391     }

 473     /**
 474      * Replace the Claroline SQL place holders __CL_MAIN__ and __CL_COURSE__ by
 475      * the corresponding value in the given SQL query
 476      * @param string $sql
 477      * @return string
 478      * @since Claroline 1.10
 479      */
 480     protected static function prepareQueryForExecution( $sql )
 481     {
 482         $sql = str_replace ('__CL_MAIN__',get_conf('mainTblPrefix'), $sql);
 483 
 484         if ( claro_is_in_a_course() )
 485         {
 486             $currentCourseDbNameGlu = claro_get_course_data(
 487                 claro_get_current_course_id(), 'dbNameGlu');
 488 
 489             $sql = str_replace('__CL_COURSE__', $currentCourseDbNameGlu['dbNameGlu'], $sql );
 490         }
 491         else
 492         {
 493             if ( preg_match( '/__CL_COURSE__/', $sql ) )
 494             {
 495                 throw new Exception( "Trying to execute course SQL query while not in a course contexte" );
 496             }
 497         }
 498 
 499         return $sql;
 500     }
 501 }

 503 /**
 504  * Database Object usable by Database_ResultSet in FETCH_CLASS mode
 505  * @since Claroline 1.9.5
 506  */
 507 interface Database_Object
 508 {
 509     /**
 510      *
 511      * @param array $data
 512      */
 513     public static function getInstance( $data );
 514 }
 515 
 516 /**
 517  * Database_ResultSet generic interface
 518  */
 519 interface Database_ResultSet extends CountableSeekableIterator// SeekableIterator, Countable
 520 {
 521     /**
 522      * Associative array fetch mode constant, default mode if no one specified
 523      */
 524     const FETCH_ASSOC = 'FETCH_ASSOC';
 525     
 526     /**
 527      * Numeric index array fetch mode constant
 528      */
 529     const FETCH_NUM = 'FETCH_NUM';
 530     
 531     /**
 532      * Associative and numeric array fetch mode constant
 533      */
 534     const FETCH_BOTH = 'FETCH_BOTH';
 535     
 536     /**
 537      * Object fetch mode constant
 538      */
 539     const FETCH_OBJECT = 'FETCH_OBJECT';
 540     
 541     /**
 542      * Fetch the value of the first column  of the first row of the result set
 543      */
 544     const FETCH_VALUE = 'FETCH_VALUE';
 545     
 546     /**
 547      * Fetch the value of the first column of each row of the result set
 548      */
 549     const FETCH_COLUMN = 'FETCH_COLUMN';
 550 
 551     /**
 552      * Fetch the next rows as a new instance of the class name specified as the
 553      * second argument of Database_ResultSet::setFetchMode
 554      *
 555      * This class must implement the magic static __set_state method
 556      * @since Claroline 1.9.5
 557      */
 558     const FETCH_CLASS = 'FETCH_CLASS';
 559     
 560     /**
 561      * Set fetch mode. If not set, the default mode is FETCH_ASSOC
 562      * @param   string $mode fetch mode
 563      * @param   string class name used for the FETCH_CLASS mode, this class
 564      *  need to implement all the method in the Database_Object interface
 565      * @return  $this for chaining
 566      */
 567     public function setFetchMode( $mode, $className = null );
 568     
 569     /**
 570      * Get the next row in the Result Set
 571      * @param   string $mode fetch mode (optional, use internal fetch mode :
 572      *      FETCH_ASSOC by default or set by setFetchMode())
 573      * @param   string class name used for the FETCH_CLASS mode, this class
 574      *  need to implement all the method in the Database_Object interface
 575      * @return  mixed result row, returned data type depends on fetch mode :
 576      *      FETCH_ASSOC, FETCH_NUM or FETCH_BOTH : array
 577      *      FETCH_OBJECT : object representation of the current row
 578      *      FETCH_CLASS : instance of the class name given
 579      *      FETCH_VALUE : value of the first field in the current row
 580      * @throws Claroline_Database_Exception
 581      */
 582     public function fetch( $mode = null, $className = null );
 583     
 584     /**
 585      * Get the number of rows in the result set
 586      * @return  int
 587      */
 588     public function numRows();
 589     
 590     /**
 591      * Check if the result set is empty
 592      * @return  boolean
 593      */
 594     public function isEmpty();
 595 
 596     /**
 597      * Set the name of the resultset key to be used as the row id in the
 598      * iterator if not, the rank of the row in the result set will be used
 599      * WARNING This will work only with FETCH_ASSOC, FETCH_OBJECT, FETCH_CLASS
 600      * and FETCH_BOTH. In FETCH_NUM, FETCH_VALUE and FETCH_ROW mode, the id key
 601      * name will be ignored and the return key will be the rank of the row in
 602      * the result set not the value of the key $idKeyName !
 603      * @param string $idKeyName
 604      * @return $this for chaining
 605      */
 606     public function useId( $idKeyName );
 607 }
 608 
 609 /**
 610  * Mysql _Database_Connection Result Set class
 611  * implements iterator and countable interfaces for
 612  * array-like behaviour.
 613  */
 614 class Mysql_ResultSet implements Database_ResultSet
 615 {
 616     protected
 617         $mode,
 618         $className,
 619         $idx,
 620         $valid,
 621         $numrows,
 622         $resultSet,
 623         $idKeyName,
 624         $idKeyValue;
 625     
 626     /**
 627      * @param   resource $result Mysql native resultset
 628      */
 629     public function __construct( $result )
 630     {
 631         if ( $result )
 632         {
 633             $this->resultSet = $result;
 634             $this->mode = self::FETCH_ASSOC;
 635             
 636             // set to 0 if false;
 637             $this->numrows = (int) @mysql_num_rows( $this->resultSet );
 638             $this->idx = 0;
 639             $this->idKeyName = null;
 640             $this->idKeyValue = null;
 641         }
 642         else
 643         {
 644             throw new Database_Connection_Exception("Invalid SQL result passed to " . __CLASS__);
 645         }
 646     }
 647     
 648     public function __destruct()
 649     {
 650         if ( $this->resultSet )
 651         {
 652             @mysql_free_result($this->resultSet);
 653         }
 654         
 655         unset( $this->resultSet );
 656         unset( $this->numrows );
 657         unset( $this->mode );
 658         unset( $this->valid );
 659         unset( $this->idx );
 660         unset( $this->idKeyName );
 661         unset( $this->idKeyValue );
 662     }
 663     
 664     // --- Database_ResultSet  ---
 665     
 666     /**
 667      * Set fetch mode
 668      * @param   string $mode fetch mode
 669      * @param   string class name used for the FETCH_CLASS mode, this class
 670      *  need to implement all the method in the Database_Object interface
 671      * @see     Database_ResultSet
 672      * @return $this
 673      */
 674     public function setFetchMode( $mode, $className = null )
 675     {
 676         $this->mode = $mode;
 677 
 678         if ( $this->mode == self::FETCH_CLASS )
 679         {
 680             $this->className = $className;
 681         }
 682 
 683         return $this;
 684     }
 685     
 686     /**
 687      * Set the name of the resultset key to be used as the row id in the
 688      * iterator if not, the rank of the row in the result set will be used
 689      * @param string $idKeyName
 690      * @return $this for chaining
 691      * @see Database_ResultSet
 692      * @since Claroline 1.9.7
 693      */
 694     public function useId( $idKeyName )
 695     {
 696         $this->idKeyName = $idKeyName;
 697     }
 698     
 699     /**
 700      * Get the number of rows in the result set
 701      * @see     Database_ResultSet
 702      * @return  int
 703      */
 704     public function numRows()
 705     {
 706         return $this->numrows;
 707     }
 708     
 709     /**
 710      * Check if the result set is empty
 711      * @see     Database_ResultSet
 712      * @return  boolean
 713      */
 714     public function isEmpty()
 715     {
 716         return (0 == $this->numRows());
 717     }
 718     
 719     /**
 720      * Get the next row in the Result Set
 721      * @see     Database_ResultSet
 722      * @param   string $mode fetch mode (optional, use internal fetch mode :
 723      *      FETCH_ASSOC by default or set by setFetchMode())
 724      * @param   string class name used for the FETCH_CLASS mode, this class
 725      *  need to implement all the method in the Database_Object interface
 726      * @return  mixed result row, returned data type depends on fetch mode :
 727      *      FETCH_ASSOC, FETCH_NUM or FETCH_BOTH : array
 728      *      FETCH_OBJECT : object representation of the current row
 729      *      FETCH_CLASS : instance of the class name given
 730      *      FETCH_VALUE : value of the first field in the current row
 731      * @throws Claroline_Database_Exception
 732      */
 733     public function fetch( $mode = null, $className = null )
 734     {
 735         $mode = empty( $mode ) ? $this->mode : $mode;
 736         $className = empty( $className ) ? $this->className : $className;
 737         
 738         if ( $mode == self::FETCH_CLASS )
 739         {
 740             if ( empty ( $className )
 741                 || ! class_exists( $className )
 742                 || ! is_callable ( array( $className, 'getInstance' ) ) )
 743             {
 744                 throw new Claroline_Database_Exception( "Cannot instanciate class {$className}" );
 745             }
 746 
 747             $row = @mysql_fetch_array( $this->resultSet, MYSQL_ASSOC );
 748 
 749             $this->setIdFromKeyValue( $mode, $row );
 750 
 751             $obj = call_user_func( array($className, 'getInstance' ), $row );
 752 
 753             return $obj;
 754         }
 755         elseif ( $mode == self::FETCH_OBJECT )
 756         {
 757             $row = @mysql_fetch_object( $this->resultSet );
 758             $this->setIdFromKeyValue( $mode, $row );
 759 
 760             return $row;
 761         }
 762         // FIXME : FETCH_VALUE should not be called twice !
 763         elseif ( $mode == self::FETCH_VALUE || $mode == self::FETCH_COLUMN )
 764         {
 765             $res = @mysql_fetch_array( $this->resultSet, MYSQL_NUM );
 766             
 767             // use side effect of the [] operator : will return null if !$res
 768             return $res[0];
 769         }
 770         else
 771         {
 772             $row = @mysql_fetch_array( $this->resultSet, $this->mysqlFetchMode( $mode ) );
 773             $this->setIdFromKeyValue( $mode, $row );
 774 
 775             return $row;
 776         }
 777     }
 778 
 779     /**
 780      *
 781      * @param <type> $fetchmode
 782      * @param <type> $row
 783      */
 784     protected function setIdFromKeyValue( $mode, $row )
 785     {
 786         if ( is_null($this->idKeyName) )
 787         {
 788             $this->idKeyValue = null;
 789         }
 790         elseif ( $mode == self::FETCH_ASSOC
 791             || $mode == self::FETCH_BOTH
 792             || $mode == self::FETCH_CLASS
 793             || $mode == self::FETCH_OBJECT )
 794         {
 795             if ( $mode == self::FETCH_OBJECT )
 796             {
 797                 $data = (array)$row;
 798             }
 799             else
 800             {
 801                 $data = $row;
 802             }
 803 
 804             if ( ! array_key_exists( $this->idKeyName, $data) )
 805             {
 806                 throw new Database_Connection_Exception("Id key {$this->idKeyName} not found in the current row");
 807             }
 808 
 809             $this->idKeyValue = $data[$this->idKeyName];
 810         }
 811         else
 812         {
 813             $this->idKeyValue = null;
 814         }
 815     }
 816 
 817     protected function mysqlFetchMode( $mode )
 818     {
 819         switch ( $mode )
 820         {
 821             case self::FETCH_ASSOC:
 822                 return MYSQL_ASSOC;
 823 
 824             case self::FETCH_NUM:
 825                 return MYSQL_NUM;
 826             
 827             case self::FETCH_BOTH:
 828             default:
 829                 return MYSQL_BOTH;
 830         }
 831     }
 832     
 833     // --- Countable  ---
 834     
 835     /**
 836      * Count the number of rows in the result set
 837      * Usage :
 838      *      $size = count( $resultSet );
 839      *
 840      * @see     Countable
 841      * @return  int size of the result set (ie number of rows)
 842      */
 843     public function count()
 844     {
 845         return $this->numRows();
 846     }
 847     
 848     // --- Iterator ---
 849     
 850     /**
 851      * Check if the current position in the result set is valid
 852      * @see     Iterator
 853      * @return  boolean
 854      */
 855     public function valid()
 856     {
 857         return $this->valid;
 858     }
 859     
 860     /**
 861      * Return the current row
 862      * @see     Iterator
 863      * @see     Database_ResultSet::fetch() for return value data type
 864      * @return  mixed, current row
 865      */
 866     public function current()
 867     {
 868         // Go to the correct data
 869         $this->seek( $this->idx );
 870         
 871         return $this->fetch( $this->mode );
 872     }
 873     
 874     /**
 875      * Advance to the next row in the result set
 876      * @see     Iterator
 877      */
 878     public function next()
 879     {
 880         $this->idx++;
 881         $this->valid = $this->idx < $this->numRows();
 882     }
 883     
 884     /**
 885      * Rewind to the first row
 886      * @see     Iterator
 887      */
 888     public function rewind()
 889     {
 890         $this->idx = 0;
 891         $this->idKeyValue = null;
 892         
 893         if ( $this->numRows() )
 894         {
 895             $this->valid = @mysql_data_seek( $this->resultSet, 0 );
 896         }
 897         else
 898         {
 899             $this->valid = false;
 900         }
 901     }
 902     
 903     /**
 904      * Return the index of the current row
 905      * @see     Iterator
 906      * @return  int
 907      */
 908     public function key()
 909     {
 910         if ( is_null($this->idKeyValue) )
 911         {
 912             return $this->idx;
 913         }
 914         else
 915         {
 916             return $this->idKeyValue;
 917         }
 918     }
 919     
 920     // --- SeekableIterator ---
 921     
 922     /**
 923      * Usage :
 924      *      $resultSet->seek( 5 );
 925      *      $r = $resultSet->fetch();
 926      *
 927      * @see     SeekableIterator
 928      * @param   int $idx
 929      * @return  void
 930      * @throws  OutOfBoundsException if invalid index
 931      */
 932     public function seek( $idx )
 933     {
 934         if ( $idx < $this->numRows()
 935             && $idx >= 0
 936             && ! $this->isEmpty()
 937             && $this->valid() )
 938         {
 939             $this->idx = $idx;
 940             @mysql_data_seek( $this->resultSet, $this->idx );
 941         }
 942         else
 943         {
 944             throw new OutOfBoundsException('Invalid seek position');
 945         }
 946     }
 947 }

  96             $userToolUrlListLeft    = array();
  97             $userToolUrlListRight   = array();
  98             
  99             if (get_conf('display_former_homepage'))
 100             {
 101                 
 102             }
 103

 105                 . get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb')
 106                 . 'desktop/index.php" target="_top">'
 107                 . get_lang('My desktop').'</a>'
 108                 ;

 113                 . get_lang('My messages').'</a>'
 114                 ;

 117             {

 121                     . get_lang('Platform administration'). '</a>'

 148     /**
 149      * Prepare the campus banner
 150      */
 151     private function _prepareCampusBanner()
 152     {
 153         $campus = array();
 154         
 155         $campus['siteName'] =  get_conf('siteLogo') != ''
 156             ? '<img src="' . get_conf('siteLogo') . '" alt="'.get_conf('siteName').'"  />'
 157             : get_conf('siteName')
 158             ;
 159 
 160         $institutionNameOutput = '';
 161 
 162         $bannerInstitutionName = (get_conf('institutionLogo') != '')
 163             ? '<img src="' . get_conf('institutionLogo')
 164                 . '" alt="' . get_conf('institution_name') . '" />'
 165             : get_conf('institution_name')
 166             ;
 167 
 168         if( !empty($bannerInstitutionName) )
 169         {
 170             if( get_conf('institution_url') != '' )
 171             {
 172                 $institutionNameOutput .= '<a href="'
 173                     . get_conf('institution_url').'" target="_top">'
 174                     . $bannerInstitutionName.'</a>'
 175                     ;
 176             }
 177             else
 178             {
 179                 $institutionNameOutput .= $bannerInstitutionName;
 180             }
 181         }
 182 
 183         /* --- External Link Section --- */
 184         if( claro_get_current_course_data('extLinkName') != '' )
 185         {
 186             $institutionNameOutput .= get_conf('institution_url') != ''
 187                 ? ' / '
 188                 : ' '
 189                 ;
 190 
 191             if( claro_get_current_course_data('extLinkUrl') != '' )
 192             {
 193                 $institutionNameOutput .= '<a href="'
 194                     . claro_get_current_course_data('extLinkUrl')
 195                     . '" target="_top">'
 196                     . claro_get_current_course_data('extLinkName')
 197                     . '</a>'
 198                     ;
 199             }
 200             else
 201             {
 202                 $institutionNameOutput .= claro_get_current_course_data('extLinkName');
 203             }
 204         }
 205         
 206         $campus['institution'] = $institutionNameOutput;
 207 
 208         $this->assign( 'campus', $campus );
 209     }

   3 // vim: expandtab sw=4 ts=4 sts=4:
   4 
   5 /**
   6  * BreadCrumbs.
   7  *
   8  * @version     1.9 $Revision: 14414 $
   9  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  10  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  11  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  12  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  13  * @package     KERNEL
  14  */
  15 
  16 /*
  17  *  Usage :
  18  *
  19  *      ClaroBreadCrumbs::getInstance()->prepend( $name, $url );
  20  *      ClaroBreadCrumbs::getInstance()->current( $name, $url );
  21  *      ClaroBreadCrumbs::getInstance()->append( $name, $url );
  22  *
  23  *      Platform, course and group are added automaticaly
  24  *
  25  *  Sample :
  26  *
  27  *      ClaroBreadCrumbs::getInstance()->prepend( 'b' );
  28  *      ClaroBreadCrumbs::getInstance()->prepend( 'a' );
  29  *      ClaroBreadCrumbs::getInstance()->setCurrent( 'c' );
  30  *      ClaroBreadCrumbs::getInstance()->prepend( 'd' );
  31  *      ClaroBreadCrumbs::getInstance()->prepend( 'e' );
  32  *
  33  *      --> a > b > c > d > e
  34  *
  35  * FIXME : reverse order for prepend !!!!
  36  *
  37  * @version     1.9 $Revision: 14414 $
  38  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  39  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  40  * @author      Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  41  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  42  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  43  * @package     display
  44  */
  45  
  46 class BreadCrumbs implements Display
  47 {
  48     // protected $breadCrumbs = array();
  49     protected $prependBc    = array();
  50     protected $currentNode  = array();
  51     protected $appendBc     = array();
  52     
  53     public function render()
  54     {
  55         if ( $this->isEmpty() )
  56         {
  57             return '';
  58         }
  59         
  60         $breadCrumbs = array_merge(
  61             array_reverse($this->prependBc),
  62             $this->currentNode,
  63             $this->appendBc );
  64         
  65         $lastNode = count( $breadCrumbs ) - 1;
  66         $currentNode = 0;
  67 
  68         $out = '<ul class="breadCrumbs">' . "\n";
  69 
  70         $nodeList = array();
  71 
  72         foreach ( $breadCrumbs as $node )
  73         {
  74             $nodeStr = '';
  75 
  76             if ( $currentNode == $lastNode )
  77             {
  78                 $nodeStr .= '<li class="breadCrumbsNode lastBreadCrumbsNode">';
  79             }
  80             elseif ( $currentNode == 0 )
  81             {
  82                 $nodeStr .= '<li class="breadCrumbsNode firstBreadCrumbsNode">';
  83             }
  84             else
  85             {
  86                 $nodeStr .= '<li class="breadCrumbsNode">';
  87             }
  88 
  89             $nodeStr .= $node->render();
  90 
  91             if ( $currentNode == $lastNode )
  92             {
  93                 $nodeStr .= '</li>';
  94             }
  95             else
  96             {
  97                 $nodeStr .= '&nbsp;&gt;&nbsp;</li>';
  98             }
  99 
 100             $nodeList[] = $nodeStr;
 101 
 102             $currentNode++;
 103         }
 104 
 105         $out .= implode ( "\n", $nodeList );
 106 
 107         $out .= "\n" . '</ul>' . "\n";
 108 
 109         return $out;
 110     }
 111     
 112     public function append( $name, $url = null, $icon = null )
 113     {
 114         $this->appendNode( new BreadCrumbsNode( $name, $url, $icon ) );
 115     }
 116 
 117     public function prepend( $name, $url = null, $icon = null )
 118     {
 119         $this->prependNode( new BreadCrumbsNode( $name, $url, $icon ) );
 120     }
 121     
 122     public function setCurrent( $name, $url = null, $icon = null )
 123     {
 124         $this->setCurrentNode( new BreadCrumbsNode( $name, $url, $icon ) );
 125     }
 126     
 127     public function setCurrentNode( $node )
 128     {
 129         $this->currentNode = array( $node );
 130     }
 131 
 132     public function appendNode( $node )
 133     {
 134         $this->appendBc[] = $node;
 135     }
 136 
 137     public function prependNode( $node )
 138     {
 139         $this->prependBc[] = $node;
 140     }
 141     
 142     public function size()
 143     {
 144         return count( $this->prependBc ) +
 145             count( $this->currentNode ) +
 146             count( $this->appendBc )
 147             ;
 148     }
 149     
 150     public function isEmpty()
 151     {
 152         return $this->size() == 0;
 153     }
 154 }
 155 
 156 class BreadCrumbsNode
 157 {
 158     private $name, $url, $icon;
 159 
 160     public function __construct( $name, $url = null, $icon = null )
 161     {
 162         $this->icon = $icon;
 163         $this->name = $name;
 164         $this->url = $url;
 165     }
 166 
 167     public function render()
 168     {
 169         $nodeHtml = '';
 170 
 171         if ( ! empty( $this->url ) )
 172         {
 173             $nodeHtml .= '<a href="'.$this->url.'"  target="_top">';
 174         }
 175 
 176         if ( ! empty( $this->icon ) )
 177         {
 178             $nodeHtml .= claro_html_icon( 'home', null, null ).'&nbsp;';
 179         }
 180 
 181         $nodeHtml .= $this->name;
 182 
 183         if ( ! empty( $this->url ) )
 184         {
 185             $nodeHtml .= '</a>';
 186         }
 187 
 188         return $nodeHtml;
 189     }
 190 }
 191 
 192 class ClaroBreadCrumbs extends BreadCrumbs
 193 {
 194     private static $instance = false;
 195     // private $breadCrumbs = array();
 196     
 197     private function __construct()
 198     {
 199     }
 200     
 201     public function init()
 202     {
 203         $this->_compatVars();
 204         $this->autoPrepend();
 205     }
 206     
 207     public function render()
 208     {
 209         $this->init();
 210         
 211         return parent::render();
 212     }
 213     
 214     private function autoPrepend()
 215     {
 216         if ( empty( $this->currentNode )
 217             && array_key_exists( 'nameTools', $GLOBALS ) )
 218         {
 219             $name = $GLOBALS['nameTools'];
 220             
 221             if ( array_key_exists( 'noPHP_SELF', $GLOBALS )
 222                 && $GLOBALS['noPHP_SELF'] )
 223             {
 224                 $url = null;
 225             }
 226             elseif ( array_key_exists( 'noQUERY_STRING', $GLOBALS )
 227                 && $GLOBALS['noQUERY_STRING'] )
 228             {
 229                 $url = $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'];
 230             }
 231             else
 232             {
 233                 if ( ! array_key_exists( 'noQUERY_STRING', $_SERVER ) )
 234                 {
 235                     $url = $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'];
 236                 }
 237                 else
 238                 {
 239                     $url  = $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] .'?'. claro_htmlspecialchars(strip_tags($_SERVER['QUERY_STRING']));
 240                 }
 241             }
 242             
 243             $url = claro_htmlspecialchars( Url::Contextualize( $url ) );
 244             
 245             $this->setCurrentNode( new BreadCrumbsNode( $name, $url ) );
 246         }
 247         
 248         if ( claro_is_in_a_group() )
 249         {
 250             $this->prependNode( new BreadCrumbsNode( claro_get_current_group_data('name')
 251                 , claro_htmlspecialchars( get_module_url('CLGRP') . '/group_space.php?cidReq='
 252                     . claro_htmlspecialchars(claro_get_current_course_id())
 253                     .'&gidReq=' . (int) claro_get_current_group_id() ) ) );
 254             $this->prependNode( new BreadCrumbsNode( get_lang('Groups')
 255                 , claro_htmlspecialchars( get_module_url('CLGRP') . '/index.php?cidReq='
 256                     . claro_htmlspecialchars(claro_get_current_course_id()) ) ) );
 257         }
 258         
 259         if ( claro_is_in_a_course() )
 260         {
 261             $this->prependNode( new BreadCrumbsNode( claro_get_current_course_data('officialCode')
 262                 , claro_htmlspecialchars( get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'course/index.php?cid='
 263                     . claro_get_current_course_id() ) ) );
 264         }
 265             
 266         $this->prependNode( new BreadCrumbsNode( get_conf('siteName')
 267             , claro_htmlspecialchars( get_path('url') . '/index.php' )
 268             , get_icon_url('home') ) );
 269     }
 270     
 271     private function _compatVars()
 272     {
 273         if ( array_key_exists( 'interbredcrump', $GLOBALS )
 274             && is_array( $GLOBALS['interbredcrump'] ) )
 275         {
 276             foreach ( $GLOBALS['interbredcrump'] as $node )
 277             {
 278                 $this->append( $node['name'], $node['url'] );
 279             }
 280         }
 281     }
 282     
 283     public static function getInstance()
 284     {
 285         if ( ! ClaroBreadCrumbs::$instance )
 286         {
 287             ClaroBreadCrumbs::$instance = new ClaroBreadCrumbs;
 288         }
 289 
 290         return ClaroBreadCrumbs::$instance;
 291     }
 292 }

  13  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  14  * @package     display
  15  */
  16 
  17 class CurrentCourseToolListBlock implements Display
  18 {
  19     protected
  20         $courseCode,
  21         $courseId,
  22         $profileId,
  23         $template,
  24         $viewMode,
  25         $courseObject;
  26     
  27     public function __construct()
  28     {
  29         $this->courseCode = claro_get_current_course_id();
  30         $this->courseId = ClaroCourse::getIdFromCode($this->courseCode);
  31         $this->userId = claro_get_current_user_id();
  32         $this->profileId = claro_get_current_user_profile_id_in_course();
  33         $this->viewMode = claro_get_tool_view_mode();
  34         $this->courseObject = new ClaroCourse();
  35         $this->courseObject->load($this->courseCode);
  36         $this->currentCourseContext = Claro_Context::getUrlContext(array( CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE => $this->courseCode ));
  37         
  38         $this->template = new CoreTemplate('coursetoollist.tpl.php');
  39     }
  40     
  41     public function setViewMode( $viewMode )
  42     {
  43         $this->viewMode = $viewMode;
  44     }
  45     
  46     protected function getCurrentToolLabel()
  47     {
  48         return $GLOBALS['tlabelReq'];
  49     }
  50     
  51     protected function getUserLastAction()
  52     {
  53         return (
  54             (isset($_SESSION['last_action']) && $_SESSION['last_action'] != '1970-01-01 00:00:00')
  55                 ? $_SESSION['last_action']
  56                 : date('Y-m-d H:i:s')
  57         );
  58     }
  59     
  60     protected function getModuleLinkList()
  61     {
  62         //$toolNameList = claro_get_tool_name_list();
  63         
  64         $claro_notifier = Claroline::getInstance()->notification;
  65 
  66         // Get tool id where new events have been recorded since last login
  67         if ( $this->userId )
  68         {
  69             $date = $claro_notifier->get_notification_date( $this->userId );
  70             $modified_tools = $claro_notifier->get_notified_tools( $this->courseCode, $date, $this->userId );
  71         }
  72         else
  73         {
  74             $modified_tools = array();
  75         }
  76         
  77         $toolLinkList = array();
  78         
  79         $toolName = get_lang('Course homepage');
  80 
  81         // Trick to find how to build URL, must be IMPROVED
  82         $url = claro_htmlspecialchars( Url::Contextualize( get_path('url') . '/claroline/course/index.php?cid='.$this->courseCode ) );
  83         $icon = get_icon_url('coursehome');
  84         $htmlId = 'id="courseHomePage"';
  85         $removableTool = false;
  86         
  87         $classCurrent = ( empty($GLOBALS['tlabelReq']) ) ? ' currentTool' : '';
  88         
  89         $toolLinkList[] = '<a '.$htmlId.'class="item' . $classCurrent . '" href="' . $url . '">'
  90             . '<img class="clItemTool"  src="' . $icon . '" alt="" />&nbsp;'
  91             . $toolName
  92             . '</a>' . "\n";
  93 
  94         // Generate tool lists
  95         $toolListSource = claro_get_course_tool_list( $this->courseCode, $this->profileId, true);
  96 
  97         foreach ( $toolListSource as $thisTool )
  98         {
  99             // Special case when display mode is student and tool invisible doesn't display it
 100             if ( ( $this->viewMode == 'STUDENT' ) && ! $thisTool['visibility']  )
 101             {
 102                 continue;
 103             }
 104 
 105             if (isset($thisTool['label'])) // standart claroline tool or module of type tool
 106             {
 107                 $thisToolName = $thisTool['name'];
 108                 $toolName = get_lang($thisToolName);
 109 
 110                 // Trick to find how to build URL, must be IMPROVED
 111                 $url = claro_htmlspecialchars( Url::Contextualize( get_module_url($thisTool['label']) . '/' . $thisTool['url'], $this->currentCourseContext ) );
 112                 $icon = get_module_url($thisTool['label']) .'/'. $thisTool['icon'];
 113                 $htmlId = 'id="' . $thisTool['label'] . '"';
 114                 $removableTool = false;
 115             }
 116             else   // External tool added by course manager
 117             {
 118                 if ( ! empty($thisTool['external_name'])) $toolName = $thisTool['external_name'];
 119                 else $toolName = '<i>no name</i>';
 120                 $url = claro_htmlspecialchars( trim($thisTool['url']) );
 121                 $icon = get_icon_url('link');
 122                 $htmlId = '';
 123                 $removableTool = true;
 124             }
 125 
 126             $style = !$thisTool['visibility']? 'invisible ' : '';
 127             $classItem = (in_array($thisTool['id'], $modified_tools)) ? ' hot' : '';
 128             $classCurrent = ( isset($thisTool['label']) && $thisTool['label'] == $GLOBALS['tlabelReq'] ) ? ' currentTool' : '';
 129 
 130             if ( !empty( $url ) )
 131             {
 132                 $toolLinkList[] = '<a '.$htmlId.'class="' . $style . 'item' . $classItem . $classCurrent . '" href="' . $url . '">'
 133                                       . '<img class="clItemTool"  src="' . $icon . '" alt="" />&nbsp;'
 134                                       . $toolName
 135                                       . '</a>' . "\n";
 136             }
 137             else
 138             {
 139                 $toolLinkList[] = '<span ' . $style . '>'
 140                                       . '<img class="clItemTool" src="' . $icon . '" alt="" />&nbsp;'
 141                                       . $toolName
 142                                       . '</span>' . "\n";
 143             }
 144         }
 145         
 146         return $toolLinkList;
 147     }
 148     
 149     protected function getExtraToolLinkList()
 150     {
 151         $otherToolsList = array();
 152         
 153         $otherToolsList[] = '<img class="iconDefinitionList" src="'.get_icon_url('hot').'" alt="'.get_lang('New items').'" />'
 154                   . ' '.get_lang('New items').' '
 155                   . '(<a href="'.claro_htmlspecialchars(Url::Contextualize( get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'notification_date.php', $this->currentCourseContext ) ).'">'
 156                   . get_lang('to another date')
 157                    . '</a>)'
 158                   . ((substr($this->getUserLastAction(), strlen($this->getUserLastAction()) - 8) == '00:00:00' ) ?
 159                       (' <br />['.claro_html_localised_date(
 160                           get_locale('dateFormatNumeric'),
 161                           strtotime($this->getUserLastAction())).']') :
 162                       (''))
 163                   . "\n";
 164         
 165         return $otherToolsList;
 166     }
 167     
 168     protected function getManagerLinkList()
 169     {
 170         $courseManageToolLinkList = array();
 171         
 172         if ( $this->viewMode != 'STUDENT' )
 173         { 
 174             $courseManageToolLinkList[] = '<a class="claroCmd" href="' . claro_htmlspecialchars(Url::Contextualize( get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb')  . 'course/tools.php', $this->currentCourseContext ) ) . '">'
 175                                 . '<img src="' . get_icon_url('edit') . '" alt="" /> '
 176                                 . get_lang('Edit Tool list')
 177                                 . '</a>';
 178 
 179             $courseManageToolLinkList[] = '<a class="claroCmd" href="' . claro_htmlspecialchars(Url::Contextualize( get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'course/settings.php', $this->currentCourseContext ) ) . '">'
 180                                         . '<img src="' . get_icon_url('settings') . '" alt="" /> '
 181                                         . get_lang('Course settings')
 182                                         . '</a>';
 183 
 184             if ( !ClaroCourse::isSessionCourse($this->courseId)
 185                 && claro_is_allowed_to_create_course()
 186                 && ( get_conf( 'courseSessionAllowed' , true ) || claro_is_platform_admin() ) )
 187             {
 188                 $courseManageToolLinkList[] = '<a class="claroCmd" href="' . claro_htmlspecialchars(Url::Contextualize( get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb')
 189                                             . 'course/create.php', array('course_sourceCourseId'=>$this->courseId) )) . '">'
 190                                             . '<img src="' . get_icon_url('duplicate') . '" alt="" /> '
 191                                             . get_lang("Create a session course")
 192                                             . '</a>' ;
 193             }
 194 
 195             if( get_conf('is_trackingEnabled') )
 196             {
 197                 $courseManageToolLinkList[] =  '<a class="claroCmd" href="' . claro_htmlspecialchars(Url::Contextualize( get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'tracking/courseReport.php', $this->currentCourseContext )) . '">'
 198                                             . '<img src="' . get_icon_url('statistics') . '" alt="" /> '
 199                                             . get_lang('Statistics')
 200                                             . '</a>';
 201             }
 202 
 203             $extraManageToolList = get_course_manage_module_list(true);
 204 
 205             if ( $extraManageToolList )
 206             {
 207                 foreach ( $extraManageToolList as $extraManageTool )
 208                 {
 209                     $courseManageToolLinkList[] =  '<a class="claroCmd" href="' . claro_htmlspecialchars(Url::Contextualize( get_module_entry_url($extraManageTool['label'] ) ) ) . '">'
 210                     .                             '<img src="' . get_module_icon_url($extraManageTool['label'], $extraManageTool['icon'], 'settings') . '" alt="" /> '
 211                     .                             get_lang($extraManageTool['name'])
 212                     .                             '</a>'
 213                     ;
 214                 }
 215             }
 216         }
 217         
 218         return $courseManageToolLinkList;
 219 
 220     }
 221     
 222     public function render()
 223     {
 224         $this->template->assign( 'toolLinkList', $this->getModuleLinkList() );
 225         $this->template->assign( 'otherToolsList', $this->getExtraToolLinkList() );
 226         $this->template->assign( 'courseManageToolLinkList', $this->getManagerLinkList() );
 227         
 228         return $this->template->render();
 229     }
 230 }
