   5 /**
   6  * CLAROLINE
   7  *
   8  * Dialog box.
   9  *
  10  * @version     $Revision: 13034 $
  11  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  12  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  13  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  14  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2.0 or later
  15  * @package     display
  16  */
  17 
  18 /**
  19  * Constants deprecated
  20  * @deprecated since Claroline 1.9.6 use DialogBox constants instead
  21  */
  22 define ( 'DIALOG_INFO',     'DIALOG_INFO' );
  23 define ( 'DIALOG_SUCCESS',  'DIALOG_SUCCESS' );
  24 define ( 'DIALOG_WARNING',  'DIALOG_WARNING' );
  25 define ( 'DIALOG_ERROR',    'DIALOG_ERROR' );
  26 define ( 'DIALOG_QUESTION', 'DIALOG_QUESTION');
  27 define ( 'DIALOG_FORM',     'DIALOG_FORM' );
  28 define ( 'DIALOG_TITLE',    'DIALOG_TITLE' );
  29 
  30 /**
  31  * Dialog Box class
  32  */
  33 class DialogBox implements Display
  34 {
  35     private
  36         $_dialogBox = array(),
  37         $_size = array(),
  38         $_boxType = 'auto';
  39 
  40     /**
  41      * @since Claroline 1.9.6
  42      **/
  43     const
  44         DIALOG_INFO =       'DIALOG_INFO',
  45         DIALOG_SUCCESS =    'DIALOG_SUCCESS',
  46         DIALOG_WARNING =    'DIALOG_WARNING',
  47         DIALOG_ERROR =      'DIALOG_ERROR',
  48         DIALOG_QUESTION =   'DIALOG_QUESTION',
  49         DIALOG_FORM =       'DIALOG_FORM',
  50         DIALOG_TITLE =      'DIALOG_TITLE';
  51 
  52     /*
  53      * Constructor
  54      */
  55     public function __construct()
  56     {
  57         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_INFO] = 0;
  58         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_SUCCESS] = 0;
  59         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_WARNING] = 0;
  60         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_ERROR] = 0;
  61         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_QUESTION] = 0;
  62         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_FORM] = 0;
  63         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_TITLE] = 0;
  64     }
  65 
  66     /*
  67      * Add a standard message
  68      * @param $msg string text to show in dialog
  69      * @return $this
  70      * @since return $this for chaining since Claroline 1.9.6
  71      */
  72     public function info( $msg )
  73     {
  74         $this->message( $msg, self::DIALOG_INFO );
  75         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_INFO]++;
  76 
  77         return $this;
  78     }
  79 
  80     /*
  81      * Add a success message
  82      * @param $msg string text to show in dialog
  83      * @return $this
  84      * @since return $this for chaining since Claroline 1.9.6
  85      */
  86     public function success( $msg )
  87     {
  88         $this->message( $msg, self::DIALOG_SUCCESS );
  89         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_SUCCESS]++;
  90 
  91         return $this;
  92     }
  93 
  94     /*
  95      * Add a success message
  96      * @param $msg string text to show in dialog
  97      * @return $this
  98      * @since return $this for chaining since Claroline 1.9.6
  99      */
 100     public function warning( $msg )
 101     {
 102         $this->message( $msg, self::DIALOG_WARNING );
 103         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_WARNING]++;
 104 
 105         return $this;
 106     }
 107 
 108     /*
 109      * Add an error message
 110      * @param $msg string text to show in dialog
 111      * @return $this
 112      * @since return $this for chaining since Claroline 1.9.6
 113      */
 114     public function error( $msg )
 115     {
 116         $this->message( $msg, self::DIALOG_ERROR );
 117         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_ERROR]++;
 118 
 119         return $this;
 120     }
 121 
 122     /*
 123      * Add a question
 124      * @param $msg string text to show in dialog
 125      * @return $this
 126      * @since return $this for chaining since Claroline 1.9.6
 127      */
 128     public function question( $msg )
 129     {
 130         $this->message( $msg, self::DIALOG_QUESTION );
 131         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_QUESTION]++;
 132 
 133         return $this;
 134     }
 135 
 136     /*
 137      * Add a form
 138      * @param $msg string text to show in dialog
 139      * @return $this
 140      * @since return $this for chaining since Claroline 1.9.6
 141      */
 142     public function form( $msg )
 143     {
 144         $this->message( $msg, self::DIALOG_FORM );
 145         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_FORM]++;
 146 
 147         return $this;
 148     }
 149 
 150     /*
 151      * Add a title message
 152      * @param $msg string text to show in dialog
 153      * @return $this
 154      * @since return $this for chaining since Claroline 1.9.6
 155      */
 156     public function title( $msg )
 157     {
 158         $this->message( $msg, self::DIALOG_TITLE );
 159         $this->_size[self::DIALOG_TITLE]++;
 160 
 161         return $this;
 162     }
 163 
 164     /*
 165      * internal function used by helpers
 166      * @param $msg string text to show in dialog
 167      * @param $type type of message to be added
 168      * @return $this
 169      * @since return $this for chaining since Claroline 1.9.6
 170      */
 171     private function message( $msg, $type )
 172     {
 173         $this->_dialogBox[] = array( 'type' => $type, 'msg' => $msg );
 174 
 175         return $this;
 176     }
 177 
 178     /*
 179      * Set which style should the box have
 180      * @param $boxType string text to show in dialog
 181      * @return $this
 182      * @since return $this for chaining since Claroline 1.9.6
 183      */
 184     public function setBoxType( $boxType )
 185     {
 186         $this->_boxType = $boxType;
 187 
 188         return $this;
 189     }
 190 
 191     /*
 192      * returns html required to display the dialog box
 193      * @return string
 194      */
 195     public function render()
 196     {
 197         if( !empty($this->_dialogBox) )
 198         {
 199             $out = array();
 200 
 201             foreach ( $this->_dialogBox as $entry )
 202             {
 203                 $type = $entry['type'];
 204                 $msg = $entry['msg'];
 205 
 206                 switch ( $type )
 207                 {
 208                     case self::DIALOG_INFO:
 209                         $class = 'msgInfo';
 210                     break;
 211 
 212                     case self::DIALOG_SUCCESS:
 213                         $class = 'msgSuccess';
 214                     break;
 215 
 216                     case self::DIALOG_WARNING:
 217                         $class = 'msgWarning';
 218                     break;
 219 
 220                     case self::DIALOG_ERROR:
 221                         $class = 'msgError';
 222                     break;
 223 
 224                     case self::DIALOG_QUESTION:
 225                         $class = 'msgQuestion';
 226                     break;
 227 
 228                     case self::DIALOG_FORM:
 229                         // forms must always be in a div
 230                         $class = 'msgForm';
 231                     break;
 232 
 233                     case self::DIALOG_TITLE:
 234                         $class = 'msgTitle';
 235                     break;
 236 
 237                     default:
 238                         $class = 'msgMessage';
 239                     break;
 240                 }
 241 
 242                 $out[] = '<div class="claroDialogMsg ' . $class . '">' . $msg . '</div>';
 243 
 244                 unset ($type, $msg );
 245             }
 246 
 247             switch( $this->_boxType )
 248             {
 249                 case 'auto' :
 250 
 251                      // order is important first meet is choosed
 252                     if( $this->_size[self::DIALOG_ERROR] > 0 )
 253                     {
 254                         $boxClass = 'boxError';
 255                     }
 256                     elseif( $this->_size[self::DIALOG_WARNING] > 0 )
 257                     {
 258                         $boxClass = 'boxWarning';
 259                     }
 260                     elseif( $this->_size[self::DIALOG_SUCCESS] > 0 )
 261                     {
 262                         $boxClass = 'boxSuccess';
 263                     }
 264                     elseif( $this->_size[self::DIALOG_QUESTION] > 0 )
 265                     {
 266                         $boxClass = 'boxQuestion';
 267                     }
 268                     elseif( $this->_size[self::DIALOG_INFO] > 0 )
 269                     {
 270                         $boxClass = 'boxInfo';
 271                     }
 272                     else
 273                     {
 274                         $boxClass = '';
 275                     }
 276 
 277                 break;
 278 
 279                 case 'info' :
 280                     $boxClass = 'boxInfo';
 281                 break;
 282 
 283                 case 'success' :
 284                     $boxClass = 'boxSuccess';
 285                 break;
 286 
 287                 case 'warning' :
 288                     $boxClass = 'boxWarning';
 289                 break;
 290 
 291                 case 'error' :
 292                     $boxClass = 'boxError';
 293                 break;
 294 
 295                 case 'question' :
 296                     $boxClass = 'boxQuestion';
 297                 break;
 298 
 299                 default :
 300                     $boxClass = '';
 301                 break;
 302             }
 303 
 304             // todo check that the floating div + spacer do not break design
 305 
 306             return '<div class="claroDialogBox ' . $boxClass . '">' . "\n"
 307                 . implode( "\n", $out )
 308                 . '</div>' . "\n\n"
 309                 ;
 310         }
 311         else
 312         {
 313             return '';
 314         }
 315     }
 316 }

  26 /**

  70 /**
  71  * Interface for any class that offers a view.
  72  */
  73 interface Display
  74 {
  75     public function render();
  76 }
  77 
  78 
  79 /**
  80  * Claroline script embed class
  81  *
  82  * @access  public
  83  */
  84 class ClaroPage implements Display
  85 {
  86     public $header, $body, $banner, $footer;
  87     
  88     private $jsBodyOnload = array();
  89     private $bannerAtEnd = false;
  90     private $inPopup = false;
  91 
  92     public function __construct()
  93     {
  94         // HACK : force loading translation here to avoid having to rewrite the kernel !
  95         language::load_translation();
  96         
  97         $this->header = ClaroHeader::getInstance();
  98         $this->body = ClaroBody::getInstance();
  99         $this->banner = ClaroBanner::getInstance();
 100         $this->footer = ClaroFooter::getInstance();
 101     }
 102 
 103     /**
 104      * Set page content
 105      *
 106      * @access  public
 107      * @param   string content, page content
 108      */
 109     public function setContent( $content )
 110     {
 111         $this->body->setContent( $content );
 112     }
 113     
 114     public function addBodyOnload( $function )
 115     {
 116         $this->jsBodyOnload[] = $function;
 117     }
 118 
 119     public function brailleMode()
 120     {
 121         $this->bannerAtEnd = true;
 122     }
 123 
 124     public function popupMode()
 125     {
 126         $this->body->popupMode();
 127         $this->banner->hide();
 128         $this->footer->hide();
 129         $this->body->hideCourseTitleAndTools();
 130     }
 131 
 132     public function frameMode()
 133     {
 134         $this->banner->hide();
 135         $this->footer->hide();
 136         $this->body->hideCourseTitleAndTools();
 137     }
 138     
 139     private function _globalVarsCompat()
 140     {
 141         if ( isset( $GLOBALS['claroBodyOnload'] ) && !empty($GLOBALS['claroBodyOnload']) )
 142         {
 143             $this->jsBodyOnload = array_merge( $this->jsBodyOnload, $GLOBALS['claroBodyOnload'] );
 144         }
 145         
 146         // set shared display variables
 147         if( isset( $_REQUEST['inPopup'] )
 148                 && 'true' == $_REQUEST['inPopup'] )
 149         {
 150             $this->popupMode();
 151         }
 152         
 153         if( isset( $_REQUEST['inFrame'] )
 154                 && 'true' == $_REQUEST['inFrame'] )
 155         {
 156             $this->frameMode();
 157         }
 158         
 159         if( isset( $_REQUEST['embedded'] )
 160                 && 'true' == $_REQUEST['embedded'] )
 161         {
 162             $this->frameMode();
 163         }
 164     
 165         if ( isset( $_REQUEST['hide_banner'] )
 166                 && 'true' == $_REQUEST['hide_banner'] )
 167         {
 168             $this->banner->hide();
 169         }
 170     
 171         if( isset( $_REQUEST['hide_footer'] )
 172                 && 'true' == $_REQUEST['hide_footer'] )
 173         {
 174             $this->footer->hide();
 175         }
 176     
 177         if( isset( $_REQUEST['hide_body'] )
 178                 && 'true' == $_REQUEST['hide_body'] )
 179         {
 180             $this->body->hideClaroBody();
 181         }
 182     }
 183 
 184     // output methods
 185     /**
 186      * Generate and set output to client
 187      *
 188      * @access  public
 189      */
 190     public function render()
 191     {
 192         try
 193         {
 194             $this->_globalVarsCompat();
 195             
 196             $contents = '';
 197                 
 198             if ( ! $this->bannerAtEnd )
 199             {
 200                 $contents .= $this->banner->render() . "\n";
 201             }
 202     
 203             $contents .= $this->body->render();
 204             
 205             if ( $this->bannerAtEnd )
 206             {
 207                 $contents .= $this->banner->render() . "\n";
 208             }
 209     
 210             $contents .= $this->footer->render() . "\n";
 211     
 212             if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 213             {
 214                 $contents .= claro_disp_debug_banner();
 215             }
 216             
 217             $output = '';
 218             
 219             $output .= $this->header->render();
 220             
 221             if ( true === get_conf( 'warnSessionLost', true ) && claro_get_current_user_id() )
 222             {
 223                 $this->jsBodyOnload[] = 'claro_session_loss_countdown(' . ini_get('session.gc_maxlifetime') . ');';
 224             }
 225             
 226             $output .= '<body dir="' . get_locale('text_dir') . '"'
 227                 .    ( !empty( $this->jsBodyOnload ) ? ' onload="' . implode('', $this->jsBodyOnload ) . '" ':'')
 228                 .    '>' . "\n"
 229                 ;
 230             
 231             $output .= $contents;
 232     
 233             $output .= '</body>' . "\n";
 234     
 235             $output .= '</html>' . "\n";
 236             
 237             $this->header->sendHttpHeaders();
 238     
 239             return $output;
 240         }
 241         catch( Exception $e )
 242         {
 243             if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 244             {
 245                 die( $e->__toString() );
 246             }
 247             else
 248             {
 249                 die( $e->getMessage() );
 250             }
 251         }
 252     }
 253 }

 256 /**
 257  * Claroline html frame class
 258  *
 259  * @access  public
 260  */
 261 class ClaroFrame implements Display
 262 {
 263     private $src;
 264     private $name;
 265     private $id;
 266     private $scrolling = false;

 272     /**

 288     /**

 310     /**
 311      * Disable frame border

 331     /**

 333      *

 336      */
 337     public function render()
 338     {
 339         return '<frame src="'.$this->src.'"'
 340             . ' name="'.$this->name.'"'
 341             . ' id="'.$this->id.'"'
 342             . ' scrolling="'.($this->scrolling
 343                 ? ( $this->autoscroll ? 'auto' : 'yes' )
 344                 : 'no' ) . '"'
 345             . ' frameborder="'.($this->frameborder
 346                 ? '1'
 347                 : '0' ) . '"'
 348             . ( $this->noresize ? ' noresize="noresize"' : '' )
 349             . ( is_null($this->framespacing)
 350                 ? ''
 351                 : ' framespacing="'.$this->framespacing.'"' )
 352             .' />'
 353             . "\n"
 354             ;
 355     }

 359 /**
 360  * Claroline html frameset class
 361  *
 362  * @access  public
 363  */
 364 class ClaroFrameset implements Display
 365 {
 366     protected $frameset = array();
 367     protected $rows = array();
 368     protected $cols = array();
 369 
 370     /**
 371      * Add a frame or frameset object to the current frameset
 372      *
 373      * @access  public
 374      * @param   ClaroFramesetElement claroFrame, frame to add could be a
 375      *  ClaroFrame or a ClaroFrameset or any other convenient Object
 376      *  implementing the ClaroFramesetElement API
 377      */
 378     public function addFrame( $claroFrame )
 379     {
 380         $this->frameset[] = $claroFrame;
 381     }
 382 
 383     /**
 384      * Add a frame or frameset object to the current frameset as a new row
 385      *
 386      * @access  public
 387      * @param   ClaroFramesetElement claroFrame, frame to add could be a
 388      *  ClaroFrame or a ClaroFrameset or any other convenient Object
 389      *  implementing the ClaroFramesetElement API
 390      * @param   mixed size, row size, could be an int or '*'
 391      */
 392     public function addRow( $claroFrame, $size )
 393     {
 394         $this->rows[] = $size;
 395         $this->addFrame( $claroFrame );
 396     }
 397 
 398     /**
 399      * Add a frame or frameset object to the current frameset as a new colum
 400      *
 401      * @access  public
 402      * @param   ClaroFramesetElement claroFrame, frame to add could be a
 403      *  ClaroFrame or a ClaroFrameset or any other convenient Object
 404      *  implementing the ClaroFramesetElement API
 405      * @param   mixed size, column size, could be an int or '*'
 406      */
 407     public function addCol( $claroFrame, $size )
 408     {
 409         $this->cols[] = $size;
 410         $this->addFrame( $claroFrame );
 411     }
 412 
 413     /**
 414      * Render the current frameset to be embedded in another HTML frameset
 415      *
 416      * @access  public
 417      * @see     ClaroFramesetElement::render()
 418      */
 419     public function render()
 420     {
 421         $html = '<frameset '
 422             . ( ! empty( $this->rows )
 423                 ? 'rows="'. implode(',', $this->rows). '" ' : '' )
 424             . ( ! empty( $this->cols )
 425                 ? 'cols="'. implode(',', $this->cols). '" ' : '' )
 426             . '>' . "\n"
 427             ;
 428 
 429         foreach ( $this->frameset as $element )
 430         {
 431             $html .= $element->render();
 432         }
 433 
 434         $html .= '</frameset>' . "\n";
 435 
 436         return $html;
 437     }
 438 }

  54 class DockAppletList
  55 {
  56     private static $instance = false;
  57 
  58     private $_dockAppletList = array();
  59     
  60     private function __construct()
  61     {
  62         $this->load();
  63     }
  64     
  65     public function load()
  66     {
  67         $tblNameList = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  68         
  69         $sql = "SELECT M.`label` AS `label`,\n"
  70             . "M.`script_url` AS `entry`,\n"
  71             . "M.`name` AS `name`,\n"
  72             . "M.`activation` AS `activation`,\n"
  73             . "D.`name` AS `dock`\n"
  74             . "FROM `" . $tblNameList['dock'] . "` AS D\n"
  75             . "LEFT JOIN `" . $tblNameList['module'] . "` AS M\n"
  76             . "ON D.`module_id` = M.`id`\n"
  77             . "ORDER BY D.`rank` "
  78             ;
  79 
  80         $appletList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows( $sql );
  81         
  82         if ( $appletList )
  83         {
  84             $dockAppletList = array();
  85             
  86             foreach ( $appletList as $key => $applet )
  87             {
  88                 if ( ! array_key_exists($applet['dock'], $dockAppletList) )
  89                 {
  90                     $dockAppletList[$applet['dock']] = array();
  91                 }
  92                 
  93                 $entryPath = get_module_path($applet['label'])
  94                     . '/' . $applet['entry']
  95                     ;
  96 
  97                 if (file_exists( $entryPath ) )
  98                 {
  99                     $applet['path'] = $entryPath;
 100                     // $appletList[$key] = $applet;
 101                     $dockAppletList[$applet['dock']][] = $applet;
 102                 }
 103             }
 104 
 105             $this->_dockAppletList = $dockAppletList;
 106         }
 107     }
 108     
 109     public function getAppletList( $dockName )
 110     {
 111         if ( array_key_exists( $dockName, $this->_dockAppletList ) )
 112         {
 113             return $this->_dockAppletList[$dockName];
 114         }
 115         else
 116         {
 117             return array();
 118         }
 119     }
 120     
 121     public static function getInstance()
 122     {
 123         if ( ! DockAppletList::$instance )
 124         {
 125             DockAppletList::$instance = new DockAppletList;
 126         }
 127         
 128         return DockAppletList::$instance;
 129     }
 130 }
 131 
 132 class ClaroDock implements Display
 133 {
 134     protected $name;
 135     protected $appletList;
 136     protected $_useList = false;
 137 
 138     public function __construct( $name )
 139     {
 140         $this->name = $name;
 141         $this->loadAppletList();
 142     }
 143     
 144     /**
 145      * @since Claroline 1.10
 146      */
 147     public function mustUseList()
 148     {
 149         $this->_useList = true;
 150     }
 151     
 152     /**
 153      * @since Claroline 1.10
 154      */
 155     protected function useList()
 156     {
 157         return $this->_useList;
 158     }
 159     
 160     public function getName()
 161     {
 162         return $this->name;
 163     }
 164     
 165     public function loadAppletList()
 166     {
 167         
 168         $dockAppletList = DockAppletList::getInstance();
 169         $this->appletList = $dockAppletList->getAppletList( $this->name );
 170     }
 171 
 172     public function render()
 173     {
 174         $claro_buffer = new ClaroBuffer;
 175         
 176         $claro_buffer->append("\n" . '<!-- ' . $this->name.' -->' . "\n");
 177         
 178         
 179         
 180         foreach ( $this->appletList as $applet )
 181         {
 182             set_current_module_label( $applet['label'] );
 183             
 184             pushClaroMessage('Current module label set to : ' . get_current_module_label(), 'debug');
 185             
 186             // install course applet
 187             if ( claro_is_in_a_course() )
 188             {
 189                 install_module_in_course( $applet['label']
 190                     , claro_get_current_course_id() ) ;
 191             }
 192             
 193             if ( $applet['activation'] == 'activated'
 194                 && file_exists( $applet['path'] ) )
 195             {
 196                 load_module_config();
 197                 Language::load_module_translation();
 198                 
 199                 if ( $this->useList() && count( $this->appletList ) > 0 )
 200                 {
 201                     $claro_buffer->append( "<li
 202                         id=\"dock-".$this->name."-applet-".$applet['label']."\"
 203                         class=\"applet dock-".$this->name." applet-".$applet['label']."\"><span>\n" );
 204                 }
 205                 else
 206                 {
 207                     $claro_buffer->append( "<span
 208                         id=\"dock-".$this->name."-applet-".$applet['label']."\"
 209                         class=\"applet dock-".$this->name." applet-".$applet['label']."\">\n" );
 210                 }
 211 
 212                 include_once $applet['path'];
 213                 
 214                 if ( $this->useList() && count( $this->appletList ) > 0 )
 215                 {
 216                     $claro_buffer->append( "\n</span></li>\n" );
 217                 }
 218                 else
 219                 {
 220                     $claro_buffer->append( "\n</span>\n" );
 221                 }
 222             }
 223             else
 224             {
 225                 Console::debug( "Applet not found or not activated : " . $applet['label'] );
 226             }
 227             
 228             clear_current_module_label();
 229             pushClaroMessage('Current module label set to : ' . get_current_module_label(), 'debug');
 230         }
 231         
 232         $claro_buffer->append("\n".'<!-- End of '.$this->name.' -->'."\n");
 233         
 234         return $claro_buffer->getContent();
 235     }
 236 }

   5 /**

  17 FromKernel::uses( 'core/loader.lib' );
  18 
  19 class ClaroHeader extends CoreTemplate
  20 {
  21     private static $instance = false;
  22     
  23     private $_htmlXtraHeaders;
  24     private $_httpXtraHeaders;
  25     private $_toolName;
  26     
  27     /**
  28      * Constructor
  29      */
  30     public function __construct()
  31     {
  32         parent::__construct('header.tpl.php');
  33         $this->_htmlXtraHeaders = array();
  34         $this->_httpXtraHeaders = array();
  35         $this->_toolName = '';
  36         
  37         if ( claro_debug_mode() )
  38         {
  39             $this->addInlineJavascript("var claro_debug_mode = true;");
  40         }
  41         
  42         require dirname(__FILE__) .'/../../installedVersion.inc.php';
  43         
  44         if ( $stable )
  45         { 
  46             if ( file_exists( dirname(__FILE__) .'/../../../../platform/currentVersion.inc.php' ) )
  47             {
  48                 require dirname(__FILE__) .'/../../../../platform/currentVersion.inc.php';
  49             }
  50             else
  51             {
  52                 $clarolineVersion = $new_version;
  53             }
  54 
  55             if ( $clarolineVersion != $new_version )
  56             {
  57                 $claroVersion = "{$clarolineVersion}-{$new_version}";
  58             }
  59             else
  60             {
  61                 $claroVersion = $new_version;
  62             }
  63         }

  71     
  72     public static function getInstance()

  82     /**
  83      * Set the page title
  84      * @since Claroline 1.9.5
  85      * @param string $title
  86      */
  87     public function setTitle( $pageTitle )
  88     {
  89         $this->_toolName = $pageTitle;
  90     }
  91 
  92     /**
  93      * Set the page title
  94      * @deprecated since Claroline 1.9.5, use setTitle() instead
  95      * @param string $pageTitle
  96      */
  97     public function setToolName( $pageTitle )
  98     {
  99         $this->setToolName( $pageTitle );
 100     }
 101     
 102     /**
 103      * Add extra HTML header elements
 104      *
 105      * @param   string $header header to add
 106      */
 107     public function addHtmlHeader( $header )
 108     {
 109         $this->_htmlXtraHeaders[] = $header;
 110     }
 111     
 112     /**
 113      * Add inline javascript code to HTML head
 114      *
 115      * @param   string $script javascript code
 116      */
 117     public function addInlineJavascript( $script )
 118     {
 119         if ( false === strpos( $script, '<script' ) )
 120         {
 121             $script = "<script type=\"text/javascript\">\n{$script}\n</script>";
 122         }
 123         
 124         $this->addHtmlHeader( $script );
 125     }
 126     
 127     /**
 128      * Add inline css style to HTML head
 129      *
 130      * @param   string $style css style
 131      */
 132     public function addInlineStyle( $style )
 133     {
 134         if ( false === strpos( $style, '<style' ) )
 135         {
 136             $style = "<style type=\"text/css\">\n{$style}\n</style>";
 137         }
 138         
 139         $this->addHtmlHeader( $style );
 140     }
 141 
 142     /**
 143      * Add extra HTTP header elements
 144      *
 145      * @param   string $header HTTP header
 146      */
 147     public function addHttpHeader( $header )
 148     {
 149         $this->_httpXtraHeaders[] = $header;
 150     }
 151     
 152     /**
 153      * Send HTTP headers to the client
 154      */
 155     public function sendHttpHeaders()
 156     {
 157         if (! is_null(get_locale('charset')) )
 158         {
 159             header('Content-Type: text/html; charset='. get_locale('charset'));
 160         }
 161 
 162         if ( !empty($this->_httpXtraHeaders) )
 163         {
 164             foreach( $this->_httpXtraHeaders as $httpHeader )
 165             {
 166                 header( $httpHeader );
 167             }
 168         }
 169     }
 170     
 171     /**
 172      * Retrieve variables used by the old header script for compatibility
 173      * with old scripts
 174      */
 175     private function _globalVarsCompat()
 176     {
 177         if ( isset( $GLOBALS['htmlHeadXtra'] ) && !empty($GLOBALS['htmlHeadXtra']) )
 178         {
 179             $this->_htmlXtraHeaders = array_merge($this->_htmlXtraHeaders, $GLOBALS['htmlHeadXtra'] );
 180         }
 181         
 182         if ( isset( $GLOBALS['httpHeadXtra'] ) && !empty($GLOBALS['httpHeadXtra']) )
 183         {
 184             $this->_httpXtraHeaders = array_merge($this->_httpXtraHeaders, $GLOBALS['httpHeadXtra'] );
 185         }
 186         
 187         if ( isset( $GLOBALS['nameTools'] ) && !empty($GLOBALS['nameTools']) )
 188         {
 189             $this->_nameTools = $GLOBALS['nameTools'];
 190         }
 191     }
 192     
 193     
 194     /**
 195      * Render the HTML page header
 196      * @return  string
 197      */
 198     public function render()
 199     {
 200         $this->_globalVarsCompat();
 201         
 202         $this->addInlineJavascript(JavascriptLanguage::getInstance()->buildJavascript());
 203         
 204         $titlePage = '';
 205 
 206         if(empty($this->_toolName) && !empty($this->_nameTools))
 207         {
 208             $titlePage .= $this->_nameTools . ' - ';
 209         }
 210         elseif (! empty($this->_toolName) )
 211         {
 212             $titlePage .= $this->_toolName  . ' - ';
 213         }
 214 
 215         if(claro_is_in_a_course() && claro_get_current_course_data('officialCode') != '')
 216         {
 217             $titlePage .= claro_get_current_course_data('officialCode') . ' - ';
 218         }
 219 
 220         $titlePage .= get_conf('siteName');
 221         
 222         $this->assign( 'pageTitle', $titlePage );
 223         
 224         if ( true === get_conf( 'warnSessionLost', true ) && claro_get_current_user_id() )
 225         {
 226             $this->assign( 'warnSessionLost',
 227 "function claro_session_loss_countdown(sessionLifeTime){
 228     var chrono = setTimeout('claro_warn_of_session_loss()', sessionLifeTime * 1000);
 229 }
 230 
 231 function claro_warn_of_session_loss() {
 232     alert('" . clean_str_for_javascript (get_lang('WARNING ! You have just lost your session on the server.') . "\n"
 233              . get_lang('Copy any text you are currently writing and paste it outside the browser')) . "');
 234 }
 235 " );
 236         }
 237         else
 238         {
 239             $this->assign( 'warnSessionLost', '' );
 240         }
 241         
 242         $htmlXtraHeaders = '';
 243         
 244         if ( !empty( $this->_htmlXtraHeaders ) )
 245         {
 246             $htmlXtraHeaders .= implode ( "\n", $this->_htmlXtraHeaders );
 247         }
 248 
 249         $this->assign( 'htmlScriptDefinedHeaders', $htmlXtraHeaders );
 250         
 251         return parent::render() . "\n";
 252     }
 253 }

   5 /**
   6  * Output buffering functions to provide output
   7  * buffering with error and exception handling
   8  *
   9  * @version     1.9 $Revision: 13034 $
  10  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  11  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  12  * @author      Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  13  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  14  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  15  * @package     display
  16  */
  17 
  18 if ( count( get_included_files() ) == 1 )
  19 {
  20     die( 'The file ' . basename(__FILE__) . ' cannot be accessed directly, use include instead' );
  21 }
  22 
  23 // load exception_error_handler
  24 FromKernel::uses ( 'core/exception.lib' );
  25 
  26 /**
  27  * Exception handler to be used inside an output buffer
  28  */
  29 function claro_ob_exception_handler( $e )
  30 {
  31     // get buffer contents
  32     $buffer = ob_get_contents();
  33     // close the output buffer
  34     ob_end_clean();
  35     // display the buffer contents
  36     echo $buffer;
  37     // display the exception
  38     if ( claro_debug_mode() )
  39     {
  40         echo '<pre>' . $e->__toString() . '</pre>';
  41     }
  42     else
  43     {
  44         echo '<p>' . $e->getMessage() . '</p>';
  45     }
  46 }
  47 
  48 /**
  49  * Start output buffering
  50  */
  51 function claro_ob_start()
  52 {
  53     // set error handlers for output buffering :
  54     set_error_handler('exception_error_handler', error_reporting() & ~E_STRICT);
  55     set_exception_handler('claro_ob_exception_handler');
  56     // start output buffering
  57     ob_start();
  58 }
  59 
  60 /**
  61  * Stop output buffering
  62  */
  63 function claro_ob_end_clean()
  64 {
  65     // end output buffering
  66     ob_end_clean();
  67     // restore original error handlers
  68     restore_exception_handler();
  69     restore_error_handler();
  70 }
  71 
  72 /**
  73  * Return buffer contents
  74  */
  75 function claro_ob_get_contents()
  76 {
  77     return ob_get_contents();
  78 }

   5 /**
   6  * CLAROLINE
   7  *
   8  * PHP-based templating system.
   9  *
  10  * @version     $Revision: 14332 $

  18 
  19 // load helpers and output buffering libs
  20 FromKernel::uses ( 'core/helpers.lib', 'display/ob.lib' );
  21 
  22 /**
  23  * Simple PHP-based template class
  24  */
  25 class PhpTemplate implements Display
  26 {
  27     protected $_templatePath;
  28     
  29     /**
  30      * Constructor
  31      * @param   string $templatePath path to the php template file
  32      */
  33     public function __construct( $templatePath )
  34     {
  35         $this->_templatePath = $templatePath;
  36     }
  37     
  38     /**
  39      * Assign a value to a variable
  40      * @param   string $name
  41      * @param   mixed $value
  42      */
  43     public function assign( $name, $value )
  44     {
  45         $this->$name = $value;
  46     }
  47     
  48     /**
  49      * Render the template
  50      * @return  string
  51      * @throws  Exception if file not found or error/exception in the template
  52      */
  53     public function render()
  54     {
  55         if ( file_exists( $this->_templatePath ) )
  56         {
  57             $claroline = Claroline::getInstance();
  58             claro_ob_start();
  59             include $this->_templatePath;
  60             $render = claro_ob_get_contents();
  61             claro_ob_end_clean();
  62             
  63             return $render;
  64         }
  65         else
  66         {
  67             throw new Exception("Template file not found {$this->_templatePath}");
  68         }
  69     }
  70     
  71     /**
  72      * Show a block in the template given its name
  73      * (ie set the variable with the block name to true)
  74      * @param   string $blockName
  75      */
  76     public function showBlock( $blockName )
  77     {
  78         $this->$blockName = true;
  79     }
  80     
  81     /**
  82      * Hide a block in the template given its name
  83      * (ie set the variable with the block name to false)
  84      * @param   string $blockName
  85      */
  86     public function hideBlock( $blockName )
  87     {
  88         $this->$blockName = false;
  89     }
  90 }
  91 
  92 /**
  93  * Extended PHP-based template class with preloaded variables for
  94  *  - current course
  95  *  - current user
  96  * Search for template files in platform/templates and in claroline/inc/templates
  97  * @throws  Exception if template file not found
  98  */
  99 class CoreTemplate extends PhpTemplate
 100 {
 101     /**
 102      * @param   string $template name of the template
 103      */
 104     public function __construct( $template )
 105     {
 106         $template = secure_file_path( $template );
 107         
 108         $customTemplatePath = get_path('rootSys') . '/platform/templates/'.$template;
 109         $defaultTemplatePath = get_path('includePath') . '/templates/'.$template;
 110         
 111         if ( file_exists( $customTemplatePath ) )
 112         {
 113             parent::__construct( $customTemplatePath );
 114         }
 115         elseif ( file_exists( $defaultTemplatePath ) )
 116         {
 117             parent::__construct( $defaultTemplatePath );
 118         }
 119         else
 120         {
 121             throw new Exception("Template not found {$template} "
 122                 . "at custom location {$customTemplatePath} "
 123                 . "or default location {$defaultTemplatePath} !");
 124         }
 125         
 126         if ( claro_is_in_a_course() )
 127         {
 128             $this->course = claro_get_current_course_data();
 129             
 130             require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../claroCourse.class.php';
 131             
 132             $this->courseObject = new ClaroCourse();
 133             $this->courseObject->load(claro_get_current_course_id());
 134 
 135             // Fetch related courses
 136             $this->relatedCourses = $this->courseObject->getRelatedCourses();
 137             // $this->relatedUserCourses = $this->courseObject->getRelatedUserCourses(claro_get_current_user_id());
 138             
 139             if ( claro_is_in_a_group() )
 140             {
 141                 $this->group = claro_get_current_group_data();
 142             }
 143         }
 144         
 145         if ( claro_is_user_authenticated() )
 146         {
 147             $this->user = claro_get_current_user_data();
 148         }
 149     }
 150 }
 151 
 152 /**
 153  * Extended PHP-based template class for a module
 154  * Search for template files in platform/templates/MODULELABEL and in module/MODULELABEL/templates
 155  * @throws  Exception if template file not found
 156  */
 157 class ModuleTemplate extends PhpTemplate

 161      * @param   string $template name of the template
 162      */
 163     public function __construct( $moduleLabel, $template )
 164     {
 165         $template = secure_file_path( $template );
 166         $moduleLabel = secure_file_path( $moduleLabel );
 167         
 168         // Custom template file for the installed campus
 169         $customTemplatePath = get_path('rootSys') . 'platform/templates/'.$moduleLabel.'/'.$template;
 170         
 171         // Version specific template file
 172         $defaultVersionTemplatePath = get_module_path($moduleLabel) . '/templates/1_11/'.$template;
 173         
 174         // Default template path
 175         $defaultTemplatePath = get_module_path($moduleLabel) . '/templates/'.$template;
 176         
 177         if ( file_exists( $customTemplatePath ) )
 178         {
 179             parent::__construct( $customTemplatePath );
 180         }
 181         elseif ( file_exists( $defaultVersionTemplatePath ) )
 182         {
 183             parent::__construct( $defaultVersionTemplatePath );
 184         }
 185         elseif ( file_exists( $defaultTemplatePath ) )
 186         {
 187             parent::__construct( $defaultTemplatePath );
 188         }
 189         else
 190         {
 191             throw new Exception("Template not found {$template} "
 192                 . "at custom location {$customTemplatePath} "
 193                 . "or default location {$defaultTemplatePath} !");
 194         }
 195     }
 196 }

   1 <?php
   2 
   3 // $Id: tooltitle.lib.php 14236 2012-08-07 14:16:12Z zefredz $
   4 // vim: expandtab sw=4 ts=4 sts=4:
   5 
   6 /**
   7  * Display a tool's title with a toolbox and help link.
   8  *
   9  * @version     Claroline 1.11 $Revision: 14236 $
  10  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2012, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  11  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  12  * @author      Antonin Bourguignon <antonin.bourguignon@claroline.net>
  13  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  14  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  15  * @package     DISPLAY
  16  */
  17 
  18 /**
  19  * How to use ?
  20  * ============
  21  *
  22  * 1st option: create a new ToolTitle object and render it.
  23  * --------------------------------------------------------
  24  *
  25  * $toolTitle = new ToolTitle(
  26  *      array('supraTitle' => 'My Section',
  27  *            'mainTitle' => 'My page',
  28  *            'subTitle' => 'List items of this page'
  29  *      ),
  30  *
  31  *      'www.help.tld',
  32  *
  33  *      array(array(
  34  *            'img' => 'new_item',
  35  *            'name' => 'Add a new item',
  36  *            'url' => './add.php'),
  37  *            array(
  38  *            'name' => 'List the 5 last items',
  39  *            'url' => './list5.php'),
  40  *            array(
  41  *            'img' => 'delete',
  42  *            'name' => 'Delete all the items',
  43  *            'url' => './delete.php',
  44  *            'params' => array('class' => 'caution')
  45  *      ),
  46  *
  47  *      array(array(
  48  *            'img' => 'export',
  49  *            'name' => 'Export',
  50  *            'url' => './export.php')
  51  * );
  52  *
  53  * echo $toolTitle->render();
  54  *
  55  *
  56  * 2nd option: use the helper claro_html_tool_title().
  57  * ---------------------------------------------------
  58  *
  59  * echo claro_html_tool_title(sames params than in 1st option);
  60  *
  61  *
  62  * Note: put tooltips on your commands.
  63  * ------------------------------------
  64  *
  65  * If you wish to give more information about a command, you can simply
  66  * put it in the "title" attribute of the command (use the "params" entry
  67  * of the assoc array).  This title will be rendered in a tooltip
  68  * when the mouse is over the command.
  69  */
  70 class ToolTitle implements Display
  71 {
  72 
  73     protected 
  74         $superTitle,
  75         $mainTitle,
  76         $subTitle,
  77         $commandList = array ( ),
  78         $advancedCommandList = array ( ),
  79         $helpUrl;
  80     
  81     /**
  82      * Constructor
  83      * 
  84      * @param mixed $titleParts string or array of title parts, 
  85      *  array('supraTitle' => 'super title', 'mainTitle' => 'main title', 
  86      *  'subTitle' => 'subtitle')
  87      * @param string $helpUrl
  88      * @param array $commandList command list, Array of array('img' => $iconUrl,
  89      *  'name' => $name, 'url' => $url, 'params' => $param) of commands
  90      * @param array $advancedCommandList acvanced command list (hideable), Array
  91      *  of array('img' => $iconUrl, 'name' => $name, 'url' => $url, 
  92      *  'params' => $param) of commands
  93      */
  94     public function __construct ( $titleParts, $helpUrl = null, $commandList = array ( ), $advancedCommandList = array ( ) )
  95     {
  96         if ( is_array ( $titleParts ) )
  97         {
  98             if ( !empty ( $titleParts[ 'supraTitle' ] ) )
  99             {
 100                 $this->superTitle = $titleParts[ 'supraTitle' ];
 101             }
 102             if ( !empty ( $titleParts[ 'mainTitle' ] ) )
 103             {
 104                 $this->mainTitle = $titleParts[ 'mainTitle' ];
 105             }
 106             if ( !empty ( $titleParts[ 'subTitle' ] ) )
 107             {
 108                 $this->subTitle = $titleParts[ 'subTitle' ];
 109             }
 110         }
 111         else
 112         {
 113             $this->mainTitle = $titleParts;
 114         }
 115 
 116         if ( !empty ( $helpUrl ) )
 117         {
 118             $this->helpUrl = $helpUrl;
 119         }
 120 
 121         if ( !empty ( $commandList ) && is_array ( $commandList ) )
 122         {
 123             $this->commandList = $commandList;
 124         }
 125 
 126         if ( !empty ( $advancedCommandList ) && is_array ( $advancedCommandList ) )
 127         {
 128             $this->advancedCommandList = $advancedCommandList;
 129         }
 130     }
 131     
 132     public function setHelpUrl( $helpUrl )
 133     {
 134         $this->helpUrl = $helpUrl;
 135     }
 136     
 137     public function setSubTitle( $subTitle )
 138     {
 139         $this->subTitle = $subTitle;
 140     }
 141     
 142     public function superTitle( $superTitle )
 143     {
 144         $this->superTitle = $superTitle;
 145     }
 146     
 147     public function setMainTitle( $mainTitle )
 148     {
 149         $this->mainTitle = $mainTitle;
 150     }
 151     
 152     public function addCommand( $name, $url, $iconUrl = null, $extraParams = null )
 153     {
 154         $this->commandList[] = array(
 155             'name' => $name,
 156             'url' => $url,
 157             'img' => $iconUrl,
 158             'params' => $extraParams
 159         );
 160     }
 161     
 162     public function addCommandList( $commandList, $replace = false )
 163     {
 164         if ( $replace )
 165         {
 166             $this->commandList = $commandList;
 167         }
 168         else
 169         {
 170             $this->commandList += $commandList;
 171         }
 172     }
 173     
 174     public function addAdvancedCommand( $name, $url, $iconUrl = null, $extraParams = null )
 175     {
 176         $this->advancedCommandList[] = array(
 177             'name' => $name,
 178             'url' => $url,
 179             'img' => $iconUrl,
 180             'params' => $extraParams
 181         );
 182     }
 183     
 184     public function addAdvancedCommandList( $commandList, $replace = false )
 185     {
 186         if ( $replace )
 187         {
 188             $this->advancedCommandList = $commandList;
 189         }
 190         else
 191         {
 192             $this->advancedCommandList += $commandList;
 193         }
 194     }
 195 
 196     /**
 197      * Render the tool title and command list
 198      * @return string
 199      */
 200     public function render ()
 201     {
 202         // We'll need some js
 203         JavascriptLoader::getInstance ()->load ( 'tooltitle' );
 204 
 205         // Command list and help
 206         $commandList = '';
 207 
 208         $help = '';
 209 
 210         if ( !empty ( $this->helpUrl ) )
 211         {
 212             $help .= '<li><a class="help" href="#" '
 213                 . "onclick=\"MyWindow=window.open('" . $this->helpUrl . "',"
 214                 . "'MyWindow','toolbar=no,location=no,directories=no,status=yes,menubar=no,scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes,width=350,height=450,left=300,top=10'); return false;\">"
 215                 . '&nbsp;</a></li>' . "\n";
 216         }
 217 
 218         if ( !empty ( $this->commandList ) )
 219         {
 220 
 221 
 222             $commands = '';
 223 
 224             foreach ( $this->commandList as $command )
 225             {
 226                 $styleA = '';
 227 
 228                 if ( !empty ( $command[ 'img' ] ) )
 229                 {
 230                     $styleA = ' style="background-image: url(' . get_icon_url ( $command[ 'img' ] ) . '); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: left center; padding-left: 20px;"';
 231                 }
 232 
 233                 $params = '';
 234 
 235                 if ( !empty ( $command[ 'params' ] ) )
 236                 {
 237                     foreach ( $command[ 'params' ] as $key => $value )
 238                     {
 239                         $params .= ' ' . $key . '="' . $value . '"';
 240                     }
 241                 }
 242 
 243                 $commands .= '<li>'
 244                     . '<a' . $styleA . $params . ' href="' . $command[ 'url' ] . '">'
 245                     . $command[ 'name' ] . '</a></li>' . "\n";
 246             }
 247 
 248             foreach ( $this->advancedCommandList as $command )
 249             {
 250                 $styleA = '';
 251 
 252                 if ( !empty ( $command[ 'img' ] ) )
 253                 {
 254                     $styleA = ' style="background-image: url(' . get_icon_url ( $command[ 'img' ] ) . '); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: left center; padding-left: 20px;"';
 255                 }
 256 
 257                 $params = '';
 258 
 259                 if ( !empty ( $command[ 'params' ] ) )
 260                 {
 261                     foreach ( $command[ 'params' ] as $key => $value )
 262                     {
 263                         $params .= ' ' . $key . '="' . $value . '"';
 264                     }
 265                 }
 266 
 267                 $commands .= '<li class="hidden">'
 268                     . '<a' . $styleA . $params . ' href="' . $command[ 'url' ] . '">'
 269                     . $command[ 'name' ] . '</a></li>' . "\n";
 270             }
 271 
 272             $more = '';
 273 
 274             if ( !empty ( $this->advancedCommandList ) )
 275             {
 276                 $more = '<li><a 
 277                     class="more" 
 278                     title="' . get_lang ( 'Show/hide %nbr more commands', array ( '%nbr' => count ( $this->advancedCommandList ) ) ) . '" 
 279                     href="#">&raquo;</a></li>';
 280             }
 281 
 282             $commandList .= '<ul class="commandList">' . "\n"
 283                 . $help
 284                 . $commands
 285                 . $more
 286                 . '</ul>' . "\n";
 287         }
 288         else
 289         {
 290             $commandList .= '<ul class="commandList">' . "\n"
 291                 . $help
 292                 . '</ul>' . "\n";
 293         }
 294 
 295         $out = '<div class="toolTitleBlock">';
 296 
 297         // Title parts
 298         if ( !empty ( $this->superTitle ) )
 299         {
 300             $out .= '<span class="toolTitle superTitle">' . $this->superTitle . '</span>' . "\n";
 301         }
 302 
 303         if ( empty ( $commandList ) )
 304         {
 305             $style = ' style="border-right: 0"';
 306         }
 307         else
 308         {
 309             $style = '';
 310         }
 311 
 312         $out .= '<table><tr><td>'
 313             . '<h1 class="toolTitle mainTitle"' . $style . '>' . $this->mainTitle . '</h1>' . "\n"
 314             . '</td><td>'
 315             . $commandList
 316             . '</td></tr></table>';
 317 
 318         if ( !empty ( $this->subTitle ) )
 319         {
 320             $out .= '<span class="toolTitle subTitle">' . $this->subTitle . '</span>' . "\n";
 321         }
 322 
 323         $out .= '</div>' . "\n";
 324 
 325         return $out;
 326     }
 327 
 328 }

  19 class UserProfileBox implements Display

  21     protected $condensedMode;
  22     protected $userId;
  23     
  24     
  25     public function __construct( $condensedMode = false )
  26     {
  27         $this->condensedMode = $condensedMode;
  28         $this->userId = claro_get_current_user_id();
  29     }
  30     
  31     
  32     public function setUserId( $userId )
  33     {

  35     }

  38     /**
  39      * Render content
  40      */
  41     public function render()

  44         
  45         load_kernel_config('user_profile');
  46         
  47         $userData = user_get_properties( $this->userId );
  48         
  49         $pictureUrl = '';
  50         
  51         if ( get_conf('allow_profile_picture') )
  52         {
  53             $picturePath = user_get_picture_path( $userData );

  55             if ( $picturePath && file_exists( $picturePath ) )
  56             {
  57                 $pictureUrl = user_get_picture_url( $userData );
  58             }
  59             else
  60             {
  61                 $pictureUrl = get_icon_url('nopicture');
  62             }
  63         }
  64         
  65         $userFullName = claro_htmlspecialchars(
  66             get_lang('%firstName %lastName',
  67                 array('%firstName' => $userData['firstname'],
  68                       '%lastName' => $userData['lastname'])
  69             )
  70         );
  71         
  72         $dock = new ClaroDock('userProfileBox');
  73         
  74         $template = new CoreTemplate('user_profilebox.tpl.php');
  75         $template->assign('userId', $this->userId);
  76         $template->assign('pictureUrl', $pictureUrl);
  77         $template->assign('userFullName', $userFullName);
  78         $template->assign('dock', $dock);
  79         $template->assign('condensedMode', $this->condensedMode);
  80         $template->assign('userData', $userData);
  81         
  82         return $template->render();
  83     }
  84 }

   5 /**

  20 class ClaroViewMode implements Display
  21 {
  22     protected static $instance = false;
  23     
  24     
  25     /**
  26      * Contructor.
  27      */
  28     protected function __construct()
  29     {
  30     }
  31     
  32     
  33     public function render()
  34     {
  35         $out = '';
  36         
  37         if ( !claro_is_user_authenticated() )
  38         {
  39             if( get_conf('claro_displayLocalAuthForm',true) == true )
  40             {

  44         elseif ( ( !claro_is_platform_admin() )

  47         {
  48             if (claro_is_current_user_enrolment_pending())
  49             {
  50                 $out .= '<img src="'.get_icon_url('warning').'" alt="off" /> '
  51                       . '<b>'.get_lang('Enrolment pending').'</b>';
  52             }
  53             else
  54             {
  55                 $out .= $this->renderRegistrationLink();
  56             }
  57         }
  58         elseif ( claro_is_display_mode_available() )
  59         {
  60             $out .= $this->renderViewModeSwitch();
  61         }
  62         
  63         return $out;
  64     }
  65     
  66     
  67     /**
  68      * Render a dropdown list to switch "student" and "course manager" mode.
  69      */
  70     private function renderViewModeSwitch()
  71     {
  72         $out = '';
  73         
  74         if ( isset($_REQUEST['View mode']) )
  75         {
  76             $out .= claro_html_tool_view_option($_REQUEST['View mode']);
  77         }
  78         else
  79         {
  80             $out .= claro_html_tool_view_option();
  81         }
  82         
  83         $out .= "\n";
  84         
  85         return $out;
  86     }
  87     
  88     
  89     /**
  90      * Render a link to register.
  91      */
  92     private function renderRegistrationLink()
  93     {
  94         return '<a href="'
  95             . claro_htmlspecialchars( get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb')
  96                 . 'auth/courses.php?cmd=exReg&course='
  97                 . claro_get_current_course_id() )
  98             . '">'
  99             . claro_html_icon( 'enroll' ) . ' '
 100             . '<b>' . get_lang('Enrolment') . '</b>'
 101             . '</a>'
 102             ;
 103     }
 104     
 105     
 106     /**
 107      * Render a link to log in.
 108      */
 109     private function renderLoginLink()
 110     {
 111         return '<a href="' 
 112             . claro_htmlspecialchars( get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'auth/login.php'
 113                 . '?sourceUrl='
 114                 . urlencode( base64_encode(
 115                     ( isset( $_SERVER['HTTPS'])
 116                         && ($_SERVER['HTTPS']=='on'||$_SERVER['HTTPS']==1)
 117                         ? 'https://'
 118                         : 'http://' )
 119                     . $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] . strip_tags( $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ) ) ) )
 120             . '" target="_top">'
 121             . get_lang('Login')
 122             . '</a>'
 123             ;
 124     }

 127     public static function getInstance()
 128     {
 129         if ( ! ClaroViewMode::$instance )
 130         {
 131             ClaroViewMode::$instance = new ClaroViewMode;
 132         }
 133         
 134         return ClaroViewMode::$instance;
 135     }

  20 function file_upload_failed( $file )
  21 {
  22     return get_file_upload_errno( $file ) > 0;
  23 }

  25 function get_file_upload_errno( $file )
  26 {
  27     return (int) $file['error'];

  30 function get_file_upload_error_message( $file )
  31 {
  32     return get_file_upload_errstring_from_errno( get_file_upload_errno( $file ) );

  35 function get_file_upload_errstring_from_errno( $errorLevel )
  36 {
  37     if ( !defined( 'UPLOAD_ERR_CANT_WRITE' ) )
  38     {
  39         // Introduced in PHP 5.1.0
  40         define( 'UPLOAD_ERR_CANT_WRITE', 5 );
  41     }
  42     
  43     switch( $errorLevel )
  44     {
  45         case UPLOAD_ERR_OK:
  46         {
  47             $details = get_lang('No error');
  48         }
  49         case UPLOAD_ERR_INI_SIZE:
  50         {
  51             $details = get_lang('File too large. Notice : Max file size %size', array ( '%size' => get_cfg_var('upload_max_filesize')) );
  52         }   break;
  53         case UPLOAD_ERR_FORM_SIZE:
  54         {
  55             $details = get_lang('File size exceeds');
  56         }   break;
  57         case UPLOAD_ERR_PARTIAL:
  58         {
  59             $details = get_lang('File upload incomplete');
  60         }   break;
  61         case UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE:
  62         {
  63             $details = get_lang('No file uploaded');
  64         }   break;
  65         case UPLOAD_ERR_NO_TMP_DIR:
  66         {
  67             $details = get_lang('Temporary folder missing');
  68         }   break;
  69         case UPLOAD_ERR_CANT_WRITE:
  70         {
  71             $details = get_lang('Failed to write file to disk');
  72         }   break;
  73         default:
  74         {
  75             $details = get_lang('Unknown error code %errCode%'
  76                 , array('%errCode%' => $errorLevel ));
  77         }   break;
  78     }
  79     
  80     return $details;
  81 }

 240 /**
 241  * Send a file over HTTP
 242  * @param   string $path file path
 243  * @param   string $name file name to force (optional)
 244  * @return  true on success,
 245  *          false if file not found or file empty,
 246  *          set a claro_failure if file not found
 247  */
 248 function claro_send_file( $path, $name = '', $charset = null )
 249 {
 250     if ( file_exists( $path ) )
 251     {
 252         if ( empty( $name ) ) $name = basename( $path );
 253         $charset = empty( $charset )
 254             ? ''
 255             : '; charset=' . $charset
 256             ;
 257         
 258         $mimeType = get_mime_on_ext( $path );
 259     
 260         header( 'Content-Type: ' . $mimeType . $charset );
 261             
 262         // IE no-cache bug
 263         
 264         // TODO move $lifetime to config
 265         $lifetime = 60;
 266         
 267         header( 'Cache-Control: max-age=' . $lifetime );
 268         header( 'Expires: ' . gmdate( 'D, d M Y H:i:s', time() + $lifetime ) .' GMT' );
 269         header( 'Pragma: ' );
 270         
 271         // Patch proposed by Diego Conde <dconde@uvigo.es> - Universidade de Vigo
 272         // It seems that with the combination of OfficeXP and Internet Explorer 6 the
 273         // downloading of powerpoints fails sometimes. I captured the network packets
 274         // and the viewer of the office doesn't send all the needed cookies,
 275         // therefore claroline redirects the viewer to the login page because its not
 276         // correctly authenticated.
 277         if ( strtolower( pathinfo( $path, PATHINFO_EXTENSION ) ) == "ppt" )
 278         {
 279             // force file name for ppt
 280             header( 'Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="' . $name . '"' );
 281         }
 282         else
 283         {
 284             // force file name for other files
 285             header( 'Content-Disposition: inline; filename="' . $name . '"' );
 286         }
 287         
 288         header( 'Content-Length: '. filesize( $path ) );
 289         
 290         return ( readfile( $path ) );
 291     }
 292     else
 293     {
 294         return claro_failure::set_failure( 'FILE_NOT_FOUND' );
 295     }
 296 }
 297

 299 /**
 300  * Send a stream over HTTP
 301  * @param   string $stream file stream
 302  * @param   string $name file name to force (optional)
 303  * @param   string $mimeType mime type of the stream if none given, the function
 304  *  will try to guess it from $name
 305  * @param   string $charset character encoding of the strem, if none given the
 306  *  function will use the encoding of the current page
 307  * @return  number of octets sent
 308  * @since Claroline 1.9.5
 309  */
 310 function claro_send_stream( $stream, $name, $mimeType = null , $charset = null )
 311 {
 312     $charset = empty( $charset )
 313         ? '; charset=' . get_locale( 'charset' )
 314         : '; charset=' . $charset
 315         ;
 316     
 317     if( is_null( $mimeType ) )
 318     {
 319         $mimeType = get_mime_on_ext( $name );
 320     }
 321     
 322     header( 'Content-Type: ' . $mimeType . $charset );
 323         
 324     // IE no-cache bug
 325     
 326     // TODO move $lifetime to config
 327     $lifetime = 60;
 328     
 329     header( 'Cache-Control: max-age=' . $lifetime );
 330     header( 'Expires: ' . gmdate( 'D, d M Y H:i:s', time() + $lifetime ) .' GMT' );
 331     header( 'Pragma: ' );
 332     
 333     // Patch proposed by Diego Conde <dconde@uvigo.es> - Universidade de Vigo
 334     // It seems that with the combination of OfficeXP and Internet Explorer 6 the
 335     // downloading of powerpoints fails sometimes. I captured the network packets
 336     // and the viewer of the office doesn't send all the needed cookies,
 337     // therefore claroline redirects the viewer to the login page because its not
 338     // correctly authenticated.
 339     if ( strtolower( pathinfo( $name, PATHINFO_EXTENSION ) ) == "ppt" )
 340     {
 341         // force file name for ppt
 342         header( 'Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="' . $name . '"' );
 343     }
 344     else
 345     {
 346         // force file name for other files
 347         header( 'Content-Disposition: inline; filename="' . $name . '"' );
 348     }
 349     
 350     header( 'Content-Length: '. strlen( $stream ) );
 351     
 352     echo $stream;
 353     
 354     return strlen( $stream );
 355 }

 358 /**
 359  * Remove /.. ../ from file path
 360  * @param   string $path file path
 361  * @return  string, clean file path
 362  */
 363 function secure_file_path( $path )
 364 {
 365     while ( false !== strpos( $path, '://' )
 366         || false !== strpos( $path, '../' )
 367         || false !== strpos( $path, '/..' ) )
 368     {
 369         // protect against remote file inclusion
 370         $path = str_replace( '://', '', $path );
 371         // protect against arbitrary file inclusion
 372         $path = str_replace( '../', './', $path );
 373         $path = str_replace( '/..', '/.', $path );
 374     }
 375 
 376     return $path;
 377 }

 379 /**
 380  * Read a file from the file system and echo it
 381  *
 382  * Workaround for the readfile bug in PHP 5.0.4 and with host where
 383  * PHP readfile is deactivated
 384  *
 385  * @param   string $path file path
 386  * @param   boolean $retbytes return file length (default true)
 387  * @return  int file length if $retbytes
 388  *          boolean true on success if not $retbytes
 389  *          boolean false on failure
 390  *          set claro_failure on failure
 391  * @deprecated since Claroline 1.9 and PHP 5.1
 392  */
 393 function claro_readfile( $path, $retbytes = true )
 394 {
 395     if ( ! file_exists( $path ) )
 396     {
 397         return claro_failure::set_failure( 'FILE_NOT_FOUND' );
 398     }
 399     
 400     $chunksize = 1*(1024*1024); // how many bytes per chunk
 401     $buffer = '';
 402     $cnt =0;
 403     
 404     $handle = fopen( $path, 'rb' );
 405     
 406     if ( ! $handle )
 407     {
 408         return claro_failure::set_failure( 'CANNOT_OPEN_FILE' );
 409     }
 410     
 411     while (!feof($handle))
 412     {
 413         $buffer = fread($handle, $chunksize);
 414         
 415         if ( $buffer === false )
 416         {
 417             return claro_failure::set_failure( 'CANNOT_READ_FILE' );
 418         }
 419         
 420         echo $buffer;
 421         
 422         if ( $retbytes )
 423         {
 424             $cnt += strlen($buffer);
 425         }
 426     }
 427     
 428     $status = fclose( $handle );
 429     
 430     if ( $retbytes && $status )
 431     {
 432         return $cnt;
 433     }
 434     else
 435     {
 436         return $status;
 437     }
 438 }

 440 /**
 441  * Check if a relative path is encoded or not
 442  * @param string $str
 443  * @return boolean
 444  */
 445 function is_download_url_encoded( $str )
 446 {
 447     $str = ltrim($str, '/');
 448     return preg_match("!^[0-9a-zA-Z\+/=]+$!", $str);

 451 /**
 452  * WARNING : DO NOT USE IN Url OBJET : ALREADY URLENCODED
 453  *  USE BASE64_ENCODE INSTEAD !
 454  * Encode course relative file path to use with backend/download
 455  * @param string file relative path
 456  * @return string
 457  */
 458 function download_url_encode( $str )
 459 {
 460     if ( $GLOBALS['is_Apache'] && get_conf('usePrettyUrl', false) )
 461     {
 462         $str = ltrim($str, '/');
 463         return '/' . urlencode(base64_encode( $str ) );
 464     }
 465     else
 466     {
 467         return urlencode(base64_encode( $str ) );
 468     }
 469 }

 471 /**
 472  * Decode encoded relative file path
 473  * @param string $str
 474  * @return string
 475  */
 476 function download_url_decode( $str )
 477 {
 478     if ( $GLOBALS['is_Apache'] && get_conf('usePrettyUrl', false) )
 479     {
 480         $str = ltrim($str, '/');
 481         return '/' . ltrim( base64_decode( $str ), '/' );
 482     }
 483     else
 484     {
 485         return base64_decode( $str );
 486     }

 489 /**
 490  * Get the url to download the file at the given file path
 491  * @param string $file path to the file
 492  * @param array $context
 493  * @param string $moduleLabel
 494  * @since Claroline 1.10.5
 495  * @return string url to the file
 496  */
 497 function claro_get_file_download_url( $file, $context = null, $moduleLabel = null )
 498 {
 499     $file = download_url_encode( $file );
 500     
 501     if ( $GLOBALS['is_Apache'] && get_conf('usePrettyUrl', false) )
 502     {
 503         // slash argument method - only compatible with Apache
 504         $url = get_path('url') . '/claroline/backends/download.php'.str_replace('%2F', '/', $file);
 505     }
 506     else
 507     {
 508         // question mark argument method, for IIS ...
 509         $url = get_path('url') . '/claroline/backends/download.php?url=' . $file;
 510     }
 511     
 512     $urlObj = new Url( $url );
 513     
 514     if ( !empty ( $context ) )
 515     {
 516         $urlObj->relayContext( Claro_Context::getUrlContext( $context ) );
 517     }
 518     else
 519     {
 520         $urlObj->relayCurrentContext();
 521     }
 522     
 523     if ( $moduleLabel )
 524     {
 525         $urlObj->addParam( 'moduleLabel', $moduleLabel );
 526     }
 527 
 528     return $urlObj->toUrl();
 529 }

 577             '~&([a-z]{1,2})(acute|cedil|circ|grave|lig|orn|ring|slash|th|tilde|uml);~i', 
 578             '$1', 
 579             claro_htmlentities( claro_utf8_encode( $string ) , ENT_QUOTES , 'UTF-8' ) 
 580         );
 581     }
 582 
 583     $string = str_replace("'", '', $string);
 584     
 585     return $string;
 586 }

  21 /**
  22  * Checks a file or a directory actually exist at this location
  23  *
  24  * @param  - filePath (string) - path of the presume existing file or dir
  25  * @return - boolean TRUE if the file or the directory exists
  26  *           boolean FALSE otherwise.
  27  */
  28 
  29 function check_name_exist($filePath)
  30 {
  31     clearstatcache();
  32     return file_exists($filePath);
  33 }

  35 /**
  36  * Delete a file or a directory (and its whole content)
  37  *
  38  * @param  - $filePath (String) - the path of file or directory to delete
  39  * @return - boolean - true if the delete succeed
  40  *           boolean - false otherwise.
  41  */
  42 
  43 function claro_delete_file($filePath)
  44 {
  45     if( is_file($filePath) )
  46     {
  47         return unlink($filePath);
  48     }
  49     elseif( is_dir($filePath) )
  50     {
  51         $dirHandle = @opendir($filePath);
  52 
  53         if ( ! $dirHandle )
  54         {
  55             function_exists('claro_html_debug_backtrace') && pushClaroMessage( claro_html_debug_backtrace());
  56             return false;
  57         }
  58 
  59         $removableFileList = array();
  60 
  61         while ( false !== ($file = readdir($dirHandle) ) )
  62         {
  63             if ( $file == '.' || $file == '..') continue;
  64 
  65             $removableFileList[] = $filePath . '/' . $file;
  66         }
  67 
  68         closedir($dirHandle); // impossible to test, closedir return void ...
  69 
  70         if ( sizeof($removableFileList) > 0)
  71         {
  72             foreach($removableFileList as $thisFile)
  73             {
  74                 if ( ! claro_delete_file($thisFile) ) return false;
  75             }
  76         }
  77 
  78         clearstatcache();
  79         if (is_writable($filePath)) return @rmdir($filePath);
  80         else
  81         {
  82             function_exists('claro_html_debug_backtrace') && pushClaroMessage( claro_html_debug_backtrace());
  83             return false;
  84         }
  85 
  86     } // end elseif is_dir()
  87 }

  92 /**
  93  * Rename a file or a directory
  94  *
  95  * @param  - $filePath (string) - complete path of the file or the directory
  96  * @param  - $newFileName (string) - new name for the file or the directory
  97  * @return - string  - new file path if it succeeds
  98  *         - boolean - false otherwise
  99  * @see    - rename() uses the check_name_exist() and php2phps() functions
 100  */
 101 
 102 function claro_rename_file($oldFilePath, $newFilePath)
 103 {
 104     if (realpath($oldFilePath) == realpath($newFilePath) ) return true;
 105 
 106     /* CHECK IF THE NEW NAME HAS AN EXTENSION */
 107     if ( ! is_dir( $oldFilePath ) )
 108     {
 109         $ext_new = get_file_extension( $newFilePath );
 110         $ext_old = get_file_extension( $oldFilePath );
 111         
 112         if( empty($ext_new) && !empty($ext_old) )
 113         {
 114             $newFilePath .= '.' . $ext_old;
 115         }
 116     }
 117 
 118     /* PREVENT FILE NAME WITH PHP EXTENSION */
 119 
 120     $newFilePath = get_secure_file_name($newFilePath);
 121 
 122     /* REPLACE CHARACTER POTENTIALY DANGEROUS FOR THE SYSTEM */
 123 
 124     $newFilePath = dirname($newFilePath).'/'
 125     .              replace_dangerous_char(basename($newFilePath))
 126     ;
 127 
 128     if (check_name_exist($newFilePath)
 129         && $newFilePath != $oldFilePath)
 130     {
 131         return false;
 132     }
 133     else
 134     {
 135         if(check_name_exist( $oldFilePath) )
 136         {
 137             if ( rename($oldFilePath, $newFilePath) )
 138             {
 139                 return $newFilePath;
 140             }
 141             else
 142             {
 143                 return false;
 144             }   
 145         }
 146         else
 147         {
 148             return false;
 149         }
 150     }
 151 }

 156 /**
 157  * Move a file or a directory to an other area
 158  *
 159  * @param  - $sourcePath (String) - the path of file or directory to move
 160  * @param  - $targetPath (String) - the path of the new area
 161  * @return - boolean - true if the move succeed
 162  *           boolean - false otherwise.
 163  */
 164 
 165 
 166 function claro_move_file($sourcePath, $targetPath)
 167 {
 168     if (realpath($sourcePath) == realpath($targetPath) ) return true;
 169 
 170     // check to not copy a directory inside itself
 171     if (   is_dir($sourcePath)
 172         && preg_match('/^' . str_replace( '/' , '\/' , $sourcePath ) . '\//', $targetPath . '/') )
 173         return claro_failure::set_failure('MOVE INSIDE ITSELF');
 174 
 175     $sourceFileName = basename($sourcePath);
 176 
 177     if (   $sourcePath == $targetPath
 178         || file_exists($targetPath . '/' . $sourceFileName) )
 179          return claro_failure::set_failure('FILE EXISTS');
 180 
 181     if ( is_dir($targetPath) )
 182     {
 183         return rename($sourcePath, $targetPath . '/' . $sourceFileName);
 184     }
 185     else
 186     {
 187         return rename($sourcePath, $targetPath);
 188     }
 189 }

 194 /**
 195  * Copy a file or a directory and its content to an other directory
 196  *
 197  * @param  - $sourcePath (String) - the path of the directory or the path of the file to move
 198  * @param  - $targetPath (String) - the path of the destination directory
 199  * @return - void no return !!
 200  */
 201 
 202 function claro_copy_file($sourcePath, $targetPath)
 203 {
 204     $fileName = basename($sourcePath);
 205     
 206     $sourcePath = realpath ($sourcePath);
 207     $targetPath = realpath ($targetPath);
 208     if (! is_readable($sourcePath)) Console::warning($sourcePath . 'not readable');
 209     if (! is_writable($targetPath)) Console::warning($targetPath . 'not writable');
 210     
 211     if ( is_file($sourcePath) )
 212     {
 213         return copy($sourcePath , $targetPath . '/' . $fileName);
 214     }
 215     elseif ( is_dir($sourcePath) )
 216     {
 217         if ( strtoupper( substr( PHP_OS, 0, 3 ) ) === 'WIN' )
 218         {
 219             // fix windows path for regexp
 220             $sourcePath = str_replace( '\\', '\\\\', $sourcePath );
 221             $targetPath = str_replace( '\\', '\\\\', $targetPath );
 222         }
 223         
 224         // check to not copy the directory inside itself
 225         if ( preg_match('/^'.str_replace( '/', '\/', $sourcePath ) . '\//', str_replace( '/', '\/', $targetPath ) . '/') ) return false;
 226 
 227         if ( ! claro_mkdir($targetPath . '/' . $fileName, CLARO_FILE_PERMISSIONS) )   return false;
 228         
 229         $dirHandle = opendir($sourcePath);
 230 
 231         if ( ! $dirHandle ) return false;
 232 
 233         $copiableFileList = array();
 234 
 235         while ( false !== ( $element = readdir($dirHandle) ) )
 236         {
 237             if ( $element == '.' || $element == '..' || $element == '.svn') continue;
 238             
 239             $copiableFileList[] = $sourcePath . '/' . $element;
 240         }
 241 
 242         closedir($dirHandle);
 243         
 244         if ( count($copiableFileList) > 0 )
 245         {
 246             foreach($copiableFileList as $thisFile)
 247             {
 248                 if ( ! claro_copy_file($thisFile, $targetPath . '/' . $fileName) ) return false;
 249             }
 250         }
 251 
 252         return true;
 253     } // end elseif is_dir()
 254 }

 274 /* NOTE: These functions batch is used to automatically build HTML forms
 275  * with a list of the directories contained on the course Directory.
 276  *
 277  * From a thechnical point of view, form_dir_lists calls sort_dir wich calls index_dir
 278  */
 279 
 280 /**
 281  * Indexes all the directories and subdirectories
 282  * contented in a given directory
 283  *
 284  * @param  dirPath (string) - directory path of the one to index
 285  * @param  mode (string) - ALL, FILE, DIR : specify what will be listed
 286  * @return an array containing the path of all the subdirectories
 287  */
 288 
 289 function index_dir($dirPath, $mode = 'ALL' )
 290 {
 291     $files = array();
 292     if( is_dir($dirPath) ) 
 293     {
 294         $fh = opendir($dirPath);
 295         while( ( $fileName = readdir($fh) ) !== false ) 
 296         {
 297             // loop through the files, skipping . and .., and recursing if necessary
 298             if( $fileName == '.' || $fileName == '..' || $fileName == 'CVS' ) continue;
 299             
 300             $filePath = $dirPath . '/' . $fileName;
 301             
 302             if( is_dir($filePath) )
 303             {
 304                 if( $mode != 'FILE' ) array_push($files, $filePath); // mode == DIR or ALL : store dirname
 305                 $files = array_merge($files, index_dir($filePath, $mode));
 306             }
 307             elseif( $mode != 'DIR' )
 308             {
 309                 // mode == FILE or ALL : store filename
 310                 array_push($files, $filePath);
 311             }
 312         }
 313         closedir($fh);
 314     } 
 315     else
 316     {
 317         // false if the function was called with an invalid non-directory argument
 318         Console::warning($dirPath . 'not a dir');
 319         $files = false;
 320     }
 321     return $files;
 322 }

 324 /**
 325  * Indexes all the directories and subdirectories
 326  * contented in a given directory, and sort them alphabetically
 327  *
 328  * @param  - path (string) - directory path of the one to index
 329  * @return - an array containing the path of all the subdirectories sorted
 330  *           false, if there is no directory
 331  * @see    - index_and_sort_dir uses the index_dir() function
 332  */
 333 
 334 function index_and_sort_dir($path)
 335 {
 336     $dir_list = index_dir($path, 'DIR');
 337 
 338     if ($dir_list)
 339     {
 340         sort($dir_list);
 341         return $dir_list;
 342     }
 343     else
 344     {
 345         return false;
 346     }
 347 }

 357 function form_dir_list($file, $baseWorkDir)
 358 {

 360     $dirList = index_and_sort_dir($baseWorkDir);
