 362     $dialogBox = '<strong>' . get_lang('Move') . '</strong>' . "\n" 
 363     ."<form action=\"".$_SERVER['PHP_SELF']."\" method=\"post\">\n"
 364                  .    claro_form_relay_context()
 365                  ."<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"cmd\" value=\"exMv\" />\n"
 366                  ."<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"file\" value=\"".base64_encode($file)."\" />\n"
 367                  ."<label for=\"destiantion\">"
 368                  . get_lang('Move <i>%filename</i> to', array('%filename' => basename($file) ))
 369                  ."</label> \n"
 370                  ."<select name=\"destination\">\n";
 371 
 372     if ( dirname($file) == '/' || dirname($file) == '\\')
 373     {
 374         $dialogBox .= '<option value="" class="invisible">root</option>' . "\n";
 375     }
 376     else
 377     {
 378         $dialogBox .= '<option value="" >root</option>' . "\n";
 379     }
 380 
 381 
 382     $bwdLen = strlen($baseWorkDir) ;    // base directories length, used under
 383 
 384     /* build html form inputs */
 385 
 386     if ($dirList)
 387     {
 388         while (list( , $pathValue) = each($dirList) )
 389         {
 390 
 391             $pathValue = substr ( $pathValue , $bwdLen );        // truncate confidential informations
 392             $dirname = basename ($pathValue);                    // extract $pathValue directory name
 393 
 394             /* compute de the display tab */
 395 
 396             $tab = '';                                        // $tab reinitialisation
 397             $depth = substr_count($pathValue, '/');            // The number of nombre '/' indicates the directory deepness
 398 
 399             for ($h = 0; $h < $depth; $h++)
 400             {
 401                 $tab .= '&nbsp;&nbsp';
 402             }
 403 
 404             if ($file == $pathValue OR dirname($file) == $pathValue)
 405             {
 406                 $dialogBox .= '<option class="invisible" value="'.$pathValue.'">'.$tab.' &gt; '.$dirname.'</option>'."\n";
 407             }
 408             else
 409             {
 410                 $dialogBox .= '<option value="'.$pathValue.'">'.$tab.' &gt; '.$dirname.'</option>'."\n";
 411             }
 412         }
 413     }
 414 
 415     $dialogBox .= '</select>' . "\n"
 416                .  '<br /><br />'
 417                .  '<input type="submit" value="'.get_lang('Ok').'" />&nbsp;'
 418                .  claro_html_button($_SERVER['PHP_SELF'].'?cmd=exChDir&file='.claro_htmlspecialchars(claro_dirname($file)), get_lang('Cancel'))
 419                .  '</form>' . "\n";
 420 
 421     return $dialogBox;

 428 /**
 429  * create directories path
 430  *
 431  * @param string  $pathname
 432  * @param int     $mode directory permission (optional)
 433  * @param boolean $recursive (optional)
 434  * @return boolean TRUE if succeed, false otherwise
 435  */
 436 
 437 function claro_mkdir($pathName, $mode = 0777, $recursive = false)
 438 {
 439     if ($recursive)
 440     {
 441         if ( strstr($pathName,get_path('rootSys')) !== false )
 442         {
 443             /* Remove rootSys path from pathName for system with safe_mode or open_basedir restrictions
 444                Functions (like file_exists, mkdir, ...) return false for files inaccessible with these restrictions
 445             */
 446 
 447             $pathName = str_replace(get_path('rootSys'),'',$pathName);
 448             $dirTrail = get_path('rootSys') ;
 449         }
 450         else
 451         {
 452             $dirTrail = '';
 453         }
 454 
 455         $dirList = explode( '/', str_replace('\\', '/', $pathName) );
 456 
 457         $dirList[0] = empty($dirList[0]) ? '/' : $dirList[0];
 458 
 459         foreach($dirList as $thisDir)
 460         {
 461             $dirTrail .= empty($dirTrail) ? $thisDir : '/'.$thisDir;
 462 
 463             if ( file_exists($dirTrail) )
 464             {
 465                 if ( is_dir($dirTrail) ) continue;
 466                 else                     return false;
 467             }
 468             else
 469             {
 470 
 471                 if ( ! @mkdir($dirTrail , $mode) ) return false;
 472             }
 473 
 474         }
 475         return true;
 476     }
 477     else
 478     {
 479         // remove trailing slash
 480         if( substr($pathName, -1) == '/' )
 481         {
 482             $pathName = substr($pathName, 0, -1);
 483         }
 484 
 485         return @mkdir($pathName, $mode);
 486     }
 487 }

 525 /**
 526  * search files or directory whose name fit a pattern
 527  *
 528  * @param string $searchPattern - Perl compatible regex to search on file name
 529  * @param string $baseDirPath - directory path where to start the search
 530  * @param string $fileType (optional) - filter allowing to restrict search
 531  *        on files or directories (allowed value are 'ALL', 'FILE', 'DIR').
 532  * @param array $excludedPathList (optional) - list of files or directories
 533  *        that have to be excluded from the search
 534  * @return array path list of the files fitting the search pattern
 535  */
 536 
 537 function claro_search_file($searchPattern             , $baseDirPath,
 538                            $recursive        = false , $fileType = 'ALL',
 539                            $excludedPathList = array()                    )
 540 {
 541         $searchResultList = array();
 542 
 543         //$baseDirPath unexisting is  a devel error or a data incoherence,
 544         if (! file_exists($baseDirPath))
 545         {
 546             // TODO would push an error but return empty array instead of false.
 547             return claro_failure::set_failure('BASE_DIR_DONT_EXIST');
 548         }
 549 
 550         $dirPt = opendir($baseDirPath);
 551 
 552         //can't be false as if (! file_exists($baseDirPath))  have make a good control
 553         //if ( ! $dirPt) return false;
 554 
 555         while ( $fileName = readdir($dirPt) )
 556         {
 557             $filePath = $baseDirPath.'/'.$fileName;
 558 
 559             if (   $fileName == '.' || $fileName == '..'
 560                 || in_array('/'.ltrim($filePath,'/'), $excludedPathList ) )
 561             {
 562                 continue;
 563             }
 564             else
 565             {
 566 
 567                 if ( is_dir($filePath) ) $dirList[] = $filePath;
 568 
 569                 if ( $fileType == 'DIR'  && is_file($filePath) )
 570                 {
 571                     continue;
 572                 }
 573 
 574                 if ( $fileType == 'FILE' && is_dir($filePath) )
 575                 {
 576                     continue;
 577                 }
 578 
 579                 if ( preg_match($searchPattern, $fileName) )
 580                 {
 581                     $searchResultList[] = $filePath;
 582                 }
 583 
 584             }
 585         }
 586 
 587         closedir($dirPt);
 588 
 589         if ( $recursive && isset($dirList) && count($dirList) > 0)
 590         {
 591             foreach($dirList as $thisDir)
 592             {
 593                 $searchResultList =
 594                     array_merge( $searchResultList,
 595                                  claro_search_file($searchPattern, $thisDir,
 596                                                    $recursive, $fileType,
 597                                                    $excludedPathList)
 598                                );
 599             }
 600         }
 601 
 602         return $searchResultList;
 603 }
 604 
 605 /**
 606  * convert search string coming from the user interface
 607  * to a Perl Compatible Regular Expression (PCRE)
 608  *
 609  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
 610  * @param string search string
 611  * @return string Perl Compatible Regular Expression
 612  */
 613 
 614 
 615 function search_string_to_pcre($searchPattern)
 616 {
 617     $searchPattern   = str_replace('.', '\\.', $searchPattern);
 618     $searchPattern   = str_replace('*', '.*' , $searchPattern);
 619     $searchPattern   = str_replace('?', '.?' , $searchPattern);
 620     $searchPattern   = '|'.$searchPattern.'|i';
 621     return $searchPattern;
 622 }

 685 /**
 686  * Update the file or directory path in the document db document table
 687  *
 688  * @param  String action    - action type require : 'delete' or 'update'
 689  * @param  String filePath  - original path of the file
 690  * @param  String $newParam - new param of the file, can contain
 691  *                              'path', 'visibility' and 'comment'
 692  *
 693  */
 694 
 695 function update_db_info($action, $filePath, $newParamList = array())
 696 {
 697     global $dbTable; // table 'document'
 698     
 699     if (strtoupper(substr(PHP_OS, 0, 3)) == "WIN")
 700     {
 701         $modifier = '';
 702     }
 703     else
 704     {
 705         $modifier = 'BINARY ';
 706     }
 707 
 708     $newComment    = (isset($newParamList['comment'   ]) ? trim($newParamList['comment'   ]) : null);
 709     $newVisibility = (isset($newParamList['visibility']) ? trim($newParamList['visibility']) : null);
 710     $newPath       = (isset($newParamList['path'      ]) ? trim($newParamList['path'      ]) : null);
 711 
 712     if ($action == 'delete') // case for a delete
 713     {
 714         $theQuery = "DELETE FROM `".$dbTable."`
 715                      WHERE path=\"".claro_sql_escape($filePath)."\"
 716                      OR    path LIKE \"".claro_sql_escape($filePath)."/%\"";
 717 
 718         claro_sql_query($theQuery);
 719     }
 720     elseif ($action == 'update')
 721     {
 722         // GET OLD PARAMETERS IF THEY EXIST
 723 
 724         $sql = "SELECT path, comment, visibility
 725                 FROM `".$dbTable."`
 726                 WHERE {$modifier} path=\"".claro_sql_escape($filePath)."\"";
 727 
 728         $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 729         if ( count($result) > 0 ) list($oldAttributeList) = $result;
 730         else                      $oldAttributeList = null;
 731 
 732         if ( ! $oldAttributeList ) // NO RECORD CONCERNING THIS FILE YET ...
 733         {
 734             if ( $newComment || $newVisibility == 'i' )
 735             {
 736                 if ( $newVisibility != 'i' ) $newVisibility = 'v';
 737                 $insertedPath = ( $newPath ? $newPath : $filePath);
 738 
 739                 $theQuery = "INSERT INTO `".$dbTable."`
 740                              SET path       = \"".claro_sql_escape($insertedPath)."\",
 741                                  comment    = \"".claro_sql_escape($newComment)."\",
 742                                  visibility = \"".claro_sql_escape($newVisibility)."\"";
 743             } // else noop
 744 
 745         }
 746         else // ALREADY A RECORD CONCERNING THIS FILE
 747         {
 748             if ( is_null($newVisibility ) ) $newVisibility = $oldAttributeList['visibility'];
 749             if ( is_null($newComment    ) ) $newComment    = $oldAttributeList['comment'   ];
 750 
 751             if ( empty($newComment) && $newVisibility == 'v')
 752             {
 753                 // NO RELEVANT PARAMETERS ANYMORE => DELETE THE RECORD
 754                 $theQuery = "DELETE FROM `".$dbTable."`
 755                              WHERE {$modifier} path=\"".$filePath."\"";
 756             }
 757             else
 758             {
 759                 $theQuery = "UPDATE `" . $dbTable . "`
 760                              SET   comment    = '" . claro_sql_escape($newComment) . "',
 761                                    visibility = '" . claro_sql_escape($newVisibility) . "'
 762                              WHERE {$modifier} path     = '" . claro_sql_escape($filePath) . "'";
 763             }
 764         } // end else if ! $oldAttributeList
 765 
 766         if( isset($theQuery ) ) claro_sql_query($theQuery);
 767 
 768         if ( $newPath )
 769         {
 770             $theQuery = "UPDATE `" . $dbTable . "`
 771                         SET path = CONCAT('" . claro_sql_escape($newPath) . "',
 772                                    SUBSTRING(path, LENGTH('" . claro_sql_escape($filePath) . "')+1) )
 773                         WHERE {$modifier} path = '" . claro_sql_escape($filePath) . "'
 774                         OR {$modifier} path LIKE '" . claro_sql_escape($filePath) . "/%'";
 775 
 776             claro_sql_query($theQuery);
 777         }
 778     } // end else if action == update
 779 }

 781 //------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 782 
 783 
 784 function update_Doc_Path_in_Assets($type, $oldPath, $newPath)
 785 {
 786     global $TABLEASSET, $TABLELEARNPATHMODULE,
 787            $TABLEUSERMODULEPROGRESS, $TABLEMODULE;
 788            
 789     if (strtoupper(substr(PHP_OS, 0, 3)) == "WIN")
 790     {
 791         $modifier = '';
 792     }
 793     else
 794     {
 795         $modifier = 'BINARY ';
 796     }
 797 
 798     switch ($type)
 799     {
 800         case 'update' :
 801 
 802             // if the path did not change, don't change it !
 803             if ( empty($newPath) )
 804             {
 805                 return false;
 806             }
 807 
 808             // Find and update assets that are concerned by this move
 809             $sql = "SELECT `path` FROM `" . $TABLEASSET . "` WHERE {$modifier} `path` = '" . claro_sql_escape($oldPath) . "%'";
 810 
 811             $result = claro_sql_query($sql);
 812 
 813             $num = mysql_num_rows($result);
 814 
 815             // the document with the exact path exists
 816             if ( $num )
 817             {
 818 
 819                 $sql = "UPDATE `" . $TABLEASSET . "`
 820                         SET `path` = '" . claro_sql_escape($newPath) . "'
 821                         WHERE {$modifier} `path` = '" . claro_sql_escape($oldPath) . "'";
 822             }
 823             // a document in the renamed directory exists
 824             else
 825             {
 826                 $sql = "UPDATE `" . $TABLEASSET . "`
 827                         SET path = CONCAT('" . claro_sql_escape($newPath) . "',
 828                                    SUBSTRING(path, LENGTH('" . claro_sql_escape($oldPath) . "')+1) )
 829                         WHERE {$modifier} path = '" . claro_sql_escape($oldPath) . "'
 830                         OR {$modifier} path LIKE '" . claro_sql_escape($oldPath) . "/%'";
 831             }
 832 
 833             claro_sql_query($sql);
 834 
 835             break;
 836 
 837         case 'delete' :
 838 
 839             // delete assets, modules, learning path modules, and userprogress that are based on this document
 840 
 841             // find all assets concerned by this deletion
 842 
 843             $sql ="SELECT *
 844                    FROM `" . $TABLEASSET . "`
 845                    WHERE {$modifier} `path` LIKE '" . claro_sql_escape($oldPath) . "%'
 846                    ";
 847 
 848             $result = claro_sql_query($sql);
 849 
 850             $num = mysql_num_rows($result);
 851             if ($num != 0)
 852             {
 853                   //find all learning path module concerned by the deletion
 854 
 855                   $sqllpm ="SELECT *
 856                             FROM `" . $TABLELEARNPATHMODULE . "`
 857                             WHERE 0=1
 858                             ";
 859 
 860                   while ($list=mysql_fetch_array($result))
 861                   {
 862                      $sqllpm.= " OR `module_id` = '" . (int)$list['module_id'] . "' ";
 863                   }
 864 
 865                   $result2 = claro_sql_query($sqllpm);
 866 
 867                   //delete the learning path module(s)
 868 
 869                   $sql1 ="DELETE
 870                           FROM `" . $TABLELEARNPATHMODULE . "`
 871                           WHERE 0=1
 872                           ";
 873 
 874                   // delete the module(s) concerned
 875                   $sql2 ="DELETE
 876                           FROM `" . $TABLEMODULE . "`
 877                           WHERE 0=1
 878                          ";
 879 
 880                   $result = mysql_query($sqllpm);//:to reset result resused
 881 
 882                   while ($list=mysql_fetch_array($result))
 883                   {
 884                      $sql1.= " OR `module_id` = '" . (int)$list['module_id'] . "' ";
 885                      $sql2.= " OR `module_id` = '" . (int)$list['module_id'] . "' ";
 886                   }
 887 
 888                   claro_sql_query($sql1);
 889                   claro_sql_query($sql2);
 890 
 891                   //delete the user module progress concerned
 892 
 893                   $sql ="DELETE
 894                          FROM `" . $TABLEUSERMODULEPROGRESS . "`
 895                          WHERE 0=1
 896                          ";
 897                   while ($list=mysql_fetch_array($result2))
 898                   {
 899                      $sql.= " OR `learnPath_module_id` = '" . (int)$list['learnPath_module_id'] . "' ";
 900                   }
 901 
 902                   claro_sql_query($sql);
 903 
 904                   // delete the assets
 905 
 906                   $sql ="DELETE
 907                          FROM `" . $TABLEASSET . "`
 908                          WHERE
 909                          {$modifier} `path` LIKE '" . claro_sql_escape($oldPath) . "%'
 910                          ";
 911 
 912                   claro_sql_query($sql);
 913             } //end if($num !=0)
 914             break;
 915      }
 916 
 917 }

 919 /*
 920  * Return html content between <body> and </body> from $html
 921  *
 922  * @param string $html html content
 923  *
 924  * @return string html body content
 925  */
 926 
 927 function get_html_body_content($html)
 928 {
 929     $body_open_pattern = '/<body[^<>]*>/';
 930     $body_close_pattern = '/<\/body>/';
 931 
 932     // remove html before <body>
 933     $split_html = preg_split($body_open_pattern,$html);
 934 
 935     if ( count($split_html) > 1 )
 936     {
 937         $html = $split_html[1];
 938     }
 939 
 940     // remove html after </body>
 941     $split_html = preg_split($body_close_pattern,$html);
 942 
 943     if ( count($split_html) > 0 )
 944     {
 945         $html = $split_html[0];
 946     }
 947 
 948     return $html;
 949 }

  36 {

  38              ? claro_html_debug_backtrace()

  46 function claro_html_date_form($dayFieldName, $monthFieldName, $yearFieldName, $unixDate = 0, $formatMonth = 'numeric' )
  47 {
  48     if( $unixDate == 0) $selectedDate = date('Y-m-d');
  49     else                $selectedDate = date('Y-m-d', $unixDate);
  50 
  51     // split selectedDate
  52     list($selYear, $selMonth, $selDay) = explode('-', $selectedDate);
  53 
  54     // day field
  55     for ($dayCounter=1;$dayCounter <=31; $dayCounter++)
  56       $available_days[$dayCounter] = $dayCounter;
  57     $dayField = claro_html_form_select( $dayFieldName
  58                                    , $available_days
  59                                    , $selDay
  60                                    , array('id'=> $dayFieldName)
  61                                    );
  62 
  63     // month field
  64     if( $formatMonth == 'numeric' )
  65     {
  66         for ($monthCounter=1;$monthCounter <= 12; $monthCounter++)
  67           $available_months[$monthCounter] = $monthCounter;
  68     }
  69     elseif( $formatMonth == 'long' )
  70     {
  71         $langMonthNames['long'] = get_lang_month_name_list('long');
  72 
  73         for ($monthCounter=1;$monthCounter <= 12; $monthCounter++)
  74           $available_months[$langMonthNames['long'][$monthCounter-1]] = $monthCounter;
  75     }
  76     elseif( $formatMonth == 'short' )
  77     {
  78         $langMonthNames['short'] = get_lang_month_name_list('short');
  79         for ($monthCounter=1;$monthCounter <= 12; $monthCounter++)
  80           $available_months[$langMonthNames['short'][$monthCounter-1]] = $monthCounter;
  81     }
  82     $monthField = claro_html_form_select( $monthFieldName
  83                                    , $available_months
  84                                    , $selMonth
  85                                    , array('id'=> $monthFieldName)
  86                                    );
  87     // year field
  88     $thisYear = date('Y');
  89     for ($yearCounter= $thisYear - 2; $yearCounter <= $thisYear+5; $yearCounter++)
  90         $available_years[$yearCounter] = $yearCounter;
  91     $yearField = claro_html_form_select( $yearFieldName
  92                                    , $available_years
  93                                    , $selYear
  94                                    , array('id'=> $yearFieldName)
  95                                    );
  96 
  97     return $dayField . '&nbsp;' . $monthField . '&nbsp;' . $yearField;
  98 }

 127 function claro_html_time_form($hourFieldName, $minuteFieldName, $unixDate = 0)
 128 {
 129     if( $unixDate == 0) $selectedTime = date("H:i");
 130     else                $selectedTime = date("H:i",$unixDate);
 131 
 132 
 133     //split selectedTime
 134     list($selHour, $selMinute) = explode(':',$selectedTime);
 135 
 136 
 137     if ($hourFieldName != '')
 138     {
 139         for($hour=0;$hour < 24; $hour++)  $aivailable_hours[$hour] = $hour;
 140         $hourField = claro_html_form_select( $hourFieldName
 141                                            , $aivailable_hours
 142                                            , $selHour
 143                                            , array('id'=> $hourFieldName)
 144                                            );
 145     }
 146 
 147     if($minuteFieldName != "")
 148     {
 149         for($minuteCounter=0;$minuteCounter < 60; $minuteCounter++)
 150             $available_minutes[$minuteCounter] = $minuteCounter;
 151 
 152         $minuteField = claro_html_form_select( $minuteFieldName
 153                                            , $available_minutes
 154                                            , $selMinute
 155                                            , array('id'=> $minuteFieldName)
 156                                            );
 157     }
 158 
 159     return '&nbsp;' . $hourField . '&nbsp;' . $minuteField;

 167  *  with reverted set to true

 169  * @param bool $reverted set the function in reverted mode to use value => label

 172  *
 173  * @author Christophe Gesché <moosh@claroline.net>

 176 function claro_html_form_select($select_name,$list_option,$preselect=null,$attr=null, $reverted = false)
 177 {
 178     $html_select = '<select name="' . $select_name . '" ';
 179     if (is_array($attr)) foreach($attr as $attr_name=>$attr_value)
 180     $html_select .=' ' . $attr_name . '="' . $attr_value . '" ';
 181     $html_select .= '>' . "\n"
 182     .                claro_html_option_list($list_option,$preselect, $reverted)
 183     .               '</select>' . "\n"
 184     ;
 185 
 186     return $html_select;
 187 }

 190 /**
 191  * return a string as html form option list to plce in a <select>
 192  * @param array $list_option 2D table where key are labels and value are values
 193  *  with reverted set to false (default) or key are values and value are labels
 194  *  with reverted set to true
 195  * @param string $preselect name of the key in $list_option would be preselected
 196  * @param bool $reverted set the function in reverted mode to use value => label
 197  *  instead of label => value arrays (default false)
 198  * @return html output of the select options
 199  *
 200  * @author Christophe Gesché <moosh@claroline.net>
 201  *
 202  */
 203 function claro_html_option_list($list_option, $preselect, $reverted = false)
 204 {
 205     $html_option_list ='';
 206     if(is_array($list_option))
 207     {
 208         if ( ! $reverted )
 209         {
 210             foreach($list_option as $option_label => $option_value)
 211             {
 212                 $html_option_list .= '<option value="' . $option_value . '"'
 213                 .                    ($option_value ==  $preselect ?' selected="selected" ':'') . '>'
 214                 .                    claro_htmlspecialchars($option_label)
 215                 .                    '</option >' . "\n"
 216                 ;
 217             }
 218         }
 219         else
 220         {
 221             foreach($list_option as $option_value => $option_label)
 222             {
 223                 $html_option_list .= '<option value="' . $option_value . '"'
 224                 .                    ($option_value ==  $preselect ?' selected="selected" ':'') . '>'
 225                 .                    claro_htmlspecialchars($option_label)
 226                 .                    '</option >' . "\n"
 227                 ;
 228             }
 229         }
 230         return $html_option_list;
 231     }
 232     else
 233     {
 234         trigger_error('$list_option would be array()', E_USER_NOTICE);
 235         return false;
 236     }
 237 
 238 }

  31 function claro_html_list($itemList, $attrBloc=array())
  32 {
  33     $classBlocAttr          = '';
  34     $otherBlocAttrString    = '';
  35     $htmlStream             = '';
  36     
  37     foreach ($attrBloc as $attrName => $attrValue)
  38     {
  39         if ($attrName == 'class')
  40             $classBlocAttr = ' ' . trim($attrValue);
  41         else
  42             $otherBlocAttrString .= ' ' . $attrName . '="' . $attrValue . '"';
  43     }
  44     
  45     if (!empty($classBlocAttr))
  46         $classBlocAttr = 'class="'.trim($classBlocAttr).'"';
  47     
  48     
  49     if (! empty($itemList) && is_array($itemList))
  50     {
  51         $htmlList = '';
  52         
  53         foreach ($itemList as $item)
  54         {
  55             $htmlList .= '<li>'.$item.'</li>';
  56         }
  57         
  58         $htmlStream = '<ul ' . $classBlocAttr . ' ' . $otherBlocAttrString . '>'
  59                     . $htmlList
  60                     . '</ul>';
  61     }
  62     
  63     return $htmlStream;
  64 }

  92 /**
  93  * Prepare an array of link following a list of section
  94  *
  95  * @param array $section_list array('section_name'=> of section array ('label','description','properties','..'.));
  96  * @param string $section_selected  section_name
  97  * @param string $url_params query string append
  98  * @param string $currentClassName css class name
  99  * @return array
 100  */
 101  
 102  function prepared_section_to_tabs($section_list, $section_selected='',$url_params = null, $currentClassName='current')
 103 {
 104     $tabList=array();
 105         
 106     // Need at least  2 items
 107     if ( !empty($section_list) && count($section_list)>2)
 108     {
 109         //  if no selected take first
 110         if ( empty($section_selected) || ! in_array($section_selected,array_keys($section_list)) )
 111         {
 112             $section_selected = key($section_list);
 113         }
 114         
 115         foreach ( $section_list as $section=>$section_def )
 116         {
 117             $section_name = $section_def['label'];
 118             
 119             $tabList[]= '<a ' . ( $section == $section_selected ? ('class="' . $currentClassName . '"') : '' )
 120             . ' href="' . $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] . '?section=' . claro_htmlspecialchars($section)
 121                                                . claro_htmlspecialchars($url_params). '">'
 122             . get_lang($section_name) . '</a>';
 123 
 124         }
 125     }
 126     return $tabList;
 127     
 128 }

 185 /**
 186 * Prepare the display of a clikcable button
 187 *
 188 * This function is needed because claroline buttons rely on javascript.
 189 * The function return an optionnal behavior fo browser where javascript
 190 * isn't  available.
 191 *
 192 * @author Hugues Peeters <hugues.peeters@claroline.net>
 193 *
 194 * @param string $url url inserted into the 'href' part of the tag
 195 * @param string $text text inserted between the two <a>...</a> tags (note : it
 196 *        could also be an image ...)
 197 * @param string $confirmMessage (optionnal) introduce a javascript confirmation popup
 198 * @return string the button
 199 */
 200 function claro_html_button($url, $text, $confirmMessage = '')
 201 {
 202     $url = secure_backlink_url($url);
 203 
 204     if ($confirmMessage != '')
 205     {
 206         $onClickCommand = "if(confirm('" . clean_str_for_javascript($confirmMessage) . "')){document.location='" . $url . "';return false}";
 207     }
 208     else
 209     {
 210         $onClickCommand = "document.location='".$url."';return false";
 211     }
 212 
 213     return '<a href="'.$url.'">'
 214     . '<input type="button" onclick="' . $onClickCommand . '" '
 215     .      'value="'.$text.'" />'
 216     .      '</a>' . "\n"
 217     ;
 218 }

 312 /**
 313 * Allows to easily display a breadcrumb trail
 314 *
 315 * @param array $nameList bame of each breadcrumb
 316 * @param array $urlList url corresponding to the breadcrumb name above
 317 * @param string $separator (optionnal) element which segregate the breadcrumbs
 318 * @param string $homeImg (optionnal) source url for a home icon at the trail start
 319 * @return string : the build breadcrumb trail
 320 *
 321  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
 322 */
 323 function claro_html_breadcrumbtrail($nameList, $urlList, $separator = ' &gt; ', $homeImg = null)
 324 {
 325     // trail of only one element has no sense ...
 326     if (count ($nameList) < 2 ) return '<div class="breadcrumbTrail">&nbsp;</div>';
 327 
 328     $breadCrumbList = array();
 329 
 330     foreach($nameList as $thisKey => $thisName)
 331     {
 332         if (   array_key_exists($thisKey, $urlList)
 333         && ! is_null($urlList[$thisKey])       )
 334         {
 335             $startAnchorTag = '<a href="' . $urlList[$thisKey] . '" target="_top">';
 336             $endAnchorTag   = '</a>' . "\n";
 337         }
 338         else
 339         {
 340             $startAnchorTag = '';
 341             $endAnchorTag   = '';
 342         }
 343 
 344         $htmlizedName = is_htmlspecialcharized($thisName)
 345         ? $thisName
 346         : claro_htmlspecialchars($thisName);
 347 
 348         $breadCrumbList [] = $startAnchorTag
 349         . $htmlizedName
 350         . $endAnchorTag;
 351     }
 352 
 353     // Embed the last bread crumb entry of the list.
 354 
 355     $breadCrumbList[count($breadCrumbList)-1] = '<strong>'
 356     .end($breadCrumbList)
 357     .'</strong>' . "\n";
 358 
 359     return  '<div class="breadcrumbTrail">' . "\n"
 360     . ( is_null($homeImg) ? '' : '<img src="' . get_icon_url( $homeImg ) . '" alt="" /> ' . "\n" )
 361     . implode($separator . "\n", $breadCrumbList)
 362     . '</div>' . "\n";
 363 }

 366 /**
 367 * Function used to draw a progression bar
 368 *
 369 * @author Piraux Sebastien <pir@cerdecam.be>
 370 *
 371 * @param integer $progress progression in pourcent
 372 * @param integer $factor will be multiply by 100 to have the full size of the bar
 373 * (i.e. 1 will give a 100 pixel wide bar)
 374 */
 375 function claro_html_progress_bar ($progress, $factor)
 376 {
 377     $maxSize  = $factor * 100; //pixels
 378     $barwidth = $factor * $progress ;
 379 
 380     // display progress bar
 381     // origin of the bar
 382     $progressBar = '<img src="' . get_icon_url('bar_1') . '" width="1" height="12" alt="" />';
 383 
 384     if($progress != 0)
 385     $progressBar .= '<img src="' . get_icon_url('bar_1u') . '" style="width:' . $barwidth . 'px; height: 12px;" alt="" />';
 386     // display 100% bar
 387 
 388     if($progress!= 100 && $progress != 0)
 389     $progressBar .= '<img src="' . get_icon_url('bar_1m') . '" style="width: 1px; height: 12px;" alt="" />';
 390 
 391     if($progress != 100)
 392     $progressBar .= '<img src="' . get_icon_url('bar_1r') . '" style="width: ' . ($maxSize - $barwidth) . 'px; height: 12px;" alt="" />';
 393     // end of the bar
 394     $progressBar .=  '<img src="' . get_icon_url('bar_1') . '" style="width:1px; height:12px;" alt="" />';
 395 
 396     return $progressBar;
 397 }

 400 /**
 401 * Display list of messages in substyled boxes in a message_box
 402 *
 403 * In most of cases  function message_box() is enough.
 404 *
 405 * @param array $msgArrBody of array of blocs containing array of messages
 406 * @author Christophe Gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
 407 * @version 1.0
 408 * @see  message_box()
 409 *
 410 *  code for using this    in your    tools:
 411 *  $msgArrBody["nameOfCssClass"][]="foo";
 412 *  css    class can be defined in    script but try to use
 413 *  class from    generic    css    ()
 414 *  error success warning
 415 *  ...
 416 *
 417 * @todo this must be a message object where code add messages with a priority,
 418 * and the rendering is set by by priority
 419 *
 420 */
 421 function claro_html_msg_list($msgArrBody, $return=true)
 422 {
 423     $msgBox = '';
 424 
 425     if (is_array($msgArrBody) && count($msgArrBody) > 0)
 426     {
 427         foreach ($msgArrBody as $classMsg => $thisMsgArr)
 428         {
 429             if( is_array($thisMsgArr) )
 430             {
 431                 $msgBox .= '<div class="' . $classMsg . '">';
 432                 foreach ($thisMsgArr as $anotherThis) $msgBox .= '<div class="msgLine" >' . $anotherThis . '</div>';
 433                 $msgBox .= '</div>';
 434             }
 435             else
 436             {
 437                 $msgBox .= '<div class="' . $classMsg . '">';
 438                 $msgBox .= '<div class="msgLine" >' . $thisMsgArr . '</div>';
 439                 $msgBox .= '</div>';
 440             }
 441         }
 442     }
 443     $dialogBox = new DialogBox();
 444     if( $msgBox )
 445     {
 446         $dialogBox->form( $msgBox );
 447     }
 448     if ($return) return $dialogBox->render();
 449     else         echo   $dialogBox->render();
 450     return true;
 451 }

 499 /**
 500 * Insert a Wysiwyg editor inside a form instead of a textarea
 501 * A standard textarea is displayed if the Wysiwyg editor is disabled or if
 502 * the user's browser have no activated javascript support
 503 *
 504 * @param string $name content for name attribute in textarea tag
 505 * @param string $content optional content previously inserted into    the    area
 506 * @param int     $rows optional    textarea rows
 507 * @param int    $cols optional    textarea columns
 508 * @param string $optAttrib    optional - additionnal tag attributes
 509 *                                       (wrap, class, ...)
 510 * @return string html output for standard textarea or Wysiwyg editor
 511 *
 512 * @author Hugues Peeters <hugues.peeters@claroline.net>
 513 * @author Sebastien Piraux <pir@cerdecam.be>
 514 */
 515 function claro_html_textarea_editor($name, $content = '', $rows=20, $cols=80, $optAttrib='',$type='advanced')
 516 {
 517     if( !get_conf('claro_editor') ) $claro_editor = 'tiny_mce';
 518     else                            $claro_editor = get_conf('claro_editor');
 519     
 520     $possibleTypeList = array('advanced', 'simple');
 521     if( ! in_array($type, $possibleTypeList) ) $type = 'advanced';
 522         
 523     $returnString = '';
 524 
 525     // $claro_editor is the directory name of the editor
 526     $incPath = get_path('rootSys') . 'claroline/editor/' . $claro_editor;
 527     $editorPath = get_conf('urlAppend') . '/claroline/editor/';
 528     $webPath = $editorPath . $claro_editor;
 529     
 530     $isSafariOn_iPhone = preg_match("!Mobile/.*?Safari/.*?!", $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT']);
 531 
 532     if( !$isSafariOn_iPhone && file_exists($incPath . '/editor.class.php') )
 533     {
 534         // include editor class
 535         include_once $incPath . '/editor.class.php';
 536 
 537         // editor instance
 538         $editor = new editor($name,$content,$rows,$cols,$optAttrib,$webPath);
 539 
 540         if( $type == 'advanced' )
 541         {
 542             $returnString .= $editor->getAdvancedEditor();
 543         }
 544         else
 545         {
 546             $returnString .= $editor->getSimpleEditor();
 547         }
 548     }
 549     else
 550     {
 551         // if the editor class doesn't exists we cannot rely on it to display
 552         // the standard textarea
 553         $returnString .=
 554         '<textarea '
 555         .'id="'.$name.'" '
 556         .'name="'.$name.'" '
 557         .'style="width:100%" '
 558         .'rows="'.$rows.'" '
 559         .'cols="'.$cols.'" '
 560         .$optAttrib.' >'
 561         .claro_htmlspecialchars($content)
 562         .'</textarea>'."\n";
 563     }
 564 
 565     return $returnString;
 566 }
 567 
 568 
 569 function claro_html_simple_textarea($name, $content = '')
 570 {
 571     return claro_html_textarea_editor($name, $content, 20, 80, '', 'simple');
 572 }
 573 
 574 
 575 function claro_html_advanced_textarea($name, $content = '')
 576 {
 577     return claro_html_textarea_editor($name, $content, 20, 80, '', 'advanced');
 578 }

 589 /**
 590  * datagrid is actually a function but can became an object.
 591  *
 592  * function claro_disp_datagrid($dataGrid, $option = null)
 593  *
 594  * would became a static method.
 595  *
 596  * but in dynamic work,
 597  * new datagrid($dataGrid = null, $option_list = null)
 598  * set_grid(array of array $datagrid)
 599  * set_option_list(array $option_list)
 600  * set_idLineType(string $line_type)
 601  * set_idLineShift(integer $line_shift)
 602  * set_colTitleList(array('colName'=>'colTitle'));
 603  * set_colAttributeList(array('colName'=> array('attribName'=>'attribValue'))
 604  * set_caption(string 'caption');
 605  * set_counterLine(bool 'dispCounter')
 606  * set_colDecoration(string columnName,string pattern, array param)
 607  *
 608  * @package HTML
 609  * @author Christophe Gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
 610  *
 611  */
 612 class claro_datagrid
 613 {
 614     private $datagrid;
 615 
 616     private $idLineType =  'numeric';
 617     private $idLineShift = 1;
 618     private $colTitleList =null;
 619     private $colAttributeList = array();
 620     private $caption = '';
 621     private $counterLine;
 622     private $dispCounter = false;
 623     private $colHead =null;
 624     private $htmlNoRowMessage = null;
 625     private $hideColsWithoutTitle = false;
 626     private $orderCols=DG_ORDER_COLS_BY_GRID;
 627     private $decorationList = array();
 628     private $dispIdCol = true;
 629     private $internalKey = 0;
 630 
 631 
 632     function claro_datagrid($datagrid = null)
 633     {
 634         if (!is_null($datagrid))    $this->set_grid($datagrid);
 635 
 636         $this->set_idLineType('none');
 637     }
 638 
 639 
 640     /**
 641      * set data grid
 642      *
 643      * @param array $datagrid
 644      */
 645     function set_grid($datagrid)
 646     {
 647         if (is_array($datagrid))
 648         {
 649             $this->internalKey = 0;
 650             $this->datagrid = $datagrid ;
 651         }
 652         else                     trigger_error('set_grid need an array : ' .var_export($datagrid,1). ' is not array' ,E_USER_NOTICE);
 653 
 654     }
 655 
 656 
 657     function set_option_list($option_list)
 658     {
 659         foreach ( $option_list as $option => $value )
 660         {
 661             switch ( $option )
 662             {
 663                 case 'idLineShift':
 664                     $this->set_idLineShift($value);
 665                     break;
 666                 case 'colTitleList':
 667                     $this->set_colTitleList($value);
 668                     break;
 669                 case 'colAttributeList':
 670                     $this->set_colAttributeList($value);
 671                     break;
 672                 case 'caption':
 673                     $this->set_caption($value);
 674                     break;
 675             }
 676         }
 677     }
 678 
 679 
 680     /**
 681      * set the  isLineType option
 682      *
 683      * @param string $line_type 'blank' 'numeric' 'key' 'none' default:'none'
 684      *
 685      */
 686     function set_idLineType( $idLineType)
 687     {
 688         //* manage idLine option
 689         $this->idLineType = $idLineType;
 690         switch (strtolower($idLineType))
 691         {
 692             case 'blank'   : $this->dispIdCol = true; $this->idLineType = '';   break;
 693             case 'numeric' : $this->dispIdCol = true; $this->internalKey = 0;   break;
 694             case 'key'     : $this->dispIdCol = true; break;
 695             case 'none'    : $this->dispIdCol = false; break;
 696             default        : $this->dispIdCol = false;
 697         }
 698     }

 702      * set the  idLineShift option
 703      *
 704      * @param integer $idLineShift
 705      */
 706     function set_idLineShift( $idLineShift)

 708         $this->idLineShift = $idLineShift;
 709     }

 713      * set the  hideColsWithoutTitle option
 714      * if hideColsWithoutTitle is true, only cols present in the colTitleList are shown in the rendered grid
 715      * @param boolean $hideColsWithoutTitle set if  the cols of grid
 716      * withouth title would be displayed
 717      */
 718     function set_hideColsWithoutTitle( $hideColsWithoutTitle)
 719     {
 720         if (is_bool($hideColsWithoutTitle)) $this->hideColsWithoutTitle = $hideColsWithoutTitle;
 721         else                                trigger_error('boolean attempt',E_USER_NOTICE);

 724 
 725     /**
 726      * set the  hideColsWithoutTitle option
 727      * if hideColsWithoutTitle is true, only cols present in the colTitleList are shown in the rendered grid
 728      * @param boolean $hideColsWithoutTitle set if  the cols of grid
 729      * withouth title would be displayed
 730      */
 731     function set_orderColBy( $orderCols)
 732     {

 744     /**
 745      * set the  colTitleList option

 814     /**
 815      * Add a decoration on a column
 816      *
 817      * add, or overide a column by a content build from a template and where
 818      * tags are replace by data from each lines
 819      *
 820      * $myDataList[]=array('id'=>1,'pid'=>'foo',);
 821      * $dg = new claro_datagrid($myDataList);
 822      * $dg->set_colDecoration('edit','<a href="?cmd=edit&amp;id=%id&amp;pid=%pid">edit</a>', array('id','pid'));
 823      * $dg->set_colDecoration('foo','<strong>%foo</strong>', array('foo'));
 824      *
 825      * The first decoration add a third column called edit. and  using id and pid from line to fill %id and %pid;
 826      * The second decoration overite the existing column 'foo' by the same content between <strong> tags
 827      *
 828      *
 829      * @param string $colName
 830      * @param string $decorationPattern
 831      * @param array $tag
 832      *
 833      * @since 1.9
 834      * @return the current list
 835      */
 836     function set_colDecoration($colName,$decorationPattern, $tag)
 837     {
 838         $this->decorationList[$colName] = array( 'decorationPattern' => $decorationPattern
 839                                          , 'tagList' => $tag);
 840         return $this->decorationList;
 841     }
 842     
 843     
 844     function render()
 845     {
 846         $stream = '';
 847         if (is_array($this->datagrid) )//&& count($this->datagrid))
 848         {
 849             /**
 850              * Build attributes for column
 851              * In  W3C <COL> seems be the good usage but browser don't follow the tag
 852              * So all attribute would be in each td of column.
 853              */
 854             if (!is_array($this->colTitleList) && count($this->datagrid))
 855             {
 856                 if (is_array($this->datagrid) && isset($this->datagrid[0]) && is_array($this->datagrid[0]))
 857                 $this->colTitleList = array_keys($this->datagrid[0]);
 858             }
 859             elseif (!is_array($this->colTitleList))
 860             {
 861                 $this->colTitleList = array();
 862             }
 863 
 864             if (isset($this->colAttributeList))
 865             foreach (array_keys($this->colAttributeList) as $col)
 866             {
 867                 $attrCol[$col]='';
 868                 foreach ($this->colAttributeList[$col] as $attriName => $attriValue )
 869                 {
 870                     $attrCol[$col] .=' ' . $attriName . '="' . $attriValue . '" ';
 871                 }
 872             }
 873 
 874             $stream .= '<table class="claroTable emphaseLine" width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="2">' . "\n"
 875             // THEAD LINE
 876             .          '<thead>' . "\n"
 877             .          $this->caption
 878             .          '<tr class="headerX" align="center" valign="top">' . "\n"
 879             ;
 880 
 881             if ($this->dispIdCol) $stream .= '<th width="10"></th>' . "\n";
 882 
 883             $i=0;
 884             if(is_array($this->colTitleList))
 885             foreach ($this->colTitleList as $colTitle)
 886             {
 887                 $stream .= '<th scope="col" id="c' . $i++ . '" >' . $colTitle . '</th>' . "\n";
 888             }
 889             $stream .= '</tr>' . "\n"
 890             .          '</thead>' . "\n"
 891             ;
 892 
 893             if ($this->dispCounter)
 894             {
 895                 $stream .= '<tfoot>' . "\n"
 896                 .          '<tr class="headerX" align="center" valign="top">' . "\n"
 897                 .          '<td>' . "\n"
 898                 .          '</td>' . "\n"
 899                 .          '<td>' . "\n"
 900                 .          count($this->datagrid) . ' ' . get_lang('Lines')
 901                 .          '</td>' . "\n"
 902                 .          '</tr>' . "\n"
 903                 .          '</tr>' . "\n"
 904                 .          '</tfoot>' . "\n"
 905                 ;
 906 
 907             }
 908 
 909             $stream .= '<tbody>' . "\n";
 910             if(count($this->datagrid))
 911             {
 912                 foreach ($this->datagrid as $key => $dataLine )
 913                 {
 914                     switch ($this->idLineType)
 915                     {
 916                         case 'key'     : $idLine = $key;                                       break;
 917                         case 'numeric' : $idLine = $this->idLineShift + $this->internalKey++ ; break;
 918                         default        : $idLine = '';
 919                     }
 920 
 921                     $stream .= '<tr>' . "\n";
 922 
 923                     if ($this->dispIdCol) $stream .= '<td align="right" valign="middle">' . $idLine . '</td>' . "\n";
 924 
 925                     $i=0;
 926                     if($this->orderCols == DG_ORDER_COLS_BY_TITLE)
 927                     {
 928                         $keyOrder=array_keys(array_merge($this->colTitleList,$dataLine,$this->decorationList));
 929                     }
 930                     else
 931                     {
 932                         $keyOrder=array_keys(array_merge($dataLine,$this->decorationList));
 933                     }
 934                     
 935                     foreach ($keyOrder as $colId)
 936                     {
 937                         // a protection if there is no cell for the current col
 938                         if(array_key_exists($colId,$dataLine)) $dataCell= $dataLine[$colId];
 939                         else                                   $dataCell = '';
 940 
 941                         if(array_key_exists($colId,$this->decorationList))
 942                         {
 943                             // Decore content
 944                             $dataCell = $this->decorationList[$colId]['decorationPattern'];
 945                             foreach ($this->decorationList[$colId]['tagList'] as $tagName)
 946                             {
 947                                 if (isset($dataLine[$tagName]))
 948                                 $dataCell = str_replace('%'.$tagName,$dataLine[$tagName],$dataCell);
 949                             }
 950                         }
 951                         
 952 
 953                         if ( !$this->hideColsWithoutTitle
 954                              || (    is_array($this->colTitleList)
 955                                   && count($this->colTitleList) > 0
 956                                   && in_array($colId,array_keys($this->colTitleList))
 957                              )
 958                         )
 959 
 960                         {
 961                             if ($this->colHead == $colId)
 962                             {
 963                                 $stream .= '<td scope="row" id="L' . $key . '" headers="c' . $i++ . '" ' . ( isset($attrCol[$colId])?$attrCol[$colId]:'') . '>';
 964                                 $stream .= $dataCell;
 965                                 $stream .= '</td>' . "\n";
 966                             }
 967                             else
 968                             {
 969                                 $stream .= '<td headers="c' . $i++ . ' L' . $key . '" ' . ( isset($attrCol[$colId])?$attrCol[$colId]:'') . '>';
 970                                 $stream .= $dataCell;
 971                                 $stream .= '</td>' . "\n";
 972                             }
 973                         }
 974                     }
 975                     $stream .= '</tr>' . "\n";
 976 
 977                 }
 978             }
 979             else
 980             {
 981                 if (is_null($this->htmlNoRowMessage )) $this->htmlNoRowMessage = get_lang('No result');
 982                 $stream .= '<tr class="dgnoresult" >'
 983                 .          '<td class="dgnoresult" colspan="' . count(array_keys($this->colTitleList)) . '">'
 984                 .          $this->htmlNoRowMessage
 985                 .          '</td>'
 986                 .          '</tr>'
 987                 ;
 988             }
 989             $stream .= '</tbody>' . "\n"
 990             .          '</table>' . "\n"
 991             ;
 992 
 993         }
 994         return $stream;
 995     }
 996 }

1004 /**
1005  * Route the script to an auhtentication form if user id is missing.
1006  * Once authenticated, the system get back to the source where the form
1007  * was trigged
1008  *
1009  * @param boolean $cidRequired - if the course id is required to leave the form
1010  * @author Christophe gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
1011  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
1012  */
1013 function claro_disp_auth_form($cidRequired = false)
1014 {
1015     if ( isset($_SESSION['login_already_claimed']) && $_SESSION['login_already_claimed'] === true )
1016     {
1017         $_SESSION['login_already_claimed'] = false;
1018         return;
1019     }
1020     
1021     $_SESSION['login_already_claimed'] = true;
1022     
1023     // TODO check if it does not break the CAS mechanism
1024     if( get_conf('claro_secureLogin', false) )
1025     {
1026         $sourceUrl = base64_encode( rtrim( get_path( 'rootWeb' ), '/' ) . $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] );
1027     }
1028     else
1029     {
1030         $sourceUrl = base64_encode($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI']);
1031     }
1032 
1033     if ( ! headers_sent () )
1034     {
1035         $urlCmd = ($cidRequired && ! claro_is_in_a_course() ? '&cidRequired=true' : '');
1036         header('Location:' . get_path('url') . '/claroline/auth/login.php?sourceUrl=' . urlencode($sourceUrl) . $urlCmd );
1037     }
1038     else // HTTP header has already been sent - impossible to relocate
1039     {
1040         Claroline::getDisplay()->body->appendContent( '<p align="center">'
1041         .    'WARNING ! Login Required <br />'
1042         .    'Click '
1043         .    '<a href="' . get_path('url') . '/claroline/auth/login.php'
1044         .    '?sourceUrl=' . urlencode($sourceUrl) . '">'
1045         .    'here'
1046         .    '</a>'
1047         .    '</p>'
1048         );
1049 
1050         Claroline::getDisplay()->render();
1051     }
1052 
1053     die(); // necessary to prevent any continuation of the application
1054 }

1057 /**
1058  * function claro_build_nested_select_menu($name, $elementList)
1059  * Build in a relevant way 'select' menu for an HTML form containing nested data
1060  *
1061  * @param string $name, name of the select tag
1062  * @param array nested data in a composite way
1063  *
1064  * @return string the HTML flow
1065  *
1066  *  $elementList[1]['name'    ] = 'level1';
1067  *  $elementList[1]['value'   ] = 'level1';
1068  *
1069  *  $elementList[1]['children'][1]['name' ] = 'level2';
1070  *  $elementList[1]['children'][1]['value'] = 'level2';
1071  *
1072  *  $elementList[1]['children'][2]['name' ] = 'level2';
1073  *  $elementList[1]['children'][2]['value'] = 'level2';
1074  *
1075  *  $elementList[2]['name' ]  = 'level1';
1076  *  $elementList[2]['value']  = 'level1';
1077  *
1078  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
1079  *
1080  */
1081 function claro_build_nested_select_menu($name, $elementList)
1082 {
1083     return '<select name="' . $name . '">' . "\n"
1084     .      implode("\n", prepare_option_tags($elementList) )
1085     .      '</select>' .  "\n"
1086     ;
1087 }

1090 /**
1091  * prepare the 'option' html tag for the claro_disp_nested_select_menu()
1092  * function
1093  *
1094  * @param array $elementList
1095  * @param int   $deepness (optionnal, default is 0)
1096  * @return array of option tag list
1097  *
1098  * @author Hugues Peeters <hugues.peeters@claroline.net>
1099  *
1100  */
1101 function prepare_option_tags($elementList, $deepness = 0)
1102 {
1103     foreach($elementList as $thisElement)
1104     {
1105         $tab = str_repeat('&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;', $deepness);
1106 
1107         $optionTagList[] = '<option value="'.$thisElement['value'].'">'
1108         .                  $tab.$thisElement['name']
1109         .                  '</option>'
1110         ;
1111         if (   isset( $thisElement['children'] )
1112         && sizeof($thisElement['children'] ) > 0)
1113         {
1114             $optionTagList = array_merge( $optionTagList,
1115             prepare_option_tags($thisElement['children'],
1116             $deepness + 1 ) );
1117         }
1118     }
1119 
1120     return  $optionTagList;
1121 }

1137 /**
1138  * function that cleans php string for javascript
1139  *
1140  * This function is needed to clean strings used in javascript output
1141  * Newlines are prohibited in the script, specialchar  are prohibited
1142  * quotes must be addslashes
1143  *
1144  * @param $str string original string
1145  * @return string : cleaned string
1146  *
1147  * @author Piraux Sebastien <pir@cerdecam.be>
1148  *
1149  */
1150 function clean_str_for_javascript( $str )
1151 {
1152     $output = $str;
1153     // 1. addslashes, prevent problems with quotes
1154     // must be before the str_replace to avoid double backslash for \n
1155     $output = addslashes($output);
1156     // 2. turn windows CR into *nix CR
1157     $output = str_replace("\r", '', $output);
1158     // 3. replace "\n" by uninterpreted '\n'
1159     $output = str_replace("\n",'\n', $output);
1160     // 4. convert special chars into html entities
1161     $output = claro_htmlspecialchars($output);
1162 
1163     return $output;
1164 }

1167 /**
1168  * Remove comments and noise from MS Office 2007 pasted-text that causes
1169  * Internet Explorer rendering engine to halt
1170  * @param   string original text
1171  * @return  string clean text
1172  */
1173 function cleanup_mso2007_text ( $string )
1174 {
1175     // remove comments from mso2007 that cause IE rendering engine to halt
1176     $regexp_if = "/\<\!--\[if(.*?)(\<\!--|\<\!)\[endif\]--\>/mi";
1177     $string = preg_replace( $regexp_if, '', $string );
1178     
1179     //remove comments missed by the previous rule
1180     $regexp_rm_if = "/(\<\!--\[if(.*?)\]\>|\<\!-*\[endif\]--\>)/mi";
1181     $string = preg_replace( $regexp_rm_if, '', $string );
1182     
1183     // remove noisy font definitions
1184     $regexp_font = "~<p>&lt;\!--  /\* Font Definitions(.*?)--&gt;</p>~i";
1185     $string = preg_replace( $regexp_font, '', $string );
1186     
1187     return $string;
1188 }

1191 /**
1192  * Parse the user text (e.g. stored in database)
1193  * before displaying it to the screen
1194  * For example it change new line charater to <br> tag etc.
1195  *
1196  * @param string $userText original user text
1197  * @return string : parsed user text
1198  * @author Hugues Peeters <hugues.peeters@claroline.net>
1199  */
1200 function claro_parse_user_text($userText)
1201 {
1202     $userText = cleanup_mso2007_text( $userText );
1203     $userText = cleanUpLaTeX( $userText );
1204     
1205     $userText = renderTex($userText);
1206     $userText = make_clickable($userText);
1207     $userText = make_spoiler($userText);
1208     
1209     if( !claro_is_html($userText) )
1210     {
1211         // only if the content isn't HTML change new line to <br>
1212         // Note the '<!-- content: html -->' is introduced by HTML Area
1213         $userText = nl2br($userText);
1214     }
1215 
1216     return $userText;
1217 }

1220 /**
1221  * Return true if the given text is HTML
1222  * @param string $userText
1223  * @return bool 
1224  */
1225 function claro_is_html($userText)
1226 {
1227     return ( preg_match('/<!-- content:[^(\-\->)]*-->/', $userText)
1228         || preg_match( '#(?<=<)\w+(?=[^<]*?>)#', $userText ) );
1229 }

1232 /**
1233  * Find all spoiler tags in text and replace them by html
1234  *
1235  * @param string $text text in which replace spoiler tags
1236  * @return string text with spoiler tags replaced by html
1237  */
1238 function make_spoiler($text)
1239 {
1240     $reg0a = "%(<p>\s*\[spoiler.*(?:/([^'/]*)/)?\s*\]([^'/]+)\s*</p>|<p>\s*\[spoiler.*(?:/([^'/]*)/)?\s*\]\s*</p>)%isU";
1241     
1242     $text = preg_replace_callback( $reg0a, 'clean_spoilerStart', $text);
1243     
1244     $reg0b = "%(<p>\s*\[/spoiler\]\s*</p>|\[/spoiler\]\s*</p>)%isU";
1245     
1246     $text = preg_replace_callback( $reg0b, 'clean_spoilerEnd', $text);
1247     
1248     $reg1 = "%(<p>\[spoiler.*(?:/([^'/]*)/)?\s*\]|\[spoiler.*(?:/([^'/]*)/)?\s*\])%isU";
1249     
1250     $reg2 = "%(\[/spoiler\]\s*</p>|\[/spoiler\])%isU";
1251     $replace2 = '</div>' . "\n"
1252     .   '</div>' . "\n"
1253     ;
1254     
1255     $out = preg_replace_callback ($reg1, 'add_spoiler', $text);
1256     $out = preg_replace($reg2, $replace2, $out);
1257     
1258     return $out;
1259 }
1260 
1261 
1262 function clean_spoilerStart($match)
1263 {
1264     if(isset($match[4]))
1265     {
1266         return '[spoiler /'.$match[4].'/]';
1267     }
1268     else
1269     {
1270         return false;
1271     }
1272     
1273 }
1274 
1275 
1276 function clean_spoilerEnd($match)
1277 {
1278     return '[/spoiler]';
1279 }

1282 /**

1284  *
1285  * @param array $match
1286  * @return string replacement for matched spoiler tags
1287  */
1288 function add_spoiler($match)
1289 {
1290     // show and hide text
1291     $spoiler_show_text = (!empty($match[3]) ? $match[3] : get_lang('Show') );
1292     $out = '<div class="spoiler">'
1293     .   '<a href="#" class="reveal showSpoiler" onclick="javascript:Claroline.spoil($(this)); return false;">'
1294     .   $spoiler_show_text
1295     .   '</a>' . "\n"
1296     .   '<div class="spoilerContent">' . "\n"
1297     ;
1298     
1299     return $out;
1300 }

1302 function cleanUpLaTeX( $text )
1303 {
1304     $claro_texRendererUrl = get_conf('claro_texRendererUrl');
1305 
1306     if ( !empty($claro_texRendererUrl) )
1307     {
1308         // new LaTeX images with class
1309         $text = preg_replace(
1310             '~<img src="(.*?)" border="0" align="absmiddle" class="latexFormula" alt="(.*?)" />~i', 
1311             '[tex]\2[/tex]', 
1312             $text );
1313         
1314         // old mimetex images without class
1315         $text = preg_replace_callback(
1316              '~<img(.*?)src="(.*?)mimetex(.*?)\?(.*?)"(.*?)/>~i',
1317              'deUrlizeLaTeX',
1318              $text );
1319 
1320     }
1321     else
1322     {
1323         $text = str_replace(
1324             '<embed TYPE="application/x-techexplorer" texdata="', 
1325             '[tex]',
1326             $text
1327         );
1328 
1329         $text = str_replace(
1330             '" width="100%" pluginspace="http://www.integretechpub.com/">','
1331             [/tex]',
1332             $text 
1333         );
1334     }
1335     
1336     return $text;
1337 }
1338 
1339 function deUrlizeLaTeX( $matches )
1340 {
1341     if ( count($matches) < 5 )
1342     {
1343         return false;
1344     }
1345 
1346     return '[tex]'.rawurldecode($matches[4]).'[/tex]';
1347 }

1352 /**
1353  * Parse the user text to transform bb code style tex tags to
1354  * embedded tex plugin or tex generated image depending on
1355  * campus config
1356  *
1357  * @param string $text original user text
1358  * @return string : parsed user text
1359  */
1360 function renderTex($text)
1361 {
1362     $claro_texRendererUrl = get_conf('claro_texRendererUrl');
1363 
1364     if ( !empty($claro_texRendererUrl) )
1365     {
1366         $text = preg_replace_callback(  '/\[tex\](.+?)\[\/tex\]/i',
1367                                         'renderTexCallback',
1368                                         $text
1369                             );
1370     }
1371     else
1372     {
1373         $text = str_replace('[tex]',
1374         '<embed TYPE="application/x-techexplorer" texdata="',
1375         $text);
1376 
1377         $text = str_replace('[/tex]',
1378         '" width="100%" pluginspace="http://www.integretechpub.com/">',
1379         $text);
1380     }
1381 
1382     return $text;
1383 }

1391

1393         return $text;

1395     else
1396     {
1397         return false;
1398     }

1402 /**
1403  * Completes url contained in the text with "<a href ...".
1404  * However the function simply returns the submitted text without any
1405  * transformation if it already contains some "<a href:" or "<img src=".
1406  *
1407  * Actually this function is taken from the PHP BB 1.4 script
1408  * - Goes through the given string, and replaces xxxx://yyyy with an HTML <a> tag linking
1409  *  to that URL
1410  * - Goes through the given string, and replaces www.xxxx.yyyy[zzzz] with an HTML <a> tag linking
1411  *  to http://www.xxxx.yyyy[/zzzz]
1412  * - Goes through the given string, and replaces xxxx@yyyy with an HTML mailto: tag linking
1413  *      to that email address
1414  * - Only matches these 2 patterns either after a space, or at the beginning of a line
1415  *
1416  * Notes: the email one might get annoying - it's easy to make it more restrictive, though.. maybe
1417  * have it require something like xxxx@yyyy.zzzz or such. We'll see.
1418  *
1419  * @param  string $text text to be converted
1420  * @return string : text after conversion
1421  *
1422  * @author Rewritten by Nathan Codding - Feb 6, 2001.
1423  * @author completed by Hugues Peeters - July 22, 2002
1424  */
1425 function make_clickable($text)
1426 {
1427 
1428     // If the user has decided to deeply use html and manage himself hyperlink
1429     // cancel the make clickable() function and return the text untouched. HP
1430 
1431     if (preg_match ( "<(a|img)[[:space:]]*(href|src)[[:space:]]*=(.*)>", $text) )
1432     {
1433         return $text;
1434     }
1435 
1436     // pad it with a space so we can match things at the start of the 1st line.
1437     $ret = " " . $text;
1438 
1439 
1440     // matches an "xxxx://yyyy" URL at the start of a line, or after a space.
1441     // xxxx can only be alpha characters.
1442     // yyyy is anything up to the first space, newline, or comma.
1443 
1444     $ret = preg_replace("#([\n ])([a-z]+?)://([^, \n\r<]+)#i",
1445     "\\1<a href=\"\\2://\\3\" >\\2://\\3</a>",
1446     $ret);
1447 
1448     // matches a "www.xxxx.yyyy[/zzzz]" kinda lazy URL thing
1449     // Must contain at least 2 dots. xxxx contains either alphanum, or "-"
1450     // yyyy contains either alphanum, "-", or "."
1451     // zzzz is optional.. will contain everything up to the first space, newline, or comma.
1452     // This is slightly restrictive - it's not going to match stuff like "forums.foo.com"
1453     // This is to keep it from getting annoying and matching stuff that's not meant to be a link.
1454 
1455     $ret = preg_replace("#([\n ])www\.([a-z0-9\-]+)\.([a-z0-9\-.\~]+)((?:/[^, \n\r<]*)?)#i",
1456     "\\1<a href=\"http://www.\\2.\\3\\4\" >www.\\2.\\3\\4</a>",
1457     $ret);
1458 
1459     // matches an email@domain type address at the start of a line, or after a space.
1460     // Note: before the @ sign, the only valid characters are the alphanums and "-", "_", or ".".
1461     // After the @ sign, we accept anything up to the first space, linebreak, or comma.
1462 
1463     $ret = preg_replace("#([\n ])([a-z0-9\-_.]+?)@([^, \n\r<]+)#i",
1464     "\\1<a href=\"mailto:\\2@\\3\">\\2@\\3</a>",
1465     $ret);
1466 
1467     // Remove our padding..
1468     $ret = substr($ret, 1);
1469 
1470     return($ret);
1471 }

1521 /**
1522  * convert a duration in seconds to a human readable duration
1523  * @author Sebastien Piraux <pir@cerdecam.be>
1524  * @param integer duration time in seconds to convert to a human readable duration
1525  */
1526 
1527 function claro_disp_duration( $duration  )
1528 {
1529     pushClaroMessage( (function_exists('claro_html_debug_backtrace')
1530     ? claro_html_debug_backtrace()
1531     : 'claro_html_debug_backtrace() not defined'
1532     )
1533     .'claro_ disp _duration() is deprecated , use claro_ html _duration()','error');
1534 
1535     return claro_html_duration( $duration  );
1536 }
1537 function claro_html_duration( $duration  )
1538 {
1539     if( $duration == 0 ) return '0 '.get_lang('SecondShort');
1540 
1541     $days = floor(($duration/86400));
1542     $duration = $duration % 86400;
1543 
1544     $hours = floor(($duration/3600));
1545     $duration = $duration % 3600;
1546 
1547     $minutes = floor(($duration/60));
1548     $duration = $duration % 60;
1549     // $duration is now equal to seconds
1550 
1551     $durationString = '';
1552 
1553     if( $days > 0 ) $durationString .= $days . ' ' . get_lang('PeriodDayShort') . ' ';
1554     if( $hours > 0 ) $durationString .= $hours . ' ' . get_lang('PeriodHourShort') . ' ';
1555     if( $minutes > 0 ) $durationString .= $minutes . ' ' . get_lang('MinuteShort') . ' ';
1556     if( $duration > 0 ) $durationString .= $duration . ' ' . get_lang('SecondShort');
1557 
1558     return $durationString;
1559 }

1561 /**
1562  * Return the breadcrumb to display in the header
1563  *
1564  * @global string  $nameTools
1565  * @global array   $interbredcrump
1566  * @global boolean $noPHP_SELF
1567  * @global boolean $noQUERY_STRING
1568  *
1569  * @return string html content
1570  */
1571 
1572 function claro_html_breadcrumb()
1573 {
1574     // dirty global to keep value (waiting a refactoring)
1575     global $nameTools, $interbredcrump, $noPHP_SELF, $noQUERY_STRING;
1576     /******************************************************************************
1577     BREADCRUMB LINE
1578     ******************************************************************************/
1579     $htmlBC = '';
1580 
1581     if( claro_is_in_a_course() || isset($nameTools) || ( isset($interbredcrump) && is_array($interbredcrump) ) )
1582     {
1583         $htmlBC .= '<div id="breadcrumbLine">' . "\n\n"
1584         .  '<hr />'
1585         . "\n"
1586         ;
1587 
1588         $breadcrumbUrlList = array();
1589         $breadcrumbNameList = array();
1590 
1591         $breadcrumbUrlList[]  = get_path('url') . '/index.php';
1592         $breadcrumbNameList[] = get_conf('siteName');
1593 
1594         if ( claro_is_in_a_course() )
1595         {
1596             $breadcrumbUrlList[]  = get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'course/index.php?cid=' . claro_htmlspecialchars(claro_get_current_course_id());
1597             $breadcrumbNameList[] = claro_get_current_course_data('officialCode');
1598         }
1599 
1600         if ( claro_is_in_a_group() )
1601         {
1602             $breadcrumbUrlList[]  = get_module_url('CLGRP') . '/index.php?cidReq=' . claro_htmlspecialchars(claro_get_current_course_id());
1603             $breadcrumbNameList[] = get_lang('Groups');
1604             $breadcrumbUrlList[]  = get_module_url('CLGRP') . '/group_space.php?cidReq=' . claro_htmlspecialchars(claro_get_current_course_id()).'&gidReq=' . (int) claro_get_current_group_id();
1605             $breadcrumbNameList[] = claro_get_current_group_data('name');
1606         }
1607 
1608         if (isset($interbredcrump) && is_array($interbredcrump) )
1609         {
1610             while ( (list(,$bredcrumpStep) = each($interbredcrump)) )
1611             {
1612                 $breadcrumbUrlList[] = $bredcrumpStep['url'];
1613                 $breadcrumbNameList[] = $bredcrumpStep['name'];
1614             }
1615         }
1616 
1617         if (isset($nameTools) )
1618         {
1619             $breadcrumbNameList[] = $nameTools;
1620 
1621             if (isset($noPHP_SELF) && $noPHP_SELF)
1622             {
1623                 $breadcrumbUrlList[] = null;
1624             }
1625             elseif ( isset($noQUERY_STRING) && $noQUERY_STRING)
1626             {
1627                 $breadcrumbUrlList[] = $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'];
1628             }
1629             else
1630             {
1631                 // set Query string to empty if not exists
1632                 if (!isset($_SERVER['QUERY_STRING'])) $_SERVER['QUERY_STRING'] = '';
1633                 $breadcrumbUrlList[] = $_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] .'?'. $_SERVER['QUERY_STRING'];
1634             }
1635         }
1636 
1637         $htmlBC .= claro_html_breadcrumbtrail($breadcrumbNameList, $breadcrumbUrlList,
1638         ' &gt; ', get_icon_url('home'));
1639 
1640 
1641         if ( !claro_is_user_authenticated() )
1642         {
1643             $htmlBC .= "\n".'<div id="toolViewOption" style="padding-right:10px">'
1644             .'<a href="' . get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'auth/login.php'
1645             .'?sourceUrl='.urlencode(base64_encode( (isset( $_SERVER['HTTPS']) && ($_SERVER['HTTPS']=='on'||$_SERVER['HTTPS']==1) ? 'https://' : 'http://'). $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] . $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'])). '" target="_top">'
1646             .get_lang('Login')
1647             .'</a>'
1648             .'</div>'."\n";
1649         }
1650         elseif ( claro_is_in_a_course() && ! claro_is_course_member() && claro_get_current_course_data('registrationAllowed') && ! claro_is_platform_admin() )
1651         {
1652             $htmlBC .= '<div id="toolViewOption">'
1653             .    '<a href="' . get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'auth/courses.php?cmd=exReg&course='.claro_get_current_course_id().'">'
1654             .     '<img src="' . get_icon_url('enroll') . '" alt="" /> '
1655             .    '<b>' . get_lang('Enrolment') . '</b>'
1656             .    '</a>'
1657             .    '</div>' . "\n"
1658             ;
1659         }
1660         elseif ( claro_is_display_mode_available() )
1661         {
1662             $htmlBC .= "\n"
1663             .          '<div id="toolViewOption">' . "\n"
1664             ;
1665 
1666             if ( isset($_REQUEST['View mode']) )
1667             {
1668                 $htmlBC .= claro_html_tool_view_option($_REQUEST['View mode']);
1669             }
1670             else
1671             {
1672                 $htmlBC .= claro_html_tool_view_option();
1673             }
1674 
1675             if ( claro_is_platform_admin() && ! claro_is_course_member() )
1676             {
1677                 $htmlBC .= ' | <a href="' . get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . 'auth/courses.php?cmd=exReg&course='.claro_get_current_course_id().'">';
1678                 $htmlBC .= '<img src="' . get_icon_url('enroll') . '" alt="" /> ';
1679                 $htmlBC .= '<b>' . get_lang('Enrolment') . '</b>';
1680                 $htmlBC .= '</a>';
1681             }
1682 
1683             $htmlBC .= "\n".'</div>' ."\n";
1684         }
1685 
1686 
1687         $htmlBC .= '<div class="spacer"></div>' ."\n"
1688         .          '<hr />' ."\n"
1689         .          '</div>' . "\n"
1690         ;
1691 
1692     } // end if claro_is_in_a_course() isset($nameTools) && is_array($interbredcrump)
1693     else
1694     {
1695         // $htmlBC .= '<div style="height:1em"></div>';
1696     }
1697     return $htmlBC;
1698 }

1700 /**
1701  * Create a navigation tab bar
1702  *
1703  * @param array $section_list associative array of tabs tab id => tab label
1704  * @param string $section_selected_id selected tab id
1705  * @param array $url_params associative array of additionnal parameters
1706  *      name => value
1707  * @param string $section_request_var_name name of the HTTP GET variable
1708  *      to store the current tab id
1709  * @param string $baseUrl base url of the navigation tab bar
1710  * @return string html navigation tab bar
1711  */
1712 function claro_html_tab_bar( $section_list,
1713                              $section_selected_id = null,
1714                              $url_params = array(),
1715                              $section_request_var_name = 'section',
1716                              $baseUrl = null )
1717 {
1718     $menu = '';
1719 
1720     if ( !empty($section_list) )
1721     {
1722         $baseUrl = empty( $baseUrl )
1723             ? $_SERVER['PHP_SELF']
1724             : $baseUrl
1725             ;
1726             
1727         $baseUrl .= ( false !== strpos($baseUrl, '?' ) )
1728             ? '&amp;'
1729             : '?'
1730             ;
1731         
1732         
1733         $extra_url_params = '';
1734         
1735         if ( ! empty ( $url_params ) )
1736         {
1737             foreach ( $url_params as $name => $value )
1738             {
1739                 $extra_url_params .= '&amp;'
1740                     . claro_htmlspecialchars($name)
1741                     . '=' . claro_htmlspecialchars($value)
1742                     ;
1743             }
1744         }
1745         
1746         $menu  = '<div>' . "\n";
1747         $menu .= '<ul id="navlist">' . "\n";
1748 
1749         foreach ( $section_list as $section_id => $section_label )
1750         {
1751             if ( empty( $section_selected_id ) )
1752             {
1753                 $section_selected_id = $section_id;
1754             }
1755             
1756             $menu .=  '<li>'
1757                 . '<a ' . ( $section_id == $section_selected_id ? 'class="current"' : '' )
1758                 . ' href="' . claro_htmlspecialchars(Url::Contextualize( $baseUrl
1759                 . claro_htmlspecialchars($section_request_var_name).'='
1760                 . claro_htmlspecialchars($section_id) .$extra_url_params )) . '" '
1761                 . 'id="'. claro_htmlspecialchars($section_id) .'">'
1762                 . get_lang($section_label) . '</a>'
1763                 . '</li>' . "\n"
1764                 ;
1765 
1766         }
1767         
1768         $menu .= '</ul>' . "\n";
1769         $menu .= '</div>' . "\n" ;
1770     }
1771     
1772     return $menu;
1773 }

  50 /**
  51  * Returns the url of the given icon
  52  *
  53  * @param string $fileName file name with or without extension
  54  * @param string $moduleLabel label of the module (optional)
  55  * @return string icon url
  56  *         mixed null if icon not found
  57  */
  58 function get_icon_url( $fileName, $moduleLabel = null )
  59 {
  60     $fileInfo = pathinfo( $fileName );
  61     
  62     $currentModuleLabel = get_current_module_label();
  63     
  64     $imgPath = array();
  65     
  66     // Search kernel first for performance !
  67     
  68     // claroline theme iconset
  69     $imgPath[get_current_iconset_path()] = get_current_iconset_url();
  70     // claroline web/img <--- is now the default location find using get_current_iconset_url
  71     //$imgPath[get_path( 'rootSys' ) . 'web/img/'] = get_path('url') . '/web/img/';
  72     
  73     if ( !empty($moduleLabel) )
  74     {
  75         // module img directory
  76         $imgPath[get_module_path($moduleLabel).'/img/'] = get_module_url($moduleLabel).'/img/';
  77         // module root directory
  78         $imgPath[get_module_path($moduleLabel).'/'] = get_module_url($moduleLabel).'/';
  79     }
  80     
  81     if ( !empty( $currentModuleLabel ) )
  82     {
  83         // module img directory
  84         $imgPath[get_module_path($currentModuleLabel).'/img/'] = get_module_url($currentModuleLabel).'/img/';
  85         // module root directory
  86         $imgPath[get_module_path($currentModuleLabel).'/'] = get_module_url($currentModuleLabel).'/';
  87     }
  88     
  89     // img directory in working directory
  90     $imgPath['./img/'] = './img/';
  91     // working directory
  92     $imgPath['./'] = './';
  93     
  94     if ( !empty( $fileInfo['extension'] ) )
  95     {
  96         $img = array( $fileName );
  97     }
  98     else
  99     {
 100         $img = array(
 101             $fileName . '.png',
 102             $fileName . '.gif'
 103         );
 104     }
 105     
 106     foreach ( $imgPath as $tryPath => $tryUrl )
 107     {
 108         foreach ( $img as $tryImg )
 109         {
 110             if ( claro_debug_mode() ) pushClaroMessage("Try ".$tryPath.$tryImg, 'debug');
 111             
 112             if ( file_exists( $tryPath.$tryImg ) )
 113             {
 114                 if ( claro_debug_mode() ) pushClaroMessage("Using ".$tryPath.$tryImg, 'debug');
 115                 
 116                 return $tryUrl.$tryImg.'?'.filemtime($tryPath.$tryImg);
 117             }
 118         }
 119     }
 120     
 121     if ( claro_debug_mode() ) pushClaroMessage("Icon $fileName not found",'error');
 122     
 123     // WORKAROUND : avoid double submission if missing image !!!!
 124     return 'image_not_found.png';
 125 }
