 127 /**
 128  * Includes an icon in html code
 129  * @param string fileName file name with or without extension
 130  * @param string toolTip tooltip for the image (optional, default none)
 131  * @param string alternate alt text for the image (optional, default fileName)
 132  * @return string html code for the image
 133  */
 134 function claro_html_icon( $fileName, $toolTip = null, $alternate = null )
 135 {
 136     $alt = $alternate
 137         ? ' alt="' . $alternate . '"'
 138         : ' alt="' . claro_htmlspecialchars( $fileName ) . '"'
 139         ;
 140         
 141     $title = $toolTip
 142         ? ' title="' . claro_htmlspecialchars( $toolTip ) .'"'
 143         : ''
 144         ;
 145         
 146     if ( false !== ( $iconUrl = get_icon_url( $fileName ) ) )
 147     {
 148         return '<img src="' . $iconUrl .'"'
 149             . $alt . $title
 150             . ' />'
 151             ;
 152     }
 153     else
 154     {
 155         return false;
 156     }
 157 }

 177         . '</a>'
 178         ;
 179 }

 471 function claro_is_module_allowed()
 472 {
 473     if ( ! array_key_exists( 'tlabelReq', $GLOBALS ) )
 474     {
 475         return claro_failure::set_failure('MISSING TOOL LABEL');
 476     }
 477     
 478     $moduleLabel = $GLOBALS['tlabelReq'];
 479     
 480     $moduleData = get_module_data( $moduleLabel );
 481 
 482     if ( $moduleData['type'] == 'tool' )
 483     {
 484         $contextList = get_module_context_list( $moduleLabel );
 485         
 486         // pushClaroMessage(var_export(iterator_to_array($contextList), true),'kernel');
 487         
 488         if ( !claro_is_in_a_course() && in_array( 'platform', iterator_to_array($contextList) ) )
 489         {
 490             return get_module_data( $moduleLabel,'activation' ) == 'activated';
 491         }
 492         
 493         // if a course tool, use claro_is_tool_allowed
 494         return claro_is_tool_allowed();
 495     }
 496     else
 497     {
 498         // if an applet "tool", return true if activated
 499         // and let module manage it's access by itself
 500         return ( $moduleData['activation'] == 'activated' );
 501     }
 502 }

 504 // 5. Generic get_init
 505 /**
 506  * Return the value of a Claroline configuration parameter
 507  * @param string $param config parameter
 508  * @param mixed $default (optionnal) - set a defaut to return value
 509  *                                     if no paramater with such a name is found.
 510  * @author Christophe Gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
 511  * @return string param value
 512  * @todo http://www.claroline.net/forum/viewtopic.php?t=4579
 513  */
 514 
 515 function get_init($param)
 516 {
 517     static $initValueList = array( '_uid'                   // claro_get_current_user_id()
 518     , '_cid'                   // claro_get_current_course_id()
 519     , '_gid'                   // claro_get_current_group_id()
 520     , '_tid'                   // claro_get_current_tool_id()
 521     , 'is_authenticated'       // is_authenticated()
 522     , 'in_course_context'      // is_in_course_context()
 523     , 'in_group_context'       // is_in_group_context()
 524     , 'is_platformAdmin'       // claro_is_platformAdmin()
 525     , '_course'                // claro_get_current_course_data(field=all)
 526     , '_user'                  // claro_get_current_user_data(field=all)
 527     , '_group'                 // claro_get_current_group_data(field=all)
 528     , '_groupProperties'       // claro_get_current_group_properties_data(field=all)
 529     , '_courseUser'            // claro_get_current_course_user_data(field=all)
 530     , '_courseTool'            // claro_get_current_course_tool_data(field=all)
 531     , '_courseToolList'        // claro_get_current_course_tool_list_data(field=all)
 532     , 'is_courseMember'        // claro_is_course_member()
 533     , 'is_courseTutor'         // claro_is_course_tutor()
 534     , 'is_courseAdmin'         // claro_is_course_admin()
 535     , 'is_courseAllowed'       // claro_is_course_allowed()
 536     , 'is_allowedCreateCourse' // claro_is_allowed_to_create_course() or claro_is_course_creator()
 537     , 'is_groupMember'         // claro_is_groupMember()
 538     , 'is_groupTutor'          // claro_is_groupTutor()
 539     , 'is_groupAllowed'        // claro_is_groupAllowed()
 540     , 'is_toolAllowed'         // claro_is_toolAllowed()
 541     , 'calledFrom'             // claro_called_from()
 542     );
 543 
 544     if(!in_array($param, $initValueList )) trigger_error( claro_htmlentities($param) . ' is not a know init value name ', E_USER_NOTICE);
 545     //TODO create a real auth function to eval this state
 546     if ( $param == 'is_authenticated') return !(bool) is_null($GLOBALS['_uid']);
 547     //TODO create a real course function to eval this state
 548     if ( $param == 'in_course_context') return !(bool) is_null(claro_get_current_course_id());
 549     if     ( array_key_exists($param,$GLOBALS) )  return $GLOBALS[$param];
 550     elseif ( defined($param)         )            return constant($param);
 551     return null;
 552 }

 590 /**
 591  * Fetch data and privileges of the given user in the given course
 592  *
 593  * U don't have enough of this function
 594  * use claro_get_course_user_data($cid,$uid,$ignoreCache=false)
 595  *  or claro_get_course_user_privilege($cid,$uid,$ignoreCache=false)
 596  *
 597  * @param string $cid course id
 598  * @param integer $uid user id
 599  * @param bool $ignoreCache true to for read in database instead of cache
 600  * @return array(data( array('role')), 'privilege'(array('_profileId','is_courseMember','is_courseTutor','is_courseAdmin')))
 601  * @see claro_get_course_user_data($cid,$uid,$ignoreCache=false)
 602  * @see claro_get_course_user_privilege($cid,$uid,$ignoreCache=false)
 603  * @author Christophe Gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
 604  */
 605 
 606 
 607 function claro_get_course_user_properties($cid,$uid,$ignoreCache=false)
 608 {
 609     $admin = claro_is_platform_admin();
 610     
 611     $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 612     $tbl_rel_course_user = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user'];
 613     
 614     static $course_user_cache       = null;
 615     static $course_user_data        = null;
 616     static $course_user_privilege   = array();
 617     
 618     if (($course_user_cache != array('uid'=>$uid,'cid'=>$cid)) || $ignoreCache)
 619     {
 620         $sql = "SELECT profile_id AS profileId,
 621                        isCourseManager,
 622                        isPending,
 623                        tutor,
 624                        role
 625                 FROM `" . $tbl_rel_course_user . "` `cours_user`
 626                 WHERE `user_id`  = '" . (int) $uid . "'
 627                 AND `code_cours` = '" . claro_sql_escape($cid) . "'";
 628         
 629         $cuData = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
 630         
 631         if ( !empty($cuData) )
 632         {
 633             $course_user_data['role'] = $cuData['role']; // not used
 634             
 635             $course_user_privilege['_profileId']        = $cuData['profileId'];
 636             $course_user_privilege['is_coursePending']  = (bool) ($cuData['isPending' ]);
 637             $course_user_privilege['is_courseMember']   = (bool) ($cuData['isPending' ] == 0 );
 638             $course_user_privilege['is_courseTutor']    = (bool) ($cuData['tutor'] == 1 );
 639             $course_user_privilege['is_courseAdmin']    = (bool) ($cuData['isCourseManager'] == 1 );
 640         }
 641         else // this user has no status related to this course
 642         {
 643             $course_user_privilege['_profileId']        = claro_get_profile_id('guest');
 644             $course_user_privilege['is_coursePending']  = false;
 645             $course_user_privilege['is_courseMember']   = false;
 646             $course_user_privilege['is_courseAdmin']    = false;
 647             $course_user_privilege['is_courseTutor']    = false;
 648             
 649             $course_user_data = null; // not used
 650         }
 651         
 652         $course_user_privilege['is_courseAdmin'] = (bool) ($course_user_privilege['is_courseAdmin'] || claro_is_platform_admin());
 653         $course_user_cache = array('uid'=>$uid,'cid'=>$cid);
 654     }
 655     
 656     return array('data' => $course_user_data, 'privilege' => $course_user_privilege);
 657 }

 659 /**

 661  * @param   string $courseId id (sysCode) of the course

 664 function claro_get_current_user_profile_id_in_course( $courseId = null )
 665 {

 667     
 668     $userPrivilege = claro_get_course_user_privilege(

 685 /**
 686  * Return if course status is enable
 687  */
 688 function claro_is_course_enable()
 689 {
 690     $tbl_mdb_names      = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 691     $tbl_course         = $tbl_mdb_names['course'];
 692     $courseId           = claro_get_current_course_id();
 693     $curdate            = claro_mktime();
 694     
 695     if (claro_is_course_manager())
 696     $sql=" SELECT c.`code`
 697              FROM `".$tbl_course."` c
 698             WHERE  (c.`status` != 'trash')
 699               AND c.`code` = '".$courseId."';";
 700     else
 701     $sql=" SELECT c.`code`
 702            FROM `".$tbl_course."` c
 703            WHERE (c.`status` = 'enable'
 704                    OR (c.`status` = 'date'
 705                        AND (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`creationDate`) <= '". $curdate ."'
 706                             OR `creationDate` IS NULL OR UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`creationDate`) = 0
 707                            )
 708                        AND ('". $curdate ."' <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`expirationDate`)
 709                             OR `expirationDate` IS NULL
 710                            )
 711                       )
 712                  )
 713                  AND c.`code` = '".$courseId."';";
 714     
 715     $result = claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sql);
 716     
 717     if (isset($result) OR claro_is_platform_admin()) $return = true;
 718     else $return = false;
 719     
 720     return $return;
 721 }

  73     /**
  74      * Load course main properties from database
  75      */
  76     protected function loadCourseKernelData()
  77     {
  78         // get course data from main
  79         $tbl =  claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  80         
  81         $sqlCourseId = Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($this->_courseId);
  82 
  83         $sql_getCourseData = "
  84             SELECT
  85                 c.code                  AS courseId,
  86                 c.code                  AS sysCode,
  87                 c.cours_id              AS id,
  88                 c.isSourceCourse        AS isSourceCourse,
  89                 c.sourceCourseId        AS sourceCourseId,
  90                 c.intitule              AS name,
  91                 c.administrativeNumber  AS officialCode,
  92                 c.administrativeNumber  AS administrativeNumber,
  93                 c.directory             AS path,
  94                 c.dbName                AS dbName,
  95                 c.titulaires            AS titular,
  96                 c.email                 AS email,
  97                 c.language              AS language,
  98                 c.extLinkUrl            AS extLinkUrl,
  99                 c.extLinkName           AS extLinkName,
 100                 c.visibility            AS visibility,
 101                 c.access                AS access,
 102                 c.registration          AS registration,
 103                 c.registrationKey       AS registrationKey,
 104                 c.diskQuota             AS diskQuota,
 105                 UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.creationDate)          AS publicationDate,
 106                 UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.expirationDate)        AS expirationDate,
 107                 c.status                AS status,
 108                 c.userLimit             AS userLimit
 109             FROM
 110                 `{$tbl['course']}`   AS c
 111             WHERE
 112                 c.code = {$sqlCourseId};
 113         ";
 114 
 115         $courseDataList = Claroline::getDatabase()
 116             ->query( $sql_getCourseData )
 117             ->fetch();
 118         
 119         if ( ! $courseDataList )
 120         {
 121             throw new Exception("Cannot load course data for {$this->_courseId}");
 122         }
 123         
 124         // set bool values
 125         $courseDataList['visibility'] = ('visible' == $courseDataList['visibility'] );
 126         $courseDataList['registrationAllowed'] = ('open' == $courseDataList['registration'] );
 127         
 128         // set dbNameGlu
 129         $courseDataList['dbNameGlu'] =
 130             get_conf('courseTablePrefix')
 131             . $courseDataList['dbName']
 132             . get_conf('dbGlu')
 133             ;
 134         
 135         $this->_rawData = $courseDataList;
 136     }

 138     /**
 139      * Load course categories
 140      */
 141     protected function loadCourseCategories()
 142     {
 143         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 144         
 145         $categoriesDataList = Claroline::getDatabase()->query("
 146             SELECT
 147                 cat.id      AS categoryId,
 148                 cat.name    AS categoryName,
 149                 cat.code    AS categoryCode,
 150                 cat.visible AS visibility,
 151                 cat.rank    AS categoryRank
 152             FROM
 153                 `{$tbl['category']}` AS cat
 154             LEFT JOIN
 155                 `{$tbl['rel_course_category']}` AS rcc
 156             ON
 157                 cat.id = rcc.categoryId
 158             WHERE
 159                 rcc.courseId = {$this->_rawData['id']};
 160         ");
 161         
 162         $this->_rawData['categories'] = array();
 163         
 164         foreach ( $categoriesDataList as $category )
 165         {
 166             $category['visibility'] = ($category['visibility'] == 1);
 167             $this->_rawData['categories'][] = $category;
 168         }
 169     }

 171     /**
 172      * Load course additionnal properties from database
 173      */
 174     protected function loadCourseProperties()
 175     {
 176         // get extra course properties
 177         $tbl = claro_sql_get_course_tbl( $this->_rawData['dbNameGlu'] );
 178 
 179         $courseProperties = Claroline::getDatabase()
 180             ->query("
 181                 SELECT
 182                     name,
 183                     value
 184                 FROM
 185                     `{$tbl['course_properties']}`
 186                 WHERE
 187                     category = 'MAIN';
 188             ")
 189             ->fetch();
 190         
 191         $coursePropertyList = array();
 192 
 193         if ( is_array( $courseProperties ) )
 194         {
 195             foreach ( $courseProperties as $currentProperty )
 196             {
 197                 $coursePropertyList[$currentProperty['name']] = $currentProperty['value'];
 198             }
 199         }
 200         
 201         $this->_rawData['courseProperties'] = $coursePropertyList;

 204     /**
 205      * Load course group properties from database
 206      */
 207     protected function loadGroupProperties()
 208     {
 209         $tbl = claro_sql_get_course_tbl( $this->_rawData['dbNameGlu'] );
 210 
 211         $db_groupProperties = Claroline::getDatabase()
 212             ->query("
 213                 SELECT
 214                     name,
 215                     value
 216                 FROM
 217                     `{$tbl['course_properties']}`
 218                 WHERE
 219                     category = 'GROUP';
 220             ");
 221         
 222         if ( ! $db_groupProperties )
 223         {
 224             // throw new Exception
 225             Console::warning("Cannot load group properties for {$courseId}");
 226         }
 227         
 228         $groupProperties = array();
 229         
 230         foreach($db_groupProperties as $currentProperty)
 231         {
 232             $groupProperties[$currentProperty['name']] = (int) $currentProperty['value'];
 233         }
 234         
 235         $groupProperties ['registrationAllowed'] =  (isset($groupProperties['self_registration']) && $groupProperties['self_registration'] == 1);
 236         unset($groupProperties['self_registration']);
 237         
 238         $groupProperties ['unregistrationAllowed'] =  (isset($groupProperties['self_unregistration']) && $groupProperties['self_unregistration'] == 1);
 239         unset($groupProperties['self_unregistration']);
 240 
 241         $groupProperties ['private'] =  ( isset( $groupProperties['private'] ) && $groupProperties['private'] == 1 );
 242 
 243         $groupProperties['tools'] = array();
 244         
 245         $groupToolList = get_activated_group_tool_label_list( $this->_courseId );
 246         
 247         foreach ( $groupToolList as $thisGroupTool )
 248         {
 249             $groupTLabel = $thisGroupTool['label'];
 250             
 251             if ( array_key_exists( $groupTLabel, $groupProperties ) )
 252             {
 253                 $groupProperties ['tools'] [$groupTLabel] = ($groupProperties[$groupTLabel] == 1);
 254                 
 255                 unset ( $groupProperties[$groupTLabel] );
 256             }
 257             else
 258             {
 259                 $groupProperties ['tools'] [$groupTLabel] = false;
 260             }
 261         }
 262         
 263         $this->_rawData['groupProperties'] = $groupProperties;
 264     }

 401     protected function _getChildrenList( $forceRefresh = false )
 402     {
 403         if ( ! $this->_children || $forceRefresh )
 404         {
 405             $tbl =  claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 406 
 407             $parentId = Claroline::getDatabase()->escape($this->_rawData['id']);
 408 
 409             $this->_children = Claroline::getDatabase()->query("
 410                 SELECT
 411                     c.code                  AS courseId,
 412                     c.code                  AS sysCode,
 413                     c.cours_id              AS id,
 414                     c.isSourceCourse        AS isSourceCourse,
 415                     c.sourceCourseId        AS sourceCourseId,
 416                     c.intitule              AS name,
 417                     c.administrativeNumber  AS officialCode,
 418                     c.administrativeNumber  AS administrativeNumber,
 419                     c.directory             AS path,
 420                     c.dbName                AS dbName,
 421                     c.titulaires            AS titular,
 422                     c.email                 AS email,
 423                     c.language              AS language,
 424                     c.extLinkUrl            AS extLinkUrl,
 425                     c.extLinkName           AS extLinkName,
 426                     c.visibility            AS visibility,
 427                     c.access                AS access,
 428                     c.registration          AS registration,
 429                     c.registrationKey       AS registrationKey,
 430                     c.diskQuota             AS diskQuota,
 431                     UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.creationDate)          AS publicationDate,
 432                     UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.expirationDate)        AS expirationDate,
 433                     c.status                AS status,
 434                     c.userLimit             AS userLimit
 435                 FROM
 436                     `{$tbl['course']}`   AS c
 437                 WHERE
 438                     c.sourceCourseId = {$parentId}
 439             ");
 440                 
 441         }
 442                     
 443         return $this->_children;

 446     /**

 450     public function getChildrenList( $forceRefresh = false )
 451     {

 454             $childrenList = array();

 456             $children = $this->_getChildrenList ( $forceRefresh );

 491     /**
 492      * Return true if the course is activated, false otherwise.
 493      *
 494      * A course is deactivated if:
 495      * - its status is 'disable' OR 'pending' OR 'trash'
 496      * - its status is 'date' AND
 497      *   - the current date is < to its publication date OR
 498      *     the current date is > to its expiration date
 499      *
 500      * @return boolean
 501      */
 502     public function isActivated()
 503     {
 504         $currentDate = claro_mktime();
 505         
 506         if ($this->status == 'disable' ||
 507             $this->status == 'pending' ||
 508             $this->status == 'trash')
 509         {
 510             return false;
 511         }
 512         elseif ($this->status == 'date')
 513         {
 514             if ($currentDate < $this->publicationDate ||
 515                 $currentDate > $this->expirationDate)
 516             {
 517                 return false;
 518             }
 519         }
 520         else
 521         {
 522             return true;
 523         }
 524     }
 525     
 526     /**
 527      * Return true if the course is visible, false otherwise.
 528      *
 529      * @return boolean
 530      */
 531     public function isVisible()
 532     {
 533         return (bool) $this->visibility;
 534     }

 536     /**
 537      * Overwrite KernelObjet::__get to get properties from both main properties
 538      * and additionnal properties.
 539      * @param string $nm property name
 540      * @return mixed property value or null
 541      */
 542     public function __get( $nm )
 543     {
 544         if ( $nm == 'categories' )
 545         {
 546             return $this->getCourseCategories();
 547         }
 548         elseif ( $nm == 'courseProperties' )
 549         {
 550             return $this->getCourseProperties();
 551         }
 552         elseif ( $nm == 'groupProperties' )
 553         {
 554             return $this->getGroupProperties();
 555         }
 556         elseif ( $nm == 'sourceCourseCode' )
 557         {
 558             return $this->getSourceCourseCode();
 559         }
 560         else
 561         {
 562             if ( isset ( $this->_rawData[$nm] ) )
 563             {
 564                 return $this->_rawData[$nm];
 565             }
 566             else
 567             {
 568                 return null;
 569             }
 570         }
 571     }
 572 }

 574 /**
 575  * Represents the current course object. This class is a singleton.
 576  */
 577 class Claro_CurrentCourse extends Claro_Course
 578 {
 579     public function __construct( $courseId = null )
 580     {
 581         $courseId = empty( $courseId )
 582             ? claro_get_current_course_id()
 583             : $courseId
 584             ;
 585             
 586         parent::__construct( $courseId );
 587     }
 588     
 589     protected static $instance = false;
 590 
 591     /**
 592      * Singleton constructor
 593      * @param int $courseId course code
 594      * @param boolean $forceReload force relaoding the course
 595      * @return Claro_CurrentCourse
 596      */
 597     public static function getInstance( $courseId = null, $forceReload = false )
 598     {
 599         if ( $forceReload || ! self::$instance )
 600         {
 601             self::$instance = new self( $courseId );
 602             
 603             if ( !$forceReload && claro_is_in_a_course() )
 604             {
 605                 self::$instance->loadFromSession();
 606             }
 607             else
 608             {
 609                 self::$instance->load( $forceReload );
 610             }
 611         }
 612         
 613         return self::$instance;
 614     }
 615 }

 112     /**
 113      * Get the properties of the user in the current Group/Team
 114      * @param Claro_User $userObj
 115      * @return stdClass user properties record :
 116      *      $userProperties->isGroupMember : boolean
 117      *      $userProperties->status : boolean
 118      *      $userProperties->role : string or null
 119      *      $userProperties->isGroupTutor : boolean
 120      */
 121     public function getUserPropertiesInGroup( Claro_User $userObj )
 122     {
 123         if ( !$this->_rawData )
 124         {
 125             throw new Exception("Group data not loaded !");
 126         }
 127 
 128         $tbl = claro_sql_get_course_tbl( $this->_courseObj->dbNameGlu );
 129 
 130         $sql = "SELECT
 131                     status,
 132                     role
 133                 FROM
 134                     `{$tbl['group_rel_team_user']}`
 135                 WHERE
 136                     `user` = {$userObj->userId}
 137                 AND
 138                     `team`   = {$this->_groupId};";
 139 
 140         $result = Claroline::getDatabase()
 141             ->query( $sql )
 142             ->fetch();
 143 
 144         $userProperties = new stdClass();
 145 
 146         if ( ! $result )
 147         {
 148             $userProperties->isGroupMember = false;
 149             $userProperties->status = false;
 150             $userProperties->role = null;
 151             $userProperties->isGroupTutor = $this->_rawData['tutorId'] == $userId;
 152         }
 153         else
 154         {
 155             $userProperties->isGroupMember = true;
 156             $userProperties->status = $result['status'];
 157             $userProperties->role = $result['role'];
 158             $userProperties->isGroupTutor = $this->_rawData['tutorId'] == $userId;
 159         }
 160 
 161         return $userProperties;
 162     }

 164     /**
 165      * Get the list of users in the group
 166      * @return Database_ResultSet group members
 167      */
 168     public function getGroupMembers()
 169     {
 170         if ( ! $this->_userList )
 171 
 172         {
 173             $mainTableName = get_module_main_tbl(array('user','rel_course_user'));
 174             $courseTableName = get_module_course_tbl(array('group_rel_team_user'), $this->_courseObj->courseId);
 175 
 176             $sql = "
 177                 SELECT
 178                     `user`.`user_id` AS `id`,
 179                     `user`.`nom` AS `lastName`,
 180                     `user`.`prenom` AS `firstName`,
 181                     `user`.`email`
 182                 FROM
 183                     `{$mainTableName['user']}` AS `user`
 184                 INNER JOIN
 185                     `{$courseTableName['group_rel_team_user']}` AS `user_group`
 186                 ON
 187                     `user`.`user_id` = `user_group`.`user`
 188                 INNER JOIN
 189                     `{$mainTableName['rel_course_user']}` AS `course_user`
 190                 ON
 191                     `user`.`user_id` = `course_user`.`user_id`
 192                 WHERE
 193                     `user_group`.`team`= {$this->_groupId}
 194                 AND
 195                     `course_user`.`code_cours` = '{$this->_courseObj->sysCode}'";
 196 
 197             $this->_userList = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
 198         }
 199 
 200         return $this->_userList;
 201     }

   5 /**
   6  * CLAROLINE
   7  *
   8  * "Magic" class to represent kernel objects. Defines __get, __set, __isset and
   9  * __unset magic methods.
  10  *
  11  * @version     Claroline 1.11 $Revision: 14326 $
  12  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2012, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  13  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  14  * @author      Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  15  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  16  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  17  * @package     kernel.objects
  18  */
  19 
  20 abstract class KernelObject
  21 {
  22     protected $_rawData = array();
  23     protected $sessionVarName;
  24 
  25     /**
  26      * Get the value of a property of the object. Magic method called by
  27      * $var = $obj->propertyName;
  28      * @param string $nm property name
  29      * @return mixed value of the property if the property exists, if not the
  30      * method returns null
  31      */
  32     public function __get( $nm )
  33     {
  34         if ( isset ( $this->_rawData[$nm] ) )
  35         {
  36             return $this->_rawData[$nm];
  37         }
  38         else
  39         {
  40             return null;
  41         }
  42     }
  43 
  44     /**
  45      * Prevent from changing the value of one of the object public property.
  46      * Magic method called by $obj->propertyName = $value;
  47      * @param string $nm
  48      * @param mixed $value
  49      * @throws Exception automaticaly ! (this object is read only)
  50      */
  51     public function __set( $nm, $value )
  52     {
  53         if ( $nm === '_rawData' )
  54         {
  55             $this->_rawData = $value;
  56         }
  57         else
  58         {
  59             throw new Exception("Cannot change variable {$nm} : ".__CLASS__." is readonly !");
  60         }
  61     }
  62 
  63     /**
  64      * Magic method called by isset($obj->propertyName);
  65      * @param string $nm property name
  66      * @return boolean true if the property is set for the object
  67      */
  68     public function __isset( $nm )
  69     {
  70         if ( isset ( $this->_rawData[$nm] ) )
  71         {
  72             return true;
  73         }
  74         else
  75         {
  76             return false;
  77         }
  78     }
  79 
  80     /**
  81      * Prevent from unsetting read only properties. Magic method called by
  82      * unset($obj->propertyName);
  83      * @param string $nm property name
  84      * @throws Exception automaticaly ! (this object is read only)
  85      */
  86     public function __unset( $nm )
  87     {
  88         throw new Exception("Cannot unset variable {$nm} : ".__CLASS__." is readonly !");
  89     }
  90 
  91     /**
  92      * Get the raw data of the object
  93      * @todo rewrite the kernel so thi method can be made 'protected'
  94      * @return array raw data contained in the object
  95      */
  96     public function getRawData()
  97     {
  98         return $this->_rawData;
  99     }
 100     
 101     public function saveToSession()
 102     {
 103         $_SESSION[$this->sessionVarName] = $this->_rawData;
 104         pushClaroMessage( "Kernel object {$this->sessionVarName} saved to session", 'debug' );
 105     }
 106     
 107     /**
 108      * Load user properties from session
 109      */
 110     public function loadFromSession()
 111     {
 112         if ( !empty($_SESSION[$this->sessionVarName]) )
 113         {
 114             $this->_rawData = $_SESSION[$this->sessionVarName];
 115             pushClaroMessage( "Kernel object {$this->sessionVarName} loaded from session", 'debug' );
 116         }
 117         else
 118         {
 119             throw new Exception("Cannot load kernel object {$this->sessionVarName} from session");
 120         }
 121     }
 122     
 123     public function load( $refresh = false )
 124     {
 125         if ( empty( $this->_rawData ) || $refresh )
 126         {
 127             $this->loadFromDatabase();
 128         }
 129     }
 130     
 131     abstract protected function loadFromDatabase();
 132 }

  19 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/object.lib.php';
  20 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../core/claroline.lib.php';
  21 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../database/database.lib.php';
  22 
  23 /**
  24  * Object used to load and represent a user.
  25  * WARNING : this object is read only.
  26  */
  27 class Claro_User extends KernelObject
  28 {
  29     protected $_userId;
  30 
  31     /**
  32      * Constructor
  33      * @param int $userId
  34      */
  35     public function __construct( $userId )
  36     {
  37         $this->_userId = $userId;
  38         $this->sessionVarName = '_user';
  39     }
  40 
  41     /**
  42      * Load user properties from database
  43      */
  44     public function loadFromDatabase()
  45     {
  46         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  47         
  48         $sqlUserId = (int) $this->_userId;
  49         
  50         $sql = "SELECT "
  51             . "`user`.`user_id` AS userId,\n"
  52             . "`user`.`username`,\n"
  53             . "`user`.`prenom` AS firstName,\n"
  54             . "`user`.`nom` AS lastName,\n"
  55             . "`user`.`email`AS `mail`,\n"
  56             . "`user`.`officialEmail` AS `officialEmail`,\n"
  57             . "`user`.`language`,\n"
  58             . "`user`.`isCourseCreator`,\n"
  59             . "`user`.`isPlatformAdmin`,\n"
  60             . "`user`.`creatorId` AS creatorId,\n"
  61             . "`user`.`officialCode`,\n"
  62             . "`user`.`language`,\n"
  63             . "`user`.`authSource`,\n"
  64             . "`user`.`phoneNumber` AS `phone`,\n"
  65             . "`user`.`pictureUri` AS `picture`,\n"
  66             
  67             . ( get_conf('is_trackingEnabled')
  68                 ? "UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`tracking`.`date`) "
  69                 : "DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) " )
  70                 
  71             . "AS lastLogin\n"
  72             . "FROM `{$tbl['user']}` AS `user`\n"
  73             
  74             . ( get_conf('is_trackingEnabled')
  75                 ? "LEFT JOIN `{$tbl['tracking_event']}` AS `tracking`\n"
  76                 . "ON `user`.`user_id`  = `tracking`.`user_id`\n"
  77                 . "AND `tracking`.`type` = 'user_login'\n"
  78                 : '')
  79                 
  80             . "WHERE `user`.`user_id` = ".$sqlUserId."\n"
  81             
  82             . ( get_conf('is_trackingEnabled')
  83                 ? "ORDER BY `tracking`.`date` DESC LIMIT 1"
  84                 : '')
  85             ;
  86 
  87         $userData = Claroline::getDatabase()->query( $sql )->fetch();
  88         
  89         if ( ! $userData )
  90         {
  91             throw new Exception("Cannot load user data for {$this->_userId}");
  92         }
  93         else
  94         {
  95             $userData['isPlatformAdmin'] = (bool) $userData['isPlatformAdmin'];
  96             $userData['isCourseCreator'] = (bool) $userData['isCourseCreator'];
  97             
  98             $this->_rawData = $userData;
  99             pushClaroMessage( "User {$this->_userId} loaded from database", 'debug' );
 100             
 101             $this->loadUserProperties();
 102         }
 103     }
 104 
 105     /**
 106      * Load additional properties from the database
 107      */
 108     public function loadUserProperties()
 109     {
 110         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 111             
 112         $userProperties = Claroline::getDatabase()->query("
 113             SELECT
 114                 propertyId AS name,
 115                 propertyValue AS value,
 116                 scope
 117             FROM
 118                 `{$tbl['user_property']}`
 119             WHERE
 120                 userId = " . (int) $this->_userId . ";
 121         ");
 122 
 123         $userProperties->setFetchMode(Database_ResultSet::FETCH_OBJECT);
 124         
 125         $this->_rawData['userProperties'] = array();
 126         
 127         foreach ( $userProperties as $property )
 128         {
 129             if ( ! array_key_exists( $property->name, $this->_rawData['userProperties'] )
 130                 || ! is_array( $this->_rawData['userProperties'][$property->name] ) )
 131             {
 132                 $this->_rawData['userProperties'][$property->name] = array();
 133             }
 134             
 135             $this->_rawData['userProperties'][$property->name][$property->scope] = $property->value;
 136         }
 137     }
 138 
 139     /**
 140      * Get an additionnal user property
 141      * @param string $name property name
 142      * @param string $scope property scope
 143      * @return mixed property value
 144      */
 145     public function getUserProperty( $name, $scope )
 146     {
 147         if ( array_key_exists( $name, $this->_rawData['userProperties'] )
 148             && array_key_exists( $scope, $this->_rawData['userProperties'][$property->name] )
 149         )
 150         {
 151             return $this->_rawData['userProperties'][$property->name][$property->scope];
 152         }
 153         else
 154         {
 155             return null;
 156         }
 157     }
 158 }

   3 /**
   4  * CLAROLINE
   5  *
   6  * Language library.  Contains function to manage l10n.
   7  *
   8  * @version     $Revision: 14452 $
   9  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  10  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html (GPL) GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
  11  * @see         http://www.claroline.net/wiki/CLUSR
  12  * @package     CLUSR
  13  * @author      Claro Team <cvs@claroline.net>
  14  */
  15 
  16 /**
  17  * Translate strings to the current locale
  18  *
  19  * When using get_lang(), try to put entire sentences and strings in
  20  * one get_lang() call. This makes it easier for translators.
  21  *
  22  * @code
  23  *  $msg = get_lang('Hello %name',array('%name' => $username))
  24  * @endcode
  25  *
  26  * @param $name
  27  *   A string containing the English string to translate.
  28  * @param $var_to_replace
  29  *   An associative array of replacements to make after translation. Incidences
  30  *   of any key in this array are replaced with the corresponding value.
  31  * @return
  32  *   The translated string.
  33  */
  34 
  35 function get_lang ($name,$var_to_replace=null)
  36 {
  37     global $_lang;
  38 
  39     $translation = '';
  40 
  41     if ( isset($_lang[$name]) )
  42     {
  43         $translation = $_lang[$name];
  44     }
  45     else
  46     {
  47         // missing translation
  48         $translation = $name;
  49     }
  50 
  51 
  52     if ( !empty($var_to_replace) && is_array($var_to_replace) )
  53     {
  54         if (claro_debug_mode())
  55         {
  56             foreach (array_keys($var_to_replace) as $signature)
  57             {
  58 
  59                 if (false === strpos($translation, $signature))
  60                 if (is_numeric($signature) && isset($var_to_replace[($signature+1)]) )
  61                 {
  62                      pushClaroMessage($signature . ' not in varlang.<br>
  63 "<b>' . $var_to_replace[$signature] . '</b>" is probably the key of "<b>' . $var_to_replace[($signature+1)] . '</b>"' ,'translation' );
  64                 }
  65                 else pushClaroMessage($signature . ' not in varlang.' ,'translation');
  66             }
  67         }
  68 
  69 
  70         uksort( $var_to_replace, 'cmp_string_by_length' );
  71         return strtr($translation, $var_to_replace);
  72     }
  73     else
  74     {
  75         // return translation
  76         return $translation;
  77     }
  78 }
  79 
  80 if ( ! function_exists( 'cmp_string_by_length' ) )
  81 {
  82     /**
  83      * Compare strings based on their length
  84      */
  85     function cmp_string_by_length( $a, $b )
  86     {
  87         if ( strlen( $a ) == strlen( $b ) )
  88         {
  89             return 0;
  90         }
  91         elseif ( strlen( $a ) > strlen( $b ) )
  92         {
  93             return -1;
  94         }
  95         else
  96         {
  97             return 1;
  98         }
  99     }
 100 }
 101 
 102 /**
 103  * Get the translation of the block
 104  *
 105  * @param $name block name
 106  * @param $var_to_remplace array with variables to replace
 107  *
 108  * @return block translation
 109  *
 110  */
 111 
 112 function get_block ($name,$var_to_replace=null)
 113 {
 114     if ( !empty($var_to_replace) && is_array($var_to_replace) )
 115     {
 116         return get_lang($name,$var_to_replace);
 117     }
 118     else
 119     {
 120         return get_lang($name);
 121     }
 122 }

 320                 if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 321                 {
 322                     pushClaroMessage(__FUNCTION__."::".$moduleLabel.'::'
 323                         . ucfirst( $language ).' lang file loaded', 'debug');
 324                 }
 325             }
 326             elseif ( $language != 'english' )
 327             {
 328                 // no language file to load
 329                 if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 330                 {
 331                     pushClaroMessage(__FUNCTION__."::".$moduleLabel.'::'
 332                         . ucfirst( $language ) .' lang file  not found', 'debug');
 333                 }
 334             }
 335             else
 336             {
 337                 // nothing to do
 338             }
 339         }
 340         else
 341         {
 342             // Not in a module

 346     public static function current_language()
 347     {
 348         // FIXME : use init.lib instead of global variables !!!
 349         global $_course, $_user, $platformLanguage;
 350 
 351         if ( claro_is_in_a_course() && isset($_course['language']) )
 352         {
 353             // course language
 354             return $_course['language'];
 355         }
 356         else
 357         {
 358             if ( claro_is_user_authenticated() && !empty($_user['language']) )
 359             {
 360                 // user language
 361                 return $_user['language'];
 362             }
 363             else
 364             {
 365                 if ( isset($_REQUEST['language'])
 366                     && in_array($_REQUEST['language'], array_keys(get_language_list())) )
 367                 {
 368                     // selected language
 369                     $_SESSION['language'] = $_REQUEST['language'];
 370                     return $_REQUEST['language'];
 371                 }
 372                 else
 373                 {
 374                     if ( empty($_SESSION['language']) )
 375                     {
 376                         // default platform language
 377                         return $platformLanguage;
 378                     }
 379                     else
 380                     {
 381                         return $_SESSION['language'];
 382                     }
 383                 }
 384             }
 385         }
 386 
 387     }
 388 }

 390 /**
 391 *   Displays a form (drop down menu) so the user can select his/her preferred
 392 language.
 393 *   The form works with or without javascript
 394 *   TODO : need some refactoring there is a lot of function to get platform
 395 language

 398 function get_language_list()
 399 {
 400     // language path
 401     $language_dirname = get_path('rootSys') . 'claroline/lang/' ;
 402 
 403     // init accepted_values list
 404     $language_list = array();
 405 
 406     if ( is_dir($language_dirname) )
 407     {
 408         // TODO : use DirectoryIterator
 409         $handle = opendir($language_dirname);
 410         
 411         while ( $elt = readdir($handle) )
 412         {
 413             if ( $elt == '.' || $elt == '..' || $elt == '.svn' ) continue;
 414 
 415             // skip if not a dir
 416             if ( is_dir( $language_dirname.$elt ) )
 417             {
 418                 $elt_key = $elt;
 419                 $elt_value = get_translation_of_language($elt_key);
 420                 $language_list[$elt_key] = $elt_value;
 421             }
 422         }
 423 
 424         asort($language_list);
 425         return $language_list;
 426     }
 427     else
 428     {
 429         return false;
 430     }
 431 }

 433 function get_language_to_display_list( $param = 'language_to_display' )
 434 {
 435     global $platformLanguage;
 436 
 437     $language_list = array();
 438 
 439     $language_to_display_list = get_conf( $param );
 440     $language_to_display_list[] = $platformLanguage;
 441 
 442     foreach ( $language_to_display_list as $language )
 443     {
 444         $key = ucfirst( get_translation_of_language($language) );
 445         $value = $language;
 446         $language_list[$key] = $value;
 447     }
 448 
 449     asort($language_list);
 450 
 451     return $language_list;
 452 }

 532          for syntax to use for this string
 533          I suggest to use the format you can find in trad4all.inc.php files
 534  * @param timestamp timestamp of date to format
 535  */
 536 
 537 function claro_disp_localised_date($formatOfDate,$timestamp = -1)
 538 {
 539     pushClaroMessage( (function_exists('claro_html_debug_backtrace')
 540              ? claro_html_debug_backtrace()
 541              : 'claro_html_debug_backtrace() not defined'
 542              )
 543              .'claro_ disp _localised_date() is deprecated , use claro_ html _localised_date()','error');
 544 
 545     return claro_html_localised_date($formatOfDate,$timestamp);

 548 function claro_html_localised_date($formatOfDate,$timestamp = -1) //PMAInspiration :)
 549 {
 550     $langDay_of_weekNames['long'] = get_lang_weekday_name_list('long');
 551     $langDay_of_weekNames['short'] = get_lang_weekday_name_list('short');
 552 
 553     $langMonthNames['short'] = get_lang_month_name_list('short');
 554     $langMonthNames['long'] = get_lang_month_name_list('long');
 555 
 556     if ($timestamp == -1) $timestamp = claro_time();
 557 
 558     // with the ereg  we  replace %aAbB of date format
 559     //(they can be done by the system when  locale date aren't aivailable
 560 
 561     $formatOfDate = preg_replace('/%[A]/', $langDay_of_weekNames['long'][(int)strftime('%w', $timestamp)], $formatOfDate);
 562     $formatOfDate = preg_replace('/%[a]/', $langDay_of_weekNames['short'][(int)strftime('%w', $timestamp)], $formatOfDate);
 563     $formatOfDate = preg_replace('/%[B]/', $langMonthNames['long'][(int)strftime('%m', $timestamp)-1], $formatOfDate);
 564     $formatOfDate = preg_replace('/%[b]/', $langMonthNames['short'][(int)strftime('%m', $timestamp)-1], $formatOfDate);
 565     return strftime($formatOfDate, $timestamp);
 566 }

 568 /**
 569  * This function return true if $Str could be UTF-8, false otehrwise
 570  *
 571  * function found @ http://www.php.net/manual/en/function.utf8-encode.php
 572  */
 573 function seems_utf8($str)
 574 {
 575     for ($i=0; $i<strlen($str); $i++)
 576     {
 577         if (ord($str[$i]) < 0x80) continue; // 0bbbbbbb
 578         elseif ((ord($str[$i]) & 0xE0) == 0xC0) $n=1; // 110bbbbb
 579         elseif ((ord($str[$i]) & 0xF0) == 0xE0) $n=2; // 1110bbbb
 580         elseif ((ord($str[$i]) & 0xF8) == 0xF0) $n=3; // 11110bbb
 581         elseif ((ord($str[$i]) & 0xFC) == 0xF8) $n=4; // 111110bb
 582         elseif ((ord($str[$i]) & 0xFE) == 0xFC) $n=5; // 1111110b
 583         else return false; // Does not match any model
 584         for ($j=0; $j<$n; $j++) // n bytes matching 10bbbbbb follow ?
 585         {
 586             if ((++$i == strlen($str)) || ((ord($str[$i]) & 0xC0) != 0x80))
 587             return false;
 588         }
 589     }
 590     return true;
 591 }
 592 
 593 /**
 594  * Returns utf-8 encoded $str. No changes are made if it was already utf-8
 595  *
 596  */
 597 function claro_utf8_encode($str, $fromCharset = '' )
 598 {
 599     if( $fromCharset != '' )    $charset = $fromCharset;
 600     else                        $charset = $GLOBALS['charset'];
 601 
 602 
 603     if( strtoupper($charset) == 'UTF-8' || seems_utf8($str) )
 604     {
 605         return $str;
 606     }
 607     elseif ( strtoupper($charset) == 'ISO-8859-1' )
 608     {
 609         return utf8_encode( $str );
 610     }
 611     elseif ( function_exists('mb_convert_encoding') )
 612     {
 613         return mb_convert_encoding( $str, $charset, 'UTF-8' );
 614     }
 615     elseif ( function_exists('iconv'))
 616     {
 617         return iconv( $charset, 'UTF-8//TRANSLIT', $str );
 618     }
 619     else
 620     {
 621         $converted = claro_htmlentities( $str, ENT_NOQUOTES, $charset );
 622         return claro_html_entity_decode( $converted, ENT_NOQUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
 623     }
 624 }
 625 
 626 /**
 627  * Returns decoded utf-8 $str. No changes are made if it was not utf-8
 628  *
 629  */
 630 function claro_utf8_decode($str, $toCharset = '')
 631 {
 632     if( $toCharset != '' )  $charset = $toCharset;
 633     else                    $charset = $GLOBALS['charset'];
 634 
 635     if( strtoupper($charset) == 'UTF-8' || !seems_utf8($str) )
 636     {
 637         return $str;
 638     }
 639     elseif ( strtoupper($charset) == 'ISO-8859-1' )
 640     {
 641         return utf8_decode( $str );
 642     }
 643     elseif ( function_exists('mb_convert_encoding') )
 644     {
 645         return mb_convert_encoding( $str, 'UTF-8', $charset );
 646     }
 647     elseif ( function_exists('iconv'))
 648     {
 649         return iconv( 'UTF-8', $charset.'//TRANSLIT', $str );
 650     }
 651     else
 652     {
 653         $converted = claro_htmlentities( $str, ENT_NOQUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
 654         return claro_html_entity_decode( $converted, ENT_NOQUOTES, $charset );
 655     }
 656 }
 657 
 658 function claro_utf8_encode_array( &$var )
 659 {
 660     if ( !is_array( $var ) )
 661     {
 662         $var = claro_utf8_encode( $var );
 663     }
 664     else
 665     {
 666         array_walk( $var, 'claro_utf8_encode_array' );
 667     }
 668 }

 670 /*
 671  * Usage :
 672  * =======
 673  * 
 674  * In PHP :
 675  * --------
 676  *
 677  *      JavascriptLanguage::getInstance()->addLangVar('User list');
 678  *      // ...
 679  * 
 680  * In javascript :
 681  * ---------------
 682  * 
 683  *      Claroline.getLang('User list');
 684 */
 685 class JavascriptLanguage
 686 {    
 687     private static $variables = array();
 688     
 689     public function addLangVar ( $varName, $varValue = null )
 690     {
 691         self::$variables[$varName] = $varValue ? $varValue : get_lang($varName);
 692     }
 693     
 694     protected function pack()
 695     {
 696         $pack = array();
 697         
 698         foreach ( self::$variables as $name => $translation )
 699         {
 700             $pack[] = '"' 
 701                 . str_replace( '"', '\\"', claro_htmlspecialchars( $name ) ) 
 702                 . '" : \'' 
 703                 . str_replace( "'", "\\'", claro_htmlspecialchars( $translation ) ) 
 704                 . '\''
 705                 ;
 706         }
 707         
 708         return implode ( ",\n\t", $pack ) . "\n";
 709     }
 710     
 711     public function buildJavascript()
 712     {
 713         return "
 714 <script type=\"text/javascript\">
 715 var __ = (function(){
 716 
 717     var translation = {
 718     " . $this->pack() . "
 719     };
 720 
 721     return function(string) {
 722         return translation[string] || string;
 723     };
 724 
 725 })();
 726 </script>
 727             ";
 728     }
 729     
 730     /**
 731      * @deprecated called automatically by kernel
 732      * @return string
 733      */
 734     public function render()
 735     {
 736         Console::debug( __CLASS__ . '::' . __FUNCTION__ . " is deprecated" );
 737         
 738         return '';
 739     }
 740     
 741     protected static $instance = false;
 742     
 743     public static function getInstance()
 744     {
 745         if ( ! self::$instance )
 746         {
 747             self::$instance = new self();
 748         }
 749         
 750         return self::$instance;
 751     }
 752 }

   4 
   5 /**
   6  *
   7  * @version     Claroline 1.11 $Revision: 14181 $
   8  * @copyright   2001-2012 Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
   9  * @author      Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>

  11  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  12  * @package     icterms
  13  */
  14 
  15 /**
  16  * This class implements lock to force the execution of only one redirecting 
  17  * kernel hook by the kernel. Kernel hooks are pieces of code defined in modules
  18  * through the functions.php script to execute instructions just after the kernel 
  19  * initialization on every pages of the platform. Redirecting are kernel hooks 
  20  * that use HTTP redirection to go to another script than the one currently 
  21  * executed. The issue with multiple redircting kernel hooks is that can redirect 
  22  * one another forming an infinite loop making the platform unable to work 
  23  * properly.
  24  * This class allows to avoid those issues by requesting a lock before the 
  25  * execution of the kernel hook, so only one redirecting hook will be executed.
  26  * You can find examples of usage in ICSURVEW and ICTERM modules.
  27  * 
  28  * WARNING : DO NOT FORGET to release the lock when the script to 
  29  * which the hook has made the redirection has finished his job.
  30  * 
  31  * Usage : in functions.php
  32  * 
  33  * // ask for the lock
  34  * Claro_KernelHook_Lock::getLock();
  35  * 
  36  * // check if the module has got the lock
  37  * if ( Claro_KernelHook_Lock::hasLock() )
  38  * {
  39  *      claro_redirect( get_module_url('MYMODULE') . '/hook.php' );
  40  * }
  41  * 
  42  * 
  43  * Usage : in hook.php
  44  * 
  45  * // do your stuff
  46  * 
  47  * 
  48  * // DO NOT FORGET TO RELEASE THE LOCK !
  49  * 
  50  * Claro_KernelHook_Lock::releaseLock();
  51  * 
  52  */
  53 class Claro_KernelHook_Lock
  54 {
  55     const CLARO_KERNEL_HOOK_LOCK = 'claroKernelHookLock';
  56     
  57     /**
  58      * Get a lock the current module
  59      * @return boolean 
  60      */
  61     public static function getLock()
  62     {
  63         $moduleLabel = get_current_module_label();
  64         
  65         if ( empty($moduleLabel) )
  66         {
  67             return false;
  68         }
  69         
  70         if( self::hasLock( $moduleLabel ) )
  71         {
  72             return true;
  73         }
  74         elseif( self::lockAvailable() )
  75         {
  76             $_SESSION[ self::CLARO_KERNEL_HOOK_LOCK ] = $moduleLabel;
  77             return true;
  78         }
  79         else
  80         {
  81             return false;
  82         }
  83     }
  84     
  85     /**
  86      * Check if the current module has the lock
  87      * @return type 
  88      */
  89     public static function hasLock()
  90     {
  91         $moduleLabel = get_current_module_label();
  92         
  93         return isset( $_SESSION[ self::CLARO_KERNEL_HOOK_LOCK ] )
  94             && $_SESSION[ self::CLARO_KERNEL_HOOK_LOCK ] == $moduleLabel;
  95     }
  96     
  97     /**
  98      * Check if the lock is available
  99      * @return type 
 100      */
 101     public static function lockAvailable()
 102     {
 103         return ! ( isset( $_SESSION[ self::CLARO_KERNEL_HOOK_LOCK ] )
 104             && ! empty( $_SESSION[ self::CLARO_KERNEL_HOOK_LOCK ] ) );
 105     }
 106     
 107     /**
 108      * Release the lock
 109      * @return boolean 
 110      */
 111     public static function releaseLock()
 112     {
 113         $moduleLabel = get_current_module_label();
 114         
 115         if( self::hasLock( $moduleLabel ) )
 116         {
 117             unset( $_SESSION[ self::CLARO_KERNEL_HOOK_LOCK ] );
 118             return true;
 119         }
 120         else
 121         {
 122             return false;
 123         }
 124     }
 125 }

 120 /**
 121  * Return the list of context that the tool can use but not manage.
 122  *
 123  * @param string $moduleLabel
 124  * @return array
 125  */
 126 function get_module_db_dependance ( $moduleLabel )
 127 {
 128     $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 129     
 130     $sqlModuleLabel = claro_sql_escape($moduleLabel);
 131     
 132     $contextList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows("
 133         SELECT 
 134             `mc`.`context` AS `context`
 135         FROM 
 136             `{$tbl['module_contexts']}` AS `mc`
 137         LEFT JOIN 
 138             `{$tbl['module']}` AS `m`
 139         ON 
 140             `m`.`id` = `mc`.`module_id`
 141         WHERE 
 142             `m`.`label` = '{$sqlModuleLabel}'
 143     ");
 144     
 145     $contextListToReturn = array();
 146     
 147     foreach ( $contextList as $context )
 148     {
 149         if ( $context['context'] == 'course' )
 150         {
 151             $contextListToReturn[] = CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE;
 152         }
 153         elseif ( $context['context'] == 'group' )
 154         {
 155             $contextListToReturn[] = CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP;
 156         }
 157     }
 158     
 159     return $contextListToReturn;
 160 }

 186 /**
 187  * Get information about a module
 188  * @param string $claroLabel module label
 189  * @param string $dataName
 190  * @param boolean $ignoreCache
 191  * @return mixed
 192  */
 193 function get_module_data( $claroLabel, $dataName = null, $ignoreCache = false )
 194 {
 195     static $cachedModuleDataList = null;
 196 
 197     if ( is_null ($cachedModuleDataList) )
 198     {
 199         $cachedModuleDataList = array();
 200     }
 201 
 202     if ($ignoreCache || ! array_key_exists($claroLabel,$cachedModuleDataList))
 203     {
 204         $tbl = claro_sql_get_tbl(array('module', 'course_tool'));
 205         $sql = "SELECT M.`label`      AS label,
 206                    M.`id`             AS id,
 207                    M.`name`           AS moduleName,
 208                    M.`activation`     AS activation,
 209                    M.`type`           AS type,
 210                    M.`script_url`     AS entry,
 211                    CT.`icon`          AS icon,
 212                    CT.`def_rank`      AS rank,
 213                    CT.`add_in_course` AS add_in_course,
 214                    CT.`access_manager` AS access_manager
 215 
 216         FROM `" . $tbl['module'] . "` AS M
 217         LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl['course_tool'] . "` AS CT
 218             ON CT.`claro_label`= M.label
 219         WHERE  M.`label` = '" . claro_sql_escape($claroLabel) . "'";
 220 
 221         $cachedModuleDataList[$claroLabel] = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
 222     }
 223     
 224     if ( !is_null( $dataName ) )
 225     {
 226         return $cachedModuleDataList[$claroLabel][$dataName];
 227     }
 228     else
 229     {
 230         return $cachedModuleDataList[$claroLabel];
 231     }
 232 }

 234 /**
 235  * Check if a module is installed and actived.
 236  *
 237  * @param string $modLabel module label
 238  * @return array
 239  */
 240 function check_module($modLabel)
 241 {
 242     $tbl_name        = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 243     $tbl_module      = $tbl_name['module'];
 244 
 245     $sql = "SELECT M.`id`              AS `id`,
 246                    M.`label`           AS `label`,
 247                    M.`activation`      AS `activation`
 248             FROM `" . $tbl_module . "` AS M
 249             WHERE M.`label` = '".$modLabel."'";
 250 
 251     $result = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
 252 
 253     if (empty($result))
 254     {
 255         $message[] = "The ".$modLabel." hasn't been installed!";
 256         return array(false,$message);
 257     }
 258     else
 259     {
 260         if ($result['activation'] == 'desactivated')
 261         {
 262             $message[] = "The ".$modLabel." hasn't been activated!";
 263             return array(false,$message);
 264         }
 265         else
 266             return array(true,null);
 267     }
 268 }

 294 /**
 295  * Get the list of all modules on the platform
 296  * @param   bool $activeModulesOnly selects only active module (default true)
 297  * @return  array module label list
 298  * @throws  COULD_NOT_GET_MODULE_LABEL_LIST
 299  * @author  Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
 300  */
 301 function get_module_label_list( $activeModulesOnly = true )
 302 {
 303     $tbl_name_list = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 304     $tbl_module = $tbl_name_list['module'];
 305 
 306     $activationSQL = $activeModulesOnly
 307         ? "WHERE `activation` = 'activated'"
 308         : ''
 309         ;
 310 
 311     $sql = "SELECT `label`, `id` \n"
 312         . "FROM `" . $tbl_module . "`\n"
 313         . $activationSQL
 314         ;
 315 
 316     if ( ! ( $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all( $sql ) ) )
 317     {
 318         return claro_failure::set_failure('COULD_NOT_GET_MODULE_LABEL_LIST');
 319     }
 320     else
 321     {
 322         $moduleLabelList = array();
 323 
 324         foreach( $result as $module )
 325         {
 326             $moduleLabelList[$module['id']] = $module['label'];
 327         }
 328 
 329         return $moduleLabelList;
 330     }
 331 }

 402 /**
 403  * Remove database for all modules in the given course
 404  * @param   string courseId
 405  * @return  array(
 406  *  boolean success
 407  *  Backlog log )
 408  * @author  Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
 409  */
 410 function delete_all_modules_from_course( $courseId )
 411 {
 412     $backlog = new Backlog;
 413     $success = true;
 414 
 415     if ( ! $moduleLabelList = get_module_label_list(false) )
 416     {
 417         $success = false;
 418         $backlog->failure( claro_failure::get_last_failure() );
 419     }
 420     else
 421     {
 422         foreach ( $moduleLabelList as $moduleLabel )
 423         {
 424             if ( ! delete_module_in_course( $moduleLabel, $courseId ) )
 425             {
 426                 $backlog->failure( get_lang('delete failed for module %module'
 427                     , array( '%module' => $moduleLabel ) ) );
 428 
 429                 $success = false;
 430             }
 431             else
 432             {
 433                 $backlog->success( get_lang('delete succeeded for module %module'
 434                     , array( '%module' => $moduleLabel ) ) );
 435             }
 436         }
 437     }
 438 
 439     return array( $success, $backlog );
 440 }

 449 function delete_module_in_course( $moduleLabel, $courseId )

 470 /**
 471  * Execute course related SQL files by replacing __CL__COURSE__ place holder
 472  * with given course code, then executing the file
 473  * @param   string file path to the sql file
 474  * @param   string courseId course sys code
 475  * @return  boolean
 476  * @author  Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
 477  * @throws  SQL_FILE_NOT_FOUND, SQL_QUERY_FAILED
 478  */
 479 function execute_sql_file_in_course( $file, $courseId )
 480 {
 481     if ( file_exists( $file ) )
 482     {
 483         $sql = file_get_contents( $file );
 484 
 485         if ( !empty( $courseId ) )
 486         {
 487             $currentCourseDbNameGlu = claro_get_course_db_name_glued( $courseId );
 488             $sql = str_replace('__CL_COURSE__', $currentCourseDbNameGlu, $sql );
 489         }
 490 
 491         if ( ! claro_sql_multi_query($sql) )
 492         {
 493             return claro_failure::set_failure( 'SQL_QUERY_FAILED' );
 494         }
 495         else
 496         {
 497             return true;
 498         }
 499     }
 500     else
 501     {
 502         return claro_failure::set_failure( 'SQL_FILE_NOT_FOUND' );
 503     }
 504 }

 534 /**
 535  * Get list of module table names 'localized' for the given course
 536  * @param array $arrTblName of tableName
 537  * @param string $courseCode course code
 538  * @return array $tableName => $dbNameGlue . $tableName
 539  * @throws Exception if no course code given and not in a course or
 540  *  course not valid
 541  */
 542 function get_module_course_tbl( $arrTblName, $courseCode = null )
 543 {
 544     if ( empty ( $courseCode ) )
 545     {
 546         if ( ! claro_is_in_a_course() )
 547         {
 548             throw new Exception('Not in a course !');
 549         }
 550         else
 551         {
 552             $courseCode = claro_get_current_course_id();
 553         }
 554     }
 555     
 556     $currentCourseDbNameGlu = claro_get_course_db_name_glued( $courseCode );
 557 
 558     if ( ! $currentCourseDbNameGlu )
 559     {
 560         throw new Exception('Invalid course !');
 561     }
 562 
 563     $aliases = get_main_tbl_aliases();
 564 
 565     $arrToReturn = array();
 566 
 567     foreach ( $arrTblName as $name )
 568     {
 569         if ( array_key_exists( $name, $aliases ) )
 570         {
 571             $arrToReturn[$name] = $currentCourseDbNameGlu . $aliases[$name];
 572         }
 573         else
 574         {
 575             $arrToReturn[$name] = $currentCourseDbNameGlu . $name;
 576         }
 577 
 578     }
 579 
 580     return $arrToReturn;
 581 }

 645 /**
 646  * Get the list of tools in a course
 647  * @param string $courseIdReq course code
 648  * @param boolean $platformActive get only modules activated for the platform
 649  * @param boolean $courseActive get only modules activated in the current course
 650  * @param string $context context of the module
 651  * @return array or false
 652  */
 653 function module_get_course_tool_list( $courseIdReq,
 654                                     $platformActive = true,
 655                                     $courseActive = true,
 656                                     $context = null )
 657 {
 658     $tbl_mdb_names        = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 659     $tbl_tool_list        = $tbl_mdb_names['tool'];
 660     $tbl_module           = $tbl_mdb_names['module'];
 661     $tbl_module_contexts  = $tbl_mdb_names['module_contexts'];
 662     $tbl_cdb_names        = claro_sql_get_course_tbl( claro_get_course_db_name_glued($courseIdReq) );
 663     $tbl_course_tool_list = $tbl_cdb_names['tool'];
 664     
 665     if ( ! is_null ($context) )
 666     {
 667         $contextJoin = "LEFT JOIN `{$tbl_module_contexts}` AS mc\n"
 668             . " ON mc.module_id = `m`.id\n"
 669             ;
 670         
 671         $contextCondition = " AND `mc`.`context` = '"
 672             .claro_sql_escape($context)."'"
 673             ;
 674     }
 675     else
 676     {
 677         $contextJoin = "";
 678         $contextCondition = "";
 679     }
 680     
 681     /*
 682     * Search all the tool corresponding to this access levels
 683     */
 684     
 685     if ( is_null( $courseActive ) )
 686     {
 687         $sql_courseActive = '';
 688     }
 689     else
 690     {
 691         $sql_courseActive = $courseActive
 692             ? " AND ctl.activated = 'true' "
 693             : " AND ctl.activated = 'false' "
 694             ;
 695     }
 696     
 697     if ( is_null( $platformActive ) )
 698     {
 699         $sql_platformActive = '';
 700     }
 701     else
 702     {
 703         $sql_platformActive = $platformActive
 704             ? " AND m.activation = 'activated' "
 705             : " AND m.activation = 'deactivated' "
 706             ;
 707     }
 708 
 709     // find module or claroline existing tools
 710     
 711     $sql = "SELECT DISTINCT ctl.id            AS id,
 712                   pct.id                      AS tool_id,
 713                   pct.claro_label             AS label,
 714                   ctl.script_name             AS external_name,
 715                   ctl.visibility              AS visibility,
 716                   IFNULL(pct.icon,'tool.png') AS icon,
 717                   ISNULL(ctl.tool_id)         AS external,
 718                   m.activation ,
 719                   m.name                      AS name,
 720                   pct.access_manager            AS access_manager,
 721                   ctl.activated,
 722                   IFNULL( ctl.script_url ,
 723                           pct.script_url )    AS url
 724             FROM `{$tbl_tool_list}` AS pct
 725             LEFT JOIN `{$tbl_course_tool_list}` AS ctl
 726             ON ctl.tool_id = pct.id
 727             LEFT JOIN `{$tbl_module}` AS m
 728             ON m.label = pct.claro_label
 729             {$contextJoin}
 730             WHERE 1
 731             {$sql_platformActive}
 732             {$sql_courseActive}
 733             {$contextCondition}
 734             ORDER BY external, pct.def_rank, ctl.rank
 735         
 736     ";
 737 
 738     return claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 739 }

 741 /**

 744  * @return array or false

 746 function get_group_tool_label_list( $activatedOnly = true )

 751         . " FROM `{$tbl['module']}` AS `m`\n"

 753         . " ON `mc`.`module_id` = `m`.`id`\n"

 756         . ( $activatedOnly ? " AND `m`.`activation` = 'activated' " : '' )

 759     return claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sql);

 779  * @return boolean
 780  */
 781 function is_tool_activated_in_course( $toolId, $courseIdReq, $forceCacheRefresh = false )
 782 {

 784     
 785     if ( ! $courseActivatedToolList )
 786     {
 787         $courseActivatedToolList = array();
 788     }
 789     
 790     if ( ! isset($courseActivatedToolList[$courseIdReq]) || $forceCacheRefresh )
 791     {
 792         
 793         $courseActivatedToolList[$courseIdReq] = array();
 794     
 795         $tbl_cdb_names = claro_sql_get_course_tbl(
 796             claro_get_course_db_name_glued( $courseIdReq ) 
 797         );

 799         $tbl_course_tool_list = $tbl_cdb_names['tool'];
 800 
 801         $sql = "SELECT tool_id \n"
 802             . "FROM `{$tbl_course_tool_list}`\n"
 803             . "WHERE `activated` = 'true'"
 804             ;

 806         $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sql);
 807     
 808         foreach ( $result as $tool )
 809         {
 810             $courseActivatedToolList[$courseIdReq][$tool['tool_id']] = true;

 812     
 813     }
 814     
 815     if ( isset( $courseActivatedToolList[$courseIdReq][$toolId] ) )
 816     {

 819     else

 821         return false;

 942 function is_module_installed_in_course_lightversion( $toolLabel, $course, $forceCacheRefresh = false )
 943 {
 944     static $courseInstalledToolList = false;
 945     
 946     $toolId = get_tool_id_from_module_label( $toolLabel );
 947     
 948     if ( ! $courseInstalledToolList )
 949     {
 950         $courseInstalledToolList = array();
 951     }
 952     
 953     $courseIdReq = $course['sysCode'];
 954     
 955     if ( ! isset($courseInstalledToolList[$courseIdReq]) || $forceCacheRefresh )
 956     {
 957         
 958         $courseInstalledToolList[$courseIdReq] = array();
 959     
 960         $tbl_cdb_names = claro_sql_get_course_tbl(
 961             get_conf('courseTablePrefix') . $course['db'] . get_conf('dbGlu')
 962         );
 963

 965 
 966         $sql = "SELECT tool_id \n"
 967             . "FROM `{$tbl_course_tool_list}`\n"
 968             . "WHERE `installed` = 'true'"
 969             ;
 970         
 971         $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sql);
 972     
 973         foreach ( $result as $tool )
 974         {
 975             $courseInstalledToolList[$courseIdReq][$tool['tool_id']] = true;
 976         }
 977     
 978     }
 979     
 980     if ( isset( $courseInstalledToolList[$courseIdReq][$toolId] ) )
 981     {
 982         return true;

1108 /**
1109  * Change a module activation in all the groups of the given course
1110  * @param Database_Connection $database, use Claroline::getDatabase()
1111  * @param string $moduleLabel
1112  * @param string $courseId
1113  * @param boolean $activated
1114  * @return boolean
1115  */
1116 function change_module_activation_in_groups ( $database, $moduleLabel, $courseId, $activated )
1117 {
1118     $tbl = get_module_course_tbl(array('course_properties'), $courseId);
1119 
1120     $activation = $activated ? 1 : 0;
1121 
1122     if ( $database->query("
1123         SELECT
1124             `value`
1125         FROM
1126             `{$tbl['course_properties']}`
1127         WHERE
1128             `name` = " . $database->quote( $moduleLabel ) . "
1129         AND
1130             `category` = 'GROUP'" )->numRows() )
1131     {
1132         // update
1133         return $database->exec( "
1134             UPDATE
1135                 `{$tbl['course_properties']}`
1136             SET
1137                 `value` = {$activation}
1138             WHERE
1139                 `name` = " . $database->quote( $moduleLabel ) . "
1140             AND
1141                 `category` = 'GROUP'
1142          " );
1143     }
1144     else
1145     {
1146         // insert
1147         return $database->exec( "
1148             INSERT INTO
1149                 `{$tbl['course_properties']}`
1150             SET
1151                 `value` = {$activation},
1152                 `name` = " . $database->quote( $moduleLabel ) . ",
1153                 `category` = 'GROUP'
1154          " );
1155     }
1156 }

  26 /**

  30  * @return array (label, id, module_name,activation, type, script_url, icon,
  31  *  version, author, author_email, website, description, license)
  32  */
  33 function get_module_info($moduleId)
  34 {
  35     $tbl = claro_sql_get_tbl(array('module', 'module_info', 'course_tool'));
  36 
  37     $sql = "
  38         SELECT M.`label`  AS label,
  39                M.`id`         AS module_id,
  40                M.`name`       AS module_name,
  41                M.`activation` AS activation,
  42                M.`type`       AS type,
  43                M.`script_url` AS script_url,
  44 
  45                CT.`icon`       AS icon,
  46                CT.`add_in_course` AS activateInCourses,
  47                CT.`access_manager` AS accessManager,
  48 
  49                MI.version      AS version,
  50                MI.author       AS author,
  51                MI.author_email AS author_email ,
  52                MI.website      AS website,
  53                MI.description  AS description,
  54                MI.license      AS license
  55 
  56           FROM `" . $tbl['module']      . "` AS M
  57 
  58      LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl['module_info'] . "` AS MI
  59             ON M.`id` = MI . `module_id`
  60 
  61      LEFT JOIN `" . $tbl['course_tool'] . "` AS CT
  62             ON CT.`claro_label`= M.label
  63 
  64          WHERE M.`id` = " . (int) $moduleId;
  65 
  66     return claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
  67 
  68 }

 134 /**
 135  * Get the list of the repositories found in the module repository
 136  * where all modules are installed, its effect is
 137  * returning the expected list
 138  *
 139  * @return an array with all the repositories found in the module repository
 140  * where all modules are installed
 141  */
 142 function get_module_repositories()
 143 {
 144 
 145     $moduleRepositorySys = get_path('rootSys') . 'module/';
 146     $folder_array = array();
 147     if(file_exists($moduleRepositorySys))
 148     {
 149         if (false !== ($handle = opendir($moduleRepositorySys)))
 150         {
 151             while (false !== ($file = readdir($handle)))
 152             {
 153                 if ( $file == '.' || $file == '..' || $file == 'CVS' )
 154                 {
 155                     continue;
 156                 }
 157                 elseif (!is_dir($moduleRepositorySys . $file) )
 158                 {
 159                     continue ;
 160                 }
 161                 elseif( is_dir($file) && $file[0] == '.' )
 162                 {
 163                     continue;
 164                 }
 165                 else
 166                 {
 167                     $folder_array[] = $file;
 168                 }
 169             }
 170         }
 171 
 172         closedir($handle);
 173     }
 174     return $folder_array;
 175 }

 177 /**
 178  * Check the presence of unexpected module repositories or unexpected module
 179  * in DB, its effect is returning a list of module not installed in DB but
 180  * present on server, or module installed in DB but not present on server.
 181  * @return an array two arrays :
 182  *            ['folder'] containing paths of the suspicious folders found that
 183  *                       did not correspond to an installed module in DB
 184  *            ['DB']     containing label of modules found in DB for which no
 185  *                       corresponding folder was found on server
 186  */
 187 function check_module_repositories()
 188 {
 189     $mistake_array           = array();
 190     $mistake_array['folder'] = array();
 191     $mistake_array['DB']     = array();
 192 
 193     $registredModuleList = get_installed_module_list();
 194 
 195     foreach ($registredModuleList as $registredModuleLabel)
 196     {
 197         $modulePath = get_module_path($registredModuleLabel);
 198 
 199         if ( !file_exists($modulePath) )
 200         {
 201             $mistake_array['DB'][] = $registredModuleLabel;
 202         }
 203     }
 204 
 205     $folders_found = get_module_repositories();
 206 
 207     foreach ($folders_found as $module_folder)
 208     {
 209         if (!in_array($module_folder,$registredModuleList))
 210         {
 211             $mistake_array['folder'][] = $module_folder;
 212         }
 213     }
 214 
 215     return $mistake_array;
 216 }
