 221 /**
 222  * Unzip a module package archive and get the path of the unzipped files
 223  * @todo split this function and use unzip_package()
 224  * @todo remove the need of the Backlog and use Exceptions instead
 225  * @return string
 226  */
 227 function get_and_unzip_uploaded_package()
 228 {
 229     $backlog_message = array();
 230 
 231     //Check if the file is valid (not to big and exists)
 232 
 233     if( !isset($_FILES['uploadedModule'])
 234     || !is_uploaded_file($_FILES['uploadedModule']['tmp_name']))
 235     {
 236         $backlog_message[] = get_lang('Upload failed');
 237     }
 238     
 239     require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../thirdparty/pclzip/pclzip.lib.php';
 240 
 241     if (!function_exists('gzopen'))
 242     {
 243         $backlog_message[] = get_lang('Error : no zlib extension found');
 244         return claro_failure::set_failure($backlog_message);
 245     }
 246 
 247     //unzip files
 248     
 249     
 250     // $moduleRepositorySys is the place where go the installed module
 251     // $uploadDirFullPath is a temporary name of the dir in $moduleRepositorySys the module is unpack
 252     // $uploadDirFullPath would be renamed to $modulePath when install is done.
 253     
 254     $moduleRepositorySys = get_path('rootSys') . 'module/';
 255     //create temp dir for upload
 256     claro_mkdir($moduleRepositorySys, CLARO_FILE_PERMISSIONS, true);
 257     $uploadDirFullPath = claro_mkdir_tmp($moduleRepositorySys);
 258     $uploadDir         = str_replace(realpath($moduleRepositorySys),'',realpath($uploadDirFullPath));
 259     $modulePath        = realpath($moduleRepositorySys.$uploadDir.'/');
 260 
 261     //1- Unzip folder in a new repository in claroline/module
 262 
 263     // treat_uploaded_file : Executes all the necessary operation to upload the file in the document tool
 264     // TODO this function would be splited.
 265     
 266     if ( preg_match('/.zip$/i', $_FILES['uploadedModule']['name'])
 267       && treat_uploaded_file( $_FILES['uploadedModule']
 268                             , $moduleRepositorySys
 269                             , $uploadDir
 270                             , get_conf('maxFilledSpaceForModule' , 20000000)
 271                             , 'unzip'
 272                             , true)
 273                             )
 274     {
 275         $backlog_message[] = get_lang('Files dezipped sucessfully in %path', array ('%path' => $modulePath )) ;
 276     }
 277     else
 278     {
 279         $backlog_message[] = get_lang('Impossible to unzip file');
 280         claro_delete_file($modulePath);
 281         return claro_failure::set_failure($backlog_message);
 282     }
 283     
 284     return $modulePath;
 285 }
 286 
 287 /**
 288  * Unzip the module package
 289  * @param string $packageFileName
 290  * @return string module path
 291  * @todo use this function in get_and_unzip_uploaded_package()
 292  * @todo remove the need of the Backlog and use Exceptions instead
 293  */
 294 function unzip_package( $packageFileName )
 295 {
 296     $backlog_message = array();
 297 
 298     //1- Unzip folder in a new repository in claroline/module
 299     require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../thirdparty/pclzip/pclzip.lib.php';
 300     
 301     if (!function_exists('gzopen'))
 302     {
 303         $backlog_message[] = get_lang('Error : no zlib extension found');
 304         return claro_failure::set_failure($backlog_message);
 305     }
 306 
 307         //unzip files
 308 
 309     $moduleRepositorySys = get_path('rootSys') . 'module/';
 310     //create temp dir for upload
 311     claro_mkdir($moduleRepositorySys, CLARO_FILE_PERMISSIONS, true);
 312     $uploadDirFullPath = claro_mkdir_tmp($moduleRepositorySys);
 313     $uploadDir         = str_replace($moduleRepositorySys,'',$uploadDirFullPath);
 314     $modulePath        = $moduleRepositorySys.$uploadDir.'/';
 315     
 316     if ( preg_match('/.zip$/i', $packageFileName)
 317       && treat_secure_file_unzip($packageFileName, $uploadDir, $moduleRepositorySys, get_conf('maxFilledSpaceForModule' , 10000000),true))
 318     {
 319         $backlog_message[] = get_lang('Files dezipped sucessfully in %path', array ('%path' => $modulePath )) ;
 320     }
 321     else
 322     {
 323         $backlog_message[] = get_lang('Impossible to unzip file');
 324         claro_delete_file($modulePath);
 325         return claro_failure::set_failure($backlog_message);
 326     }
 327     return $modulePath;
 328 }

 330 function generate_module_names_translation_cache()
 331 {
 332     $cacheRepositorySys = get_path('rootSys') . get_conf('cacheRepository', 'tmp/cache/');
 333     $moduleLangCache = $cacheRepositorySys . 'module_lang_cache';
 334 
 335     if ( ! file_exists($moduleLangCache) )
 336     {
 337         claro_mkdir( $moduleLangCache, CLARO_FILE_PERMISSIONS, true );
 338     }
 339 
 340     $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 341     $sql = "SELECT `name`, `label`
 342               FROM `" . $tbl['module'] . "`
 343              WHERE activation = 'activated'";
 344 
 345     $module_list = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 346 
 347     $langVars = array();
 348 
 349     foreach ( $module_list as $module )
 350     {
 351         $langPath = get_module_path( $module['label'] ).'/lang/';
 352 
 353         if ( file_exists( $langPath ) )
 354         {
 355             $it = new DirectoryIterator( $langPath );
 356 
 357             foreach ( $it as $file )
 358             {
 359                 if ( $file->isFile()
 360                     && preg_match('/^lang_\w+.php$/', $file->getFilename() ) )
 361                 {
 362                     $langName = str_replace( 'lang_', '', $file->getFilename() );
 363                     $langName = str_replace( '.php', '', $langName );
 364 
 365                     if ( $langName != 'english' )
 366                     {
 367                         pushClaroMessage( $langName . ':' . $module['label'], 'debug');
 368 
 369                         $_lang = array();
 370 
 371                         ob_start();
 372                         include $file->getPathname();
 373                         ob_end_clean();
 374 
 375                         if ( ! isset( $langVars[$langName] ) )
 376                         {
 377                             $langVars[$langName] = '';
 378                         }
 379 
 380                         if ( isset($_lang[$module['name']]) )
 381                         {
 382                             $langVars[$langName] .= '$_lang[\''.$module['name'].'\'] = \''.str_replace( "'", "\\'", $_lang[ $module['name'] ]).'\';'."\n";
 383                         }
 384                     }
 385                 }
 386             }
 387         }
 388     }
 389 
 390     foreach ( $langVars as $lgnNm => $contents )
 391     {
 392         $langFile = $moduleLangCache . '/'.$lgnNm.'.lang.php';
 393 
 394         if ( file_exists( $langFile ) )
 395         {
 396             unlink( $langFile );
 397         }
 398 
 399         file_put_contents( $langFile, "<?php\n".$contents );
 400     }
 401 }

 403 /**
 404  * Generate the cache php file with the needed include of activated module of the platform.
 405  * @return boolean true if succeed, false on failure
 406  */
 407 function generate_module_cache()
 408 {
 409 
 410     $module_cache_filename = get_conf('module_cache_filename','moduleCache.inc.php');
 411     $cacheRepositorySys = get_path('rootSys') . get_conf('cacheRepository', 'tmp/cache/');
 412     $module_cache_filepath = $cacheRepositorySys . $module_cache_filename;
 413 
 414     if ( ! file_exists( $cacheRepositorySys ) )
 415     {
 416         claro_mkdir($cacheRepositorySys, CLARO_FILE_PERMISSIONS, true);
 417     }
 418 
 419     $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 420     $sql = "SELECT `label`
 421               FROM `" . $tbl['module'] . "`
 422              WHERE activation = 'activated'";
 423 
 424     $module_list = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
 425 
 426     if (file_exists($cacheRepositorySys) && is_writable($cacheRepositorySys))
 427     {
 428         if ( file_exists( $module_cache_filepath ) && ! is_writable( $module_cache_filepath ) )
 429         {
 430             return claro_failure::set_failure('cannot write to cache file ' . $module_cache_filepath);
 431         }
 432         else
 433         {
 434             if ( false !== ( $handle = fopen($module_cache_filepath, 'w') ) )
 435             {
 436                 $cache = '<?php #auto created by claroline modify it at your own risks'."\n";
 437                 $cache .= 'if (count( get_included_files() ) == 1) die();'."\n";
 438                 $cache .= "\n" . '# ---- start of cache ----'."\n\n";
 439 
 440                 foreach($module_list as $module)
 441                 {
 442                     $functionsFilePath = get_module_path($module['label']) . '/functions.php';
 443 
 444                     if (file_exists( $functionsFilePath ))
 445                     {
 446                         $cache .= '# ' . $module['label'] . "\n" ;
 447                         $cache .= 'if (file_exists(get_module_path("'.addslashes($module['label']).'")."/functions.php") ){' . "\n";
 448                         $cache .= 'set_current_module_label("'.addslashes($module['label']).'");' . "\n";
 449                         $cache .= 'load_module_config("'.addslashes($module['label']).'");' . "\n";
 450                         $cache .= 'language::load_module_translation("'.addslashes($module['label']).'","'.language::current_language().'");' . "\n";
 451                         $cache .= 'require get_module_path("'.addslashes($module['label']).'")."/functions.php";' . "\n";
 452                         $cache .= 'clear_current_module_label();'. "\n";
 453                         $cache .= '}' . "\n";
 454                     }
 455                 }
 456 
 457                 $cache .= "\n";
 458 
 459                 fwrite( $handle, $cache );
 460                 fclose( $handle );
 461             }
 462             else
 463             {
 464                 return claro_failure::set_failure('Cannot open path %path', array('%path'=> $module_cache_filepath));
 465             }
 466         }
 467     }
 468     else
 469     {
 470         // FIXME E_USER_ERROR instead of E_USER_NOTICE
 471         return claro_failure::set_failure('Directory %directory is not writable', array('%directory' => $cacheRepositorySys) );
 472     }
 473 
 474     generate_module_names_translation_cache();
 475 
 476     return true;
 477 }

 479 /**
 480  * Install a specific module to the platform
 481  * @param string $modulePath path to the module
 482  * @param bool $skipCheckDir skip checking if module directory already exists (default false)
 483  * @return array( backlog, int )
 484  *      backlog object containing the messages
 485  *      int moduleId if the install process suceeded, false otherwise
 486  * @todo remove the need of the Backlog and use Exceptions instead
 487  */
 488 function install_module($modulePath, $skipCheckDir = false, $registerModuleInCourses = false )
 489 {
 490     $backlog = new Backlog;
 491     $moduleId = false;
 492 
 493     if (false === ($module_info = readModuleManifest($modulePath)))
 494     {
 495         claro_delete_file($modulePath);
 496         $backlog->failure( claro_failure::get_last_failure() );
 497     }
 498     else
 499     {
 500         //check if a module with the same LABEL is already installed, if yes, we cancel everything
 501         // TODO extract from install function should be tested BEFORE calling install_module
 502         if ( (!$skipCheckDir) && check_name_exist(get_module_path($module_info['LABEL']) . '/'))
 503         {
 504             $backlog->failure( get_lang('Module %module is already installed on your platform'
 505                 , array('%module'=>$module_info['LABEL'])));
 506             // claro_delete_file($modulePath);
 507             // TODO : add code to point on existing instance of tool.
 508             // TODO : how to overwrite . prupose uninstall ?
 509         }
 510         else
 511         {
 512             //3- Save the module information into DB
 513             if ( false === ( $moduleId = register_module_core($module_info) ) )
 514             {
 515                 claro_delete_file($modulePath);
 516                 $backlog->failure(claro_failure::get_last_failure());
 517                 $backlog->failure( get_lang('Module registration failed') );
 518             }
 519             else
 520             {
 521                 //in case of tool type module, the dock can not be selected and must added also now
 522 
 523                 if ('tool' == $module_info['TYPE'])
 524                 {
 525                     // TODO FIXME handle failure
 526                     register_module_tool($moduleId,$module_info);
 527                 }
 528 
 529                 if (array_key_exists('DEFAULT_DOCK',$module_info))
 530                 {
 531                     foreach($module_info['DEFAULT_DOCK'] as $dock)
 532                     {
 533                         // TODO FIXME handle failure
 534                         add_module_in_dock($moduleId, $dock);
 535                     }
 536                 }
 537 
 538                 //4- Rename the module repository with label
 539                 $currentPlace = realpath($modulePath) . '/';
 540                 $destPath = get_module_path( $module_info['LABEL'] );
 541                 claro_mkdir(get_path('rootSys') . 'module/', CLARO_FILE_PERMISSIONS, true);
 542                 if (!@rename( $currentPlace , $destPath ))
 543                 {
 544                    $backlog->failure(get_lang("Error while renaming module folder").
 545                    ' from:' . $currentPlace  .
 546                    ' to:' . $destPath
 547                    );
 548                 }
 549                 else
 550                 {
 551                     // force access rights on module root dir after rename() because some modules written on M$ Win$#!t are causing issues
 552                     chmod( $destPath,CLARO_FILE_PERMISSIONS );
 553                     
 554                     //5-Include the local 'install.sql' and 'install.php' file of the module if they exist
 555                     if ( isset( $installSqlScript ) ) unset ( $installSqlScript );
 556                     $installSqlScript = get_module_path( $module_info['LABEL'] ) . '/setup/install.sql';
 557 
 558                     if (file_exists( $installSqlScript ) )
 559                     {
 560                         $sql = file_get_contents( $installSqlScript );
 561 
 562                         if (!empty($sql))
 563                         {
 564                             $sql = str_replace ('__CL_MAIN__',get_conf('mainTblPrefix'), $sql);
 565 
 566                             if ( claro_sql_multi_query($sql) === false )
 567                             {
 568                                 $backlog->failure(get_lang( 'Sql installation query failed' ));
 569                             }
 570                             else
 571                             {
 572                                 $backlog->failure(get_lang( 'Sql installation query succeeded' ));
 573                             }
 574                         }
 575                     }
 576                     
 577                     // generate the conf if a def file exists
 578                     if ( file_exists( get_module_path($module_info['LABEL'])
 579                         . '/conf/def/'.$module_info['LABEL'].'.def.conf.inc.php' ) )
 580                     {
 581                         require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../config.lib.inc.php';
 582                         $config = new Config($module_info['LABEL']);
 583                         list ($confMessage, $status ) = generate_conf($config);
 584 
 585                         $backlog->info($confMessage);
 586                     }
 587 
 588                     // call install.php after initialising database in case it requires database to run
 589                     if ( isset( $installPhpScript ) ) unset ( $installPhpScript );
 590                     $installPhpScript = get_module_path($module_info['LABEL']) . '/setup/install.php';
 591 
 592                     if (file_exists($installPhpScript))
 593                     {
 594                         language::load_translation( );
 595                         language::load_locale_settings( );
 596                         language::load_module_translation( $module_info['LABEL'] );
 597                         load_module_config( $module_info['LABEL'] );
 598                         
 599                         // FIXME this is very dangerous !!!!
 600                         require $installPhpScript;
 601                         $backlog->info(get_lang( 'Module installation script called' ));
 602                     }
 603 
 604                     $moduleInfo =  get_module_info($moduleId);
 605 
 606                     if (($registerModuleInCourses && $moduleInfo['type'] =='tool') && $moduleId)
 607                     {
 608                         list ( $backlog2, $success2 ) = register_module_in_courses( $moduleId );
 609 
 610                         if ( $success2 )
 611                         {
 612                             $backlog->success( get_lang('Module installed in all courses') );
 613                         }
 614                         else
 615                         {
 616                             $backlog->append( $backlog2 );
 617                         }
 618                     }
 619 
 620                     //6- cache file with the module's include must be renewed after installation of the module
 621 
 622                     if ( ! generate_module_cache() )
 623                     {
 624                         $backlog->failure(get_lang( 'Module cache update failed' ));
 625                     }
 626                     else
 627                     {
 628                         $backlog->success(get_lang( 'Module cache update succeeded' ));
 629                     }
 630                 }
 631             }
 632         }
 633     }
 634 
 635     return array( $backlog, $moduleId );
 636 }

 638 /**
 639  * Activate a module, its effect is
 640  * - to call the activation script of the module (if there is any)
 641  * - to modify the information in the main DB
 642  * @param  integer $moduleId : ID of the module that must be activated
 643  * @return array( backlog, boolean )
 644  *      backlog object
 645  *      boolean true if the activation process suceeded, false otherwise
 646  */
 647 function activate_module($moduleId, $activateInAllCourses = false)
 648 {
 649     $success = true;
 650     $backlog1 = new Backlog;
 651     // find module informations
 652 
 653     $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 654     $moduleInfo =  get_module_info($moduleId);
 655 
 656     list( $backlog2, $success ) = activate_module_in_platform($moduleId);
 657     
 658     if( ! $success )
 659     {
 660         return array( $backlog2, $success );
 661     }
 662     
 663     $backlog1->append($backlog2);
 664     
 665     if ( $activateInAllCourses && $moduleInfo['type'] == 'tool' /*&& $moduleInfo['activateInCourses'] == 'AUTOMATIC'*/ )
 666     {
 667         // FIXME : ONLY WHEN INSTALLING A MODULE !
 668         if ( activate_module_in_all_courses( $moduleInfo['label'] ) )
 669         {
 670             $success = true;
 671             $backlog1->success( get_lang('Module activation in courses succeeded'));
 672         }
 673         else
 674         {
 675             $success = false;
 676             $backlog1->failure( get_lang('Module activation in courses failed'));
 677         }
 678     }
 679 
 680     return array( $backlog1, $success );
 681 }

 816 /**
 817  * Uninstall a specific module to the platform
 818  *
 819  * @param integer $moduleId the id of the module to uninstall
 820  * @return array( backlog, boolean )
 821  *      backlog object
 822  *      boolean true if the uninstall process suceeded, false otherwise
 823  * @todo remove the need of the Backlog and use Exceptions instead
 824  */
 825 function uninstall_module($moduleId, $deleteModuleData = true)
 826 {
 827     $success = true;
 828     $backlog = new Backlog;
 829 
 830     //first thing to do : deactivate the module
 831 
 832     // deactivate_module($moduleId);
 833     $moduleInfo =  get_module_info($moduleId);
 834     if ( ($moduleInfo['type'] =='tool') && $moduleId )
 835     {
 836 
 837         // 2- delete the module in the cours_tool table, used for every course creation
 838 
 839         list ( $backlog2, $success2 ) = unregister_module_from_courses( $moduleId );
 840 
 841         if ( $success2 )
 842         {
 843             $backlog->success( get_lang('Module uninstalled in all courses') );
 844         }
 845         else
 846         {
 847             $backlog->append( $backlog2 );
 848         }
 849     }
 850 
 851     //Needed tables and vars
 852 
 853     $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 854 
 855     $backlog = new Backlog;
 856 
 857     // 0- find info about the module to uninstall
 858 
 859     $sql = "SELECT `label`
 860               FROM `" . $tbl['module'] . "`
 861              WHERE `id` = " . (int) $moduleId;
 862 
 863     $module = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
 864 
 865     if ( $module == false )
 866     {
 867         $backlog->failure(get_lang("No module to uninstall"));
 868         $success = false;
 869     }
 870     else
 871     {
 872         // 1- Include the local 'uninstall.sql' and 'uninstall.php' file of the module if they exist
 873 
 874         // call uninstall.php first in case it requires module database schema to run
 875         if ( isset( $uninstallPhpScript ) ) unset ( $uninstallPhpScript );
 876         $uninstallPhpScript = get_module_path($module['label']) . '/setup/uninstall.php';
 877         if (file_exists( $uninstallPhpScript ))
 878         {
 879             language::load_translation( );
 880             language::load_locale_settings( );
 881             language::load_module_translation( $module['label'] );
 882             load_module_config( $module['label'] );
 883             
 884             require $uninstallPhpScript;
 885             
 886             $backlog->info( get_lang('Module uninstallation script called') );
 887         }
 888 
 889         if ( isset( $uninstallSqlScript ) ) unset ( $uninstallSqlScript );
 890         $uninstallSqlScript = get_module_path($module['label']) . '/setup/uninstall.sql';
 891         
 892         if ($deleteModuleData && file_exists( $uninstallSqlScript ))
 893         {
 894             $sql = file_get_contents( $uninstallSqlScript );
 895             if (!empty($sql))
 896             {
 897                 $sql = str_replace ('__CL_MAIN__',get_conf('mainTblPrefix'), $sql);
 898 
 899                 if ( false !== claro_sql_multi_query($sql) )
 900                 {
 901                     $backlog->success(get_lang( 'Database uninstallation succeeded' ));
 902                 }
 903                 else
 904                 {
 905                     $backlog->failure(get_lang( 'Database uninstallation failed' ));
 906                     $success = false;
 907                 }
 908             }
 909         }
 910         elseif ( ! $deleteModuleData && file_exists( $uninstallSqlScript ) )
 911         {
 912             $backlog->info(get_lang( 'Database uninstallation skipped' ));
 913         }
 914 
 915         // 2- delete related files and folders
 916 
 917         $modulePath = get_module_path($module['label']);
 918 
 919         if ( file_exists($modulePath) )
 920         {
 921             if(claro_delete_file($modulePath))
 922             {
 923                 $backlog->success( get_lang('Delete scripts of the module') );
 924             }
 925             else
 926             {
 927                 $backlog->failure( get_lang('Error while deleting the scripts of the module') );
 928                 $success = false;
 929             }
 930         }
 931 
 932         //  delete the module in the cours_tool table, used for every course creation
 933 
 934         //retrieve this module_id first
 935 
 936         $sql = "SELECT id as tool_id FROM `" . $tbl['tool']."`
 937                 WHERE claro_label = '".$module['label']."'";
 938         $tool_to_delete = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
 939         $tool_id = $tool_to_delete['tool_id'];
 940 
 941 
 942         $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl['tool']."`
 943                 WHERE claro_label = '".$module['label']."'
 944             ";
 945 
 946         claro_sql_query($sql);
 947 
 948         // 3- delete related entries in main DB
 949 
 950         $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl['module'] . "`
 951                 WHERE `id` = ". (int) $moduleId;
 952         claro_sql_query($sql);
 953 
 954         $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl['module_info'] . "`
 955                 WHERE `module_id` = " . (int) $moduleId;
 956         claro_sql_query($sql);
 957         
 958         $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl['module_contexts'] . "`
 959                 WHERE `module_id` = " . (int) $moduleId;
 960         claro_sql_query($sql);
 961 
 962         // 4-Manage right - Delete read action
 963         $action = new RightToolAction();
 964         $action->setName('read');
 965         $action->setToolId($tool_id);
 966         $action->delete();
 967 
 968         // Manage right - Delete edit action
 969         $action = new RightToolAction();
 970         $action->setName('edit');
 971         $action->setToolId($tool_id);
 972         $action->delete();
 973 
 974         // 5- remove all docks entries in which the module displays
 975         // TODO FIXME handle failure
 976         remove_module_dock($moduleId, 'ALL');
 977 
 978         // 6- cache file with the module's include must be renewed after uninstallation of the module
 979 
 980         if ( ! generate_module_cache() )
 981         {
 982             $backlog->failure(get_lang( 'Module cache update failed' ));
 983             $success = false;
 984         }
 985         else
 986         {
 987             $backlog->success(get_lang( 'Module cache update succeeded' ));
 988         }
 989     }
 990 
 991     return array( $backlog, $success );
 992 
 993 }

 995 /**
 996  * Register module in all courses
 997  * @param int $moduleId
 998  * @return array( backlog, boolean )
 999  *      backlog object
1000  *      boolean true if suceeded, false otherwise
1001  * @todo remove the need of the Backlog and use Exceptions instead
1002  */
1003 function register_module_in_courses( $moduleId )
1004 {
1005     $backlog = new Backlog;
1006     $success = true;
1007     // TODO : remove fields script_url, claro_label, def_access, access_manager
1008     // TODO : rename def_rank to rank

1217 // MODULE REGISTRATION FUNCTIONS
1218 
1219 /**
1220  * Add module in claroline, giving  its path
1221  *
1222  * @param string $modulePath
1223  * @return int module id or false
1224  * @todo remove the need of the Backlog and use Exceptions instead
1225  */
1226 function register_module($modulePath)
1227 {
1228     $backlog = new Backlog;
1229     if (file_exists($modulePath))
1230     {
1231         /*$parser = new ModuleManifestParser;
1232         $module_info = $parser->parse($modulePath.'/manifest.xml');*/
1233         
1234         $module_info = readModuleManifest( $modulePath );
1235         
1236         if ( false === $module_info )
1237         {
1238             $backlog->failure(get_lang( 'Cannot parse module manifest'));
1239             
1240             $moduleId = false;
1241         }
1242         elseif ( is_array($module_info)
1243             && false !== ($moduleId = register_module_core($module_info)) )
1244         {
1245             $backlog->failure(get_lang('Module %claroLabel registered',
1246                 array('%claroLabel'=>$module_info['LABEL'])));
1247             
1248             if('TOOL' == strtoupper($module_info['TYPE']))
1249             {
1250                 if (false !== ($toolId   = register_module_tool($moduleId,$module_info)))
1251                 {
1252                     $backlog->failure(get_lang('Module %label registered as tool', array('%claroLabel'=>$module_info['LABEL'])));
1253             
1254                 }
1255                 else
1256                 {
1257                     $backlog->failure( get_lang('Cannot register tool %label', array('%label' => $module_info['LABEL'])));
1258                 }
1259             }
1260             elseif('APPLET' == strtoupper($module_info['TYPE']))
1261             {
1262                 if ( array_key_exists('DEFAULT_DOCK',$module_info)
1263                     && is_array($module_info['DEFAULT_DOCK']) )
1264                 {
1265                     foreach ( $module_info['DEFAULT_DOCK'] as $dock )
1266                     {
1267                         add_module_in_dock($moduleId, $dock);
1268                             $backlog->failure(get_lang('Module %label added in dock : %dock'
1269                             , array('%label' => $module_info['LABEL'], '%dock' => $dock)));
1270                         
1271                     }
1272                 }
1273             }
1274         }
1275         else
1276         {
1277             $backlog->failure(get_lang('Cannot register module %label', array('%label' => $module_info['LABEL'])));
1278         }
1279     }
1280     else
1281     {
1282         $backlog->failure(get_lang('Cannot find module'));
1283     }
1284 
1285     return $moduleId;
1286 }
1287 
1288 /**
1289  * Add common info about a module in main module registry.
1290  * In Claroline this  info is split in two type of info
1291  * into two tables :
1292  * * module  for really use info,
1293  * * module_info for descriptive info
1294  *
1295  * @param array $module_info.
1296  * @return int moduleId in the registry.
1297  */
1298 function register_module_core($module_info)
1299 {
1300     $tbl             = claro_sql_get_tbl(array('module','module_info','tool','module_contexts'));
1301     $tbl_name        = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
1302 
1303     $missingElement = array_diff(array('LABEL','NAME','TYPE'),array_keys($module_info));
1304     if (count($missingElement)>0)
1305     {
1306         return claro_failure::set_failure(get_lang('Missing elements in module Manifest : %MissingElements' , array('%MissingElements' => implode(',',$missingElement))));
1307     }
1308     
1309     if (isset($module_info['ENTRY']))
1310     {
1311         $script_url = $module_info['ENTRY'];
1312     }
1313     else
1314     {
1315         $script_url = 'entry.php';
1316     }
1317 
1318     $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $tbl['module'] . "`
1319             SET label      = '" . claro_sql_escape($module_info['LABEL'      ]) . "',
1320                 name       = '" . claro_sql_escape($module_info['NAME']) . "',
1321                 type       = '" . claro_sql_escape($module_info['TYPE']) . "',
1322                 script_url = '" . claro_sql_escape($script_url)."'
1323                 ";
1324     $moduleId = claro_sql_query_insert_id($sql);
1325 
1326     $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $tbl['module_info'] . "`
1327             SET module_id      = " . (int) $moduleId . ",
1328                 version        = '" . claro_sql_escape($module_info['VERSION']) . "',
1329                 author         = '" . claro_sql_escape($module_info['AUTHOR']['NAME']) . "',
1330                 author_email   = '" . claro_sql_escape($module_info['AUTHOR']['EMAIL']) . "',
1331                 author_website = '" . claro_sql_escape($module_info['AUTHOR']['WEB']) . "',
1332                 website        = '" . claro_sql_escape($module_info['WEB']) . "',
1333                 description    = '" . claro_sql_escape($module_info['DESCRIPTION']) . "',
1334                 license        = '" . claro_sql_escape($module_info['LICENSE']) . "'";
1335     
1336     claro_sql_query($sql);
1337     
1338     foreach ( $module_info['CONTEXTS'] AS $context )
1339     {
1340         $sql = "INSERT INTO `{$tbl['module_contexts']}`\n"
1341             . "SET\n"
1342             . "  `module_id` = " . (int) $moduleId . ",\n"
1343             . "  `context` = '" . claro_sql_escape( $context ) . "'"
1344             ;
1345             
1346         claro_sql_query($sql);
1347     }
1348 
1349     return $moduleId;
1350 }
1351 
1352 /**
1353  * Store all unique info about a tool during install
1354  * @param integer $moduleId
1355  * @param array $moduleToolData, data from manifest
1356  * @return int tool id or false
1357  */
1358 
1359 function register_module_tool($moduleId,$module_info)
1360 {
1361     $tbl = claro_sql_get_tbl('course_tool');
1362 
1363     if ( is_array($module_info) )
1364     {
1365         $icon = array_key_exists('ICON',$module_info)
1366             ? "'" . claro_sql_escape($module_info['ICON']) . "'"
1367             : 'NULL'
1368             ;
1369 
1370         if ( !isset($module_info['ENTRY'])) $module_info['ENTRY'] = 'entry.php';
1371 
1372         // find max rank in the course_tool table
1373 
1374         $sql = "SELECT MAX(def_rank) AS maxrank FROM `" . $tbl['course_tool'] . "`";
1375         $maxresult = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
1376 
1377         // insert the new course tool
1378 
1379         $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $tbl['course_tool'] ."`
1380                 SET
1381                 claro_label = '". claro_sql_escape($module_info['LABEL']) ."',
1382                 script_url = '". claro_sql_escape($module_info['ENTRY']) ."',
1383                 icon = " . $icon . ",
1384                 def_access = 'ALL',
1385                 def_rank = (". (int) $maxresult['maxrank']."+1),
1386                 add_in_course = 'AUTOMATIC',
1387                 access_manager = 'COURSE_ADMIN' ";
1388 
1389         $tool_id = claro_sql_query_insert_id($sql);
1390 
1391         // Init action/right
1392 
1393         // Manage right - Add read action
1394         $action = new RightToolAction();
1395         $action->setName('read');
1396         $action->setToolId($tool_id);
1397         $action->save();
1398 
1399         // Manage right - Add edit action
1400         $action = new RightToolAction();
1401         $action->setName('edit');
1402         $action->setToolId($tool_id);
1403         $action->save();
1404 
1405         // Init all profile/right
1406 
1407         $profileList = array_keys(claro_get_all_profile_name_list());
1408 
1409         foreach ( $profileList as $profileId )
1410         {
1411             $profile = new RightProfile();
1412             $profile->load($profileId);
1413             
1414             $profileRight = new RightProfileToolRight();
1415             $profileRight->load($profile);
1416             
1417             if ( claro_get_profile_id('manager') == $profileId )
1418             {
1419                 $profileRight->setToolRight($tool_id,'manager');
1420             }
1421             else
1422             {
1423                 $profileRight->setToolRight($tool_id,'user');
1424             }
1425             
1426             $profileRight->save();
1427         }
1428 
1429         return $tool_id;
1430     }
1431     else
1432     {
1433         return false ;
1434     }
1435 }

1437 // MODULE DOCK MANAGEMENT FUNCTIONS
1438 
1439 /**
1440  * Set the dock in which the module displays its content
1441  * @param integer $moduleId id of the module to rename
1442  * @param string $newDockName new name  for the doc
1443  * @return boolean
1444  */
1445 function add_module_in_dock( $moduleId, $newDockName )
1446 {
1447     $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
1448 
1449     //find info about this module occurence in this dock in the DB
1450 
1451     $sql = "SELECT D.`name`      AS dockname,
1452                    D.`rank`      AS oldRank
1453             FROM `" . $tbl['module'] . "` AS M
1454                , `" . $tbl['dock']   . "` AS D
1455             WHERE M.`id` = D.`module_id`
1456             AND M.`id` = " . (int) $moduleId . "
1457             AND D.`name` = '" . $newDockName . "'";
1458     $module = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
1459 
1460     //if the module is already in the dock ,we just do nothing and return true.
1461 
1462     if (isset($module['dockname']) && $module['dockname'] == $newDockName)
1463     {
1464         return true;
1465     }
1466     else
1467     {
1468         //find the highest rank already used in the new dock
1469         $max_rank = get_max_rank_in_dock($newDockName);
1470         // the module is not already in this dock, we just insert it into this in the DB
1471 
1472         $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $tbl['dock'] . "`
1473                 SET module_id = " . (int) $moduleId . ",
1474                     name    = '" . claro_sql_escape($newDockName) . "',
1475                     rank    = " . ((int) $max_rank + 1) ;
1476         $result = claro_sql_query($sql);
1477 
1478         // TODO FIXME handle failure
1479         generate_module_cache();
1480 
1481         return $result;
1482     }
1483 }
1484 
1485 /**
1486  * Remove a module from a dock in which the module displays
1487  * @param integer $moduleId
1488  * @param string  $dockName
1489  */
1490 
1491 function remove_module_dock($moduleId, $dockName)
1492 {
1493     $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
1494 
1495     // call of this function to remove ALL occurence of the module in any dock
1496 
1497     if ('ALL' == $dockName)
1498     {
1499         //1- find all dock in which the dock displays
1500 
1501         $sql="SELECT `name` AS dockName
1502               FROM   `" . $tbl['dock'] . "`
1503               WHERE  `module_id` = " . (int) $moduleId;
1504 
1505         $dockList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
1506 
1507         //2- re-call of this function which each dock concerned
1508 
1509         foreach($dockList as $dock)
1510         {
1511             remove_module_dock($moduleId,$dock['dockName']);
1512         }
1513     }
1514     else //call of this function to remove ONE SPECIFIC occurence of the module in the dock
1515     {
1516         //find the rank of the module in this dock :
1517 
1518         $sql = "SELECT `rank` AS oldRank
1519                 FROM   `" . $tbl['dock'] . "`
1520                 WHERE  `module_id` = " . (int) $moduleId . "
1521                 AND    `name` = '" .$dockName . "'";
1522         $module = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
1523 
1524         //move up all modules displayed in this dock
1525 
1526         $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl['dock'] . "`
1527                 SET `rank` = `rank` - 1
1528                 WHERE `name` = '" . $dockName . "'
1529                 AND `rank` > " . (int) $module['oldRank'];
1530         claro_sql_query($sql);
1531 
1532         //delete the module line in the dock table
1533 
1534         $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl['dock'] . "`
1535                 WHERE `module_id` = " . (int) $moduleId. "
1536                 AND   `name` = '" . $dockName . "'";
1537         claro_sql_query($sql);
1538 
1539         generate_module_cache();
1540     }
1541 }
1542 
1543 /**
1544  * Move a module inside its dock (change its position in the display
1545  * @param integer $moduleId
1546  * @param string $dockName
1547  * @param string $direction 'up' or 'down'
1548  */
1549 
1550 function move_module_in_dock($moduleId, $dockName, $direction)
1551 {
1552     $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
1553 
1554     switch ($direction)
1555     {
1556         case 'up' :
1557         {
1558             //1-find value of current module rank in the dock
1559             $sql = "SELECT `rank`
1560                     FROM `" . $tbl['dock'] . "`
1561                     WHERE `module_id`=" . (int) $moduleId . "
1562                     AND `name`='" . claro_sql_escape($dockName) . "'";
1563             $result=claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sql);
1564 
1565             //2-move down above module
1566             $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl['dock'] . "`
1567                     SET `rank` = `rank`+1
1568                     WHERE `module_id` != " . (int) $moduleId . "
1569                     AND `name`       = '" . claro_sql_escape($dockName) . "'
1570                     AND `rank`       = " . (int) $result['rank'] . " -1 ";
1571 
1572             claro_sql_query($sql);
1573 
1574             //3-move up current module
1575             $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl['dock'] . "`
1576                     SET `rank` = `rank`-1
1577                     WHERE `module_id` = " . (int) $moduleId . "
1578                     AND `name`      = '" .  claro_sql_escape($dockName) . "'
1579                     AND `rank` > 1"; // this last condition is to avoid wrong update due to a page refreshment
1580             claro_sql_query($sql);
1581 
1582             break;
1583         }
1584         case 'down' :
1585         {
1586             //1-find value of current module rank in the dock
1587             $sql = "SELECT `rank`
1588                     FROM `" . $tbl['dock'] . "`
1589                     WHERE `module_id`=" . (int) $moduleId . "
1590                     AND `name`='" . claro_sql_escape($dockName) . "'";
1591             $result=claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sql);
1592 
1593             //this second query is to avoid a page refreshment wrong update
1594 
1595             $sqlmax= "SELECT MAX(`rank`) AS `max_rank`
1596                       FROM `" . $tbl['dock'] . "`
1597                       WHERE `name`='" .  claro_sql_escape($dockName) . "'";
1598             $resultmax=claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sqlmax);
1599 
1600             if ($resultmax['max_rank'] == $result['rank']) break;
1601 
1602             //2-move up above module
1603             $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl['dock'] . "`
1604                     SET `rank` = `rank` - 1
1605                     WHERE `module_id` != " . $moduleId . "
1606                     AND `name` = '" . claro_sql_escape($dockName) . "'
1607                     AND `rank` = " . (int) $result['rank'] . " + 1
1608                     AND `rank` > 1";
1609             claro_sql_query($sql);
1610 
1611             //3-move down current module
1612             $sql = "UPDATE `" . $tbl['dock'] . "`
1613                     SET `rank` = `rank` + 1
1614                     WHERE `module_id`=" . (int) $moduleId . "
1615                     AND `name`='" .  claro_sql_escape($dockName) . "'";
1616             claro_sql_query($sql);
1617 
1618             break;
1619         }
1620     }
1621     // TODO FIXME handle failure
1622     generate_module_cache();
1623 }
1624 
1625 /**
1626  * Function used by the SAX xml parser when the parser meets a opening tag
1627  * @param tring $dockName the dock from which we want this info
1628  * @return int the max rank used for this dock
1629  *
1630  */
1631 function get_max_rank_in_dock($dockName)
1632 {
1633     $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
1634 
1635 
1636     $sql = "SELECT MAX(rank) AS mrank
1637             FROM `" . $tbl['dock'] . "` AS D
1638             WHERE D . `name` = '" . claro_sql_escape($dockName) . "'";
1639     $max_rank = claro_sql_query_get_single_value($sql);
1640     return (int) $max_rank;
1641 }

1643 /**
1644  * Return list of dock where a module is docked

1701 // COURSE TOOL RANK MANAGEMENT FUNCTIONS
1702 
1703 /**
1704  * Move the place of the module in the module list
1705  * (it changes the value of def_rank in the course_tool table)
1706  * @param $moduleId id of the module tool to move
1707  * @param $sense should either 'up' or 'down' to know in which direction the module has to move in the list
1708  */
1709 function move_module_tool($toolId, $sense)
1710 {
1711    $tbl_mdb_names        = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
1712    $tbl_tool_list        = $tbl_mdb_names['tool'];
1713 
1714    $current_rank = get_course_tool_rank($toolId);
1715 
1716    switch($sense)
1717    {
1718         case 'up':
1719         {
1720             $min_rank = get_course_tool_min_rank();
1721             if ($current_rank == $min_rank) //do not allow to move up if this is the first in the list
1722             {
1723                 return false;
1724             }
1725             else
1726             {
1727                 $before_rank = get_before_course_tool($current_rank);
1728 
1729                 //SWAP the two ranks
1730 
1731                 $sql = "UPDATE `".$tbl_tool_list."`
1732                         SET def_rank = '".$current_rank."' WHERE def_rank = '".$before_rank."'";
1733                 claro_sql_query($sql);
1734 
1735                 $sql = "UPDATE `".$tbl_tool_list."`
1736                         SET def_rank = '".$before_rank."' WHERE id = '".$toolId."'";
1737                 claro_sql_query($sql);
1738 
1739             }
1740         }
1741         break;
1742 
1743         case 'down':
1744         {
1745             $max_rank = get_course_tool_max_rank();
1746             if ($current_rank == $max_rank) //do not allow to move down if this is the last in the list
1747             {
1748                 return false;
1749             }
1750             else
1751             {
1752                 $next_rank = get_next_course_tool($current_rank);
1753 
1754                 //SWAP the two ranks
1755 
1756                 $sql = "UPDATE `".$tbl_tool_list."`
1757                         SET def_rank = ".$current_rank." WHERE def_rank = ".$next_rank;
1758                 claro_sql_query($sql);
1759 
1760                 $sql = "UPDATE `".$tbl_tool_list."`
1761                         SET def_rank = ".$next_rank." WHERE id = ".$toolId;
1762                 claro_sql_query($sql);
1763             }
1764         }
1765         break;
1766    }
1767    return true;
1768 }
1769

1900 /**
1901  * Change the activation status for the given tool in the given course
1902  * @param int $toolId main tool id
1903  * @param string $courseId
1904  * @param boolean $activated
1905  * @return boolean
1906  */
1907 function update_course_tool_activation_in_course( $toolId, $courseId, $activated )
1908 {
1909     if ( $activated && !course_tool_already_installed($toolId,$courseId) )
1910     {
1911         $tLabel = get_module_label_from_tool_id( $toolId );
1912 
1913         if ( $tLabel )
1914         {
1915             if ( ! is_tool_registered_in_course( $toolId, $courseId ) )
1916             {
1917                 register_module_in_single_course( $toolId, $courseId );
1918             }
1919             
1920             install_module_in_course( $tLabel, $courseId );
1921             update_tool_installation_in_course( $toolId, $courseId );
1922         }
1923     }
1924     
1925     $sql_activated = $activated ? "'true'" : "'false'";
1926     
1927     $tbl_cdb_names = claro_sql_get_course_tbl( claro_get_course_db_name_glued($courseId) );
1928     $tblCourseToolList = $tbl_cdb_names['tool'];
1929     
1930     $sql = "UPDATE `{$tblCourseToolList}`\n"
1931         . "SET `activated` = " . $sql_activated . "\n"
1932         . "WHERE tool_id = " . (int) $toolId
1933         ;
1934         
1935     if ( claro_sql_query( $sql ) )
1936     {
1937         return claro_sql_affected_rows();
1938     }
1939     else
1940     {
1941         false;
1942     }
1943 }

2074 /**
2075  * Get the count of modules by type.
2076  * @param bool $onlyActivated set to true to count only activated module 
2077  *      (default)
2078  * @return array [type => count]
2079  * @since Claroline 1.9.10, 1.10.7, 1.11
2080  */
2081 function count_modules_by_type( $onlyActivated = true )
2082 {
2083     $cnt = array();
2084     
2085     foreach ( get_available_module_types() as $moduleType )
2086     {
2087         $cnt[$moduleType] = 0;
2088     }
2089     
2090     $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
2091     
2092     if ( $onlyActivated )
2093     {
2094         $activation = "WHERE `activation` = 'activated'";
2095     }
2096     else
2097     {
2098         $activation = "WHERE 1 = 1";
2099     }
2100     
2101     $rs = Claroline::getDatabase()->query("
2102         SELECT 
2103             `type`,
2104             COUNT(*) AS `count`
2105         FROM 
2106             `{$tbl['module']}`
2107         {$activation}
2108         GROUP BY `type`" );
2109     
2110     foreach ( $rs as $moduleTypeCount )
2111     {
2112         $cnt[$moduleTypeCount['type']] = $moduleTypeCount['count'];
2113     }
2114     
2115     return $cnt;
2116 }

  17 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../backlog.class.php';
  18 
  19 /**
  20  *  Module manifest parser
  21  */
  22 class ModuleManifestParser
  23 {
  24     protected $elementPile;
  25     protected $moduleInfo;
  26     protected $backlog;
  27 
  28     public function __construct()
  29     {
  30         $this->backlog = new Backlog;
  31         $this->elementPile = array();
  32         $this->moduleInfo = array();
  33     }
  34 
  35     // TODO handle other module types
  36     /**
  37      *  Parse the manifest file given in argument
  38      *  @param   string manifestPath, path to the manifest file
  39      *  @return  bool false on failure, array moduleInfo on success
  40      */
  41     public function parse( $manifestPath )
  42     {
  43         // reset state
  44         $this->elementPile = array();
  45         $this->moduleInfo = array();
  46         
  47         $this->backlog->info( 'Parsing manifest file ' . $manifestPath );
  48         
  49         if ( !file_exists( $manifestPath ) )
  50         {
  51             $this->backlog->failure(
  52                   get_lang('Manifest missing : %filename'
  53                 , array('%filename' => $manifestPath)));
  54             return false;
  55         }
  56 
  57         $xmlParser = xml_parser_create();
  58 
  59         xml_set_element_handler(
  60               $xmlParser
  61             , array(&$this, 'startElement')
  62             , array(&$this, 'endElement') );
  63 
  64         xml_set_character_data_handler(
  65               $xmlParser
  66             , array(&$this, 'elementData') );
  67 
  68         // read manifest file
  69 
  70         if ( false === ( $data = @file_get_contents( $manifestPath ) ) )
  71         {
  72             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Cannot open manifest file'));
  73             return false;
  74         }
  75         else
  76         {
  77             $this->backlog->debug('Manifest open : '.$manifestPath);
  78             $data = claro_html_entity_decode(urldecode($data));
  79         }
  80 
  81         if ( !xml_parse( $xmlParser, $data ) )
  82         {
  83             // if reading of the xml file in not successfull :
  84             // set errorFound, set error msg, break while statement
  85             $this->backlog->failure(get_lang('Error while parsing manifest'));
  86             return false;
  87         }
  88 
  89         // liberate parser ressources
  90         xml_parser_free( $xmlParser );
  91         
  92         // complete module info for missing optional elements
  93         
  94         if ( ! array_key_exists( 'ENTRY', $this->moduleInfo ) )
  95         {
  96             $this->moduleInfo['ENTRY'] = 'entry.php';
  97         }
  98         
  99         // Module License
 100         if ( ! array_key_exists( 'LICENSE', $this->moduleInfo ) )
 101         {
 102             $this->moduleInfo['LICENSE'] = '';
 103         }
 104         
 105         // Module version
 106         if ( ! array_key_exists( 'VERSION', $this->moduleInfo ) )
 107         {
 108             $this->moduleInfo['VERSION'] = '';
 109         }
 110         
 111         // Module description
 112         if ( ! array_key_exists( 'DESCRIPTION', $this->moduleInfo ) )
 113         {
 114             $this->moduleInfo['DESCRIPTION'] = '';
 115         }
 116         
 117         // Author informations
 118         if ( ! array_key_exists( 'AUTHOR', $this->moduleInfo ) )
 119         {
 120             $this->moduleInfo['AUTHOR'] = array();
 121         }
 122         
 123         // Author name
 124         if ( ! array_key_exists( 'NAME', $this->moduleInfo['AUTHOR'] ) )
 125         {
 126             $this->moduleInfo['AUTHOR']['NAME'] = '';
 127         }
 128         
 129         // Author email
 130         if ( ! array_key_exists( 'EMAIL', $this->moduleInfo['AUTHOR'] ) )
 131         {
 132             $this->moduleInfo['AUTHOR']['EMAIL'] = '';
 133         }
 134         
 135         // Author website
 136         if ( ! array_key_exists( 'WEB', $this->moduleInfo['AUTHOR'] ) )
 137         {
 138             $this->moduleInfo['AUTHOR']['WEB'] = '';
 139         }
 140         
 141         // Module website
 142         if ( ! array_key_exists( 'WEB', $this->moduleInfo ) )
 143         {
 144             $this->moduleInfo['WEB'] = '';
 145         }
 146         
 147         // Set default module context
 148         if ( ! array_key_exists( 'CONTEXTS', $this->moduleInfo )
 149             || empty($this->moduleInfo['CONTEXTS']) )
 150         {
 151             if ( strtoupper( $this->moduleInfo['TYPE'] ) == 'TOOL' )
 152             {
 153                 $this->moduleInfo['CONTEXTS'] = array('course');
 154             }
 155             else
 156             {
 157                 $this->moduleInfo['CONTEXTS'] = array('platform');
 158             }
 159         }
 160 
 161         return $this->moduleInfo;
 162     }
 163 
 164     /**
 165      *  SAX Parser Callback method : end of an element
 166      */
 167     public function endElement($parser,$name)
 168     {
 169         array_pop( $this->elementPile );
 170     }
 171 
 172     /**
 173      *  SAX Parser Callback method : start of an element
 174      */
 175     public function startElement($parser, $name, $attributes)
 176     {
 177         array_push( $this->elementPile, $name );
 178     }
 179 
 180     /**
 181      *  SAX Parser Callback method : data handler
 182      */
 183     public function elementData($parser,$data)
 184     {
 185         $currentElement = end( $this->elementPile );
 186 
 187         if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 188         {
 189             $this->backlog->debug( 'The metadata ' . $currentElement
 190                 . ' as been found with value ' . var_export($data,true) );
 191         }
 192 
 193         switch ( $currentElement )
 194         {
 195             case 'TYPE' :
 196             {
 197                 $this->moduleInfo['TYPE'] = $data;
 198                 break;
 199             }
 200             case 'DESCRIPTION' :
 201             {
 202                 $this->moduleInfo['DESCRIPTION'] = $data;
 203                 break;
 204             }
 205             case 'EMAIL':
 206             {
 207                 $parent = prev($this->elementPile);
 208                 switch ($parent)
 209                 {
 210                     case 'AUTHOR':
 211                     {
 212                         $this->moduleInfo['AUTHOR']['EMAIL'] = $data;
 213                         break;
 214                     }
 215                 }
 216                 break;
 217             }
 218             case 'LABEL':
 219             {
 220                 $this->moduleInfo['LABEL'] = $data;
 221                 break;
 222             }
 223             case 'ENTRY':
 224             {
 225                 $this->moduleInfo['ENTRY'] = $data;
 226                 break;
 227             }
 228             case 'LICENSE':
 229             {
 230                 $this->moduleInfo['LICENSE'] = $data;
 231                 break;
 232             }
 233             case 'ICON':
 234             {
 235                 $this->moduleInfo['ICON'] =  $data;
 236                 break;
 237             }
 238             case 'NAME':
 239             {
 240                 $parent = prev($this->elementPile);
 241                 switch ($parent)
 242                 {
 243                     case 'MODULE':
 244                     {
 245                         $this->moduleInfo['NAME'] = $data;
 246                         break;
 247                     }
 248                     case 'AUTHOR':
 249                     {
 250                         $this->moduleInfo['AUTHOR']['NAME'] = $data;
 251                         break;
 252                     }
 253                 }
 254                 break;
 255             }
 256             case 'DEFAULT_DOCK' :
 257             {
 258                 if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 259                 {
 260                     $this->backlog->debug(
 261                         'The use of default_dock is deprecated in manifest file, please use defaultDock instead' );
 262                 }
 263 
 264                 // nobreak
 265             }
 266             case 'DEFAULTDOCK':
 267             {
 268                 if ( ! array_key_exists( 'DEFAULT_DOCK', $this->moduleInfo ) )
 269                 {
 270                     $this->moduleInfo['DEFAULT_DOCK'] = array();
 271                 }
 272 
 273                 $this->moduleInfo['DEFAULT_DOCK'][] = $data;
 274                 break;
 275             }
 276             case 'WEB':
 277             {
 278                 $parent = prev($this->elementPile);
 279                 switch ($parent)
 280                 {
 281                     case 'MODULE':
 282                     {
 283                         $this->moduleInfo['WEB'] = $data;
 284                         break;
 285                     }
 286                     case 'AUTHOR':
 287                     {
 288                         $this->moduleInfo['AUTHOR']['WEB'] = $data;
 289                         break;
 290                     }
 291                 }
 292 
 293                 break;
 294             }
 295             // PHP/MySQL/Claroline versions dependencies
 296             // TODO check in install
 297             case 'MINVERSION':
 298             {
 299                 $parent = prev($this->elementPile);
 300                 switch ($parent)
 301                 {
 302                     case 'PHP':
 303                     {
 304                         $this->moduleInfo['PHP_MIN_VERSION'] = $data;
 305                         break;
 306                     }
 307                     case 'MYSQL':
 308                     {
 309                         $this->moduleInfo['MYSQL_MIN_VERSION'] = $data;
 310                         break;
 311                     }
 312                     case 'CLAROLINE' :
 313                     {
 314                         $this->moduleInfo['CLAROLINE_MIN_VERSION'] = $data;
 315                         break;
 316                     }
 317                 }
 318                 break;
 319             }
 320             case 'MAXVERSION':
 321             {
 322                 $parent = prev($this->elementPile);
 323                 switch ($parent)
 324                 {
 325                     case 'PHP':
 326                     {
 327                         $this->moduleInfo['PHP_MAX_VERSION'] = $data;
 328                         break;
 329                     }
 330                     case 'MYSQL':
 331                     {
 332                         $this->moduleInfo['MYSQL_MAX_VERSION'] = $data;
 333                         break;
 334                     }
 335                     case 'CLAROLINE' :
 336                     {
 337                         $this->moduleInfo['CLAROLINE_MAX_VERSION'] = $data;
 338                         break;
 339                     }
 340                 }
 341                 break;
 342             }
 343             // FIXME I'm not sure this is cool...
 344             // if VERSION is 1.8 what about 1.8.* ?
 345             // check the behaviour of version_compare...
 346             case 'VERSION':
 347             {
 348                 $parent = prev($this->elementPile);
 349                 switch ($parent)
 350                 {
 351                     case 'MODULE':
 352                     {
 353                         $this->moduleInfo['VERSION'] = $data;
 354                         break;
 355                     }
 356                     case 'CLAROLINE' :
 357                     {
 358                         $this->moduleInfo['CLAROLINE_MIN_VERSION'] = $data;
 359                         $this->moduleInfo['CLAROLINE_MAX_VERSION'] = $data;
 360                         break;
 361                     }
 362                     case 'PHP':
 363                     {
 364                         $this->moduleInfo['PHP_MIN_VERSION'] = $data;
 365                         $this->moduleInfo['PHP_MAX_VERSION'] = $data;
 366                         break;
 367                     }
 368                     case 'MYSQL':
 369                     {
 370                         $this->moduleInfo['MYSQL_MIN_VERSION'] = $data;
 371                         $this->moduleInfo['MYSQL_MAX_VERSION'] = $data;
 372                         break;
 373                     }
 374                 }
 375                 break;
 376             }
 377             case 'CONTEXT':
 378             {
 379                 if ( ! array_key_exists( 'CONTEXTS', $this->moduleInfo ) )
 380                 {
 381                     $this->moduleInfo['CONTEXTS'] = array();
 382                 }
 383                 
 384                 if ( ! in_array( $data, $this->moduleInfo['CONTEXTS'] ) )
 385                 {
 386                     $this->moduleInfo['CONTEXTS'][] = $data;
 387                 }
 388                 
 389                 break;
 390             }
 391         }
 392     }
 393 }
 394 
 395 /**
 396  *  Check if the module information are valid :
 397  *      - is an array
 398  *      - in not empty
 399  *      - contains required elements (label, name, type)
 400  */
 401 function checkModuleInfo ( $module_info )
 402 {
 403     if ( ! is_array( $module_info ) || count( $module_info ) == 0 )
 404     {
 405         return claro_failure::set_failure(get_lang('Empty manifest'));
 406     }
 407     
 408     $missingElement = array_diff(
 409         array('LABEL','NAME','TYPE'),
 410         array_keys($module_info)
 411     );
 412 
 413     if ( !empty($missingElement) )
 414     {
 415         return claro_failure::set_failure(
 416             get_lang( 'Missing elements in module Manifest : %MissingElements'
 417                      , array('%MissingElements' => implode(',',$missingElement)) ) );
 418     }
 419     else
 420     {
 421         return true;
 422     }
 423 }
 424 
 425 /**
 426  *  Helper function to read, validate and complete module information from
 427  *  a manifest file
 428  */
 429 function readModuleManifest($modulePath)
 430 {
 431     $manifestPath = $modulePath. '/manifest.xml';
 432     
 433     if (! file_exists ($manifestPath) )
 434     {
 435         return claro_failure::set_failure(
 436             get_lang( 'Manifest missing : %filename'
 437                      , array('%filename' => $manifestPath) ) );
 438     }
 439     else
 440     {
 441         $parser = new ModuleManifestParser;
 442         $moduleInfo = $parser->parse($manifestPath);
 443         
 444         if ( !checkModuleInfo( $moduleInfo ) )
 445         {
 446             return false;
 447         }
 448         else
 449         {
 450             return $moduleInfo;
 451         }
 452     }
 453 }

   8 /**
   9  * CLAROLINE
  10  *
  11  * Built url and system paths.
  12  *
  13  * @version     $Revision: 14181 $
  14  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  15  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html (GPL) GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
  16  * @author      see 'credits' file
  17  * @since       Claroline 1.8.3
  18  * @package     KERNEL
  19  */
  20 
  21 
  22 /**
  23 Http://www.domain.tld/whereisMyCampus/claroline/blah
  24 
  25 $rootWeb    = Http://www.domain.tld/whereisMyCampus/claroline/blah
  26 $hostWeb    = Http://www.domain.tld
  27 $urlAppend  = /whereisMyCampus/claroline/blah
  28 $clarolineRepositorySys = Http://www.domain.tld/whereisMyCampus/claroline
  29 
  30 */
  31 /**
  32  * Return a common path of claroline
  33  *
  34  * @param string $pathKey key name of the path ( varname in previous version of claroline)
  35  * @author Christophe Gesche <moosh@claroline.net>
  36  * @return path
  37  */
  38 function get_path($pathKey)
  39 {
  40     static $pathList = array() ;
  41 
  42     if ( count($pathList) == 0 )
  43     {
  44         $rootPath = dirname(dirname(dirname(dirname(__FILE__))));
  45 
  46         // root path
  47         $pathList['rootSys'] =  $rootPath . '/' ;
  48         $pathList['includePath'] =  $rootPath . '/claroline/inc' ;
  49         $pathList['incRepositorySys'] =  $rootPath . '/claroline/inc' ;
  50 
  51         // root url
  52         $pathList['url'] =  get_conf('urlAppend');
  53         $pathList['rootWeb'] =  get_conf('rootWeb') ;
  54 
  55         // append path
  56         $pathList['imgRepositoryAppend'] =  'web/img/';
  57         $pathList['coursesRepositoryAppend'] =  get_conf('coursesRepositoryAppend','courses/');
  58 
  59         // root path + append path
  60         $pathList['clarolineRepositorySys'] =  $rootPath . '/claroline/' ;
  61         $pathList['coursesRepositorySys'] =  $rootPath . '/' . $pathList['coursesRepositoryAppend'] ;
  62         $pathList['rootAdminSys'] =  $rootPath . '/claroline/admin/' ;
  63         $pathList['imgRepositorySys'] =  $rootPath . '/' . $pathList['imgRepositoryAppend'];
  64 
  65         // root url + append path
  66         $pathList['coursesRepositoryWeb'] =  $pathList['url'] . '/' . $pathList['coursesRepositoryAppend'];
  67         $pathList['imgRepositoryWeb'] = $pathList['url']  . '/' . $pathList['imgRepositoryAppend'];
  68         $pathList['clarolineRepositoryWeb'] =  $pathList['url'] . '/claroline/';
  69         $pathList['rootAdminWeb'] =  $pathList['url'] . '/claroline/admin/';
  70 
  71         // path special case
  72         $pathList['garbageRepositorySys'] =  get_conf('garbageRepositorySys');
  73         $pathList['mysqlRepositorySys'] =  get_conf('mysqlRepositorySys');
  74         
  75         // user folder
  76         $pathList['userRepositorySys'] = $pathList['rootSys'].'platform/users/';
  77         $pathList['userRepositoryWeb'] = $pathList['url'].'/platform/users/';
  78     }
  79 
  80     if ( array_key_exists( $pathKey, $pathList ) )
  81     {
  82         return $pathList[$pathKey];
  83     }
  84     else
  85     {
  86         trigger_error('Claroline : Unknown path name "' . $pathKey . '" passed to get_path function' , E_USER_NOTICE);
  87         return false;
  88     }
  89 
  90 }
  91 
  92 /**
  93  * return prefix for urls to externalize
  94  */
  95 function get_url_domain()
  96 {
  97     /*
  98     Array
  99     (
 100     [scheme] => http
 101     [host] => hostname
 102     [user] => username     [pass] => password
 103     [path] => /path
 104     [query] => arg=value
 105     [fragment] => anchor
 106     )
 107     */
 108 
 109     $urlPart = parse_url(get_conf('rootWeb'));
 110 
 111     $url  = $urlPart[scheme] . '://';
 112     if(! empty($urlPart[user]))
 113     {
 114         $url .= $urlPart[user] ;
 115         if(! empty($urlPart[pass])) $url .= ':' . $urlPart[pass] ;
 116         $url .= '@' ;
 117     }
 118     $url .= $urlPart[host] . '/';
 119 
 120 }
 121 
 122 /**
 123  * Get platform path url : return get_path('url') if not empty, 
 124  *  '/' if get_path('url') is empty.
 125  * Use this instead of in get_path('url') in claro_redirect
 126  * @return string platform base url without domain, port...
 127  * @since Claroline 1.11.0
 128  */
 129 function get_platform_base_url()
 130 {
 131     $url = get_path('url');
 132     
 133     if ( empty( $url ) )
 134     {
 135         return '/';
 136     }
 137     else
 138     {
 139         return $url;
 140     }
 141 }

   1 <?php // $Id: courseProfileToolAction.class.php 14198 2012-07-06 13:24:06Z zefredz $
   2 
   3 /**
   4  * CLAROLINE
   5  *
   6  * Class to manage relation between profile and tool action in a course
   7  *
   8  * @version     1.11 $Revision: 14198 $
   9  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2012, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  10  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html (GPL) GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
  11  * @package     RIGHT
  12  * @author      Claro Team <cvs@claroline.net>
  13  */
  14 require_once dirname ( __FILE__ ) . '/constants.inc.php';
  15 require_once dirname ( __FILE__ ) . '/profileToolRight.class.php';
  16 
  17 class RightCourseProfileToolRight extends RightProfileToolRight
  18 {
  19 
  20     /**
  21      * @var $courseId
  22      */
  23     var $courseId;
  24 
  25     /**
  26      * @array $defaultToolActionList list action of the profile and their values
  27      */
  28     var $defaultToolActionList = array ( );
  29 
  30     /**
  31      * Constructor
  32      */
  33     public function __construct ()
  34     {
  35         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl ();
  36 
  37         $this->tbl[ 'profile' ] = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'right_profile' ];
  38         $this->tbl[ 'rel_profile_action' ] = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'right_rel_profile_action' ];
  39         $this->tbl[ 'action' ] = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'right_action' ];
  40         $this->tbl[ 'course_tool' ] = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'tool' ];
  41         $this->tbl[ 'module' ] = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'module' ];
  42     }
  43 
  44     /**
  45      * Load rights of a profile/course
  46      */
  47     public function load ( $profile )
  48     {
  49         // Load toolAction of the parent
  50         parent::load ( $profile );
  51 
  52         $this->defaultToolActionList = $this->getToolActionList ();
  53 
  54         // load value of action of the courseId
  55         $sql = " SELECT PA.action_id, PA.value, A.tool_id, A.name
  56                  FROM `" . $this->tbl[ 'rel_profile_action' ] . "` `PA`,
  57                       `" . $this->tbl[ 'action' ] . "` `A`
  58                  WHERE PA.profile_id = " . $this->profile->id . "
  59                  AND PA.action_id = A.id
  60                  AND PA.courseId = '" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->courseId ) . "'";
  61 
  62         $action_list = claro_sql_query_fetch_all ( $sql );
  63 
  64         // load all actions value for the profile
  65         foreach ( $action_list as $this_action )
  66         {
  67             $actionName = $this_action[ 'name' ];
  68             $actionValue = (bool) $this_action[ 'value' ];
  69             $toolId = $this_action[ 'tool_id' ];
  70 
  71             if ( isset ( $this->toolActionList[ $toolId ][ $actionName ] ) )
  72             {
  73                 $this->toolActionList[ $toolId ][ $actionName ] = $actionValue;
  74             }
  75         }
  76 
  77         // Remove deactivated tool
  78         $sql = "SELECT t.id
  79                 FROM `" . $this->tbl[ 'module' ] . "`  AS m,
  80                     `" . $this->tbl[ 'course_tool' ] . "` AS t
  81                 WHERE t.claro_label = m.label
  82                   AND m.activation <> 'activated'";
  83 
  84         $deactivatedToolList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all ( $sql );
  85 
  86         foreach ( $deactivatedToolList as $deactivatedTool )
  87         {
  88             if ( isset ( $this->toolActionList[ $deactivatedTool[ 'id' ] ] ) )
  89                 unset ( $this->toolActionList[ $deactivatedTool[ 'id' ] ] );
  90             if ( isset ( $this->defaultToolActionList[ $deactivatedTool[ 'id' ] ] ) )
  91                 unset ( $this->defaultToolActionList[ $deactivatedTool[ 'id' ] ] );
  92         }
  93     }
  94 
  95     /**
  96      * Save profile tool list action value
  97      */
  98     public function save ()
  99     {
 100         // delete all relation
 101         $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $this->tbl[ 'rel_profile_action' ] . "`
 102                 WHERE profile_id=" . $this->profile->id . "
 103                 AND courseId = '" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->courseId ) . "'";
 104 
 105         claro_sql_query ( $sql );
 106 
 107         // insert new relation
 108 
 109         foreach ( $this->toolActionList as $toolId => $actionList )
 110         {
 111             // get difference between default and course
 112             $toolActionListDiff = array_diff_assoc ( $this->defaultToolActionList[ $toolId ], $actionList );
 113 
 114             if ( !empty ( $toolActionListDiff ) )
 115             {
 116                 foreach ( $actionList as $actionName => $actionValue )
 117                 {
 118                     if ( $actionValue == true )
 119                         $actionValue = 1;
 120                     else
 121                         $actionValue = 0;
 122 
 123                     $action = new RightToolAction();
 124 
 125                     $action->load ( $actionName, $toolId );
 126 
 127                     $actionId = $action->getId ();
 128 
 129                     $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $this->tbl[ 'rel_profile_action' ] . "`
 130                             SET profile_id = " . $this->profile->id . ",
 131                             action_id = " . $actionId . ",
 132                             value = " . $actionValue . ",
 133                             courseId = '" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->courseId ) . "'";
 134 
 135                     claro_sql_query ( $sql );
 136                 }
 137             }
 138         }
 139     }
 140 
 141     /**
 142      * Get courseId
 143      */
 144     public function getCourseId ()
 145     {
 146         return $this->courseId;
 147     }
 148 
 149     /**
 150      * Set courseId
 151      */
 152     public function setCourseId ( $value )
 153     {
 154         $this->courseId = $value;
 155     }
 156 
 157     /**
 158      * Reset the values of the profile/course
 159      */
 160     public function reset ()
 161     {
 162         // Empty tool action list
 163         $this->toolActionList = array ( );
 164 
 165         // Set tool action list to default values
 166         $this->toolActionList = $this->defaultToolActionList;
 167 
 168         // Delete all relations
 169         $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $this->tbl[ 'rel_profile_action' ] . "`
 170                 WHERE profile_id=" . $this->profile->id . "
 171                 AND courseId = '" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->courseId ) . "'";
 172 
 173         return claro_sql_query ( $sql );
 174     }
 175 
 176     /*
 177      * Delete all rights of a course
 178      * @param string $courseId
 179      * @return boolean
 180      */
 181 
 182     public static function resetAllRightProfile ( $courseId )
 183     {
 184         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl ();
 185 
 186         $tbl_rel_profile_action = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'right_rel_profile_action' ];
 187 
 188         // Delete all relations
 189         $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $tbl_rel_profile_action . "`
 190                 WHERE courseId = '" . claro_sql_escape ( $courseId ) . "'";
 191 
 192         return claro_sql_query ( $sql );
 193     }
 194 
 195 }

   1 <?php // $Id: profile.class.php 14314 2012-11-07 09:09:19Z zefredz $

   3 /**
   4  * CLAROLINE
   5  *
   6  * Library to manage profile
   7  *
   8  * @version     1.11 $Revision: 14314 $
   9  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2012, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)

  14 
  15 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/constants.inc.php';
  16 
  17 /**
  18  * Class right profile
  19  */
  20 
  21 class RightProfile
  22 {
  23     /**
  24      * @var $id id ofthe profile, -1 if profile doesn't exists already
  25      */
  26 
  27     var $id;
  28 
  29     /**
  30      * @var $label
  31      */
  32 
  33     var $label;
  34 
  35     /**
  36      * @var $name name of the profile
  37      */
  38 
  39     var $name;
  40 
  41     /**
  42      * @var $type type of the profile
  43      */
  44 
  45     var $type;
  46 
  47     /**
  48      * @var $description description of the profile
  49      */
  50

 119     /**
 120      * Load a profile from DB
 121      *
 122      * @param integer $id identifier of profile
 123      * @return boolean load successfull
 124      */
 125 
 126     public function load($id)
 127     {
 128         $sql = " SELECT profile_id,
 129                         name,
 130                         label,
 131                         type,
 132                         description,
 133                         locked,
 134                         required,
 135                         courseManager,
 136                         groupTutor,
 137                         userListPublic,
 138                         mailingList
 139                  FROM `" . $this->tbl['profile'] . "`
 140                  WHERE profile_id = " . (int) $id ;
 141 
 142         $data = claro_sql_query_get_single_row($sql);
 143 
 144         if ( !empty($data) )
 145         {
 146             $this->id = (int) $data['profile_id'];
 147             $this->name = $data['name'];
 148             $this->label = $data['label'];
 149             $this->type = $data['type'];
 150             $this->description = $data['description'];
 151 
 152             $this->isLocked = $data['locked'];
 153             $this->isRequired = $data['required'];
 154 
 155             $this->isCourseManager = $data['courseManager'];
 156             $this->isTutor = $data['groupTutor'];
 157             $this->isUserPublic = $data['userListPublic'];
 158             $this->isEmailNotify = $data['mailingList'];
 159 
 160             return true;
 161         }
 162         else
 163         {
 164             return false;
 165         }
 166     }
