 168     /**
 169      * save profile to DB
 170      *
 171      * @return mixed false or id of the profile
 172      */
 173 
 174     public function save()
 175     {
 176         if ( $this->id == 0 )
 177         {
 178             // insert
 179             $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $this->tbl['profile'] . "`
 180                     SET `name` = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->name) . "',
 181                         `label` = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->label) . "',
 182                         `description` = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->description) . "',
 183                         `type` = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->type) . "',
 184                         `courseManager` = " . (int) $this->isCourseManager . ",
 185                         `mailingList` = " . (int) $this->isEmailNotify . ",
 186                         `userlistPublic` = " . (int) $this->isUserPublic . ",
 187                         `groupTutor` = " . (int) $this->isTutor . ",
 188                         `locked` = " . (int) $this->isLocked . ",
 189                         `required` = " . (int) $this->isRequired . "";
 190 
 191             // execute the creation query and get id of inserted assignment
 192             $insertedId = claro_sql_query_insert_id($sql);
 193 
 194             if( $insertedId )
 195             {
 196                 $this->id = (int) $insertedId;
 197                 return $this->id;
 198             }
 199             else
 200             {
 201                 return false;
 202             }
 203 
 204         }
 205         else
 206         {
 207             // update, main query
 208             $sql = "UPDATE `". $this->tbl['profile'] ."`
 209                     SET `name` = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->name) . "',
 210                         `label` = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->label) . "',
 211                         `description` = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->description) . "',
 212                         `type` = '" . claro_sql_escape($this->type) . "',
 213                         `courseManager` = " . (int) $this->isCourseManager . ",
 214                         `mailingList` = " . (int) $this->isEmailNotify . ",
 215                         `userlistPublic` = " . (int) $this->isUserPublic . ",
 216                         `groupTutor` = " . (int) $this->isTutor . ",
 217                         `locked` = " . (int) $this->isLocked . ",
 218                         `required` = " . (int) $this->isRequired . "
 219                     WHERE `profile_id` = '". (int) $this->id."'";
 220 
 221             // execute and return main query
 222             if( claro_sql_query($sql) )
 223             {
 224                 return $this->id;
 225             }
 226             else
 227             {
 228                 return false;
 229             }
 230         }
 231 
 232     }

 234     /**

 241     public function delete()
 242     {
 243         if ( ! $this->isRequired )
 244         {
 245             $sql = "DELETE FROM `". $this->tbl['profile'] ."`
 246                     WHERE `profile_id` = '". (int) $this->id."'";
 247             claro_sql_query($sql);
 248 
 249             // is it required to empty the fields of the object ?
 250             $this->id = -1;
 251             return true;
 252         }
 253         else
 254         {
 255             // the profile is required
 256             return false;
 257         }

 260     /**
 261      * Check if data are valide
 262      *
 263      * @return boolean
 264      */
 265 
 266     public function validate()
 267     {
 268         // use validator library
 269         require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../datavalidator.lib.php';
 270 
 271         // new validator
 272         $validator = new DataValidator();
 273 
 274         $dataList = array('name'  => $this->name,
 275                           'description' => $this->description);
 276 
 277         $validator->setDataList($dataList);
 278 
 279         $validator->addRule('name',get_lang('Name is missing'),'required');
 280         // $validator->addRule('description',get_lang('Description is missing'),'required');
 281 
 282         if ( $validator->validate(DATAVALIDATOR_STRICT_MODE) )
 283         {
 284             return true;
 285         }
 286         else
 287         {
 288             $this->errorList = $validator->getErrorList();
 289             return false;
 290         }
 291     }

 623     /**

 632         if ( isset($_REQUEST['description']) ) $this->description = $_REQUEST['description'];

 634         $this->isCourseManager = isset($_REQUEST['isCourseManager'])?true:false;
 635         $this->isTutor = isset($_REQUEST['isTutor'])?true:false;
 636         $this->isLocked = isset($_REQUEST['isLocked'])?true:false;
 637         $this->isUserPublic = isset($_REQUEST['isUserPublic'])?true:false;

  10 /**
  11  * CLAROLINE
  12  *
  13  * Class to manage relation between profile and tool action
  14  *
  15  * @version     1.9 $Revision: 14198 $
  16  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  17  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html (GPL) GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
  18  * @package     RIGHT
  19  * @author      Claro Team <cvs@claroline.net>
  20  */
  21 require_once dirname ( __FILE__ ) . '/constants.inc.php';
  22 require_once dirname ( __FILE__ ) . '/profile.class.php';
  23 require_once dirname ( __FILE__ ) . '/toolAction.class.php';
  24 
  25 class RightProfileToolAction
  26 {
  27 
  28     /**
  29      * @var $profile profile object
  30      */
  31     var $profile;
  32 
  33     /**
  34      * @array $toolActionList list action of the profile and their values
  35      */
  36     var $toolActionList = array ( );
  37 
  38     /**
  39      * @array $tbl list of table (DB)
  40      */
  41     var $tbl;
  42 
  43     /**
  44      * Constructor
  45      */
  46     public function __construct ()
  47     {
  48         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl ();
  49 
  50         $this->tbl[ 'profile' ] = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'right_profile' ];
  51         $this->tbl[ 'rel_profile_action' ] = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'right_rel_profile_action' ];
  52         $this->tbl[ 'action' ] = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'right_action' ];
  53         $this->tbl[ 'course_tool' ] = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'tool' ];
  54     }
  55 
  56     /**
  57      * Load rights of a profile
  58      */
  59     public function load ( $profile )
  60     {
  61         // load profile
  62         $this->profile = $profile;
  63 
  64         // load all tool_action
  65         $this->loadToolActionList ();
  66     }
  67 
  68     /**
  69      * Load tool action list value of a profile
  70      */
  71     public function loadToolActionList ()
  72     {
  73         // load all action for this profile type
  74         $sql = " SELECT A.id, A.name, A.tool_id, CT.claro_label
  75                  FROM `" . $this->tbl[ 'action' ] . "` `A`,
  76                       `" . $this->tbl[ 'course_tool' ] . "` `CT`
  77                  WHERE type = '" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->profile->type ) . "'
  78                     AND A.tool_id = CT.id
  79                  ORDER BY CT.def_rank";
  80 
  81         $actionResult = claro_sql_query_fetch_all ( $sql );
  82 
  83         // initialise all tool action
  84         foreach ( $actionResult as $action )
  85         {
  86             $toolId = $action[ 'tool_id' ];
  87             $actionName = $action[ 'name' ];
  88             $this->toolActionList[ $toolId ][ $actionName ] = false;
  89         }
  90 
  91         // load value of action
  92         $sql = " SELECT PA.action_id, PA.value, A.tool_id, A.name
  93                  FROM `" . $this->tbl[ 'rel_profile_action' ] . "` `PA`,
  94                       `" . $this->tbl[ 'action' ] . "` `A`
  95                  WHERE PA.profile_id = " . $this->profile->id . "
  96                  AND PA.action_id = A.id
  97                  AND PA.courseId = ''";
  98 
  99         $action_list = claro_sql_query_fetch_all ( $sql );
 100 
 101         // load all actions value for the profile
 102         foreach ( $action_list as $this_action )
 103         {
 104             $actionName = $this_action[ 'name' ];
 105             $actionValue = (bool) $this_action[ 'value' ];
 106             $toolId = $this_action[ 'tool_id' ];
 107 
 108             if ( isset ( $this->toolActionList[ $toolId ][ $actionName ] ) )
 109             {
 110                 $this->toolActionList[ $toolId ][ $actionName ] = $actionValue;
 111             }
 112         }
 113     }
 114 
 115     /**
 116      * Save profile tool list action value
 117      */
 118     public function save ()
 119     {
 120         $this->toolActionList;
 121 
 122         // delete all relation
 123         $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $this->tbl[ 'rel_profile_action' ] . "`
 124                 WHERE profile_id=" . $this->profile->id . "
 125                 AND courseId = '' ";
 126 
 127         claro_sql_query ( $sql );
 128 
 129         // insert new relation
 130 
 131         foreach ( $this->toolActionList as $toolId => $actionList )
 132         {
 133             foreach ( $actionList as $actionName => $actionValue )
 134             {
 135                 if ( $actionValue == true )
 136                     $actionValue = 1;
 137                 else
 138                     $actionValue = 0;
 139 
 140                 $action = new RightToolAction();
 141 
 142                 $action->load ( $actionName, $toolId );
 143 
 144                 $actionId = $action->getId ();
 145 
 146                 $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $this->tbl[ 'rel_profile_action' ] . "`
 147                         SET profile_id = " . $this->profile->id . ",
 148                          action_id = " . $actionId . ",
 149                          value = " . $actionValue . ",
 150                          courseId = '' ";
 151                 claro_sql_query ( $sql );
 152             }
 153         }
 154     }
 155 
 156     /**
 157      * Set action value of the profile
 158      *
 159      * @param integer $tool_id tool identifier
 160      * @param string $action_name action name
 161      * @param boolean $value action value
 162      */
 163     public function setAction ( $toolId, $actionName, $value )
 164     {
 165         $value = (bool) $value;
 166 
 167         if ( isset ( $this->toolActionList[ $toolId ][ $actionName ] ) )
 168         {
 169             $this->toolActionList[ $toolId ][ $actionName ] = $value;
 170         }
 171     }
 172 
 173     /**
 174      * Get action value of the profile
 175      *
 176      * @param integer $toolId tool identifier
 177      * @param string $actionName action name
 178      * @return boolean
 179      */
 180     public function getAction ( $toolId, $actionName )
 181     {
 182         if ( isset ( $this->toolActionList[ $toolId ][ $actionName ] ) )
 183         {
 184             return $this->toolActionList[ $toolId ][ $actionName ];
 185         }
 186         else
 187         {
 188             return null;
 189         }
 190     }
 191 
 192     /**
 193      * Get action list of the profile
 194      */
 195     public function getToolActionList ()
 196     {
 197         return $this->toolActionList;
 198     }
 199 
 200 }

  12  * @author      Claro Team <cvs@claroline.net>
  13  */
  14 require_once dirname ( __FILE__ ) . '/constants.inc.php';
  15 require_once dirname ( __FILE__ ) . '/profileToolAction.class.php';
  16 
  17 class RightProfileToolRight extends RightProfileToolAction
  18 {
  19 
  20     /**
  21      * Set the tool right (none, user, manager)
  22      *
  23      * @param integer $toolId tool identifier
  24      * @param string $right the right value
  25      */
  26     public function setToolRight ( $toolId, $right )
  27     {
  28         if ( $right == 'none' )
  29         {
  30             $this->setAction ( $toolId, 'read', false );
  31             $this->setAction ( $toolId, 'edit', false );
  32         }
  33         elseif ( $right == 'user' )
  34         {
  35             $this->setAction ( $toolId, 'read', true );
  36             $this->setAction ( $toolId, 'edit', false );
  37         }
  38         elseif ( $right == 'manager' )
  39         {
  40             $this->setAction ( $toolId, 'read', true );
  41             $this->setAction ( $toolId, 'edit', true );
  42         }
  43     }
  44 
  45     /**
  46      * Get the tool right (none, user, manager)
  47      *
  48      * @param integer $toolId tool identifier
  49      */
  50     public function getToolRight ( $toolId )
  51     {
  52         $readAction = (bool) $this->getAction ( $toolId, 'read' );
  53         $manageAction = (bool) $this->getAction ( $toolId, 'edit' );
  54 
  55         if ( $readAction == false && $manageAction == false )
  56         {
  57             return 'none';
  58         }
  59         elseif ( $readAction == true && $manageAction == false )
  60         {
  61             return 'user';
  62         }
  63         else
  64         {
  65             return 'manager';
  66         }
  67     }
  68 
  69     /**
  70      * Set right of the tool list
  71      */
  72     public function setToolListRight ( $toolList, $right )
  73     {
  74         foreach ( $toolList as $toolId )
  75         {
  76             $this->setToolRight ( $toolId, $right );
  77         }
  78     }
  79 
  80 }

  23 /**
  24  * Get all names of profile in an array where key are profileId
  25  * return array assoc profileId => profileName
  26  */
  27 
  28 function claro_get_all_profile_name_list ()
  29 {
  30     $profileList = null;
  31 
  32     static $cachedProfileList = null ;
  33 
  34     if ( $cachedProfileList )
  35     {
  36         $profileList = $cachedProfileList;
  37     }
  38     else
  39     {
  40         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  41         $tbl_profile = $tbl_mdb_names['right_profile'];
  42 
  43         $sql = "SELECT profile_id, name, label, description
  44                 FROM `" . $tbl_profile . "`
  45                 ORDER BY profile_id ";
  46 
  47         $result = claro_sql_query_fetch_all($sql);
  48 
  49         foreach ( $result as $profile)
  50         {
  51             $profile_id = $profile['profile_id'];
  52             $profileList[$profile_id]['name'] = $profile['name'];
  53             $profileList[$profile_id]['label'] = $profile['label'];
  54             $profileList[$profile_id]['description'] = $profile['description'];
  55         }
  56 
  57         $cachedProfileList = $profileList ; // cache for the next time ...
  58     }
  59 
  60     return $profileList ;
  61 }

 121 /**
 122  * Get course/profile right
 123  *
 124  * @param integer $profileId profile identifier
 125  * @param integer $courseId course identifier
 126  * @return array ['tool_id']['action_name'] value
 127  */
 128 
 129 function claro_get_course_profile_right ($profileId = null, $courseId = null)
 130 {
 131     $courseProfileRightList = null;
 132 
 133     static $cachedProfileId = null ;
 134     static $cachedCourseId = null ;
 135     static $cachedCourseProfileRightList = null ;
 136 
 137     // load courseId
 138     if ( is_null($courseId) )
 139     {
 140         if ( claro_is_in_a_course() ) $courseId = claro_get_current_course_id();
 141         else                             return false ;
 142     }
 143 
 144     // load profile id
 145     if ( is_null($profileId) )
 146     {
 147         if ( !empty($GLOBALS['_profileId']) ) $profileId = $GLOBALS['_profileId'];
 148         else                                  return false ;
 149     }
 150 
 151     if ( !empty($cachedCourseProfileRightList) &&
 152          ( $cachedProfileId == $profileId ) &&
 153          ( $cachedCourseId == $courseId )
 154        )
 155     {
 156         $courseProfileRightList = $cachedCourseProfileRightList;
 157     }
 158 
 159     if ( empty($courseProfileRightList) )
 160     {
 161         $profile = new RightProfile();
 162 
 163         if ( $profile->load($profileId) )
 164         {
 165             $courseProfileToolRight = new RightCourseProfileToolRight();
 166             $courseProfileToolRight->setCourseId($courseId);
 167             $courseProfileToolRight->load($profile);
 168 
 169             $courseProfileRightList = $courseProfileToolRight->getToolActionList();
 170 
 171             // cache for the next time ...
 172             $cachedProfileId = $profileId;
 173             $cachedCourseId = $courseId;
 174             $cachedCourseProfileRightList = $courseProfileRightList;
 175         }
 176         else
 177         {
 178             return false;
 179         }
 180     }
 181 
 182     return $courseProfileRightList ;
 183 }

 185 /**
 186  * Is tool action allowed
 187  *
 188  * @param string $actionName name of the action
 189  * @param integer $tid tool identifier
 190  * @param integer $profileId profile identifier
 191  * @param string $courseId course identifier
 192  * @return boolean 'true' if it's allowed
 193  */
 194 
 195 function claro_is_allowed_tool_action ($actionName, $tid = null, $profileId = null, $courseId = null)
 196 {
 197     global $_mainToolId;
 198     global $_profileId;
 199 
 200     // load tool id
 201     if ( is_null($tid) )
 202     {
 203         if ( !empty($_mainToolId) ) $tid = $_mainToolId ;
 204         else                        return false ;
 205     }
 206 
 207     // load profile id
 208     if ( is_null($profileId) )
 209     {
 210         if ( !empty($_profileId) ) $profileId = $_profileId ;
 211         else                        return false ;
 212     }
 213 
 214     // load course id
 215     if ( is_null($courseId) )
 216     {
 217         if ( claro_is_in_a_course() ) $courseId = claro_get_current_course_id() ;
 218         else                 return false ;
 219     }
 220 
 221     // FIXME
 222     if ( claro_is_platform_admin() ) return true;
 223 
 224     // get course profile right
 225     $courseProfileRight = claro_get_course_profile_right($profileId,$courseId);
 226 
 227     // return value for tool/action
 228     if ( isset($courseProfileRight[$tid][$actionName]) )
 229     {
 230         return $courseProfileRight[$tid][$actionName];
 231     }
 232     else
 233     {
 234         return false;
 235     }
 236 }

 238 /**
 239  * Is tool read action allowed
 240  *
 241  * @param string $actionName name of the action
 242  * @param integer $tid tool identifier
 243  * @param integer $profileId profile identifier
 244  * @param string $courseId course identifier
 245  * @return boolean 'true' if it's allowed
 246  */
 247 
 248 function claro_is_allowed_tool_read ($tid = null, $profileId = null, $courseId = null)
 249 {
 250     if ( claro_is_tool_activated($tid,$courseId) )
 251     {
 252         if ( claro_is_allowed_tool_action('read',$tid,$profileId,$courseId) )
 253         {
 254             if ( claro_is_tool_visible($tid,$courseId) )
 255             {
 256                 return true ;
 257             }
 258             else
 259             {
 260                 // if tool isn't visible, only user with edit right have read right
 261                 if ( claro_is_allowed_tool_edit($tid,$profileId,$courseId) )
 262                 {
 263                     return true ;
 264                 }
 265                 else
 266                 {
 267                     return false ;
 268                 }
 269             }
 270         }
 271         else
 272         {
 273             // no read right
 274             return false ;
 275         }
 276     }
 277     else
 278     {
 279         // tool deactivated
 280         return false;
 281     }
 282 }

 306 /**
 307  * Is tool activate
 308  *
 309  * @param integer $tid tool identifier
 310  * @param string courseId
 311  *
 312  * @return boolean 'true' if it's activated
 313  */
 314 
 315 function claro_is_tool_activated ($tid, $courseId)
 316 {
 317     global $_mainToolId;
 318 
 319     static $activation = false;
 320     static $toolCourseActivation = false;
 321 
 322     // load tool id
 323     if ( is_null($tid) )
 324     {
 325         if ( !empty($_mainToolId) ) $tid = $_mainToolId ;
 326         else                        return false ;
 327     }
 328 
 329     // load course id
 330     if ( is_null($courseId) )
 331     {
 332         if ( claro_is_in_a_course() ) $courseId = claro_get_current_course_id() ;
 333         else                 return false ;
 334     }
 335 
 336     // tool platform activation cache
 337     if ( !$activation )
 338     {
 339         $activation = array();
 340 
 341         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 342 
 343         $sql = " SELECT t.id, m.activation
 344                  FROM `" . $tbl_mdb_names['module'] . "` as m,
 345                       `" . $tbl_mdb_names['tool'] . "` as t
 346                  WHERE t.claro_label = m.label";
 347 
 348         $tool_activationTmp = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sql);
 349 
 350         foreach ( $tool_activationTmp as $tool )
 351         {
 352             $activation[$tool['id']] = $tool['activation'];
 353         }
 354     }
 355 
 356     $tool_activation = $activation[$tid];
 357 
 358     if ( $tool_activation == 'activated' )
 359     {
 360         if ( claro_is_in_a_course())
 361         {
 362             // tool course activation cache
 363             if ( ! $toolCourseActivation )
 364             {
 365                 $tbl_cdb_names = claro_sql_get_course_tbl();
 366 
 367                 $sql = " SELECT ctl.tool_id AS tool_id, ctl.activated AS activated
 368                      FROM `" . $tbl_cdb_names['tool'] . "` as ctl ";
 369 
 370                 $tools_activatedInCourse = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sql);
 371 
 372                 $toolCourseActivation = array();
 373 
 374                 foreach ( $tools_activatedInCourse as $tool_activatedInCourse )
 375                 {
 376                     $toolCourseActivation[$tool_activatedInCourse['tool_id']] = $tool_activatedInCourse['activated'];
 377                 }
 378             }
 379 
 380             return isset($toolCourseActivation[$tid]) && $toolCourseActivation[$tid]  == 'true';
 381         }
 382 
 383         return true;
 384     }
 385     else
 386     {
 387         return false;
 388     }
 389 
 390 }
 391 
 392 /**
 393  * Is tool visible
 394  *
 395  * @param integer $tid tool identifier
 396  * @param string courseId
 397  * @todo to move in a lib
 398  *
 399  * @return boolean 'true' if it's visible
 400  */
 401 
 402 function claro_is_tool_visible ($tid, $courseId)
 403 {
 404     global $_mainToolId;
 405 
 406     static $toolVisibilityCache = false;
 407 
 408     // load tool id
 409     if ( is_null($tid) )
 410     {
 411         if ( !empty($_mainToolId) ) $tid = $_mainToolId ;
 412         else                        return false ;
 413     }
 414 
 415     // load course id
 416     if ( is_null($courseId) )
 417     {
 418         if ( claro_is_in_a_course() ) $courseId = claro_get_current_course_id() ;
 419         else                 return false ;
 420     }
 421 
 422     if ( !$toolVisibilityCache )
 423     {
 424         $toolVisibilityCache = array();
 425 
 426         $tbl_cdb_names = claro_sql_get_course_tbl(claro_get_course_db_name_glued($courseId));
 427         $sql = " SELECT tool_id, visibility
 428                  FROM `" . $tbl_cdb_names['tool'] . "`";
 429 
 430         $tool_visibilityTmp = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sql);
 431 
 432         foreach ( $tool_visibilityTmp as $tool )
 433         {
 434             $toolVisibilityCache[$tool['tool_id']] = $tool['visibility'];
 435         }
 436 
 437     }
 438 
 439     return (boolean) $toolVisibilityCache[$tid] ;
 440 }

   3 /**
   4  * CLAROLINE
   5  *
   6  * Class to manage tool action
   7  *
   8  * @version     1.11 $Revision: 14198 $

  12  * @author      Claro Team <cvs@claroline.net>
  13  */
  14 require_once dirname ( __FILE__ ) . '/constants.inc.php';
  15 
  16 class RightToolAction
  17 {
  18 
  19     var $name;
  20     var $description;
  21     var $toolId;
  22     var $type;
  23     var $tbl = array ( );
  24 
  25     /**
  26      * Constructor
  27      */
  28     public function __construct ()
  29     {
  30         $this->id = '';
  31         $this->name = '';
  32         $this->description = '';
  33         $this->toolId = '';
  34         $this->type = PROFILE_TYPE_COURSE;
  35 
  36         $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl ();
  37         $this->tbl[ 'action' ] = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'right_action' ];
  38         $this->tbl[ 'rel_profile_action' ] = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'right_rel_profile_action' ];
  39     }
  40 
  41     /**
  42      * Load action from DB
  43      *
  44      * @param $action_name
  45      * @param $toolId
  46      * @return boolean load successfull ?
  47      */
  48     public function load ( $actionName, $toolId )
  49     {
  50         $sql = "SELECT id,
  51                        name,
  52                        description,
  53                        tool_id,
  54                        type
  55                 FROM `" . $this->tbl[ 'action' ] . "`
  56                 WHERE name = '" . claro_sql_escape ( $actionName ) . "'
  57                 AND `tool_id` =  " . (int) $toolId;
  58 
  59         $data = claro_sql_query_get_single_row ( $sql );
  60 
  61         if ( !empty ( $data ) )
  62         {
  63             $this->id = $data[ 'id' ];
  64             $this->name = $data[ 'name' ];
  65             $this->description = $data[ 'description' ];
  66             $this->toolId = $data[ 'tool_id' ];
  67             $this->type = $data[ 'type' ];
  68 
  69             return true;
  70         }
  71         else
  72         {
  73             return false;
  74         }
  75     }
  76 
  77     /**
  78      * Save action
  79      */
  80     public function save ()
  81     {
  82         if ( empty ( $this->name ) || empty ( $this->toolId ) || empty ( $this->type ) )
  83         {
  84             return false;
  85         }
  86         elseif ( !$this->exists () )
  87         {
  88             // insert action
  89             $sql = "INSERT INTO `" . $this->tbl[ 'action' ] . "`
  90                     SET `name` = '" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->name ) . "',
  91                         `description` = '" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->description ) . "',
  92                         `type` = '" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->type ) . "',
  93                         `tool_id` =" . (int) $this->toolId;
  94 
  95             return claro_sql_query ( $sql );
  96         }
  97         else
  98         {
  99             // update action
 100             $sql = "UPDATE `" . $this->tbl[ 'action' ] . "`
 101                     SET `description` = '" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->description ) . "'
 102                     WHERE name ='" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->name ) . "' AND
 103                           type ='" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->type ) . "' AND
 104                           tool_id = " . (int) $this->toolId;
 105 
 106             return claro_sql_query ( $sql );
 107         }
 108     }
 109 
 110     /**
 111      * Delete action
 112      */
 113     public function delete ()
 114     {
 115         // Delete from rel_profile_action
 116         $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $this->tbl[ 'rel_profile_action' ] . "`
 117                 WHERE action_id = " . (int) $this->id;
 118         claro_sql_query ( $sql );
 119 
 120         // Delete from action
 121         $sql = "DELETE FROM `" . $this->tbl[ 'action' ] . "`
 122                 WHERE id = " . (int) $this->id;
 123 
 124         claro_sql_query ( $sql );
 125 
 126         $this->id = -1;
 127 
 128         return true;
 129     }
 130 
 131     /**
 132      * Check if action already exists
 133      */
 134     public function exists ()
 135     {
 136         $sql = " SELECT count(*)
 137                  FROM `" . $this->tbl[ 'action' ] . "`
 138                  WHERE name ='" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->name ) . "' AND
 139                        type ='" . claro_sql_escape ( $this->type ) . "' AND
 140                        tool_id = " . (int) $this->toolId;
 141 
 142         if ( claro_sql_query_get_single_value ( $sql ) == 0 )
 143             return false;
 144         else
 145             return true;
 146     }
 147 
 148     /**
 149      * Get action id
 150      */
 151     public function getId ()
 152     {
 153         return $this->id;
 154     }
 155 
 156     /**
 157      * Get action name
 158      */
 159     public function getName ()
 160     {
 161         return $this->name;
 162     }
 163 
 164     /**
 165      * Get action description
 166      */
 167     public function getDescription ()
 168     {
 169         return $this->description;
 170     }
 171 
 172     /**
 173      * Get tool identifier
 174      */
 175     public function getToolId ()
 176     {
 177         return $this->toolId;
 178     }
 179 
 180     /**
 181      * Get type
 182      */
 183     public function getType ()
 184     {
 185         return $this->type;
 186     }
 187 
 188     /**
 189      * Set name
 190      */
 191     public function setName ( $value )
 192     {
 193         $this->name = $value;
 194     }
 195 
 196     /**
 197      * Set description
 198      */
 199     public function setDescription ( $value )
 200     {
 201         $this->description = $value;
 202     }
 203 
 204     /**
 205      * Set tool identifier
 206      */
 207     public function setToolId ( $value )
 208     {
 209         $this->toolId = $value;
 210     }
 211 
 212     /**
 213      * set type
 214      */
 215     public function setType ( $value )
 216     {
 217         $this->type = $value;
 218     }
 219 
 220 }

  20 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/thirdparty/phpmailer/class.phpmailer.php' ;
  21 include_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/user.lib.php' ;
  22 
  23 class ClaroPHPMailer extends PHPMailer
  24 {
  25     function ClaroPHPMailer()
  26     {
  27     	//prevent phpMailer from echo'ing anything
  28         parent::__construct(true);
  29         // set charset
  30         $this->CharSet = get_locale('charset');        
  31 
  32         if ( get_conf('smtp_host') != '' )
  33         {
  34             // set smtp mode and smtp host
  35             $this->IsSMTP();
  36             $this->Host = get_conf('smtp_host');
  37 
  38             if ( get_conf('smtp_username') != '' )
  39             {
  40                 // SMTP authentification
  41                 $this->SMTPAuth = true;     // turn on SMTP
  42                 $this->Username = get_conf('smtp_username'); // SMTP username
  43                 $this->Password = get_conf('smtp_password'); // SMTP password
  44             }
  45         	if ( get_conf('smtp_port') != '' )
  46             {              
  47                 $this->Port = (int)get_conf('smtp_port');
  48             }
  49         	if ( get_conf('smtp_secure') != '' )
  50             {              
  51                 $this->SMTPSecure = get_conf('smtp_secure');
  52             }
  53             
  54         }
  55         else
  56         {
  57             // set sendmail mode
  58             $this->IsMail();
  59         }
  60         
  61     }
  62 
  63     /**
  64      * Returns a message in the appropriate language.
  65      *
  66      * @access private
  67      * @return string
  68      */
  69     function Lang($key) {
  70             return "Language string failed to load: " . $key . " ";
  71     }

  73     function getError ()
  74     {
  75         return $this->ErrorInfo;
  76     }    
  77     
  78     function Send(){
  79         // errors can be retrieved when return value is false by calling getError method
  80         try{
  81         	return parent::Send();
  82         }
  83         catch (phpmailerException $e)
  84         {
  85         	return false;
  86         }
  87     }

  90 /**
  91  * Send e-mail using Main settings
  92  */
  93 
  94 function claro_mail($subject, $message, $to, $toName, $from, $fromName)
  95 {
  96     $mail = new ClaroPHPMailer();
  97 
  98     if (empty($from))
  99     {
 100         $from = get_conf('administrator_email');
 101         if (empty($fromName))
 102         {
 103             $fromName = get_conf('administrator_name');
 104         }
 105     }
 106     
 107     $mail->Subject  = $subject;
 108     $mail->Body     = $message;
 109     $mail->From     = $from;
 110     $mail->FromName = $fromName;
 111     $mail->Sender   = $from;
 112     
 113     $mail->AddAddress($to,$toName);
 114 
 115     if ( $mail->Send() )
 116     {
 117         return true;
 118     }
 119     else
 120     {
 121         return claro_failure::set_failure($mail->getError());
 122     }
 123 }

 125  /**
 126   * Send e-mail to Claroline users form their ID a user of Claroline
 127   *
 128   * Send e-mail to Claroline users form their ID a user of Claroline
 129   * default from clause in email address will be the platorm admin adress
 130   * default from name clause in email will be the platform admin name and surname
 131   *
 132   * @author Hugues Peeters <peeters@advalavas.be>
 133   * @param  int or array $userIdList - sender id's
 134   * @param  string $message - mail content
 135   * @param  string $subject - mail subject
 136   * @param  string $specificFrom (optional) sender's email address
 137   * @param  string  $specificFromName (optional) sender's name
 138   * @return int total count of sent email
 139   */
 140 
 141 function claro_mail_user($userIdList, $message, $subject , $specificFrom='', $specificFromName='' )
 142 {
 143     if ( ! is_array($userIdList) ) $userIdList = array($userIdList);
 144     if ( count($userIdList) == 0)  return 0;
 145 
 146     $tbl      = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 147     $tbl_user = $tbl['user'];
 148 
 149     $sql = 'SELECT DISTINCT email
 150             FROM `'.$tbl_user.'`
 151             WHERE user_id IN ('. implode(', ', array_map('intval', $userIdList) ) . ')';
 152 
 153     $emailList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_cols($sql);
 154     $emailList = $emailList['email'];
 155 
 156     $emailList = array_filter($emailList, 'is_well_formed_email_address');
 157 
 158     $mail = new ClaroPHPMailer();
 159 
 160     if ($specificFrom != '')     $mail->From = $specificFrom;
 161     else                         $mail->From = get_conf('administrator_email');
 162 
 163     if ($specificFromName != '') $mail->FromName = $specificFromName;
 164     else                         $mail->FromName = get_conf('administrator_name');
 165 
 166     $mail->Sender = $mail->From;
 167 
 168     if (strlen($subject)> 78)
 169     {
 170         $message = $subject . "\n" . $message;
 171         $subject = substr($subject,0,73) . '...';
 172     }
 173     $mail->Subject = $subject;
 174     $mail->Body    = $message;
 175     $emailSentCount = 0;
 176 
 177     if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 178     {
 179         $message = '<p>Subject : ' . claro_htmlspecialchars($subject) . '</p>' . "\n"
 180                  . '<p>Message : <pre>' . claro_htmlspecialchars($message) . '</pre></p>' . "\n"
 181                  . '<p>From : ' . claro_htmlspecialchars($mail->FromName) . ' - ' . claro_htmlspecialchars($mail->From) . '</p>' . "\n"
 182                  . '<p>Dest : ' . implode(', ', $emailList) . '</p>' . "\n";
 183         pushClaroMessage($message,'mail');
 184     }
 185 
 186     foreach ($emailList as $thisEmail)
 187     {
 188         $mail->AddAddress($thisEmail);
 189         if ( $mail->Send() )
 190         {
 191             $emailSentCount ++;
 192         }
 193         else
 194         {
 195             if ( claro_debug_mode() )
 196             {
 197                 pushClaroMessage($mail->getError(),'error');
 198             }
 199         }
 200         $mail->ClearAddresses();
 201     }
 202 
 203     return $emailSentCount;
 204 }

  19 /**
  20  * Return the tablename for a tool, dependig on the execution context
  21  * WARNING DO NOT USE THIS FUNCTION UNTIL THE deprecated TAG IS REMOVE
  22  *
  23  * @param array $tableList
  24  * @param array $contextData id To discrim table. Do not add context Id
  25  *  of an context active but managed by tool.
  26  * @return array
  27  * @deprecated for modules since Claroline 1.9, use get_module_main_tbl and
  28  *  get_module_course_tbl instead
  29  * @todo rewrite to use new Claroline core/context.lib.php
  30  */
  31 function claro_sql_get_tbl( $tableList, $contextData=null)
  32 {
  33     /**
  34      * If it's in a course, $courseId is set or $courseId is null but not claro_get_current_course_id()
  35      * if both are null, it's a main table
  36      *
  37      * when
  38      */
  39 
  40     if( ! is_array($tableList))
  41     {
  42         $tableListArr[] = $tableList;
  43         $tableList = $tableListArr;
  44     }
  45     else $tableList = $tableList;
  46 
  47     /**
  48      * Tool Context capatibility
  49      *
  50      * There is many context in claroline,
  51      * a new tool can don't provide initially
  52      * all field to discrim each context in fields.
  53      * When a tool can't discrim a context,
  54      * the table would be duplicated for each instance
  55      * and the name of table (or db) contain the discriminator
  56      *
  57      * This extreme modularity provide an easy growing
  58      * and integration but
  59      * easy
  60      *
  61      * Easy can't mean slowly.
  62      * If  I prupose a blog tool wich can't discrim user
  63      * I need to duplicate all blog table (in same or separate db).
  64      */
  65 
  66     if (!is_array($contextData)) $contextData = array();
  67 
  68     if ( isset($GLOBALS['_courseTool']['label']) )
  69     {
  70         $toolId = rtrim($GLOBALS['_courseTool']['label'],'_');
  71     }
  72     else
  73     {
  74         $toolId = null;
  75     }
  76 
  77     $contextDependance = get_context_db_discriminator($toolId);
  78     // Now place discriminator in db & table name.
  79     // if a context is needed ($contextData) and $contextDependance is found,
  80     // add the discriminator in schema name or table prefix
  81     $schemaPrefix = array();
  82 
  83     if (is_array($contextDependance) )
  84     {
  85         if (array_key_exists('schema',$contextDependance))
  86         {
  87             if (array_key_exists(CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE,$contextData)
  88             && !is_null($contextData[CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE])
  89             && in_array(CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE, $contextDependance['schema']))
  90             {
  91                 $schemaPrefix[] = get_conf('courseTablePrefix') . claro_get_course_db_name($contextData[CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE]);
  92             }
  93         }
  94 
  95         $tablePrefix = '';
  96 
  97         if (array_key_exists('table',$contextDependance))
  98         {
  99             if (array_key_exists(CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE,$contextData)
 100             && !is_null($contextData[CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE])
 101             && in_array(CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE, $contextDependance['table']))
 102             {
 103                 $tablePrefix .= 'C_' . $contextData[CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE] . '_';
 104             }
 105         }
 106     }
 107 
 108     //$schemaPrefix = (0==count($schemaPrefix) ? get_conf('mainDbName') : implode(get_conf('dbGlu'),$schemaPrefix)); // ne pas utiliser dbGlu tant qu'il peut valoir .
 109     $schemaPrefix = (0 == count($schemaPrefix) ? get_conf('mainDbName') : implode('_',$schemaPrefix));
 110     $tablePrefix  = ('' == $tablePrefix) ? get_conf('mainTblPrefix') : $tablePrefix;
 111 
 112     foreach ($tableList as $tableId)
 113     {
 114         /**
 115          *  Read this  to understand chanche  since  previous version thant 1.8
 116          *
 117          * Until 1.8  there was 2 functions
 118          *
 119          * function claro_sql_get_main_tbl()
 120          * function claro_sql_get_course_tbl($dbNameGlued = null)
 121          *
 122          * both was using  conf values
 123          * claro_sql_get_main_tbl was using  conf values
 124          * * get_conf('mainDbName')
 125          * * get_conf('mainTblPrefix')
 126          *
 127          */
 128         $tableNameList[$tableId] = $schemaPrefix . '`.`' . $tablePrefix . $tableId;
 129     }
 130 
 131     return $tableNameList;
 132 }

 277 /**
 278  * CLAROLINE mySQL query wrapper. It also provides a debug display which works
 279  * when the CLARO_DEBUG_MODE constant flag is set to on (true)
 280  *
 281  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
 282  * @author Christophe Gesch√© <moosh@claroline.net>
 283  * @param  string  $sqlQuery   - the sql query
 284  * @param  handler $dbHandler  - optional
 285  * @return handler             - the result handler
 286  * @deprecated since Claroline 1.9, use Claroline::getDatabase() and new classes
 287  *  in database/database.lib.php instead
 288  */
 289 function claro_sql_query($sqlQuery, $dbHandler = '#' )
 290 {
 291 
 292     if ( claro_debug_mode()
 293       && get_conf('CLARO_PROFILE_SQL',false)
 294       )
 295       {
 296          $start = microtime();
 297       }
 298     if ( $dbHandler == '#')
 299     {
 300         $resultHandler =  @mysql_query($sqlQuery);
 301     }
 302     else
 303     {
 304         $resultHandler =  @mysql_query($sqlQuery, $dbHandler);
 305     }
 306 
 307     if ( claro_debug_mode()
 308       && get_conf('CLARO_PROFILE_SQL',false)
 309       )
 310     {
 311         static $queryCounter = 1;
 312         $duration = microtime()-$start;
 313         $info = 'execution time : ' . ($duration > 0.001 ? '<b>' . round($duration,4) . '</b>':'&lt;0.001')  . '&#181;s'  ;
 314         // $info = ( $dbHandler == '#') ? mysql_info() : mysql_info($dbHandler);
 315         // $info .= ': affected rows :' . (( $dbHandler == '#') ? mysql_affected_rows() : mysql_affected_rows($dbHandler));
 316         $info .= ': affected rows :' . claro_sql_affected_rows();
 317 
 318         pushClaroMessage( '<br />Query counter : <b>' . $queryCounter++ . '</b> : ' . $info . '<br />'
 319             . '<code><span class="sqlcode">' . nl2br($sqlQuery) . '</span></code>'
 320             , (claro_sql_errno()?'error':'sqlinfo'));
 321 
 322     }
 323     if ( claro_debug_mode() && claro_sql_errno() )
 324     {
 325         echo '<hr size="1" noshade>'
 326         .    claro_sql_errno() . ' : '. claro_sql_error() . '<br>'
 327         .    '<pre style="color:red">'
 328         .    $sqlQuery
 329         .    '</pre>'
 330         .    ( function_exists('claro_html_debug_backtrace')
 331              ? claro_html_debug_backtrace()
 332              : ''
 333              )
 334         .    '<hr size="1" noshade>'
 335         ;
 336     }
 337 
 338     return $resultHandler;
 339 }

 427  * Get the name of the specified fields in a query result
 428  *
 429  * @param string $sq - SQL query
 430  * @param ressource (optional) - result pointer
 431  * @return  names of the specified field index
 432  *
 433  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
 434  * @deprecated since Claroline 1.9, use Claroline::getDatabase() and new classes
 435  *  in database/database.lib.php instead
 436  */
 437 function claro_sql_field_names( $sql, $resultPt = null )
 438 {
 439     static $_colNameList = array();
 440 
 441     $sqlHash = md5($sql);
 442 
 443     if ( ! array_key_exists( $sqlHash, $_colNameList) )
 444     {
 445         if ( is_resource($resultPt) && get_resource_type($resultPt) == 'mysql result' )
 446         {
 447             // if ressource type is mysql result use it
 448             $releasablePt = false;
 449         }
 450         else
 451         {
 452             $resultPt     = claro_sql_query($sql);
 453             $releasablePt = true;
 454         }
 455 
 456         $resultFieldCount = mysql_num_fields($resultPt);
 457 
 458         for ( $i = 0; $i < $resultFieldCount ; ++$i )
 459         {
 460             $_colNameList[$sqlHash][] = mysql_field_name($resultPt, $i);
 461         }
 462 
 463         if ( $releasablePt ) mysql_free_result($resultPt);
 464     }
 465 
 466     return $_colNameList[$sqlHash];
 467 }

 469 /**
 470  * CLAROLINE SQL query and fetch array wrapper. It returns all the result rows
 471  * in an associative array.
 472  *
 473  * @param  string  $sqlQuery the sql query
 474  * @param  handler $dbHandler optional
 475  * @return array associative array containing all the result rows
 476  *
 477  * @author Hugues Peeters <hugues.peeters@claroline.net>
 478  * @deprecated since Claroline 1.9, use Claroline::getDatabase() and new classes
 479  *  in database/database.lib.php instead
 480  */
 481 
 482 function claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sqlQuery, $dbHandler = '#')
 483 {
 484     $result = claro_sql_query($sqlQuery, $dbHandler);
 485 
 486     if ($result)
 487     {
 488         $rowList = array();
 489 
 490         while( $row = mysql_fetch_array($result, MYSQL_ASSOC) )
 491         {
 492             $rowList [] = $row;
 493         }
 494 
 495         if ( count($rowList) == 0 )
 496         {
 497             // If there is no result at all, anticipate that the user could ask
 498             // for field name at least. It is more efficient to call the
 499             // function now as we still hold the result pointer. The field names
 500             // will be statically cached into the claro_sql_field_names() funtion.
 501 
 502             claro_sql_field_names($sqlQuery, $result);
 503         }
 504 
 505         mysql_free_result($result);
 506 
 507         return $rowList;
 508     }
 509     else
 510     {
 511         return false;
 512     }
 513 }

 528  * associative array ARRANGED BY COLUMNS.
 529  *

 531  * @param  handler $dbHandler optional
 532  * @return associative array containing all the result arranged by columns

 535  * @author Hugues Peeters <hugues.peeters@claroline.net>,
 536  * @deprecated since Claroline 1.9, use Claroline::getDatabase() and new classes
 537  *  in database/database.lib.php instead
 538  */
 539 function claro_sql_query_fetch_all_cols($sqlQuery, $dbHandler = '#')
 540 {
 541     $result = claro_sql_query($sqlQuery, $dbHandler);
 542 
 543     if ($result)
 544     {
 545         $colList = array();
 546 
 547         while( $row = mysql_fetch_array($result, MYSQL_ASSOC) )
 548         {
 549             foreach($row as $key => $value ) $colList[$key][] = $value;
 550         }
 551 
 552         if( count($colList) == 0 )
 553         {
 554             // WHEN NO RESULT, THE SCRIPT CREATES AT LEAST COLUMN HEADERS
 555 
 556             $FieldNamelist = claro_sql_field_names($sqlQuery, $result);
 557 
 558             foreach($FieldNamelist as $thisFieldName)
 559             {
 560                 $colList[$thisFieldName] = array();
 561             }
 562         } // end if( count($colList) == 0)
 563 
 564         mysql_free_result($result);
 565 
 566         return $colList;
 567 
 568     }
 569     else
 570     {
 571         return false;
 572     }
 573 }

 678 /**
 679  * CLAROLINE SQL query wrapper returning the number of rows affected by the
 680  * query
 681  *
 682  * @param  string  $sqlQuery  the sql query
 683  * @param  handler $dbHandler optional
 684  * @return int                the number of rows affected by the query
 685  *
 686  * @see    claro_sql_query()
 687  * @author Hugues Peeters <hugues.peeters@claroline.net>,
 688  * @deprecated since Claroline 1.9, use Claroline::getDatabase() and new classes
 689  *  in database/database.lib.php instead
 690  */
 691 function claro_sql_query_affected_rows($sqlQuery, $dbHandler = '#')
 692 {
 693     $result = claro_sql_query($sqlQuery, $dbHandler);
 694 
 695     if ($result)
 696     {
 697         if ($dbHandler == '#') return mysql_affected_rows();
 698         else                   return mysql_affected_rows($dbHandler);
 699 
 700         // NOTE. To make claro_sql_query_affected_rows() work properly,
 701         // database connection is required with CLIENT_FOUND_ROWS flag.
 702         //
 703         // When using UPDATE, MySQL will not update columns where the new
 704         // value is the same as the old value. This creates the possiblity
 705         // that mysql_affected_rows() may not actually equal the number of
 706         // rows matched, only the number of rows that were literally affected
 707         // by the query. But this behavior can be changed by setting the
 708         // CLIENT_FOUND_ROWS flag in mysql_connect(). mysql_affected_rows()
 709         // will return then the number of rows matched, even if none are
 710         // updated.
 711     }
 712     else
 713     {
 714         return false;
 715     }
 716 }

  14 /**
  15  * CLAROLINE mySQL query wrapper. It allows to send multiple query at once to SQl server in a single string
  16  *
  17  * @author Guillaume Lederer    <guillaume@claroline.net>,
  18  * @param  string  $sqlQueries   - the string containing sql queries to apply
  19  * @param  bool $breakOnFailure  - stop query execution if one query failed (default true)
  20  * @return true on success, false on failure
  21  * @deprecated since Claroline 1.9, use Claroline::getDatabase() and new classes
  22  *  in database/extra.lib.php instead
  23  */
  24 function claro_sql_multi_query( $sqlQueries, $breakOnFailure = true )
  25 {
  26    $queryArray = PMA_splitSqlFile( $sqlQueries );
  27    
  28    foreach ($queryArray as $theQuery)
  29     {
  30         if (!$theQuery['empty'])
  31         {
  32             if ( true === $breakOnFailure
  33                 && false === claro_sql_query($theQuery['query'] ) )
  34             {
  35                 return false;
  36             }
  37         }
  38     }
  39     
  40    return true;
  41 }
  42 
  43 /**
  44  * FUNCTION TAKEN FROM PHPMYADMIN TO ALLOW MULTIPLE SQL QUERIES AT ONCE
  45  * Removes comment lines and splits up large sql files into individual queries
  46  *
  47  * Last revision: September 23, 2001 - gandon
  48  * @param   string  $sql the sql commands
  49  * @return  array   the splitted queries
  50  * @access  public
  51  * @deprecated since Claroline 1.9, use Claroline::getDatabase() and new classes
  52  *  in database/extra.lib.php instead
  53  */
  54 function PMA_splitSqlFile( $sql )
  55 {
  56     $ret = array();
  57     // do not trim, see bug #1030644
  58     //$sql          = trim($sql);
  59     $sql          = rtrim($sql, "\n\r");
  60     $sql_len      = strlen($sql);
  61     $char         = '';
  62     $string_start = '';
  63     $in_string    = FALSE;
  64     $nothing      = TRUE;
  65     for ($i = 0; $i < $sql_len; ++$i)
  66     {
  67         $char = $sql[$i];
  68         // We are in a string, check for not escaped end of strings except for
  69         // backquotes that can't be escaped
  70         if ($in_string)
  71         {
  72             for (;;)
  73             {
  74                 $i         = strpos($sql, $string_start, $i);
  75                 // No end of string found -> add the current substring to the
  76                 // returned array
  77                 if (!$i)
  78                 {
  79                     $ret[] = array('query' => $sql, 'empty' => $nothing);
  80                     return $ret;
  81                 }
  82                 // Backquotes or no backslashes before quotes: it's indeed the
  83                 // end of the string -> exit the loop
  84                 else if ($string_start == '`' || $sql[$i-1] != '\\')
  85                 {
  86                     $string_start      = '';
  87                     $in_string         = FALSE;
  88                     break;
  89                 }
  90                 // one or more Backslashes before the presumed end of string...
  91                 else
  92                 {
  93                     // ... first checks for escaped backslashes
  94                     $j                     = 2;
  95                     $escaped_backslash     = FALSE;
  96                     while ($i-$j > 0 && $sql[$i-$j] == '\\') {
  97                         $escaped_backslash = !$escaped_backslash;
  98                         $j++;
  99                     }
 100                     // ... if escaped backslashes: it's really the end of the
 101                     // string -> exit the loop
 102                     if ($escaped_backslash)
 103                     {
 104                         $string_start  = '';
 105                         $in_string     = FALSE;
 106                         break;
 107                     }
 108                     // ... else loop
 109                     else
 110                     {
 111                         $i++;
 112                     }
 113                 } // end if...elseif...else
 114             } // end for
 115         } // end if (in string)
 116         
 117         // lets skip comments (/*, -- and #)
 118         else if (($char == '-' && $sql_len > $i + 2 && $sql[$i + 1] == '-' && $sql[$i + 2] <= ' ')
 119             || $char == '#' || ($char == '/' && $sql_len > $i + 1 && $sql[$i + 1] == '*'))
 120         {
 121             $i = strpos($sql, $char == '/' ? '*/' : "\n", $i);
 122             // didn't we hit end of string?
 123             if ($i === FALSE)
 124             {
 125                 break;
 126             }
 127             if ($char == '/') $i++;
 128         }
 129         
 130         // We are not in a string, first check for delimiter...
 131         else if ($char == ';')
 132         {
 133             // if delimiter found, add the parsed part to the returned array
 134             $ret[]      = array('query' => substr($sql, 0, $i), 'empty' => $nothing);
 135             $nothing    = TRUE;
 136             $sql        = ltrim(substr($sql, min($i + 1, $sql_len)));
 137             $sql_len    = strlen($sql);
 138             if ($sql_len)
 139             {
 140                 $i      = -1;
 141             }
 142             else
 143             {
 144                 // The submited statement(s) end(s) here
 145                 return $ret;
 146             }
 147         } // end else if (is delimiter)
 148 
 149         // ... then check for start of a string,...
 150         else if (($char == '"') || ($char == '\'') || ($char == '`'))
 151         {
 152             $in_string    = TRUE;
 153             $nothing      = FALSE;
 154             $string_start = $char;
 155         } // end else if (is start of string)
 156         elseif ($nothing)
 157         {
 158             $nothing = FALSE;
 159         }
 160     } // end for
 161 
 162     // add any rest to the returned array
 163     if (!empty($sql) && preg_match('@[^[:space:]]+@', $sql))
 164     {
 165         $ret[] = array('query' => $sql, 'empty' => $nothing);
 166     }
 167 
 168     return $ret;
 169 }

  14 class claro_text_zone
  15 {
  16 
  17     /**
  18      * Build the file path of a textzone in a given context
  19      *
  20      * @param string $key
  21      * @param array $context specify the context to build the path.
  22      * @param array $right specify an array of right to specify the file
  23      * @return file path
  24      */
  25     public static function get_textzone_file_path ( $key, $context = null, $right = null )
  26     {
  27         $textZoneFile = null;
  28         $key .= '.';
  29 
  30         if ( !is_null ( $right ) && is_array ( $right ) )
  31         {
  32             foreach ( $right as $context => $rightInContext )
  33             {
  34                 if ( is_array ( $rightInContext ) )
  35                 {
  36                     $key .= $context . '_';
  37                     
  38                     foreach ( $rightInContext as $rightName => $rightValue )
  39                     {
  40                         if ( is_bool ( $rightValue ) )
  41                         {
  42                             $key .= ($rightValue) ? $rightName : 'not_' . $rightName;
  43                         }
  44                         else
  45                         {
  46                             $key .= $rightName . '_' . $rightValue;
  47                         }
  48                         
  49                         $key .= '.';
  50                     }
  51                 }
  52             }
  53         }
  54         
  55         if ( is_array ( $context ) && array_key_exists ( CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE, $context ) )
  56         {
  57             if ( is_array ( $context ) && array_key_exists ( CLARO_CONTEXT_GROUP, $context ) )
  58             {
  59                 $textZoneFile = get_conf ( 'coursesRepositorySys' ) 
  60                     . claro_get_course_group_path ( $context ) 
  61                     . '/textzone/' . $key . 'inc.html'
  62                     ;
  63             }
  64             else
  65             {
  66                 $textZoneFile = get_conf ( 'coursesRepositorySys' ) 
  67                     . claro_get_course_path ( $context[ CLARO_CONTEXT_COURSE ] ) 
  68                     . '/textzone/' . $key . 'inc.html'
  69                     ;
  70             }
  71         }
  72         
  73         if ( is_null ( $textZoneFile ) )
  74         {
  75             $textZoneFile = get_path ( 'rootSys' ) 
  76                 . 'platform/textzone/' . $key . 'inc.html'
  77                 ;
  78         }
  79         
  80         pushClaroMessage($textZoneFile);
  81 
  82         return $textZoneFile;
  83     }
  84 
  85     /**
  86      * return the content
  87      *
  88      * @param coursecode $key
  89      * @param array $context
  90      * @return string : html content
  91      */
  92     public static function get_content ( $key, $context = null, $right = null )
  93     {
  94         $textZoneFile = claro_text_zone::get_textzone_file_path ( $key, $context, $right );
  95 
  96         if ( file_exists ( $textZoneFile ) )
  97         {
  98             $content = file_get_contents ( $textZoneFile );
  99         }
 100         else
 101         {
 102             $content = '';
 103         }
 104         
 105         return $content;
 106     }

 108     /**
 109      * return the content
 110      *
 111      * @param coursecode $key
 112      * @param array $context
 113      * @return string : html content
 114      */
 115     public static function get_block ( $key, $isadmin, $context = null, $right = null )
 116     {
 117         $out = self::get_content($key, $context, $right);
 118         
 119         
 120         if (  $isadmin )
 121         {
 122             $out .= '<p>' . "\n"
 123                 .    '<a href="'.get_path('rootAdminWeb').'managing/editFile.php?cmd=rqEdit&amp;file=textzone_messaging_top.inc.html">' . "\n"
 124                 .    '<img src="'.get_icon_url('edit').'" alt="" />' . get_lang('Edit text zone') . "\n"
 125                 .    '</a>' . "\n"
 126                 .    '</p>';
 127         }
 128         
 129         return $out;
 130     }

 433   /**
 434    * Adds a "Reply-to" address.

 441   }

 443   /**
 444    * Adds an address to one of the recipient arrays
 445    * Addresses that have been added already return false, but do not throw exceptions
 446    * @param string $kind One of 'to', 'cc', 'bcc', 'ReplyTo'
 447    * @param string $address The email address to send to
 448    * @param string $name
 449    * @return boolean true on success, false if address already used or invalid in some way
 450    * @access private
 451    */
 452   private function AddAnAddress($kind, $address, $name = '') {
 453     if (!preg_match('/^(to|cc|bcc|ReplyTo)$/', $kind)) {
 454       echo 'Invalid recipient array: ' . kind;
 455       return false;
 456     }
 457     $address = trim($address);
 458     $name = trim(preg_replace('/[\r\n]+/', '', $name)); //Strip breaks and trim
 459     if (!self::ValidateAddress($address)) {
 460       $this->SetError($this->Lang('invalid_address').': '. $address);
 461       if ($this->exceptions) {
 462         throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('invalid_address').': '.$address);
 463       }
 464       echo $this->Lang('invalid_address').': '.$address;
 465       return false;
 466     }
 467     if ($kind != 'ReplyTo') {
 468       if (!isset($this->all_recipients[strtolower($address)])) {
 469         array_push($this->$kind, array($address, $name));
 470         $this->all_recipients[strtolower($address)] = true;
 471         return true;
 472       }
 473     } else {
 474       if (!array_key_exists(strtolower($address), $this->ReplyTo)) {
 475         $this->ReplyTo[strtolower($address)] = array($address, $name);
 476       return true;
 477     }
 478   }
 479   return false;
 480 }

 482 /**

 488   public function SetFrom($address, $name = '',$auto=1) {

 490     $name = trim(preg_replace('/[\r\n]+/', '', $name)); //Strip breaks and trim
 491     if (!self::ValidateAddress($address)) {
 492       $this->SetError($this->Lang('invalid_address').': '. $address);
 493       if ($this->exceptions) {
 494         throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('invalid_address').': '.$address);
 495       }
 496       echo $this->Lang('invalid_address').': '.$address;
 497       return false;
 498     }
 499     $this->From = $address;
 500     $this->FromName = $name;
 501     if ($auto) {
 502       if (empty($this->ReplyTo)) {
 503         $this->AddAnAddress('ReplyTo', $address, $name);
 504       }
 505       if (empty($this->Sender)) {
 506         $this->Sender = $address;
 507       }
 508     }
 509     return true;
 510   }

 512   /**
 513    * Check that a string looks roughly like an email address should
 514    * Static so it can be used without instantiation
 515    * Tries to use PHP built-in validator in the filter extension (from PHP 5.2), falls back to a reasonably competent regex validator
 516    * Conforms approximately to RFC2822
 517    * @link http://www.hexillion.com/samples/#Regex Original pattern found here
 518    * @param string $address The email address to check
 519    * @return boolean
 520    * @static
 521    * @access public
 522    */
 523   public static function ValidateAddress($address) {
 524     if (function_exists('filter_var')) { //Introduced in PHP 5.2
 525       if(filter_var($address, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) === FALSE) {
 526         return false;
 527       } else {
 528         return true;
 529       }
 530     } else {
 531       return preg_match('/^(?:[\w\!\#\$\%\&\'\*\+\-\/\=\?\^\`\{\|\}\~]+\.)*[\w\!\#\$\%\&\'\*\+\-\/\=\?\^\`\{\|\}\~]+@(?:(?:(?:[a-zA-Z0-9_](?:[a-zA-Z0-9_\-](?!\.)){0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9_-]?\.)+[a-zA-Z0-9_](?:[a-zA-Z0-9_\-](?!$)){0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9_]?)|(?:\[(?:(?:[01]?\d{1,2}|2[0-4]\d|25[0-5])\.){3}(?:[01]?\d{1,2}|2[0-4]\d|25[0-5])\]))$/', $address);
 532     }
 533   }

 539   /**
 540    * Creates message and assigns Mailer. If the message is
 541    * not sent successfully then it returns false.  Use the ErrorInfo
 542    * variable to view description of the error.
 543    * @return bool
 544    */
 545   public function Send() {
 546     try {
 547       if ((count($this->to) + count($this->cc) + count($this->bcc)) < 1) {
 548         throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('provide_address'), self::STOP_CRITICAL);
 549       }
 550 
 551       // Set whether the message is multipart/alternative
 552       if(!empty($this->AltBody)) {
 553         $this->ContentType = 'multipart/alternative';
 554       }
 555 
 556       $this->error_count = 0; // reset errors
 557       $this->SetMessageType();
 558       $header = $this->CreateHeader();
 559       $body = $this->CreateBody();
 560 
 561       if (empty($this->Body)) {
 562         throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('empty_message'), self::STOP_CRITICAL);
 563       }
 564 
 565       // digitally sign with DKIM if enabled
 566       if ($this->DKIM_domain && $this->DKIM_private) {
 567         $header_dkim = $this->DKIM_Add($header,$this->Subject,$body);
 568         $header = str_replace("\r\n","\n",$header_dkim) . $header;
 569       }
 570 
 571       // Choose the mailer and send through it
 572       switch($this->Mailer) {
 573         case 'sendmail':
 574           return $this->SendmailSend($header, $body);
 575         case 'smtp':
 576           return $this->SmtpSend($header, $body);
 577         default:
 578           return $this->MailSend($header, $body);
 579       }
 580 
 581     } catch (phpmailerException $e) {
 582       $this->SetError($e->getMessage());
 583       if ($this->exceptions) {
 584         throw $e;
 585       }
 586       echo $e->getMessage()."\n";
 587       return false;
 588     }
 589   }

 591   /**
 592    * Sends mail using the $Sendmail program.
 593    * @param string $header The message headers
 594    * @param string $body The message body
 595    * @access protected
 596    * @return bool
 597    */
 598   protected function SendmailSend($header, $body) {
 599     if ($this->Sender != '') {
 600       $sendmail = sprintf("%s -oi -f %s -t", escapeshellcmd($this->Sendmail), escapeshellarg($this->Sender));
 601     } else {
 602       $sendmail = sprintf("%s -oi -t", escapeshellcmd($this->Sendmail));
 603     }
 604     if ($this->SingleTo === true) {
 605       foreach ($this->SingleToArray as $key => $val) {
 606         if(!@$mail = popen($sendmail, 'w')) {
 607           throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('execute') . $this->Sendmail, self::STOP_CRITICAL);
 608         }
 609         fputs($mail, "To: " . $val . "\n");
 610         fputs($mail, $header);
 611         fputs($mail, $body);
 612         $result = pclose($mail);
 613         // implement call back function if it exists
 614         $isSent = ($result == 0) ? 1 : 0;
 615         $this->doCallback($isSent,$val,$this->cc,$this->bcc,$this->Subject,$body);
 616         if($result != 0) {
 617           throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('execute') . $this->Sendmail, self::STOP_CRITICAL);
 618         }
 619       }
 620     } else {
 621       if(!@$mail = popen($sendmail, 'w')) {
 622         throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('execute') . $this->Sendmail, self::STOP_CRITICAL);
 623       }
 624       fputs($mail, $header);
 625       fputs($mail, $body);
 626       $result = pclose($mail);
 627       // implement call back function if it exists
 628       $isSent = ($result == 0) ? 1 : 0;
 629       $this->doCallback($isSent,$this->to,$this->cc,$this->bcc,$this->Subject,$body);
 630       if($result != 0) {
 631         throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('execute') . $this->Sendmail, self::STOP_CRITICAL);
 632       }
 633     }
 634     return true;
 635   }

 637   /**
 638    * Sends mail using the PHP mail() function.
 639    * @param string $header The message headers
 640    * @param string $body The message body
 641    * @access protected
 642    * @return bool
 643    */
 644   protected function MailSend($header, $body) {
 645     $toArr = array();
 646     foreach($this->to as $t) {
 647       $toArr[] = $this->AddrFormat($t);
 648     }
 649     $to = implode(', ', $toArr);
 650 
 651     $params = sprintf("-oi -f %s", $this->Sender);
 652     if ($this->Sender != '' && strlen(ini_get('safe_mode'))< 1) {
 653       $old_from = ini_get('sendmail_from');
 654       ini_set('sendmail_from', $this->Sender);
 655       if ($this->SingleTo === true && count($toArr) > 1) {
 656         foreach ($toArr as $key => $val) {
 657           $rt = @mail($val, $this->EncodeHeader($this->SecureHeader($this->Subject)), $body, $header, $params);
 658           // implement call back function if it exists
 659           $isSent = ($rt == 1) ? 1 : 0;
 660           $this->doCallback($isSent,$val,$this->cc,$this->bcc,$this->Subject,$body);
 661         }
 662       } else {
 663         $rt = @mail($to, $this->EncodeHeader($this->SecureHeader($this->Subject)), $body, $header, $params);
 664         // implement call back function if it exists
 665         $isSent = ($rt == 1) ? 1 : 0;
 666         $this->doCallback($isSent,$to,$this->cc,$this->bcc,$this->Subject,$body);
 667       }
 668     } else {
 669       if ($this->SingleTo === true && count($toArr) > 1) {
 670         foreach ($toArr as $key => $val) {
 671           $rt = @mail($val, $this->EncodeHeader($this->SecureHeader($this->Subject)), $body, $header, $params);
 672           // implement call back function if it exists
 673           $isSent = ($rt == 1) ? 1 : 0;
 674           $this->doCallback($isSent,$val,$this->cc,$this->bcc,$this->Subject,$body);
 675         }
 676       } else {
 677         $rt = @mail($to, $this->EncodeHeader($this->SecureHeader($this->Subject)), $body, $header);
 678         // implement call back function if it exists
 679         $isSent = ($rt == 1) ? 1 : 0;
 680         $this->doCallback($isSent,$to,$this->cc,$this->bcc,$this->Subject,$body);
 681       }
 682     }
 683     if (isset($old_from)) {
 684       ini_set('sendmail_from', $old_from);
 685     }
 686     if(!$rt) {
 687       throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('instantiate'), self::STOP_CRITICAL);
 688     }
 689     return true;
 690   }
 691 
 692   /**
 693    * Sends mail via SMTP using PhpSMTP
 694    * Returns false if there is a bad MAIL FROM, RCPT, or DATA input.
 695    * @param string $header The message headers
 696    * @param string $body The message body
 697    * @uses SMTP
 698    * @access protected
 699    * @return bool
 700    */
 701   protected function SmtpSend($header, $body) {
 702     require_once $this->PluginDir . 'class.smtp.php';
 703     $bad_rcpt = array();
 704 
 705     if(!$this->SmtpConnect()) {
 706       throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('smtp_connect_failed'), self::STOP_CRITICAL);
 707     }
 708     $smtp_from = ($this->Sender == '') ? $this->From : $this->Sender;
 709     if(!$this->smtp->Mail($smtp_from)) {
 710       throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('from_failed') . $smtp_from, self::STOP_CRITICAL);
 711     }
 712 
 713     // Attempt to send attach all recipients
 714     foreach($this->to as $to) {
 715       if (!$this->smtp->Recipient($to[0])) {
 716         $bad_rcpt[] = $to[0];
 717         // implement call back function if it exists
 718         $isSent = 0;
 719         $this->doCallback($isSent,$to[0],'','',$this->Subject,$body);
 720       } else {
 721         // implement call back function if it exists
 722         $isSent = 1;
 723         $this->doCallback($isSent,$to[0],'','',$this->Subject,$body);
 724       }
 725     }
 726     foreach($this->cc as $cc) {
 727       if (!$this->smtp->Recipient($cc[0])) {
 728         $bad_rcpt[] = $cc[0];
 729         // implement call back function if it exists
 730         $isSent = 0;
 731         $this->doCallback($isSent,'',$cc[0],'',$this->Subject,$body);
 732       } else {
 733         // implement call back function if it exists
 734         $isSent = 1;
 735         $this->doCallback($isSent,'',$cc[0],'',$this->Subject,$body);
 736       }
 737     }
 738     foreach($this->bcc as $bcc) {
 739       if (!$this->smtp->Recipient($bcc[0])) {
 740         $bad_rcpt[] = $bcc[0];
 741         // implement call back function if it exists
 742         $isSent = 0;
 743         $this->doCallback($isSent,'','',$bcc[0],$this->Subject,$body);
 744       } else {
 745         // implement call back function if it exists
 746         $isSent = 1;
 747         $this->doCallback($isSent,'','',$bcc[0],$this->Subject,$body);
 748       }
 749     }
 750 
 751 
 752     if (count($bad_rcpt) > 0 ) { //Create error message for any bad addresses
 753       $badaddresses = implode(', ', $bad_rcpt);
 754       throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('recipients_failed') . $badaddresses);
 755     }
 756     if(!$this->smtp->Data($header . $body)) {
 757       throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('data_not_accepted'), self::STOP_CRITICAL);
 758     }
 759     if($this->SMTPKeepAlive == true) {
 760       $this->smtp->Reset();
 761     }
 762     return true;
 763   }
 764 
 765   /**
 766    * Initiates a connection to an SMTP server.
 767    * Returns false if the operation failed.
 768    * @uses SMTP
 769    * @access public
 770    * @return bool
 771    */
 772   public function SmtpConnect() {
 773     if(is_null($this->smtp)) {
 774       $this->smtp = new SMTP();
 775     }
 776 
 777     $this->smtp->do_debug = $this->SMTPDebug;
 778     $hosts = explode(';', $this->Host);
 779     $index = 0;
 780     $connection = $this->smtp->Connected();
 781 
 782     // Retry while there is no connection
 783     try {
 784       while($index < count($hosts) && !$connection) {
 785         $hostinfo = array();
 786         if (preg_match('/^(.+):([0-9]+)$/', $hosts[$index], $hostinfo)) {
 787           $host = $hostinfo[1];
 788           $port = $hostinfo[2];
 789         } else {
 790           $host = $hosts[$index];
 791           $port = $this->Port;
 792         }
 793 
 794         $tls = ($this->SMTPSecure == 'tls');
 795         $ssl = ($this->SMTPSecure == 'ssl');
 796 
 797         if ($this->smtp->Connect(($ssl ? 'ssl://':'').$host, $port, $this->Timeout)) {
 798 
 799           $hello = ($this->Helo != '' ? $this->Helo : $this->ServerHostname());
 800           $this->smtp->Hello($hello);
 801 
 802           if ($tls) {
 803             if (!$this->smtp->StartTLS()) {
 804               throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('tls'));
 805             }
 806 
 807             //We must resend HELO after tls negotiation
 808             $this->smtp->Hello($hello);
 809           }
 810 
 811           $connection = true;
 812           if ($this->SMTPAuth) {
 813             if (!$this->smtp->Authenticate($this->Username, $this->Password)) {
 814               throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('authenticate'));
 815             }
 816           }
 817         }
 818         $index++;
 819         if (!$connection) {
 820           throw new phpmailerException($this->Lang('connect_host'));
 821         }
 822       }
 823     } catch (phpmailerException $e) {
 824       $this->smtp->Reset();
 825       throw $e;
 826     }
 827     return true;
 828   }

 830   /**
 831    * Closes the active SMTP session if one exists.

 833    */
 834   public function SmtpClose() {
 835     if(!is_null($this->smtp)) {
 836       if($this->smtp->Connected()) {
 837         $this->smtp->Quit();
 838         $this->smtp->Close();
 839       }
 840     }
 841   }

 843   /**

 845   * Returns false if it cannot load the language file.  The default language is English.
 846   * @param string $langcode ISO 639-1 2-character language code (e.g. Portuguese: "br")
 847   * @param string $lang_path Path to the language file directory
 848   * @access public
 849   */
 850   function SetLanguage($langcode = 'en', $lang_path = 'language/') {
 851     //Define full set of translatable strings
 852     $PHPMAILER_LANG = array(
 853       'provide_address' => 'You must provide at least one recipient email address.',
 854       'mailer_not_supported' => ' mailer is not supported.',
 855       'execute' => 'Could not execute: ',
 856       'instantiate' => 'Could not instantiate mail function.',
 857       'authenticate' => 'SMTP Error: Could not authenticate.',
 858       'from_failed' => 'The following From address failed: ',
 859       'recipients_failed' => 'SMTP Error: The following recipients failed: ',
 860       'data_not_accepted' => 'SMTP Error: Data not accepted.',
 861       'connect_host' => 'SMTP Error: Could not connect to SMTP host.',
 862       'file_access' => 'Could not access file: ',
 863       'file_open' => 'File Error: Could not open file: ',
 864       'encoding' => 'Unknown encoding: ',
 865       'signing' => 'Signing Error: ',
 866       'smtp_error' => 'SMTP server error: ',
 867       'empty_message' => 'Message body empty',
 868       'invalid_address' => 'Invalid address',
 869       'variable_set' => 'Cannot set or reset variable: '
 870     );
 871     //Overwrite language-specific strings. This way we'll never have missing translations - no more "language string failed to load"!
 872     $l = true;
 873     if ($langcode != 'en') { //There is no English translation file
 874       $l = @include $lang_path.'phpmailer.lang-'.$langcode.'.php';
 875     }
 876     $this->language = $PHPMAILER_LANG;
 877     return ($l == true); //Returns false if language not found

 892   /**
 893    * Creates recipient headers.
 894    * @access public
 895    * @return string
 896    */
 897   public function AddrAppend($type, $addr) {
 898     $addr_str = $type . ': ';

 900     foreach ($addr as $a) {
 901       $addresses[] = $this->AddrFormat($a);
 902     }
 903     $addr_str .= implode(', ', $addresses);
 904     $addr_str .= $this->LE;
 905 
 906     return $addr_str;

 909   /**

 913    */
 914   public function AddrFormat($addr) {
 915     if (empty($addr[1])) {
 916       return $this->SecureHeader($addr[0]);

 918       return $this->EncodeHeader($this->SecureHeader($addr[1]), 'phrase') . " <" . $this->SecureHeader($addr[0]) . ">";
