   5 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/classutils.lib.php';
   6 
   7 /**
   8  * Set of PHP classes to manipulate Claroline user classes
   9  *
  10  * @version 1.11 $Revision: 14526 $
  11  * @copyright (c) 2013 Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  12  * @license http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html (GPL) GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
  13  * @package kernel
  14  * @author Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  15  * @todo move to Claroline kernel
  16  */
  17 
  18 /**
  19  * @since Claroline 1.11.9
  20  */
  21 class Claro_Class_Exception extends Exception {}; 
  22 
  23 /**
  24  * Represent a user class
  25  * 
  26  * WARNING Claro_Class only deal with the class itself not with its users or 
  27  * their registration to courses. For example deleting a class will not remove 
  28  * its users or unregister them from the courses the class is registered to.
  29  * To manage class user list and course user registrations, you need to use 
  30  * Claro_ClassUserList and Claro_BatchCourseRegistration.
  31  * @since Claroline 1.11.9
  32  */
  33 class Claro_Class
  34 {
  35     protected 
  36         $id = null,
  37         $name = null,
  38         $parentId = null,
  39         $level = null;
  40     
  41     protected 
  42         $name_changed = false,
  43         $parentId_changed = false;
  44     
  45     protected
  46         $subClassesIdList = array(),
  47         $subClassesIterator = null,
  48         $parentClass = null;
  49     
  50     protected $database;
  51     
  52     /**
  53      * @param Database_Connection $database connection to the database
  54      */
  55     public function __construct( $database = null )
  56     {
  57         $this->database = $database ? $database : Claroline::getDatabase();    
  58     }
  59     
  60     public function fromArray( $data )
  61     {
  62         if ( !isset( $data['id'] ) || ! isset($data['name']) )
  63         {
  64             throw new Claro_Class_Exception("Invalid arguments supplied to method : missing id or name");
  65         }
  66         
  67         $this->id = $data['id'];
  68         $this->name = $data['name'];
  69         $this->level = $data['level'];
  70         $this->parentId = $data['parentId'];
  71     }
  72     
  73     /**
  74      * @param string $name class name
  75      * @return $this
  76      */
  77     public function setName( $name )
  78     {
  79         if ( $name != $this->name )
  80         {
  81             $this->name = $name;
  82             $this->name_changed = true;
  83         }
  84         
  85         return $this;
  86     }
  87     
  88     /**
  89      * @param int $parentId id of the parent class
  90      * @return $this
  91      */
  92     public function setParentId ( $parentId )
  93     {
  94         if ( $parentId != $this->parentId )
  95         {
  96             $this->parentId = $parentId;
  97             $this->parentId_changed = true;
  98         }
  99         
 100         return $this;
 101     }
 102     
 103     /**
 104      * Create ths class in database
 105      * @throws Claro_Class_Exception if class already exists (i.e. id given)
 106      * @throws Database_Connection_Exception in case of database error
 107      */
 108     public function create ( )
 109     {
 110         if ( $this->id )
 111         {
 112             throw new Claro_Class_Exception("Cannot create class : id not empty");
 113         }
 114         
 115         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 116         
 117         if ( $this->parentId )
 118         {
 119             // load parent class
 120             $parentClass = new self ( $this->database );
 121             $parentClass->load( $this->parentId );
 122             $this->level = $parentClass->getLevel()+1;
 123         }
 124         else
 125         {
 126             $this->level = 1;
 127         }
 128         
 129         $fields = array();
 130         
 131         $fields[] = "name = " . $this->database->quote( $this->name );
 132         
 133         if ( $this->parentId )
 134         {
 135             $parentClass = new self ( $this->database );
 136             $parentClass->load( $this->parentId );
 137             $this->level = $parentClass->getLevel()+1;
 138             $fields[] = "class_parent_id = " . $this->database->escape( $this->parentId );
 139         }
 140         else
 141         {
 142             $this->level = 1;
 143         }
 144 
 145         $fields[] = "class_level = " . $this->database->escape( $this->level );
 146         
 147         $this->database->exec("
 148             INSERT INTO 
 149                 `" . $tbl['class'] . "`
 150             SET
 151                 " . implode( ",\n", $fields ) . "
 152         ");
 153         
 154         $this->id = $this->database->insertId();
 155         
 156         return $this;
 157     }
 158     
 159     /**
 160      * Delete the class from the database
 161      */
 162     public function delete()
 163     {
 164         $this->unregisterFromAllCourses();
 165         
 166         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 167         
 168         $this->database->exec("
 169             DELETE FROM 
 170                 `" . $tbl['class'] . "`
 171             WHERE
 172                 id = " . $this->database->escape($this->id) . "
 173         ");
 174     }
 175     
 176     /**
 177      * Update ths class in database
 178      * @throws Claro_Class_Exception if class does not exists (i.e. no id given)
 179      * @throws Database_Connection_Exception in case of database error
 180      */
 181     public function update ( )
 182     {
 183         if ( ! $this->id )
 184         {
 185             throw new Exception("Cannot update class information : no id given");
 186         }
 187         
 188         $fields = array();
 189         
 190         if ( $this->name_changed )
 191         {
 192             $fields[] = "name = " . $this->database->quote( $this->name );
 193         }
 194         
 195         if ( $this->parentId_changed )
 196         {
 197             if ( $this->parentId )
 198             {
 199                 $parentClass = new self ( $this->database );
 200                 $parentClass->load( $this->parentId );
 201                 $this->level = $parentClass->getLevel()+1;
 202             }
 203             else
 204             {
 205                 $this->level = 1;
 206             }
 207             
 208             $fields[] = "class_parent_id = " . $this->database->escape( $this->parentId );
 209             $fields[] = "class_level = " . $this->database->escape( $this->level );
 210         }
 211         
 212         if ( count( $fields ) == 0 )
 213         {
 214             return $this;
 215         }
 216         
 217         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 218         
 219         $this->database->exec("
 220             UPDATE 
 221                 `" . $tbl['class'] . "`
 222             SET
 223                 " . implode( ",\n", $fields ) . "
 224             WHERE
 225                 id = " . $this->database->escape($this->id) . "
 226         ");
 227         
 228         return $this;
 229     }
 230     
 231     /**
 232      * Load a class
 233      * @param int $classId id of the class
 234      * @return Claro_Class
 235      * @throws Claro_Class_Exception if class does not exists (i.e. no id given)
 236      * @throws Database_Connection_Exception in case of database error
 237      */
 238     public function load( $classId )
 239     {
 240         $this->id = $classId;
 241         
 242         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 243         
 244         // what about the level ?
 245         
 246         $result = $this->database->query( "
 247             SELECT id,
 248                 name,
 249                 class_parent_id,
 250                 class_level
 251             FROM `" . $tbl['class'] . "`
 252             WHERE `id`= ". (int) $this->id )->fetch();
 253 
 254         if ( $result )
 255         {
 256             $this->parentId = $result['class_parent_id'];
 257             $this->name = $result['name'];
 258             $this->level = $result['class_level'];
 259             
 260             return $this;
 261         }
 262         else
 263         {
 264             throw new Claro_Class_Exception("Cannot load class {$this->id}");
 265         }
 266     }
 267     
 268     /**
 269      * Load a class
 270      * @param int $classId id of the class
 271      * @return Claro_Class
 272      * @throws Claro_Class_Exception if class does not exists (i.e. no id given)
 273      * @throws Database_Connection_Exception in case of database error
 274      */
 275     public function loadByName( $className )
 276     {
 277         $this->name = $className;
 278         
 279         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 280         
 281         // what about the level ?
 282         
 283         $result = $this->database->query( "
 284             SELECT id,
 285                 name,
 286                 class_parent_id,
 287                 class_level
 288             FROM `" . $tbl['class'] . "`
 289             WHERE `name` = ". $this->database->quote($this->name) )->fetch();
 290 
 291         if ( $result )
 292         {
 293             $this->parentId = $result['class_parent_id'];
 294             $this->id = $result['id'];
 295             $this->level = $result['class_level'];
 296             
 297             return $this;
 298         }
 299         else
 300         {
 301             throw new Claro_Class_Exception("Cannot load class {$this->id}");
 302         }
 303     }
 304     
 305     /**
 306      * Get the id of the class
 307      * @return int class id
 308      */
 309     public function getId()
 310     {
 311         return $this->id;
 312     }
 313     
 314     /**
 315      * Get the name of the class
 316      * @return string class name
 317      */
 318     public function getName()
 319     {
 320         return $this->name;
 321     }
 322     
 323     /**
 324      * Get the id of the parent class
 325      * @return int id of the parent class if any, null if no parent class
 326      */
 327     public function getParentId()
 328     {
 329         return $this->parentId;
 330     }
 331     
 332     /**
 333      * Get the level (i.e. the depth of the class in the class tree)
 334      * @return int depth of the class
 335      */
 336     public function getLevel()
 337     {
 338         return $this->level;
 339     }
 340     
 341     /**
 342      * Get the userlist of the class
 343      * @return Claro_ClassUserList
 344      */
 345     public function getClassUserList()
 346     {
 347         $classUserList = new Claro_ClassUserList( $this, $this->database );
 348         
 349         return $classUserList;
 350     }
 351     
 352     /**
 353      * Get the list of course in which the class is registered
 354      * @return Iterator
 355      */
 356     public function getClassCourseList()
 357     {
 358         $tbl  = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 359     
 360         return $this->database->query("
 361             SELECT
 362                 cc.courseId AS code,
 363                 cc.courseId AS courseId,
 364                 c.administrativeNumber,
 365                 c.intitule AS title,
 366                 c.titulaires AS titulars
 367             FROM 
 368                 `{$tbl['rel_course_class']}` AS `cc`
 369             JOIN
 370                 `{$tbl['course']}` AS `c`
 371             ON
 372                 `c`.`code` = `cc`.`courseId`
 373             WHERE
 374                 cc.classId = ".$this->database->escape($this->id)."
 375         ");
 376     }
 377     
 378     /**
 379      * Add the class (but not its users) to the given course
 380      * @param string $courseId course code
 381      * @return bool
 382      */
 383     public function registerToCourse( $courseId )
 384     {
 385         if ( $this->isRegisteredToCourse ( $courseId ) )
 386         {
 387             return false;
 388         }
 389         
 390         $tbl  = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 391     
 392         return $this->database->exec("
 393             INSERT INTO 
 394                 `{$tbl['rel_course_class']}`
 395             SET
 396                 classId = ".$this->database->escape($this->id).",
 397                 courseId = ".$this->database->quote( $courseId )."
 398         ");
 399     }
 400     
 401     /**
 402      * Remove the class (but not its users) from the given course
 403      * @param string $courseId course code
 404      * @return bool
 405      */
 406     public function unregisterFromCourse( $courseId )
 407     {
 408         if ( !$this->isRegisteredToCourse ( $courseId ) )
 409         {
 410             return false;
 411         }
 412         
 413         $tbl  = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 414     
 415         return $this->database->exec("
 416             DELETE FROM 
 417                 `{$tbl['rel_course_class']}`
 418             WHERE
 419                 classId = ".$this->database->escape($this->id)."
 420             AND
 421                 courseId = ".$this->database->quote( $courseId )."
 422         ");
 423     }
 424     
 425     /**
 426      * Unregister the class from all registred courses
 427      * @return \Claro_Class
 428      */
 429     public function unregisterFromAllCourses()
 430     {
 431         $courses = $this->getClassCourseList();
 432         
 433         foreach ( $courses as $course )
 434         {
 435             $this->unregisterFromCourse($course['courseId']);
 436         }
 437         
 438         return $this;
 439     }
 440     
 441     /**
 442      * Check if the class is registered to the given course
 443      * @param string $courseId course code
 444      * @return bool
 445      */
 446     public function isRegisteredToCourse( $courseId )
 447     {
 448         $tbl  = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 449     
 450         return $this->database->query("
 451             SELECT
 452                 courseId as code
 453             FROM 
 454                 `{$tbl['rel_course_class']}`
 455             WHERE
 456                 classId = ".$this->database->escape($this->id)."
 457             AND
 458                 courseId = ".$this->database->quote( $courseId )."
 459         ")->numRows() > 0;
 460     }
 461     
 462     protected function loadSubclassesList()
 463     {
 464         $parentId = $this->database->escape($this->id);
 465         
 466         $tbl = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 467         
 468         $subclasses = $this->database->query("
 469             SELECT id,
 470                 name,
 471                 class_parent_id as parentId,
 472                 class_level as level
 473             FROM `" . $tbl['class'] . "`
 474             WHERE `class_parent_id`= {$parentId}
 475         ");
 476             
 477         if ( $subclasses->numRows() )
 478         {
 479             foreach ( $subclasses as $sclass )
 480             {
 481                 $this->subClassesIdList[$sclass['id']] = $sclass['id'];
 482             }
 483         }
 484         
 485         $subclasses->rewind();
 486         
 487         $this->subClassesIterator = new Claro_ClassIterator( $subclasses, $this->database );
 488     }
 489     
 490     public function hasSubclasses()
 491     {
 492         if ( is_null($this->subClassesIterator ) )
 493         {
 494             $this->loadSubclassesList();
 495         }
 496         
 497         return count( $this->subClassesIdList ) > 0;
 498     }
 499     
 500     public function getSubClassesIterator()
 501     {
 502         if ( ! $this->hasSubclasses () )
 503         {
 504             throw new Claro_Class_Exception("This class has no subclasses");
 505         }
 506         else
 507         {
 508             return $this->subClassesIterator;
 509         }
 510     }
 511     
 512     public function getSubClassesIdList()
 513     {
 514         if ( ! $this->hasSubclasses () )
 515         {
 516             throw new Claro_Class_Exception("This class has no subclasses");
 517         }
 518         else
 519         {
 520             return $this->subClassesIdList;
 521         }
 522     }
 523     
 524     public function hasParent()
 525     {
 526         return $this->parentId ? true : false;
 527     }
 528     
 529     public function getParent()
 530     {
 531         if ( ! $this->hasParent () )
 532         {
 533             throw new Claro_Class_Exception("This class has no parent");
 534         }
 535     }
 536 }

 538 /**
 539  * User list of a class
 540  * @since Claroline 1.11.9
 541  */
 542 class Claro_ClassUserList
 543 {
 544     protected $class, $database, $tbl;
 545     
 546     protected $userIdList, $classUserList;
 547     
 548     /**
 549      * 
 550      * @param Claro_Class $class
 551      * @param Database_Connection $database
 552      */
 553     public function __construct( $class, $database = null )
 554     {
 555         $this->class = $class;
 556         $this->database = $database ? $database : Claroline::getDatabase();
 557         $this->userIdList = false;
 558         $this->tbl = get_module_main_tbl( array('rel_class_user') );
 559     }
 560     
 561     /**
 562      * Generate the query to add the given user ids
 563      * @param array $userIdList list of user id (array of int)
 564      * @return string
 565      */
 566     protected function generateAddUserListQuery ( $userIdList )
 567     {
 568         $alreadyInClass = $this->getUsersAlreadyInClass($userIdList);
 569         
 570         $lines = array();
 571         
 572         $classId = $this->class->getId();
 573         
 574         foreach ( $userIdList as $userId )
 575         {
 576             $userId = (int) $userId;
 577             
 578             if ( $userId > 0 && !isset($alreadyInClass[$userId])  )
 579             {
 580                 $lines[] = "({$userId}, {$classId})";
 581             }
 582         }
 583         
 584         if ( ! count( $lines ) )
 585         {
 586             return false;
 587         }
 588         
 589         return "INSERT INTO 
 590                 `{$this->tbl['rel_class_user']}`(user_id, class_id)
 591             VALUES
 592         " . implode ( ",\n", $lines ) . "
 593         ";
 594     }
 595     
 596     /**
 597      * Generate the query to remove the given user ids
 598      * @param array $userIdList list of user id (array of int)
 599      * @return string
 600      */
 601     protected function generateRemoveUserListQuery( $userIdList )
 602     {
 603         $ids = array();
 604         
 605         foreach ( $userIdList as $userId )
 606         {
 607             $userId = (int) $userId;
 608             
 609             if ( $userId > 0 )
 610             {
 611                 $ids[] = $userId;
 612             }
 613         }
 614         
 615         if ( ! count( $ids ) )
 616         {
 617             return false;
 618         }
 619         
 620         $classId = $this->class->getId();
 621 
 622         return "DELETE FROM 
 623                 `{$this->tbl['rel_class_user']}`
 624             WHERE 
 625                 user_id 
 626             IN 
 627                 ( " . implode( ',', array_unique( $ids ) ) . ")
 628             AND
 629                 class_id = {$classId}
 630          ";
 631     }
 632     
 633     /**
 634      * Generate the query to remove the given user ids
 635      * @param array $userIdList list of user ids (array of int)
 636      * @return string
 637      */
 638     protected function getUsersAlreadyInClass ( $userIdList )
 639     {
 640         $ids = array();
 641         
 642         $classId = $this->class->getId();
 643         
 644         $results = $this->database->query("
 645             SELECT 
 646                 user_id 
 647             FROM 
 648                 `{$this->tbl['rel_class_user']}` 
 649             WHERE 
 650                 class_id = {$classId}
 651             AND
 652                 user_id IN (".implode( ',', $userIdList ).")");
 653                 
 654         foreach ( $results as $user )
 655         {
 656             $ids[$user['user_id']] = true;
 657         }
 658         
 659         return $ids;
 660     }

 677     public function addUserIdList ( $userIdList )
 678     {
 679         if ( ! count( $userIdList ) )
 680         {
 681             return false;
 682         }
 683         // register users to class
 684         $query = $this->generateAddUserListQuery($userIdList);
 685         
 686         if ( $query )
 687         {     
 688             return $this->database->exec( $query );
 689         }
 690         else
 691         {
 692             return false;
 693         }
 694         
 695         // register users to course
 696         // is this the role of the class ?
 697     }

 712      * @return boolean
 713      */
 714     public function removeUserIdList ( $userIdList )
 715     {
 716         // remove users from courses

 718         
 719         if ( $query )
 720         {     
 721             return $this->database->exec( $query );
 722         }
 723         else
 724         {
 725             return false;
 726         }
 727         // remove users from class
 728     }
 729     
 730     /**
 731      * Remove all users from the class
 732      * @return bool
 733      */
 734     public function removeAllUsers()
 735     {
 736         $classId = $this->class->getId();

 749      */
 750     public function getClassUserIdListIterator( $forceRefresh = false )
 751     {

 753         {
 754             $classId = $this->class->getId();
 755 
 756             $this->userIdList = $this->database->query("

 764         
 765         return $this->userIdList;

 768     /**
 769      * Get the iterator of user id list
 770      * @param boolean $forceRefresh
 771      * @return return user id list (array of int)
 772      */
 773     public function getClassUserIdList( $forceRefresh = false )
 774     {
 775         $it = $this->getClassUserIdListIterator($forceRefresh);
 776         
 777         $list = array();

 780         {
 781             $list[$row['user_id']] = $row['user_id'];
 782         }

 786     
 787     /**
 788      * Get the iterator for the users registered in the class
 789      * @param bool $forceRefresh
 790      * @return Iterator Countable
 791      */
 792     public function getClassUserListIterator ( $forceRefresh = false )
 793     {
 794         if ( !is_array ( $this->classUserList ) || $forceRefresh )
 795         {
 796             $tbl_mdb_names = claro_sql_get_main_tbl ();
 797             $tbl_user = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'user' ];
 798             $tbl_rel_class_user = $tbl_mdb_names[ 'rel_class_user' ];
 799 
 800             $classId = $this->database->quote ( $this->class->getId () );
 801 
 802             $this->classUserList = $this->database->query ( "
 803                 SELECT 
 804                     u.username AS username,
 805                     u.nom AS lastname,
 806                     u.prenom AS firstname,
 807                     u.email AS email,
 808                     u.officialCode AS fgs,
 809                     cu.user_id AS user_id
 810                 FROM
 811                     `{$tbl_rel_class_user}` AS cu
 812                 JOIN
 813                     `{$tbl_user}` AS u
 814                 ON
 815                     cu.user_id = u.user_id
 816                 WHERE
 817                     cu.class_id = {$classId}
 818                 ORDER BY
 819                     u.nom, u.prenom, u.email
 820             " );
 821         }
 822 
 823         return $this->classUserList;
 824     }

 826     /**

 828      * @param type $forceRefresh
 829      * @return array of user_id => user(username, firstname, lastname, email, user_id)
 830      */
 831     public function getClassUserList( $forceRefresh = false )
 832     {
 833         $classUserList = array ( );
 834 
 835         foreach ( $this->getClassUserIdListIterator ( $forceRefresh ) as $user )
 836         {

 838             $classUserList[ $user['user_id'] ] = $user;

 840 
 841         return $classUserList;

 858         return $classUsernameList;

 861     /**
 862      * Check if a user id is in the course
 863      * @param int $userId
 864      * @return boolean
 865      */
 866     public function isUserIdInClass( $userId )
 867     {
 868         $classId = $this->class->getId();
 869         $userId = $this->database->escape( $userId );
 870 
 871         return $this->database->query("
 872             SELECT 
 873                 user_id 
 874             FROM 
 875                 `{$this->tbl['rel_class_user']}` 
 876             WHERE 
 877                 class_id = {$classId}
 878             AND
 879                 user_id = {$userId}" )->numRows() > 0;
 880     }
 881 }

 883 class Claro_CourseClassList
 884 {
 885     private $course, $database;
 886     
 887     public function __construct ( $course, $database = null )
 888     {
 889         $this->course = $course;
 890         $this->database = $database ? $database : Claroline::getDatabase();
 891     }
 892     
 893     public function getClassListIterator()
 894     {
 895         $tbl  = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 896     
 897         $classList = $this->database->query("
 898             SELECT
 899                 c.id,
 900                 c.name,
 901                 c.class_parent_id as parentId,
 902                 c.class_level as level
 903             FROM 
 904                 `{$tbl['rel_course_class']}` AS `cc`
 905             JOIN
 906                 `{$tbl['class']}` AS `c`
 907             ON
 908                 `c`.`id` = `cc`.`classId`
 909             WHERE
 910                 cc.courseId = ".$this->database->quote($this->course->courseId)."
 911         ");
 912         
 913         $classIterator = new Claro_ClassIterator($classList);
 914         
 915         return $classIterator;
 916     }
 917 }
 918 
 919 class Claro_ClassIterator extends RowToObjectIteratorIterator
 920 {
 921     protected
 922         $database;
 923     
 924     public function __construct ( CountableIterator $internalIterator, $database = null )
 925     {
 926         $this->database = $database ? $database : Claroline::getDatabase();
 927         parent::__construct ( $internalIterator );
 928     }
 929     public function current ()
 930     {
 931         $claroClass = new Claro_Class();
 932         $claroClass->fromArray( $this->internalIterator->current() );
 933         
 934         return $claroClass;
 935     }    
 936 }

   3 /**
   4  * Utility function to manipulate Claroline user classes
   5  * @version 1.11 $Revision: 14502 $

  10  * @todo move to Claroline kernel
  11  */
  12 
  13 /**
  14  * Get the number of users in a class. 
  15  * @param int $class_id id of the class
  16  * @param bool $include_children if set to true recursively count users in subclasses
  17  * @return int
  18  */
  19 function class_get_number_of_users( $class_id, $include_children = true )
  20 {
  21     $tbl_mdb_names  = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  22     $tbl_class_user = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_class_user'];
  23     $tbl_class      = $tbl_mdb_names['class'];
  24     //1- get class users number
  25 
  26     $sqlcount = "SELECT COUNT(`user_id`) AS qty_user
  27                  FROM `" . $tbl_class_user . "`
  28                  WHERE `class_id`=" . (int) $class_id;
  29 
  30     $qty_user =  Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sqlcount)->setFetchMode ( Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE )->fetch();
  31     
  32     if ( $include_children )
  33     {
  34 
  35         $sql = "SELECT `id`
  36                 FROM `" . $tbl_class . "`
  37                 WHERE `class_parent_id`=" . (int) $class_id;
  38 
  39         $subClassesList = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
  40 
  41         //2- recursive call to get subclasses'users too
  42 
  43         foreach ( $subClassesList as $subClass )
  44         {
  45             $qty_user += class_get_number_of_users( $subClass['id'], true );
  46         }
  47     }
  48 
  49     //3- return result of counts and recursive calls
  50 
  51     return $qty_user;
  52 }
  53 
  54 /**
  55  * Count the number of student in both the given course and the given class
  56  * @param string $course_id
  57  * @param int $class_id
  58  * @param bool $include_children recursively count students from subclasses
  59  * @return int
  60  */
  61 function class_get_number_of_users_in_course( $course_id, $class_id, $include_children = true )
  62 {
  63     $tbl_mdb_names  = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
  64     $tbl_class_user = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_class_user'];
  65     $tbl_class      = $tbl_mdb_names['class'];
  66     $tbl_course_user = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user' ];
  67     
  68     $sqlCourseId = Claroline::getDatabase()->quote( $course_id );
  69     
  70     //1- get class users number
  71 
  72     $sqlcount = "SELECT COUNT(clu.`user_id`) AS qty_user
  73                  FROM `{$tbl_class_user}` AS clu
  74                  INNER JOIN `{$tbl_course_user}` AS cu 
  75                  ON `cu`.`user_id` = `clu`.`user_id`
  76                  AND `cu`.`code_cours` = {$sqlCourseId}
  77                  WHERE clu.`class_id` = " . (int) $class_id;
  78 
  79     $qty_user =  Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sqlcount)->setFetchMode ( Database_ResultSet::FETCH_VALUE )->fetch();
  80     
  81     if ( $include_children )
  82     {
  83 
  84         $sql = "SELECT `id`
  85                 FROM `" . $tbl_class . "`
  86                 WHERE `class_parent_id`=" . (int) $class_id;
  87 
  88         $subClassesList = Claroline::getDatabase()->query($sql);
  89 
  90         //2- recursive call to get subclasses'users too
  91 
  92         foreach ( $subClassesList as $subClass )
  93         {
  94             $qty_user += class_get_number_of_users_in_course( $subClass['id'], true );
  95         }
  96     }
  97 
  98     //3- return result of counts and recursive calls
  99 
 100     return $qty_user;
 101 }

 260     /**
 261      * Subscribe a specific user to a specific course.  If this course is a session
 262      * course, the user will also be subscribed to the source course.
 263      * @return boolean TRUE  if it succeeds, FALSE otherwise
 264      */
 265     public function addUser()
 266     {
 267         if ( !$this->isRegistrationAllowed() )
 268         {
 269             
 270             return false;
 271         }
 272         
 273         $userId = $this->userAuthProfile->getUserId();
 274         $courseCode = $this->course->courseId;
 275         
 276         $tbl_mdb_names          = claro_sql_get_main_tbl();
 277         $tbl_user               = $tbl_mdb_names['user'];
 278         $tbl_rel_course_user    = $tbl_mdb_names['rel_course_user'];
 279 
 280         if (  Claroline::getDatabase()->query("
 281             SELECT
 282                 user_id
 283             FROM
 284                 `{$tbl_user}`
 285             WHERE
 286                 user_id = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->escape($userId) )->numRows() == 0 )
 287         {
 288             $this->status = self::STATUS_SYSTEM_ERROR;
 289             $this->errorMessage = get_lang('User not found');
 290             return false;
 291         }
 292         else
 293         {
 294             // Previously check if the user isn't already subscribed to the course
 295             $courseUserListResultSet = Claroline::getDatabase()->query( "
 296                 SELECT
 297                     count_user_enrol, count_class_enrol
 298                 FROM
 299                     `{$tbl_rel_course_user}`
 300                 WHERE
 301                     user_id = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->escape($userId) . "
 302                 AND
 303                     code_cours = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($courseCode) );
 304 
 305             if ( $courseUserListResultSet->numRows() > 0 )
 306             {
 307                 $course_user_list = $courseUserListResultSet->fetch(Mysql_ResultSet::FETCH_OBJECT);
 308                 
 309                 $count_user_enrol = (int) $course_user_list->count_user_enrol;
 310                 $count_class_enrol = (int) $course_user_list->count_class_enrol;
 311 
 312                 // Increment the count of registration by the user or class
 313                 if ( ! $this->registerByClass )
 314                 {
 315                     $count_user_enrol = 1;
 316                 }
 317                 else
 318                 {
 319                     $count_class_enrol++;
 320                 }
 321 
 322                 if ( !Claroline::getDatabase()->exec("
 323                     UPDATE
 324                         `{$tbl_rel_course_user}`
 325                     SET
 326                         `count_user_enrol` = " . $count_user_enrol . ",
 327                         `count_class_enrol` = " . $count_class_enrol . "
 328                     WHERE
 329                         user_id = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->escape($userId) . "
 330                     AND
 331                         code_cours = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($courseCode)
 332                 ) )
 333                 {
 334                     $this->status = self::STATUS_SYSTEM_ERROR;
 335                     $this->errorMessage = get_lang('Cannot register user in course');
 336                     return false;
 337                 }
 338                 else
 339                 {
 340                     return true;
 341                 }
 342             }
 343             else
 344             {
 345                 // First registration to the course
 346                 $count_user_enrol = 0;
 347                 $count_class_enrol = 0;
 348 
 349                 // If a validation is requested for this course: isPending is true
 350                 // If the current user is course manager: isPending is false
 351                 $isPending = !$this->admin && $this->isValidationRequired() ? true : false;
 352 
 353 
 354                 if ( ! $this->registerByClass )
 355                 {
 356                     $count_user_enrol = 1;
 357                 }
 358                 else
 359                 {
 360                     $count_class_enrol = 1;
 361                 }
 362 
 363                 if ( $this->admin )
 364                 {
 365                     $profileId = claro_get_profile_id('manager');
 366                 }
 367                 elseif ( $this->profileId )
 368                 {
 369                     $profileId = $this->profileId;
 370                 }
 371                 else
 372                 {
 373                     $profileId = claro_get_profile_id($this->getCourseProfile());
 374                 }
 375 
 376                 // if this course is a session course, enrol to the source course
 377                 
 378                 if ( $this->course->sourceCourseId )
 379                 {
 380                     $sourceCourseCode = $this->course->getSourceCourseCode();
 381                     
 382                     // only enrol the user to the source course only if he is not already there
 383                     
 384                     $sourceCourseUserListResultSet = Claroline::getDatabase()->query( "
 385                         SELECT
 386                             count_user_enrol, count_class_enrol
 387                         FROM
 388                             `{$tbl_rel_course_user}`
 389                         WHERE
 390                             user_id = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->escape($userId) . "
 391                         AND
 392                             code_cours = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote($sourceCourseCode) );
 393 
 394                     if ( $sourceCourseUserListResultSet->numRows() == 0 )
 395                     {
 396                         if ( !Claroline::getDatabase()->exec("INSERT INTO `" . $tbl_rel_course_user . "`
 397                                 SET code_cours      = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote( $sourceCourseCode )  . ",
 398                                     user_id         = " . (int) $userId . ",
 399                                     profile_id      = " . (int) $profileId . ",
 400                                     isCourseManager = " . (int) ($this->admin ? 1 : 0 ) . ",
 401                                     isPending       = " . (int) ($isPending ? 1 : 0) . ",
 402                                     tutor           = " . (int) ($this->tutor ? 1 : 0) . ",
 403                                     count_user_enrol = " . $count_user_enrol . ",
 404                                     count_class_enrol = " . $count_class_enrol . ",
 405                                     enrollment_date = NOW()" ) )
 406                         {
 407                             $this->status = self::STATUS_SYSTEM_ERROR;
 408                             $this->errorMessage = get_lang('Cannot register user in source course');
 409                             return false;
 410                         }
 411                     }
 412                 }
 413                 
 414                 // register user to new session course                
 415                 if ( !Claroline::getDatabase()->exec("INSERT INTO `" . $tbl_rel_course_user . "`
 416                         SET code_cours      = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->quote( $courseCode )  . ",
 417                             user_id         = " . (int) $userId . ",
 418                             profile_id      = " . (int) $profileId . ",
 419                             isCourseManager = " . (int) ($this->admin ? 1 : 0 ) . ",
 420                             isPending       = " . (int) ($isPending ? 1 : 0) . ",
 421                             tutor           = " . (int) ($this->tutor ? 1 : 0) . ",
 422                             count_user_enrol = " . $count_user_enrol . ",
 423                             count_class_enrol = " . $count_class_enrol  . ",
 424                             enrollment_date = NOW()" ) )
 425                 {
 426                     $this->status = self::STATUS_SYSTEM_ERROR;
 427                     $this->errorMessage = get_lang('Cannot register user in source course');
 428                     return false;
 429                 }
 430                 else
 431                 {
 432                     return true;
 433                 }
 434             }
 435         } // end else user register in the platform
 436     }

 490     /**
 491      * Is the user allowed to enrol to the course
 492      * @return boolean
 493      */
 494     protected function isRegistrationAllowed()
 495     {
 496         if ( $this->isSuperUser )
 497         {
 498             return true;
 499         }
 500 
 501         if ( $this->userAuthProfile->isProfileAllowedToRegisterInCourse() )
 502         {
 503 
 504             if( $this->isCourseRegistrationAllowed() )
 505             {
 506                 if ( $this->ignoreRegistrationKeyCheck )
 507                 {
 508                     return true;
 509                 }
 510                 else
 511                 {
 512                     if ( $this->checkRegistrationKey() )
 513                     {
 514                         return true;
 515                     }
 516                     else
 517                     {
 518                         $this->status = self::STATUS_KEYVALIDATION_FAILED;
 519                         return false;
 520                     }
 521                 }
 522             }
 523             else
 524             {
 525                 return false;
 526             }
 527         }
 528         else
 529         {
 530             $this->status = self::STATUS_REGISTRATION_NOTAVAILABLE;
 531             $this->errorMessage = get_lang('Your profile does not allow you to register to course.');
 532             return false;
 533         }

 561     /**
 562      * Is the user allowed to enrol to the course
 563      * @return boolean
 564      */
 565     protected function isUnregistrationAllowed()
 566     {
 567         $coursePrivileges = new CourseUserPrivileges( $this->course->courseId, $this->userAuthProfile->getUserId() );
 568         
 569         if ( !$this->forceUnregOfManager && $coursePrivileges->isCourseManager () && $this->userAuthProfile->getUserId() == claro_get_current_user_id () && !claro_is_platform_admin () )
 570         {
 571             $this->status = self::STATUS_MANAGER_CANNOT_UNREGISTER_ITSELF;
 572             $this->errorMessage = get_lang('Course manager cannot unsubscribe himself'); // unless he is platform admin too
 573             return false;
 574         }
 575         
 576         // check if is thelast course manager
 577         
 578         if ( $coursePrivileges->isCourseManager () && $this->onlyOneCourseManagerLeft () )
 579         {
 580             $this->status = self::STATUS_CANNOT_UNREGISTER_LASTMANAGER;
 581             $this->errorMessage = get_lang('You cannot unsubscribe the last course manager of the course'); // even if platform admin...
 582             return false;
 583         }
 584         
 585         
 586         if ( $this->isSuperUser )
 587         {
 588             return true;
 589         }
 590 
 591         if ( $this->userAuthProfile->isProfileAllowedToRegisterInCourse() )
 592         {
 593             return $this->isCourseUnregistrationAllowed();
 594         }
 595         else
 596         {
 597             $this->status = self::STATUS_UNREGISTRATION_NOTAVAILABLE;
 598             $this->errorMessage = get_lang('Your profile does not allow you to unregister from this course.');
 599             return false;
 600         }
 601     }

 622     protected function checkRegistrationKey()
 623     {
 624         if ( $this->getCourseRegistrationMode() == 'open' && !empty( $this->course->registrationKey ) )
 625         {
 626             if( empty( $this->givenCourseKey ) )
 627             {
 628                 $this->errorMessage = get_lang('This course requires a key for enrolment');
 629                 $this->status = self::STATUS_KEYVALIDATION_FAILED;
 630                 return false;
 631             }
 632             if ( $this->givenCourseKey != $this->course->registrationKey )
 633             {
 634                 $this->errorMessage = get_lang('Invalid enrolment key given');
 635                 $this->status = self::STATUS_KEYVALIDATION_FAILED;
 636                 return false;
 637             }
 638             else
 639             {
 640                 return true;
 641             }
 642         }
 643         else
 644         {
 645             return true;
 646         }
 647     }
 648     
 649     /**
 650      * Is the registration allowed in the current course
 651      * @return boolean
 652      */
 653     protected function isCourseRegistrationAllowed()
 654     {
 655         $curdate = claro_time();
 656         
 657         if ( !$this->ignoreCategoryRegistrationCheck 
 658             && !is_null( $this->categoryId ) 
 659             && ! $this->isAllowedToRegisterToCategory() )
 660         {
 661             $this->status = self::STATUS_REGISTRATION_FAILED;
 662             $isUserAllowedToEnrol = false;
 663             $this->errorMessage = get_lang('You have to be registered to this course\'s category in order to enrol the course');
 664         }
 665         elseif ( $this->isUserLimitExceeded() )
 666         {
 667             $this->status = self::STATUS_REGISTRATION_FAILED;
 668             $isUserAllowedToEnrol = false;
 669             $this->errorMessage = get_lang('The users limit for this course has been reached');
 670         }
 671         elseif ( !in_array( $this->getCourseRegistrationMode(), array('open', 'validation') ) )
 672         {
 673             $isUserAllowedToEnrol = false;
 674             $this->status = self::STATUS_REGISTRATION_NOTAVAILABLE;
 675             $this->errorMessage = get_lang(
 676                 'This course currently does not allow new enrolments (registration: %registration)',
 677                 array('%registration' => $this->getCourseRegistrationMode()) );
 678         }
 679         elseif ( !in_array( $this->course->status, array('enable', 'date') ) )
 680         {
 681             $isUserAllowedToEnrol = false;
 682             $this->status = self::STATUS_REGISTRATION_NOTAVAILABLE;
 683             $this->errorMessage = get_lang(
 684                 'This course currently does not allow new enrolments (status: %status)',
 685                 array('%status' => $this->course->status));
 686         }
 687         elseif ( $this->course->status == 'date' && !empty($this->course->publicationDate) && $this->course->publicationDate >= $curdate )
 688         {
 689             $isUserAllowedToEnrol = false;
 690             $this->status = self::STATUS_REGISTRATION_NOTAVAILABLE;
 691             $this->errorMessage = get_lang(
 692                 'This course will be enabled on the %date',
 693                 array('%date' => claro_date('d/m/Y', $this->course->publicationDate)));
 694         }
 695         elseif ( $this->course->status == 'date' && !empty($this->course->expirationDate) && $this->course->expirationDate <= $curdate )
 696         {
 697             $isUserAllowedToEnrol = false;
 698             $this->status = self::STATUS_REGISTRATION_NOTAVAILABLE;
 699             $this->errorMessage = get_lang(
 700                 'This course has been deactivated on the %date',
 701                 array('%date' => claro_date('d/m/Y', $this->course->expirationDate)));
 702             
 703         }
 704         elseif ( $this->course->status == 'date'
 705             && ( empty($this->course->expirationDate) && empty($this->course->publicationDate) ) )
 706         {
 707             $isUserAllowedToEnrol = false;
 708             $this->status = self::STATUS_SYSTEM_ERROR;
 709             $this->errorMessage = get_lang('This course is not available');
 710             Console::error(
 711                 "Invalid publication and expiration date for course " . $this->course->courseId );
 712         }
 713         else
 714         {
 715             $isUserAllowedToEnrol = true;
 716         }
 717         
 718         return $isUserAllowedToEnrol;
 719     }

 721     protected function isCourseUnregistrationAllowed()
 722     {
 723         // Check if course available or option set to allow unregistration from unavailable course
 724         if ( get_conf('crslist_UserCanUnregFromInactiveCourses', false ) )
 725         {
 726             $isUserAllowedToUnenrol = true;
 727         }
 728         else
 729         {
 730             $curdate = claro_time();
 731             
 732             if ( !in_array( $this->course->status, array('enable', 'date') ) )
 733             {
 734                 $isUserAllowedToUnenrol = false;
 735                 $this->status = self::STATUS_UNREGISTRATION_NOTAVAILABLE;
 736                 $this->errorMessage = get_lang(
 737                     'This course currently does not allow to unenrol (status: %status)',
 738                     array('%status' => $this->course->status));
 739             }
 740             elseif ( $this->course->status == 'date' && !empty($this->course->publicationDate) && $this->course->publicationDate >= $curdate )
 741             {
 742                 $isUserAllowedToUnenrol = false;
 743                 $this->status = self::STATUS_UNREGISTRATION_NOTAVAILABLE;
 744                 $this->errorMessage = get_lang(
 745                     'This course will be enabled on the %date',
 746                     array('%date' => claro_date('d/m/Y', $this->course->publicationDate)));
 747             }
 748             elseif ( $this->course->status == 'date' && !empty($this->course->expirationDate) && $this->course->expirationDate <= $curdate )
 749             {
 750                 $isUserAllowedToUnenrol = false;
 751                 $this->status = self::STATUS_UNREGISTRATION_NOTAVAILABLE;
 752                 $this->errorMessage = get_lang(
 753                     'This course has been deactivated on the %date',
 754                     array('%date' => claro_date('d/m/Y', $this->course->expirationDate)));
 755 
 756             }
 757             elseif ( $this->course->status == 'date'
 758                 && ( empty($this->course->expirationDate) && empty($this->course->publicationDate) ) )
 759             {
 760                 $isUserAllowedToUnenrol = false;
 761                 $this->status = self::STATUS_SYSTEM_ERROR;
 762                 $this->errorMessage = get_lang('This course is not available');
 763                 Console::error(
 764                     "Invalid publication and expiration date for course " . $this->course->courseId );
 765             }
 766             else
 767             {
 768                 $isUserAllowedToUnenrol = true;
 769             }
 770         }
 771 
 772         return $isUserAllowedToUnenrol;
 773     }

 775     /**
 776      * If the course registration requires registration to the course category,
 777      * check if the user is register to the category
 778      * @return boolean
 779      */
 780     protected function isAllowedToRegisterToCategory()
 781     {
 782         if ( $this->isSuperUser )
 783         {
 784             return true;
 785         }
 786         
 787         if( get_conf( 'registrationRestrictedThroughCategories', false ) )
 788         {
 789             if ( !ClaroCategory::isRegistredToCategory( $this->userAuthProfile->getUserId(), $this->categoryId ) )

 791                 return false;
 792             }
 793             else
 794             {
 795                 return true;
 796             }
 797         }
 798         else
 799         {
 800             return true;
 801         }
 802     }

 811             && $this->countCourseUsers() >= $this->course->userLimit )

   8 /**
   9  * Set of PHP classes for user batch registration and enrolment
  10  *
  11  * @version Claroline 1.11 $Revision: 14688 $
  12  * @copyright (c) 2013 Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  13  * @license http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html (GPL) GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE
  14  * @package kernel
  15  * @author Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  16  * @todo move to Claroline kernel
  17  */
  18 
  19 /**
  20  * Class to store the result of a batch registration
  21  */
  22 class Claro_BatchRegistrationResult
  23 {
  24     // status masks
  25     const 
  26         STATUS_NOT_SET = 0,
  27         STATUS_ERROR_UPDATE_FAIL = 1,
  28         STATUS_ERROR_INSERT_FAIL = 2,
  29         STATUS_ERROR_DELETE_FAIL = 4,
  30         STATUS_ERROR_NOTHING_TO_DO = 8;
  31     
  32     private
  33         $insertedUserList,
  34         $failedUserList,
  35         $updateUserList,
  36         $deletedUserList,
  37         $status,
  38         $errLog;
  39     
  40     public function __construct ()
  41     {
  42         $this->status = self::STATUS_NOT_SET;
  43         $this->errLog = array();
  44         $this->insertedUserList = array();
  45         $this->deletedUserList = array();
  46         $this->failedUserList = array();
  47         $this->updateUserList = array();
  48     }
  49     
  50     /**
  51      * set the status mask
  52      * @param int $status
  53      * @return Claro_BatchRegistrationResult $this
  54      */
  55     public function setStatus( $status )
  56     {
  57         if ( $this->status === self::STATUS_NOT_SET )
  58         {
  59             $this->status = $status;
  60         }
  61         else
  62         {
  63             $this->status = $this->status | $status;
  64         }
  65         
  66         return $this;
  67     }
  68     
  69     /**
  70      * check the status mask
  71      * @param int $status
  72      * @return boolean
  73      */
  74     public function statusSet( $status )
  75     {
  76         // SUCCESS is only set when there is no error !
  77         if ( $status === self::STATUS_NOT_SET && $this->status === self::STATUS_NOT_SET )
  78         {
  79             return true;
  80         }
  81         else
  82         {
  83             return ( ( $this->status & $status ) == $status );
  84         }
  85     }
  86     
  87     /**
  88      * add an error message
  89      * @param string $error
  90      * @return Claro_BatchRegistrationResult $this
  91      */
  92     public function addError( $error )
  93     {
  94         $this->errLog[] = $error;
  95         
  96         return $this;
  97     }
  98     
  99     /**
 100      * merge error messages array
 101      * @param array $errors
 102      */
 103     public function mergeErrors( $errors = array() )
 104     {
 105         $this->errLog = array_merge($this->errLog, $errors);
 106         
 107         return $this;
 108     }
 109     
 110     /**
 111      * add inserted users
 112      * @param array $inserted
 113      * @return Claro_BatchRegistrationResult $this
 114      */
 115     public function addInserted( $inserted )
 116     {
 117         $this->insertedUserList = array_merge($this->insertedUserList, $inserted);
 118         
 119         return $this;
 120     }
 121     
 122     /**
 123      * add deleted users
 124      * @param array $deleted
 125      * @return Claro_BatchRegistrationResult $this
 126      */
 127     public function addDeleted( $deleted )
 128     {
 129         $this->deletedUserList = array_merge( $this->deletedUserList, $deleted );
 130         
 131         return $this;
 132     }
 133     
 134     /**
 135      * add updated users
 136      * @param array $updated
 137      * @return Claro_BatchRegistrationResult $this
 138      */
 139     public function addUpdated( $updated )
 140     {
 141         $this->updateUserList = array_merge( $this->updateUserList, $updated );
 142         
 143         return $this;
 144     }
 145     
 146     /**
 147      * add failed users
 148      * @param array $failed
 149      * @return Claro_BatchRegistrationResult $this
 150      */
 151     public function addFailed( $failed )
 152     {
 153         $this->failedUserList = array_merge( $this->failedUserList, $failed );
 154         
 155         return $this;
 156     }
 157     
 158     /**
 159      * Merge with another result
 160      * @param Claro_BatchRegistrationResult $otherResult
 161      */
 162     public function mergeResult( Claro_BatchRegistrationResult $otherResult )
 163     {
 164         $this->setStatus($otherResult->getStatus());
 165         $this->addDeleted($otherResult->getDeletedUserList());
 166         $this->addFailed($otherResult->getFailedUserList());
 167         $this->addInserted($otherResult->getInsertedUserList());
 168         $this->addUpdated($otherResult->getUpdatedUserList());
 169         $this->mergeErrors($otherResult->getErrorLog());
 170     }
 171     
 172     /**
 173      * Get the status of the operation

 175      *  STATUS_ERROR_INSERT_FAIL or STATUS_ERROR_DELETE_FAIL
 176      */
 177     public function getStatus()
 178     {

 180     }
 181     
 182     /**
 183      * Check if the operation ended with errors
 184      * @return bool
 185      */
 186     public function hasError()
 187     {
 188         return $this->status > 0 && $this->status !== self::STATUS_ERROR_NOTHING_TO_DO;
 189     }
 190     
 191     /**
 192      * Get the error log
 193      * @return array
 194      */
 195     public function getErrorLog()
 196     {
 197         return $this->errLog;
 198     }
 199     
 200     /**
 201      * Get the list of users newly inserted in the course
 202      * @return array of user_id => user
 203      */
 204     public function getInsertedUserList()
 205     {
 206         return $this->insertedUserList;
 207     }
 208     
 209     /**
 210      * Get the list of users with updated registration in the course
 211      * @return array of user_id => user
 212      */
 213     public function getUpdatedUserList()
 214     {
 215         return $this->updateUserList;
 216     }
 217     
 218     /**
 219      * Get the list of users for which the insertion or deletion failed

 221      */
 222     public function getFailedUserList()

 224         return $this->failedUserList;
 225     }

 227     /**

 230      */
