 237 /**
 238  * Utility class to add or remove users into or from a course by batch
 239  * @since Claroline 1.11.9
 240  */
 241 class Claro_BatchCourseRegistration
 242 {
 243     private 
 244         $database, 
 245         $course, 
 246         $result, 
 247         $tableNames;
 248     
 249     /**
 250      * 
 251      * @param Claro_Course $course
 252      * @param mixed $database Database_Connection instance or null, if null, the default database connection will be used
 253      */
 254     public function __construct( $course, $database = null, $result = null )
 255     {
 256         $this->course = $course;
 257         $this->database = $database ? $database : Claroline::getDatabase();
 258         $this->tableNames = get_module_main_tbl(array('rel_course_user'));
 259         $this->tableNames = array_merge( $this->tableNames, 
 260             get_module_course_tbl( 
 261                 array( 'bb_rel_topic_userstonotify', 'group_team', 'userinfo_content', 'group_rel_team_user', 'tracking_event' ), 
 262                 $this->course->courseId ) );
 263         
 264         $this->result = $result ? $result : new Claro_BatchRegistrationResult();
 265     }
 266     
 267     public function getResult()
 268     {
 269         return $this->result;
 270     }
 271     
 272     /**
 273      * Get the status of the operation
 274      * @return int : STATUS_SUCCESS, STATUS_ERROR_UPDATE_FAIL, 
 275      *  STATUS_ERROR_INSERT_FAIL or STATUS_ERROR_DELETE_FAIL
 276      */
 277     public function getStatus()
 278     {
 279         return $this->result->getStatus ();
 280     }
 281     
 282     /**
 283      * Check if the operation ended with errors
 284      * @return bool
 285      */
 286     public function hasError()
 287     {
 288         return $this->result->hasError ();
 289     }
 290     
 291     /**
 292      * Get the error log
 293      * @return array
 294      */
 295     public function getErrorLog()
 296     {
 297         return $this->result->getErrorLog ();
 298     }
 299     
 300     /**
 301      * Get the list of users newly inserted in the course
 302      * @return array of user_id => user
 303      */
 304     public function getInsertedUserList()
 305     {
 306         return $this->result->getInsertedUserList ();
 307     }
 308     
 309     /**
 310      * Get the list of users with updated registration in the course
 311      * @return array of user_id => user
 312      */
 313     public function getUpdatedUserList()
 314     {
 315         return $this->result->getUpdatedUserList ();
 316     }
 317     
 318     /**
 319      * Get the list of users for which the insertion or deletion failed
 320      * @return array of user_id => user
 321      */
 322     public function getFailedUserList()
 323     {
 324         return $this->result->getFailedUserList ();
 325     }
 326     
 327     /**
 328      * Get the list of users removed from the course
 329      * @return array of user_id => user
 330      */
 331     public function getDeletedUserList()
 332     {
 333         return $this->result->getDeletedUserList();
 334     }
 335     
 336     /**
 337      * Get the list of users in $userIdList already registered to the course
 338      * @param array $userIdList
 339      * @param string $courseCode
 340      * @return array of user_id => [ user_id => int,count_user_enrol => int,count_class_enrol => int ]
 341      */
 342     protected function getUsersAlreadyInCourse ( $userIdList, $courseCode )
 343     {
 344         $ids = array();
 345         
 346         $courseUserIdListResultSet = $this->database->query( "
 347                 SELECT
 348                     user_id, count_user_enrol, count_class_enrol, isPending
 349                 FROM
 350                     `{$this->tableNames['rel_course_user']}`
 351                 WHERE
 352                     code_cours = " . $this->database->quote($courseCode) . "
 353                 AND 
 354                     user_id IN (" . implode( ',', $userIdList ) .")" );
 355         
 356         foreach ( $courseUserIdListResultSet as $user )
 357         {
 358             $ids[$user['user_id']] = $user;
 359         }
 360         
 361         return $ids;
 362     }
 363     
 364     /**
 365      * Add a list of users given their user id to the course
 366      * @param array $userIdList list of user ids to add
 367      * @param Claro_Class $class execute class registration instead of individual registration if given (default:null)
 368      * @param bool $forceClassRegistrationOfExistingClassUsers transform individual registration to class registration if set to true (default: false)
 369      * @param array $userListAlreadyInClass user already in class as an array of user_id => user
 370      * @param bool $forceValidationOfPendingUsers pending user enrollments will be validated if set to true (default: false)
 371      * @return boolean
 372      */
 373     public function addUserIdListToCourse( $userIdList, $class = null, $forceClassRegistrationOfExistingClassUsers = false, $userListAlreadyInClass = array(), $forceValidationOfPendingUsers = false )
 374     {
 375         if ( ! count( $userIdList ) )
 376         {
 377             return false;
 378         }
 379         
 380         $classMode = is_null( $class ) ? false : true;
 381         
 382         $courseCode = $this->course->courseId;
 383         $sqlCourseCode = $this->database->quote( $courseCode );
 384         
 385         $updateUserList = array();
 386         $failedUserList = array();
 387         
 388         // 1. PROCESS USERS ALREADY IN COURSE
 389         
 390         // get user id already in course
 391         
 392         $usersAlreadyInCourse = $this->getUsersAlreadyInCourse( $userIdList, $courseCode );
 393                     
 394         // update registration of existing users if classMode
 395                     
 396         if ( $classMode )
 397         {
 398             // register class to course if not already done
 399             if ( ! $class->isRegisteredToCourse ( $courseCode ) )
 400             {
 401                 $class->registerToCourse( $courseCode );
 402             }
 403             
 404             foreach ( $usersAlreadyInCourse as $userId => $courseUser )
 405             {
 406                 if ( $forceClassRegistrationOfExistingClassUsers /* || $courseUser['count_class_enrol'] != 0 */ )
 407                 {
 408                     $courseUser['count_user_enrol'] = 0;                 
 409                 }
 410                 
 411                 if ( ! array_key_exists( $courseUser['user_id'], $userListAlreadyInClass ) || $courseUser['count_class_enrol'] <= 0 )
 412                 {
 413                     $courseUser['count_class_enrol']++;
 414                 }
 415                 
 416                 $pending = $forceValidationOfPendingUsers ? '`isPending` = 0,' : '';
 417                 
 418                 // update user in DB
 419                 if ( !$this->database->exec("
 420                     UPDATE
 421                         `{$this->tableNames['rel_course_user']}`
 422                     SET
 423                         {$pending}
 424                         `count_user_enrol` = " . $courseUser['count_user_enrol'] . ",
 425                         `count_class_enrol` = " . $courseUser['count_class_enrol'] . "
 426                     WHERE
 427                         user_id = " . Claroline::getDatabase()->escape($userId) . "
 428                     AND
 429                         code_cours = {$sqlCourseCode}"
 430                 ) )
 431                 {
 432                     $failedUserList[$courseUser['user_id']] = $courseUser;
 433                 }
 434                 
 435                 $updateUserList[$courseUser['user_id']] = $courseUser;
 436             }
 437             
 438             if ( count ( $failedUserList ) )
 439             {
 440                 $this->result->addFailed($failedUserList);
 441                 $this->result->setStatus( Claro_BatchRegistrationResult::STATUS_ERROR_UPDATE_FAIL );
 442                 $this->result->addError( get_lang( 
 443                     "Cannot update course registration information for users %userlist% in course %course%", array( 
 444                         '%userlist%' =>  implode(",",$failedUserList ), 
 445                         '%course%' => $courseCode ) ) );
 446                 Console::error( "Cannot update course registration information for users " . implode(",",$failedUserList ) . " in course {$courseCode}" );
 447             }
 448             
 449             $this->result->addUpdated($updateUserList);
 450         }
 451         
 452         // 2. PROCESS USERS NOT ALREADY IN COURSE
 453                     
 454         // construct the query for insertion of new users
 455         
 456         $sqlProfileId = $this->database->escape( claro_get_profile_id(USER_PROFILE) );
 457         
 458         $userNewRegistrations = array();
 459         $userListToInsert = array();
 460         
 461         foreach ( $userIdList as $userId )
 462         {
 463             if ( !array_key_exists ( $userId, $usersAlreadyInCourse ) )
 464             {
 465                 if ( $classMode )
 466                 {
 467                     $userNewRegistration = array(
 468                         'user_id' => $this->database->escape( $userId ),
 469                         'count_user_enrol' => 0,
 470                         'count_class_enrol' => 1,
 471                         'isPending' => 0
 472                     );
 473                 }
 474                 else
 475                 {
 476                     $userNewRegistration = array(
 477                         'user_id' => $this->database->escape( $userId ),
 478                         'count_user_enrol' => 1,
 479                         'count_class_enrol' => 0,
 480                         'isPending' => 0
 481                     );
 482                 }
 483 
 484                 // user_id, profile_id, isCourseManager, isPending, tutor, count_user_enrol, count_class_enrol, enrollment_date
 485                 $userNewRegistrations[] = "({$userNewRegistration['user_id']},{$sqlCourseCode}, {$sqlProfileId}, 0, 0, 0, {$userNewRegistration['count_user_enrol']},{$userNewRegistration['count_class_enrol']}, NOW())";
 486                 $userListToInsert[$userId] = $userNewRegistration;
 487             }
 488         }
 489         
 490         // execute the query
 491         
 492         if ( count($userNewRegistrations) )
 493         {  
 494             if ( !$this->database->exec("
 495                 INSERT INTO
 496                     `{$this->tableNames['rel_course_user']}`
 497                         (user_id, code_cours, profile_id, isCourseManager, isPending, tutor, count_user_enrol, count_class_enrol, enrollment_date)
 498                 VALUES\n" . implode( ",\n\t", $userNewRegistrations ) ) )
 499             {
 500                 $this->result->setStatus( Claro_BatchRegistrationResult::STATUS_ERROR_INSERT_FAIL);
 501                 $this->result->addError ( get_lang( 
 502                     "Cannot insert userlist %userlist% in course %course%", array( 
 503                         '%userlist%' =>  implode( ",", $userListToInsert ), 
 504                         '%course%' => $courseCode ) ) );
 505                 Console::error( "Cannot insert userlist " . implode( ",", $userListToInsert ) . " in  course  {$courseCode}" );
 506                 
 507                 $this->result->addFailed( $userListToInsert );
 508             }
 509             else
 510             {
 511                 $this->result->addInserted ( $userListToInsert );
 512             }
 513             
 514         }
 515         
 516         if ( $this->course->hasSourceCourse () )
 517         {
 518             $sourceCourse = $this->course->getSourceCourse();
 519             $sourceReg = new Claro_BatchCourseRegistration($sourceCourse, $this->database, $this->result);
 520             $sourceReg->addUserIdListToCourse($userIdList, $class, $forceClassRegistrationOfExistingClassUsers, $userListAlreadyInClass, $forceValidationOfPendingUsers);
 521             $this->result->mergeResult( $sourceReg->getResult () );
 522         }
 523         
 524         return !$this->result->hasError();
 525     }
 526     
 527     /**
 528      * Force remove a list of users given their user id from the cours. All users' registrations (even by class) to the course will be removed
 529      * @param array $userIdList list of user ids to add
 530      * @param bool $keepTrackingData tracking data will be deleted if set to false (default:true, i.e. keep data)
 531      * @param array $moduleDataToPurge list of module_label => (purgeTracking => bool, purgeData => bool)
 532      * @param bool $unregisterFromSourceIfLastSession remove users that are in no other session course from the source course if any
 533      * @return boolean
 534      */
 535     public function forceRemoveUserIdListFromCourse( $userIdList, $keepTrackingData = true, $moduleDataToPurge = array(), $unregisterFromSourceIfLastSession = true )
 536     {
 537         if ( ! count( $userIdList ) )
 538         {
 539             return false;
 540         }
 541         
 542         $courseCode = $this->course->courseId;
 543         $sqlCourseCode = $this->database->quote( $courseCode );
 544         
 545         // var_dump($userIdList);
 546         
 547         $this->database->exec("
 548             UPDATE
 549                 `{$this->tableNames['rel_course_user']}`
 550             SET
 551                 `count_class_enrol` = 0,
 552                 `count_user_enrol` = 0
 553             WHERE
 554                 `code_cours` = {$sqlCourseCode}
 555             AND
 556                 `user_id` IN (".implode( ',', $userIdList ).")
 557         ");
 558                 
 559                 
 560         // get the user ids to remove
 561         
 562         $userListToRemove = $this->database->query("
 563             SELECT 
 564                 `user_id`
 565             FROM
 566                 `{$this->tableNames['rel_course_user']}`
 567             WHERE
 568                 `count_class_enrol` <= 0
 569             AND
 570                 `count_user_enrol` <= 0
 571             AND
 572                 `code_cours` = {$sqlCourseCode}
 573         ");
 574         
 575         if ( $userListToRemove->numRows() )
 576         {
 577             $userIdListToRemove = array();
 578             
 579             foreach ( $userListToRemove as $user )
 580             {
 581                 $userIdListToRemove[] = $user['user_id'];
 582             }
 583             
 584             $sqlList = array();
 585             
 586             $sqlList[] = "DELETE FROM `{$this->tableNames['bb_rel_topic_userstonotify']}` WHERE user_id IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).")";
 587             $sqlList[] = "DELETE FROM `{$this->tableNames['userinfo_content']}` WHERE user_id IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).")";
 588             $sqlList[] = "UPDATE `{$this->tableNames['group_team']}` SET `tutor` = NULL WHERE `tutor` IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).")";
 589             $sqlList[] = "DELETE FROM `{$this->tableNames['group_rel_team_user']}` WHERE user IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).")";
 590             
 591             if ( !$keepTrackingData )
 592             {
 593                 $sqlList[] = "DELETE FROM `{$this->tableNames['tracking_event']}` WHERE user_id IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).")";
 594             }
 595             
 596             $sqlList[] = "DELETE FROM `{$this->tableNames['rel_course_user']}` WHERE user_id IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).") AND `code_cours` = {$sqlCourseCode}";
 597             
 598             foreach ( $sqlList as $sql )
 599             {
 600                 $this->database->exec( $sql );
 601             }
 602             
 603             if ( !empty( $moduleDataToPurge ) )
 604             {
 605                 foreach ( $moduleDataToPurge as $moduleData )
 606                 {
 607                     $connectorPath = get_module_path( $moduleData['label'] ) . '/connector/adminuser.cnr.php';
 608                     
 609                     if ( file_exists( $connectorPath ) )
 610                     {
 611                         require_once $connectorPath;
 612                         
 613                         $connectorClass = $moduleData['label'] . '_AdminUser';
 614                         
 615                         if ( class_exist ( $connectorClass ) )
 616                         {
 617                             $connector = new $connectorClass( $this->database );
 618 
 619                             if ( $moduleData['purgeTracking'] )
 620                             {
 621                                 $connector->purgeUserListCourseTrackingData( $userIdListToRemove, $this->course->courseId );
 622                             }
 623 
 624                             if ( $moduleData['purgeResources'] )
 625                             {
 626                                 $connector->purgeUserListCourseResources( $userIdListToRemove, $this->course->courseId );
 627                             }
 628                         }
 629                         else
 630                         {
 631                             Console::warning("Class {$connectorClass} not found");
 632                         }
 633                     }
 634                     else
 635                     {
 636                         Console::warning("No user delete connector found for module {$moduleData['label']}");
 637                     }
 638                 }
 639             }
 640             
 641             $this->result->addDeleted ( $userIdListToRemove );
 642             
 643             if ( $this->course->isSourceCourse () )
 644             {
 645                 $sessionCourseIterator = $this->course->getChildren();
 646                 
 647                 foreach ( $sessionCourseIterator as $sessionCourse )
 648                 {
 649                     $batchReg = new self( $sessionCourse, $this->database );
 650                     $batchReg->forceRemoveUserIdListFromCourse( $userIdListToRemove, $keepTrackingData, $moduleDataToPurge, $unregisterFromSourceIfLastSession );
 651                     $this->result->mergeResult($batchReg->getResult () );
 652                 }
 653             }
 654             
 655             if ( $this->course->hasSourceCourse () && $unregisterFromSourceIfLastSession )
 656             {
 657                 $sourceCourse = $this->course->getSourceCourse();
 658                 
 659                 $sessionCourseIterator = $sourceCourse->getChildren();
 660                                  
 661                 // get userids registered in other sessions than the current one
 662 
 663                 $sessionList = $sourceCourse->getChildrenList();
 664                 
 665                 if ( count( $sessionList ) )
 666                 {  
 667                     $userIdListToRemoveFromSource = array();
 668 
 669                     $sessionIdList = array_keys( $sessionList );
 670 
 671                     $sqlCourseCode = $this->database->quote($this->course->courseId);
 672 
 673                     $usersInOtherSessions = $this->database->query("
 674                         SELECT
 675                             user_id
 676                         FROM
 677                             `{$this->tableNames['rel_course_user']}`
 678                         WHERE
 679                             user_id IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).")
 680                         AND
 681                             code_cours IN ('".implode( "','", $sessionIdList )."')
 682                         AND
 683                             code_cours != {$sqlCourseCode}
 684                     ");
 685 
 686 
 687                     // loop on $userIdList and keep only those who are not in another session and inject them in $userIdListToRemoveFromSource
 688 
 689                     $usersInOtherSessionsList = array();
 690 
 691                     foreach ( $usersInOtherSessions as $userNotToRemove  )
 692                     {
 693                         $usersInOtherSessionsList[$userNotToRemove['user_id']] = $userNotToRemove['user_id'];
 694                     }
 695 
 696                     foreach ( $userListToRemove as $userIdToRemove )
 697                     {
 698                         if ( ! isset( $usersInOtherSessionsList[$userIdToRemove['user_id']] ) )
 699                         {
 700                             $userIdListToRemoveFromSource[] = $userIdToRemove['user_id'];
 701                         }
 702                     }
 703 
 704                     if ( count( $userIdListToRemoveFromSource ) )
 705                     {
 706                         $batchReg = new self( $sourceCourse, $this->database );
 707                         $batchReg->forceRemoveUserIdListFromCourse( $userIdListToRemoveFromSource, $keepTrackingData, $moduleDataToPurge, $unregisterFromSourceIfLastSession );
 708                         $this->result->mergeResult($batchReg->getResult () );
 709                     }
 710                 }
 711             }
 712             
 713         }
 714         else
 715         {
 716             $this->result->setStatus(Claro_BatchRegistrationResult::STATUS_ERROR_NOTHING_TO_DO);
 717             $this->result->addError(get_lang("No user to delete"));
 718         }
 719         
 720         return !$this->result->hasError();
 721     }
 722     
 723     /**
 724      * Remove a list of users given their user id from the cours
 725      * @param array $userIdList list of user ids to add
 726      * @param Claro_Class $class execute class unregistration instead of individual registration if given (default:null)
 727      * @param bool $keepTrackingData tracking data will be deleted if set to false (default:true, i.e. keep data)
 728      * @param array $moduleDataToPurge list of module_label => (purgeTracking => bool, purgeData => bool)
 729      * @param bool $unregisterFromSourceIfLastSession remove users that are in no other session course from the source course if any
 730      * @return boolean
 731      */
 732     public function removeUserIdListFromCourse( $userIdList, $class = null, $keepTrackingData = true, $moduleDataToPurge = array(), $unregisterFromSourceIfLastSession = true )
 733     {
 734         if ( ! count( $userIdList ) )
 735         {
 736             return false;
 737         }
 738         
 739         $classMode = is_null( $class ) ? false : true;
 740         
 741         $courseCode = $this->course->courseId;
 742         $sqlCourseCode = $this->database->quote( $courseCode );
 743         
 744         if ( $classMode && !$class->isRegisteredToCourse($courseCode) )
 745         {
 746             $this->result->addError(get_lang("Class not registered to course"));
 747             $this->result->setStatus(Claro_BatchRegistrationResult::STATUS_ERROR_NOTHING_TO_DO);
 748             return false;
 749         }
 750         
 751         // update user registration counts
 752         $cntToChange = $classMode ? 'count_class_enrol' : 'count_user_enrol';
 753         
 754         $this->database->exec("
 755             UPDATE
 756                 `{$this->tableNames['rel_course_user']}`
 757             SET
 758                 `{$cntToChange}` = `{$cntToChange}` - 1
 759             WHERE
 760                 `code_cours` = {$sqlCourseCode}
 761             AND
 762                 `{$cntToChange}` > 0
 763             AND
 764                 `user_id` IN (".implode( ',', $userIdList ).")
 765         ");
 766                 
 767                 
 768         // get the user ids to remove
 769         
 770         $userListToRemove = $this->database->query("
 771             SELECT 
 772                 `user_id`
 773             FROM
 774                 `{$this->tableNames['rel_course_user']}`
 775             WHERE
 776                 `count_class_enrol` <= 0
 777             AND
 778                 `count_user_enrol` <= 0
 779             AND
 780                 `code_cours` = {$sqlCourseCode}
 781         ");
 782                 
 783         if ( $userListToRemove->numRows() )
 784         {
 785             $userIdListToRemove = array();
 786             
 787             foreach ( $userListToRemove as $user )
 788             {
 789                 $userIdListToRemove[] = $user['user_id'];
 790             }
 791             
 792             $sqlList = array();
 793             
 794             $sqlList[] = "DELETE FROM `{$this->tableNames['bb_rel_topic_userstonotify']}` WHERE user_id IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).")";
 795             $sqlList[] = "DELETE FROM `{$this->tableNames['userinfo_content']}` WHERE user_id IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).")";
 796             $sqlList[] = "UPDATE `{$this->tableNames['group_team']}` SET `tutor` = NULL WHERE `tutor` IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).")";
 797             $sqlList[] = "DELETE FROM `{$this->tableNames['group_rel_team_user']}` WHERE user IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).")";
 798             
 799             if ( !$keepTrackingData )
 800             {
 801                 $sqlList[] = "DELETE FROM `{$this->tableNames['tracking_event']}` WHERE user_id IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).")";
 802             }
 803             
 804             $sqlList[] = "DELETE FROM `{$this->tableNames['rel_course_user']}` WHERE user_id IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).") AND `code_cours` = {$sqlCourseCode}";
 805             
 806             foreach ( $sqlList as $sql )
 807             {
 808                 $this->database->exec( $sql );
 809             }
 810             
 811             if ( !empty( $moduleDataToPurge ) )
 812             {
 813                 foreach ( $moduleDataToPurge as $moduleData )
 814                 {
 815                     $connectorPath = get_module_path( $moduleData['label'] ) . '/connector/adminuser.cnr.php';
 816                     
 817                     if ( file_exists( $connectorPath ) )
 818                     {
 819                         require_once $connectorPath;
 820                         
 821                         $connectorClass = $moduleData['label'] . '_AdminUser';
 822                         
 823                         if ( class_exist ( $connectorClass ) )
 824                         {
 825                             $connector = new $connectorClass( $this->database );
 826 
 827                             if ( $moduleData['purgeTracking'] )
 828                             {
 829                                 $connector->purgeUserListCourseTrackingData( $userIdListToRemove, $this->course->courseId );
 830                             }
 831 
 832                             if ( $moduleData['purgeResources'] )
 833                             {
 834                                 $connector->purgeUserListCourseResources( $userIdListToRemove, $this->course->courseId );
 835                             }
 836                         }
 837                         else
 838                         {
 839                             Console::warning("Class {$connectorClass} not found");
 840                         }
 841                     }
 842                     else
 843                     {
 844                         Console::warning("No user delete connector found for module {$moduleData['label']}");
 845                     }
 846                 }
 847             }
 848             
 849             $this->result->addDeleted ( $userIdListToRemove );
 850             
 851             if ( $this->course->isSourceCourse () )
 852             {
 853                 $sessionCourseIterator = $this->course->getChildren();
 854                 
 855                 foreach ( $sessionCourseIterator as $sessionCourse )
 856                 {
 857                     $batchReg = new self( $sessionCourse, $this->database );
 858                     $batchReg->removeUserIdListFromCourse( $userIdListToRemove, $class, $keepTrackingData, $moduleDataToPurge, $unregisterFromSourceIfLastSession );
 859                     $this->result->mergeResult($batchReg->getResult () );
 860                 }
 861             }
 862             
 863             if ( $this->course->hasSourceCourse () && $unregisterFromSourceIfLastSession )
 864             {
 865                 $sourceCourse = $this->course->getSourceCourse();
 866                 
 867                 $sessionCourseIterator = $sourceCourse->getChildren();
 868                 
 869                 $foundSessionWithClass = false;
 870                 
 871                 if ( $classMode )
 872                 {
 873                     foreach ( $sessionCourseIterator as $sessionCourse )
 874                     {
 875                         if ( ( $sessionCourse->courseId != $this->course->courseId )
 876                             && $class->isRegisteredToCourse ( $sessionCourse->courseId ) )
 877                         {
 878                             $foundSessionWithClass = true;
 879                         }
 880                     }
 881                     
 882                     if ( ! $foundSessionWithClass )
 883                     {
 884                         $batchReg = new self( $sourceCourse, $this->database );
 885                         $batchReg->removeUserIdListFromCourse( $userIdListToRemove, $class, $keepTrackingData, $moduleDataToPurge, $unregisterFromSourceIfLastSession );
 886                     }
 887                 
 888                 }
 889                 else
 890                 {                    
 891                     // get userids registered in other sessions than the current one
 892                     
 893                     $sessionList = $sourceCourse->getChildrenList();
 894                     
 895                     if ( count( $sessionList ) )
 896                     {
 897                         $userIdListToRemoveFromSource = array();
 898                         
 899                         $sessionIdList = array_keys( $sessionList );
 900 
 901                         $sqlCourseCode = $this->database->quote($this->course->courseId);
 902 
 903                         $usersInOtherSessions = $this->database->query("
 904                             SELECT
 905                                 user_id
 906                             FROM
 907                                 `{$this->tableNames['rel_course_user']}`
 908                             WHERE
 909                                 user_id IN (".implode( ',', $userIdListToRemove ).")
 910                             AND
 911                                 code_cours IN ('".implode( "','", $sessionIdList )."')
 912                             AND
 913                                 code_cours != {$sqlCourseCode}
 914                         ");
 915 
 916 
 917                         // loop on $userIdList and keep only those who are not in another session and inject them in $userIdListToRemoveFromSource
 918 
 919                         $usersInOtherSessionsList = array();
 920 
 921                         foreach ( $usersInOtherSessions as $userNotToRemove  )
 922                         {
 923                             $usersInOtherSessionsList[$userNotToRemove['user_id']] = $userNotToRemove['user_id'];
 924                         }
 925 
 926                         foreach ( $userListToRemove as $userIdToRemove )
 927                         {
 928                             if ( ! isset( $usersInOtherSessionsList[$userIdToRemove['user_id']] ) )
 929                             {
 930                                 $userIdListToRemoveFromSource[] = $userIdToRemove['user_id'];
 931                             }
 932                         }
 933                     
 934                         if ( count( $userIdListToRemoveFromSource ) )
 935                         {
 936                             $batchReg = new self( $sourceCourse, $this->database );
 937                             $batchReg->removeUserIdListFromCourse( $userIdListToRemoveFromSource, $class, $keepTrackingData, $moduleDataToPurge, $unregisterFromSourceIfLastSession );
 938                             $this->result->mergeResult($batchReg->getResult () );
 939                         }
 940                     }
 941                 }
 942             }
 943         }
 944         else
 945         {
 946             $this->result->setStatus(Claro_BatchRegistrationResult::STATUS_ERROR_NOTHING_TO_DO);
 947             $this->result->addError(get_lang("No user to delete"));
 948         }        
 949         
 950         return !$this->result->hasError();
 951     }
 952     
 953     /**
 954      * Helper to remove all users from a course
 955      * @param bool $keepClasses if true, all classes will be removed too
 956      * @param array $profilesToDelete array of profile labels
 957      * @param string $registeredBefore date yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss
 958      * @param string $registeredAfter date yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss
 959      * @return bool false if an error occured
 960      * @throws Exception
 961      */
 962     public function removeAllUsers( $keepClasses = true, $profilesToDelete = array(), $registeredBefore = null, $registeredAfter = null )
 963     {
 964         if ( $keepClasses && ( !is_null( $registeredBefore ) || !is_null($registeredAfter) ) )
 965         {
 966             throw new Exception(get_lang('Cannot combine enrolment date filters and class deletion, please delete the classes independently'));
 967         }
 968         
 969         $courseUserList = new Claro_CourseUserList($this->course->courseId, $this->database );
 970 
 971         if ( empty( $profilesToDelete ) )
 972         {
 973             $profilesToDelete = array( USER_PROFILE );
 974         }
 975 
 976         $courseUserIdList = $courseUserList->getFilteredUserIdList( $profilesToDelete, $registeredBefore, $registeredAfter );
 977 
 978         $this->removeUserIdListFromCourse($courseUserIdList);
 979 
 980         if ( ! $keepClasses )
 981         {
 982             $courseClassList = new Claro_CourseClassList( $this->course, $this->database );
 983 
 984             foreach ($courseClassList->getClassListIterator() as $class )
 985             {
 986                 $classUserList = new Claro_ClassUserList( $class, $this->database );
 987 
 988                 $this->removeUserIdListFromCourse( $classUserList->getClassUserIdList(), $class );
 989             }
 990         }
 991 
 992         return !$this->result->hasError();
 993     }
 994 }
 995 
 996 /**
 997  * Add a list of users to the platform
 998  * @since Claroline 1.11.9
 999  */
1000 class Claro_PlatformUserList
1001 {
1002 
1003     protected $database, $tables;
1004     
1005     protected 
1006         $userSuccessList = array(), 
1007         $userFailureList = array(), 
1008         $userInsertedList = array(),
1009         $userConvertedList = array(),
1010         $userDisabledList = array(),
1011         $userAlreadyThere = array();
1012     
1013     /**
1014      * 
1015      * @param mixed $database Database_Connection instance or null, if null, the default database connection will be used
1016      */
1017     public function __construct ( $database = null )
1018     {
1019         $this->database = is_null ( $database ) ? Claroline::getDatabase () : $database;
1020         $this->tables = claro_sql_get_main_tbl ();
1021     }
1022     
1023     /**
1024      * Get the list of valid users i.e. users registered to the platform
1025      * @return array of username => user_id
1026      */
1027     public function getValidUserIdList()
1028     {
1029         return $this->userSuccessList;
1030     }
1031     
1032     /**
1033      * Get the list of newly inserted users
1034      * @return array of username => user_id
1035      */
1036     public function getInsertedUserIdList()
1037     {
1038         return $this->userInsertedList;
1039     }
1040     
1041     public function getFailedUserInsertionList()
1042     {
1043         return $this->userFailureList;
1044     }
1045     
1046     /**
1047      * Get the list of converted users i.e. users for which the authSource/password has been changed
1048      * @return array of username => user_id
1049      */
1050     public function getConvertedUserIdList()
1051     {
1052         return $this->userConvertedList;
1053     }
1054     
1055     /**
1056      * Get the list of valid users for which the account has been disabled
1057      * @return array of username => user_id
1058      */
1059     public function getDisabledUserIdList()
1060     {
1061         return $this->userConvertedList;
1062     }
1063     
1064     /**
1065      * Get the list of users that were alredy in the platform
1066      * @return array of username => user_id
1067      */
1068     public function getAlreadyThereUserIdList()
1069     {
1070         return $this->userAlreadyThere;
1071     }
1072     
1073     /**
1074      * 
1075      * @param Iterator $userList
1076      * @param string $overwriteAuthSourceWith change the auth source for existing users with the given one, set to null if you want to keep the original auth source (default:null)
1077      * @param bool $emptyPasswordForOverWrittenAuthSource empty (i.e. set to string value 'empty') users for which the auth source is changed
1078      * @return boolean false if empty list given
1079      */
1080     public function registerUserList ( $userList, $overwriteAuthSourceWith = null, $emptyPasswordForOverWrittenAuthSource = false )
1081     {
1082         if ( ! count( $userList ) )
1083         {
1084             return false;
1085         }
1086         
1087         foreach ( $userList as $user )
1088         {
1089             try
1090             {
1091                 $userFound = $this->getUserIfAlreadyExists ( $user );
1092 
1093                 if ( false !== $userFound )
1094                 {
1095                     if ( $userFound['email'] == $user->email )
1096                     {
1097                         if ( $overwriteAuthSourceWith 
1098                             && ( $userFound['authSource']  !== $overwriteAuthSourceWith ) )
1099                         {
1100                             if ( $emptyPasswordForOverWrittenAuthSource )
1101                             {
1102                                 $emptyPassword = ",
1103                                     `password` = 'empty'
1104                                 ";
1105                             }
1106                             else
1107                             {
1108                                 $emptyPassword = '';
1109                             }
1110                             
1111                             $this->database->exec( "
1112                             UPDATE
1113                                 `{$this->tables['user']}`
1114                             SET
1115                                 `authSource` = ".$this->database->quote( $overwriteAuthSourceWith )."
1116                                 {$emptyPassword}
1117                             WHERE
1118                                 user_id = " . Claroline::getDatabase ()->escape ( $userFound['user_id'] )
1119                             );
1120                             
1121                             $this->userConvertedList[$userFound['username']] = $userFound['user_id'];
1122                             Console::info ( "Change authSource to {$overwriteAuthSourceWith} for user ".var_export($userFound,true) );
1123                         }
1124                         else
1125                         {
1126                             // user already there, nothing to be done
1127                             $this->userAlreadyThere[$userFound['username']] = $userFound['user_id'];
1128                         }
1129 
1130                         $this->userSuccessList[$userFound['username']] = $userFound['user_id'];
1131                     }
1132                     else
1133                     {
1134                         if ( $userFound['authSource']  !== $overwriteAuthSourceWith )
1135                         {
1136                             // disable old account by changing the username
1137                             $this->database->exec( "
1138                             UPDATE
1139                                 `{$this->tables['user']}`
1140                             SET
1141                                 `authSource` = 'disabled',
1142                                 `username` = CONCAT('*EPC*', username )
1143                             WHERE
1144                                 user_id = " . Claroline::getDatabase ()->escape ( $userFound['user_id'] )
1145                             );
1146 
1147                             $this->userDisabledList[$userFound['username']] = $userFound['user_id'];
1148 
1149                             Console::info ( "Disable account for user ".var_export($userFound,true)." : conflict with ldap account " .var_export($user,true) );
1150 
1151                             $this->insertUserAsNew($user);
1152                         }
1153                         else
1154                         {
1155                             // this is the same user and we trust the authentication source over the user list data
1156                             Console::info('User already there with same authsource but different email : trust authsource [' . var_export($userFound,true).']');
1157                             $this->userAlreadyThere[$userFound['username']] = $userFound['user_id'];
1158                             $this->userSuccessList[$userFound['username']] = $userFound['user_id'];
1159                         }
1160                     }
1161                 }
1162                 else
1163                 {
1164                     $this->insertUserAsNew($user);
1165                 }
1166             }
1167             catch ( Exception $e )
1168             {
1169                 $this->userFailureList[] = $user;
1170                 Console::error ( "Cannot add user {$user->username} : EXCEPTION '{$e->getMessage()}' with stack {$e->getTraceAsString ()}" );
1171             }
1172         }
1173         
1174         Console::info( "Add user to platform from EPC : converted=" . count( $this->userConvertedList )
1175                 . " disabled=" .count( $this->userDisabledList )
1176                 . " inserted=" . count( $this->userInsertedList )
1177                 . " alreadythere=" . count( $this->userAlreadyThere )
1178                 . " failed=" . count( $this->userFailureList ) );
1179         
1180         if ( count( $this->userInsertedList ) )
1181         {
1182             Console::info( "Add user to platform from EPC : userid created " . implode(',', $this->userInsertedList ) );
1183         }
1184         
1185         return true;
1186         
1187     }
1188     
1189     /**
1190      * Insert a user record as new user in the platform user list
1191      * @param stdClass $user (lastname,firstname,username,email,officialCode)
1192      */
1193     protected function insertUserAsNew( $user )
1194     {
1195         $this->database->exec( "
1196         INSERT INTO `{$this->tables['user']}`
1197         SET nom             = ". $this->database->quote($user->lastname) .",
1198             prenom          = ". $this->database->quote($user->firstname) .",
1199             username        = ". $this->database->quote($user->username) .",
1200             language        = '',
1201             email           = ". $this->database->quote($user->email) .",
1202             officialCode    = ". $this->database->quote($user->officialCode) .",
1203             officialEmail   = ". $this->database->quote($user->email) .",
1204             authSource      = 'ldap', 
1205             phoneNumber     = '',
1206             password        = 'empty',
1207             isCourseCreator = 0,
1208             isPlatformAdmin = 0,
1209             creatorId    = " . claro_get_current_user_id() );
1210         
1211         $key = (string) $user->username;
1212 
1213         $this->userInsertedList[$key] = $this->userSuccessList[$key] = $this->database->insertId();
1214     }
1215     
1216     /**
1217      * Returns a user if it is found, false otherwise
1218      * @param stdClass $user (username,...)
1219      * @return mixed false or the found user
1220      */
1221     public function getUserIfAlreadyExists ( $user )
1222     {
1223         $foundUser = $this->database->query ( "
1224             SELECT 
1225                 u.username,
1226                 u.user_id,
1227                 u.authSource,
1228                 u.email
1229             FROM 
1230                 `{$this->tables['user']}` AS u 
1231             WHERE 
1232                 u.`username` = " . $this->database->quote ( $user->username )
1233         );
1234 
1235         if ( !$foundUser->numRows () )
1236         {
1237             return false;
1238         }
1239         else
1240         {
1241             return $foundUser->fetch();
1242         }
1243     }
1244     
1245     /**
1246      * Delete a user list
1247      * @param array $userIdList
1248      * @return int
1249      */
1250     public function deleteUserList ( $userIdList )
1251     {
1252         if ( ! count( $userIdList ) )
1253         {
1254             return false;
1255         }
1256         
1257         $affectedRows = $this->database->exec("
1258             DELETE FROM
1259                 `{$this->tables['user']}`
1260             WHERE
1261                 `user_id` IN (".implode( ',', $userIdList ).")
1262         ");
1263                 
1264         // do we need to delete user tracking or not ?
1265         
1266         Console::info("Removed {$affectedRows} users : " . implode( ',', $userIdList ) );
1267                 
1268         return $affectedRows;
1269     }
1270     
1271     /**
1272      * Disable the accounts for the given user list
1273      * @param array $userIdList
1274      * @return int
1275      */
1276     public function disableUserList ( $userIdList )
1277     {
1278         if ( ! count( $userIdList ) )
1279         {
1280             return false;
1281         }
1282         
1283         $affectedRows = $this->database->exec("
1284             UPDATE
1285                 `{$this->tables['user']}`
1286             SET
1287                 `authSource` = 'disabled'
1288             WHERE
1289                 `user_id` IN (".implode( ',', $userIdList ).")
1290         ");
1291         
1292         Console::info("Disabled {$affectedRows} users : " . implode( ',', $userIdList ) );
1293                 
1294         return $affectedRows;
1295     }
1296 
1297 }
1298 
1299 /**
1300  * USer list of a course
1301  * @since Claroline 1.11.9
1302  */
1303 class Claro_CourseUserList
1304 {
1305     const
1306         USE_KEY_USERID = 'user_id',
1307         USE_KEY_USERNAME = 'username';
1308 
1309     protected $cid, $course, $database, $tables;
1310     protected $courseUserList, $courseUserIdList, $courseUsernameList;
1311     
1312     protected $hasPendingUsers = null;
1313 
1314     /**
1315      * 
1316      * @param string $cid id(code) of the course
1317      * @param mixed $database Database_Connection instance or null, if null, the default database connection will be used
1318      */
1319     public function __construct ( $cid = null, $database = null )
1320     {
1321         $this->cid = is_null ( $cid ) ? claro_get_current_course_id () : $cid;
1322         $this->database = is_null ( $database ) ? Claroline::getDatabase () : $database;
1323 
1324         $this->course = new Claro_course ( $cid );
1325         $this->course->load ();
1326         
1327         $this->tables = claro_sql_get_main_tbl ();
1328     }
1329     
1330     /**
1331      * Get the list of users registered in the course
1332      * @param bool $forceRefresh
1333      * @return array of user_id => (username,user_id,count_user_enrol,count_class_enrol,isPending)
1334      */
1335     public function getUserList ( $forceRefresh = false )
1336     {
1337         if ( !is_array ( $this->courseUserList ) || $forceRefresh )
1338         {
1339             $resultSet = $this->getUserListIteratorUsingKey( self::USE_KEY_USERID );
1340 
1341             $this->courseUserList = array ( );
1342 
1343             foreach ( $resultSet as $userId => $user )
1344             {
1345                 $this->courseUserList[ $userId ] = $user;
1346             }
1347         }
1348 
1349         return $this->courseUserList;
1350     }
1351     
1352     protected function getUserListIteratorUsingKey( $key )
1353     {
1354         if ( $key != self::USE_KEY_USERID && $key != self::USE_KEY_USERNAME )
1355         {
1356             throw new Exception('Invalid key : must be Claro_CourseUserList::USE_KEY_USERID or Claro_CourseUserList::USE_KEY_USERNAME');
1357         }
1358 
1359         $cid = $this->database->quote ( $this->cid );
1360 
1361         $resultSet = $this->database->query ( "
1362             SELECT 
1363                 u.username, 
1364                 cu.user_id, 
1365                 cu.count_user_enrol, 
1366                 cu.count_class_enrol,
1367                 cu.isPending
1368             FROM
1369                 `{$this->tables['rel_course_user']}` AS cu
1370             JOIN
1371                 `{$this->tables['user']}` AS u
1372             ON
1373                 cu.user_id = u.user_id
1374             WHERE
1375                 cu.code_cours = {$cid}
1376         " );
1377 
1378         $resultSet->useId ( $key );
1379         
1380         return $resultSet;
1381     }
1382     
1383     /**
1384      * Get the list of the ids of the users registered in the course
1385      * @param bool $forceRefresh
1386      * @return array of user_id => user_id so it can be used a a list or a set
1387      */
1388     public function getUserIdList ( $forceRefresh = false )
1389     {
1390         if ( !is_array ( $this->courseUserIdList ) || $forceRefresh )
1391         {
1392             $cid = $this->database->quote ( $this->cid );
1393 
1394             $resultSet = $this->database->query ( "
1395                 SELECT
1396                     cu.user_id
1397                 FROM
1398                     `{$this->tables['rel_course_user']}` AS cu
1399 
1400                 WHERE
1401                     cu.code_cours = {$cid}
1402                 
1403             " );
1404 
1405             $resultSet->useId ( 'user_id' );
1406 
1407             $this->courseUserIdList = array ( );
1408 
1409             foreach ( $resultSet as $user_id => $user )
1410             {
1411                 $this->courseUserIdList[ $user_id ] = $user_id;
1412             }
1413         }
1414 
1415         return $this->courseUserIdList;
1416     }
1417     
1418     /**
1419      * Get the list of the usernames of the users registered in the course
1420      * @param bool $forceRefresh
1421      * @return array of username => (username,user_id,count_user_enrol,count_class_enrol,isPending)
1422      */
1423     public function getUsernameList( $forceRefresh = false )
1424     {
1425         if ( !is_array ( $this->courseUserList ) || $forceRefresh )
1426         {
1427             $resultSet = $this->getUserListIteratorUsingKey( self::USE_KEY_USERNAME );
1428 
1429             $this->courseUsernameList = array ( );
1430 
1431             foreach ( $resultSet as $username => $user )
1432             {
1433                 $this->courseUsernameList[ $username ] = $user;
1434             }
1435         }
1436 
1437         return $this->courseUsernameList;
1438     }
1439     
1440     /**
1441      * Check if the given user is already in the course
1442      * @param int $userId
1443      * @return boolean
1444      */
1445     public function is_userIdAlreadyInCourse( $userId )
1446     {
1447         $userIdList = $this->getUserIdList();
1448         
1449         return isset( $userIdList[$userId] ) ? true : false;
1450     }
1451     
1452     /**
1453      * Check if a course has pending user registrations
1454      * @param boolean $forceRefresh
1455      * @return boolean
1456      */
1457     public function has_registrationPending( $forceRefresh = false )
1458     {
1459         if ( is_null($this->hasPendingUsers) || $forceRefresh )
1460         {
1461             $cid = $this->database->quote ( $this->cid );
1462 
1463             $this->hasPendingUsers = $this->database->query ( "
1464                 SELECT 
1465                     u.username, 
1466                     cu.user_id, 
1467                     cu.count_user_enrol, 
1468                     cu.count_class_enrol,
1469                     cu.isPending
1470                 FROM
1471                     `{$this->tables['rel_course_user']}` AS cu
1472                 JOIN
1473                     `{$this->tables['user']}` AS u
1474                 ON
1475                     cu.user_id = u.user_id
1476                 WHERE
1477                     cu.code_cours = {$cid}
1478                 AND    
1479                     cu.isPending = 1
1480                 AND
1481                     cu.isCourseManager = 0
1482             " )->numRows();
1483         }
1484         
1485         return $this->hasPendingUsers;
1486     }
1487     
1488     /**
1489      * Get the list of user ids filtered
1490      * @param array $profileList list of profile labels
1491      * @param string $registeredBefore date yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss
1492      * @param string $registeredAfter date yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss
1493      * @return array of id => id
1494      */
1495     public function getFilteredUserIdList( $profileList = array(), $registeredBefore = null, $registeredAfter = null )
1496     {
1497         $sqlCourseCode = $this->database->quote( $this->course->courseId );
1498 
1499         $sqlDateFilterArray = array();
1500 
1501         if ( $registeredAfter )
1502         {
1503             $sqlDateFilterArray[] = "`registration_date` >= " . $this->database->quote( $registeredAfter );
1504         }
1505 
1506         if ( $registeredBefore )
1507         {
1508             $sqlDateFilterArray[] = "`registration_date` <= " . $this->database->quote( $registeredBefore );
1509         }
1510 
1511         if ( count($sqlDateFilterArray) == 2 )
1512         {
1513             $sqlDateFilter = "
1514                 AND
1515                     (" . implode( ' OR ', $sqlDateFilterArray ) . ")
1516             ";
1517         }
1518         elseif ( count($sqlDateFilterArray) == 1 )
1519         {
1520             $sqlDateFilter = "
1521                 AND
1522                     {$sqlDateFilterArray[0]}
1523             ";
1524         }
1525         else
1526         {
1527             $sqlDateFilter = "";
1528         }
1529 
1530         if ( count( $profileList ) )
1531         {
1532             foreach ( $profileList as $key => $value )
1533             {
1534                 $profileList[$key] = claro_get_profile_id( $value );
1535             }
1536 
1537             // profileId not in profileToKeep
1538             $sqlProfilesToDelete = "
1539                 AND 
1540                     `profile_id` IN (".implode(',',$profileList).")
1541             ";
1542         }
1543         else
1544         {
1545             $sqlProfilesToDelete = "";
1546         }
1547         
1548         $userList = $this->database->query( "
1549             SELECT
1550                 `user_id` AS `id`
1551             FROM
1552                 `{$this->tables['rel_course_user']}`
1553             WHERE
1554                 `code_cours` = {$sqlCourseCode}
1555             {$sqlProfilesToDelete}
1556             {$sqlDateFilter}
1557 
1558         ");
1559         
1560         $userIdList = array();
1561         
1562         foreach ( $userList as $user )
1563         {
1564             $userIdList[$user['id']] = $user['id'];
1565         }
1566         
1567         return $userIdList;
1568     }
1569 
1570 }

  20 /**
  21  * JSON Response
  22  */
  23 class Json_Response
  24 {
  25     /**
  26      * Message type SUCCESS
  27      */
  28     const SUCCESS = 'success';
  29 
  30     /**
  31      * Message type ERROR
  32      */
  33     const ERROR = 'error';
  34     
  35     protected $type, $body;
  36 
  37     /**
  38      * @param mixed $body
  39      * @param string $type Json_Response::SUCCESS (default)
  40      *  or Json_Response::ERROR
  41      */
  42     public function __construct( $body, $type = self::SUCCESS )
  43     {
  44         $this->body = $body;
  45         $this->type = $type;
  46     }
  47 
  48     /**
  49      * Get JSON code for the response
  50      * @return string JSON code (utf-8 encoded)
  51      */
  52     public function toJson()
  53     {
  54         $response = $response = array(
  55             'responseType' => $this->type,
  56             'responseBody' => $this->body
  57         );
  58         
  59         claro_utf8_encode_array( $response );
  60         
  61         return json_encode( $response );
  62     }
  63 }

  86      * @param Exception $e
  87      */
  88     public function __construct( $e )
  89     {
  90         $errorArr = array(
  91             'errno' => $e->getCode(),
  92             'error' => $e->getMessage()

  94

  98             $errorArr['file'] = $e->getFile();

 106 /**
 107  * AJAX Remote Method Request
 108  * @since Claroline 1.9.5
 109  */
 110 class Ajax_Request
 111 {
 112     protected $klass, $method, $params;
 113 
 114     /**
 115      * @param string $class class name
 116      * @param string $method invoked method name
 117      * @param array $params method invokation parameters
 118      */
 119     public function __construct( $class, $method, $params = array() )
 120     {
 121         $this->klass = $class;
 122         $this->method = $method;
 123         $this->params = $params;
 124     }
 125 
 126     /**
 127      * Get the name of the invoked class
 128      * @return string class name
 129      */
 130     public function getClass()
 131     {
 132         return $this->klass;
 133     }
 134 
 135     /**
 136      * Get the name of the invoked method
 137      * @return string method name
 138      */
 139     public function getMethod()
 140     {
 141         return $this->method;
 142     }
 143 
 144     /**
 145      * Get the parameters for the invoked method
 146      * @param  bool $getInputValidator return a Claro_Input_validator instead of an array
 147      * @return array method parameters or Claro_Input_validator
 148      */
 149     public function getParameters( $getInputValidator = false )
 150     {
 151         if ( $getInputValidator )
 152         {
 153             return new Claro_Input_Validator( 
 154                 new Claro_Input_Array( $this->params ) );
 155         }
 156         else
 157         {
 158             return $this->params;
 159         }
 160     }
 161 
 162     public function  __toString()
 163     {
 164         return $this->getClass().'::'.$this->getMethod().'('.implode(',',$this->getParameters()).')';
 165     }
 166 
 167     /**
 168      * FActory : build an Ajax Request object from the user input
 169      * @param Claro_Input $userInput
 170      * @return Ajax_Request
 171      */
 172     public static function getRequest( Claro_Input $userInput )
 173     {
 174         if ( $userInput->get( 'parametersType', null ) == 'json' )
 175         {
 176             $parameters = json_decode($userInput->get('parameters', array()));
 177         }
 178         // default parametersType = array
 179         else
 180         {
 181             $parameters = $userInput->get('parameters', array());
 182         }
 183 
 184         $request = new self(
 185             $userInput->getMandatory('class'),
 186             $userInput->getMandatory('method'),
 187             $parameters
 188         );
 189 
 190         return $request;
 191     }
 192 }

 194 /**
 195  * Ajax Remote Service interface
 196  * @since Claroline 1.9.5
 197  */
 198 interface Ajax_Remote_Service
 199 {
 200     /**
 201      * Check if the current user is allowed execute the request
 202      * @param Ajax_Request $request

 204      */

 208 /**
 209  * Abstract Module Remote Service. Should be extended by module Ajax Remote
 210  * Service.
 211  * @since Claroline 1.9.5
 212  */
 213 abstract class Ajax_Remote_Module_Service implements Ajax_Remote_Service
 214 {
 215     /**
 216      * Get the invokable methods for the service
 217      * @return array of remotely invokable public methods
 218      */
 219     abstract public function getInvokableMethods();
 220 
 221     /**
 222      * Get the invokation name of the class
 223      * @return string
 224      */
 225     abstract public function getInvokableClassName();
 226 
 227     /**
 228      * Get the label of the module this service belongs to
 229      * @return string
 230      */
 231     abstract public function getModuleLabel();
 232 
 233     /**
 234      * Register the service
 235      * @param Ajax_Remote_Service_Broker $broker
 236      */
 237     public function register( Ajax_Remote_Service_Broker $broker )
 238     {
 239         $broker->register(
 240             $this->getInvokableClassName(),
 241             $this,
 242             $this->getInvokableMethods(),
 243             true );
 244     }
 245 
 246     /**
 247      * Get the Invokation url to use to call the given method from inside the 
 248      * platform. The url object return is not contextualized !
 249      * @param string $method optional name of the method to invoke
 250      * @param array $parameters optional parameters for method invokation
 251      * @return Url
 252      */
 253     public function getInvokationUrl( $method = null, $parameters = null )
 254     {
 255         $url = new Url( rtrim( get_platform_base_url (), '/' )
 256             . '/claroline/backends/ajaxbroker.php' );
 257 
 258         $url = $this->addParametersToInvokationUrl($url, $method, $parameters);
 259         
 260         return  $url;
 261     }
 262     
 263     /**
 264      * Get the Invokation url to use to call the given method from outside the 
 265      * platform. The url object return is not contextualized !
 266      * @param string $method optional name of the method to invoke
 267      * @param array $parameters optional parameters for method invokation
 268      * @return Url
 269      */
 270     public function getExternalInvokationUrl( $method = null, $parameters = null )
 271     {
 272         $url = new Url( rtrim( get_path('rootWeb'), '/' )
 273             . '/claroline/backends/ajaxbroker.php' );
 274 
 275         $url = $this->addParametersToInvokationUrl($url, $method, $parameters);
 276         
 277         return  $url;
 278     }
 279     
 280     private function addParametersToInvokationUrl( $url, $method = null, $parameters = null )
 281     {
 282         $url->addParam( 'moduleLabel', $this->getModuleLabel() );
 283         $url->addParam( 'class', $this->getInvokableClassName() );
 284 
 285         if ( ! empty( $method ) )
 286         {
 287             if ( ! in_array( $method, $this->getInvokableMethods() ) )
 288             {
 289                 throw new Exception("Method not in invokable method list");
 290             }
 291             else
 292             {
 293                 $url->addParam( 'method', $method );
 294             }
 295         }
 296 
 297         if ( is_array( $parameters ) && !empty( $parameters ) )
 298         {
 299             foreach ( $parameters as $key => $value )
 300             {
 301                 $url->addParam("parameters['{$key}']", $value);
 302             }
 303         }
 304 
 305         return $url;
 306     }
 307 
 308     /**
 309      * Instanciate and register the AJAX remote service for a given module.
 310      * The remote service must be defined in the connector/ajaxservice.cnr.php
 311      * file of the module, extends the Ajax_Remote_Module_Service abstract class
 312      * and, in addition, it's name must follow the pattern "{$moduleLabel}_AjaxRemoteService"
 313      * @param string $moduleLabel
 314      * @return Ajax_Remote_Module_Service
 315      * @throws Exception if the module does not provide an AJAX remote service
 316      */
 317     public static function registerModuleServiceInstance( $moduleLabel )
 318     {
 319         $ajaxHandler = self::getModuleServiceInstance ( $moduleLabel );
 320         $ajaxHandler->register( Claroline::ajaxServiceBroker() );
 321         
 322         return $ajaxHandler;
 323     }
 324     
 325     /**
 326      * Factory method to instanciate the AJAX remote service for a given module.
 327      * The remote service must be defined in the connector/ajaxservice.cnr.php
 328      * file of the module, extends the Ajax_Remote_Module_Service abstract class
 329      * and, in addition, it's name must follow the pattern "{$moduleLabel}_AjaxRemoteService"
 330      * @param string $moduleLabel
 331      * @return Ajax_Remote_Module_Service
 332      * @throws Exception if the module does not provide an AJAX remote service
 333      */
 334     public static function getModuleServiceInstance( $moduleLabel )
 335     {
 336         $ajaxHandlerPath = get_module_path($moduleLabel) . '/connector/ajaxservice.cnr.php';
 337         $ajaxHandlerClass = "{$moduleLabel}_AjaxRemoteService";
 338 
 339         if ( file_exists( $ajaxHandlerPath ) )
 340         {
 341             require_once $ajaxHandlerPath;
 342 
 343             if ( class_exists( $ajaxHandlerClass ) )
 344             {
 345                 $ajaxHandler = new $ajaxHandlerClass();
 346 
 347                 return $ajaxHandler;
 348             }
 349             else
 350             {
 351                 throw new Exception("No AJAX service found for {$moduleLabel}");
 352             }
 353         }
 354         else
 355         {
 356             throw new Exception("No AJAX service found for {$moduleLabel}");
 357         }
 358     }
 359 }
 360 
 361 /**
 362  * Ajax remote service broker serves the ajax request to the right ajax remote
 363  * service and returns the response from the method invokation
 364  * @since Claroline 1.9.5
 365  */
 366 class Ajax_Remote_Service_Broker
 367 {
 368     protected $register = array();
 369 
 370     /**
 371      * Register an Ajax Remote Service
 372      * @param string $className
 373      * @param Ajax_Remote_Service $object
 374      * @param array $methods or null to allow remote invokation of the public
 375      *  methods of the service (not recommanded)
 376      * @param boolean $overwrite set to true to averwrite a previous
 377      *  registration of the same service
 378      * @throws Exception if trying to overwrite accidentally (i.e. without
 379      *  setting $overwrite to true) an already registered service
 380      */
 381     public function register( $className, Ajax_Remote_Service $object, $methods = null, $overwrite = false )
 382     {
 383         if ( ! isset($this->register[$className]) || $overwrite === true )
 384         {
 385             $this->register[$className] = array(
 386                 'object' => $object,
 387                 'methods' => $methods
 388             );
 389         }
 390         else
 391         {
 392             throw new Exception ("Service Error : try to overwrite class {$className}");
 393         }
 394     }
 395 
 396     /**
 397      * Handle an Ajax Request
 398      * @param Ajax_Request $request
 399      * @return Json_Response or Json_Exception if the invoked class or method
 400      *  is not found or not callable or if the invokation is not allowed or
 401      *  throws an exception
 402      */
 403     public function handle( Ajax_Request $request )
 404     {
 405         try
 406         {
 407             if ( isset ($this->register[$request->getClass()]) )
 408             {
 409                 if (
 410                     in_array( $request->getMethod(), $this->register[$request->getClass()]['methods'] )
 411                     || is_null($this->register[$request->getClass()]['methods'])
 412                 )
 413                 {
 414                     if ( ! $this->register[$request->getClass()]['object']->isMethodInvokationAllowed($request) )
 415                     {
 416                         throw new Exception('Remote method invokation not allowed : ' . $request->__toString());
 417                     }
 418 
 419                     if ( is_callable( array(
 420                             $this->register[$request->getClass()]['object'],
 421                             $request->getMethod() )
 422                         )
 423                     )
 424                     {
 425                         $response = call_user_func(
 426                             array( $this->register[$request->getClass()]['object'],
 427                             $request->getMethod() ),
 428                             $request );
 429 
 430                         return new Json_Response(array(
 431                             'class' => $request->getClass(),
 432                             'method' => $request->getMethod(),
 433                             'parameters' => $request->getParameters(),
 434                             'response' => $response
 435                         ));
 436                     }
 437                     else
 438                     {
 439                         throw new Exception( "Method not callable {$request->getMethod()} in class {$request->getClass()}" );
 440                     }
 441                 }
 442                 else
 443                 {
 444                     throw new Exception( "Method not found {$request->getMethod()} in class {$request->getClass()}" );
 445                 }
 446             }
 447             else
 448             {
 449                 throw new Exception( "Class not found {$request->getClass()}" );
 450             }
 451         }
 452         catch ( Exception $e )
 453         {
 454             return new Json_Exception($e);
 455         }
 456     }
 457 }

   5 /**
   6  * File Finder Library
   7  * Inspired by SPL examples by Marcus Boerger
   8  *
   9  * @version     1.9 $Revision: 12923 $
  10  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  11  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  12  * @author      Frederic Minne <zefredz@claroline.net>
  13  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  14  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  15  * @package     utils
  16  */
  17 
  18 // From PEAR PHP_Compat 1.5.0
  19 if (!defined('PATH_SEPARATOR'))
  20 {
  21     define('PATH_SEPARATOR', strtoupper(substr(PHP_OS, 0, 3) == 'WIN') ? ';' : ':' );
  22 }
  23 
  24 /**
  25  * File Finder that searches a given path for files or folders matching a given criterium
  26  */
  27 class Claro_FileFinder extends FilterIterator
  28 {
  29     protected $searchString;
  30     
  31     /**
  32      * @param   string $path list of directory path separated by PATH_SEPARATOR
  33      * @param   string $searchString search criterium
  34      * @param   bool $recursive set to false to disable recursive search in subdirectories, default true
  35      */
  36     public function __construct( $path, $searchString, $recursive = true )
  37     {
  38         $this->searchString = $searchString;
  39         
  40         $pathList = explode( PATH_SEPARATOR, $path );
  41             
  42         if (count($pathList) <= 1)
  43         {
  44             if ( ! $recursive )
  45             {
  46                 parent::__construct( 
  47                     new IteratorIterator( 
  48                         new DirectoryIterator($path) ) ); 
  49             }
  50             else
  51             {
  52                 parent::__construct(
  53                     new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
  54                         new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($path)));
  55             }
  56         }
  57         else
  58         {
  59             $it = new AppendIterator();
  60                 
  61             foreach ( $pathList as $path )
  62             {
  63                 if ( ! $recursive )
  64                 {
  65                     $it->append( 
  66                         new IteratorIterator( 
  67                             new DirectoryIterator($path) ) ); 
  68                 }
  69                 else
  70                 {
  71                     $it->append(
  72                         new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
  73                             new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($path)));
  74                 }
  75             }
  76             
  77             parent::__construct($it);
  78         }
  79     }
  80     
  81     /**
  82      * Get the search criterium
  83      * @return  string
  84      */
  85     public function getSearchString()
  86     {
  87         return $this->searchString;
  88     }
  89     
  90     /**
  91      * @see     FilterIterator (SPL)
  92      */
  93     public function accept()
  94     {
  95         return !strcmp($this->getSearchString(), $this->current() );
  96     }
  97 }
  98 
  99 /**
 100  * Use a PCRE regular expression as search criterium
 101  */
 102 class Claro_FileFinder_Regexp extends Claro_FileFinder
 103 {
 104     public function accept()
 105     {
 106         return preg_match( $this->current(), $this->getSearchString() );
 107     }
 108 }
 109 
 110 /**
 111  * Use a file extension as search criterium
 112  */
 113 class Claro_FileFinder_Extension extends Claro_FileFinder
 114 {
 115     public function accept()
 116     {
 117         return $this->current()->isFile() &&
 118             ( strtolower( substr( $this->current(), - ( strlen($this->getSearchString()) ) ) ) == 
 119                 strtolower( $this->getSearchString() ) );
 120     }
 121 }
