  20 //load receivedmessage class
  21 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../message/receivedmessage.lib.php';
  22 
  23 class ReceivedMessageBox extends MessageBox
  24 {
  25     protected $numberOfUnreadMessage = FALSE;
  26     protected $numberOfPlatformMessage = FALSE;
  27 
  28     /**
  29      * mark the message (by the message id) as unread for the user (user identifiation) in parameter
  30      *
  31      * @param int $messageId message identification
  32      * @param int $userId user identification
  33      */
  34     public function markUnread($messageId, $userId = NULL)
  35     {
  36         $message = new ReceivedMessage($messageId, $userId);
  37         $message->markUnread();
  38     }
  39     
  40     /**
  41      * mark the message (by the message id) as read for the user (user identifiation) in parameter
  42      *
  43      * @param int $messageId message identification
  44      * @param int $userId user identification
  45      */
  46     public function markRead($messageId, $userId = NULL)
  47     {
  48         $message = new ReceivedMessage($messageId, $userId);
  49         $message->markRead();
  50     }
  51 
  52     /**
  53      * Set the deleted status as deleted for the message in parameter
  54      *
  55      * @param int $messageId message identification
  56      * @param int $userId user identification
  57      * if it not defined it use current user id
  58      */
  59     public function moveMessageToTrashBox($messageId, $userId = NULL)
  60     {
  61         $message = new ReceivedMessage($messageId, $userId);
  62         $message->moveToTrashBox();
  63     }
  64 
  65     /**
  66      * Set the deleted status as not deleted in the data base
  67      *
  68      * @param int $messageId message identification
  69      * @param int $userId user identification
  70      * if it not defined it use current user id
  71      */
  72     public function moveMessageToInBox($messageId, $userId = NULL)
  73     {
  74         $message = new ReceivedMessage($messageId, $userId);
  75         $message->moveToInBox();
  76     }
  77 
  78     /**
  79      * @see MessageBox
  80      *
  81      */
  82     public function loadMessageList()
  83     {
  84         if (!$this->messageList)
  85         {
  86             $tableName = get_module_main_tbl(array('im_message','im_message_status','user','im_recipient'));
  87 
  88             if ( ! is_null($this->messageFilter))
  89             {
  90                 $strategy = $this->messageFilter->getStrategy();
  91                 $order = $this->messageFilter->getOrder();
  92                 $limit = $this->messageFilter->getLimit();
  93             }
  94             else
  95             {
  96                 $strategy = "";
  97                 $order = "";
  98                 $limit = "";
  99             }
 100             
 101             $sql =
 102                 "SELECT  U.nom AS lastName, U.prenom AS firstName, M.message_id, M.sender, M.subject,\n"
 103                 ."M.message, M.send_time, R.is_read, R.is_deleted, R.user_id, M.course, M.group, M.tools,\n"
 104                 ."RE.sent_to"
 105                 . " FROM `" . $tableName['im_message'] . "` as M\n"
 106                 . " LEFT JOIN `" . $tableName['im_message_status'] . "` as R ON M.message_id = R.message_id\n"
 107                 . " LEFT JOIN `".$tableName['user']."` AS U ON M.sender = U.user_id\n"
 108                 ." LEFT JOIN `".$tableName['im_recipient']."` AS RE ON M.message_id = RE.message_id AND RE.user_id = R.user_id\n"
 109                 . " WHERE (R.user_id = " . (int)$this->getUserId() . " OR R.user_id = 0) \n" // 0 platforme message
 110                 .    " " . $strategy
 111                 .    " " . $order
 112                 .    " " . $limit
 113                 ;
 114             
 115             $this->messageList = claro_sql_query_fetch_all_rows($sql);
 116             
 117             //load number of message if its necessary
 118             $this->loadNumberOfMessage();
 119         }
 120     }
 121 
 122     /**
 123      * return the current message
 124      *
 125      * @return ReceivedMessage the current message
 126      */
 127     public function current()
 128     {
 129         return ReceivedMessage::fromArray($this->messageList[$this->index]);
 130     }
 131 
 132     /**
 133      * @see MessageBox
 134      */
 135     public function getNumberOfMessage()
 136     {
 137         //load number of message if its necessary
 138         $this->loadNumberOfMessage();
 139         
 140         return $this->numberOfMessage;
 141     }
 142     
 143     protected function loadNumberOfMessage()
 144     {
 145         if (!$this->numberOfMessage)
 146         {
 147             $tableName = get_module_main_tbl(array('im_message','im_message_status','user'));
 148                 
 149             if ( ! is_null($this->messageFilter))
 150             {
 151                 $strategy = $this->messageFilter->getStrategy();
 152             }
 153             else{
 154                 $strategy = "";
 155             }
 156 
 157             $sql =
 158                 "SELECT count(*)" 
 159                 ." FROM `" . $tableName['im_message'] . "` as M\n"
 160                 ." LEFT JOIN `" . $tableName['im_message_status'] . "` as "
 161                 ."R ON M.message_id = R.message_id\n"
 162                 ." LEFT JOIN `".$tableName['user']."` AS U ON M.sender = U.user_id\n"
 163                 ." WHERE (R.user_id = " . (int)$this->getUserId() . " OR R.user_id = 0) \n"
 164                 ." " . $strategy
 165                 ;
 166                 
 167             $this->numberOfMessage = claro_sql_query_fetch_single_value($sql);
 168         }
 169     }
 170     
 171     /**
 172      * return the number of unread message
 173      * 
 174      * @return int the number of unread message
 175      */
 176     public function numberOfUnreadMessage()
 177     {
 178         if (!$this->numberOfUnreadMessage)
 179         {
 180             $tableName = get_module_main_tbl(array('im_message','im_message_status','user'));
 181             
 182             if ( ! is_null($this->messageFilter) )
 183             {
 184                 $strategy = $this->messageFilter->getStrategy();
 185             }
 186             else
 187             {
 188                 $strategy = "";
 189             }
 190 
 191             $sql =
 192                 "SELECT count(*)\n" 
 193                 ." FROM `" . $tableName['im_message'] . "` as M\n"
 194                 ." LEFT JOIN `" . $tableName['im_message_status'] . "` as R ON M.message_id = R.message_id\n"
 195                 ." LEFT JOIN `".$tableName['user']."` AS U ON M.sender = U.user_id\n"
 196                 ." WHERE R.user_id = " . (int)$this->getUserId()."\n"
 197                 ." AND R.is_read = 0\n"
 198                 ." " . $strategy
 199                 ;
 200 
 201             $this->numberOfUnreadMessage = claro_sql_query_fetch_single_value($sql);
 202         }
 203         
 204         return $this->numberOfUnreadMessage;
 205     }
 206 
 207     /**
 208      * return the number of platform message
 209      * 
 210      * @return int the number of platform message
 211      */    
 212     public function numberOfPlatformMessage()
 213     {
 214         if (!$this->numberOfUnreadMessage)
 215         {
 216             $tableName = get_module_main_tbl(array('im_message','im_message_status','user'));
 217             
 218             if ( ! is_null($this->messageFilter) )
 219             {
 220                 $strategy = $this->messageFilter->getStrategy();
 221             }
 222             else
 223             {
 224                 $strategy = "";
 225             }
 226 
 227             $sql =
 228                 "SELECT count(*)\n" 
 229                 ." FROM `" . $tableName['im_message'] . "` as M\n"
 230                 ." LEFT JOIN `" . $tableName['im_message_status'] . "` as R ON M.message_id = R.message_id\n"
 231                 ." LEFT JOIN `".$tableName['user']."` AS U ON M.sender = U.user_id\n"
 232                 ." WHERE R.user_id = 0"."\n"
 233                 ." " . $strategy
 234                 ;
 235                 
 236             $this->numberOfPlatformMessage = claro_sql_query_fetch_single_value($sql);
 237         }
 238         
 239         return $this->numberOfPlatformMessage;
 240     }
 241     
 242     /**
 243      * return the number of page of the current message box
 244      *
 245      * @return int number of page
 246      */
 247     public function getNumberOfPage()
 248     {
 249         return ceil($this->getNumberOfMessage() / $this->getMessageStrategy()->getNumberOfMessagePerPage());
 250     }
 251 
 252     /**
 253      * empty the trashbox
 254      *
 255      */
 256     public function empyTrashBox()
 257     {
 258         $tableName = get_module_main_tbl(array('im_message_status'));
 259         
 260         $sql = 
 261             "DELETE FROM `" . $tableName['im_message_status'] . "`\n"
 262             ." WHERE is_deleted = 1\n"
 263             ." AND user_id = " . (int)$this->getUserId()."\n"
 264             ;
 265 
 266         claro_sql_query($sql);
 267     }
 268 }

   5 /**

  14  * @package     internal_messaging
  15  */
  16 
  17 FromKernel::uses('utils/finder.lib.php');
  18 
  19 class MessagingUserNotifier
  20 {
  21     /**
  22      * call all gateway notification
  23      *
  24      * @param int $uidList
  25      * @param messageToSend $message
  26      * @param int $messageId
  27      */
  28     public static function notify ($uidList, $message, $messageId)
  29     {
  30         // list all file in ./notifier/
  31         $notifierFile = new Claro_FileFinder_Extension(dirname(__FILE__) . '/notifier/', '.notifier.lib.php', false);
  32         
  33         $classNotLoad = '';
  34         
  35         foreach ( $notifierFile as $file )
  36         {
  37             require_once $file->getPathname();
  38             
  39             //take the name of the class  
  40             // convention file: name.lib.php classe: name
  41             $className = substr($file->getFilename(),0,strlen($file->getFilename())-strlen(".notifier.lib.php")).'Notifier';
  42             
  43             if (class_exists($className))
  44             {
  45                 $notifier = new $className();
  46                 $notifier->notify($uidList, $message,$messageId);
  47             }
  48             else
  49             {
  50                 if ($classNotLoad != '')
  51                 {
  52                     $classNotLoad .= ', ';
  53                 }
  54                 
  55                 $classNotLoad .= $className;
  56             }
  57         }
  58         
  59         if ($classNotLoad != '')
  60         {
  61             claro_die(get_lang("The message sent but the notification by " . $classNotLoad . " failed"));
  62         }
  63     }
  64 }
  65

  67  * messagingnotifier interface
  68  *
  69  * @version     1.9 $Revision: 13498 $

  74  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  75  * @package     internal_messaging
  76  */
  77 
  78 interface MessagingNotifier
  79 {
  80     public function notify ($userDataList,$message,$messageId);
  81 }

   1 <?php // $Id: recipientlist.lib.php 12923 2011-03-03 14:23:57Z abourguignon $
   2 
   3 // vim: expandtab sw=4 ts=4 sts=4:
   4 
   5 /**
   6  * recipient list class
   7  *
   8  * @version     1.9 $Revision: 12923 $
   9  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  10  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  11  * @author      Christophe Mertens <thetotof@gmail.com>
  12  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  13  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  14  * @package     internal_messaging
  15  */
  16 
  17 //load messagetoSend class
  18 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../message/messagetosend.lib.php';
  19 //load notifier class
  20 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/../notification/notifier.lib.php';
  21 
  22 abstract class RecipientList
  23 {
  24     /**
  25      * Return an array of the users identification (int)
  26      *
  27      * @return array the identification of the users
  28      */
  29     abstract public function getRecipientList();
  30     
  31     /**
  32      * add the userId as recpient of the message id
  33      *
  34      * @param int $messageId message id
  35      * @param int $userId user id
  36      */
  37     abstract protected function addRecipient($messageId,$userId);
  38     
  39     /**
  40      * send the current message to the user in the recipientList
  41      *
  42      * @param messageToSend 
  43      * @return int id of the message
  44      */
  45     public final function sendMessage($message)
  46     {
  47         $recipientListID = $this->getRecipientList();
  48 
  49         if (!is_array($recipientListID))
  50         {
  51             throw new Exception("");
  52         }
  53 
  54         if (empty($recipientListID))
  55         {
  56             return false;
  57         }
  58 
  59         $messageId = $this->addMessage($message);
  60         
  61         $this->sendMessageToUser($recipientListID,$messageId);
  62         
  63         MessagingUserNotifier::notify($recipientListID,$message,$messageId);
  64 
  65         return $messageId;
  66 
  67     }
  68 
  69     /**
  70      * create the message in the message table and return the identification of this
  71      *
  72      * @return int message identification
  73      */
  74     private final function addMessage($messageToSend)
  75     {
  76         //create an array of the name of the table needed
  77         $tableName = get_module_main_tbl(array('im_message'));
  78         
  79         $subject = claro_sql_escape($messageToSend->getSubject());
  80         $message = claro_sql_escape($messageToSend->getMessage());
  81         
  82         if ( is_null( $messageToSend->getSender() ) )
  83         {
  84             $sender = claro_get_current_user_id();
  85         }
  86         else
  87         {
  88             $sender = (int) $messageToSend->getSender();
  89         }
  90 
  91         if (!is_null($messageToSend->getCourseCode()))
  92         {
  93             $course = "'".claro_sql_escape($messageToSend->getCourseCode())."'";
  94         }
  95         else
  96         {
  97             $course = "NULL";
  98         }
  99         
 100         if (!is_null($messageToSend->getGroupId()))
 101         {
 102             $group = (int)$messageToSend->getGroupId();
 103         }
 104         else
 105         {
 106             $group = "NULL";
 107         }
 108         
 109         if (!is_null($messageToSend->getToolsLabel()))
 110         {
 111             $tools = "'".claro_sql_escape($messageToSend->getToolsLabel())."'";
 112         }
 113         else
 114         {
 115             $tools = "NULL";
 116         }
 117 
 118         // add the message in the table of messages and retrieves the ID
 119         $addInternalMessageSQL =
 120             "INSERT INTO `".$tableName['im_message']."` \n"
 121             . "(sender, subject, message, send_time, course, `group` , tools) \n"
 122             . "VALUES ($sender,'".$subject."','".$message."', '\n" 
 123             . date( "Y-m-d H:i:s", claro_time() ) . "',".$course.",".$group.",".$tools.")\n"
 124             ;
 125 
 126         // try to read the last ID inserted if the request pass
 127         if (claro_sql_query($addInternalMessageSQL))
 128         {
 129             return claro_sql_insert_id();
 130         }
 131         else
 132         {
 133             throw new Exception(claro_sql_errno().":".claro_sql_error());
 134         }
 135     }
 136 
 137     /**
 138      * Send the message to member of user list
 139      *
 140      * @param array of userId $recipientListID list of user identification
 141      * @param int $messageId message identification
 142      */
 143     private final function sendMessageToUser($recipientListId,$messageId)
 144     {
 145         $tableName = get_module_main_tbl(array('im_message_status'));
 146         
 147         //send a message to each user
 148         foreach ($recipientListId as $currentRecipient)
 149         {
 150             $addInternalMessageSQL =
 151                 "INSERT INTO `" . $tableName['im_message_status'] . "` "
 152                 . "(user_id, message_id, is_read, is_deleted) \n"
 153                 . "values (" . (int)$currentRecipient . "," . (int)$messageId . ",0 , 0)\n"
 154                 ;
 155             
 156             if (!claro_sql_query($addInternalMessageSQL))
 157             {
 158                 throw new Exception(claro_sql_errno().":".claro_sql_error());
 159             }
 160             
 161             $this->addRecipient($messageId,$currentRecipient);
 162         }
 163     }
 164 }

   5 /**

  16 
  17 //load selector strategy interface
  18 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/selectorstrategy.lib.php';
  19 
  20 abstract class MessageStrategy implements SelectorStrategy 
  21 {
  22     const NO_FILTER = "";
  23     
  24     const SEARCH_STRATEGY_EXPRESSION = "expression";
  25     const SEARCH_STRATEGY_WORD = "word";
  26     
  27     const ORDER_DESC = "DESC";
  28     const ORDER_ASC = "ASC";
  29     
  30     const ORDER_BY_DATE = "M.send_time %order%";
  31     
  32     protected $search = "";
  33     protected $searchStrategy = self::SEARCH_STRATEGY_WORD;
  34     
  35     protected $fieldOrder = self::ORDER_BY_DATE;
  36     protected $order = self::ORDER_DESC;
  37     
  38     protected $numberMessagePerPage;
  39     protected $pageToDisplay = 1;
  40 
  41     /**
  42      * create a message stratagy
  43      *
  44      */
  45     public function __construct()
  46     {
  47         $this->numberMessagePerPage = get_conf('messagePerPage',20);
  48     }
  49     
  50     /**
  51      * set the string to search
  52      *
  53      * @param string $search string to search
  54      */
  55     public function setSearch($search)
  56     {
  57         $this->search = $search;
  58     }
  59     
  60     /**
  61      * set the search strategy
  62      * MessageStrategy::SEARCH_STRATEGY_EXPRESSION to search the exact expression
  63      * MessageStrategy::SEARCH_STRATEGY_WORD to search message contain at least 1 word of the string
  64      *
  65      * @param unknown_type $searchStrategy
  66      */
  67     public function setSearchStrategy($searchStrategy)
  68     {
  69         if ($searchStrategy == self::SEARCH_STRATEGY_EXPRESSION || 
  70             $searchStrategy == self::SEARCH_STRATEGY_WORD)
  71         {
  72             $this->searchStrategy = $searchStrategy;
  73         }
  74     }
  75     
  76     /**
  77      * Set the order of search
  78      *
  79      * @param string $order: accpeted value MessageStrategy::ORDER_DESC and MessageStrategy::ORDER_ASC
  80      */
  81     public function setOrder($order)
  82     {
  83         if ($order == self::ORDER_ASC
  84               || $order == self::ORDER_DESC)
  85         {
  86             $this->order = $order;
  87         }
  88     }
  89     
  90     /**
  91      * Set the number of message per page (used for the desktop)
  92      *
  93      * @param int $numberOfPage number of message per page
  94      */
  95     public function setNumberOfMessagePerPage($numberOfPage)
  96     {
  97         $this->numberMessagePerPage = (int)$numberOfPage; 
  98     }
  99     
 100     /**
 101      * set the page to display
 102      *
 103      * @param int $page page to display
 104      */
 105     public function setPageToDisplay($page)
 106     {
 107         $this->pageToDisplay = $page;
 108     }
 109     
 110     /**
 111      * return the number of message per page
 112      *
 113      * @return int number of message per page
 114      */
 115     public function getNumberOfMessagePerPage()
 116     {
 117         return $this->numberMessagePerPage;
 118     }
 119     
 120     /**
 121      * return the part of the sql request to the pagination
 122      *
 123      * @return string the part of the sql request to limit results
 124      */
 125     public function getLimit()
 126     {
 127         if ($this->numberMessagePerPage <= 0)
 128         {
 129             throw new Exception("The number of message per page must be positif and not null");
 130         }
 131         
 132         if ($this->pageToDisplay <= 0)
 133         {
 134             throw new Exception("The page to display must be positif and not null");
 135         }
 136         
 137         return " LIMIT " . (int)($this->pageToDisplay - 1)*$this->numberMessagePerPage . ", " 
 138             . (int)$this->numberMessagePerPage."\n";
 139     }
 140     
 141     /**
 142      * return the part of the SQL request to order the result
 143      *
 144      * @return string Part of the SQL request to order the result
 145      */
 146     public function getOrder()
 147     {
 148         $orderString = $this->fieldOrder;
 149         $orderString = str_replace('%order%',$this->order,$orderString);
 150         return " ORDER BY ".$orderString."\n";
 151     }
 152 }

   1 <?php // $Id: receivedmessagestrategy.lib.php 12923 2011-03-03 14:23:57Z abourguignon $
   2 
   3 // vim: expandtab sw=4 ts=4 sts=4:
   4 
   5 /**
   6  * receivedmessagebox strategy class
   7  *
   8  * @version     1.9 $Revision: 12923 $
   9  * @copyright   (c) 2001-2011, Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL)
  10  * @author      Claroline Team <info@claroline.net>
  11  * @author      Christophe Mertens <thetotof@gmail.com>
  12  * @license     http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html
  13  *              GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE version 2 or later
  14  * @package     internal_messaging
  15  */
  16 
  17 //load messagestrategy class
  18 require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/messagestrategy.lib.php';
  19 
  20 class ReceivedMessageStrategy extends MessageStrategy 
  21 {
  22     const ONLY_READ = "R.is_read = 1";
  23     const ONLY_UNREAD = "R.is_read = 0";
  24     
  25     const ONLY_DELETED = "R.is_deleted = 1";
  26     const ONLY_NOT_DELETED = "R.is_deleted = 0";
  27 
  28     const SEARCH_SELECT = "CONCAT(U.prenom,' ',U.nom) LIKE '%%search%%' OR U.prenom LIKE '%%search%%' OR U.nom LIKE '%%search%%' OR M.subject LIKE '%%search%%' OR M.course LIKE '%%search%%'";
  29     
  30     const ORDER_BY_DATE = "M.send_time %order%";
  31     const ORDER_BY_SENDER = "U.nom %order%, U.prenom %order%";
  32 
  33     protected $readStrategy = self::NO_FILTER;
  34     protected $deletedStrategy = self::NO_FILTER;
  35     
  36     /**
  37      * set read strategy
  38      *
  39      * @param string $readStrategy
  40      *             accepted value: 
  41      *                 ReceivedMessageStrategy::ONLY_READ
  42      *                 ReceivedMessageStrategy::ONLY_UNREAD
  43      *                 MessageStrategy::NO_FILTER
  44      */
  45     public function setReadStrategy($readStrategy)
  46     {
  47         if ( $readStrategy == parent::NO_FILTER
  48             || $readStrategy == self::ONLY_READ
  49             || $readStrategy == self::ONLY_UNREAD)
  50         {
  51             $this->readStrategy = $readStrategy;
  52         }
  53     }
  54 
  55      /**
  56      * set deleted strategy
  57      *
  58      * @param string $deletedStrategy
  59      *             accepted value: 
  60      *                 ReceivedMessageStrategy::ONLY_DELETED
  61      *                 ReceivedMessageStrategy::ONLY_NOT_DELETED
  62      *                 MessageStrategy::NO_FILTER
  63      */
  64     public function setDeletedStrategy($deletedStrategy)
  65     {
  66         if ( $deletedStrategy == self::NO_FILTER
  67             || $deletedStrategy == self::ONLY_DELETED
  68             || $deletedStrategy == self::ONLY_NOT_DELETED)
  69         {
  70             $this->deletedStrategy = $deletedStrategy;
  71         }
  72     }
  73 
  74     /**
  75      * set the field order
  76      *
  77      * @param string $fieldOrder
  78      *         accepted value: ReceivedMessageStrategy::ORDER_BY_DATE
  79      *                         ReceivedMessageStrategy::ORDER_BY_SENDER
  80      */
  81     public function setFieldOrder($fieldOrder)
  82     {
  83         if ($fieldOrder == self::ORDER_BY_DATE
  84                 ||  $fieldOrder == self::ORDER_BY_SENDER)
  85         {
  86             $this->fieldOrder = $fieldOrder;    
  87         }
  88     }
  89     
  90     /**
  91      * return the conditions
  92      *
  93      * @return string conditions
  94      */
  95     public function getStrategy()
  96     {
  97         $condition = "";
  98         
  99         if ($this->readStrategy != self::NO_FILTER)
 100         {
 101             $condition .= " AND ".$this->readStrategy;
 102         }
 103         
 104         if ($this->deletedStrategy != self::NO_FILTER)
 105         {
 106             $condition .= " AND ".$this->deletedStrategy;
 107         }
 108         
 109         $this->search = trim($this->search);
 110         
 111         if ($this->search != "" && $this->search != "*")
 112         {
 113             $wordList = array();
 114             
 115             if ($this->searchStrategy == parent::SEARCH_STRATEGY_EXPRESSION)
 116             {
 117                 $wordList = array($this->search);
 118             }
 119             elseif ($this->searchStrategy == parent::SEARCH_STRATEGY_WORD)
 120             {
 121                 $wordList = preg_split('/\s+/',$this->search);
 122             }
 123             
 124             $searchCondition = "";
 125             
 126             foreach ($wordList as $key => $word)
 127             {
 128                 if ($searchCondition != "")
 129                 {
 130                     $searchCondition .= " OR ";
 131                 }
 132                 
 133                 $searchCondition .= str_replace('%search%',claro_sql_escape($word),self::SEARCH_SELECT)."\n";
 134             }
 135             
 136             $condition .= " AND (".$searchCondition.")";
 137         }
 138         
 139         return $condition;
 140     }
 141 }

   5 /**

  17 
  18     /**
  19      * create a argument string for a link
  20      *
  21      * @param array of string $paramList array of all argument
  22      * @param array of string $without array of argument name to don't add to the link
  23      * @return string arguments of the url
  24      */
  25     function makeArgLink($paramList,$without = array())
  26     {
  27         $argString = "";
  28         
  29         foreach ($paramList as $key => $arg)
  30         {
  31             if (!in_array($key, $without))
  32             {
  33                 if ($argString != "")
  34                 {
  35                     $argString .= "&amp;";
  36                 }
  37                 $argString .= $key."=".rawurlencode($arg);
  38             }
  39         }
  40     
  41         return $argString;
  42     }
  43     
  44     /**
  45      * return the HTML source for the menu bar (to navigate between message box)
  46      *
  47      * @param int $currentUserId user identification (the admin read message box of an other user)
  48      * @return string HTML source
  49      */
  50     function getBarMessageBox( $currentUserId, $currentSection )
  51     {
  52         require_once dirname(__FILE__) . '/messagebox/inbox.lib.php';
  53         
  54         $inboxWithoutFilter = new InBox($currentUserId);
  55 
  56         $sectionList = array(
  57             'inbox' => get_lang(get_lang('Inbox').'('.$inboxWithoutFilter->numberOfUnreadMessage().')'),
  58             'outbox' => get_lang('Outbox'),
  59             'trashbox' => get_lang('Trashbox')
  60         );
  61         
  62         if ( !in_array( $currentSection, array_keys( $sectionList ) ) )
  63         {
  64             $currentSection = 'inbox';
  65         }
  66         
  67         $parameter = array();
  68         
  69         if (isset($_REQUEST['userId']))
  70         {
  71             $parameter['userId'] = (int)$_REQUEST['userId'];
  72         }
  73         
  74         return claro_html_tab_bar($sectionList,$currentSection, $parameter, 'box', get_path('clarolineRepositoryWeb') . "messaging/messagebox.php");
  75     }
  76     
  77     /**
  78      * return true if the user in parameter is admin, false is the user in parameter is not admin
  79      *
  80      * @param int $userId
  81      * @return bool true if the user is admin
  82      *                 false if the user is not admin
  83      */
  84     function claro_is_user_platform_admin($userId)
  85     {
  86         static $uidAdmin = false;
  87 
  88         require_once get_path('incRepositorySys') . '/lib/user.lib.php';
  89 
  90         if ( ! $uidAdmin )
  91         {
  92             $uidAdmin = claro_get_uid_of_platform_admin();
  93         }
  94         
  95         return (in_array($userId,$uidAdmin));
  96     }
  97     
  98     /**
  99      * return true if the user in parameter is manager of the course in 2nd parameters
 100      *
 101      * @param int $userId user id
 102      * @param string $courseCode syscode du cours
 103      * @return boolean true if the user is manager of the course
 104      *                    false if the user is not manager of the course
 105      */
 106     function claro_is_user_course_manager($userId,$courseCode)
 107     {
 108         $tableName = get_module_main_tbl(array('rel_course_user'));
 109         
 110         $sql = "SELECT count(*)"
 111             ." FROM `".$tableName['rel_course_user']."`"
 112             ." WHERE code_cours = '" . claro_sql_escape($courseCode) . "'"
 113             ." AND user_id = " . (int)$userId
 114             ." AND isCourseManager = 1"
 115         ;
 116         
 117         return ( claro_sql_query_fetch_single_value($sql) > 0 );
 118     }
 119 
 120     /**
 121      * return the pager
 122      *
 123      * @param string $link link of the page to display(without page=x)
 124      * @param int $currentPage current page
 125      * @param int $totalPage number of page
 126      * @return string HTML source of the pager
 127      */
 128     function getPager($link,$currentPage,$totalPage)
 129     {
 130         // number of page to display in the page before and after thecurrent page
 131         $nbPageToDisplayBeforeAndAfterCurrentPage = 10;        
 132         
 133         $content = '<div id="im_paging">';
 134         
 135         // prepare list of page
 136         $beginPager = max(array(1,$currentPage-$nbPageToDisplayBeforeAndAfterCurrentPage));
 137         $endPager = min(array($totalPage,$currentPage+$nbPageToDisplayBeforeAndAfterCurrentPage));
 138         
 139         if ($beginPager != 1)
 140         {
 141             $content .= '&nbsp;<a href="'.$link.'1">1</a>'."\n";
 142             if ($beginPager-1 != 1)
 143             {
 144                 $content .= '...'."\n";
 145             }
 146         }
 147         
 148         for ($countPage = $beginPager; $countPage <= $endPager; $countPage++)
 149         {
 150             if ($countPage == $currentPage)
 151             {
 152                 $content .= $countPage."\n";
 153             }
 154             else
 155             {
 156                 $content .= '<a href="'.$link.$countPage.'">'.$countPage.'</a>'."\n";
 157             }
 158         }
 159         if ($endPager != $totalPage)
 160         {
 161             if ($endPager+1 != $totalPage)
 162             {
 163                 $content .= '...'."\n";
 164             }
 165             
 166             $content .= '<a href="'.$link.$totalPage.'">'.$totalPage.'</a>'."\n";
 167             
 168         }
 169         $content .= '</div>';
 170         
 171         return $content;
 172     }
